description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:** 
 R\&D Senior Member of Technical Staff
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Regular, full\-time, hybrid work arrangement
   

  

**The job**
 We are seeking a self\-driven Senior Software Engineer to help design and build the foundation that powers our industrial software portfolio in the cloud. You’ll work on Microsoft Azure to deliver scalable, secure, and high\-performing solutions that enable customers to reduce IT costs and accelerate digital transformation. This is a collaborative, fast\-paced environment where you’ll partner with architects and engineers to solve complex technical challenges while continuing to grow your cloud expertise.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and implement cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure, ensuring scalability, performance, and security
* Collaborate with architects and engineers to deliver infrastructure and data solutions aligned with business and compliance requirements
* Evaluate system architecture, perform risk analysis, and implement mitigation strategies
* Implement secure development practices and support compliance and security\-related activities
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system designs and implementation artifacts
* Mentor/guide junior engineers on routine issues / Review junior engineer’s work/delivery
* Continuously grow your technical skills in an environment of rapidly evolving technology
* Owns project deliveries, procedures and designs within the role


**Essential Requirements**
* 7\+ years of strong software development experience in C\# (.NET), React.js, WEB/REST API’s, SQL servers
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing cloud solutions, preferably on Azure
* Hands\-on / Familiarity with Azure Functions, App Services, Service Fabric, Networking, Storage technologies and Auth0/Identity server concepts
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and containerized environments
* Hands\-on / Familiarity with security tools / SDL process
* Familiarity with IaaS/SaaS/PaaS architecture and microservice architecture
* Familiarity in migrating projects from legacy to latest technologies
* Solid understanding of cloud architecture, Infrastructure as a Service, microservices, networking, and authentication/authorization concepts
* Strong understanding of secure software development practices, including threat modeling
* Good communication skills, working with a broad range of people, including Architects and Testers.


**Desired Skills And Competencies**
* Curiosity to explore emerging cloud and security technologies and apply them effectively (Curiosity)
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to deliver secure, scalable solutions to complex challenges (Impact)
* Effective collaboration and communication when working with customers and cross\-functional teams (Trust)
* Ability to manage priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining high\-quality outcomes (Aspiration)


**R\&D at AVEVA**
 Our global team of 2000\+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
   

  

 Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r\-and\-d\-careers/
   

  

**India Benefits include:**
 Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support
   

  

 It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
   

  

**Hybrid working**
 We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
   

  

**Hiring process**
 Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process
   

  

**About AVEVA**
 AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
   

  

 We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/
   

  

 Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
   

  

 AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third\-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
   

  

 AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case\-by\-case basis.

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team


NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.


**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH**


You will be reporting to the Engineering Manager at Geographies \& Marketplace Experiences \- India Technology Center, who will guide you to grow and build your career path. You will be directly working within a team of dedicated engineers that work on the same solutions. You share your experience and technical expertise such that we improve on the longer\-term technical strategic direction.


**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**


If you’re ready to innovate and lead in the Digital world, join Nike’s Global Technology \- Geographies And Marketplace Experiences Organization. We bring together technology and process expertise to deliver the next generation of applications for Stores team. You are responsible for building next generation tools and services that serve our Athletes with Cart and checkout capability within stores. We are in the process of modernizing and scaling our in\-store applications, building scalable applications and services in the cloud. This is a team that’s always on the offense, working on innovative solutions and building world class solutions to serve Nike teams and consumers around the globe.


As a Technical Lead for the Geographies \& Marketplace Experiences team, you will be part of a mission critical team focused on building a high\-throughput, low\-latency, fault\-tolerant Retail Stores Cloud Checkout that drives Nike’s Digital transformation and growth strategies.


* A minimum of 8\+ years software development experience.
* Experience working in a highly collaborative, multi\-discipline development team environment
* Experience working in a distributed/cloud\-based environment (e.g. AWS Services, GCE, Azure etc.)
* Experience in micro service architecture, domain driven design, and RESTful Services using Java and Spring Boot framework mandatorily.
* Demonstrate an AI\-first mindset, actively leveraging AI powered developer tools (e.g., Cursor) to accelerate development and learning.
* Experience in micro service architecture, domain driven design, and RESTful Services using languages such as Java
* Experience in Test Driven development – with Junit, Mockito, cucumber, Playwright etc.,
* Experience with monitoring and tracing tools like Splunk, SignalFx, Kibana/Grafana etc.
* Experience working with NoSQL data stores like DynamoDB and relational data stores like MySQL, Oracle etc.
* Experience with continuous integration, unit testing, static analysis, and automated integration tests. Continuous delivery experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of Scrum and agile principles.
* Working in a fast\-paced, results\-oriented environment with globally distributed and diverse teams
* Demonstrate end\-to\-end ownership of project/capabilities that includes requirements evaluation, design, implementation, code reviews, observability, maintenance and support.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and collaboration skills to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or other relevant subject area, or equivalent experience
* Experience with CI/CD (**Jenkins**) and engineering hygiene: **GitHub** workflows (branching, PR reviews, code quality, collaboration) and release readiness
* Observability and operational readiness using **Splunk** and **SignalFx**, including monitoring and alerting

The following would be nice\-to\-have:


* Experience in designing and implementing highly scalable web applications
* Exposure to Stores application areas like Point of Sale

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**


As a Technical lead, you will be part of the Stores Retail Cloud Checkout Engineering team, which is responsible for building next generation tools and services that serve consumer to checkout from Nike Retail Stores and support back\-end teams.


In this role, you will


* Contribute on Application Architecture and Design, technical development and delivery of backend cloud native micro services
* Contribute ideas for new features and identifying technical areas for improvement proactively collaborating with product team members at Nike to design, develop, and deploy a highly scalable digital asset management system and services.
* Contribute to define solution options, provide estimates on effort and risks, and evaluate technical feasibility.
* Strong skills in team leadership and building collaborative relationships with team members and stakeholders
* Define standards and guidelines to ensure quality of the code
* Review application architecture, Design, application code, Test cases, Test Automation Scripts and Test Reports to ensure quality deliverables
* You will use your in\-depth experience in software development to write clean, tested, and well\-documented code, as well as perform peer code review process and mentor other engineers on the team.
* You will remain current with industry trends and participate in development of key innovation features.
* You will support the team’s agile practices, promoting continuous improvement and collaboration to deliver top\-notch in\-store applications.
* Leverage GenAI powered capabilities (RAG, prompt driven workflows, MCP and spec driven architectures) to deliver faster, scalable, intelligent capabilities \& experiences
* Ensure quality of the code and products throughout the entire development lifecycle (DevOps)
* Ensure continuous improvement in performance, scalability, extensibility, reliability, usability, and availability of the platform
* Leverage agile methodology concepts for quality, delivery and continuous improvement
* Participate in sprint planning and other scrum ceremonies. Help team plan and execute sprint tickets
* Work in full DevOps model in the entire tech stack including designing, implementing, deploying, monitoring, and operating services at scale
* Resolve technical issues and remove blockers for the team
* Actively participate in code review and feedback for other developers
* Own build, test, release, and production support for team‑owned capabilities, ensuring stability, incident resolution, and continuous improvement
* Implement strong observability and operational readiness using **Splunk** and **SignalFx**, including monitoring and alerting
NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.


NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

**PLATFORM LEAD – COMMERCETOOLS** **We are looking for a Platform lead – Commercetools to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital \& Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.** **Position Snapshot:**  

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

 **The Role:** *The Platform Lead for Commercetools and help shape the future of Nespresso’s global digital commerce ecosystem. You will be the subject matter expert for**commercetools, a core platform supporting our direct\-to\-customer business**across**40 markets.**Working with technology, architecture, product,**engineering**and business teams, you will guide platform evolution, reliability, security,**compliance**and adoption.* *Key responsibilities of the Commerce Platform Lead:** *Own the strategic direction of the**commercetools**platform, acting as Nespresso**’**s subject matter expert and primary point of connection with the vendor. Build a strong partnership with**commercetools, influence roadmap conversations, assess new**capabilities**and translate platform opportunities into clear business value.*
* *Drive platform health, reliability,**security**and compliance across the global digital commerce ecosystem. Partner with architecture,**engineering**and operations teams to ensure**commercetools**remains**scalable,**resilient**and aligned with Nestl**é* *standards as the platform evolves.*
* *Accelerate platform adoption by enabling teams to use**commercetools**effectively and consistently. Strengthen documentation, training, best**practices**and developer experience so product and engineering teams can move faster while**maintaining**quality and governance.*

  

**In This Role, You Will:**  

* Conduct regular alignment sessions with commercetools to understand newly released capabilities and future roadmap items.
* Identify opportunities for Nespresso to influence and benefit from the commercetools roadmap.
* Partner closely with the re\-architecture team, Head of eCommerce Technology, development teams and commercetools.
* Ensure commercetools solutions, including Merchant Center, Frontend Studio and Connectors, have robust upgrade and compliance plans.
* Collaborate with reliability engineering teams to monitor platform health.
* Drive adoption of new platform capabilities across product and engineering teams.
* Support knowledge sharing through documentation, training and platform best practices.
* Act as the go\-to subject matter expert for commercetools across the organization.

 **What We’re Looking For:**  

* 10\+ years of professional experience.
* 5\+ years of experience within digital commerce, eCommerce technology or platform leadership roles.
* Demonstrated hands\-on or platform leadership experience with commercetools is required.
* Proven experience leading a digital commerce platform and engaging with technical, product and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of reliability, scalability, security and compliance principles.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Fluent business English.

 **Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**  

* Have experience with MACH, composable commerce or other headless commerce platforms.
* Can bridge technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Have strong experience with agile delivery models.
* Have worked in global environments and virtual teams.

 **We Offer You:**  

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state\-of\-the\-art campus is equipped with areas to co\-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic \& inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

 **The Hiring Process:*** **Your Application:** Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* **Initial Screening:** Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* **Hiring Manager Interview:** Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.
* **Stakeholder Interview:** Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration.
* **Leadership \& HRBP Interaction:** Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team \& HRBP.
* **Feedback:** After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* **Job Offer:** Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* **First Working Day:** Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

 **About Nespresso:**  

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.  

Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.  

We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net\-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.
In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.  

*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*
People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together
Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.
**Join Nestlé \#beaforceforgood**

Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our mission is to enable effective financial decisions through reliable data, increased efficiency, and automation. We support Marketing, Sales, Seller, Accounting, Tax, Finance and Strategy (F\&S), Finance Operations (FinOps), and Treasury functions across automation, data insights, and process improvements.
   

  

 You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas including
   

  

 Seller Systems — Responsible for building the systems and tooling that make sellers and internal revenue teams at Stripe dramatically more productive and effective. We partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product to deliver a single "plane of glass" selling experience that spans deal creation and modeling, negotiation and approvals, contracting, onboarding, and activation. The Seller Systems team composes first‑party, custom Stripe components with best‑in‑class third‑party business systems to deliver configurable, auditable, and globally scalable workflows. Engineers on Seller Systems build services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and internal UIs that power seller productivity, reduce time‑to‑activation, improve deal velocity, and enable AI‑driven assistive workflows. Use cases include deal modeling and pricing engines, approval and orchestration platforms, CLM/CPQ integrations, onboarding automation, seller analytics, and AI‑assisted seller tooling.
   

  

 Finance Engineering — Responsible for building the robust and scalable infrastructure that powers the company's core financial operations, including payments processing, fund settlement, accounting, and business intelligence. The Finance Engineering team is at the core of Stripe to empower business\-critical financial domains including Accounting, Finance operations, Finance and Strategy, and Treasury. Engineers on the Financial Engineering team build platforms, data pipelines, and financial products for the Finance team. The use cases include financial analytics and insights, accounting automation, auditing, financial planning and forecasting, and financial business intelligence.
   

  

 Marketing and Sales Systems — Responsible for building the most measurable, cross\-channel messaging capability possible, to attract and engage customers. We do this through scalable motions, with the most relevant messaging and increasing reach of our marketing motions. We are a cross\-functional team of engineers, analysts, marketers, and product managers that deliver the insights, internal systems and tools that fuel growth at Stripe.
   

  

 As part of the Marketing Systems team, you own systems that power go\-to\-market motions productizing gathered insights and intelligence. This includes building tools that 1/ power better digital experiences, 2/ accelerate customer journey with intelligent orchestrations, 3/ drive smarter decisions with CDP, and 4/ improve marketer and seller productivity.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 We're looking for Software Engineers who want to make an impact on managing money at a global scale with a passion for building ergonomic APIs. You'll play a key role in extending our balance management platform and in building out a new funds accessibility platform leveraged by enterprises and SMBs alike. Our team collaborates with many cross\-functional teams — from Infrastructure to Product — at Stripe to deliver innovative solutions that address evolving user needs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain beautiful, robust, and high\-performance APIs and services
* Ensure our infrastructure is extensible, scalable, reliable, and meets service\-level agreements for both external and internal users
* Hide complexity from our users behind simple yet powerful abstractions
* Partner closely with other engineers, analysts, and scientists to build highly scalable systems, to deliver delightful developer experiences and comprehensive interfaces
* Build the APIs that power internal stakeholder\-facing UI experiences, defining composable data models and durable interfaces
* Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack with an eye towards improving maintainability over the long term
* Improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 8\+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating large\-scale, high\-performance APIs and services
* You have implemented server\-side APIs in dynamic languages like Ruby, working with document and relational datastores (especially Mongo and MySQL) and enjoy spelunking through new datasets (especially in systems like Redshift, Presto, or Trino).
* Empathetic, collaborative, and user\-first mindset in everything you build and have excellent oral and written communication
* Experience proactively seeking feedback from users, teammates, and subject matter experts
* The skills to build holistically — from specs and documentation to implementation, testing, deployment, and measuring impact and ability to balance speed, complexity, and scope in service of user needs


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with large\-scale financial tracking systems
* Good understanding and practical knowledge in cloud\-based services (e.g. gRPC, GraphQL, Docker and Kubernetes, cloud services such as AWS, etc.)
* Experience in marketing domain building products that contribute to marketing tech stack
* Experience with machine learning, recommender systems, product\-led growth, or lifecycle marketing
* Prior experience building distributed systems or a microservices architecture


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 We believe collective knowledge drives exceptional support. While our content currently serves a functional purpose, we are ready to elevate it into a true strategic asset. Nutanix is committed to delivering a proactive, customer\-first experience by "shifting left"—empowering our customers with the right answers at the exact moment of need.
   

  

 We are seeking experienced Content and Knowledge Manager(s) to lead this evolution. In this role, you will align cross\-functional teams, leverage your technical expertise, and execute a knowledge strategy that turns our ecosystem into a powerful, customer\-enablement engine.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will be a key player in our global Support organization, reporting directly to the head of the Support Project Management Office (PMO) responsible for Strategy and Innovation. Our mission is to scale operational efficiency and elevate customer satisfaction in every interaction. We value action and collaboration, giving you the runway to lead knowledge strategies that make a tangible impact.
   

  

 Your Role
   

  

 As the Content \& Knowledge Manager, you will transform how technical information flows across the organization. Treating knowledge as a strategic asset, you will partner with our Support Engineers and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to build best\-in\-class knowledge programs.
   

  

 By championing AI and automation, governing the documentation lifecycle, and optimizing relevance and findability, you will scale our knowledge operations. Ultimately, your work will directly empower support teams, drive self\-service, and enhance the overall Nutanix customer experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Knowledge \& Program Strategy: Design and automate workflows that improve content accessibility, Knowledge Base (KB) performance, and scale support delivery. Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on data\-driven insights, user feedback, and modern KM frameworks (e.g. Knowledge\-Centered Success (KCS)).
* Content Lifecycle Management: Oversee the end\-to\-end lifecycle of technical documentation, KB articles, and interactive assets. Empower and educate Support Engineers and SMEs to capture knowledge seamlessly, ensuring all assets align with global Support goals and compliance standards.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary bridge between Support, IT, Product Management, and Engineering teams. Lead knowledge readiness and facilitate communication around content roadmaps to ensure seamless collaboration and frictionless knowledge sharing.
* Metrics \& Analytics: Develop reporting frameworks to analyze KB utilization, content value, and effectiveness. Quantify the impact of your programs on scaling Assisted Support, driving self\-service success, and improving overall Nutanix Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Optimization: Continually optimize knowledge architecture and searchability. Implement industry best practices and leverage AI\-driven search and chat capabilities to ensure the right information reaches the right user at the exact moment of need.


 What You Will Bring
   

  

* Experience: 5\+ years of combined experience in Knowledge Management, Technical Program Management, or Technical Writing within a complex enterprise software, SaaS, or global Technical Support environment.
* Technical Acumen: Exceptional ability to distill complex technical concepts into clear, actionable project plans. Proven experience partnering with engineering and IT/SaaS teams and subject matter experts (SMEs) to scale operations and deliver results.
* Tool Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with enterprise KM systems, CRM platforms (ex: Salesforce, ServiceNow), and collaborative tools (e.g. Slack, Confluence, Jira). Familiarity with CMS platforms and enterprise search or AI\-driven KM technologies/techniques.
* Operational Excellence: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on scaling operations. Familiarity with industry KM frameworks, ITIL, or continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma).
* Project \& Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to drive alignment and influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority. Excellent organizational skills to manage competing priorities and drive programmatic initiatives from conception to execution.
* Education \& Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Technical Communications, or a related field. Certifications in KCSv6, PMP, or Agile Scrum are highly preferred.


 Work Arrangement
   

  

 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

description:
Role: SE II \- Fullstack
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better.
   

  

 As a SE II \- Fullstack in our Engineering department, you’ll have the chance to:
   

  

 Design and develop end to end software components and systems from ground up and have ownership of them. You will have the opportunity to utilize a variety of latest Web application frameworks, Big Data technologies, Angular/React UI frameworks. You will be part of agile teams that utilizes CI and CD pipelines to speed up the products’ time to market. You will have an opportunity to work on different tech stacks comprising Java, Python, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Spark, Qubole and many others to satiate your tech buds!
   

  

 Who are your stakeholders?
   

  

 Key stakeholders include the Product Leads of various products, Leads of various teams across Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Trading departments.
   

  

 What you’ll bring
   

  

* 2\-4 years experience developing with an Object Oriented Language (Java, C\+\+).
* Excellent grasp of at least one language.
* Excellent understanding of algorithm \& data structures.
* Good knowledge of the Linux environment.
* Good understanding of UI technologies such as Javascript, jQuery, AngularJS, ReactJS.
* Good understanding of multi\-tier web applications, experience working on all layers of the stack is a plus.
* Exposure to HLD, LLD
* Good understanding of Distributed systems is a plus.
* Good understanding of cloud environments such as AWS, Google Cloud or Azure is a plus
* Hands on product development experience using Java or Kotlin and good understanding of Microservices architecture.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.


 We’ve highlighted some key skills, experience and requirements for this role. But please don’t worry if you don’t meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that’s a fit for this role, or another opportunity at MiQ.
   

  

 If you have a passion for the role, please still apply.
   

  

 What impact will you create?
   

  

 You will identify \& evangelize frameworks and methodologies for building highly available, high\-performance systems. You ensure that design/architecture documents incorporate these practices and introduce new tools and methodologies when appropriate to simplify or increase efficiency of development. You’ll drive evaluation of new tools via POCs and continuously evaluate how the team operates in different areas of software engineering. You will Initiate changes necessary to move the team a step higher in adopting best practices and critique the software product design and architecture and contribute to its evolution from the inception. What’s in it for you?
   

  

 Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it’s where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact across our entire global business.
   

  

 MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.
   

  

 Values
   

  

 Our values are so much more than statements. They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone, so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do \- no matter how big or small.
   

  

* We do what we love \- Passion
* We figure it out \- Determination
* We anticipate the unexpected \- Agility
* We always unite \- Unite
* We dare to be unconventional \- Courage


**Benefits**
 Every region and office have specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect:
   

  

* A hybrid work environment
* New hire orientation with job specific onboarding and training
* Internal and global mobility opportunities
* Competitive healthcare benefits
* Bonus and performance incentives
* Generous annual PTO paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives.
* Employee resource groups designed to connect people across all MiQ regions, drive action, and support our communities.


 Apply today!
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer

description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 








  


**Your New Role**
**:**
  
 



 As an
 **App Developer \- AI/ML** 
 at one of the largest global Media \& Entertainment companies, you will play a crucial role in building and optimizing cutting\-edge applications powered by Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. In this exciting and dynamic environment, you will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the creation of innovative solutions that transform content delivery, user experiences, and engagement. Your work will empower millions of users around the world and support the business in staying at the forefront of technological advancements.
 







 You will be part of a talented, forward\-thinking team working with the latest tools and technologies to develop scalable, high\-performance AI/ML\-powered applications. If you are passionate about AI and ML, have a strong app development background, and are eager to create impactful applications, this is the perfect opportunity for you to join an industry\-leading organization that thrives on innovation.
 











  


**1\. AI/ML Application Development** 



* Design, develop, and maintain AI/ML\-powered applications that enhance the company's core services and customer\-facing products.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI/ML models into mobile and web applications seamlessly.
* Ensure that AI/ML features in applications are scalable, high\-performing, and reliable, meeting the demands of millions of users.
* Build and optimize mobile and web interfaces for AI\-powered functionalities, such as personalized content recommendations, intelligent search, and dynamic content creation.
* Implement end\-to\-end app solutions by incorporating data pipelines, machine learning models, and real\-time data processing.



  


**2\. AI/ML Model Integration \& Optimization** 



* Collaborate with data scientists and AI/ML engineers to integrate machine learning models into mobile/web platforms and ensure they work seamlessly across multiple devices.
* Conduct optimization of AI/ML models for high\-performance deployment, reducing latency and enhancing the user experience.
* Implement techniques like transfer learning, deep learning, and reinforcement learning to improve model performance and overall system efficiency.
* Monitor and troubleshoot deployed AI models within applications to ensure continuous improvement and enhancement.
* Contribute to model versioning, model rollback strategies, and performance tuning in production environments.



  


**3\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Work closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, and business teams to ensure AI features align with customer needs and business objectives.
* Partner with software engineers, data scientists, and AI architects to align on the architecture, design, and functionality of AI\-driven features.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions by applying a deep understanding of AI/ML technologies.
* Communicate technical challenges and solutions effectively to non\-technical stakeholders and business leaders.
* Contribute to brainstorming and ideation sessions for new features or apps that leverage AI/ML technologies.



  


**4\. Continuous Improvement \& Innovation** 



* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest AI/ML trends, tools, and technologies to ensure the app development process is innovative and competitive.
* Experiment with new frameworks, technologies, and AI methods to enhance the functionality and performance of applications.
* Regularly evaluate the performance of AI\-powered applications and contribute ideas for optimization and future improvements.
* Collaborate with the team to resolve any application issues and refine features based on user feedback and testing results.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of development practices by introducing new approaches or optimizing current processes.



  


**5\. Quality Assurance \& Testing** 



* Ensure that all AI/ML applications are tested thoroughly and function as intended across all supported platforms (mobile, web, etc.).
* Develop unit tests, integration tests, and other quality assurance measures for AI\-powered app features.
* Debug and resolve issues related to performance, scalability, and security in applications.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and internal guidelines for coding practices, security, and data privacy.
* Take ownership of the deployment process, ensuring smooth application launches and versioning management.



  


**Qualifications \& Experiences:**




  


**Academic Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
* Specialized certifications in AI/ML or app development technologies are a plus.



  


**Professional Experience:** 



* **3\+ years** 
  of experience in app development with a strong focus on integrating AI/ML technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML application development, including model integration, real\-time inference, and deployment.
* Proficient in developing mobile and web applications using modern development frameworks (e.g., React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Django, Flask).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and integrating AI models within cloud\-native applications.
* Experience with AI/ML libraries and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and Scikit\-learn, with the ability to optimize and scale models in production.



  


**Technical Skills:** 



* **AI \& Machine Learning Expertise**
* **Deep Learning Frameworks** 
  – Experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or JAX for training and fine\-tuning models.
* **Generative Models** 
  – Knowledge of transformers (GPT, BERT, LLaMA), diffusion models (Stable Diffusion, DALL·E), and VAEs.
* **Prompt Engineering** 
  – Ability to craft effective prompts and optimize LLM responses.
* **Model Fine\-Tuning \& Optimization** 
  – Experience in LoRA, PEFT (Parameter Efficient Fine\-Tuning), RLHF (Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback).
* **NLP \& Computer Vision** 
  – Depending on the application (text, images, or multimodal AI).



  


**Full\-Stack Development** 



* **Frontend Technologies** 
  – React, Next.js, Vue.js for web apps; Swift/Kotlin for mobile apps.
* **Backend Development** 
  – Node.js, Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django), or Go for API development.
* **Database Management** 
  – NoSQL (MongoDB, Firebase), SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* **API Integration** 
  – Experience with OpenAI API, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Google Gemini, etc.



  


**Cloud \& DevOps** 



* **Cloud Platforms** 
  – AWS (SageMaker, Lambda), Google Cloud (Vertex AI), Azure (OpenAI services).
* **Containerization \& Deployment** 
  – Docker, Kubernetes for scalable AI services.
* **MLOps \& CI/CD** 
  – GitHub Actions, MLflow, Kubeflow for continuous model integration and monitoring.



  


**Other Skills:** 



* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for app development.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* A collaborative mindset with a focus on working in teams and driving projects forward in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Passion for AI and its transformative role in the Media \& Entertainment industry.



















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**

**About The Job**
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
   

  

 The Knowledge Catalog team owns core search infrastructure and search quality frameworks, powering the discovery of billions of assets for Google employees. The mission is to make google's internal data discoverable for both Google employees and agentic workflows.

 The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365, all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors, including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil, and Goldman Sachs, and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

**We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @rippling.com addresses.**
**About Monetization Platform**
 The Monetization Platform team owns the systems behind how Rippling
 ****sells, contracts, bills, collects, and recognizes revenue****
 across products and countries.
   

  

 The team owns the platform behind the complete monetization lifecycle:
   

  

****Quote → Contract → Entitlement → Subscription → Usage → Bill → Revenue****
 These systems support a
 ****$1B\+ sales base****
 , manage entitlements, metering, and usage\-based billing rules, and enable localized billing as Rippling launches into new countries.
   

  

 As Rippling continues to introduce new products, pricing models, packaging structures, and markets, the Monetization Platform provides the common infrastructure that allows teams to move quickly without rebuilding monetization logic each time.
   

  

 Our vision is simple:
   

  

*****Let any team monetize any product, anywhere, without writing code.*****
 This is a platform for engineers who enjoy solving foundational problems where correctness matters, abstractions need to last, and the impact extends far beyond a single product or team.
   

  

****The opportunity****
* Rippling's product portfolio is expanding rapidly across HR, IT, Finance, and new product categories.
* Every new product introduces monetization complexity: what a customer purchased, what they are entitled to use, how their subscription evolves, how usage should be measured, what they should be charged, how payments are collected, and how that activity is ultimately reflected in financial systems.
* We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the next generation of Rippling's Monetization Platform.
* You will own broad, ambiguous, multi\-team technical charters spanning contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows.
* You will work on systems where errors are expensive. Incorrect contract state, entitlement state, usage calculations, invoices, payments, taxes, or revenue records can directly affect customers, financial accuracy, and trust.
* This role combines:
* 
+ Hands\-on backend and platform engineering
+ Org\-level architectural leadership
+ Technical leadership and mentorship
+ Cross\-functional influence across Engineering, Product, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Payments, Security, and Data

* You will define architecture, make difficult technical tradeoffs, align teams around durable solutions, mentor technical leaders, and help build a platform that allows Rippling to monetize new products and markets faster and with greater confidence.
* This is not an architecture\-only role. You will stay close to execution through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation\-level technical decisions.


**What You'll Own**
* Own major technical charters across CPQ, contracts, entitlements, subscriptions, usage metering, billing, invoicing, payments, tax, compliance, and revenue workflows.
* Define architecture for systems requiring strong guarantees around data integrity, auditability, reliability, recoverability, and clear ownership across service boundaries.
* Design durable platform abstractions that allow product teams to introduce new packaging, pricing, entitlement, metered billing, subscription, and contract models without building custom one\-off solutions.
* Lead multi\-team initiatives from problem definition and architecture through technical design, execution, migration, launch, and long\-term operational ownership.
* Define clear service boundaries, APIs, data models, ownership models, and failure\-handling strategies across interconnected monetization systems.
* Make high\-quality technical tradeoffs across correctness, scalability, performance, cost, compliance, maintainability, and delivery speed.
* Stay hands\-on through design reviews, code reviews, debugging, prototyping, production investigations, and implementation\-level decisions.
* Partner closely with Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, Payments, Platform, Security, Data, and product engineering teams.
* Identify systemic technical risks early and drive alignment on durable solutions, particularly where customer trust or financial accuracy is at stake.
* Establish engineering standards for critical monetization systems, including testing, observability, incident learning, migration safety, rollout mechanisms, and operational readiness.
* Mentor Staff, Senior, and mid\-level engineers and help grow technical leadership across the organization.
* Raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment, thoughtful design reviews, clear technical writing, and operational excellence.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Platform leverage: Product teams can launch new products, pricing structures, packaging models, entitlement models, and usage\-based offerings without rebuilding core monetization infrastructure.
* Correctness and trust: Critical contract, entitlement, subscription, billing, payment, tax, and revenue workflows maintain a high standard of data integrity, auditability, and reliability.
* Clear architectural boundaries: Monetization capabilities have well\-defined ownership, APIs, data contracts, and service boundaries, reducing coupling and one\-off implementations.
* Faster product and market expansion: New products and country launches can adopt common monetization capabilities rather than creating bespoke billing and entitlement systems.
* Operational excellence: Critical monetization systems have strong observability, safe migration patterns, effective incident learning, and clear operational ownership.
* Technical leadership: Engineers across teams look to you for architectural guidance, difficult technical decisions, and direction on complex cross\-system problems.
* Stronger technical leaders: Staff, Senior, and mid\-level engineers around you develop greater technical judgment, ownership, and ability to lead increasingly complex initiatives.


**What We're Looking For**
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, preferably across backend engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, product engineering, or systems engineering.
* Proven experience operating at Senior Staff, Principal Engineer, or equivalent Staff\+ scope.
* Deep hands\-on engineering foundation with strong coding, debugging, system design, and production ownership experience.
* Experience building and operating large\-scale distributed systems with demanding reliability, observability, and data correctness requirements.
* Strong architecture depth across APIs, databases, data modeling, concurrency, event\-driven systems, service boundaries, reliability, performance, failure modes, and long\-term maintainability.
* Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous, cross\-functional, multi\-team technical initiatives from definition through production ownership.
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to make tradeoffs across product needs, business constraints, engineering quality, and long\-term platform direction.
* Ability to influence senior engineers, product leaders, and cross\-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Strong mentorship record and a track record of raising the technical bar for engineers around you.
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining complex technical decisions to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Comfort operating in fast\-paced, high\-ambiguity environments.
* Deep backend programming experience in one or more languages. Python and Django experience is a strong plus.


****Bonus points****
* Experience building monetization, entitlement, metered or usage\-based billing, subscription, pricing, payments, accounting, revenue, tax, or fintech systems.
* Experience building internal platforms used by multiple product engineering teams.
* Experience working in SaaS, enterprise software, HR technology, payroll, compliance, workflow\-heavy domains, or high\-growth product companies.
* Experience with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases.
* Experience with reliability engineering, incident response, performance tuning, observability, and operational excellence.
* Experience with security, permissions, auditability, compliance, or enterprise\-grade controls.
* A builder\-leader mindset: someone who can define direction, align stakeholders, establish durable architecture, and remain close to execution.

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a skilled content developer to support a range of training programs and digital learning initiatives. This role will assist in instructional design to enhance e\-learning content, analyze learning data, and work closely with key stakeholders to improve the effectiveness of digital learning. This position will also be responsible for managing and delivering new hire onboarding and department specific trainings to employees through the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring a seamless and user\-friendly experience for learners, instructors, and administrators.
   

  

 This position works in the Talent Management and Learning COE and reports to the Senior LMS Team Lead who is based in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
**E\-Learning Development \& Instructional Design:**
* Design and develop end\-to\-end courseware, including interactive eLearning modules, instructor\-led training materials, simulations, videos, and assessments aligned with defined learning objectives, using tools like Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, and similar platforms.
* Create and refine clear, engaging instructional content—including scripts, storyboards, assignments, and assessments—by converting SME\-provided content and technical documentation into learner\-ready training materials aligned with established learning frameworks such as ADDIE and Bloom’s Taxonomy. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop, implement, and maintain e\-learning courses and training materials.
* Conduct rigorous quality reviews of training content to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with instructional design and industry standards.
* Maintain and manage content updates, version control, and archival processes to ensure training materials remain current and relevant.


**LMS Administration And Support**
* Administer and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS) for a large user base, ensuring smooth operation and a user\-friendly experience.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for global new hires, managing the end\-to\-end onboarding training process and implementing automation to enhance efficiency.
* Coordinate and manage Instructor\-Led Training (ILT) sessions, including scheduling, attendance tracking, learner record updates, and communication with instructors and learners.
* Provide prompt and responsive technical support to learners, instructors, and stakeholders, resolving LMS\-related issues.
* Maintain and organize learning content within the LMS, SharePoint, and content repositories and ensure alignment of content structure across sites, programs, and folders
* Monitor enrollments, completions, and system usage metrics for accuracy and to ensure data integrity within the LMS.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Create detailed reports and dashboards to measure learner engagement, track course completions, and evaluate training effectiveness.
* Assist with compliance tracking and meet regulatory reporting obligations through accurate data analysis and documentation.
* Keep abreast of emerging trends and best practices in instructional design and e\-learning technologies.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by incorporating learner feedback and performance data to introduce creative and innovative solutions that enhance engagement and optimize the overall learning experience.


**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**
* Keep abreast of emerging trends and best practices in instructional design and e\-learning technologies.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by incorporating learner feedback and performance data to introduce creative and innovative solutions that enhance engagement and optimize the overall learning experience.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Instructional Technology, Information Systems, or a closely related discipline.
* 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in training, instructional design, learning experience design, or content development, ideally in a global or multicultural work environment.
* Proficient in using eLearning development tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Suite, Vyond, or other instructional technologies.
* Strong understanding of adult learning theories and instructional design principles.
* Familiarity with e\-learning standards including SCORM and xAPI.
* Proficient in data analysis and report generation using Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working with enterprise learning management systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms (i.e. Cornerstone, Docebo).
* Strong graphic design and multimedia development skills, supported by hands\-on proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and video editing tools, are highly desirable.
* Proficient in writing clear and engaging instructional content, including copy, video/audio scripts, and learning materials.
* Ability to develop storyboards and design visual layouts for instructional content and user interfaces.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders across the globe.


**Key Competencies**
* Innovation: Creative and innovative mindset, capable of designing engaging and impactful learning solutions.
* Adaptability: Adaptable and responsive to evolving priorities and constructive feedback in a fast\-paced environment.

* Planning and Organizing: Effective time management and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.
* Work Standards / Details Quality: High attention to detail in reviewing content for quality, accuracy, and alignment with learning goals.

You will collaborate with product owners, UX designers, engineers, and QA teams to create innovative components and workflows, leveraging GenAI tools to enhance productivity and user experience.
 



 In this role, you will contribute to both front\-end and back\-end development, ensuring the platform performs optimally across all modern browsers and devices. You will also participate in the design and implementation of modular, maintainable, and high\-performance microservices that power our platform. The ideal candidate is product\-focused, passionate about solving complex problems, and committed to driving Marriott value through cutting\-edge technology solutions.

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high\-performance web applications and reusable component libraries using React, TypeScript, and Next.js.

* Participate in and lead code reviews, ensuring adherence to engineering best practices, coding standards, security guidelines, and maintainable software design principles.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex production issues through structured root\-cause analysis, while continuously improving application stability, reliability, and performance.
* Mentor and coach junior engineers by promoting engineering best practices, modern frontend development techniques, effective use of AI\-assisted development tools, and continuous learning.
* Stay current with emerging frontend technologies, cloud\-native architectures, AI innovations, and industry best practices, proactively recommending improvements that enhance engineering capabilities.

* Follows the defined project management standards and processes

* Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests using frameworks such as Jest, Jasmine, Mocha, JUnit with Mockito, Cypress, or Playwright.

**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU** 



* 5\+ years of experience designing and developing enterprise software using Microsoft technologies.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* 5\+ years of experience with C\# and .NET Core.
* 5\+ years of experience with RESTful API design and development.
* 3\+ years of experience parsing and processing JSON, XML, HTML, and SQL.
* 3\+ years of experience with data import/export systems and complex data transformations.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Tax Platform
description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Rippling's Tax Platform is one of only \~5 companies globally that owns the full tax calculation and filing stack. We process over $30 billion in annual payroll for 1 million\+ employees—growing 50% year\-over\-year. Our systems handle millions of payroll transactions across multiple countries, ensuring tax correctness across 4,000\+ jurisdictions while staying compliant with constantly changing tax regulations.
   

  

 We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who takes ownership of complex problems, designs robust systems, and delivers high\-quality solutions that directly impact millions of tax calculations.
   

  

****Why This Role****
****Rare Opportunity****
 You'd be joining one of only \~5 companies in the world that owns the full tax stack. ADP took 70\+ years, Paychex 50\+ years, Paycom 25\+ years—Rippling built it in 10\. Everyone else licenses from vendors. At Rippling, you own the engine.
   

  

****Uniquely Hard Technical Challenges****
* Real\-time at scale: Sub\-second tax calculations for payroll preview, batch processing of millions of records at month\-end, with perfect consistency across retries
* Integration complexity: Filing to thousands of agencies via PDF, XML, fixed\-width files, SFTP, web portals, APIs—and yes, some still require paper mail
* Testing without ground truth: No "tax oracle" exists; you'll build validation systems for millions of edge cases across 50 states × 12 months × multiple entity types
* Historical accuracy: Must calculate taxes using rules from any past date as regulations constantly change


****The Big Bets You'll Contribute To****
* Building an AI\-Driven Global Tax Engine with explainable AI for full audit defensibility
* Massive System Scaling to support 100x current volume and enterprise\-grade companies
* Expanding International Support to 20\+ countries, each with unique tax systems
* Building Distributed Transactional Systems handling $100B\+ in tax payments
* Automating Tax Filing to minimize manual intervention at scale


**What You'll Build**
* FQL (Filing Query Language): Our proprietary DSL encoding tax rules across 4,000\+ jurisdictions
* Real\-time Tax Calculation: Sub\-second calculations at scale with perfect consistency


****AI\-Powered Compliance Engine****
 : Multi\-model validation with human\-in\-the\-loop
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* System Design: Architect scalable, reliable systems that handle billions of dollars in tax calculations with zero tolerance for error
* Ownership \& Impact: Own features end\-to\-end—from design through production—with direct visibility into business outcomes
* Engineering Excellence: Set the bar for code quality, testing practices, and technical documentation within your team
* Reliability \& Correctness: Build systems where accuracy is non\-negotiable; a single bug can mean compliance failures across thousands of companies
* Global Scale: Solve challenges unique to processing millions of payroll transactions across multiple countries with 4,000\+ jurisdictions and evolving regulations
* Collaboration: Partner with compliance, product, and platform teams to translate complex tax requirements into elegant technical solutions


**What You Will Have**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience
* Strong system design skills with experience building distributed, high\-reliability systems
* Proficiency in Python; experience with Django or similar frameworks that follow the MVC pattern (layered architecture).
* Track record of owning and delivering impactful projects autonomously
* Rigorous approach to correctness—you write tests, handle edge cases, and think about failure modes
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity in complex problem spaces
* Clear communication and ability to influence technical decisions


****Nice to Have****
* Experience in fintech, payroll, or tax domains
* Background in compliance\-critical systems where correctness is paramount
* Experience with domain\-specific languages or rule engines
* Familiarity with MongoDB, Temporal, or event\-driven architectures


****Tech Stack****
* Languages: Python, FQL (proprietary tax DSL), Go
* Framework: Django, MongoEngine
* Database: MongoDB, Redis, PostGre
* Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Temporal


****Observability****
 : Buildkite, Datadog, Sentry

You will work closely with the Senior SailPoint Engineering Lead and partner with IAM, cloud, infrastructure, security, and application teams to deliver scalable and secure identity governance solutions across hybrid, cloud, SaaS, and enterprise environments.
   

  

 You will play a critical role in implementing identity governance, lifecycle management, provisioning, access certifications, role management, entitlement governance, cloud identity governance, application onboarding, and automation capabilities. As a highly hands\-on engineering professional, you will contribute to platform modernization, migration initiatives, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while leveraging modern identity security practices and cloud\-native governance capabilities.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, develop, configure, test, and deploy SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) and SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) solutions.
* Develop and maintain IIQ workflows, lifecycle events, provisioning policies, business processes, rules, forms, reports, customizations, plugins, and application integrations.
* Configure and support ISC sources, access profiles, roles, lifecycle states, identity processing, certifications, provisioning policies, workflows, and event triggers.
* Design, configure, and support Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) lifecycle management processes across IIQ and ISC environments.
* Implement and support onboarding of enterprise applications, authoritative sources, directories, databases, SaaS platforms, cloud services, and enterprise systems.
* Develop integrations using REST APIs, Web Services, SCIM, JDBC, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, XML, JSON, Java, and BeanShell technologies.
* Configure and support identity aggregation, correlation, reconciliation, and identity data quality processes.
* Design and support automated provisioning and de\-provisioning capabilities across enterprise, SaaS, and cloud environments.
* Support access request, approval, provisioning, certification, role management, entitlement governance, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and access review processes.
* Participate in IdentityIQ\-to\-ISC migration initiatives, platform upgrades, modernization programs, testing, release management, and implementation activities.
* Develop automation solutions using Java, BeanShell, PowerShell, Python, APIs, and orchestration capabilities to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Troubleshoot and resolve provisioning, workflow, connector, integration, certification, and performance issues while supporting production environments.
* Prepare technical documentation, deployment guides, runbooks, implementation procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Collaborate with IAM teams, cloud teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, compliance teams, and business stakeholders to deliver identity governance solutions.

* 4\+ years of hands\-on SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) development experience.
* 2\+ years of SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) implementation, configuration, and development experience.
* Experience developing and supporting Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) lifecycle management processes across IIQ and ISC platforms.
* Experience configuring provisioning, certifications, access request workflows, role management, entitlement governance, and governance controls.
* Experience integrating SailPoint with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, ServiceNow, HR systems, cloud applications, SaaS platforms, and enterprise systems.
* Experience developing REST API, Web Services, and SCIM\-based integrations for identity governance solutions.
* Experience onboarding enterprise applications, authoritative sources, cloud platforms, and SaaS applications into SailPoint.
* Experience supporting identity correlation, aggregation, reconciliation, provisioning, and de\-provisioning automation.
* Experience supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ upgrades, migrations, patching, and modernization initiatives.
* Experience supporting large\-scale identity governance environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while following established architecture and governance standards.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation discipline, attention to detail, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced enterprise environment.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for delivering secure and scalable identity solutions.
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.


**These Will Help You Succeed**
* Expertise in SailPoint IdentityIQ Development and Administration.
* Experience with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) / IdentityNow Development and Administration.
* Strong knowledge of IIQ workflow development including LCM, provisioning, certifications, approvals, rules, forms, reports, and business processes.
* Experience with IdentityIQ customization, rule development, plugin development, and connector configuration.
* Knowledge of ISC workflows, lifecycle states, identity processing, access profiles, roles, certifications, provisioning policies, source onboarding, and event triggers.
* Experience working with Java, BeanShell, REST APIs, Web Services, SCIM, JDBC, LDAP, XML, JSON, SAML, OAuth, and OIDC.
* Experience with identity aggregation, correlation, reconciliation, data quality management, and governance processes.
* Experience integrating with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure, AWS, GCP, ServiceNow, HR platforms, SaaS applications, and enterprise systems.
* Knowledge of SQL, database development concepts, PowerShell, Python, Git, CI/CD practices, and automation frameworks.
* Understanding of Zero Trust Architecture, Identity Security, Cloud Identity Governance, and IGA best practices.
* SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer.
* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Certification.
* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Professional Certification.
* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Engineer Certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate.
* Microsoft Azure / Entra ID Certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate.
* CompTIA Security\+.
* CISSP or CISM certification.


**Work Model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a client or Cognizant office as determined by business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs

 Job Description

 As a Sr Staff Engineer, you will own significant technical domains and critical platform capabilities, defining their architecture, technical direction, and roadmap.  . You will also help establish the engineering practices and platform capabilities required to build and operate AI\-powered products at scale.

You will identify problems before they are assigned, challenge the status quo, and continuously improve the platform and how engineering teams build software.
