* Establish reusable engineering patterns, standards, frameworks, and tooling that can be adopted across teams.
* Continuously identify opportunities to simplify architecture, eliminate technical debt, and improve platform capabilities.


 AI\-Native Engineering
   

  

* Treat AI as a first\-class engineering capability across the software development lifecycle.
* Use LLMs, coding agents, AI\-assisted development environments, and agentic workflows to increase engineering velocity, quality, and effectiveness.
* Apply AI across problem discovery, design, implementation, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and operational troubleshooting.
* Develop effective human\-AI collaboration patterns and establish guardrails for AI\-assisted engineering.
* Evaluate emerging AI\-native development tools and incorporate those that provide meaningful engineering leverage.
* Help engineering teams evolve from traditional development practices toward AI\-native software engineering.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering activities and enable AI agents to independently execute well\-defined engineering workflows.


 AI Platform \& Product Capabilities
   

  

* Design and build platform capabilities that enable teams to integrate and operate AI\-powered experiences at scale.
* Lead technical design for LLM integrations, agent workflows, tool calling, RAG, orchestration, and related AI capabilities where applicable.
* Establish reusable patterns for AI reliability, security, observability, evaluation, scalability, latency, and cost management.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve product capabilities or engineering workflows.


 Cross\-Team Technical Leadership
   

  

* Partner within and across engineering teams to provide cross\-cutting technical solutions.
* Lead initiatives involving multiple teams, systems, and technical dependencies.
* Consistently deliver deadline\-sensitive work that is interdependent with other engineering teams.
* Drive technical alignment across teams without requiring management escalation.
* Resolve architectural conflicts, technical dependencies, and integration challenges.
* Communicate complex engineering and architectural concepts clearly and concisely to engineers, product managers, and other cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Influence product and engineering roadmaps through strong technical judgment and demonstrated outcomes.


 Continuous Improvement \& Engineering Excellence
   

  

* Challenge the status quo and continuously improve the platform, architecture, processes, and engineering practices.
* Identify systemic problems proactively and drive them to resolution.
* Improve platform reliability, performance, security, developer experience, and operational efficiency.
* Introduce new tooling and standards that reduce engineering friction and increase developer productivity.
* Regularly participate in and lead peer code reviews, engineering design reviews, architecture reviews, and technical discussions.
* Establish and promote engineering best practices across teams.


 Ownership, Execution \& Mentorship
   

  

* Operate independently on ambiguous, high\-complexity problems with minimal direction.
* Own initiatives from problem definition through architecture, execution, delivery, and adoption.
* Anticipate risks and dependencies and proactively establish mitigation strategies.
* Work effectively in a startup\-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
* Mentor IC1–IC4 engineers and help raise the technical capabilities of the broader engineering organization.
* Share knowledge, encourage experimentation, and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement.


**Qualifications**

 Experience mentoring engineers and up skilling team members.
   

  

 Async programming skills — streams, event\-driven architecture, reactive flows.. Frontend experience with React
   

  

 Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic.com.
   

  

 We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office\-based, fully remote, or hybrid.

 Your Role \& Mission

We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

*Help Build the Next Generation of Cloud\-Scalable Security Products*
 Have a passion for software security? Excel at implementing public cloud at scale? Desire to build analytics/reporting over a data platform ingesting massive amounts of data? This may well be the role for you. Our Communication and Collaboration Security products are cutting edge solutions that empower Mimecast customers to Work Protected™ at tremendous scale.
   

  

**About Mimecast**
 Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications from today's most sophisticated threats. With over 42,000 customers worldwide, we analyze more than 18 billion security events daily to stop attacks before they cause harm. Mimecast DMARC Analyzer is a cloud\-based service that simplifies the complex process of implementing and managing DMARC (Domain\-based Message Authentication, Reporting \& Conformance) policies for an organization's email domains. It provides visibility into who is sending emails using an organization's domain, helps identify legitimate versus fraudulent senders, simplifies DMARC policy enforcement, and ultimately protects the brand from domain spoofing and email fraud.
   

  

**AI\-First Engineering at Mimecast**
 Mimecast is an AI\-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI\-powered development tools to accelerate innovation, improve code quality, and solve complex cybersecurity challenges at scale. We are looking for technical engineering leaders who embrace these technologies or are eager to master them quickly. Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI tooling and AI\-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer with expertise in Java, AWS cloud technologies, and email security protocols like DMARC, SPF, and DKIM, API based email protection. The ideal candidate will lead the design and development of secure, scalable systems while ensuring robust email authentication and protection. This role requires a strong technical leader who can drive innovation, mentor teams, and implement best practices for email security and cloud\-native development.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Architect and develop scalable, secure, and high\-performance systems using AWS services (e.g., Lambda, S3, API Gateway, RDS).
* Optimize cloud infrastructure for cost\-efficiency, performance, and scalability.

* Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, processes, and procedures. Ensure code quality through unit testing, code reviews, and adherence to best practices.
* Collaboration: Work closely with Product Management, Architecture, UX, other Developers and SDETs to implement new product features with high quality and on time.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This role requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, and the ability to foster a collaborative and innovative environment. We are looking for a Project Lead familiar with cloud\-native and AI\-native development practices. Our software is built around AI at its core—LLMs, agents, and retrieval systems—and runs on IaaS (Google Cloud/AWS/etc.), so familiarity with these environments and their managed AI services is a plus. Full ownership of your code will be encouraged, including deployment, testing, evaluation, and validation of both traditional and AI components. You will lead a team of software and AI engineers, coaching and mentoring them. Familiarity with CI/CD, test\-driven development, and evaluation\-driven development (eval harnesses for AI features) will be a benefit.
   

  

**Responsibility Area: Software Development**
* Develop intuitive AI\-native software that meets and exceeds the needs of the company
* Development of technical specifications and planning, including model selection, prompt/agent design, and data/retrieval architecture
* Analyze and automate tests for software components prior to delivery, and build evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, and hallucination checks) for AI features
* Troubleshoot coding and model\-behavior problems quickly and efficiently to ensure a productive workplace
* Follow secure software coding practices, including AI\-specific safeguards (prompt\-injection defense, data privacy, PII handling, and responsible\-AI guardrails)
* Professionally maintain all software and create updates regularly to address customer and company concerns, including monitoring model performance and drift in production
* IaaS procedures and practices, including managed AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI)
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerization is welcome; experience serving models or deploying inference/GPU workloads is a plus


**Responsibility Area: Communication**
* Communicate effectively and professionally in all forms of communication with internal and external customers
* Liaise with team members, management, and clients
* Be transparent about challenges, failures, and successes, including the limitations and non\-deterministic nature of AI systems
* Deliver presentations and write progress reports for stakeholders, translating AI capabilities and trade\-offs for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Actively seek ways to improve business software processes and interactions, including where AI and automation can add value


**Responsibility Area: Leadership**
* Manage individual contributors' daily tasks
* Mentor software and AI engineers to ensure high product quality across both deterministic code and AI/model behavior
* Perform detailed code reviews, including reviews of prompts, agent logic, and evaluation results
* Evaluate performance, provide feedback and constructive criticism to team members
* Set and track quarterly goals for all team members
* Assist with training and recruitment activities
* Provide status updates, weekly reports, and issue details to senior leadership as needed
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis for customer\-reported issues, including failures rooted in model behavior, hallucinations, or data/retrieval quality
* Aid and support the coaching and training of other team members to ensure all employees are confident in the use of software applications and AI tooling
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including product management, domain specialists, and engineering to define requirements and develop scalable AI\-driven solutions
* Stay current with the latest advancements in AI and related technologies (new models, frameworks, and techniques), and proactively identify opportunities to apply them to our products and services


**Qualifications**
* 8\-12 years of practical Java experience
* 2 years of experience with prompt engineering and prompt/agent scripting
* 2 years of hands\-on experience integrating third\-party AI/ML services and platform APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Salesforce and other SaaS)
* Proven ability to design and manage domain\-specific languages, prompt templates, and agent instruction frameworks
* Develop and optimize microservices that power high\-performance data and embedding pipelines, handling up to 10 million rows and feeding vector stores
* Proficiency in Python, Java, and JavaScript, with strong Python skills for the ML/AI ecosystem
* Experience with RESTful and streaming APIs, model/inference endpoints, web services, and integration technologies
* Knowledge of cloud computing and managed AI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI)
* Create customer\-centric AI solutions such as RAG assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-driven customer service
* Create data and knowledge\-base migration tools for SaaS applications, including moving embeddings and vector data between cloud instances
* Experience with LLM orchestration and retrieval frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector)
* Outstanding collaboration and communication skills
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills, including working with non\-deterministic AI outputs
* Ability to learn quickly, take direction, work independently, and as part of a team
* Ability to develop unit tests and AI evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, and hallucination checks) for code components, prompts, and complete applications
* Ability to debug and isolate the root cause of complex issues in probabilistic and distributed systems
* Experience with Agile and Scrum development methodologies
* Experience with Spring Boot or similar frameworks
* Experience working with APIs, REST standards, JSON, SQL, and NoSQL/vector stores
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field; coursework or experience in ML/AI a plus


 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

title: Senior Platform Software Engineer - Platform Architect
description:
NVIDIA is building a new wave of accelerated computing systems, where platform manageability, secure firmware, and high\-performance networking must work as one coherent architecture. We are looking for an engineer to help define and implement OpenBMC\-based management for systems that include host CPUs, BMCs, and coordinated top\-of\-rack Ethernet switching functionality.
   

  

 This role focuses on extending the BMC from a traditional server management controller into a secure management authority for both system management and Ethernet switch management, while preserving clear separation between the BMC management plane and the switch data plane.
   

  

 Are you ready to help develop the next generation of OpenBMC networking architecture? Join us at the forefront of platform firmware, system management, and enterprise network infrastructure.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Architect and implement OpenBMC support for platforms where the BMC handles host system functions and a coordinated ToR Ethernet switch subsystem.
* Define the end\-to\-end switch\-management architecture across OpenBMC D\-Bus services, bmcweb/Redfish APIs, persistent configuration, eventing, telemetry, security, and backend switch control interfaces.
* Develop OpenBMC object models and services for switch inventory, switch ASICs, front\-panel ports, internal ports, PHYs, optics, retimers, VLANs, LAGs, FDB entries, counters, sensors, and health state.
* Implement L2 networking capabilities including port admin control, speed and FEC configuration, auto\-negotiation, breakout, VLAN creation and membership, access/trunk mode, MAC learning, FDB management, flooding controls, link aggregation, and loop\-prevention features.
* Build backend abstraction layers that can integrate with Linux switchdev/netlink, SAI/SONiC/SWSS\-style components, DENT\-style Linux networking components, or vendor switch ASIC SDKs.
* Work closely with hardware, ASIC, security, firmware, QA, manufacturing, and cloud infrastructure networking teams to influence board architecture, schematics, manageability interfaces, and production test strategy.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Technology R&D
description:
**About Signant Health**
 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
   

  

 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
   

  

 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a member of the Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy, and manage infrastructure, application components, and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable, and sustainable. You will also work with the Apps Integration and DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall support process.
   

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function**
* Automate tasks such as deployment of servers and application software across environments, and alerts via scripting.
* Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work\-arounds and resolution of reported issues.
* Quickly and effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve the troubleshooting process in the long run.
* Ensure the stability and availability of application operation components running on public clouds.
* Participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation to support production environments, including shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right\-size servers and services.
* Migrate on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Attributes**
**Essential:**
* BS degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
* At least 3 years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices, with hands\-on experience of DevOps tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, and TFS.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, and PowerShell.
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible.
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux / Windows server operating systems and web server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere, and Apache Web Server.
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, or MySQL.
* Proven ability to work in a team\-oriented environment, providing back\-up support to team members and establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with co\-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.


**Desirable:**
* 5\+ years of experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices.
* Experience migrating on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS / Azure).
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere.
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation and shift work to support production environments.
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need basis.


**Why Signant Health?**
 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
   

  

 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
   

  

 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
   

  

 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
   

  

 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Build high\-quality, clean, scalable and reusable code by enforcing best practices around software engineering architecture and processes (Code Reviews, Unit testing, etc.)
* Implement software that is simple to use to allow customers to extend and customise the functionality to meet their specific needs
* Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while also enhancing the existing product suite
* Integrate with third\-party SaaS platforms and identity providers (OAuth 2\.0, SAML, SCIM), handling authentication, rate limits, pagination, and error recovery
* Contribute to AI\-powered capabilities in the product
* Write automated tests (unit, integration) and treat test coverage as part of the definition of done
* Debug and resolve product defects, including customer\-reported issues, with clear root\-cause analysis
* Partner with product managers, UX, and documentation to clarify requirements and surface risks early
* Be a mentor for colleagues and help promote knowledge\-sharing


**Qualifications**
**Core engineering**
* 3–5 years of professional software development experience building and shipping production software
* Strong programming fundamentals in Java (or a comparable OO language) plus solid JavaScript/TypeScript
* Practical front\-end experience with a modern framework (React, Angular, or Vue)
* Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL — schema design, indexing, and query performance
* Experience designing and consuming web services like SOAP and REST APIs
* Familiarity with Git\-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines


**AI fluency**
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving — whether through AI\-powered tools, workflow automation, analysis of AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's impact on your function
* Comfort using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate delivery, with the judgment to review and validate what they produce
* Awareness of the practical constraints of production AI — hallucination handling, evaluation, guardrails, token cost, and data privacy


**Collaboration \& Communication**
* Delivers assigned work independently with minimal supervision; knows when to escalate rather than stall
* Communicates clearly in writing — design notes, story updates, and PR descriptions that a reader can follow
* Comfortable in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and iterative delivery


**Nice to have**
* Experience with the ServiceNow platform (Glide, Flow Designer, scoped applications, etc)
* Background in ITAM/SAM or SaaS management domains
* Knowledge of cloud fundamentals (AWS/Azure/GCP)


 Additional Information

Learn more here. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

title: SW Applications Engineer
description:
****Who We Are****
 Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next\-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
   

  

****What We Offer****
 Location:
   

  

 Mumbai,IND
   

  

 You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
   

  

 At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground\-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high\-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
   

  

**SW Applications Engineer:**
 This position is within the process diagnostics and control (PDC) group, which deals with advanced imaging together with cutting edge image processing \& AI algorithms and electronic design data to detect, measure and classify nanometer size defects and pattern variations from semiconductor fabrication process steps. As PDC to multi\-source data products and AI\-based solutions, this engineer plays a central role in both shaping those products and driving their success in the field.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
*Product Performance \& Application*
* Maximize the performance of Data Products through deep understanding of customer use\-cases and close technical collaboration with R\&D, Algorithms, and Product teams
* Extend applicative expertise across multiple data sources (CAD, design, process, inspection) and beyond LINK to the full PDC product portfolio
* Ensure applicative value and readiness of SW and algorithmic solutions prior to and during field deployment


*Field Execution \& Customer Success*
* Drive adoption and integrated deployment of Data Product solutions at leading semiconductor fabs worldwide
* Serve as the technical escalation point for complex field issues, providing rapid resolution and root cause analysis
* Develop utilities and scripts (Python) for debugging, workflow automation, and issue isolation


*Innovation \& Roadmap Contribution*
* Conceptualize and prototype technical flows that convert multi\-source data into new applications and insights
* Translate Voice of Customer (VoC) and field learnings into concrete product requirements and roadmap inputs
* Explore and validate AI/ML\-based approaches that advance PDC's data product capabilities


****What We Offer****
* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge semiconductor technology and products.
* Direct collaboration with customers and global R\&D teams
* A role with real product influence — your field learnings shape the roadmap
* Dual career track: technical specialist or engineering leadership
* A culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous learning


****What You Bring****
* Master’s / Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, VLSI, or a related field
* 2–5 years of experience in semiconductor process and defectivity, with hands\-on knowledge of CAD and design\-based inspection concepts
* Proficiency in Python; experience building scripts, tools, or analytical workflows
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and practical experience applying them to data analysis or product development
* Comfort with GenAI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for code generation, debugging, and documentation
* Willingness to travel \~50% to leading fabs globally
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently and within cross\-functional teams
* Excellent communication skills — equally effective with customers, field teams, and R\&D engineers

**Employee Type:**

 Yes

 Position Overview and Objective
   

  

 We are expanding our Platform \& Infrastructure Engineering team and are looking for a Senior Developer 2 – CI/CD Platform Engineering who can lead the design, implementation, and evolution of scalable software delivery platforms and developer enablement solutions.
   

  

 In this role, you will drive the architecture and operational excellence of CI/CD systems that power reliable, secure, and efficient software delivery across the organization. You will work closely with engineering, SRE, security, and platform teams to improve developer experience, standardize engineering practices, and build resilient cloud\-native infrastructure at scale.
   

  

 You will also mentor engineers, influence technical direction, and contribute to long\-term platform strategy while remaining hands\-on with implementation and automation.
   

  

**Some Of The Things You Might Work On Include**
* Designing and evolving enterprise\-scale CI/CD platforms that support multi\-team and multi\-environment software delivery workflows
* Building self\-service developer platform capabilities that simplify infrastructure provisioning, deployment automation, secrets management, and operational workflows
* Architecting scalable GitOps and Infrastructure\-as\-Code patterns that improve reliability, consistency, and governance across cloud environments
* Developing internal platform services(e.g Backstage), automation tooling, and APIs to improve engineering productivity and operational efficiency
* Improving software supply chain security, including artifact management, vulnerability scanning, policy enforcement, workload identity, and secure deployment practices
* Defining and implementing governance standards for CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, access management, and cloud resource utilization
* Driving observability and operational excellence across platform systems, including metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and SLO\-based monitoring
* Partnering with application and reliability engineering teams to improve deployment reliability, release velocity, and incident response capabilities
* Researching and evaluating emerging technologies in Kubernetes, container ecosystems, platform engineering, developer tooling, and cloud\-native security
* Leading proof\-of\-concept initiatives and guiding adoption of new tooling and architectural improvements across the organization
* Mentoring and supporting engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, operational best practices, and platform enablement initiatives
* Promoting AI\-driven development practices and tools such as GitHub Copilot to improve developer productivity and engineering efficiency
* Create and review comprehensive High\-Level Design (HLD) and Data Flow Diagrams (DFD) documents covering architecture, scalability, reliability, security, operational impact, and deployment considerations for proposed changes


**Desired Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure engineering roles
* Strong software development background in either of Go, Python, or similar languages, with a focus on building maintainable and secure automation systems
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud\-native infrastructure, with hands\-on experience operating Amazon EKS and supporting CI/CD platforms at scale
* Strong expertise with AWS services including EC2, IAM, VPC, Route 53, S3, CloudWatch, ECR, Lambda, and managed Kubernetes services
* Strong understanding of CI/CD architecture, deployment automation, GitOps workflows, and developer platform engineering concepts
* Extensive experience implementing Infrastructure\-as\-Code using tools such as Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or CDK
* Deep understanding of cloud security, IAM, secrets management, policy enforcement, and least\-privilege access controls
* Strong troubleshooting and operational skills across Linux systems, networking, containers, and distributed systems
* Ability to lead technical initiatives, influence engineering standards, and collaborate effectively across multiple teams
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document architecture, operational processes, and engineering standards
* Experience mentoring engineers and driving engineering best practices within platform or infrastructure teams
* Experience managing artifact registries and their lifecycle at scale, including governance, retention, replication, and security controls
* Experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Buildkite (preferred), or GitLab CI, along with artifact management platforms such as JFrog Artifactory
* Experience implementing software supply chain security and compliance controls including SBOM, image signing, and vulnerability management
* Experience operating and securing Linux\-based systems including Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, or Docker/container\-optimized operating systems


**Additional Skills And Technologies**
* Experience designing internal developer platforms (e.g., Backstage), reusable automation frameworks, and self\-service infrastructure capabilities
* Familiarity with multi\-tenant platform architectures and developer experience optimization
* Experience supporting large\-scale engineering organizations with platform standardization and governance initiatives
* Bazel understanding and experience is strongly preferred


**Why Arctic Wolf?**
 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including
 **Top Workplace USA** 
 (2021\-2024\),

 (2021\-2024\),

 (2021\-2024\),

 (2024\), and

As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

 Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.   We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 CORPORATE AUDIT RISK TECHNOLOGY team is responsible for the management and delivery of Corporate Audit applications for the bank’s enterprise control functions. We also manage GT\&O’s business operations, business process and controls, workforce management, Simplify \& Improve (SIM) governance, and initiative and master planning processes.
   

  

**Job Description\*** 
 .
   

  

 We are seeking a Data Engineer to support CACR 2\.0 as the platform and enterprise data landscape continue to scale. This role will contribute to delivering trusted, compliant, and scalable data solutions while helping reduce risks arising from manual processes and inconsistent practices.
   

  

 The Data Engineer will work closely with senior engineers and architects to implement Data Virtualization, support Data Quality frameworks, and contribute to Metadata and Data Lineage capabilities that improve data accessibility, accuracy, and transparency. This role focuses on hands‑on development, implementation, and operational support within established enterprise data standards and architectures.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
 Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, integrations, and data processing solutions within enterprise data platforms.
* Contribute to end‑to‑end delivery of data engineering initiatives, including requirements understanding, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Assist in the implementation and adoption of Data Virtualization, Data Quality frameworks, Metadata Management, and Data Lineage capabilities.
* Develop scalable and reusable data integration patterns to support batch and near real‑time data processing use cases.
* Support modernization of legacy data processes by reducing manual interventions and improving automation and monitoring.
* Follow and help enforce enterprise data standards, best practices, and governance guidelines to ensure data quality, security, and compliance.
* Collaborate with architects, platform teams, governance, security, and business stakeholders to deliver aligned data solutions.
* Troubleshoot and support performance, reliability, and scalability issues in production data platforms.
* Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives across the data engineering team.


**Requirements**
**Education\***
* Any Graduation / Post Graduation


**Experience Range\***
* 6 to 8 years


**Foundational skills\***
* Solid understanding of data engineering fundamentals, including data ingestion, transformation, integration, orchestration, and data lifecycle management.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and good programming skills in Python for building and maintaining data pipelines.
* Hands‑on experience with data integration and ETL/ELT tools such as Informatica, supporting batch and near real‑time processing.
* Working knowledge of data virtualization concepts, with exposure to platforms such as Starburst (Trino/Presto) preferred.
* Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, and familiarity with data warehouses and data lake architectures.
* Understanding of data modeling concepts, including conceptual, logical, and physical models (dimensional and normalized).
* Exposure to distributed data systems, APIs, and messaging or event‑driven integration patterns.
* Basic to intermediate understanding of Data Quality, Metadata, and Data Lineage principles.
* Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and cloud‑based data engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and automation for data solutions.
* Awareness of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements in enterprise environments.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross‑functional teams.


**Desired skills\***
* Exposure to cloud‑native data services (e.g. ADLS, S3\).
* Familiarity with CDC patterns, and hybrid (on‑prem \+ cloud) data integrations.
* Knowledge of streaming platforms such as Kafka for near real‑time data ingestion and processing.
* Experience with data observability, monitoring, and alerting tools for data pipelines.
* Understanding of master data management (MDM) and reference data concepts.


**Work Timings\*:**
 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM IST
   

  

**Job Location\*:**
 Gurugram / GIFT City

 Kaufman Rossin, headquartered in Miami, Florida has been celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida more than a dozen times. The firm has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri\-county area and sister entities, Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
   

  

 The Firm is ranked 49th among the top 100 firms in the US by Inside Public Accounting 2023\. Internationally, the Firm has offices in Bangalore and Haryana in India and the Ivory Coast in Africa.
   

  

**Think you have what it takes?**
 This role spans four Microsoft platform disciplines — SharePoint development, Power Apps, Power BI, and Azure DevOps. The ideal candidate is a versatile M365 engineer who can build production\-grade intranet solutions, automate business workflows, deliver self\-service analytics, and maintain the DevOps pipelines that keep it all running reliably.
   

  

**Requirements**
**How You'll Contribute:**
**SharePoint Online Development**
* Design, build, and maintain SharePoint Online sites, portals, and intranet experiences that serve KR's internal teams — including department hubs, document libraries, approval workflows, and knowledge bases
* Develop custom SharePoint solutions using SPFx (SharePoint Framework) web parts, extensions, and application customizers — delivering rich, branded experiences that conform to the KR design system
* Configure and manage SharePoint site architecture: site collections, hub sites, managed metadata, content types, taxonomy, permissions hierarchies, and information architecture
* Build SharePoint\-integrated workflows and forms using Power Automate and Power Apps — eliminating manual, email\-based processes with structured, auditable digital workflows
* Implement SharePoint as the firm's primary document management and collaboration platform — migrating content from legacy systems, configuring retention policies, and applying sensitivity labels via Microsoft Purview
* Optimize SharePoint performance: page load times, search configuration, content query tuning, and CDN integration
* Conduct regular governance reviews of SharePoint environments — identifying sprawl, inactive sites, overly permissive access, and opportunities to consolidate and rationalize


**Power Apps Development**
* Design and build Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps in Power Apps to replace manual workflows, paper\-based processes, and disconnected spreadsheet\-driven operations across KR's service lines
* Develop responsive, mobile\-friendly Power Apps that connect to SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and REST APIs — delivering cohesive user experiences across desktop and mobile
* Implement complex business logic in Power Apps using Power Fx, custom connectors, and component libraries — following reusable, maintainable development patterns
* Build and maintain Dataverse solutions for structured business data — defining tables, relationships, forms, views, business rules, and role\-based security aligned to KR's data governance standards
* Integrate Power Apps with Power Automate flows, SharePoint document libraries, and Azure\-hosted APIs — creating end\-to\-end solutions that automate and digitize business processes
* Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) coordination and post\-deployment support for Power Apps — gathering feedback, resolving defects, and iterating toward adoption
* Apply ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) practices for Power Platform solutions — using Azure DevOps pipelines and solution packaging for structured, repeatable deployments across Dev, Test, and Production environments


**Power BI Development \& Analytics**
* Design and build Power BI reports and dashboards that deliver actionable business intelligence to KR's leadership, advisory teams, and operational stakeholders — replacing Domo and legacy reporting tools as part of KR's BI modernization initiative
* Develop semantic models (datasets) in Power BI Desktop using DAX — building robust, reusable measures, calculated columns, and hierarchies that serve as the single source of truth for each reporting domain
* Connect Power BI to KR's data sources: Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, SQL databases, SharePoint lists, and REST APIs — using DirectQuery, Import, and Composite models appropriately
* Build and maintain Power BI dataflows for reusable, governed data transformation logic — applying Power Query (M) to cleanse, reshape, and standardize data before it reaches report layers
* Implement Row\-Level Security (RLS) and Object\-Level Security (OLS) in Power BI — ensuring reports enforce data access rules that align with KR's client confidentiality and internal access control requirements
* Publish and manage Power BI content in workspaces — configuring refresh schedules, gateway connections, deployment pipelines, and sensitivity labels for published reports
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, validate data accuracy, and iterate on dashboard design — translating business questions into well\-structured, intuitive visuals
* Document all semantic models, data source connections, and report logic — maintaining a living data dictionary that supports governance, audit, and onboarding of new developers


**Azure DevOps Engineering**
* Build, configure, and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines (CI/CD) for M365 and Power Platform workloads — automating build, test, and deployment processes for SPFx solutions, Power Platform solutions, and supporting APIs
* Manage Azure DevOps Boards for assigned initiatives — maintaining Epic/Feature/Story/Task hierarchy, sprint structure, board hygiene, and workflow automation rules in coordination with the PO/BA
* Configure branch strategies, pull request policies, and code review gates in Azure Repos — enforcing quality standards and protecting production deployments from unreviewed changes
* Implement automated testing stages in CI/CD pipelines — unit tests, integration tests, and deployment validation checks — reducing manual release verification effort
* Maintain environment configurations across Dev, Test, and Production for all M365 and Power Platform workloads — using variable groups, service connections, and environment approvals
* Monitor pipeline health and build metrics — proactively identifying flaky tests, slow builds, and deployment failures, and resolving them before they impact delivery velocity
* Support the Azure Architect in extending Azure DevOps practices to other KR application workloads as the firm's DevSecOps maturity grows


**Governance, Security \& Platform Health**
* Apply Microsoft 365 governance standards across all deliverables — sensitivity labeling, data loss prevention (DLP) policies, conditional access, and information barriers where required
* Implement Power Platform governance: environment strategy (Dev/Test/Prod), DLP connector policies, solution management, and usage analytics via Power Platform Admin Center
* Collaborate with the IT Security team to ensure SharePoint, Power Apps, and Power BI solutions comply with KR's security standards — including Entra ID authentication, least\-privilege access, and audit logging
* Contribute to KR's M365 Center of Excellence (CoE) — building reusable component libraries, templates, coding standards, and developer guidance that raise the quality baseline across the team


**Collaboration \& Delivery**
* Work directly from user stories and acceptance criteria provided by the Bengaluru PO/BA and US stakeholders — asking clarifying questions early and flagging platform constraints before sprint commitment
* Participate in all sprint ceremonies — planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives — contributing estimates, surfacing blockers, and demoing completed solutions to business stakeholders
* Produce and maintain technical documentation for every deliverable: solution architecture, data source mappings, deployment guides, and user guides — so solutions are maintainable and transferable
* Mentor junior developers on the Bengaluru team on SharePoint, Power Platform, and Azure DevOps best practices


**What Skills You'll Bring:**

* 4\+ years of hands\-on development experience across Microsoft 365 / Power Platform technologies in a professional environment
* Proficiency in SharePoint Online development — SPFx web parts and extensions, site architecture, permissions management, and content management
* Hands\-on Power Apps development — Canvas Apps and Model\-Driven Apps, Power Fx, Dataverse, and custom connector integration
* Power BI development experience — semantic model design, DAX, Power Query (M), RLS/OLS implementation, and report/dashboard delivery

* Analyze application and system performance and proactively optimize scalability, reliability, and maintainability
* Collaborate with solution architects, product owners, and clients to translate business requirements into technical designs.
* Troubleshoot production issues and drive root\-cause analysis for bot performance degradation.
* Support deployment, environment configuration, and release activities in partnership with DevOps teams
* Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, designers, and cross\-functional development teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions

description:
**Description**
 Do you love creating and editing helpful process documents and strategic, customer\-facing communications? Are you passionate about developing clear, concise, and straightforward content for internal and external audiences? Do you have a proven track record of delivery high\-quality content in a fast\-paced environment? If you enjoy driving improvements in content readability, discoverability, and usability, then we'd love to talk to you about joining Amazon's Customer Trust Content Management (CTCM) team as a Content Developer.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Content Developer, you will be responsible for developing standard operating procedure documents for risk and fraud investigators and email communications for Amazon's customers. With the help of our style guide, you will document operational processes and create messaging for a global audience. You are not a copy editor—you are the owner of the investigator and customer experience.
   

  

 You will work with global stakeholders to understand the business priorities and legal requirements that drive the need for high\-quality content. It's important that you are self\-motivated to look around corners for ways to improve the reader experience. Amazon is a fast\-paced environment, and you must be committed to partnering with internal and external stakeholders to deliver high\-quality content that responds to the rapidly changing seller landscape.
   

  

 In addition to working on content projects, you will also contribute to team\-level goals and initiatives. You will be expected to work on content projects, team\-level goals and initiatives, and ad\-hoc tasks simultaneously. You will troubleshoot tool issues impacting content that we support and flag issues to the relevant tech team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The CTCM team supports investigators by updating and managing content to support global operations. We use data to make decisions about our content, and we advocate for the investigator and customer experience while balancing advocacy with the need for action. We measure success by having clear and simple content that answers readers' questions before they arise. We are are a global team based in the US, UK, Costa Rica, Ireland, and India.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in editing, copy\-editing, and proofreading
* Experience in overseeing and managing projects and deadlines
* Experience using content management systems and content tools
* Experience managing content projects of varying complexity, conducting content review and overseeing localization
* Experience of content strategy and information architecture.
* Demonstrated success at learning and explaining business processes.
* Ability to solve problems and work without close direction in ambiguous environments.
* Ability to troubleshoot and report issues via the appropriate channels.
* Good judgment and effective communication.

* Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Linguistics, or a related field

* Experience with HTML, XML, or DITA.

description:
**Where you fit?**
 Shell Trading and Supply is the world's largest Energy Trader. It combines a global network of trading companies, industry leading shipping and maritime capabilities, and an integrated network of supply and distribution activities to act as the central integrator for Royal Dutch Shell. Our trading capability, deep market knowledge, global portfolio and end\-to\-end integration within Shell creates opportunities to deliver value for our customers and for Shell across Upstream, Downstream, Integrated Gas and New Energies. Through our main trading offices in London, Houston, Singapore, Dubai and Rotterdam we trade crude oil, natural gas, LNG, electricity, refined products, chemical feedstocks and environmental products. With more than 125 distribution terminals and hundreds of outside supply points in around 25 countries, our supply and distribution infrastructure is well positioned to make deliveries around the world. Trading is at the centre of the Shell's Energy Transition and Decarbonisation plans, working closely with New Energies and the wider business to develop lower carbon solutions, driven through technology and data.
   

  

 The Trading and Supply CC is a delivery organization in IDE that enables business products to deliver value faster than before via long enduring teams who retain deep business domain knowledge and expertise. Together we will work to deliver customer focused solutions, effectively manage risk and controls and act as leaders in the energy transition through developing integrated power and trading capabilities. If you would like to be at the centre of Shell's future, join our Trading \& Supply Competency Centre and play a part in the delivery of our energy future.
   

  

**What’s the role?**
 The role offers you the opportunity to participate in the growing Trading and Supply businesses. There will be many ‘new’ and ‘first’ for the candidate to be part of. The role is responsible for working with business and IT to deliver solutions in projects or enhancements for the business needs.
   

  

 The Software Engineer will be working in full partnership with the IT teams and Business Stakeholders to design, develop and deliver fit for purpose IT solutions. The scope of the work includes but not limited to analytical activities \- identify \& understand issues, analyse impacts and dependencies, recommend end\-to\-end solution design, and implement a solution.
   

  

 The role will work on defect fixes, enhancements, and special project delivery following the software development lifecycle. Key activities will evolve around DevOps delivery methodology and encompass tasks management, requirements gathering and traceability, prototyping, design, and development, testing and release/patching.
   

  

 Another key aspect of this role is to support turn\-key/SaaS solutions, prototyping and delivery of new technology which may include new development, configuration and installation of third\-party packages. The Software Engineer will also be tasked to work with third party suppliers to implement change requests, support end\-to\-end internal and user testing, testing/trials of software patches/upgrades, support deployment, post deployment validation and business acceptance.
   

  

 Delivery process and activities, standards and communications, will be in accordance to the Enterprise/team guidelines, tooling, processes and norms (e.g. attending and providing sharing sessions, attending scrum calls, process improvements, etc)

* Full life cycle development experience in a project development role
* Experience in supporting a diverse application landscape, including change management, application testing, data integrity management, patch management and end\-user support and training
* Experience designing or changing business critical components to gain full value from technology solutions
* Energy/Commodity Trading and Risk Management domain experience required
* Specific experience with Trade Capture, Risk Management, Scheduling \& Operations, or Settlements \& Accounting
* Endur development using JVS or OpenComponents
* Experience with developing solutions using Java and .Net
* Experience with Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL and Informatica

 You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet.  The Core Engineering
   

  

 The Core Engineering Builds And Operates The Platforms, Applications, Data Solutions, Models, And Analytics That Power Critical Processes For The Core Divisions Of The Firm (e.g., Risk, Responsible For The Risk Profile Of Firm Activities; Controllers, Responsible For The Financial Control And Reporting Obligations; Compliance, Responsible For The Firm’s Compliance, Regulatory, And Reputational Risks; Corporate Treasury, Responsible For The Firm’s Liquidity, Funding, Balance Sheet, Etc.; And Human Capital Management, Responsible For Attracting, Developing, And Managing a Global Workforce). A Centralized Engineering Structure In Support Of The Core Enables a Common Platform Model And Operating Framework That Promotes Consistent Governance And Scalable Solutions, Leveraging Cloud, AI, And Machine Learning For Innovation And Efficiency. The Core Engineering’s 2,000\+ Engineers And Strats Deliver Engineering, Data, Analytics, And Quantitative Capabilities Within Six Business Units:
   

  

* Metrics \& Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm’s risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions
* The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics
* Financials \& Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm’s financials and a wide range of reporting functions
* Non\-Financial Risk \& Controls: responsible for non\-financial risk and control processes
* Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement
* Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk


****Role Responsibilities****
 Market Risk Analytics \& Reporting (A\&R) delivers critical regulatory and risk metrics \& analytics across risk domains (market, credit, liquidity, operational, capital) and firm activities via regular reporting, customized risk analysis, systematically generated risk reporting and risk tools . This role will focus on Market Risk.
   

  

 A\&R Has a Unique Vantage Point In The Firm’s Risk Data Flows That, When Coupled With a Deep Understanding Of Client And Market Activities, Allows It To Build Scalable Workflows, Processes And Procedures To Deliver Actionable Risk Insights . The Following Are Core Responsibilities For A\&R:
   

  

* Delivering regular and reliable risk metrics, analytics \& insights based on deep understanding of the firm’s businesses and its client activities.
* Building robust, systematic \& efficient workflows, processes and procedures around the production of risk analytics for financial \& non\-financial risk, risk capital and regulatory reporting.
* Attesting to the quality, timeliness and completeness of the underlying data used to produce these analytics .


****Qualifications, Skills \& Aptitude****
 Eligible candidates are preferred to have the following:
   

  

* Masters or Bachelors degree in a quantitative discipline such as data science, mathematics, physics, econometrics, computer science or engineering.
* Entrepreneurial, analytically creative, self\-motivated and team\-oriented.
* Excellent written, verbal and team\-oriented communication skills.
* Working knowledge of the financial industry, markets and products and associated non\-financial risk.
* Working knowledge of mathematics including statistics, time series analysis and numerical algorithms.
* Experience with programming in Python and SQL for extract transform load (ETL) operations and data analysis (including performance optimization). Experience in using languages such as R, Java, C\+\+ is beneficial.
* Experience in developing data visualization and business intelligence solutions using tools such as, but not limited to, Tableau, Alteryx, PowerBI, and front\-end technologies and languages.
* 7\+ years of experience, preferably in financial, regulatory or consulting environment

**Job Description**
 Job Summary
   

  

 Responsible for the design, development, implementation, integration, and support of scalable enterprise applications using
 **Angular 20, .NET Core, C\#, Entity Framework Core, Azure PaaS services, and Azure Cosmos DB** 
 .

Participate in solution architecture and technical design, ensure application quality and security, and provide technical guidance to junior developers.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Cloud
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3\.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5\.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
   

  

 Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy\-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
   

  

 Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9\.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2\.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
   

  

 With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
   

  

****Position Summary****
 This role comes under the
 **Cloud Engineering charter,** 
 focused on designing and building a secure, reliable, multi\-cloud, and highly scalable platform that powers Harness SaaS and Self\-Managed deployments. The team is responsible for developing portable, cloud\-native, and open\-source\-backed infrastructure, along with common capabilities across infrastructure automation, CI/CD, observability, disaster recovery, security, and operational tooling.
   

  

 The platform serves as a core foundation for Harness products and services, including Continuous Delivery, Continuous Integration, Security Testing Orchestration, Cloud Cost Management, Internal Developer Portal, and Software Engineering Insights. As a Staff Engineer, you will drive the architecture, design, and delivery of high\-impact platform capabilities, solve complex engineering challenges, and provide technical direction across teams. You will influence engineering standards, mentor engineers, and collaborate with product and engineering stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions. The role will also drive operational excellence through automation, monitoring, reliability improvements, disaster readiness, and cost optimization of large\-scale cloud infrastructure. Most importantly, you will help strengthen the engineering culture and contribute to Harness’s mission of enabling developers to deliver software faster, more reliably, and securely.
   

  

 As a Staff Software Engineer at Harness, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our systems, incorporating a blend of Cloud Engineering and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices. This role requires a strong technical background, a passion for innovation, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Cloud Infrastructure Design \& Implementation:**
* Design, build, and manage scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure using GCP, AWS or Azure.
* Develop infrastructure\-as\-code using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar.


****Site Reliability Engineering (SRE):****
* Implement SRE practices to ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of cloud services.
* Develop and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to detect and address issues proactively.
* Perform capacity planning and demand forecasting to ensure system scalability and performance.


****Automation \& CI/CD:****
* Deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes (K8s).
* Utilize Helm for packaging, deploying, and managing applications on Kubernetes.
* Design and implement continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate the delivery of applications and infrastructure.
* Develop automation scripts and tools to streamline operations and improve efficiency.


****Security \& Compliance:****
* Ensure cloud infrastructure and applications meet security and compliance standards.
* Implement security best practices and perform regular security audits and assessments.


****Collaboration \& Mentorship:****
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including developers, product managers, and operations to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers, sharing best practices and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.


****About You****
**Technical Expertise:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 7\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, or related roles.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and cloud\-native services.
* Proficiency in infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform), Helm package manager and configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet)
* Experience with AI\-OPS


****SRE Practices:****
* Experience with SRE principles, including error budgets, SLIs, SLOs, and incident management.
* Strong knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, GCM).


****Automation \& DevOps:****
* Expertise in building and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI or Harness
* Strong coding skills (Python, Go, etc.) and familiarity with version control systems (Git).


****Security \& Compliance:****
* Understanding of security best practices for cloud infrastructure and applications.
* Experience with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS) is a plus.


****Soft Skills:****
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive and innovative approach.


****What You Will Have At Harness****
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
* Quarterly Harness TGIF\-Off / 4 days
* Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team\-building events
* Recharge \& Reset Program
* Monthly internet reimbursement
* Commuter benefits


**Harness In The News:**
* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5\.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale \| Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success


 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
   

  

 At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness\-privacy.relyance.ai/
   

  

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
 We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
   

  

 Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
   

  

 If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job\-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

description:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 The Core Platform Team is responsible for the comprehensive management of our operating systems, Azure cloud infrastructure, and container environments. We specialize in the creation, deployment, and maintenance of containers, as well as the automation of daily platform tasks. Our team ensures seamless integration and optimal performance across our technology stack, driving efficiency and innovation in all our operations.
   

  

**Job Description**
****Job Description****
**We are seeking a skilled and experienced Red Hat/Linux Administrator to join our dynamic Platform team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Linux administration, container technologies, and scripting. This role involves maintaining, upgrading, and securing our Linux environments, as well as managing Docker containers and writing scripts to automate tasks.**
****Basic Requirements****
**Key Responsibilities**
* Red Hat/Linux Administration:
* Perform day\-to\-day Linux administration tasks, ensuring system stability, performance, and security.
* Manage OS patching processes, including planning, execution, and troubleshooting.
* Conduct upgrade and rollback validations to ensure system integrity.
* Implement quarterly security patch upgrades to maintain compliance and protect against vulnerabilities.
* Docker and Container Management:
* Write Dockerfiles from scratch to create custom Docker images tailored to specific application requirements.
* Build, manage, and deploy Docker images in various environments.
* Perform Docker container upgrades and rollbacks, ensuring minimal downtime and service continuity.
* Understand Docker networking concepts and configure container networks for optimal performance.
* Debug and resolve Docker\-related issues efficiently, ensuring smooth operation of containerized applications.
* Scripting and Automation:
* Develop and maintain shell scripts to automate system administration tasks and improve efficiency.
* Write Ansible scripts for configuration management and deployment automation.
* Utilize Python for advanced scripting needs (is an added advantage).
* Lead Responsibilities:
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to team members.
* Drive architectural improvements and best practices for system scalability.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to align platform roadmap with business goals.
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis for critical system outages.
* Oversee complex project deliveries to ensure high\-quality standards.


**Qualifications**
* B.Tech in Computer Science or a related field with Computer science as one of the core subject
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to document processes and procedures clearly.


**Experience**
* Overall experience of 8\+ years.
* Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in Linux administration.
* Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience with Docker or other container technologies.
* Minimum 3 \- 4 years of Experience with shell scripting and Ansible automation tools.


**Preferred Certifications**
 Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)
   

  

 Basic Requirements
   

  

 Git ops, kubernetus, cloud, Ansible, Shell scripting
   

  

 Travel Requirements
   

  

 None
   

  

 Relocation Provided
   

  

 None
   

  

 Position Type
   

  

 Experienced
   

  

 Referral Payment Plan
   

  

 Yes
   

  

***EEO Statement***
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.
   

  

 We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

 To build and maintain the systems that collect, store, process, and analyse data, such as data pipelines, data warehouses and data lakes to ensure that all data is accurate, accessible, and secure.
