title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Software Engineer to work on Qualys’ next\-generation data platform and middleware. Working alongside a very talented team of engineers and architects, you will be responsible for prototyping, designing, developing and supporting a highly scalable SaaS based cloud security data platform. This is a great opportunity to be an integral part of a team building Qualys’ next generation microservices based technology platform processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day, leverage open source technologies, and work on challenging and business\-impacting projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a data platform engineer you will be responsible for the team running data stored with millions of transactions per second, scaling 100s of terrabytes of data. Responsible for driving the data source and providing data platform as a service to all applications built in Qualys.
   

  

 You will be reviewing the application architecture and identify the data scale needs. Investigate the cutting edge technologies and do POC and then responsible for rolling out in production. Be the face and developer advocate of the stack you own and contribute back to open source community if any enhancement needed to fit in Qualys ecosystem.
   

  

 You will be instrumenting both day 1 and day 2 operations on these data technologies keeping the 100s of thousands if not millions of operations per second. Migrate, burst into cloud and scale the stack with zero or least amount of downtime.
   

  

 You will be responsible for delivering resilient client SDKs to the applications to communicate with the data source you are responsible for.
   

  

 You will be constantly in the hunt for better solutions out there to resolve the current scaling, availability and cost effective alternative solutions.
   

  

 Co\-develop with a strong sense of ownership Qualys’ big\-data platform that scales to meet/exceed the demands of processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day. Architecture, performance, scalability, high availability and security will be your primary goals for delivering a first\-rate experience to our customers.
   

  

 Work closely with engineering teams, product management and operations to provide platform and infrastructure features and components to support Qualys’ business objectives.
   

  

 Produce high quality software following good architecture and design principles that you and your team will find easy to work with in the future.
   

  

**A day in the life…**
* Apply advanced concepts, theories and principles to create multi\-disciplinary innovations and solutions for the most complex or risky data source related situations
* Contribute to development of new data platform principles and concepts
* Collaborate with and suggest best practices to application teams in Qualys
* Provide thought leadership across multiple teams to ensure that systems and services are designed, and operating to achieve optimal levels of performance, reliability and sustainability interacting with data platform in Qualys
* Ensure security coding practices and security system fundamentals across multiple teams
* Demonstrate ability to identify important areas to instrument across multiple teams


**Who You Are...**
* A trendsetter. You thrive in an intellectually challenging environment with leading edge technologies.
* A teacher. You’re able to mentor your peers and help our team grow.
* A learner. You have an insatiable thirst for knowledge and greater understanding.
* A pragmatist. Your goal is to create useful products, not build technology for technology’s sake.
* An empath. You understand what the customer needs and use that perspective to create the best user experience.


**How We Work...**
* With others. We have remote pairing tools where engineers often work together, as well as virtual collaboration tools for building out architecture solutions.
* With transparency. We encourage open dialog and discourse. We don’t encourage silos.
* With agility. We don’t believe in following a process for process’s sake. We ship frequently and focus on delivering incremental value.
* With open minds. We are committed to building a diverse team of people with unique perspectives. This encourages a healthy and inclusive environment that builds a more sustainable, successful company.
* With pride. We value our people most of all. We invest in ourselves by applying our own strengths and interests to company needs.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience .
* 6\+ years hands\-on experience with developing SaaS based software products and solutions for service\-oriented deployments in public (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, etc.) or private clouds.
* Prior experience with RDBMS systems and NoSQL databases.
* Proven expertise in data\-driven critical thinking problem\-solving
* Ability to debug systems of software and people
* Demonstrated ability to write high\-quality, production\-ready code (readable, well\-tested, with well\-designed APIs)
* Demonstrated passion for innovation with an ability to work within agile software development methodologies
* Experience with infrastructure orchestration and automation tools (Terraform)
* Hands\-on experience using CI/CD pipelines
* Data platform design / build utilizing Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Ceph, Flink, Spark or similar technologies
* Strong analytical and debugging skills.
* Java programming skills including object\-oriented design, prototyping, development, testing, profiling, etc.
* Knowledge of JVM concepts like garbage collection, heap, stack, profiling, class loading, etc.
* Strong in data structures and algorithms.
* Ability to clearly articulate and communicate technical concepts within and across teams.
* Knowledge of the below is a plus
* Built a data platform from the ground up.
* Experience with applying data encryption and data security standards.
* Experience with container and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes etc.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Graphite, Grafana and Prometheus.
* Experience with HashiCorp technologies such as Consul, Vault, Terraform and Vagrant.
* Experience with configuration management tools such as Chef, Puppet or Ansible.
* In\-depth experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines.
* Exposure to Maven, Ant or Gradle for builds.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 Are you interested in working for one of the most exciting teams at Microsoft owning a fundamental piece of the Azure cloud? Looking for a new challenge to demonstrate your expertise in building systems at massive scale with extremely high availability (100% SLA)? Then look no further than the Azure DNS Team. We are looking for an engineer with deep technical expertise, a curiosity\-driven mindset, and a strong sense of ownership. You’ll work on globally distributed, scalable, and low\-latency services that serve critical workloads across the globe.
   

  

 The Azure DNS team is looking for a Principal Software Engineer with deep technical expertise, a curiosity\-driven mindset, and a strong sense of ownership. You will work to design and implement a globally distributed, scalable and low latency super service that provides DNS capabilities for the most critical domains in the world. The developer will work with a team of other software engineers to design and implement various components that constitute this state\-of\-the\-art distributed systems solution and ensure a timely execution of the components with high quality \- think of 1 billion records at very low latencies. Running DNS at such scale requires building systems that are resilient to multiple failure patterns with continuous investments in quality of service.
   

  

 Azure DNS also enables other innovations in Azure by providing a robust platform for resource naming across all Azure features like Storage, Software Defined Networking, databases and Azure Compute. This provides an enormous learning opportunity to build integrated solutions with other Azure services. description:
**Description**
 As Principal Engineer for Delivery Choices in Hyderabad, you'll own the technical foundation for Add to Delivery, our fastest\-growing customer experience that delivered $billions incremental OPS in 2025 and is expanding to nine countries in 2026\. This isn't about optimizing existing systems—it's about architecting delivery\-building behavior that fundamentally changes how 200\+ million Prime members shop.
   

  

 In a team that sits between core Amazon operations and core Amazon retail organizations, this is a unique role with enormous breath of influence and ownership. You'll work at the intersection of customer experience, fulfillment networks, and international expansion, coordinating architectural decisions across 30\+ partner organizations (SCOT, P13N, CPX, EUIC, Search, Promise, Shipping, GDCX) while your team operates at maximum parallelization. Your Hyderabad team owns systems spanning international AtD expansion to nine countries (representing large OPS impact and ship cost savings), Core DC precision products across 18\+ markets, and foundational services requiring Tier\-1 migration.
   

  

 What Makes This Different
   

  

 You're not solving scale or latency—you're solving architectural coherence across organizational and geographic boundaries during a high\-velocity scaling phase.
   

  

 You'll have principal\-level authority to drive real\-time architectural decisions. This is influencer and integrator work—shaping technical direction across teams you don't control, building consensus across distributed ownership, and ensuring our international expansion maintains architectural consistency while moving at maximum velocity.
   

  

 You're solving architectural coherence across organizational and geographic boundaries during a high\-velocity scaling phase. The technical challenges are specific: redesigning Buy\-X\-Get\-Y promotions architecture to work across multiple purchase sessions, evolving Add to Delivery personalization to remove post\-filtering from the CX layer in under XXms, partnering with Fulfillment Optimization and Search teams to recover XXXms of latency in Search Gateway, extending Amazon Day and other consolidation products to pre\-checkout surfaces, and re\-architecting checkout flows with the Purchase Experience team.
   

  

 Required Domain Expertise
   

  

 This role requires experience with broad design systems and cross\-organizational technical coordination at scale. As an ideal candidate, you will already have experience in e\-commerce delivery systems architecture. When fully ramped you will need deep understanding of Amazon's delivery promise systems—how systems like Promise, and Fulfillment Optimization interact to calculate, align, and fulfill delivery dates across multiple fulfillment networks. This includes expertise in promise matching, promise alignment, eligibility evaluation, and the technical mechanisms that enable consolidation across orders.
   

  

 Beyond technical depth, this role demands expertise in architectural coordination across 30\+ partner organizations where you must influence design decisions without direct authority. You'll navigate country\-specific legal requirements (EU payment regulations, MFA constraints in India), marketplace\-specific fulfillment characteristics, and localized promise behaviors while maintaining architectural consistency.
   

  

 While in role you must also understand international expansion complexity: configuration management across 27 services, promise accuracy requirements varying by locale, and the technical debt patterns that compound across markets. This isn't generic distributed systems work—it's delivery\-domain\-specific architecture requiring fluency in how customers shop, how promises are calculated, and how consolidation creates network value.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Delivery Choices supports customers' unique needs for shopping convenience defined as greater consolidation, predictability, and control over delivery timelines. We enable customers to easily add items to an upcoming delivery at any point during their shopping journey, and provide delivery options that offer customers additional benefits like increased control over delivery timelines, lower carbon delivery, and monetary rewards.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of professional software development experience
* 7\+ years programming experience with at least one software programming language
* 5\+ years experience contributing to the system design or architecture (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead OR leading an engineering team


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Ability to take raw product requirements and develop software architectures and designs to bring them to life
* Analytical abilities, proven design skills and a track record of delivery
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Hands\-on expertise in many disparate technologies, typically ranging from front\-end user interfaces through to back\-end systems and all points in between
* Experience in driving systemic operational improvements
* Experience mentoring software engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
* Experience influencing software engineers best practices across teams
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Master's degree in computer science or related technical discipline, or equivalent experience
* Experience with or knowledge of AWS services
* Deep understanding of e\-commerce delivery systems, promise calculation, and fulfillment optimization
* Experience coordinating architecture across multiple organizations without direct authority
* Track record of successful international expansion and marketplace\-specific technical adaptations

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
Senior Back-end Developer 
 Kavi India Software Technologies is seeking an experienced Senior Back-end Developer with a minimum of 10+ years of experience in Python application development. You should be highly proficient in Python and have strong experience building scalable, secure, high-performance enterprise applications. You should have hands-on experience in developing RESTful APIs, web applications, and backend services using modern Python frameworks. A good understanding of software architecture, testing, performance optimization, security, and cloud-based application development is essential. 
 A Senior Python Developer should be capable of quickly understanding an existing product, its business objectives, application architecture, technical design, and development practices, and should be able to take ownership of the assigned modules or applications with minimal guidance. The candidate should be able to independently analyse requirements, understand technical dependencies, make appropriate design decisions, and effectively roll out solutions within the expected timelines. 
 The candidate should also have the ability to guide and mentor other developers, provide technical direction to the team, participate in architectural and design discussions, and ensure that development activities follow established engineering standards and best practices. 
 Responsibilities : 
 Take end-to-end ownership of assigned backend applications, modules, and technical deliverables. Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and high-performance code using Python. Develop web applications, RESTful APIs, and microservices using frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask. Quickly understand existing product architecture, business requirements, application workflows, technical designs, and development practices. Analyse business and functional requirements and translate them into appropriate technical solutions. Design and develop technical interfaces, application architecture, API specifications, and software components. Participate actively in architecture and technical design discussions and provide recommendations based on scalability, maintainability, security, and performance. Utilize established development tools, guidelines, and best practices including Python, SQL, Git, REST APIs, and modern software development practices. Develop and maintain technical documentation throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Prepare and maintain Python applications while resolving application defects, performance issues, and production problems. Develop unit tests, integration tests, and automated test cases to ensure application quality and reliability. Enhance existing applications by analysing business objectives, identifying areas for improvement, and preparing implementation plans. Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential issues early and take appropriate corrective actions. Take responsibility for delivering assigned features and enhancements with minimal supervision. Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, UI Developers, and other stakeholders to deliver product features successfully. Guide and mentor junior and mid-level developers on technical implementation, coding standards, debugging, and best practices. Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to ensure code quality and consistency. Help the team resolve complex technical issues and provide technical direction when required. Monitor application health and provide production support when required. Investigate and evaluate new technologies and recommend suitable solutions that can improve product capabilities, development efficiency, performance, or maintainability. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications : 
 10+ years of experience in Python application development. Proven experience as a Senior Python Developer, Senior Back-end Developer, or equivalent technical role. Strong hands-on experience in Python application development and software engineering. Strong experience with Python web frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask. Strong understanding of RESTful API development and Microservices architecture. Experience with ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy or Django ORM. Good understanding of authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth2, JWT, LDAP, and SSO. Familiarity with API documentation tools such as Swagger/OpenAPI. Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, and common design patterns. Good understanding of software architecture and ability to translate requirements into scalable technical designs. Experience working with relational databases and writing efficient SQL queries. Strong understanding of application performance, scalability, reliability, and security considerations. Knowledge of unit and integration testing frameworks such as PyTest or UnitTest. Experience in debugging complex application and production issues. Ability to quickly understand an existing product, architecture, codebase, and business domain. 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) Experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based application development. Experience with Azure services such as Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure Service Bus, Azure Redis Cache, Key Vault, and Application Insights. Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Docker and containerized application development.

Key Skills: Python,Django,Fast API,Flask

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Description This role requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, and the ability to foster a collaborative and innovative environment. We are looking for a Project Lead familiar with cloud-native and AI-native development practices. Our software is built around AI at its core-LLMs, agents, and retrieval systems-and runs on IaaS (Google Cloud/AWS/etc.), so familiarity with these environments and their managed AI services is a plus. Full ownership of your code will be encouraged, including deployment, testing, evaluation, and validation of both traditional and AI components. You will lead a team of software and AI engineers, coaching and mentoring them. Familiarity with CI/CD, test-driven development, and evaluation-driven development (eval harnesses for AI features) will be a benefit. Responsibility Area: Leadership Manage individual contributors daily tasks Mentor software and AI engineers to ensure high product quality across both deterministic code and AI/model behavior Perform detailed code reviews, including reviews of prompts, agent logic, and evaluation results Evaluate performance, provide feedback and constructive criticism to team members Set and track quarterly goals for all team members Assist with training and recruitment activities Provide status updates, weekly reports, and issue details to senior leadership as needed Participate in Root Cause Analysis for customer-reported issues, including failures rooted in model behavior, hallucinations, or data/retrieval quality Aid and support the coaching and training of other team members to ensure all employees are confident in the use of software applications and AI tooling Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including product management, domain specialists, and engineering to define requirements and develop scalable AI-driven solutions Stay current with the latest advancements in AI and related technologies (new models, frameworks, and techniques), and proactively identify opportunities to apply them to our products and services Responsibility Area: Software Development Develop intuitive AI-native software that meets and exceeds the needs of the company Development of technical specifications and planning, including model selection, prompt/agent design, and data/retrieval architecture Analyze and automate tests for software components prior to delivery, and build evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, and hallucination checks) for AI features Troubleshoot coding and model-behavior problems quickly and efficiently to ensure a productive workplace Follow secure software coding practices, including AI-specific safeguards (prompt-injection defense, data privacy, PII handling, and responsible-AI guardrails) Professionally maintain all software and create updates regularly to address customer and company concerns, including monitoring model performance and drift in production IaaS procedures and practices, including managed AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI) Experience with Kubernetes and containerization is welcome; experience serving models or deploying inference/GPU workloads is a plus Responsibility Area: Communication Communicate effectively and professionally in all forms of communication with internal and external customers Liaise with team members, management, and clients Be transparent about challenges, failures, and successes, including the limitations and non-deterministic nature of AI systems Deliver presentations and write progress reports for stakeholders, translating AI capabilities and trade-offs for both technical and non-technical audiences Actively seek ways to improve business software processes and interactions, including where AI and automation can add value Qualifications 3-5 years of practical Java experience 1-2 years of experience with prompt engineering and prompt/agent scripting 1-2 years of hands-on experience integrating third-party AI/ML services and platform APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Salesforce and other SaaS) Proven ability to design and manage domain-specific languages, prompt templates, and agent instruction frameworks Develop and optimize microservices that power high-performance data and embedding pipelines, handling up to 10 million rows and feeding vector stores Proficiency in Python, Java, and JavaScript, with strong Python skills for the ML/AI ecosystem Experience with RESTful and streaming APIs, model/inference endpoints, web services, and integration technologies Knowledge of cloud computing and managed AI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI) Create customer-centric AI solutions such as RAG assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-driven customer service Create data and knowledge-base migration tools for SaaS applications, including moving embeddings and vector data between cloud instances Experience with LLM orchestration and retrieval frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) Outstanding collaboration and communication skills Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, including working with non-deterministic AI outputs Ability to learn quickly, take direction, work independently, and as part of a team Ability to develop unit tests and AI evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, and hallucination checks) for code components, prompts, and complete applications Ability to debug and isolate the root cause of complex issues in probabilistic and distributed systems Experience with Agile and Scrum development methodologies Experience with Spring Boot or similar frameworks Experience working with APIs, REST standards, JSON, SQL, and NoSQL/vector stores Bachelors degree in computer science or a related field; coursework or experience in ML/AI a plus

description:
**Job Title: Senior Software Engineer**

This role aligns with market job titles such as Agentic system engineer, Agentic Ai Engineer, or AgentOps Engineer


***Drive the future of Agentic AI at Pearson as part of the AgentOps Engineering team. Inspire innovation. Empower learning.***

Pearson, the world’s leading learning company, is hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to play a key role on our AgentOps Engineering team.


**Why This Role Matters**

Are you passionate about building AI agents that reason, plan, route work, and run reliably in production—not just prototypes? Do you want to shape how an enterprise builds, operates, and governs digital workers at scale? Join our AgentOps Engineering team and help build the core platform capabilities that power agent crews running across the business.


This is a hands\-on senior engineering role focused on **building** . You’ll ship the write\-path features that let agents take real actions, design the orchestration and routing patterns that direct work to the right agent, and engineer enhancements to the platform itself—working inside it, not just on top of it. Through this, you’ll help teams across Pearson put dependable AI agents to work, and help people realize the lives they imagine through learning.


**As a key member of the AgentOps Engineering team and Pearson, you will be expected to embody, and role model our leadership dimensions:**

* **Live Our Purpose:** You connect your engineering work to Pearson’s mission and make decisions that reflect a clear understanding of our strategy.
* **Simplify the Complexity:** You navigate ambiguity in a fast\-changing field and distil complex agentic systems into clear, reliable solutions.
* **Carry Our Culture:** You collaborate generously, mentor through design and code reviews, and contribute to an inclusive, high\-performing team.
* **Deliver Results:** You set a high quality bar, get the details right, and own outcomes that matter to learners and stakeholders.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Build write\-path features**
* Ship the features that let agents take real, governed actions—wrapping enterprise APIs, validators, and data sources so agents can write, not just read.
* Design safe write semantics: idempotency, confirmation and human\-in\-the\-loop gates, structured outputs, and audit\-ready action logging.
* **Design multi\-agent orchestration**
* Build multi\-agent and digital\-worker orchestration patterns that let specialized agents delegate, collaborate, and complete multi\-step goals.
* Build stateful, cyclic workflows using modern agent orchestration frameworks—enabling reflection, recovery, and adaptive execution beyond linear chains.
* **Engineer agent routing**
* Build the routing layer that directs requests to the right agent or crew—intent classification, capability\-based dispatch, fallback, and escalation paths.
* Create reusable components for retries, degraded modes, and human handoff; tune agent roles, goals, and prompts using fixtures and golden sets.
* **Enhance the platform**
* Work hands\-on with the agentic platform—creating, versioning, invoking, and debugging crews, tasks, and graphs through platform APIs—and contribute enhancements back where new patterns are needed.
* Design long\-running, resumable workflows (checkpointing, persistence, context restoration) and resilience patterns for non\-deterministic AI.
* **Ship with AI, at quality**
* Work primarily through AI\-pair\-programming as your default mode—researching, scaffolding, implementing, reviewing, and shipping at high velocity while holding quality through TDD and rigorous verification.
* **Raise the bar**
* Drive reusable engineering standards, shared libraries, and reference patterns; mentor engineers through design and code reviews; and share the prompts, skills, and workflows that multiply everyone’s output.

**Who You Are**

* A hands\-on senior engineer who builds production\-grade agentic systems, not demos.
* An independent owner who takes complex workstreams from ambiguity to reliable, shipped software.
* A collaborator who influences through standards and mentoring, without needing authority.
* Someone with strong taste and trade\-off judgment across quality, latency, cost, resilience, and maintainability.

**What You’ll Bring**

*(we hire for demonstrated skill, not years on a résumé)*

* You build LLM\-powered systems, agents, or digital workers that run in production.
* Strong Python and backend/platform engineering—async services, typed code, and clean architecture.
* You work fluently with agent orchestration frameworks and can design, build, and orchestrate reliable agent tools—contracts, error handling, tool chaining.
* You’ve built routing, dispatch, or workflow\-control logic that directs work across components or services.
* You use AI\-pair\-programming as a primary delivery mode without sacrificing quality.
* Strong prompt engineering for structured outputs, nested schemas, and multi\-agent coordination.
* You read, edit, and contribute to a real platform codebase—APIs, runtime, storage—not just an SDK.
* Solid APIs, distributed systems, and cloud\-native engineering, with production\-reliability instincts.

**Even Better…**

* Experience evaluating agents—task success, groundedness, tool\-use accuracy, schema conformance, and regression against golden fixtures.
* Experience with tool/context interoperability protocols (such as MCP).
* Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), containerization, and CI/CD; familiarity with state stores for orchestration and persistence.
* AI observability and evaluation tooling for LLM systems.
* RAG and memory patterns: vector databases, hybrid retrieval, re\-ranking, and grounding.
* Secure execution, sandboxing, and prompt\-injection mitigation.

**What You’ll Gain**

* A front\-row seat building enterprise agentic AI infrastructure that teams across Pearson rely on.
* Real ownership of orchestration, routing, and platform patterns others adopt.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and innovation\-driven culture.
* Access to cutting\-edge tools, platforms, and thought leadership.

**Why Pearson?**

At Pearson, we don’t just build careers—we accelerate them. Known for our strong culture of internal mobility and leadership development, we offer a clear path to broader technical and leadership roles.


We believe great work deserves great rewards. That’s why we offer some of the most competitive benefits in the industry—designed to support the diverse needs of our people and their families. Explore our Benefits.


At Pearson, we’re reimagining learning through technology. If you’re an engineer who thrives in complexity, builds with craft, and is excited to put AI agents to work at scale—we’d love to hear from you.


**Apply today and imagine the impact you can make.**

**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.


Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E\-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.


If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  





**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**




 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  





***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

 At Freshworks, we are building the future of customer and employee engagement \- and AI agents are at the center of it. The AI Agent Platform is the foundation on which our next generation of autonomous and assistive experiences are built. AI Studio is the product surface that brings that platform to life: the place where builders design, test, deploy, observe, and continuously optimize AI agents that ship inside our CX and EX products.
   

  

 We are looking for a visionary engineering leader to own AI Studio end to end. As the Senior Director of Engineering for AI Studio, you will lead a dynamic, multi\-disciplinary organization that builds the front\-end experience and the Backend\-for\-Frontend (BFF) layer for the AI Agent Platform, and embeds these capabilities natively within our CX and EX product lines. This is a pivotal, high\-visibility role with the opportunity to shape how thousands of businesses build and operate AI agents \- setting the bar for craftsmanship, developer experience, reliability, and scale.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead a dynamic, multi\-disciplinary organization of engineers and engineering managers spanning front\-end, BFF/services, and platform integration.
* Own the vision and technical execution for AI Studio \- the end\-to\-end experience to build, test, deploy, observe, and optimize AI agents on the AI Agent Platform.
* Deliver a best\-in\-class front end and a robust Backend\-for\-Frontend (BFF) layer that expose the AI Agent Platform’s capabilities to builders with speed, trust, and clarity.
* Embed AI Studio natively within both CX and EX product lines, ensuring a seamless, consistent builder and end\-user experience across surfaces.
* Establish the agent lifecycle as a first\-class product: authoring and configuration, testing and evaluation, safe deployment, live observability, and data\-driven optimization.
* Partner deeply with the AI Agent Platform, AI/ML, and Data Science teams to surface state\-of\-the\-art models, tools, and orchestration capabilities through intuitive workflows.
* Define and track impact: agent build velocity, time\-to\-deploy, adoption, agent quality and containment/deflection, reliability, and measurable ROI for CX and EX customers.
* Establish governance and trust: access controls, guardrails, data classification, privacy/PII handling, auditability, and compliance\-ready practices for agent workflows.



**What You’ll Do**



* **Set the AI Studio vision:** 
 Define the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for a unified studio experience that lets builders create, test, deploy, observe, and optimize AI agents across CX and EX.
* **Own the full builder journey:** 
 Ship the front\-end and BFF that make agent authoring, configuration, and iteration fast, intuitive, and reliable \- from first prototype to production at scale.
* **Deliver testing \& evaluation:** 
 Build the tooling for agent testing, simulation, and evaluation (quality, safety, regression) so teams ship agents with confidence and measurable quality bars.
* **Enable safe, scalable deployment:** 
 Provide deployment, versioning, and rollout controls that let teams promote agents across environments with strong guardrails and zero\-downtime expectations.
* **Build observability \& optimization:** 
 Deliver real\-time monitoring, tracing, and analytics for live agents \- surfacing quality, latency, cost, and outcome signals \- and close the loop so insights drive continuous optimization.
* **Embed across CX \& EX:** 
 Ensure AI Studio integrates natively into Freshworks CX and EX products, delivering a consistent experience while respecting the needs of each product line.
* **Lead \& inspire:** 
 Cultivate a high\-performance, inclusive culture across a multi\-tiered organization of engineers and managers. Mentor the next generation of technical leaders and build a team known for technical excellence and execution velocity.
* **Execute with excellence:** 
 Master the full development lifecycle, from strategic planning and roadmap management to deployment and operations. Champion agile, iterative delivery to ship exceptional products under ambitious deadlines and evolving priorities.
* **Drive technical \& architectural strategy:** 
 Act as the technical authority for AI Studio. Guide teams in building large\-scale, distributed cloud systems, performant front\-end architectures, and resilient BFF/API layers, adopting best practices and emerging AI technologies.
* **Collaborate to win:** 
 Build powerful partnerships with AI Agent Platform, AI/ML, Product, Design, and GTM leaders so the AI Studio roadmap is aligned with platform capabilities, business needs, and customer expectations. Foster a “one team” mindset.
* **Champion innovation \& quality:** 
 Foster continuous improvement and out\-of\-the\-box thinking. Establish and track KPIs that measure AI Studio health, reliability, builder productivity, and business impact.


**Qualifications**

**What You’ll Bring**



* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (Director or above) leading product\-facing platform, developer\-tooling, or application engineering teams.
* Demonstrable experience building, scaling, and leading high\-performing product and engineering organizations in an enterprise SaaS environment.
* Strong technical foundation in building and operating large\-scale, distributed systems on public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including modern front\-end architectures and Backend\-for\-Frontend (BFF)/API design.
* Hands\-on understanding of the AI/agent landscape: LLMs, agent orchestration, RAG, evaluation and observability for AI systems, and the practical realities of shipping AI features into production.
* Track record of delivering builder\- or developer\-facing products (studios, low\-code/no\-code tooling, or platform consoles) with excellent UX and reliability at scale.



**Skills Inventory:**




**Leadership \& Talent Management**



* Inspirational leadership \& mentorship
* Talent acquisition \& retention
* Organizational design \& scaling
* Performance management \& career development



**Technical \& Architectural Acumen**



* Front\-end architecture \& Backend\-for\-Frontend (BFF) design

You will work on complex technical challenges spanning semantic search, RAG systems, knowledge graphs, and enterprise AI agents, while establishing observability standards. **Specialized Qualifications (Strongly Preferred)**

* AI Agentic Platforms: Familiarity with agentic AI systems and autonomous agent frameworks.
* OpenTelemetry \& Observability: Proficiency with OTel for distributed tracing, structured logging, and metrics across complex systems.
* AI\-Driven Development: Experience with Claude, Cursor, or similar AI coding assistants.

description:
**Position Summary**
 The Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for transforming high\-precision fixture designs into physical assets with a focus on technical excellence and financial efficiency. This role requires a blend of advanced CNC/CAM expertise and rigorous project management to ensure parts are machined "Right First Time" within the estimated budget and hours.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* CNC / CAM \& Process Strategy
* High\-Precision Programming: Develop 3\-axis and 5\-axis CNC programs using advanced CAM software, optimizing tool paths for surface finish and accuracy.
* Manufacturing Methods: Identify the most efficient manufacturing sequence to ensure dimensions meet customer specifications (±5 to ±10 microns).
* Surface Treatment Planning: Calculate and apply precise machining allowances to account for post\-processing requirements like Hard Anodizing, ENP, or Heat Treatment.
* Material Expertise \& Development
* Metallic Machining: Implement specialized cutting strategies for Stainless Steel (work\-hardening prevention) and Aluminium (high\-speed machining with superior surface finish).
* Non\-Metallic \& Polymer Development: Lead the machining and development of TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane) and other engineering plastics. This includes managing material compression during clamping and selecting razor\-sharp tooling to prevent "burring" or melting.
* Distortion\-Free Machining: Develop specialized workholding and stress\-relieving machining sequences to prevent warping in thin\-walled components.
* Production Control \& Cost Management
* Machining Hour Control: Monitor and control actual machining hours against the pre\-defined Estimated Man\-Hours. Identify variances and implement corrective actions to prevent cost overruns.
* Efficiency Audits: Continuously review CNC cycle times and setup procedures to align shop\-floor performance with the commercial estimate.
* Assembly Engineering: Lead the physical integration of mechanical, pneumatic, and electrical subsystems, ensuring zero interference during the final build.


**Technical Requirements**
* Education \& Experience
* Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech in Manufacturing, Mechanical, or Production Engineering.
* Experience: 4–7 years in high\-precision CNC machining and toolroom operations.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in managing "Estimate vs. Actual" machining costs for custom tooling projects.
* Software \& Technical Proficiency
* CAM Mastery: Expert proficiency in Mastercam, NX CAM, or PowerMill.
* Project Tracking: Familiarity with ERP systems or Excel\-based tracking for monitoring machining hours and production milestones.
* Metrology: Hands\-on experience with CMM, 3D scanning, and high\-precision manual gauging.
* Specialized Knowledge
* Material Science: Understanding of the thermal and mechanical properties of Stainless Steel, Aluminium alloys, and the elastic behaviour of TPU during machining.
* Tooling Economics: Ability to select cutting tools that balance high\-speed removal with long\-term cost\-efficiency.


**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**
 Labor Efficiency: Percentage variance between Estimated vs. Actual machining hours (Target: \<5% variance).
 - Quality Rate: Success rate of First Article Inspection (FAI) with zero rework due to machining errors or material distortion.

- Material Integrity: Zero part rejections due to improper handling of specialized materials (e.g., melting of TPU or work\-hardening of SS).

- On\-Time Delivery: Adherence to the production schedule for final fixture assembly.

description:
**About Rippling** 




  





 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
 



 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
 



  





 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
 



  





 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 At Rippling, the Accounting Integrations team sits at the critical intersection of product innovation and financial infrastructure. Our mission is to empower finance teams to move from traditional month\-end closes to real\-time accounting by seamlessly connecting Rippling’s platform with the world’s most widely\-used ERP systems—including NetSuite, QuickBooks, and soon Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle, and more.
 



  





 We build robust, bi\-directional integrations that serve both Rippling’s internal products (like Payroll, Spend Management, Procurement, and Travel) and external ERPs used by our customers. These integrations power complex accounting workflows such as journal syncing, reconciliation, audit readiness, and more, enabling our customers to automate the most repetitive and error\-prone financial operations.
 



  





 As Rippling expands globally and moves upmarket to serve large enterprises, the Accounting Integrations team is at the forefront of unlocking key use cases and supporting new geographies, integrations, and accounting standards. This team also operates in a high\-velocity, continuous delivery environment, tackling a wide surface area of capabilities, systems, and support scenarios.
 



  





 If you’re excited by systems design, love working across product boundaries, and want to build foundational infrastructure that finance teams depend on, the Accounting Integrations team is the place to be.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Grow Payroll products by expanding accounting coverage across all spend use cases. Empower finance teams to move from traditional month\-end closes to real\-time accounting.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable, two\-way integrations between Rippling and ERP systems , powering features like journal syncing, bank reconciliations, audit data, and real\-time transaction flows.
* Ship medium\-to\-large features end\-to\-end with minimal oversight, owning requirements gathering, architectural design, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, UX, internal platform teams (Payroll, Spend, Procurement, Travel), and external partners to translate high\-level business needs into robust technical solutions.
* Drive technical excellence by defining and enforcing best practices in code quality, testing (unit/integration), observability, and performance for a high\-throughput, continuous\-delivery environment.
* Tackle production support and incident response: dive into complex debugging, triage integration failures, resolve customer issues, and implement fixes that strengthen reliability and reduce future support load.
* Continuously improve integration frameworks and abstractions to accelerate delivery across multiple ERP platforms, ensuring consistency, extensibility, and maintainability.
* Drive key initiatives in partnership with technical leadership,own critical roadmap projects, propose architectural enhancements, and influence the team’s vision for expanding global accounting capabilities.
* Mentor and coach peers and more junior engineers,conduct design/code reviews, share feedback on architecture, and help unblock teammates to raise the team’s overall bar.



  





**Who you are** 



* You care about product ownership and solving problems for our customers.
* You’re passionate about being in a product\-focused environment where everyone cares deeply about customer impact.
* Adapt and learn beyond your core expertise: pick up new frameworks, front\-end or back\-end technologies, infrastructure tools, and domain concepts to get work done autonomously.
* Embrace a sense of urgency to onboard quickly: shadow support rotations, tackle real tickets early, and proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, documentation, and tooling.



  





**What you will need** 



* BS/MS in Computer Science (or equivalent practical experience).
* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping backend or full\-stack systems end\-to\-end.
* Strong CS fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and reliability at scale.
* Proficiency in one or more backend languages (Python, Go, Java, or Node.js) and hands\-on experience with RESTful or gRPC APIs.
* Deep experience building integrations or middleware, ideally connecting to ERPs (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Dynamics 365, Oracle) or other financial systems.
* Solid database skills, including designing schemas and writing efficient queries in relational (Postgres, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) stores.
* Proven troubleshooting and support skills, with experience debugging production incidents, analyzing logs/metrics, and driving root\-cause fixes.
* Product mindset and communication excellence, able to collaborate with PMs, UX, internal teams, and external partners to turn ambiguous requirements into robust solutions.
* Self\-starter attitude, comfortable learning new frameworks, digging into unfamiliar codebases, and proactively taking on non\-core tasks (e.g., light front\-end work, custom tooling, support).
* Bonus: Prior hands\-on with ERP\-specific APIs or SDKs (NetSuite SuiteTalk, QuickBooks API, Dynamics OData, Oracle integrations).
* Bonus: Direct experience or deep interest in accounting workflows (journal entries, reconciliations, book closure).

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
**Hello there! We're Infrrd.** 




 Infrrd (pronounced In\-fur\-d) is an Enterprise AI company that uses AI and Machine Learning to automate human tasks in document\-heavy workflows across mortgage, insurance, and finance. We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to help build and own the backend services that power our mortgage document processing platform.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 You will own backend services that process large, complex mortgage documents at scale — designing the pipelines, integrating LLMs, and keeping the whole thing fast, accurate, and cost effective in production. This is a hands\-on senior role with real ownership: you will make architecture calls, drive them to a decision, and set the quality bar for engineers working alongside you.
 



  





**What You'll Actually Work On:** 




 High\-throughput extraction pipelines that process big\-size documents and large volumes of data in parallel, LLM failover and resilience logic across multiple model providers, and continuous work on accuracy, latency, and cost.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 
 :
 


* **Build high\-throughput document pipelines.** 
 Asynchronous, parallel processing with batching, retries, backpressure, and idempotent reprocessing for big\-size documents and large data volumes.
* **Work with the latest LLMs.** 
 Build against current LLM APIs — timeouts, token and cost controls, response validation, and automatic failover between providers.
* **Engineer for resilience.** 
 Circuit breakers, fallback chains, and graceful degradation so a single upstream failure never takes the pipeline down.
* **Debug production.** 
 Investigate extraction failures, latency spikes, and cost regressions using dashboards and metrics, and fix the root cause.
* **Raise the bar on the team.** 
 Review PRs, break features into clear tasks, unblock junior engineers, and write design docs that hold up to scrutiny across time zones.



  





  





**Who You Are** 
 :
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on Java development, including at least 2 years owning a production service.
* Excellent command of Core Java, with real depth in multithreading and concurrent architecture design.
* Strong with Spring Boot and Spring Data; comfortable in microservices and REST architecture.
* Strong working knowledge of No\-SQL DB (preferred MongoDB ); familiar with relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
* Comfortable with Docker and Kubernetes, and at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills with a solid command of data structures.
* Reasons about tradeoffs — cost, latency, and accuracy — not just correctness.
* Has informally mentored or guided junior engineers; the person others come to when they're stuck.
* Operates independently with minimal supervision, and proactively flags risks instead of waiting to be asked.
* Excellent written communication — much of the collaboration is asynchronous and across time zones.



  





**Good to Have** 
 :
 


* Exposure to LLM or GenAI application development — prompt iteration, evaluation, or accuracy measurement.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Experience with streaming queues like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Background in Document AI, OCR, or the mortgage / fintech domain.
* Familiarity with observability tooling (Grafana, Metabase, ELK).



  





**Work Mode:** 




 5\-days work in office with flexible working hours (Google Maps Location).
 



  





**Curious about the kind of engineering challenges we solve? Check out a few of our tech talks:** 




**Automated Data Extraction from Engineering \& Construction Drawings** 




**Ally \| Agentic AI for Mortgage** 




**NLP\-powered Table Extraction for Insurance Policy Data**

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
   

  

**Your opportunity**
 At New Relic, we provide our customers real\-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance and get the most of their software and infrastructure.
   

  

 If you are driven by innovation, passionate about technical excellence, and ready to lead a team of exceptional engineers, apply now for the position of Lead Software Engineer at New Relic.
   

  

 At New Relic, you will architect and build the massive\-scale streaming data platform that powers our industry\-leading observability ingestion pipelines. Join us in our mission to revolutionize observability by engineering systems that process massive data volumes with extreme throughput and low latency.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Define and drive the architectural roadmap for our core observability ingestion pipelines, ensuring high availability, resilience, and operational excellence.
* Lead the design and development of highly concurrent, distributed systems using advanced Java, Kafka, and cloud\-native technologies.
* Act as the principal technical expert, mentoring a team of engineers and establishing rigorous standards for code quality, testing, and performance optimization.
* Architect multi\-cloud infrastructure solutions, optimizing primarily for AWS while leveraging Azure for cross\-cloud compatibility and routing.
* Proactively identify and eliminate systemic bottlenecks through JVM tuning, advanced concurrency management, and efficient data structure design.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional leadership to translate complex business requirements into highly scalable technical strategies.


**This Role Requires**
* Experience: 8\+ years in software engineering, with a strong focus on designing and building large\-scale, highly concurrent distributed systems.
* Advanced Java Engineering: Expert\-level proficiency in Java, including deep knowledge of JVM tuning, garbage collection optimization, concurrency, and multithreading under extreme load.
* Distributed Streaming: Mastery of Apache Kafka (or AWS MSK), including deep understanding of partition strategies, consumer group rebalancing, and high\-throughput tuning.
* Cloud Architecture: Extensive hands\-on experience with AWS compute and data services (EKS, S3\) and strong architectural knowledge of Kubernetes and Docker.
* System Design: Exceptional problem\-solving skills with a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and resilient microservices design.
* Technical Leadership: Proven track record of defining technical vision, mentoring engineers, and successfully leading the delivery of mission\-critical systems.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Familiarity with stream processing frameworks, preferably Apache Flink or Kafka Streams.
* Practical experience with Azure equivalents (e.g., Event Hubs, AKS, Blob Storage).
* Experience utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform for automated provisioning.
* Experience establishing and improving CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps best practices.


**Bonus Points If You Have**
* Observability Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the MELT stack (Metrics, Events, Logs, Traces) and OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards.
* High Cardinality Solutions: Proven experience designing systems capable of handling high\-cardinality time\-series data at massive scale.
* Significant contributions to open\-source projects in distributed systems, stream processing, or observability domains.

description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself for more than two decades. The invention of the GPU in 1999 fueled the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. GPU\-powered deep learning helped ignite the era of modern AI, establishing GPUs as the foundation of intelligent applications across productivity, gaming, and creative workflows, and reinforcing NVIDIA’s position as a leading AI computing company.
   

  

 More recently, there is a growing focus on running AI models locally, closer to where data is generated. This approach reduces latency, enables real\-time processing, and addresses privacy concerns by minimizing the need to send data to centralized servers. As technology continues to evolve, client\-side AI will play an increasingly important role in shaping the digital landscape. The LocalAI team is seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer to develop efficient on\-device AI software for RTX and DGX\-class systems. The role focuses on delivering high\-performance local inference with low latency, optimized memory utilization, robust infrastructure, and practical deployment on resource\-constrained platforms.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Partner with NVIDIA’s software, research, architecture, and product teams to align technical requirements and strategic priorities, fostering the AI ecosystem on RTX and DGX PCs.
* Build and optimize the local AI inference stack for RTX, RTX Pro, and DGX GPUs, with a focus on performance, stability, and scalability across diverse hardware architectures.
* Design and develop modern inference runtimes and execution stacks using frameworks such as llama.cpp, vLLM, PyTorch, WinML, DXCGC, and TensorRT\-RTX, supporting LLM, vision\-language, TTS, ASR, and diffusion\-based AI workloads.
* Perform end\-to\-end optimization of AI models, data pipelines, and inference runtimes to maximize performance on current and next\-generation GPU architectures. Apply model optimization techniques, including quantization, pruning, sparsity, and distillation, to enable efficient deployment of large models on local and edge devices.
* Conduct system\-level debugging, performance tuning, and performance\-accuracy trade\-off analysis; develop infrastructure for performance and accuracy sweeps; analyse results to identify gaps and drive fixes; and establish engineering guidelines to accelerate bring\-up and ensure production readiness of new models and inference backends.


**What We Need To See**
* 5\+ Years of experience with Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent C\+\+ programming and debugging skills, with a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and machine learning.
* Proven experience developing and optimizing AI inference pipelines and applications using ML/DL frameworks such as Llama.cpp, vLLM, PyTorch, Windows ML, DXCGC, and TensorRT.
* Deep understanding of inference backends and runtime internals, including scheduling, memory management, KV\-cache behaviour, graph execution, quantization, and hardware\-aware optimization.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across engineering teams and management.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Understanding of modern machine learning, deep neural network, and generative AI techniques, with relevant contributions to major open\-source projects.
* Consistent track record of delivering end\-to\-end products in multinational companies with geographically distributed teams.
* Proficiency in low\-level system and GPU programming, CUDA, and the development of high\-performance systems.
* Contributions to open\-source inference runtimes, model tooling, or performance infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience building applications using frameworks and APIs such as llama.cpp, PyTorch, TensorRT, Vulkan, DirectX, and vLLM.

**Job Description – Senior PIM Developer With Commerce Integration Expertise**
**Experience: Min 5 years of hands\-on experience**
**Role Summary**
 The Senior PIM Developer will design, implement, and maintain Product Information Management solutions with a focus on product data governance, catalog enrichment, and seamless integration with Commerce platforms (Adobe Commerce / VTEX), ERP, OMS, and other enterprise systems. The role requires deep expertise in PIM tools, data modeling, and multi\-channel product syndication.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and configure PIM data models including product attributes, attribute sets, families, categories, and taxonomy structures.
* Implement and maintain PIM platforms (Akeneo, InRiver, Salsify) including workflows, rules, and data quality checks.
* Integrate PIM with downstream systems — Commerce platforms (Adobe Commerce / VTEX), ERP, OMS, CMS, and DAM — via REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, or ETL pipelines.
* Govern product data quality — define completeness rules, validation workflows, and enrichment processes.
* Manage multi\-channel catalog publishing — map and syndicate product data to various channels (web, print, marketplaces).
* Optimize data synchronization pipelines for performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Troubleshoot data discrepancies, sync failures, and production issues with timely resolution.
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to data governance and integration design decisions.
* Perform code and configuration reviews and mentor junior developers.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Data Stewards, Architects, QA, and business stakeholders in Agile environments.


**Qualifications**
**Must Have**
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one PIM platform: Akeneo, InRiver, Salsify, or equivalent.
* Deep understanding of product data modeling — attribute families, completeness metrics, variant/SKU hierarchies, and category trees.
* Experience building PIM\-to\-Commerce integrations (Adobe Commerce, VTEX, Salesforce Commerce, etc.).
* Proficiency with REST / GraphQL APIs for data ingestion and syndication.
* Experience with ERP integration (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) for pricing, inventory, and product master data.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with catalog APIs or Adobe Commerce catalog modules.
* Knowledge of DAM systems and media asset enrichment workflows.
* Familiarity with ETL tools (MuleSoft, Boomi).
* Understanding of B2B catalog scenarios: customer\-specific pricing, entitlements, and product visibility rules.
* Exposure to data governance frameworks and MDM concepts.


**Key Differentiators for This Role**
* PIM platform configuration and administration not just integration.
* Ownership of product data quality and enrichment workflows end\-to\-end.
* Ability to bridge business/merchandising teams and technical engineering teams.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Advisor - Software Engineer - SPE
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

**About Lilly**
 At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
   

  

**About Technology@Lilly**
 At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
   

  

**About The Business Function**
 The Software Product Engineering (SPE) team is a specialized engineering group that delivers strategic solutions and differentiated capabilities. We take a forward\-thinking approach, focusing on an enterprise platform and product mindset, ensuring that the solutions we build can be leveraged across Technology teams for broader impact and efficiency.
   

  

 As an Advisor Software Engineer (R5\), you are a recognised technical authority who shapes the engineering direction of the SPE organisation. You combine deep, hands\-on expertise in system design and distributed architecture with a forward\-looking AI\-first mindset – designing and building agentic AI systems, intelligent automation pipelines, and next\-generation software platforms. You are the go\-to person when teams face their hardest technical challenges, and you translate that expertise into scalable, production\-grade solutions that drive measurable business outcomes across multiple functions. This is a high\-impact, hands\-on technical leadership role. You will architect end\-to\-end systems, write production code, champion AI\-driven development practices, and influence engineering culture across teams – all while mentoring and coaching engineers to raise the overall technical bar.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
**System Design \& Architecture**
 Own end\-to\-end system design of large\-scale, distributed, cloud\-native platforms – from API contracts and data models to deployment topology and observability. Define and enforce architectural standards and patterns (microservices, event\-driven, serverless, CQRS) and lead architecture reviews, ADRs, and technical blueprints. Design for resilience, scalability, security, and cost\-efficiency on cloud platforms (AWS preferred; GCP/Azure acceptable). Drive decomposition of monolithic and COTS systems into modern, maintainable, in\-house services and platform capabilities. Hands\-On Full\-Stack Engineering
   

  

 Write production\-quality code across the stack using modern languages and frameworks (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Java, Rust, or equivalent) on both frontend and backend. Build and optimise APIs (RESTful, GraphQL), real\-time communication layers, and high\-throughput data pipelines with appropriate database technologies (relational, NoSQL, or columnar). Champion code quality through rigorous reviews, test\-driven development, and CI/CD automation. Apply DevSecOps principles end\-to\-end.
   

  

**AI\-Driven \& Agentic Engineering**
 Architect and build agentic AI systems that autonomously execute multi\-step workflows – leveraging LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent), tool\-use patterns, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). Design AI\-native architectures that embed intelligence into products: context\-aware assistants, automated decision support, and self\-healing infrastructure. Demonstrate mastery of prompt engineering, model evaluation, and responsible AI practices. Leverage AI\-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) and set the standard for the team. Evaluate emerging AI technologies (foundation models, multi\-modal AI, MCP, A2A protocols) and drive adoption where they create measurable value.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Influence**
 Act as the technical conscience across multiple teams and functions – challenging the status quo and providing recommendations to improve processes, tooling, and practices. Coach engineers at all levels, sharing specialised knowledge in architecture, AI, and software craftsmanship. Represent SPE in architecture guilds and technology leadership forums. What You Should Bring
   

  

**System Design \& Architecture**
 Proven track record designing and delivering large\-scale distributed systems in production (microservices, event\-driven, serverless architectures). Deep expertise in at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred) with infrastructure\-as\-code (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform) and containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes). Cloud certifications are a plus. Strong knowledge of domain\-driven design (DDD), CQRS, API gateway patterns, and system decomposition strategies.
   

  

**Software Engineering**
 Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Java, Rust) with the ability to work across the full stack. Experience building frontend applications with modern frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Vue) with focus on performance, accessibility, and component\-driven design. Proficient in backend development with appropriate frameworks and database technologies (relational and/or NoSQL). Strong testing discipline and CI/CD experience. AI \& Agentic Systems
   

  

 Hands\-on experience building AI\-powered applications: agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and prompt engineering at production scale. Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks and foundation model capabilities, limitations, evaluation, and responsible AI principles.
   

  

**Leadership \& Influence**
 Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority. Excellent communication for architecture documents, ADRs, and standards. Strong track record of coaching engineers. A challenger mindset: you question assumptions, propose better alternatives, and drive innovation.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. 14\+ years of hands\-on software development experience across frontend and backend systems, with at least 4 years in a senior/lead architecture role. Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and software architecture. Effective communication skills with the ability to influence at a cross\-functional level. High intellectual curiosity and commitment to continuous learning.
   

  

**Additional Skills / Preferences**
 Experience in regulated industries (e.g., Life Sciences, Healthcare) or familiarity with compliance frameworks (GxP, HIPAA, SOX). Contributions to open\-source projects, technical publications, or a visible engineering community presence. Experience with platform engineering, developer experience (DX) tooling, or multi\-modal AI in enterprise contexts.
   

  

*At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. This is not just a policy. It is who we are.*
