title: Shopify Developer
description:
Shopify Developer \+ UI/UX Designer

**WebzPlot \| Bangalore**

We’re looking for a **Shopify Developer who also has a strong eye for UI/UX and eCommerce design.**

Someone who can build a technically solid Shopify store, but also understands that a good eCommerce website is not just about clean code.

It needs to **look good, feel intuitive and convert.**

At WebzPlot, we work with brands across fashion, jewellery, beauty, lifestyle, D2C and other eCommerce categories. We’re looking for someone who can take a store from idea to execution while thinking about both the customer experience and the development behind it.

What You’ll Do

* Build and customise Shopify stores from scratch
* Work with Shopify 2\.0 themes and custom sections
* Develop using Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Customise existing themes based on client requirements
* Convert Figma or design concepts into responsive Shopify pages
* Design and improve product pages, collection pages, landing pages and homepages
* Create clean, modern and conversion\-focused eCommerce layouts
* Improve mobile shopping experiences
* Work on cart, upsell, cross\-sell and conversion\-focused functionality
* Integrate Shopify apps and third\-party tools
* Troubleshoot theme, app and frontend issues
* Improve website speed and frontend performance
* Maintain consistent design systems across the store

The UI/UX Side Matters

We are not looking for someone who simply takes a design and codes it.

We want someone who can look at an eCommerce page and understand:

* Whether the visual hierarchy makes sense
* Whether the CTA is prominent enough
* Whether the product information is easy to scan
* Whether the page feels trustworthy
* Whether the mobile experience is smooth
* Whether too many elements are creating friction
* Whether the layout supports conversion

You should be able to suggest improvements instead of blindly implementing everything you are given.

What We Expect From You

You should have strong working knowledge of:

* Shopify
* Shopify Liquid
* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* Shopify 2\.0 architecture
* Metafields and dynamic content
* Theme customisation
* Responsive design
* Cross\-browser compatibility
* Shopify app integrations
* Basic performance optimisation

You should also have a strong understanding of:

* eCommerce UI/UX
* Conversion\-focused design
* Product page structure
* Collection page usability
* Mobile\-first design
* Visual hierarchy
* Typography and spacing
* CTA placement
* Navigation and information architecture

Design Tools

Experience with the following is preferred:

* Figma
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Canva

Figma knowledge is especially important.

You do not need to be a full\-time graphic designer, but you should be comfortable creating and refining clean website layouts.

You’ll Be a Strong Fit If

You care about the small details.

You notice when spacing is inconsistent.

You understand why a button should be above the fold.

You know when a page looks visually impressive but is difficult to shop.

You think about the customer journey before adding another section.

You can balance aesthetics with conversion.

And when you build something, you test it properly across desktop and mobile instead of assuming it works.

Bonus Points If You

* Have experience working with D2C brands
* Have built premium or luxury eCommerce websites
* Understand CRO
* Know basic SEO principles for Shopify
* Have experience with page builders
* Understand Shopify app conflicts
* Can work with APIs or custom integrations
* Have experience with Git
* Understand accessibility and usability best practices
* Can create reusable Shopify sections that clients can manage easily

What Your Work Will Be Judged On

Not just whether the website works.

We’ll look at:

* Code quality
* Visual quality
* Responsiveness
* Website speed
* User experience
* Conversion thinking
* Attention to detail
* Ability to solve problems independently

Experience

**2 to 5 years preferred**

Strong Shopify experience is required.

Agency experience is an advantage because you’ll be working across multiple brands and projects.

Location

**Bangalore \- In our JP Nagar Office**

Think You’re a Fit?

Send us:

* Your CV
* Your Shopify portfolio
* 3 websites you have worked on
* What you specifically handled on each project
* A Figma or UI/UX sample if available

We’re looking for someone who can **build like a developer and think like an eCommerce designer.**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Bengaluru, Karnataka (Bengaluru, Bengaluru Urban District): Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Are you currently in Bengaluru? If not are you willing to relocate and work from our JP Nagar office?
* Show us one eCommerce website you think is beautifully designed but poorly optimised for conversion. What would you change?
* Share your work sample links and shortlist your best works and let us know what do you like about it and what could be done better if you were to redo it

Experience:

* Creating Ecommerce Website on Shopify: 1 year (Required)
* UI design: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

 Snoox Automation Pvt. Ltd. is a leading provider of industrial automation solutions, specializing in process control, PLC, AC Drives Motion, and HMI technologies across multiple industries. Founded in 2019, the company designs, develops, and implements measurement, control, and data logging systems for sectors such as heat treatment, environmental chambers, pharmaceuticals, glass furnaces, and oil processes. Snoox Automation executes turnkey automation projects for industries including power generation and distribution, food and beverages, metals, and packaging, and also offers repair services for industrial automation products. **Role Description** 
 The PLC Programmer will work full time on\-site at Snoox Automation Pvt. * Experience designing scalable cloud solutions in Azure and AWS
* Proven experience leading complex technical initiatives


**AI Capability**
* Experience designing AI\-augmented development workflows
* Ability to define:
+ Validation standards for AI outputs
+ Prompt engineering frameworks

* Understanding of LLM integration and responsible AI practices


**Core Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and system design
* Platform and automation mindset
* Influence and cross\-team collaboration
* Innovation and continuous improvement

title: Workday Integration Developer
description:
**Do you enjoy implementing innovative solutions?**
**Would you like to facilitate improvements in Workday??**
**Join our Digital Technology team**
 Our Digital Technology business provides intelligent, connected technologies to monitor and control our energy extraction assets. We provide customers with the peace of mind needed to reliably and efficiently improve their operations. Our team creates business value through continuous improvement in up\-time, resilience, performance, time to market ,security and compliance.
   

  

**Partner with the best**
 The Workday Developer, on the Digital Technologies Human Resources (HR) Applications Team, develops and supports our Global HR Workday platform using the various Workday integration technologies. The successful candidate must have a strong knowledge of Workday's integration technologies, Workday's implementation methodology and ability to partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless data flow and reliable automation across the HR technology landscape
   

  

 As a Workday Integration Developer, you will be responsible for:
   

  

  

* Designing, building, test, and deploy Workday integration solutions. Troubleshoot Workday integration issues
* Collaborating with Product Owners, and business stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective integration solutions within Workday.
* Analyzing and translating functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications
* Providing guidance to business, IT or service partners on integration strategies Contribute to the end users’ experience with Workday’s integration products, tools, and services in a way that results in high customer satisfaction
* Conducting unit and end\-to\-end testing of interfaces to ensure they function as designed based on functional and technical requirements
* Working with project teams through integration discovery and scoping phases of their implementation projects
* Coordinating for assigned deliverable schedules to ensure timelines are met
* Collaborating with cross‑functional teams to support Workday releases and associated regression testing.
* Following company defined change control processes to implement the changes and solutions


**Fuel your passion**
 To be successful in this role you will:
   

  

  

* Have a bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university
* Have a minimum 5 years of overall experience and minimum 3 years as Workday Integrations Consultant / Developer
* Have a minimum 3 years of Workday integration skills with any of the following Workday setup tools: Studio, Core Connectors, EIBs, and PECIs
* Have a minimum 2 years of experience with integrating applications via web service APIs \- SOAP and REST
* Have a minimum 2 years of experience with JavaScript, XSLT, JSON, and xPath programming


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
   

  

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working with us**
 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Working for you**
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
   

  

  

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

**About Us:**
 We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
   

  

**Join Us:**

We are looking for a mid\-level SAP Joule developer to design, build, and extend generative AI capabilities on SAP Joule, SAP's AI copilot embedded across S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, and SAP BTP. The role covers building custom Joule skills and agents, integrating generative AI into SAP applications, and connecting SAP's AI stack to business processes and data.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Design, build, and test custom Joule skills and agents using Joule Studio / SAP Build.
  
Develop backend services and APIs (CAP, Node.js/Java, or ABAP RESTful Programming Model) that expose business logic and data to Joule.
  
Integrate SAP Generative AI Hub / SAP AI Core with large language models (LLMs) for use cases such as summarization, Q\&A, and workflow automation.
  
Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, including embeddings, vector stores, and grounding Joule responses in SAP business data.
  
**Configure and extend SAP BTP services:** destinations, XSUAA/authorization, event mesh, and API Business Hub connections.
  
Write and tune prompts, evaluate model outputs, and iterate on accuracy, tone, and safety guardrails.
  
Build or extend Fiori/SAPUI5 front ends and OData/REST services that surface Joule\-driven features.
  
Collaborate with functional/business teams to translate requirements into AI\-enabled scenarios.
  
Support testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting of deployed Joule skills in production.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
3\-5 years of software development experience, including at least 1\-2 years working with SAP BTP or SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model.
  
Hands\-on experience with SAP Joule, Joule Studio, or SAP Build (Apps/Code/Process Automation).
  
Proficiency in Node.js or Java for CAP\-based services, or ABAP Cloud / RAP for backend extensions.
  
**Practical understanding of generative AI concepts:** prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, and LLM integration (e.g., via SAP AI Core / Generative AI Hub or comparable platforms).
  
Experience with OData and REST API design and consumption.
  
**Familiarity with SAP security concepts:** XSUAA, role\-based access control, and destination configuration.
  
Working knowledge of SAPUI5/Fiori Elements for front\-end development.
  
Comfortable with Git\-based version control and agile delivery practices.
  
  

Desired Qualifications
  
Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, IBP, or Ariba functional modules.
  
Exposure to SAP Business Technology Platform's Event Mesh or Integration Suite.
  
Familiarity with vector databases (e.g., SAP HANA Cloud vector engine) and RAG architectures.
  
SAP certifications (e.g., SAP Certified Development Associate \- SAP BTP, or Generative AI\-related credentials).
  
**Experience with responsible AI practices:** bias testing, output evaluation, and data privacy compliance.

title: Principal Enterprise Software Engineer
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
 The Endoscopy Operating Unit develops technologies that support the detection, prevention, and treatment of gastrointestinal diseases and cancers. The team combines software, data, and connected device capabilities to deliver digital solutions that enhance clinical workflows, patient management, and healthcare outcomes.
   

  

 This position is based in Hyderabad, India and follows a Flex work arrangement, combining onsite and remote work based on business and team needs. No travel is anticipated for this role.
   

  

 As a Principal Enterprise Software Engineer, you will lead the design and development of cloud\-based software solutions that integrate with connected medical technologies. This role provides technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, driving scalable architectures, cloud\-native solutions, and engineering practices that support secure, reliable, and compliant products.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Lead the architecture, design, and development of full\-stack cloud applications and services that integrate with connected medical products.
* Design and implement scalable microservices, application programming interfaces (APIs), and distributed systems using Python, FastAPI, React, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies.
* Evaluate and recommend cloud services, frameworks, and architectural patterns to improve scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Drive technical excellence through code reviews, design reviews, testing strategies, and adherence to established engineering standards.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to refine requirements, develop technical solutions, and support product delivery from concept through post\-release support.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation to support quality, regulatory, and business requirements.
* Implement and optimize continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, DevOps practices, and cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Mentor engineering team members and contribute to continuous improvement of software development processes and product quality.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline and 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 6\+ years of full\-stack web application development using Python.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise\-scale microservices and distributed systems architectures.
* Experience developing cloud\-native applications utilizing Amazon Web Services (AWS) and container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker.
* Experience with PostgreSQL database development, API design, event\-driven architectures, and real\-time data processing solutions.
* Experience developing front\-end applications using React or Angular, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing software products within the medical device industry or another regulated industry.
* Experience applying object\-oriented design principles and established software design patterns.
* Experience with networking and communication protocols used in distributed systems.
* Experience performing security assessments, risk analysis, and secure software development activities.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments and leading technical initiatives across engineering teams.


**Physical Job Requirements**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
   

  

 ‌
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
 We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:
   

  

 Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.
   

  

 Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

title: ERPNext Developer
description:
**Overview:** 




 As an ERPNext/Frappe Developer, you will be responsible for developing and customizing ERPNext applications based on client business requirements.
 



  





 You will work across the complete implementation lifecycle — from requirement understanding and solution design to development, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving business problems through technology and can convert functional requirements into reliable ERP solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**ERPNext / Frappe Development:** 



* Develop and customize ERPNext applications using the Frappe Framework.
* Develop custom business logic using Python and Frappe APIs.
* Build client\-side customizations using JavaScript.
* Create custom scripts, server scripts, scheduled jobs, and automation.
* Customize existing ERPNext modules based on client requirements.
* Develop reusable custom applications/modules on the Frappe Framework.



  





**Client Implementation:** 



* Understand business requirements from functional consultants and clients.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Participate in ERPNext implementation projects.
* Configure and customize ERPNext according to business processes.
* Support data migration and data validation activities.
* Participate in UAT, bug fixing, deployment, and go\-live activities.
* Provide post\-implementation technical support.



  





**Integrations:** 



* Develop integrations between ERPNext and external systems.
* Work with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and third\-party APIs.
* Integrate ERPNext with applications.



  





**Database \& Reporting** 



* Work with MariaDB/MySQL databases.
* Write and optimize SQL queries.
* Develop custom ERPNext reports and Query Reports.
* Build business dashboards and reporting solutions.
* Troubleshoot database and application performance issues.



  





**Deployment \& Support** 



* Deploy and maintain ERPNext/Frappe applications in development, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, server, and deployment issues.
* Work with Linux/Ubuntu environments.
* Use Git for source\-code management.
* Support ERPNext upgrades, patches, and migration activities.
* Maintain technical documentation.



  





**Must Have Skills:** 



* Experience with Frappe Cloud.
* Experience building custom Frappe applications.
* Experience with ERPNext implementation projects.
* Experience with ERP data migration.
* Knowledge of Docker.
* Experience with AWS / Azure / GCP.
* Experience integrating payment gateways or banking systems.
* Experience with ERPNext upgrades and version migrations.
* Experience with CI/CD.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI integrations with ERP systems.



  





**What We Expect From You:** 




 We are looking for someone who can:
 



 Understand → Design → Develop → Test → Deploy → Support
 



 You should be comfortable taking ownership of a feature or customization rather than waiting for step\-by\-step technical instructions.You should also be comfortable interacting with Business Analysts, Functional Consultants, Project Managers, and clients.
 



  





**Candidate Profile:** 




**Experience:** 
 2–4 years
 



**Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT and Engineering.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate:** 



* 2\+ years of hands\-on ERPNext/Frappe development experience.
* Strong Python programming skills.
* Good understanding of ERPNext architecture and customization.
* Able to independently develop custom DocTypes and business workflows.
* Comfortable working with APIs and integrations.
* Good SQL/database knowledge.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication skills.
* Willingness to work directly with clients when required.
* Strong ownership and ability to deliver within project timelines.



  





**Why Join Pixeldust:** 



* Work on real\-world ERPNext implementation projects.
* Work directly with clients across different industries.
* Opportunity to work on custom ERP products and applications.
* Exposure to AI \+ ERP automation.
* Opportunity to work across Finance, HR, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and CRM.
* Learn modern cloud, data, and application technologies.
* Be part of a growing technology/product organization.

 Investing is stressful and emotional. Building \& growing wealth is difficult and time\-consuming. Most individuals struggle with managing their investments and money. Our goal is to help individuals grow their wealth without the stress, time, and costs involved in a traditional investment. At Dezerv, we are building a platform that leverages our decades of investment expertise to help individuals invest better for their future.

 We are passionate about helping Indians invest better. We manage investments with active oversight to help both sophisticated and new investors build long term wealth across various market conditions.

* Design and build microservices that are reusable, testable, and built to scale \- not just to ship on time.

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry\-specific survey data.

* Equity

**ABOUT LEGION**



Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission\-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. title: Robotics Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Cosmoserve Space is dedicated to building a cleaner, more sustainable future for space exploration through active debris removal solutions. The company focuses on high\-tech, cost\-effective technologies that address the growing challenge of space debris and help safeguard the orbital environment. With a passionate team of specialists and a strong engineering culture, Cosmoserve Space is shaping the next generation of responsible space operations. Team members work on cutting\-edge projects that keep space accessible for future missions and long\-term exploration. Applicants can expect a mission\-driven environment where innovation and accountability guide everyday work.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 





 Cosmoserve Space operates a state\-of\-the\-art robotics laboratory used for proximity operations research — a controlled environment where robotic systems are used to study and replicate close\-range manoeuvring scenarios relevant to space missions. As a Robotics Software Engineer, your primary responsibility is to develop, maintain, and evolve the full software stack that powers this facility. You will write production\-quality code, build and extend ROS 2 based systems, and ensure the lab’s robotic platforms run reliably and safely. You will work closely with Controls Engineers who own controller design and MBD Engineers who own dynamic modelling, consuming their outputs and integrating them into the larger software architecture.
 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**ROS 2 Software Development** 





 •
 

 Design, develop, and maintain large\-scale ROS 2 based software systems for the robotics lab facility, including node architecture, launch configurations, topic/service/action interfaces, and lifecycle management.
 





 •
 

 Apply knowledge of robot kinematics and dynamics to implement correct coordinate transforms, Jacobian\-based velocity mapping, trajectory execution pipelines, and force/torque\-aware software interfaces — bridging the gap between mathematical models and running code.
 





 •
 

 Write clean, modular, well\-documented C\+\+ and Python code adhering to software engineering best practices — unit testing, code review, version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
 





 • 
 

 Develop and maintain custom ROS 2 packages for robot control, state management, sensor processing, and inter\-system communication across the lab’s robotic platforms.
 





 • 
 

 Design robust software architectures that can evolve as the facility expands — new robots, new sensors, new experiment configurations — without requiring rewrites.
 





  
 




**Facility Software Maintenance \& Operations** 





 • 
 

 Own the ongoing maintenance, debugging, and reliability of all software systems running in the robotics lab — ensuring maximum uptime and experiment readiness.
 





 • 
 

 Triage and resolve software faults across the stack, from low\-level hardware drivers and communication protocols to high\-level experiment orchestration logic.
 





 • 
 

 Manage software dependencies, ROS 2 workspace configurations, and system environments across multiple robot platforms in the lab.
 





 • 
 

 Write and maintain operational runbooks, software documentation, and onboarding guides so the facility can be operated and maintained by the wider team.
 





 • 
 

 Implement logging, monitoring, and diagnostics tooling to give the team real\-time visibility into system health during experiments.
 





  
 




**Hardware Integration \& Driver Development** 





 • 
 

 Integrate robotic hardware — manipulators, motion platforms, actuators, and sensors — into the ROS 2 ecosystem, developing or adapting hardware abstraction layers and drivers as needed.
 





 • 
 

 Interface with industrial robot controllers and motion systems via standard protocols (EtherCAT, CAN bus, Modbus, serial) and expose them as ROS 2 hardware interfaces using ros2\_control.
 





 • 
 

 Integrate sensor payloads (cameras, IMUs, encoders, force/torque sensors) and develop calibration pipelines and data synchronisation across the lab infrastructure.
 





 • 
 

 Work with MBD Engineers to consume dynamic model outputs and simulation interfaces, integrating them into the software stack for hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) test modes.
 





 • 
 

 Integrate trained RL/ML models produced by the MBD Engineering team into the ROS 2 stack — wrapping learned policies as ROS 2 nodes, managing inference pipelines, and ensuring real\-time performance constraints are met.
 





  
 




**Experiment Software \& Automation** 





 • 
 

 Develop software frameworks for configuring, launching, recording, and post\-processing experiments in the robotics lab — enabling the research team to run repeatable, parameterised test campaigns.
 





 • 
 

 Build data recording and playback infrastructure using ROS 2 bag files, enabling full experiment replay and post\-hoc analysis.
 





 • 
 

 Implement safety supervision software — workspace monitoring, joint limit enforcement, emergency stop logic — ensuring safe lab operations at all times.
 





 • 
 

 Collaborate with Controls Engineers to integrate controller outputs into the software stack, providing clean interfaces without owning controller design or tuning.
 





  
 




**REQUIRED SKILLS** 
**CATEGORY** 




**Programming:** 

 C\+\+ (strong proficiency), Python (strong proficiency), CMake, Bash scripting
 




**ROS 2:** 

 Node architecture, Launch system, Topics / Services / Actions, Lifecycle nodes, ros2\_control, Nav2, MoveIt 2, ROS 2 bag
 




**Software Engineering:** 

 Git, CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI), Unit \& integration testing, Code review, Documentation
 




**Hardware Integration:** 

 ros2\_control, Hardware abstraction layers, EtherCAT / CAN bus / serial protocols, Driver development
 




**Sensing \& Data:** 

 Camera / IMU / encoder / F/T sensor integration, Sensor calibration, ROS 2 bag recording \& playback
 




**System \& DevOps:** 

 Linux / Ubuntu, Docker, Systemd services, Networking (TCP/IP, DDS / FastDDS), Multi\-machine ROS 2 setups
 




**Simulation:** 

 Gazebo / Ignition, RViz 2, URDF / XACRO — for software\-in\-the\-loop testing and model validation
 




**Robotics Fundamentals:** 

 Solid understanding of robot kinematics (FK/IK, Jacobians, DH parameters) and dynamics (equations of motion, torque/force relationships) — applied to writing correct software for trajectory execution, coordinate transforms, and hardware interfacing
 





  
 




**NICE TO HAVE** 





 • 
 

 Experience with real\-time Linux (PREEMPT\-RT) or real\-time middleware (Orocos, micro\-ROS) for low\-latency control interfaces.
 





 •  
 

 Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac ROS or GPU\-accelerated perception pipelines for robot vision.
 





 • 
 

 Experience with robot operating facility or lab management software — experiment orchestration, scheduling, and remote monitoring.
 





 •  
 

 Background in software architecture for multi\-robot systems or distributed ROS 2 deployments.
 





 • 
 

 Knowledge of DDS middleware configuration (FastDDS, CycloneDDS) for reliable multi\-machine communication.
 





 •  
 

 Experience with web\-based robot monitoring dashboards (e.g., Foxglove Studio, custom WebSocket / REST interfaces).
 





 • 
 

 Familiarity with space proximity operations, relative motion dynamics, or orbital mechanics at a conceptual level.
 





 •  
 

 Prior experience maintaining a shared research facility or lab software infrastructure.
 





  
 




**QUALIFICATIONS** 





 • 
 

 B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field.
 





 • 
 

 2–3 years of hands\-on experience developing production\-quality software for robotic systems.
 





 • 
 

 Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and Python with demonstrated experience architecting and maintaining large, complex codebases — multi\-package ROS 2 workspaces, shared libraries, and long\-lived production systems rather than one\-off scripts or prototypes.
 





 • 
 

 Solid ROS 2 experience: building multi\-package workspaces, writing custom nodes, configuring launch files, and integrating hardware via ros2\_control.
 





 • 
 

 Sound understanding of robot kinematics and dynamics — forward/inverse kinematics, Jacobians, equations of motion — applied to writing software that correctly implements trajectory execution, coordinate transforms, and hardware interfaces.
 





 • E
 

 xperience integrating real robot hardware into a ROS 2 stack, including driver development or adaptation.
 





 • 
 

 Comfortable owning a complex software system end\-to\-end — development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and documentation.
 





 • 
 

 Familiarity with software engineering practices: version control workflows, CI/CD, automated testing, and code review.

title: SB-1501-Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
----------------


We are looking for a **Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead** with 7–10 years of strong hands\-on development experience and proven expertise in **technical architecture, application security, Azure, code quality, and team leadership**.
The role will be responsible for developing and modernizing enterprise\-grade .NET applications, designing scalable and secure technical solutions, reviewing and vetting code developed by other resources, and ensuring adherence to established architectural and security standards.
The candidate will work extensively on **authentication and credential security, cryptography, Azure Key Vault, API security, secure coding, vulnerability remediation, observability, performance, and legacy .NET application modernization**.
The role also requires the ability to lead developers technically, identify implementation risks, make architecture\-level decisions, and actively adopt **AI\-driven and specification\-driven development practices** to improve engineering productivity and delivery quality.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Development \& Technical Architecture**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using **C\#, ASP.NET MVC/Web API, .NET Framework and related Microsoft technologies**.
* Analyze existing applications and understand legacy architecture, dependencies, business flows, and technical constraints before implementing changes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, secure, and high\-performing application architectures.
* Define technical approaches, application components, integrations, APIs, data flows, and security mechanisms.
* Participate in architecture discussions and prepare technical design solutions for complex requirements.
* Ensure implementations follow established architectural patterns, coding standards, SOLID principles, and secure development practices.
* Identify technical debt, architectural risks, performance bottlenecks, and security weaknesses and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Work closely with Azure/DevOps resources to ensure application architecture aligns with infrastructure and deployment architecture.

### **Application Security \& Authentication**

* Implement and review secure authentication, authorization, password management, password reset, password history, and session\-management flows.
* Implement **bcrypt/Argon2id password hashing** and lazy re\-hashing/migration strategies for existing accounts.
* Implement secure random salt generation and eliminate static or hardcoded salts.
* Secure sensitive credentials and application secrets through appropriate key and secret management mechanisms.
* Implement and review **RSA, AES/symmetric encryption, hashing, encryption/decryption, key rotation, and secure key\-management practices**.
* Implement secure migration and re\-encryption of existing sensitive database values.
* Integrate applications with **Azure Key Vault** for RSA keys, symmetric keys, secrets, and tokenized credentials.
* Review and secure authentication cookies, including **Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite** attributes.
* Implement API security controls including authentication protection and **rate limiting for login, password\-reset, and related endpoints**.
* Ensure sensitive information is not exposed through APIs, logs, configuration files, resource files, or repositories.
* Apply **OWASP secure coding principles** and security best practices throughout development.

### **Code Review \& Technical Governance**

* Act as the primary technical reviewer for code delivered by other developers.
* Perform detailed **code reviews and architecture reviews** across backend components.
* Vet implementations for correctness, security, scalability, maintainability, performance, and architectural compliance.
* Identify security vulnerabilities, poor coding practices, technical debt, and architectural deviations.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, branching practices, and development guidelines.
* Review and validate database changes, API contracts, authentication implementations, encryption mechanisms, and third\-party integrations.
* Guide junior and mid\-level developers on technical implementation and troubleshooting.
* Ensure Critical/High findings from **SonarQube and vulnerability scans** are appropriately addressed.

### **Azure, DevSecOps \& Reliability**

* Work with **Azure Key Vault, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Azure monitoring, Application Insights, and related Azure services**.
* Ensure secure configuration and deployment practices across environments.
* Support removal of hardcoded secrets/keys from application resources and configuration.
* Implement appropriate retry, timeout, error\-handling, and dependency\-failure strategies.
* Contribute to resilience and redundancy considerations for security\-sensitive components.
* Support repository security, Git history cleanup, secret scanning, and .gitignore protection.
* Implement **correlation IDs, structured logging, security\-event logging, monitoring, and observability** across modified flows.
* Support dead\-letter/error handling for applicable asynchronous operations.
* Participate in vulnerability scanning, static code analysis, remediation, and security verification.

### **Testing \& Quality**

* Develop and maintain high\-quality, testable backend code.
* Write and review **unit and integration tests** for authentication, credential, API, and security\-sensitive flows.
* Support performance testing of login and authentication flows following credential\-storage changes.
* Work closely with QA to identify and resolve defects and improve test coverage.
* Review regression results and ensure all affected authentication and security flows are validated.
* Ensure implementation evidence, test results, scan results, and remediation details are properly documented in **Azure DevOps**.

### **Team Leadership \& Delivery**

* Provide day\-to\-day technical direction to developers working on the project.
* Break down complex technical requirements into appropriate implementation approaches.
* Mentor developers and support technical problem\-solving.
* Review estimates and technical feasibility of proposed solutions.
* Identify technical risks and dependencies early and communicate them to the Engineering/Delivery team.
* Coordinate with frontend, QA, DevOps, and project management teams to ensure smooth delivery.
* Take ownership of technical quality and ensure deliverables meet agreed architecture, security, and coding standards.
* Participate in sprint planning, technical discussions, reviews, retrospectives, and client\-facing technical discussions where required.

### **AI\-Driven Development**

* Actively use **AI\-assisted development tools** to improve development speed, code quality, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* Work with tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, and other AI\-powered engineering tools**.
* Apply AI\-assisted and specification\-driven development practices across requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, code review, testing, and documentation.
* Use AI tools responsibly for code generation, refactoring, test generation, documentation, debugging, and code analysis while maintaining engineering review and security controls.
* Evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, security, architectural compliance, performance, and maintainability before integration.
* Stay current with emerging AI development practices and contribute to adoption of AI\-enabled engineering workflows within the team.

Backend Development C\#, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, .NET Framework 4\.x, REST APIs **Must**

title: Principal/Senior/Software Engineer (AI-Powered Advertising Agents - AgenticOS)
description:
**About The Role**
 PubMatic is looking for engineers with expertise in Generative AI and AI agent development. You will be responsible for building and optimizing advanced AI agents that leverage the latest technologies in Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and large language models (LLMs). You will work on developing state\-of\-the\-art solutions that enhance Generative AI capabilities and enable our platform to handle complex information retrieval, contextual generation, and adaptive interactions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI\-driven features. Drive end\-to\-end ownership—from feasibility analysis and design specifications to execution and release—while ensuring quick iterations based on customer feedback in a fast\-paced Agile environment.
* Spearhead technical design meetings and produce detailed design documents that outline scalable, secure, and robust AI architectures.
* Ensure that the solutions are aligned with long\-term product strategy and technical roadmaps.
* Implement and optimize LLMs for specific use cases, including fine\-tuning models, deploying pre\-trained models, and evaluating their performance.
* Develop AI agents powered by RAG systems, integrating external knowledge sources to improve the accuracy and relevance of generated content.
* Design, implement, and optimize vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) for efficient and scalable vector search, and work on various vector indexing algorithms.
* Create sophisticated prompts and fine\-tune them to improve the performance of LLMs in generating precise and contextually relevant responses.
* Utilize evaluation frameworks and metrics (e.g., Evals) to assess and improve the performance of generative models and AI systems.
* Work with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to integrate AI\-driven capabilities into customer\-facing products and internal tools.
* Stay up to date with the latest research and trends in LLMs, RAG, and generative AI technologies to drive innovation in the company’s offerings.
* Continuously monitor and optimize models to improve their performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.


**We'd Love For You To Have**
* 2 to 10 years of total experience and strong understanding of LLMs and their underlying principles — transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, and hyperparameter tuning.
* Proven experience designing and building AI agents, including multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-use patterns, multi\-step planning, and agent memory architectures (short\-term and long\-term).
* Hands\-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen, and familiarity with RAG pipelines that integrate external knowledge sources (documents, databases, APIs).
* In\-depth knowledge of vector databases and indexing algorithms; practical experience with FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus.
* Experience with agent observability, tracing, and guardrails — tools like Langfuse or equivalent — to ensure reliability, safety, and debuggability of agentic systems.
* Proficiency in prompt engineering — crafting, iterating, and optimizing complex prompts for context\-sensitive, domain\-specific LLM outputs.
* Familiarity with Evals and other performance evaluation tools for measuring model quality, relevance, and efficiency.
* Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers.
* Experience with data preprocessing, vectorization, and handling large\-scale datasets.
* Ability to present complex technical ideas and results to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience in building AI agents using graph\-based architectures, including knowledge graph embeddings and graph neural networks (GNNs).
* Experience with training small base models using custom data, including data collection, pre\-processing, and fine\-tuning models to specific domains or tasks.
* Familiarity with deploying AI models on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with programmatic advertising, RTB, or ad auction mechanics.
* Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool\-integration standards
* Publication or contributions to research in AI, LLMs, or related fields.


**Qualification**
 Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute/university.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office** 
 : PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!.
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

As a Software Engineer, you will build the backend services that power omnichannel commerce capabilities. You will be responsible for technical design, implementation and validation. Working closely with the Lead Engineer and Engineering Manager, you will deliver low\-latency services that support real\-time consumer experiences.


**What you will do:**


* + Develop and support scalable services for real\-time inventory availability, allocation, and order promising across digital and physical commerce channels.
* + Develop accurate Available\-to\-Sell calculations by combining on\-hand, in\-transit, reserved, allocated, and safety\-stock inventory positions.
* + Build order\-promising capabilities that calculate reliable delivery and pickup estimates based on inventory location, fulfilment\-node capacity, carrier options, shipping methods, and operational cut\-off times.
* + Implement inventory segmentation and buffer strategies, including safety stock and channel\-specific allocations, to balance availability while minimizing overselling and underselling risks.
* + Develop production\-grade microservices using Java and Spring Boot, with a strong focus on scalability, resilience, maintainability, and operational performance.
* + Build event\-driven inventory processing using Kafka or similar messaging technologies to handle receipts, adjustments, reservations, releases, cancellations, and fulfilment updates in near real time.
* + Integrate inventory and promising services with OMS, commerce, WMS, ERP, store, and fulfilment platforms to provide consistent availability across the order lifecycle.
* + Ensure solutions are secure, observable, reliable, and resilient through strong engineering practices.
* + Own well\-defined features or components from design through production.
* + Write clean, tested and maintainable code, participate in peer reviews, and maintain relevant technical documentation.
* + Optimize performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation and proactive improvements.
* + Support production services through monitoring, troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis, contributing to reliability improvements.
**Your talent**
---------------


* 4\+ years of experience designing, developing and supporting enterprise\-grade applications, preferably within commerce, order management, inventory or supply\-chain domains.
* + Hands\-on software engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot and microservices architectures.
* + Strong understanding of REST APIs, event\-driven architectures, messaging technologies and integration patterns.
* + Experience building reliable, scalable, maintainable and production\-grade backend services.
* + Practical understanding of design patterns, data structures and algorithms.
* + Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and production support.
* + Understanding of observability, reliability engineering and performance optimisation.
* + Working knowledge of order lifecycle or inventory\-management concepts such as availability, reservations, ATP, ATS, allocation or fulfilment.
* + Experience integrating with OMS, WMS, ERP, commerce or fulfilment platforms will be an advantage.
* + Experience configuring and extending Distributed Order Management Systems (OMS), with Fluent Commerce experience preferred.
* + Experience with Kafka or equivalent messaging technologies.
* + Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity.
**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. title: Senior Software Developer (AI Agents)
description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 09/07/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services
* Work Experience 5\-6 years
* City Pune City
* State/Province Maharashtra
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 411057
### **About Us**


nCircle Tech Private Limited (Incorporated in 2012\) empowers passionate innovators to create impactful 3D visualization software for desktop, mobile and cloud. Our domain expertise in CAD and BIM customization is driving automation with the ability to integrate advanced technologies like AI/ML and AR/VR, which empowers our clients to reduce time to market and meet business goals. nCircle has a proven track record of technology consulting and advisory services for AEC and Manufacturing industry across the globe. Our team of dedicated engineers, partner ecosystem and industry veterans are on a mission to redefine how you design and visualize.  

### **Job Description**


ABOUT THE ROLE The Data \+ Automation team at nCircle Tech builds the data and automation infrastructure behind decision making across the business. Our platform runs on Databricks and AWS. We're hiring a strong software engineer to design, build, and ship production services — including LLM\-powered agents and the tooling around them. This is a hands\-on, code\-first role.  

  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**
* Designing, building, and productionizing LLM agents: tool\-use loops, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and guardrails
* Writing the production\-grade services and APIs around those agents in Python and Node/TypeScript
* Deploying and operating on AWS — provisioning with IaC, wiring CI/CD, owning your code from commit to production
* Contributing to a shared codebase with feature branches, code review, and Conventional Commits

  

**REQUIRED**
  

**Software Engineering (the core)**
* Strong Python and Node/TypeScript — writes clean, tested, production\-grade code, not scripts
* Solid fundamentals: data structures, API design, error handling, testing, debugging real systems
* Feature branches and PRs; comfortable both giving and receiving code review; meaningful commit messages
* Follows engineering standards (12\-factor, testing, documentation) without hand\-holding

  

**AWS \+ IaC**
* Real AWS experience — the environment our services run on
* Deploys with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent) rather than clicking through consoles
* Comfortable with CI/CD, environment promotion, and AWS basics (S3, IAM, networking)

  

**LLM Agents (non\-negotiable)**
  

This is a hard requirement, not a nice\-to\-have. We are a small team and cannot train this skill on the job — you must already know how to build agents and be able to contribute to real work quickly.
* Has built and shipped LLM agents to production — not demos or prototypes; systems that ran and were relied on
* Can explain the agent loop from experience: how the model decides to call a tool, observes the result, and re\-decides across multiple steps 1 Senior Software Engineer, AI Agents

 Has designed retrieval (RAG) end\-to\-end — chunking, indexing, hybrid or re\-ranked retrieval — and can justify each choice Has a real evaluation story: how they measured whether the agent was correct, and the worst failure mode they hit in production and fixed
* Knows when NOT to use an agent — where a plain LLM call or deterministic code is the better answer
* Framework\-agnostic — LangChain, CrewAI, Databricks Agent Framework, or raw tool\-use loops all fine; what matters is that you've shipped real agents

  

**Databricks (working proficiency)**
  

Our platform runs on Databricks, so this is required — but working proficiency, not mastery. You should be able to build and ship in Databricks unaided; you don't need to be a Spark\-tuning specialist.
* Comfortable building and running Databricks notebooks and Jobs (task chains, parameters, schedules) end\-to\-end
* Understands the Unity Catalog three\-part namespace (catalog.schema.table) and works within it
* Has written Delta Lake operations beyond basic reads — e.g. MERGE, overwrite, schema evolution
* Can navigate and debug an existing pipeline, not only write greenfield code

  

**GOOD TO HAVE**
* Deeper Databricks / Spark depth — performance tuning, advanced Unity Catalog governance
* MCP (Model Context Protocol) exposure
* Agent observability and tracing tools in production

 Construction, AEC, or project\-based industry experience Jira  

  

  

**GENERAL BAR**
* 5\+ years writing code, not configuring tools
* Ships independently: scopes work, executes, communicates progress
* Can ramp on an unfamiliar system by reading docs and asking targeted questions

* **Think in systems**

 Development \& Technical Architecture

 Application Security \& Authentication
   

  

* Implement and review secure authentication, authorization, password management, password reset, password history, and session\-management flows.
* Implement bcrypt/Argon2id password hashing and lazy re\-hashing/migration strategies for existing accounts.

* Secure sensitive credentials and application secrets through appropriate key and secret management mechanisms.

* Implement API security controls including authentication protection and rate limiting for login, password\-reset, and related endpoints.
* Ensure sensitive information is not exposed through APIs, logs, configuration files, resource files, or repositories.
* Apply OWASP secure coding principles and security best practices throughout development.


 Code Review \& Technical Governance

* Support removal of hardcoded secrets/keys from application resources and configuration.
* Implement appropriate retry, timeout, error\-handling, and dependency\-failure strategies.
* Contribute to resilience and redundancy considerations for security\-sensitive components.
* Support repository security, Git history cleanup, secret scanning, and .gitignore protection.
* Implement correlation IDs, structured logging, security\-event logging, monitoring, and observability across modified flows.
* Support dead\-letter/error handling for applicable asynchronous operations.
* Participate in vulnerability scanning, static code analysis, remediation, and security verification.


 Testing \& Quality
   

  

* Develop and maintain high\-quality, testable backend code.
* Write and review unit and integration tests for authentication, credential, API, and security\-sensitive flows.
* Support performance testing of login and authentication flows following credential\-storage changes.

title: Lead Software Engineer (ERP Modernisation)
description:
**Company Description:** 




 Partap Singh and Sons (PSS), established in 1951, is a leading distributor of automobile spare parts across Western, Central, Northern, and Eastern India. The company partners with major manufacturers including TVS SFL, Tata Motors, Ashok Leyland, Mahindra \& Mahindra, Force Motors, Maxion Wheels, Rane group companies, Schaeffler, and ZF Wabco, serving more than 18,000 customers across heavy, medium, car segments, and industrial fasteners. PSS also exports to multiple global markets. The organization aims to be the comprehensive solution provider for all aftermarket needs and relies on proprietary software to support its nationwide operational network. This focus on technology and innovation creates a dynamic environment for engineering talent looking to impact core business systems.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 The Lead Software Engineer (ERP Modernisation) is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The role involves leading the modernization of PSS’s proprietary ERP and related systems, including designing scalable architectures, refactoring legacy components, and implementing secure, efficient back\-end services. 
 



  





**Why this role exists:** 




 Partap Singh \& Sons has distributed automobile spare parts since 1951\. Ninety\-plus branches across twenty states. Authorised distributor for Bosch, ZF, Tata Motors, Mahindra and Ashok Leyland. Fourth\-generation, family\-run, and one of the larger independent distribution networks in the country.
 



 For two decades the business has run on a VB.NET WinForms ERP: 1\.24 million lines of code, 18 modules, 215 screens, 1,808 Crystal Reports, on a single SQL Server 2008 box.
 



  





 We have started the development on the replacement. 
 



 PSS One is Python and React, developed in\-house, with a /core rulebook of 122 money\-checks and an MCP server so AI agents can operate the system directly rather than screen\-scrape it. It has been reconciled against real production data: 630 invoices recomputed at 99\.8% accuracy, full\-year double\-entry integrity confirmed across all 94 branch sets, receivables ageing clean across 915 debtors. Offline billing has been proven in test. The PSS Go field app and our public sites already run on the new stack.
 



  





 It is not yet live. The legacy system still holds the books. PSS One is in trials, against a copy of the data, and no branch has cut over. That is the job. Finish what is still unbuilt, then move ninety branches across without a single day's billing going wrong.
 



  





**What you will own end to end:** 



* The switchover \- Two branch write\-paths (goods receipt and stock adjustment) are specified but not built, and they close a branch's full daily cycle. Then clerk trials, a five\-branch test, and fleet rollout across the network. You own the runbook, the pass conditions and the rollback.
* The report estate \- 1,808 Crystal Reports do not carry across. Establishing which ones are actually alive, and rebuilding those, is roughly forty percent of the remaining work.
* The head\-office console \- bank reconciliation, expense posting, purchase orders, item\-code approval, branch reconciliation, year\-end close. Partly specified, none of it built. This is a substantial body of work sitting outside the branch rollout entirely.
* GST and other taxation workflows: The existing ERP is used heavily for any GST and other tax\-related filings and workflows (from procurement, to expenses, to sale). This has to be further automated and streamlined. Statutory e\-invoicing still runs in the legacy system and has to move.
* Branch\-to\-head\-office data flow \- Sync, offline queue, conflict resolution, reconnect rules. Move from a single on\-prem server to branches syncing to a cloud brain.
* The AI integration \- Extending the /core rulebook and the MCP surface so agents can safely do more of the routine work.



  





**What we are looking for:** 




**Required** 



* 4–8 years building systems where money moves: ERP, billing, payments, accounting, logistics or supply chain. We care far more about this than about your industry
* Strong Python and actively working with React. You need not be a front\-end specialist, but you should be able to ship a screen end to end
* Real SQL Server depth: query plans, indexing, and the ability to explain why a report takes forty seconds
* Everyday, serious use of AI coding tools, together with a clear sense of where you stop trusting them. Candidates who have never used them and candidates who trust them completely will both struggle here
* The ability to read twenty\-year\-old VB.NET without contempt.
* Willingness to sit with a branch accountant in Indore and explain a change in language or a UI/screen interface she would use
* B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent



  





**Preferred, but not essential** 




 • A legacy migration you saw through to the end, especially with a parallel run
 



 • Nice to have: Hardware and system engineering understanding
 



 • Understanding of how businesses operate – basic commerce and taxation knowledge. As well as a solid understanding of CRM and DMS operations.
 



 • Crystal Reports, SSRS or similar reporting estates
 



 • Offline\-first or intermittently\-connected systems
 



 • GST e\-invoicing or IRP integration
 



 • Hindi or a regional language
 



  





**How you will work** 



* You will work directly with the CEO and leadership, who built PSS One and will be in the code processes with you.
* You will also work alongside two engineers who have held the legacy system together for 20 years. They know things about this business that are written down nowhere. Part of the job is getting that knowledge out of their heads and into the new system, which requires their goodwill. If your instinct on seeing old code is to call it stupid, this is not the role for you.



  





**How we'll hire you:** 




**About three weeks, five stages:** 




 1\. A thirty\-minute conversation with the CEO about motivation and your experience with legacy systems.
 



 2\. Ninety minutes of live pairing with the leadership and one of the existing engineers.
 



 3\. A paid take home assignment on a fully clean part of our actual pricing codebase. AI tools are explicitly permitted and expected, and we want to see how you verify what those tools give you, not whether you can generate code. We will pay you up to ₹10,000 for a submission that stands up to review, whether or not we take you forward.
 



 4\. Run a trial with an actual office clerk from one of the branches, discuss and close and feedback in loops to make sure that the operationalization is solid.  
 



 5\. Any references, weighted heavily towards whether you finish what you start.
 



  





**Compensation and logistics:** 




 • ₹110,000 per month fixed, plus quarterly performance bonuses. PF and gratuity as part of overall compensation
 



 • Mumbai, on\-site, with travel to branches during the rollout
 



 • Tell us your notice period. We will consider a buy out for the right teammate
 



  





**To apply:** 




 Apply through LinkedIn and/or write to
 **hr@pssao.com** 
 with two things:
 



 1\. One paragraph on the hardest bug you have found where the system did not crash, it just produced a wrong number.
 



 2\. Your
 **notice period** 
 , and whether it is negotiable
 



  





 We read every application and reply either way.
 **Good luck!**

 What Success Looks Like

 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for
 **Senior Software Developers**

 **C\#, .NET, WPF, XAML, and MVVM** 
 to support the modernization of a business\-critical legacy desktop application.
 



 The selected developers will progressively refactor tightly coupled legacy components into a
 **modular, maintainable, testable architecture** 
 , while ensuring existing business functionality remains stable and new feature development can continue in parallel.
 



 The ideal candidate will have proven experience modernizing legacy WPF applications, applying MVVM and dependency injection, introducing service\-layer abstractions, and improving code quality through automated testing and static\-analysis tools.

* Modernize legacy

 .

* **C\#**

* **WPF**
* **XAML**
* **MVVM**

* Data binding

* **Prism**
* or equivalent frameworks
* Strong knowledge of:
* Dependency Injection
* Inversion of Control
* Interface\-driven design
* Service abstractions
* SOLID principles
* Proven experience
 **refactoring and modernizing complex legacy applications** 
 .
* Strong unit\-testing experience with
 **xUnit/NUnit and Moq or equivalent** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with
 **SonarQube or equivalent static\-analysis and quality\-management tools** 
 .
* Experience using Visual Studio code analysis/metrics and addressing technical debt.
* Ability to understand and implement
 **UML, architectural documentation, coding standards, and established development conventions** 
 .
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and contribute with minimal technical ramp\-up.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience modernizing
 **large\-scale or business\-critical WPF applications** 
 .
* Experience performing
 **incremental migration** 
 from legacy architecture to MVVM.
* Experience supporting modernization while simultaneously delivering new business features.
* Experience developing strategies for
 **legacy/modern module coexistence** 
 .
* Experience improving maintainability, cyclomatic complexity, coupling, and technical debt.
* Experience working in environments with formal architecture governance and quality gates.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Major Accountabilities:**
 Manage QNX\-based software development projects throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC), from requirements analysis and design to implementation, testing, and deployment.
   

  

 Optimize boot times and system performance for QNX\-based embedded systems through bootloader configuration, kernel optimization, and system\-level tuning.
   

  

 Identify and implement boot optimization techniques and strategies to minimize startup latency and improve overall system responsiveness.
   

  

 Utilize debugging tools and techniques for QNX, such as Uboot, Kernel, and QNX\-specific debugging utilities, to diagnose and resolve software issues and ensure robustness and stability.
   

  

 Develop and execute testing strategies and procedures for QNX\-based software components, including unit testing, integration testing, and system testing, to validate functionality, performance, and reliability.
   

  

 Define and implement bootloader configurations to support features such as secure boot, reflashing, and hypervisor integration, in accordance with project specifications and standards.
   

  

 Manage reflash processes and procedures for QNX\-based systems, including firmware updates, patching, and system recovery mechanisms.
   

  

 Develop and maintain reflash scripts, tools, and utilities to automate and streamline the reflash process, minimizing downtime and ensuring system integrity and security.
   

  

 Integrate hypervisor technologies into QNX\-based embedded systems to support virtualization and isolation of software components and services.
   

  

 Configure and manage hypervisor environments for QNX, ensuring optimal resource utilization, performance, and security in multi\-domain embedded systems architectures.

title: Principal Software Engineer - Compilers
description:
**Who We Are**
 This role is part of the
 **Kinara Group at NXP Semiconductors** 
 , combining the agility and innovation of a startup with the scale, stability, and global reach of a leading semiconductor company.
   

  

 Kinara was founded on
 **patented technology developed during the founders’ Ph.D. research at Stanford University** 
 , with a mission to redefine AI inference at the edge through tightly integrated hardware and software. Following Kinara’s acquisition, this mission continues within NXP, with the Kinara team operating as a
 **dedicated AI accelerator and software group** 
 focused on pushing the boundaries of edge AI.
   

  

 The team has delivered
 **two generations of AI silicon shipping in volume** 
 , supported by a
 **mature and production** 
 ‑
 **ready software stack** 
 , making it one of the most proven edge AI platforms in the industry. Kinara technology is used by
 **marquee customers** 
 , including GAFA‑class companies, a leading global e‑commerce provider, and Tier‑1 PC OEMs.
   

  

 As part of NXP, the Kinara Group now benefits from
 **world** 
 ‑
 **class silicon execution, manufacturing scale, and customer access** 
 , while retaining its startup culture, deep AI expertise, and compiler‑driven engineering mindset. Joining this team offers the
 **best of both worlds** 
 : the opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI compiler and silicon technology, with real‑world impact and long‑term stability.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We build
 **game** 
 ‑
 **changing edge AI solutions** 
 that enable faster, smarter, and more power‑efficient decision making where every millisecond matters.
   

  

 At the core of our platform are
 **Ara AI inference processors** 
 , purpose‑built to deliver
 **unrivaled deep learning performance per watt at the edge** 
 . Paired with our
 **comprehensive SDK and software toolchain** 
 , these processors enable developers to deploy and optimize complex AI models for real‑time inference under tight latency and power constraints.
   

  

 Kinara’s hardware–software co‑design approach allows high‑performance AI to be
 **seamlessly embedded into edge devices** 
 , enabling applications across vision, industrial automation, consumer electronics, and intelligent systems. Our solutions focus on
 **performance, efficiency, and scalability** 
 , helping customers bring advanced AI capabilities out of the cloud and into the real world.
   

  

 Edge AI is at an inflection point, and the Kinara Group within NXP is uniquely positioned to play a
 **leading role in its growth** 
 , delivering production‑proven silicon, a robust compiler and SDK stack, and a clear roadmap for next‑generation intelligent edge devices.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Front\-End Compiler Engineer** 
 with 10\+ years of experience to lead the design and development of our
 **AI/ML compiler front\-end** 
 . The role focuses on building scalable
 **model conversion pipelines** 
 that translate models from
 **ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch** 
 into our internal
 **Intermediate Representation (IR)** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in
 **compiler design** 
 ,
 **graph\-based optimizations** 
 ,
 **machine learning frameworks** 
 , and modern AI architectures including
 **Transformers** 
 and
 **Large Language Models (LLMs)** 
 . You will collaborate with compiler backend, runtime, performance, and hardware teams to deliver a high\-performance and production\-ready AI compiler stack.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and develop compiler front\-end architecture and model conversion frameworks.
* Build and maintain Python\-based converters for ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
* Implement graph construction, graph transformation, IR lowering, and optimization pipelines.
* Develop graph optimization passes including operator fusion, canonicalization, simplification, and decomposition.
* Design scalable pattern\-matching and graph\-rewrite frameworks.
* Enable support for modern AI architectures such as CNNs, Transformers, and LLMs.
* Drive validation, testing infrastructure, regression testing, and CI/CD integration.
* Debug and resolve issues across model conversion, optimization, and IR generation stages.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and collaborate across teams.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in compiler development, ML systems, or AI infrastructure.
* Strong Python programming and software architecture skills.
* Deep understanding of:
+ Intermediate Representations (IRs)
+ Graph\-based computation models
+ Compiler transformations and optimizations
+ Pattern matching and graph rewriting

* Hands\-on experience with ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
* Experience in graph parsing, graph transformations, and ML model optimizations.
* Strong understanding of CNNs, Transformers, and LLM architectures.
* Excellent debugging, problem\-solving, and technical leadership skills.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with MLIR, TOSA, StableHLO, or Torch\-MLIR.
* Familiarity with AI compiler stacks such as IREE, TVM, XLA, TensorRT, or ONNX Runtime.
* Experience targeting GPUs, NPUs, DSPs, or custom AI accelerators.
* Knowledge of quantization, model optimization, and deployment workflows.

* Handle complex debugging and root cause analysis across APIs, events, and workflows.
* Provide strong support for critical production issues and performance bottlenecks.


**Monitoring, Reliability \& Performance**
* Implement and enhance observability frameworks using Azure Monitor and Application Insights.

* Drive alignment between design, development, and delivery timelines.
* Actively contribute to high\-velocity, agile delivery environments.

* Azure Integration: Deep expertise in Azure Integration Services (AIS).
* API Development: Advanced experience with Azure API Management (APIM).
* Programming: Strong coding expertise in C\#, .NET, REST APIs, JSON, XML.

* Active and effective use of GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot
