title: Principal Software Engineer- Performance Engineering
description:
**Principal Software Engineer, Performance Engineering**

Job Summary


We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer, Performance Engineering to embed performance as a first\-class engineering discipline across our large\-scale applications and databases — shifting performance validation left into design and active development, rather than treating it as a pre\-release regression gate. This is a hybrid engineering role: the candidate writes and reviews code, builds performance tooling and instrumentation, and partners directly with feature teams during design and implementation to catch scalability and efficiency issues before they reach production. The ideal candidate is fluent in Linux environments, comfortable authoring both application\-level code and test/automation code, skilled in modern load and performance testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD, and capable of deep database performance analysis to identify and resolve bottlenecks at the query, index, and schema level. This role requires a minimum of 10 years of relevant software engineering experience.


Why This Role Is Different


Traditional performance testing runs *after* code is "done," turning every finding into a costly late\-cycle fix. This role exists to move that curve left: performance budgets, load profiles, and profiling hooks become part of design review, code review, and CI — not a separate phase owned by a separate team.


Key Responsibilities


Shift\-Left Performance Engineering


* Partner with Product Architects and engineering teams *during design and development* to define performance/scalability requirements, SLOs, and load profiles before code is written.
* Embed lightweight, code\-as\-test performance checks (e.g., k6, Gatling, Locust) directly into CI/CD pipelines so regressions surface on every build/PR, not at a downstream test cycle.
* Review production code and architecture for performance anti\-patterns (N\+1 queries, unbounded loops, inefficient serialization, poor connection/thread pool sizing) as part of the normal code review process.
* Build and maintain reusable performance test harnesses, fixtures, and synthetic data generators that developers can run locally and in CI without specialist hand\-holding.

Load, Stress, and Full\-Scale Validation


* Design, script, execute, and evaluate performance, load, and stress tests to validate system behavior under expected and peak conditions, using modern load\-generation tooling (k6, Gatling, Locust) alongside JMeter/LoadRunner for legacy scenario coverage.
* Develop and maintain scripts to simulate realistic UI and transactional load across applications.
* Use the Linux command line and shell/Python scripting to configure environments, automate test setup/execution/data collection/reporting, and troubleshoot in flight.

Database \& Query Performance


* Write and evaluate SQL queries against large\-scale databases to support test data preparation and results analysis.
* Perform detailed evaluation of table and index design, query execution plans, and their impact on overall database performance.
* Generate and analyze deep diagnostics (Oracle AWR/ASH, SQL Server Query Store/MDW, or Postgres pg\_profile/PoWA) to isolate database\-layer bottlenecks.
* Generate and load large volumes of representative test data to support realistic performance validation.

Analysis, Instrumentation \& Remediation


* Analyze test and production telemetry (APM, profiling, GC/memory data) to identify root causes and drive optimization — collaborating directly with developers, DBAs, and infrastructure teams on fixes, not just findings.
* Evaluate and tune JVM memory management and garbage collection behavior under load.
* Document performance requirements, findings, and recommendations, and communicate clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills and Experience


* Minimum 10 years of software engineering experience, including a minimum of 6 years focused on performance engineering, performance/load testing, or a closely related discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to write and/or review production application code — this is not a testing\-only role.
* Strong proficiency with the Linux command line for navigation, file management, process monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Semi\-advanced scripting ability (Bash/Korn, Python, or Perl) to automate workflows and build reusable tooling.
* Hands\-on experience with JMeter and/or LoadRunner for legacy load scenario coverage.
* Hands\-on experience integrating performance/load tests into CI/CD pipelines (shift\-left practice), using modern frameworks such as k6, Gatling, or Locust.
* Experience with Java memory management, garbage collection, evaluation, and tuning.
* Solid understanding of large\-scale database fundamentals: SQL, table/index design, referential integrity, and query performance evaluation.
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle AWR/ASH generation and evaluation, or equivalent (SQL Server Query Store/MDW, Postgres pg\_profile/PoWA).
* Ability to work with Product Management, Architects, and engineering teams to define performance requirements early in the development lifecycle, and to prioritize competing demands accordingly.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Tanzu, or OpenShift for deploying, scaling, and monitoring workloads under test.
* Familiarity with Cassandra or Scylla; performance evaluation and tuning experience in either is a plus.

Preferred (Nice to Have) Skills


* Experience extending JMeter/LoadRunner or custom Java\-based test frameworks for runtime transaction generation.
* Experience with APM/observability platforms (Dynatrace, New Relic, Datadog, Grafana) for production\-signal\-driven performance work.
* Python for data analysis and tooling beyond test automation.
* Basic project management and Agile Scrum experience.

What We Offer


* Ownership of performance as an engineering discipline, not a downstream checkpoint — direct influence on architecture and design decisions.
* Exposure to large\-scale, high\-throughput fintech systems and modern cloud\-native infrastructure.
* Collaborative engineering culture with direct partnership across product, architecture, and infrastructure teams.
Competitive compensation and benefits package.

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:
**Summary**
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an immediate joiner for the role Senior ServiceNow Developer to take ownership of our platform, providing expertise in ITOM, HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Field Service Management (FSM), finance, and platform development, CSM, SSM. In this role, you will be responsible for translating complex business requirements into solutions, maintaining the platform, and driving our technical strategy forward.
   

  

**Senior ServiceNow Developer**
 Platform Development
   

  

* Finance
* HRSD
* Field Service Management
* Serval AI
* ITOM


**About The Role**
 ServiceNow is central to how work gets done across our IT, HR, finance, and field operations. Teams depend on it every day, and the roadmap continues to grow. We are looking for a senior developer to take end\-to\-end ownership of the platform — someone equally at home designing a clean data model, guiding solution architecture, and resolving complex issues under release pressure.
   

  

 You will serve as the technical anchor across several product lines — core platform development, Financial Management, HR Service Delivery, Field Service Management, our emerging Serval AI capabilities, and IT Operations Management — while keeping the instance healthy, current, and maintainable. This is a role with genuine ownership and influence: we value engineers who challenge assumptions and recommend the right approach rather than simply delivering to spec. Our platform strategy will continue to evolve, and should our direction shift toward a TypeScript\-based AI platform, we want someone who can help lead that transition and any migration away from ServiceNow.
   

  

**Platform development \& architecture**
 Building is at the heart of this role. You will translate complex business requirements into supportable solutions and set the engineering standards the wider team follows.
   

  

* Design and build across Flow Designer, UI Builder, scoped applications, Business Rules, Script Includes, client scripts, and the IntegrationHub.
* Own the data model and CMDB relationships — decide what belongs in a scoped app versus the global scope, and keep custom work from fighting the platform.
* Build and maintain integrations to external systems over REST, SOAP, and MID Server, including error handling and retry logic that survives real\-world outages.
* Set and enforce coding standards, run peer code reviews, and mentor mid\-level developers and admins.
* Build with modern tooling where it fits — TypeScript and the ServiceNow SDK (Fluent) for source\-controlled, IDE\-based development, plus custom UI Builder components.
* Champion out\-of\-the\-box first: reach for configuration before customization, and document the reason whenever you do have to customize.


**Financial Management (Finance module)**
 Finance is one of our fastest\-moving areas. We need someone who understands both the ServiceNow tooling and how finance teams think about and manage cost.
   

  

* Configure and extend ServiceNow Financial Management — cost models, cost transparency, budgeting, chargeback and showback, and allocation rules.
* Partner with finance stakeholders to map general\-ledger data, cost pools, and business services so that reporting is accurate and defensible.
* Build dashboards and reports that give leaders clear, trusted visibility into where IT spend is going.
* Support integrations between Financial Management, the CMDB, and upstream ERP or procurement systems.


**HR Service Delivery (HRSD)**
 You will help HR deliver employee\-facing services with the same rigour as IT — well\-structured processes, clear SLAs, and an intuitive employee portal.
   

  

* Build and maintain HR services, case types, and Lifecycle Events (onboarding, offboarding, transfers) with the right approvals and tasks.
* Design Employee Center experiences, knowledge, and guided journeys that reduce inbound questions.
* Apply strong data segregation, scoped access, and privacy controls to keep sensitive HR records secure.
* Partner with HR operations to automate routine casework while preserving a considered, human experience where it matters most.


**Field Service Management (FSM)**
 Our field teams rely on ServiceNow to reach the right location with the right parts. Reliable scheduling and dispatch directly affect service quality and customer experience.
   

  

* Configure work order management, dynamic scheduling and dispatch, and technician assignment based on skills, location, and availability.
* Support the mobile experience so technicians can work offline and sync cleanly when they reconnect.
* Integrate FSM with inventory, asset, and parts management so that scheduling reflects real\-world availability.
* Refine SLAs, entitlements, and territory rules as the field organisation grows and evolves.


**Serval AI**
 Serval AI is an early and high\-potential area for us. We are looking for someone curious and rigorous, who will pilot AI capabilities responsibly and apply them where they deliver real value.
   

  

* Implement and tune Serval AI across service workflows — case summarisation, resolution suggestions, and generative responses in conversational assistants.
* Extend Serval AI through its TypeScript capability — building custom logic, connectors, and integrations in a type\-safe, source\-controlled codebase.
* Design and refine conversational assistant flows, improving them using real conversation data and deflection metrics.
* Apply Serval AI for classification, similarity, and routing so that work reaches the right team automatically.
* Apply Serval AI over CMDB and asset data — reasoning across Configuration Item and Asset relationships and their lifecycle state to deliver accurate, context\-aware insight.
* Monitor Serval AI quality, guardrails, and cost, and validate that each capability delivers measurable value before rolling it out broadly.


**IT Operations Management (ITOM)**
 A trustworthy CMDB underpins everything else on the platform. You will help keep it accurate and ensure the platform reflects the estate as it truly is.
   

  

* Configure and troubleshoot Discovery and Service Mapping, including MID Server setup, credentials, and custom patterns.
* Maintain CMDB health — identification and reconciliation rules, data certification, and remediation of duplicate or stale CIs.
* Understand and maintain the relationship between Configuration Items (cmdb\_ci) and Asset records (alm\_asset), and map hardware and software lifecycle stages to the corresponding CI operational status.
* Work with graph connectors to ingest and relate external data, keeping CI and asset status accurate and consistent alongside ITOM Discovery and Service Mapping.
* Configure Event Management and alert correlation to reduce noise into a small set of actionable alerts.
* Support Service Mapping so business services are modeled well enough to drive impact analysis and change decisions.


**Platform maintenance \& operations**
 Delivery is only part of the role. Equally important is keeping the instance stable, current, and well\-documented, so that it remains maintainable for the whole team.
   

  

* Plan and execute family upgrades and patching, including impact assessment, skipped\-updates review, and regression testing.
* Run instance health scans, address technical debt, and manage update sets and CI/CD promotion across environments.
* Monitor performance — slow queries, long\-running jobs, and table growth — and address root causes rather than symptoms.
* Manage ACLs, roles, and security so that access is appropriately scoped, and maintain clear documentation so that knowledge is shared across the team.


**Requirements**
**Job Requirements**
 You do not need to be an expert in every module on day one. We value genuine depth in several of these areas, sound platform judgement, and the drive to grow into the rest.
   

  

**Must have**
* Five or more years building on ServiceNow, including senior or lead responsibility on production delivery.
* Strong JavaScript (and ideally TypeScript) with hands\-on command of the core platform: Flow Designer, scripting, ACLs, the data model, and integrations.
* Production experience in at least two of: Financial Management, HRSD, FSM, or ITOM.
* Experience owning upgrades and general platform maintenance on a live, business\-critical instance.
* Adaptable and forward\-looking — comfortable adopting a new TypeScript\-based AI platform should the strategy shift, and able to help plan and lead the migration of workloads away from ServiceNow.
* Certified System Administrator (CSA), plus at least one Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in a relevant module.
* A clear communicator who can engage effectively with senior stakeholders and technical teams alike.


**Preferred**
* Hands\-on work with Serval AI or comparable AI/LLM platforms and conversational assistants.
* Additional CIS certifications, or Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* Experience with CI/CD tooling, automated testing (ATF), and source control for ServiceNow.
* TypeScript and the ServiceNow SDK (Fluent) for building and versioning scoped apps in code.
* Exposure to ITOM Discovery patterns, Service Mapping, or Event Management at scale.
* Background integrating ServiceNow with ERP, IdP/SSO, or monitoring tools.

title: Staff Software Engineer - CTV (Ad Server)
description:
**About The Role**
 PubMatic is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help architect and evolve our next\-generation, highly scalable, low\-latency AdServer for Connected TV (CTV) – operating at a scale of 1 trillion\+ requests per day and managing millions of requests per second. This is a technical leadership role for an engineer who wants to shape the architectural direction of the CTV AdServer platform, not just one team’s roadmap, in one of the fastest\-growing areas of programmatic advertising. If you thrive on solving distributed\-systems problems at extreme scale, enjoy influencing engineering direction across multiple teams, and want to be one of the most senior technical voices in the organization, we’d love to talk to you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Product \& Architecture Influence: Influence multiple teams across the AdServer organization by defining and reviewing product and platform architecture and implementations. Identify architectural risks early and propose alternatives and solutions that hold up at trillion\-scale.
* Architectural Oversight: Oversee the design and implementation of critical platform components by maintaining in\-depth knowledge of best practices, technologies, architectures, and emerging technologies, and by setting the technical bar for the AdServer engineering organization.
* Standards \& Decisions: Document and communicate exceptions to architectural standards by capturing significant architectural decisions (ADRs), ensuring decisions and their rationale are visible, durable, and reusable across teams.
* Own end\-to\-end technical direction for the AdServer platform – partnering with Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, Engineering Leads, and Product Leads to translate business needs into a coherent, multi\-quarter technical roadmap.
* Lead the design and evolution of highly reliable, scalable, low\-latency distributed backend platforms and services, and set the technical direction that other teams build on.
* Drive research into emerging technologies, sponsor proof\-of\-concepts, and make build/adopt decisions that materially move the platform forward.
* Act as a technical escalation point across teams – auditing designs for platform stability, reviewing major architecture changes across the AdServer Development Team, and unblocking the hardest cross\-cutting problems.
* Partner with Data Center and DevOps teams on long\-range technical planning – new technology adoption, software optimization strategy, and stability roadmaps for the overall platform.
* Mentor and raise the technical bar of Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, and other senior ICs, through design reviews, architecture forums, and hands\-on technical guidance.
* Champion engineering best practices and documentation standards across teams; ensure designs meet requirements and that platform\-wide work meets a consistently high quality bar.
* Drive the application of GenAI across the software development lifecycle – design, coding, testing, and documentation – and help set the standard for AI\-enabled engineering across the org.


**We'd Love for You to Have**
* 14\+ years of hands\-on development experience in C/C\+\+ in a Linux/UNIX environment, with a track record of shipping and evolving large\-scale distributed systems. Experience with Go is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated experience defining architecture and technical direction across multiple teams or a full platform, not just a single service or team.
* Deep proficiency in algorithms and advanced data structures, with a strong foundation in core computer science principles.
* Extensive experience in software design and architecture for complex, scalable, low\-latency, high\-throughput systems.
* A track record of identifying architectural risk ahead of time and driving alternatives that are adopted broadly.
* Ability to write and review architectural decision records, and to communicate trade\-offs clearly to both engineering and product stakeholders.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to find optimal, innovative solutions to open\-ended technical problems.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI\-based tools and IDEs to accelerate development; comfort with prompt engineering fundamentals and an understanding of different model types at a working level.
* Deep knowledge of OS internals and systems programming – multi\-threading, multi\-processing, and memory management – and the ability to troubleshoot the hardest production issues.
* Ability to write clean, modular, loosely coupled code, and to hold others to that same bar through review.
* Strong end\-to\-end understanding of product functionality across the platform, not just an individual component.
* Working knowledge of scripting (Perl/Python/Shell) and databases (preferably MySQL).
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across teams without direct authority.


**Good To Have \- CTV Domain Experience**
* Prior hands\-on experience building or scaling ad serving, ad decisioning, or real\-time bidding systems specifically for Connected TV (CTV) / OTT.
* Working knowledge of CTV\-specific technical protocols and standards – e.g. VAST/VPAID/VMAP, SSAI (server\-side ad insertion) and CSAI, HLS/DASH manifest manipulation, and IAB CTV/OTT specifications.
* Understanding of the CTV supply chain and its unique constraints – device\- and app\-level identifiers (e.g. IFA, RIDA), frequency capping and pod/ad\-break management, content\-level targeting, and the latency/quality bar required for a living\-room viewing experience.
* Familiarity with SSAI stitching architectures and the trade\-offs between client\-side and server\-side ad insertion at scale.
* Exposure to OTT/streaming platforms, smart TV operating systems (e.g. Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS), or set\-top box environments, and the constraints they place on ad delivery.
* Understanding of CTV measurement, viewability, and completion\-rate reporting requirements, and how they differ from traditional display/video.
* Awareness of the evolving CTV privacy and identity landscape (e.g. data clean rooms, alternative identifiers, cross\-device graphs) and its implications for ad server architecture.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering Mindset**
 We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI\-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high\-scale, performance\-critical environment.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute or university; advanced degree is a plus but not required given depth of experience.


**Additional Information**
**Return to Office** 
 : PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

title: Senior Software Engineer - IPv6 Networking exp is a must**
description:
**SonicWall** is a cybersecurity forerunner with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner\-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real\-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud\-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose\-built security solutions to enable any organization—enterprise, government agencies and SMBs—around the world. For more information, visit **www.sonicwall.com** or follow us on **Twitter**, **LinkedIn**, **Facebook** and **Instagram**.

**About the Role**



SonicWall is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer with deep IPv6 expertise** to lead the design, implementation, and hardening of IPv6 capabilities across the Sonicwall firewall firmware stack. As a Principal Engineer, you will be the technical authority for IPv6 feature parity, protocol correctness, and interoperability across SonicWall Next\-Generation Firewall (NGFW) platforms. This role is ideal for engineers with hands\-on experience delivering IPv6 in high\-performance router, switch, or carrier\-grade networking products who are looking to apply that expertise in the embedded network security domain.


**Responsibilities**


* **Lead IPv6 Architecture \& Feature Delivery** — Own end\-to\-end design and implementation of IPv6 features across the Sonicwall frewall networking stack, including IPv6 routing, interface addressing, DHCPv6, NDP, MLDv2, and IPv6 Policy\-Based Routing (PBR).
* **Drive IPv6 Feature Parity** — Identify and close gaps between IPv4 and IPv6 feature sets across subsystems — including VPN Tunnel Interfaces, IPsec/IKEv2, SSL\-VPN, Syslog, SNMP, and NAT64 — ensuring consistent dual\-stack and IPv6\-only operation.
* **Design High\-Performance IPv6 Packet Processing Paths** — Architect and optimize the IPv6 dataplane for packet forwarding, classification, ACL matching, and session lookup within the sonicwall high\-performance packet\-processing pipeline.
* **Resolve Complex IPv6 Protocol Issues** — Diagnose and resolve deep\-rooted interoperability, conformance, and performance issues involving IPv6 neighbor discovery, prefix delegation, ICMPv6 error handling, and fragmentation edge cases.
* **Establish IPv6 Protocol Conformance Standards** — Define and drive compliance with IETF IPv6 RFCs (RFC 2460, RFC 4291, RFC 4861, RFC 4862, RFC 6724, RFC 8200, and related extensions) within the Sonicwall frewall codebase.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** — Work closely with Platform, Security, Data Platform, and QA teams to integrate IPv6 changes safely across subsystems and validate correctness at scale.
* **Prototype and Evaluate IPv6 Technologies** — Evaluate emerging IPv6 transition mechanisms (464XLAT, MAP\-T, CLAT, SRv6\) and contribute to next\-generation NGFW networking capabilities.
* **Influence Technical Direction** — Drive architectural decisions, IPv6 scalability strategies, and long\-term technical roadmap for protocol parity and government/federal compliance (USGv6, IPv6\-ready certification, DoD IPv6 mandates).
* **Mentorship \& Technical Leadership** — Serve as the IPv6 subject\-matter expert (SME) for the Sonicwall frewall engineering org; mentor senior and mid\-level engineers and lead cross\-team IPv6 technical design reviews.


**Requirements**


* **7\- 9\+ years** of hands\-on C/C\+\+ systems\-level development for networking platforms — with a strong emphasis on routers, Layer\-3 switches, carrier\-grade NAT (CGNAT) devices, or network security appliances.
* **Deep IPv6 Protocol Expertise** — Proven, production\-level implementation experience with:
* + IPv6 addressing, subnetting, and prefix delegation (DHCPv6\-PD)
	+ Neighbor Discovery Protocol (NDP), Router Advertisements (RA), and MLDv2
	+ IPv6 routing protocols (OSPFv3, BGP with IPv6 AFI/SAFI, RIPng)
	+ IPsec/IKEv2 over IPv6 transport
	+ IPv6 ACLs, PBR, and traffic classification at line rate
	+ IPv6 transition and coexistence mechanisms (Dual\-Stack, 6in4, 6rd, NAT64/DNS64, 464XLAT)
* **L2/L3/L4 Networking Depth** — Solid understanding of Ethernet, VLANs, 802\.1Q, bridging, routing (static and dynamic), NAT, firewall state tables, and VPN tunneling in the context of both IPv4 and IPv6\.
* **High\-Performance Packet Processing** — Experience with DPDK, ODP, OFP, XDP/eBPF, or comparable frameworks for low\-latency, high\-throughput packet forwarding is a strong advantage.
* **Protocol Conformance \& Testing** — Experience validating IPv6 implementations against IETF RFC requirements and government IPv6\-ready test suites (USGv6, IPv6\-Ready Logo Phase\-2\) is highly desirable.
* **Strong Debugging \& Diagnostic Skills** — Proficient with tcpdump, Wireshark (IPv6 dissectors), GDB, kernel trace tools, and network emulation environments (GNS3, EVE\-NG, or equivalent) for root\-cause analysis of IPv6 issues.
* **Communication \& Leadership** — Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the proven ability to lead cross\-functional IPv6 design discussions, write technical specifications, and represent engineering in product and architecture reviews.


**Nice to Have**


* Experience with **government / federal IPv6 compliance** requirements (DoD IPv6 mandate, NIST SP 500\-267, USGv6 Profile).
* Exposure to **SRv6** (Segment Routing over IPv6\) or **MPLS over IPv6** architectures.
* Familiarity with **Sonicwall frewall**, SonicWall NGFWs, or similar embedded network security firmware.
* Working knowledge of **WireGuard over IPv6** transport.
* Experience with **automated IPv6 test frameworks** (RFC 2544, IXIA, Spirent, or similar).

description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **Company Description**



Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre\-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.


### **Position Description**



We are seeking an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to play a key role in building and scaling the **Okta Recovery Vault (ORV)**. This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise\-grade soft\-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.



As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real\-time, high\-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.


### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**


* **Feature Execution:** Drive the technical design and end\-to\-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
* **Component Design:** Design and build reliable core components for real\-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
* **Relationship \& State Management:** Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
* **Security \& Compliance:** Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft\-delete, restore, permanent\-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
* **Product \& Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
* **Operational Excellence:** Participate in on\-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
* **Code Quality \& Technical Standards:** Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* **Team Growth:** Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**


* **Experience:** 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production\-grade applications.
* **Java Expertise:** Strong proficiency in object\-oriented programming, with extensive experience in **Java** and the **Spring Boot** framework.
* **Distributed Systems:** Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event\-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).
* **Data Management:** Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., **MySQL**) and caching strategies (e.g., **Redis**) to manage state and high\-throughput data snapshots.
* **API Design:** Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust **RESTful APIs** for enterprise integration.
* **Problem Solving \& Ownership:** Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs.

### **Nice to Haves**


* Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
* Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).
* Hands\-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.
* Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).

### **Education and Training**


* **B.S. or M.S.** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

title: Senior Quality Engineer, Automation & API Testing
description:
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open\-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open\-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.


LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.


OUR PEOPLE:


People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.


We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.


**Position Overview**

  

The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for driving quality across the software development lifecycle through a strong focus on test automation, API validation, quality engineering practices, and continuous delivery. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and DevOps teams to establish testing strategies, improve automation coverage, identify quality risks early, and enable rapid, reliable releases.


The Senior QE serves as a quality advocate and technical leader, helping teams adopt scalable automation frameworks, shift\-left testing practices, and data\-driven quality standards. The role is expected to operate independently, influence engineering decisions, and mentor team members on quality engineering best practices.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Strategy \& Test Leadership**

* Define and execute comprehensive quality strategies aligned with product and engineering objectives.
* Lead test planning activities and establish risk\-based testing approaches across initiatives.
* Review requirements, architectures, and designs to identify quality risks and testability concerns early.
* Establish quality gates, standards, and automation objectives for development teams.
* Provide technical leadership on quality engineering practices across multiple products or services.
* Mentor Quality Engineers and development teams on automation, testing methodologies, and quality best practices.

**API \& Service\-Level Testing**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust API and service\-level automation frameworks.
* Validate REST, GraphQL, and microservice\-based architectures through automated testing.
* Create automated tests covering functional, integration, contract, regression, and negative testing scenarios.
* Validate authentication, authorization, data integrity, error handling, and security controls across services.
* Perform data validation through API responses, databases, queues, and downstream integrations.
* Collaborate with developers to improve API testability and observability.

**Test Automation Engineering**

* Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, and test data management solutions.
* Drive automation\-first testing approaches, minimizing reliance on manual regression testing.
* Continuously improve automation reliability, execution speed, and maintainability.
* Measure automation effectiveness using coverage, execution, defect detection, and quality metrics.
* Ensure automated tests are integrated into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous delivery goals.

**System Integration \& End\-to\-End Testing**

* Validate complex workflows across distributed systems, microservices, and third\-party integrations.
* Design test strategies for highly integrated cloud\-based applications.
* Conduct integration and system testing to ensure end\-to\-end business process validation.
* Identify risks associated with cross\-system dependencies and recommend mitigation strategies.

**Performance, Reliability \& Security Testing**

* Define and execute performance, scalability, and reliability testing approaches.
* Analyze application behaviour under load and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Support security testing initiatives by validating authentication, authorization, and API security controls.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to improve application resilience and production readiness.

**DevOps \& Continuous Quality**

* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
* Ensure quality gates are embedded within deployment pipelines.
* Leverage test execution analytics and quality metrics to drive continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve environment stability, test data availability, and deployment validation.
* Support quality practices within cloud\-native and containerized environments.

**Release Quality \& Production Support**

* Evaluate release readiness using risk assessments, automation results, and quality metrics.
* Participate in production incident investigations and root cause analysis.
* Develop monitoring and validation strategies to ensure quality after deployment.
* Analyze defect trends and recommend preventative quality improvements.

**Skills \& Qualifications**

**Required**

* **7\+ years of experience** in Quality Engineering, Software Testing, or Test Automation.
* Strong experience designing and implementing **test automation frameworks** .
* Advanced experience in **API testing and automation** using tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, Playwright, Karate, or similar frameworks.
* Strong programming/scripting experience with languages such as **Java, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python** .
* Experience testing **distributed systems, microservices, and cloud\-native applications** .
* Strong understanding of software architecture, SDLC, Agile, and DevOps methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience with **CI/CD pipelines** and automated quality gates.
* Experience with SQL and database validation techniques.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to independently drive quality initiatives and influence engineering teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud environments.
* Experience with containerized platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience implementing contract testing and service virtualization.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms (Application Insights, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana).
* Experience in regulated, enterprise, or high\-availability environments.
* ISTQB Advanced, CSTE, or equivalent certification.

title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high\-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle.


The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross\-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.


The ideal candidate is a hands\-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud\-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data\-intensive solutions for regulated or asset\-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.

 **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high\-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long\-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest\-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud\-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map\-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer\-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high\-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity.
* Establish outcome\-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service\-level objectives, and operational readiness.
* Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes.
* Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness.
* Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer\-focused engineering culture.
* Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required.
* Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI\-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices.

**First 6\-12 Months**


The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer\-facing teams to confirm the highest\-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan.


Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest\-value Unify Energy capabilities.

title: Technical Lead - Software Engineering
description:
**About The Position** 




 Aqua Security enables enterprises to secure their container\-based and cloud\-native applications from development to production, accelerating container adoption and bridging the gap between DevOps and IT security. We are building a state\-of\-the\-art security platform for large enterprises in the exciting and innovative new field of software containers. Our systems are deployed on thousands of customer servers around the world. A distributed system to watch over distributed systems!
 


* We are looking for a talented Technical Lead to join our server team, in charge of developing Aqua's management console \- a multi\-component system with many responsibilities, performing various background jobs and large\-scale data processing; supplying REST APIs, a web based UI and more.
* In this role, you will take part in further development of our management console, writing features across the entire application stack: SQL queries, business logic, background processes, REST APIs and web\-based user interfaces.
* At Aqua, you will not be writing code for in\-house applications. You will be writing code for large technology companies, banks, government agencies and multi\-national chains.
* Our product is composed of multiple components, mostly installed on\-premise in our customer's cloud environments, but also has SaaS components, plugins for various CI/CD systems and many more. Almost everything runs inside containers. It is written in Go \- an exciting new language from Google, and heavily depends on free software/open source components. Our web UI is currently written in VueJS. We are primarily a Linux company, but our software also supports Windows and Mac.



  





**Working from Aqua Hyderabad office a minimum of 4 days per week (Mon\-Thu)** 




**Requirements** 



1. 9\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience delivering features for large\-scale, distributed applications.
2. Proven experience designing and building multi‑component systems / microservices with efficient inter‑service communication patterns.
3. Strong programming background in Go, Node.js, Java, or similar high\-level languages — extra credit if you’ve used Go in production or survived a weekend debugging a catastrophic memory leak.
4. Experienced in building and maintaining APIs (REST or RPC) while owning the lifecycle of backward‑compatibility decisions (including the ones you regret).
5. Passionate about modern engineering practices, open\-source ecosystems, and developing software that runs reliably at scale in real customer environments.



  





**AI \& GenAI Expertise** 



1. Practical, high\-impact experience using GenAI development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to boost developer productivity, accelerate code reviews, support architectural decisions, and improve engineering workflows.
2. Familiarity with AI\-supported observability, predictive alerting, data analysis and intelligent root‑cause analysis.
3. Experience integrating AI/ML\-assisted tooling into design, development, test automation, CI/CD, or operational pipelines is a strong plus.



  





**Data \& Storage Technologies** 



1. Deep hands\-on experience with RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQLite) and/or NoSQL systems (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra, Couchbase).
2. Comfortable writing complex queries (yes, including multi‑join monsters) and having strong opinions on integer vs UUIDprimary keys.
3. Bonus points for familiarity with Graph Databases.



  





**Cloud, Infra \& DevOps** 



1. Solid, production\-grade experience on AWS (required).
2. Strong knowledge of IaC tooling, automated provisioning, and cloud\-native infrastructure design.
3. Experience building cloud\-native apps using Serverless (Lambda), SNS, SQS, S3, EC2, and event\-driven architectures.
4. Understanding of AI\-supported IaC, automated configuration checks, and intelligent cloud monitoring is a plus.



  





**Containers, Linux \& Ecosystem** 



1. Strong Linux fundamentals — you should feel at home in \*nix environments.
2. Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (required); OpenShift is a bonus.
3. Knowledge of event streaming platforms like Kafka is a plus.



  





 Aqua Security is the pioneer in cloud native security. Founded in 2015, Aqua Security is a global late\-stage scale\-up and the largest pure play cloud native vendor. Aqua helps enterprises see and stop threats across every phase of the software development lifecycle, from dev to cloud and back.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Compilers
description:
**Who We Are**
 This role is part of the Kinara Group at NXP Semiconductors, combining the agility and innovation of a startup with the scale, stability, and global reach of a leading semiconductor company.
   

  

 Kinara was founded on patented technology developed during the founders' Ph.D. research at Stanford University, with a mission to redefine AI inference at the edge through tightly integrated hardware and software. Following Kinara's acquisition, this mission continues within NXP, with the Kinara team operating as a dedicated AI accelerator and software group focused on pushing the boundaries of edge AI.
   

  

 The team has delivered two generations of AI silicon shipping in volume, supported by a mature and production\-ready software stack, making it one of the most proven edge AI platforms in the industry. Kinara technology is used by marquee customers, including GAFA\-class companies, a leading global e\-commerce provider, and Tier\-1 PC OEMs.
   

  

 As part of NXP, the Kinara Group now benefits from world\-class silicon execution, manufacturing scale, and customer access, while retaining its startup culture, deep AI expertise, and compiler\-driven engineering mindset. Joining this team offers the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI compiler and silicon technology, with real\-world impact and long\-term stability.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We build game\-changing edge AI solutions that enable faster, smarter, and more power\-efficient decision making where every millisecond matters.
   

  

 At the core of our platform are Ara AI inference processors, purpose\-built to deliver unrivaled deep learning performance per watt at the edge. Paired with our comprehensive SDK and software toolchain, these processors enable developers to deploy and optimize complex AI models for real\-time inference under tight latency and power constraints.
   

  

 Kinara's hardware\-software co\-design approach allows high\-performance AI to be seamlessly embedded into edge devices, enabling applications across vision, industrial automation, consumer electronics, and intelligent systems. Our solutions focus on performance, efficiency, and scalability, helping customers bring advanced AI capabilities out of the cloud and into the real world.
   

  

 Edge AI is at an inflection point, and the Kinara Group within NXP is uniquely positioned to play a leading role in its growth, delivering production\-proven silicon, a robust compiler and SDK stack, and a clear roadmap for next\-generation intelligent edge devices.
   

  

**This Is What You Are Responsible For**
* Implement compiler modules within defined subsystems: MLIR dialects, lowering passes, operator fusion strategies, and target code generation components for our NPU.
* Participate in design and deployment of quantization flows and numerical\-correctness verification for assigned features.
* Develop and ship production\-grade compiler passes and runtime integration components that are stable, debuggable, and performant.
* Perform low\-level optimizations and collaborate with kernel teams to address HW/SW performance gaps.
* Contribute to compiler CI pipelines, test suites, profiling, and release processes.
* Debug and root\-cause performance and correctness issues on customer models; produce reproducible fixes.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to design reviews.
* Provide feedback to product and silicon teams on compiler\-driven feature opportunities and tradeoffs.


**Necessary Qualifications**
* 7\-8 years of software engineering experience with hands\-on compiler and systems work.
* Experience with graph lowering, IR design, operator fusion, scheduling, and code generation for accelerators.
* Strong systems programming skills \-\- proficient C\+\+ and solid Python for tooling and infrastructure.
* Track record of shipping compiler components or systems software used in deployed products.
* Solid debugging and profiling skills with common performance toolchains.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work cross\-functionally with hardware architects and kernel teams.
* Willingness to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team engineering practices.


**Good to Have**
* Familiarity with MLIR\-based frontends and dialects, such as TOSA, StableHLO, TorchMLIR.
* Exposure to AI compiler stacks, hardware backends, or accelerator targeting.
* Experience working with large\-scale models or production ML inference pipelines.


 More information about NXP in India...

description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .
   

  

 What you have
   

  

 The SAM Data Technology team builds and enhances cloud native data pipelines and data platform capabilities that support Schwab Asset Management’s analytical, operational, and regulatory data needs. As a Sr. Specialist (Level 56\), you will take on expanded ownership of data pipeline design, cloud data engineering patterns, and the development of scalable data solutions across Snowflake and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
   

  

 Engineers at this level operate with greater independence, take lead roles in technical problem solving, and contribute to shaping best practices for data engineering within SAMDA.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design \& Build Investment Data Pipelines
* Design, develop, and optimize investment data pipelines using ETL/ELT patterns.
* Integrate data from custodians, vendors, and internal platforms into curated datasets.
* Build reliable workflows using GCS, Dataproc, Cloud Dataflow, Composer (Airflow), and Pub/Sub.
* Implement scalable transformations in Snowflake and other cloud data warehouses.
* Investment Data Modeling
* Contribute to portfolio, transaction, pricing, and performance data models aligned to investment use cases.
* Apply Kimball/star schema patterns and domain driven modeling for analytics and reporting.
* Optimize schemas for API consumption, dashboards, and quantitative analysis.
* Data APIs for Investment Use Cases (Full Stack)
* Design and implement Investment Data APIs using Python
* Expose curated investment datasets (holdings, performance, risk metrics) via secure REST endpoints.
* Enable programmatic access for portfolio managers, analysts, and downstream applications.
* Apply authentication, authorization, and data entitlement controls consistent with regulated investment data.
* Python Dashboards \& Investment Analytics UI
* Build Python based dashboards and UI applications (Streamlit, Dash, Panel).
* Create interactive visualizations for portfolio views, performance trends, and risk insights using Plotly, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
* Translate complex investment datasets into intuitive, self service analytical experiences.
* Optimize dashboard performance for large portfolios and time series data.
* Advanced Cloud \& Application Engineering
* Build data and application services using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and Cloud SQL.
* Apply distributed processing frameworks (Apache Spark, Beam, Flink) for large scale investment datasets.
* Package and deploy APIs and dashboards using Docker.
* DevOps, CI/CD \& Automation
* Own CI/CD pipelines for data pipelines, investment data APIs, and Python UI applications.
* Use Git/Bitbucket/Bamboo, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Maven, Nexus for build and release automation.
* Data Quality, Controls \& Reliability (Investments)
* Implement data quality checks specific to investment data (reconciliation, completeness, timeliness).
* Monitor pipelines, APIs, and dashboards to ensure reliable delivery of investment insights. Troubleshoot complex data issues impacting portfolio, performance, or risk reporting.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 3–5 years of experience building cloud based investment or financial data platforms.
* Hands on experience with Snowflake and GCP services (GCS, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Composer, Cloud SQL).
* Strong Python skills for data engineering, API development, and visualization.
* Experience building REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
* Experience building Python dashboards/UI (Streamlit, Dash, Panel).
* Experience with distributed processing frameworks (Spark, Beam, or Flink).
* Proficiency with CI/CD, Docker, and IaC (Terraform or GCP Deployment Manager).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with investment management data (portfolios, performance, risk, pricing).
* Familiarity with custodians, portfolio accounting, or market data vendors.
* Knowledge of data governance, entitlements, and controls in regulated investment environments.
* Ability to lead cross functional investment data initiatives.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more

title: Agentic AI Developer
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role:**

Azurity is seeking an Agentic AI Developer to design, build, and deploy AI agents and multi\-step autonomous workflows that integrate with internal systems and business processes.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Design and build AI agents that use large language models to plan, reason, and execute multi\-step tasks, including data retrieval, document generation, and cross\-system workflows
* Integrate agents with internal and third\-party systems via APIs, MCP servers, and other tool\-calling frameworks
* Build and maintain orchestration layers for multi\-agent workflows, including error handling, retries, and human\-in\-the\-lead checkpoints


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Three or more years of professional software development experience, including at least one year working directly with large language models or agentic AI systems
* Strong proficiency in Python or a similar language, with experience using large language model APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable providers
* Hands\-on experience building tool\-calling or function\-calling agents, including designing tool schemas and managing multi\-turn reasoning
* Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks and concepts (ReAct, planning/reflection loops, multi\-agent coordination)
* Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and embedding models
* Solid understanding of API design, integration patterns, and asynchronous systems
* Experience implementing evaluation, observability, and safety guardrails for AI systems in production
* Comfort working in a regulated industry, with attention to data privacy, security, and compliance requirements
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate business problems into technical solutions and explain AI system behavior to non\-technical stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industries
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool\-integration standards
* Experience with enterprise systems commonly used in pharmaceutical environments, such as Veeva, Salesforce, ERP, or IT service management platforms
* Background in prompt engineering and fine\-tuning/evaluation of LLMs
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps practices.

  

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description:
**Namaskaram!** 




  





 AjnaLens is looking for an experienced Audio DSP Engineer to join our Product Engineering team at Thane (Maharashtra – India). This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on developing and optimizing real\-time audio solutions for next\-generation smart glasses, wearables, and consumer electronics.
 



 The ideal candidate should have 5\+ years of experience in Audio DSP / Embedded Audio, with strong expertise in digital signal processing, multi\-microphone systems, acoustic tuning, and real\-time audio algorithm implementation.
 



  





**Who Are We Looking For?** 



* An experienced Audio DSP Engineer with strong hands\-on expertise in real\-time audio processing and embedded audio systems.
* Someone with a strong understanding of DSP algorithms, speech enhancement, acoustic processing, and multi\-microphone systems.
* A hands\-on engineer proficient in C/C\+\+ who can implement and optimize DSP algorithms on embedded MCU/DSP/SoC platforms.
* Someone who understands the complete audio pipeline, from microphone input and acoustic capture to DSP processing and audio output.
* A strong problem solver who can debug complex audio issues and collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, acoustics, mechanical, and AI/ML teams.



  





**Top 3 Daily Responsibilities** 



* Develop and optimize real\-time Audio DSP algorithms for embedded platforms.
* Design and tune multi\-microphone audio pipelines for voice calls, recording, ASR, and media applications.
* Optimize and debug audio processing for latency, CPU/MIPS, memory, power consumption, and audio quality.



  





**Minimum Work Experience Required** 



* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Audio DSP / Embedded Audio.
* Experience implementing real\-time DSP algorithms on embedded MCU/DSP/SoC platforms.
* Experience developing audio solutions for consumer electronics, wearables, hearables, headphones, smart speakers, AR/VR, or similar products is preferred.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Signal Processing, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.



  





**Top 5 Skills You Should Possess** 



* Strong knowledge of FFT/DFT, FIR/IIR filters, adaptive filtering, sampling, resampling, and time/frequency\-domain processing.
* Strong programming expertise in C/C\+\+.
* Hands\-on experience with AEC, ANC, Noise Suppression/ENC, Beamforming, AGC, VAD, EQ, or Speech Enhancement.
* Strong understanding of microphones, speakers, ADC/DAC, amplifiers, audio buffering, synchronization, and latency.
* Knowledge of RTOS, DMA, interrupts, and real\-time embedded systems.



  





**Full\-Stack \& System Awareness** 



* Experience with audio interfaces including PDM, PCM, I2S, TDM, USB Audio, and Bluetooth Audio.
* Knowledge of Bluetooth profiles and codecs such as A2DP, HFP, LE Audio, SBC, AAC, LC3, Opus, and PCM.
* Understanding of microphone characterization, gain calibration, channel matching, and acoustic tuning.
* Ability to troubleshoot echo, noise, feedback, clipping, distortion, latency, and audio dropouts.
* Experience integrating vendor and third\-party audio libraries and codecs.



  





**Leadership \& Strategic Capabilities** 



* Ability to independently own audio DSP features from algorithm development through tuning, validation, and production.
* Strong debugging and root\-cause\-analysis capabilities.
* Ability to work closely with hardware, firmware, mechanical, acoustics, and AI/ML teams.
* Strong technical communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to optimize audio solutions based on product requirements and hardware constraints.



  





**Bonus Points For** 



* Experience working on Smart Glasses, TWS Earbuds, Hearables, AR/VR, Headphones, or Wearable products.
* Experience with Qualcomm, BES, MediaTek, Cadence/Tensilica HiFi, CEVA, TI, NXP, or similar audio platforms.
* Experience with Bluetooth Classic and LE Audio.
* Exposure to Wake\-word detection and ASR front\-end processing.
* Experience with MEMS microphone characterization and multi\-mic tuning.
* Hands\-on experience with MATLAB/Python for audio analysis.
* Familiarity with Audio Precision, HEAD acoustics, REW, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Exposure to AI/ML\-based speech enhancement or audio processing is a plus.



  





**What You'll Be Creating** 



* High\-quality real\-time audio experiences for next\-generation AI smart glasses and wearable products.
* Advanced multi\-microphone audio pipelines for voice interaction, calls, recording, and ASR.
* Production\-ready DSP algorithms optimized for latency, performance, memory, and power.
* Robust audio processing systems that enable clear and natural voice interaction.
* Audio solutions that integrate seamlessly across hardware, firmware, acoustics, and AI systems.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Embedded Systems, or a related field.
* Strong equivalent hands\-on experience in Audio DSP / Embedded Audio development is highly valued.

**Title: SailPoint Developer/ Senior SailPoint Developer**

The global Governance, Risk and Assurance team is responsible for maintaining compliance with enterprise cybersecurity control frameworks, policies and procedures. The team is part of the global Cybersecurity Engineering and Assurance organization at Cornerstone OnDemand.
  

  

The SailPoint Developer plays a critical role in supporting the identity security strategy and vision of the Cybersecurity Engineering \& Assurance team, and reports into the Associate Director of Cybersecurity \& Assurance. Cornerstone uses SailPoint IIQ for automated governance of its access control mechanisms covering areas such as account lifecycle management, role\-based access control, access recertifications, and more.
  

  

This role focuses on development of new features and integrations based on changing business and cybersecurity requirements, as well as continuous maintenance of the platform. You should have a solid working knowledge of IT systems and technologies and enjoy working collaboratively across teams. * Perform thorough root\-cause analyses for identified problems and exceptions as needed.

Strong experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ workflows, lifecycle events, approval processes, rules, forms, tasks and customizations.

* Proficient in software development methodologies using Java, Bean Shell/JavaScript, JSP/Servlets, SQL, PowerShell and XML.
* Experience working with Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft SQL Server, LDAP, HRMS, DBMS and SaaS applications.
* Experience in integrating ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow and Jira with SailPoint IdentityIQ.
* Experience in troubleshooting and performance\-tuning of SailPoint IdentityIQ, including aggregation, provisioning, workflows, database queries, scheduled tasks, and connector\-related issues.
* Strong knowledge of SailPoint debugging, logging, task monitoring, error analysis, and production incident management.
* Experience with Bitbucket, Splunk, Thycotic/Delinea, Entra ID, AWS and Azure technologies is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 tools such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint with mature data analysis, documentation, articulation and presentation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders across global regions and organizational levels.
* Ability to work autonomously with flexibility, professionalism and excellent judgment.
