title: Manager, Engineering (AI & Agentic Platform)
description:
**Company Description**  

QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through an intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and technology into a single System of Action. Founded in 1979 and headquartered in Miami, Florida, the company serves manufacturers across more than 100 countries in industries including automotive, consumer products, food and beverage, high technology, industrial equipment, and life sciences.


The platform is built on three core pillars: **Redzone** (frontline empowerment), **Adaptive ERP** (the intelligent backbone of manufacturing operations), and **ChampionAI** (Agentic AI purpose\-built for manufacturing). Together, these enable manufacturers to achieve measurable productivity, resilience, and growth — in as little as 90 days.

 **Job Description**  

QAD \| Redzone is seeking a technically strong Engineering Manager to lead our AI \& Agentic Platform team. You will be responsible for building and scaling a production\-grade AI platform for Manufacturing, combining strong people leadership with deep software engineering and AI expertise. This is a high\-impact role at the intersection of modern cloud architecture, agentic AI systems, and industrial software.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Define technical priorities for the engineering team and collaborate cross\-functionally with Product and other engineering teams.
* Coach, mentor, and develop software and AI engineers to support their professional growth.
* Manage a small, focused team — including engineers more specialized than you in specific AI domains.
* Challenge architecture and design decisions without becoming a bottleneck; uphold high standards for code quality, security, and reliability.
* Balance innovation, delivery speed, and production\-grade quality when building and scaling platform services.
* Lead technical decisions spanning AI, backend, frontend, data, and cloud infrastructure.
* Drive the design and deployment of robust software using modern cloud, container, and microservices architectures.
* Oversee integration of Agentic AI elements — agent orchestration, RAG, tool calling, and workflows.
* Implement standards for AI governance, evaluation, and agent observability.

 **Qualifications** **MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS**

* Total Experience of around 10\+ years with 5\+ years managing or technically leading a small engineering team.
* Strong software engineering and architecture background (ideally from a Senior / Principal / Tech Lead trajectory).
* Solid understanding of AI/LLM technologies — RAG, agent orchestration, tool calling, and workflows.
* Hands\-on exposure to building and deploying Agentic AI systems (not just conceptual knowledge).
* Good command of data architectures and pipelines.
* Experience with cloud architectures and modern cloud\-native design.
* Working knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, containers, and observability.
* Ability to challenge technical decisions across AI, backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure.
* Proven record delivering production\-grade software end\-to\-end.

**NICE\-TO\-HAVE**

* Manufacturing, Industrial software, ERP, Supply Chain, WMS, or TMS experience.
* AWS ecosystem familiarity — Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent.
* Experience with Snowflake and/or Kubernetes.
* Microservices and event\-driven architecture patterns.
* Background in AI governance, evaluation frameworks, and agent observability tooling.

**LEADERSHIP PROFILE**


The strongest candidates come from a Senior Software Engineer, Principal Engineer, or Tech Lead background who have grown into engineering management while retaining strong technical depth. You remain technically credible — you can engage deeply with architecture, debug hard problems, and set the bar — but you no longer need to be the strongest coder or AI specialist on the team.

 **KEY SKILLS**

**Software \& Cloud Architecture**


Microservices · Kubernetes · AWS · CI/CD · Observability

**AI \& Agentic Systems**


LLMs · RAG · Orchestration · Tool Calling · Evaluation

**Data Pipelines \& Observability**


Snowflake · Event\-driven · Monitoring · Logging


‍ **Engineering Leadership**


Coaching · Cross\-functional · Technical Strategy · Delivery

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field (required).
* Master's degree, MBA, or equivalent graduate program (a plus).

  

**Additional Information**  

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD:**


QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  

Job Overview
  
  

ROLE PURPOSE
  
  

Serve as the programme's Jira Cloud subject\-matter authority in support of Client's migration execution. The role advises on target\-state architecture, rationalization, app strategy, and validation approach — ensuring Client's migration engineering team executes against a clean, well\-designed cloud destination — without itself owning migration execution.
  
  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

**Advise on target\-state Atlassian Cloud architecture:** site and plan topology, sandbox strategy, data residency posture, identity and access patterns (SSO/SCIM, Atlassian Guard), and permission/governance models.
  
**Lead rationalization recommendations ahead of each wave:** workflows, custom fields, schemes, screens, dashboards, and Confluence space structures — reducing migration payload and post\-migration debt.
  
**Own the Marketplace app gap analysis:** Data Center app inventory, cloud equivalence assessment, Connect\-to\-Forge implications, and recommendations to replace, retire, or rebuild — a primary driver of wave complexity classification.
  
Advise on integration patterns for rebuilt or replaced integrations with enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow), in coordination with the Senior Cloud Engineer and Client integration owners.
  
Support wave criteria definition and per\-project complexity assessment; contribute to go/no\-go readiness reviews.
  
Define the validation and verification approach for migrated data and configuration (staging\-first migration, integrity comparison, user mapping consistency) and review verification outcomes with Client's migration engineers.
  
Provide escalation\-level troubleshooting guidance during migration windows and hypercare; document architectural decisions and standards in Confluence.
  
  

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE
  
  

10\+ years of Atlassian platform expertise spanning Jira Data Center and Jira Cloud administration/architecture at enterprise scale (5,000\+ users).
  
Direct experience with Data Center\-to\-Cloud migration assessment and planning, including familiarity with Atlassian's cloud migration tooling and staged (staging\-to\-production) migration approaches.
  
Deep knowledge of the Atlassian Marketplace ecosystem, including cloud app parity analysis and the Connect/Forge platform transition.
  
Strong grasp of enterprise identity, security, and governance in Atlassian Cloud (Atlassian Guard/Access, SSO/SCIM, data residency).
  
Ability to communicate architectural trade\-offs crisply to both engineers and programme leadership.
  
  

PREFERRED
  
  

Atlassian certifications (e.g., ACP\-level Jira administration).
  
Experience in regulated industries where validation evidence and auditability matter.
  
Exposure to SAFe\-aligned Jira configuration at scale.

title: GenAI Developer
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic
 **Generative AI Developer** 
 to join our Controls Technology team and support the development and integration of generative AI solutions. In this hands\-on role, you will work under the guidance of senior developers and AI architects to help build retrieval\-grounded, context\-aware, and increasingly
 **agentic** 
 AI applications. You will contribute to reliable, AI\-driven features while growing your expertise across the modern GenAI stack. This role focuses on
 **applying pre\-trained and hosted foundation models** 
 — through context engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and agentic workflows — rather than training or fine\-tuning models.
   

  

 This is a growth\-oriented role: you'll take ownership of well\-scoped components, learn established patterns from senior engineers, and progressively increase your technical depth and independence.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Assist in building and integrating generative AI applications using pre\-trained and hosted foundation models (via managed GenAI APIs and open\-model endpoints).
* Support the implementation of context engineering workflows — assembling system instructions, retrieved knowledge, tool definitions, and conversation memory into reliable, token\-efficient prompts, following established patterns.
* Contribute to prompt engineering (zero\-shot, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, role\-based prompting) for AI\-powered workflows.
* Help develop and maintain Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) components, including chunking, embedding, and semantic/keyword search.
* Support the development of knowledge graph and Graph RAG pipelines under guidance to enable grounded, traceable responses.
* Contribute to agentic workflows — helping build AI agents with tool\-calling and basic planning/memory, using frameworks such as Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangGraph, or CrewAI.
* Assist with integrating agents to external tools and data sources via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), with exposure to the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol.
* Support the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of GenAI and agentic applications in production environments.
* Perform data preprocessing, document ingestion, and basic API development for AI applications.
* Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to integrate AI capabilities into products.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure quality and reliability.
* Stay curious about advancements in GenAI and agentic AI, and share learnings with the team.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Proficiency in Python for GenAI development, data preprocessing, and scripting.
* Solid understanding of core generative AI concepts — foundation models, LLMs, tokenization, embeddings, and context windows.
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering; foundational understanding of context engineering techniques.
* Practical experience (project or professional) building RAG systems, including chunking, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs and interest in Graph RAG for relationship\-aware retrieval.
* Exposure to agentic AI development — building tool\-using agents or multi\-step workflows with a framework such as Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Awareness of agent tooling and protocols, including tool/function calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP); familiarity with the A2A protocol is a plus.
* Basic understanding of agent harness concepts — session/state management, memory, and guardrails.
* Experience consuming major GenAI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) and exposure to orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
* Understanding of application deployment and containerization (Docker).
* Working knowledge of version control systems (Git).
* Awareness of AI compliance, data privacy, guardrails, and responsible AI principles.


**Required Soft Skills**
* Strong teamwork and communication abilities.
* Eagerness to learn new AI/GenAI and agentic technologies and frameworks.
* Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
* Openness to feedback, coaching, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of experience with min 2–4 years of professional experience in software/AI development, with exposure to Generative AI and agentic AI.
* Experience contributing to AI/GenAI or software projects in a collaborative team setting.
* Exposure to cloud\-based AI/ML environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes & ServiceMesh
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
 
  
 


**Roku is changing how the world watches TV** 

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 



**About the Role**

  
 





 Join us in building Roku’s next\-generation
 
**cloud\-agnostic platform**

 that powers Kubernetes and service mesh at scale. If you’re passionate about designing resilient infrastructure, automating deployments, and enabling hundreds of workloads across multiple regions, this role is for you. You’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies like Kubernetes, Istio, Envoy, Terraform, modern observability stacks and collaborate with teams worldwide to deliver a unified hosting experience.
 

  
 





 If you’re passionate about deep platform and infrastructure engineering, solving complex scaling challenges, and enabling teams through elegant, automated solutions—this role is for you.
 

  
 




**About the Team**

  
 





 Our Cloud Compute Platform
 


 Engineering team is at the heart of Roku’s transformation toward a single, unified platform. We design and scale Kubernetes clusters, service mesh architecture, and supporting systems to ensure all engineering teams speak the same infrastructure language. We partner with internal teams to migrate workloads, enhance CI/CD pipelines, and integrate observability and security into every layer of the stack. Collaboration and impact are core to what we do.
 

  
 




**What You’ll Be Doing**

  
 



* Architect, design, and deploy Roku’s next\-generation cloud platform and service mesh.
* Build and own solutions to Roku's compute problems using Docker, Kubernetes, Istio/Envoy, Terraform and scripting to evolve our tech stack and deployments.
* Proactively drive the research and implementation of new technologies to enhance scalability, reliability, and developer experience.
* Integrate security best practices into infrastructure design and automation.
* Build tooling to visualize inefficiencies and optimize costs across shared\-tenancy clusters, including network traffic insights, cross\-cluster communication efficiency, and cost attribution.
* Collaborate with internal teams to migrate workloads to Kubernetes \+ Istio, leveraging open\-source observability tools.
* Work closely with the Observability team to scale monitoring and logging solutions for a holistic view of the platform.
* Leverage SRE principles to maintain high availability and streamline onboarding workflows.
* Mentor team members and help define best practices for infrastructure and automation.



**We’re Excited If You Have**

  
 



* Strong hands\-on experience with cloud technologies (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure is a plus), specifically in architecting and managing performant, large\-scale systems handling significant traffic/data.
* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS, or similar) and service mesh technologies.
* Proficiency in Go or another programming language, Python or another scripting language.
* Experience designing infrastructure and building automation tools, while collaborating with internal team members and external stakeholders.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines and following modern deployment practices.
* Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, etc.).
* Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Passion for learning and solving complex infrastructure challenges.
* Experience integrating AI tools to improve processes and reduce operational toil (a plus).
* Master’s degree or equivalent experience (8\+ years preferred).



  
 



  
 


**Our Hybrid Work Approach** 

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy.
 



  
 


**Benefits** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**The Roku Culture** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
 



 By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

**Description**
**JOB TITLE: Senior Software Engineer \- AI Platform Engineer**
**JOB TYPE: Full\-Time**
**JOB LOCATION: India, Chennai (Hybrid)**
**About CloudBees**
 CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
   

  

 Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
   

  

 CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
   

  

 Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
   

  

 Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re embedding AI across the entire software development lifecycle to reduce the time it takes to understand, triage, and resolve problems \- from planning and code, through CI/CD, to production systems.
   

  

 The AI Foundation team builds the platform infrastructure that makes AI\-assisted software delivery possible inside CloudBees (and our CloudBees Unify product). Our systems ingest signals from pipelines, pull requests, source\-code, tests, and incidents \- and need to process them reliably, at scale, in production.
   

  

 This is a platform engineering role. Your primary identity here is as someone who writes production\-quality Go, operates confidently in Kubernetes\-native environments, and takes observability seriously as a design constraint, not an afterthought.
   

  

 You’ll work in an environment where AI tooling is part of how the team operates \- from development through to the systems we ship. That means being an effective conductor: knowing how to direct AI tooling, decompose problems for it, and apply the same critical judgement to its output that you would to any other contributor’s work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Platform Engineering:**
* Design, build, and operate Go services running on Kubernetes that form the backbone of our agent infrastructure
* Own reliability for production systems \- define SLOs, write runbooks, and be accountable when things go wrong
* Instrument everything: structured logging, distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), and metrics that surface both system health and the behaviour of the AI workflows running on top
* Contribute to Kubernetes\-native patterns: operators, CRDs, workload isolation, and resource management for dynamic agent workloads
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support rapid, safe iteration \- using AI tooling as a natural part of that workflow


**Engineering in an AI\-Native Environment:**
* Use AI development tooling effectively \- generating, reviewing, and steering code with the same rigour you’d apply to any PR
* Decompose and delegate work to AI agents where appropriate, and know when not to \- catching drift, validating output, and maintaining ownership of outcomes
* Review AI\-generated code with an understanding of its specific failure modes: plausible\-looking but subtly wrong logic, missing edge cases, and over\-confident implementations
* Contribute to the team’s shared judgement on when new models, frameworks, or tooling change the architecture assumptions we’re building on


**Technical Collaboration:**
* Partner with the broader AI Foundation team to establish platform patterns that other teams adopt
* Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to build vs buy decisions
* Mentor more junior engineers and raise the team’s bar for production readiness and operational discipline


**Working Across Disciplines:**
* You'll work closely with ML engineers and agentic systems engineers on the team, providing the platform foundation \- reliability, observability, deployment infrastructure \- that lets their work reach production safely.
* This is a genuine collaboration: you'll bring rigour to how their systems are built and operated, and they'll bring you along on the AI domain specifics \- model behaviour, context design, evaluation approaches \- as the work demands.
* You won't be expected to arrive knowing that space deeply; you will be expected to engage with it seriously.


**What We're Looking For**
**Required:**
* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time operating at senior level
* Strong Go \- idiomatic, well\-tested, production\-shipped (if you meet all the other requirements, but have a different language \- please apply)
* Solid Kubernetes operations experience: you’ve debugged real production incidents, understand the scheduler, and know when a CRD is the wrong answer
* Hands\-on observability experience \- OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, distributed tracing \- and a genuine conviction that unobservable systems are untrustworthy
* Cloud\-native background on AWS or GCP: IAM, managed Kubernetes, infrastructure\-as\-code
* Comfortable working in an AI\-augmented development environment \- directing tools, critically evaluating their output, and maintaining engineering rigour throughout
* Demonstrated ability to own production systems end\-to\-end: design, ship, monitor, iterate


**Preferred:**
* Familiarity with Tekton, Jenkins, Argo Workflows, or similar pipeline infrastructure
* Exposure to how LLM\-based systems are structured \- enough to reason about them as infrastructure dependencies, not black boxes
* Experience contributing to platform or shared infrastructure used by multiple teams


**What Success Looks Like**
**First 3 Months:**
* Shipping production code to the AI Foundation platform with minimal ramp\-up
* Owning at least one service end\-to\-end: SLOs, alerts, and runbooks included
* Identifying and addressing a meaningful observability gap in an existing workflow


**3 \- 6 Months:**
* Delivering a materially improved platform capability that the team relies on
* Contributing patterns or tooling that other engineers adopt
* Being the person teammates reach for on K8s and observability questions


**6 \- 12 Months:**
* Leading a significant platform initiative from design through to production reliability
* Influencing how the team approaches build vs buy vs integrate decisions
* Raising the bar on how the team uses AI tooling in its own engineering practice


**Why This Role**
 Platform engineering here isn’t maintenance work. The systems are genuinely hard \- dynamic workloads, heterogeneous signal sources, reliability requirements that don’t bend because the underlying models are probabilistic.
   

  

 You’ll also be engineering in the way most teams will be working in a few years: AI tooling as a normal part of the workflow, with engineers who know how to get the most out of it without losing ownership of what ships.

 At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day \- building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
   

  

 As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Software Engineer will play a critical role in maintaining and modernizing legacy Order Fulfillment and Light Manufacturing systems for the Miramar Supply Chain Tech team.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Fanatics is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Miramar Supply Chain Tech team in Hyderabad, focused on sustaining and evolving critical ERP and fulfillment systems built on Microsoft Dynamics SL and a portfolio of .NET applications. This role is central to ensuring the stability of Order Management, Inventory, and Fulfillment workflows while driving integration with modern platforms such as Manhattan Active and enabling a thoughtful transition away from legacy architecture. The Senior Software Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
   

  

**How Will You Drive Impact**
 Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Team \& Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
   

  

* Lead and participate in design reviews and peer code reviews, setting a standard for engineering quality across the Miramar Supply Chain Tech team.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts, cloud and on\-prem partner teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders to align technical solutions with operational requirements.
* Coordinate and synchronize all changes across QC and production environments, ensuring reliable delivery and minimal disruption to critical supply chain operations.


 Fan \& Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
   

  

* Support ERP workflows through Dynamics SL that directly power Order Management, Inventory Control, and Fulfillment — capabilities that underpin the on\-time delivery of merchandise to fans globally.
* Provide incident resolution and break\-fix support for all Miramar systems, minimizing downtime and maintaining a seamless fulfillment experience.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions that improve order accuracy, inventory visibility, and fulfillment speed for fans and retail partners.
* Integrate legacy systems with platforms like Manhattan Active to enable a more modern, reliable, and scalable customer fulfillment experience.


 Innovation \& Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
   

  

* Build APIs and wrapper services that bridge legacy ERP functionality with modern cloud and on\-prem platforms, extending system capability without disrupting live operations.
* Document legacy business logic and contribute to migration planning, helping chart a clear path from current\-state systems to next\-generation solutions.
* Evaluate and apply event streaming platforms (Kafka, Pulsar, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, SQS) and CI/CD tooling to improve system integration and deployment reliability.
* Deliver full\-stack solutions across the entire lifecycle — from inception through UAT to production — using modern frameworks and containerization practices.


 Ownership \& Execution (Determined \& Relentless Mindset)
   

  

* Maintain version control for all custom applications and ensure all code is archived, documented in GitHub, and tracked through Jira and Confluence.
* Manage SQL Server stored procedures and optimize SQL views and queries, troubleshooting and resolving job or runtime errors as they arise.
* Take ownership of existing workflows and support them using the tools already in place, learning rapidly and acting decisively to keep systems stable.
* Operate effectively under pressure, solving complex problems in mission\-critical environments while maintaining clear documentation and communication throughout.


 AI \& DIGITAL CAPABILITY
   

  

 We are building a future\-ready organization. This role is expected to:
   

  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement


**Required Qualifications**
 CAPABILITIES \& EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
   

  

* Five or more years of software development experience using agile methodology, with at least five years supporting legacy ERP and fulfillment software.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP domains including Order Management, Inventory Control, and Fulfillment — preferably within Microsoft Dynamics SL or comparable platforms.
* Proficiency with SQL Server stored procedures, query optimization, and troubleshooting SQL job or runtime errors.
* Experience writing production software in one or more of the following languages: C\#, Java, Go, or Python, with access to relational databases.
* Familiarity with GitHub or GitLab, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines; experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka, Pulsar, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or SQS is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of APIs, integration patterns, and batch\-driven workflows, with demonstrated ability to build wrapper services connecting legacy and modern systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to solve problems effectively under pressure across cross\-functional teams.


**Education**

**Installer cum Programmer – Home Automation**

**Department:** Projects / Technical  
**Job Location:** Delhi NCR  
**Experience:** 1–5 Years

**About the Role**

We are looking for an **Installer cum Programmer – Home Automation** who will be responsible for the **installation, wiring, configuration, programming, testing and commissioning of home automation systems** at residential and commercial project sites.

The candidate should have hands\-on experience in electrical/electronic installation and a good understanding of **KNX\-based automation systems**. The role requires both **site execution and programming skills**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Home Automation Installation**

* Install and configure home automation devices and equipment at project sites.
* Carry out installation of automation modules, sensors, actuators, touch panels, switches, dimmers and other automation products.
* Perform control panel and field\-device installation as per project requirements.
* Handle wiring, termination, labelling and cable management.
* Read and understand electrical drawings, wiring diagrams and automation layouts.
* Ensure proper installation of devices as per project specifications.

**2\. KNX Programming \& Configuration**

* Perform **KNX programming and configuration** for home automation projects.
* Configure KNX devices using **ETS software**.
* Create and configure group addresses and communication objects.
* Program lighting, dimming, curtain/blind control, HVAC and other automation functions.
* Configure scenes, schedules and automation logic as required.
* Download and commission KNX programs into field devices.
* Troubleshoot KNX communication and programming\-related issues.

**3\. Testing \& Commissioning**

* Test installed automation systems and verify proper functioning.
* Commission automation systems at project sites.
* Conduct point\-to\-point testing of devices.
* Identify and rectify wiring, communication and programming issues.
* Coordinate with Project Engineers and Project Managers during commissioning.
* Ensure the system is functioning according to the approved project requirements.

**4\. Site Execution**

* Visit client/project sites for installation, programming and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with electricians, contractors, Project Engineers and other site teams.
* Ensure work is completed within the project timeline.
* Maintain proper documentation of installation and commissioning activities.
* Report site issues, material requirements and project progress to the reporting manager.

**5\. Troubleshooting \& Support**

* Diagnose hardware, wiring, network and programming\-related issues.
* Provide technical support during installation and after commissioning.
* Attend site complaints related to automation systems.
* Identify the root cause of system failures and implement appropriate solutions.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Hands\-on experience in **Home Automation Installation**.
* Good knowledge of **KNX automation systems**.
* Practical experience with **KNX programming and ETS software**.
* Understanding of KNX topology and bus communication.
* Knowledge of electrical wiring and termination.
* Understanding of basic networking concepts such as IP addressing, switches and LAN connectivity.
* Ability to read electrical and automation drawings.
* Knowledge of sensors, actuators, relays, dimmers and automation controllers.
* Basic troubleshooting skills for electrical, networking and automation systems.
* Ability to use basic electrical testing tools and installation tools.

**Preferred Knowledge**

Experience with any of the following will be an advantage:

* KNX

description:
### **Software Engineer (C\+\+)**

**The Firm**
------------


Teesta Investment is a proprietary high\-frequency trading (HFT) and market\-making firm focused on global digital asset markets. We build automated trading systems that operate 24×7 across global crypto markets, where software, infrastructure, and quantitative research come together to make decisions in microseconds.


Unlike traditional software, trading systems operate under demanding constraints. Market data is continuous, latency directly influences outcomes, and every layer of the technology stack, from operating systems and networking to execution engines and infrastructure, contributes to performance. Building these systems requires engineers who enjoy solving difficult technical problems with precision and discipline.


At Teesta, engineers work alongside traders and quantitative researchers to design technology that is reliable, scalable, and built for production from day one. We believe great engineering comes from curiosity, ownership, and a relentless focus on continuous improvement.

**The Team**
------------


This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in our Kolkata or Mumbai office.


You'll join a small, highly technical engineering team responsible for developing the software that powers our trading platform. The team works closely with traders and quantitative researchers to build systems that process market data, execute trades, and support research across global digital asset markets.


We value engineers who are intellectually curious, enjoy working close to the hardware and operating system, and take pride in writing software that is efficient, reliable, and maintainable.

**The Role**
------------


Building software for high\-frequency trading is unlike building conventional applications.


Trading systems must process large volumes of real\-time market data, respond within extremely tight latency constraints, and remain reliable throughout constantly changing market conditions. Performance, correctness, and robustness are equally important, and even small engineering improvements can have a measurable impact.


As a Software Engineer, you'll contribute to the development of the core systems that power our trading platform. Working closely with experienced engineers, you'll build software that combines low\-level systems programming with modern software engineering practices.


Depending on your experience, your work may include:

* Designing, developing, testing, and maintaining high\-performance applications using modern C\+\+.
* Building components that process real\-time market data and support low\-latency trade execution.
* Applying data structures and algorithms to solve complex performance\-critical problems.
* Working with operating system concepts to improve application performance, efficiency, and reliability.
* Collaborating with senior engineers, traders, and quantitative researchers to design and implement robust technical solutions.
* Participating in code reviews and engineering discussions to improve software quality and share knowledge.
* Monitoring and troubleshooting production systems to maintain high availability and operational reliability.
* Exploring new technologies, development tools, and engineering practices that improve system performance and developer productivity.


This role offers the opportunity to work on technically challenging systems where engineering decisions have a direct impact on production performance.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


We're looking for engineers with strong computer science fundamentals and a passion for building high\-performance software.


You should have:

* 1 to 3 years of professional software development experience, preferably in high\-frequency trading, algorithmic trading, fintech, or another performance\-sensitive environment.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong proficiency in modern C\+\+ with experience writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity.
* Strong knowledge of computer architecture and how hardware and software interact.
* Good understanding of operating systems, including processes, threads, memory management, scheduling, and performance.
* Basic understanding of computer networking concepts and network protocols.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to continuously learn new technologies.


Experience in high\-frequency trading or cryptocurrency markets is beneficial but not essential. Exceptional software engineers with strong systems programming fundamentals and an eagerness to learn are encouraged to apply.

**Why Join Teesta?**
--------------------


Joining Teesta means working on software that directly powers our trading business.


You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, traders, and quantitative researchers to solve technically challenging problems, gain exposure to modern low\-latency systems, and develop software where performance and correctness matter every day.


As part of a small engineering team, you'll have meaningful ownership, opportunities to learn across the technology stack, and the chance to contribute to systems that operate at the limits of speed and reliability.

**Benefits**
------------

* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your dependants.
* Relocation assistance.
* Fitness and wellness reimbursement.
* Sponsorship for higher education and professional development.
* Fully stocked office with snacks and beverages.
* A collaborative, engineering\-first culture with high ownership and continuous learning.

title: Software Engineer II (Quality) - Core Commerce Platform

* Apply risk\-based testing to prioritise validation according to consumer impact, transaction risk and change complexity.
* 
* Build and maintain API, integration, and contract testing suites for OMS integrations with WMS, ERP, POS, payment providers, and 3PL/carrier systems.
* 
* Collaborate with the Product Owner, Lead Engineer and Software Engineers to understand requirements, identify test scenarios and execute the agreed testing approach.


**YOUR TALENT:**
* 
* 4\+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, test automation or software quality assurance, preferably within commerce, order management, inventory or supply\-chain platforms.
* 
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining automated tests for APIs, microservices and event\-driven systems.
* 
* Experience with Java and relevant automation frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, REST Assured, Selenium, Playwright or equivalent.
* 
* Experience with API, integration, contract and regression testing.
* 
* Understanding of inventory concepts such as availability, reservations, allocation, ATP or ATS.
* 
* Experience validating business\-rule\-driven workflows such as order promising, sourcing or fulfilment will be an advantage.
* 
* Understanding of concurrency and data\-consistency risks, with experience testing transactional or high\-volume systems.
* 
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and contributing to quality gates.
* 
* Experience with test\-data management, defect investigation and failure analysis.
* 
* Understanding of reliability, scalability, resilience and performance testing considerations for distributed systems.
* 
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted test generation, intelligent regression testing or AI\-native quality engineering practices.
* 
* Experience with cross\-browser or cross\-device testing tools such as BrowserStack or equivalent will be an advantage


 PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. description:

 ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self\-healing, self\-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. * Use testing tools and frameworks to assist with and streamline automation testing and reduce test cycles.

* Passion and curiosity.

* Ability to at least read Python code.

**YOUR MISSION:**
**About the Organisation \& Role:**
 You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence \& Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership \& loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI\-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data\-driven interactions across the consumer journey.
   

  

 As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will own quality strategy, test automation and test execution for personalisation and recommendation capabilities. You will work closely with Software Engineers, Tech Leads, Product Owners and Data Engineering teams to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle. Your focus will be building scalable automation, validating AI powered consumer experiences, improving engineering quality and enabling fast, reliable releases.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Define and drive quality strategy \& standards for personalisation, recommendation, experimentation, and consumer intelligence capabilities.
* Design, build and maintain automated test frameworks covering API, integration, contract, functional and E2E testing.
* Embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle by partnering closely with Software Engineers, Tech Leads, Product Owners and Data Engineering teams.
* Validate recommendation outputs, personalisation rules, consumer segmentation, experimentation journeys through automated \& manual test suite.
* Establish test data, test environments and quality validation approaches for personalised consumer journeys.
* Drive shift\-left quality practices through automation, quality gates, CI/CD integration and risk based testing.
* Ensure quality and consistency across browsers, devices, and digital consumer journeys.
* Leverage AI\-assisted quality engineering practices to improve test coverage, regression efficiency, defect detection and engineering productivity.
* Define quality metrics, test coverage goals and continuous improvement initiatives across the team.
* Coach engineers on test automation, quality practices and continuous improvement.


**YOUR TALENT:**
* 7\+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Strategy and Test Automation.
* Strong experience designing and scaling automation frameworks for modern digital platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, Appium, Selenium or equivalent automation frameworks.
* Strong experience in API, integration, contract, E2E, regression and release validation testing.
* Experience building automated quality pipelines integrated with CI/CD processes.
* Experience validating personalisation, recommendations and experimentation platforms.
* Experience with test data management, consumer segmentation and data quality validation.
* Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures and distributed systems.
* Experience validating recommendation outputs, business rules and consumer\-facing experiences.
* Experience with observability setup for quality engineering and production quality analytics preferred.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to influence engineering quality across multiple teams.
* Experience using coding agents, AI\-assisted testing tools or LLMs to improve testing productivity and quality outcomes.
* Experience in eCommerce, retail, consumer digital products, personalisation or recommendation platforms is strongly preferred.

description:
**Job Description**
**Position: Software Engineer II, Frontend** 
**Base Location: New Delhi** 
**Location:** 
 India (Remote / Hybrid)
 **Experience:** 
 4\+ years
   

  

**About Chegg Skills**
 As Chegg Skills engineers, our software empowers students to move from "learning" to "earning." We build the applications and systems that help students make life\-changing career transitions into high\-growth job opportunities. We take pride in making education accessible to motivated career switchers, and we build the technology that helps them achieve mastery and success.
   

  

 In this role, you will play a key role in a fully remote team of diverse, motivated engineers who are rethinking what education can look like. We serve thousands of students and educators every year, and your work will directly shape how those students learn and succeed.
   

  

 Chegg Skills is a growing division of Chegg focused on post\-collegiate learners. We are continuing to grow our engineering team to support business expansion as more students take the next step in their careers with Chegg. Join us and help scale the engineering foundation for our next phase of growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're hiring a Software Engineer II, Frontend to own the design, quality, and delivery of features across our student\- and educator\-facing web applications. This role is focused on building React/Next.js product experiences, the GraphQL\-powered data layers behind them, and increasingly, AI\-powered learning features. You will also contribute across the stack as needed — this is a frontend\-first role with full\-stack reach, and you should be comfortable enough with backend concepts and AWS infrastructure to ramp into our Kotlin/Java or Python backend services when a task calls for it.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own frontend features end\-to\-end — architecture, implementation, testing, staged rollout, and production monitoring — across our student and educator web applications.
* Translate product requirements into component architecture, GraphQL query/schema boundaries, and client\-state contracts (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar) that other engineers build on.
* Debug cross\-system issues that surface in the UI — GraphQL supergraph errors, auth/session edge cases, server/client rendering mismatches — by tracing root cause across the stack.
* Build AI\-powered learning features responsibly: validate model output before it reaches the UI, design graceful fallbacks for unusable responses, and instrument these flows with telemetry.
* Apply security and data\-protection practices — input validation, secure auth/session handling, careful treatment of user data — as a default part of the code you ship, not a step someone else checks for.
* Optimize application performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals) as an ongoing part of feature work.
* Own the quality of your changes through automated tests (unit, component, and end\-to\-end), CI stability, and production validation.
* Partner closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Content Operations to deliver and harden high\-impact learner and educator workflows.
* Contribute to engineering quality through strong code reviews — including review of AI\-generated code — reusable patterns, shared components, and clear documentation that keeps technical debt low.
* Ship end\-to\-end changes across the web application and its supporting APIs/schema, as needed.


**Required Qualifications**
* Most qualified candidates will likely bring 4\+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production web applications, with demonstrated ownership of features from design through launch.
* Strong hands\-on experience with React and Next.js, and comfort working in TypeScript.
* Working knowledge of web fundamentals — common security pitfalls (XSS, CSRF, auth/session handling), performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals), and accessibility (WCAG/ARIA basics) — and the judgment to apply them without being told to.
* Experience designing and consuming APIs across common paradigms — GraphQL (schema design, codegen, querying), REST, and real\-time protocols such as WebSockets — and working with at least one modern client\-state approach (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar).
* Strong testing and release\-validation discipline — unit/component testing (Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library) and end\-to\-end testing (Playwright or Cypress).
* Comfort using AI\-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, validate, and safely ship the code you produce.
* Sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, and general software design principles, applied pragmatically rather than academically.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with a CSS\-in\-JS styling approach and working alongside a component library (e.g., MUI).
* Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, basic service architecture) and some Node.js backend exposure — enough of a foundation to ramp into our Kotlin/Java or Python backend services when needed, even without prior production experience in those languages.
* Experience with Auth0 or similar authentication providers in a Next.js application.
* Experience shipping AI\-powered UI — streaming responses, structured output rendering, graceful handling of model failures.
* Experience contributing to shared component libraries or tooling used across multiple teams/repos.
* Familiarity with frontend observability tooling (New Relic or similar).
* Experience in EdTech, e\-commerce, or another consumer\-facing product company.


**Tech Stack**
* Frontend: React (18/19\), Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo tooling, codegen against a shared supergraph), React Query / Redux Toolkit / Zustand, styled\-components, MUI
* Backend (foundational): Node.js, AWS (compute/storage/networking basics) — enough to ramp into Kotlin/Java (Spring) or Python (FastAPI/Django) services owned by backend engineering
* Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, MSW
* Auth / Delivery: Auth0, GitLab CI
* Observability: New Relic
* AI / ML: OpenAI, AWS Bedrock (via shared backend integrations)


 Why do we exist?
   

  

 Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we’ve expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student.

**About the role:**

A Software Engineer III is an individual contributor who delivers production\-quality software for well\-defined components or features within a product or service. They work with guidance from senior engineers to translate requirements into maintainable, secure, and reliable systems that support customer and business outcomes. They are developing deeper knowledge of the systems within their team and contribute to engineering quality, operational health, and team collaboration while continuing to build their technical expertise.

description:

You'll learn fast, work directly with senior engineers, and grow from executing well-defined tasks into owning small pieces of infrastructure independently. The Role at a Glance Be the local IT point of contact for the Lisbon office - onboarding, hardware, and everyday support. Learn and apply core SRE practices - scripting, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure - under the guidance of senior engineers. Split your time between hands-on specialist work and hands-on engineering work; grow into more of the latter over time. Build a foundation in Linux, AWS, and automation that sets up a long-term engineering career path. What You'll Do & the Impact You'll Own Measured by growth and reliability, not tenure - within 6-12 months Own IT specialist duties for the Lisbon office: Handle new-hire onboarding end to end - hardware provisioning, account setup, workstation configuration, and welcome/orientation support - so new colleagues are productive from day one. Keep the local office running: Support workstations, conference rooms, and A/V equipment; manage local IT inventory and procurement; act as the first point of contact when something in the office isn't working. Provide day-to-day technical support: Troubleshoot common issues - login problems, device setup, network connectivity, basic Linux/Windows/macOS issues - and know when to escalate to the broader distributed team. Learn and contribute to automation: Write and maintain simple scripts and Ansible playbooks under guidance to reduce repetitive manual work; progressively take on larger pieces of automation as your skills grow. Support CI/CD and cloud infrastructure: Get hands-on with GitLab pipelines and AWS building blocks (IAM, EC2, basic networking) by shadowing and then assisting senior engineers on real infrastructure tasks. Build strong fundamentals: Develop working knowledge of Linux systems administration, version control, and cloud basics through real tickets and projects, not just documentation. Document and communicate clearly: Keep clear records of issues and fixes so recurring problems get solved once, not repeatedly; communicate status and blockers proactively to the wider (mostly remote) team. What You'll Need Experience: 0-2 years in an IT support, systems administration, or junior engineering role (internships and academic projects count). Linux fundamentals: Comfortable in a Linux/Unix environment - command line, file permissions, basic networking, and troubleshooting common issues. Scripting: Working knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar) and eagerness to write more of it. IT support mindset: Comfortable being hands-on with hardware and being the local face of IT - patient, clear communicator, good with people who arent technical. Cloud curiosity: Basic familiarity with a cloud platform (AWS preferred) and genuine interest in learning infrastructure and automation - formal production experience not required. Ownership and reliability: Able to work independently as the only (or one of very few) on-site technical resource, while staying closely connected to a distributed, remote-first team. Language: Fluent English (written and spoken); Portuguese is a plus for local vendor and office coordination. Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered. Nice to Have Exposure to configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef). Familiarity with Git and CI/CD concepts (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar). Coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving AWS (Cloud Practitioner or higher). Prior experience in a hardware/device support or IT helpdesk role.

title: Senior Software Engineer - VOIP / SIP
description:
About the Company
 



 Practice by Numbers (PbN) is building medical AI SaaS for the U.S. dental market—software that helps dental teams run smoother, grow revenue, and improve patient experience. The platform unifies analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation into a single system, replacing scattered tools and manual workflows trusted by thousands of practices across North America.
 



 PbN is mission\-driven and execution\-oriented: high ownership, tight cross\-functional collaboration, and product work with clear, measurable impact. You'll get real autonomy and see direct results in a large, under\-digitized healthcare vertical that's actively moving toward AI\-first workflows.
 



  





 Position Overview
 



 This role owns the design and implementation of PbN's core VoIP/SIP telephony backbone—the infrastructure layer that powers calling, routing, and communication workflows for thousands of dental practices. You will architect and build carrier\-grade SIP services in Golang on top of open\-source components, and integrate the telephony stack with PbN's broader AI\-first SaaS platform. The role reports to the Engineering India Head and sits at the intersection of deep infrastructure work and product\-facing impact.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 


* Design and implement a carrier\-grade SIP/VoIP core using Kamailio or OpenSIPS for SIP signaling and FreeSWITCH or similar for media and application services.
* Build Golang\-based SIP services—registrar, SBC\-like components, routing logic, monitoring daemons—and internal APIs to control routing, policies, and provisioning.
* Configure and operate SIP load balancing, failover, and high\-availability setups across multi\-node SIP proxies, distributed media servers, and RTP proxies.
* Implement and maintain dial plans, least\-cost routing, DID management, class\-4/class\-5 switching logic, and integrations with upstream carriers and PSTN gateways.
* Own security and robustness of the VoIP stack: TLS/SRTP, authentication, rate limiting, fraud detection hooks, and abuse controls.
* Integrate the telephony backbone with PbN's SaaS platform via well\-defined internal APIs and webhooks, covering user accounts, billing, analytics, and AI/automation flows.
* Define and own monitoring, alerting, logging, and capacity planning for SIP signaling, RTP/media, and VoIP quality metrics (MOS, jitter, packet loss).



  





 Must\-Have Requirements
 


* 7–10 years of software development experience with at least 4–5 years building or operating large\-scale VoIP/SIP systems in production.
* Strong Golang skills including high\-performance networked services, concurrent processing, and production\-grade APIs.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one open\-source SIP server—Kamailio, OpenSIPS, or Asterisk—including configuration, routing logic, and packet\-level troubleshooting.
* Deep understanding of SIP, RTP, SDP, NAT traversal, registrar/registration flows, B2BUA vs. proxy behavior, and SBC concepts.
* Proven ability to design and operate highly available telephony backbones: clustering, health checks, load balancing, and graceful failover.
* Strong Linux and networking fundamentals—iptables, firewalls, TCP/UDP, QoS—with comfort debugging at packet level using tcpdump or Wireshark.
* Experience integrating VoIP platforms with RESTful backends and databases (PostgreSQL or MariaDB/MySQL) and message queues for control and billing workflows.



  





 Nice to Have
 


* Experience with WebRTC, SIP over WebSockets, and browser or mobile softphone integrations.
* Familiarity with VoIP billing, rating engines, CDR processing, and reseller hierarchies (class\-4/class\-5 softswitch products or similar).
* Cloud\-native deployment of VoIP stacks—containerized Kamailio or FreeSWITCH clusters on AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, service meshes.
* Prior work building call center or CPaaS\-style platforms including programmable IVRs, call queues, and analytics.



  





 What We Offer
 


* End\-to\-end ownership of a mission\-critical infrastructure layer powering thousands of live dental practices across North America.
* Direct exposure to AI\-first product evolution—conversational automation, intelligent call routing, and front\-office workflow integration.
* High\-autonomy environment with tight cross\-functional collaboration across product, engineering, and operations.
* Competitive compensation commensurate with senior infrastructure expertise.
* Flexible scheduling within a fast\-moving, execution\-oriented team with real measurable impact.

title: Integration Developer
description:
**We're Hiring: Integration Developer** 




  





**📍 Ahmedabad, Gujarat — full\-time, on\-site \| 💼 0–2 Years** 




  





 Every system in the world is trying to talk to another one. Someone has to make that conversation happen.
 



 That's what we do. We build the integrations that let businesses and services across the UK, Ireland and beyond actually work — data moving cleanly between systems that were never designed to meet.
 



 We're looking for someone at the start of their career to come and learn how to do it properly.

**You'll break things in test. You'll fix them. That's how this works.** 




  





**What you bring** 



* Solid Java fundamentals — the rest we'll teach you

 Degree in CS, IT or Engineering — or you've taught yourself and can show us what you've built. Both count.
 



  





**🤖 AI\-friendly? That's a real advantage here.** 




 We're not precious about it. If you use AI tools to learn faster, debug smarter and write better code — and you understand what the code is doing rather than just pasting it — that's exactly the mindset we want. Bring it.
 



  





**Bonus, not blockers** 



* Apache Camel
* Spring Boot
* Docker
* Kafka
* Any cloud platform
* a GitHub with something interesting on it



  





**Why this one** 




 Real projects, not training exercises. Senior developers who'll actually sit with you — which is why this role is on\-site in Ahmedabad, five days a week. You learn this craft by turning to the person next to you, not by messaging them.
 



  





 A clear route to mid\-level and beyond. Competitive salary based on your experience. And a team where asking questions is the job, not an interruption.
 



  





 You'll know more in six months here than in two years somewhere that keeps you on maintenance tickets.
 



  





**📩 Interested?** 




**CV to** 
**careers@itouchvision.com**

* Effective communication and collaboration skills; ability to work as part of a team.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist or Certified Application Developer (preferred but not required for entry).
* Adaptable, detail\-oriented, and motivated to learn new ServiceNow and Gen AI/automation features as they emerge.


**Good to have skillset Preferred:**

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**
 As a Staff Software Engineer on the Care Interactions team, you will shape and build the systems that enable Hinge Health’s care teams to communicate with members and deliver personalized musculoskeletal care at scale. Care Interactions is part of CareHub, Hinge Health’s internal care\-delivery platform used by physical therapists, health coaches, physicians, care managers, and other clinical teams.
   

  

 The team owns core communication and care\-delivery capabilities, including in\-app messaging, video visits, scheduling\-related experiences, clinical notes, care plans, and the CareHub interaction record used for coordinated care. You will provide technical leadership across these complex, workflow\-heavy domains, helping the team build reliable, secure, and intuitive products that reduce fragmented tools and repetitive administrative work so care team members can focus on clinical judgment and member connection.
   

  

 CareHub is evolving toward an AI\-first platform. In this role, you may help build AI\-assisted capabilities for visit preparation, documentation, summarization, contextual recommendations, and follow\-up workflows. You will contribute to systems that are clinically useful, observable, resilient, and safe, with appropriate human oversight for decisions that affect care delivery.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and other engineering teams to take problems from discovery through production. This is an opportunity to work on high\-impact, workflow\-heavy products where thoughtful technical decisions can improve care\-team efficiency, member experience, and Hinge Health’s ability to deliver care at scale.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership.
   

  

**What You'll Accomplish**
* Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories.
* Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents.
* Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short\-term and long\-term trade\-offs.
* Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real\-time pairing.
* Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health’s AI\-driven care platform.
* Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team’s features, and contribute to the team’s overall architecture and developer tooling.
* Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non\-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference.


**Hinge Health Hybrid Model**
 We believe that remote work and in\-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.
   

  

**This is a Bengaluru\-based role** 
 that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.
   

  

* Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).
* Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am \- 6pm PT).


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
* 10\+ years of non\-internship full time professional software development experience
* 4\+ years of experience with at least one software programming language
* 4\+ years of experience in the full software development life cycle
* 3\+ years of work experience with react JS and Node JS/ Typescript
* 1\+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision\-making
* Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, LangChain, LangGraph
* Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment.
* Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* A platform\-as\-product mindset: understanding internal users and consumers, defining clear contracts, improving developer experience and adoption, and measuring platform outcomes.
* Strong backend and distributed\-systems fundamentals, including latency, throughput, availability, capacity, backpressure, consistency, resilience, and failure\-mode analysis.
* Experience integrating large language models or generative AI services into production workflows with appropriate evals, validation, observability, and failure handling.
* Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service\-health metrics, alerting, on\-call practices, incident response, and root\-cause analysis to improve reliability.
* Experience improving observability through metrics, structured logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with practical knowledge of cache design and invalidation, database performance KPIs, query and index tuning, connection pools, and capacity management
* Experience with headless CMS integrations, webhook\-driven systems, vendor adapters, content delivery networks, or publishing pipelines.
* Experience with durable workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal, or comparable workflow technology.
* Experience with media processing tools such as ffmpeg, adaptive bitrate video, text\-to\-speech, speech\-to\-text, or caption formats such as WebVTT.
* Experience with event streaming, such as Kafka, and CI/CD automation, such as GitHub Actions.
* Experience working in healthcare, privacy\-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high\-trust environments.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers or serving as a technical lead for a platform, migration, or cross\-functional launch.


**About Hinge Health**
 At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1\.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI\-powered human\-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting\-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post\-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence\-based care.
   

  

 As the preferred partner to 50\+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com/
   

  

**What You'll Love About Us**
* Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).
* Well\-being \& Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well\-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.
* Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.


**Culture \& Engagement**
 Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.
   

  

 By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy.
   

  

 Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.
