 Enviri GSC handles a wide range of services, including finance and accounting shared services, global HR shared services, providing IT services and helpdesk support, and market research support to Harsco globally. We have been operating since 2008 \& serving 30\+ Countries
 



  





**Job Description \-** 
 We are seeking a hands\-on SeniorDigital Developer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with modern AI\-assisted development practices. The role will design, build, modernize, and support enterprise applications using .NET 8\+, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, Angular, SQL Server, and Azure. The successful candidate will use GitHub Copilot and approved AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery while remaining accountable for correctness, security, maintainability, testing, and business outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Full\-Stack Engineering:** 
 Architect and implement scalable backend services using C\#, .NET 8\+, ASP.NET Core, and EF Core, together with responsive Angular applications using TypeScript, Angular Material, HTML, and SCSS.
* **Solution Design:** 
 Translate business requirements into maintainable technical designs, APIs, data models, integrations, and reusable components. Contribute to architecture reviews and document key decisions and trade\-offs.
* **AI\-Assisted Development:** 
 Use GitHub Copilot and other approved AI tools for code exploration, scaffolding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, documentation, and development planning. Write clear prompts and provide relevant context to improve output quality.
* **Human Validation:** 
 Critically review AI\-generated code and recommendations. Verify logic, licensing considerations, security, performance, accessibility, test coverage, and alignment with coding standards before adoption.
* **Cloud Engineering:** 
 Build and support secure Azure solutions using services such as App Service, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Storage, Functions, Logic Apps, Application Insights, and managed identities where appropriate.
* **Database Engineering:** 
 Design and optimize SQL Server data models, queries, stored procedures, indexes, and EF Core mappings, migrations, and Fluent API configurations.
* **Quality Engineering:** 
 Develop unit, integration, and frontend tests. Use automation and AI assistance to improve coverage while ensuring tests validate meaningful behavior and edge cases.
* **DevOps \& Automation:** 
 Manage Git and GitHub workflows, pull requests, branching, reviews, and CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions. Support repeatable deployments across environments.
* **Production Reliability:** 
 Troubleshoot defects and performance issues using logs, telemetry, profiling, and root\-cause analysis. Improve observability and preventive controls following incidents.
* **Technical Leadership:** 
 Mentor juniors, lead design discussions, provide constructive code\-review feedback, share effective AI\-assisted practices, and promote continuous improvement.



  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 



* 8\-12 years of hands\-on software development experience, with strong recent experience delivering enterprise web applications.
* Advanced C\# and .NET experience, including ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, security, error handling, and performance optimization.
* Strong Angular and TypeScript experience, including component design, reactive programming, forms, routing, state management, performance, and reusable UI patterns.
* Strong SQL Server and EF Core experience covering schema design, query tuning, indexing, transactions, migrations, concurrency, and troubleshooting.
* Practical Azure development experience with secure configuration, monitoring, diagnostics, and cloud deployment patterns.
* Experience with GitHub, pull requests, code reviews, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and automated quality checks.
* Hands\-on use of GitHub Copilot or comparable AI\-assisted programming tools within day\-to\-day software delivery.
* Ability to assess AI\-assisted output for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and suitability before adoption.
* Experience integrating Azure OpenAI or other approved AI services into enterprise applications or building AI\-enabled business features.
* Understanding of responsible AI, privacy, security, transparency, human oversight, and governance.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, communication, collaboration, ownership, and stakeholder\-management skills



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 
 \- You are a pragmatic senior engineer who remains hands\-on while influencing design and delivery. You are comfortable using AI as an engineering accelerator, but you understand that accountability stays with the developer. You can explain technical decisions clearly, challenge weak assumptions, support colleagues, and deliver secure, maintainable solutions in a collaborative enterprise environment.

* Understanding of EVM basics and how smart contracts interact with the chain
* Familiarity with Git and version control workflows
* Strong communication skills and ability to work in a small, fast\-moving startup team
* Curiosity about financial markets, trading systems, or decentralized finance
* Comfortable with ambiguity and iterative development in a growing product

* Personal projects or GitHub contributions involving smart contracts (even testnet deployments)
* Exposure to Hardhat, Foundry, Truffle, or Remix
* Basic understanding of DeFi concepts (AMMs, liquidity pools, DEXs)
* Familiarity with React/Next.js for dApp frontends
* Coursework or certifications in blockchain development

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

1. Primary evaluation will be executed through comprehensive, hands\-on programming assessments on the day of interview.
2. A formal code review followed by a rigorous technical discussion regarding the submitted codebase will be conducted.
3. A week\-long practical assessment involving a specific development assignment will be administered to evaluate candidate performance.



  





 Only final year students who can contribute full time will be considered for internship opportunities. Academic records and outstanding backlogs will not influence the selection process. Advancement in the evaluation process is contingent upon the successful demonstration of fundamental hands\-on programming skills.

* Mentor junior engineers and help them grow their technical skills while contributing to a supportive team culture that adopts company values.


**Design \& Development**
* Design small systems or processes with collaborative support, making design choices that prioritize long\-term maintainability and scalability
* Actively participate in design reviews and improvement efforts, anticipating how your work affects upstream and downstream systems.
* Take ownership of the reliability of your deliverables and ensure quality and efficiency in your own work while supporting others to do the same.


**Quality \& Operations**
* Plan and execute validation for your systems, ensuring repeatable and traceable practices while understanding common failure points.
* Plan and execute validation for systems, utilizing repeatable and traceable practices to monitor performance and mitigate potential security or operational risks.
* Understand testing coverage and common failure points, contributing to documentation to ensure the team learns from every incident.
* Identify recurring operational issues (e.g., latency, throughput bottlenecks) and propose improvements to our cloud\-native environment.


**Tech Stack:** 
 RUST, RESTful APIs, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Cloud native
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Experience: 5\-8 years of professional software development experience.
* Domain Knowledge: A deep understanding of the business, user needs, and the technical landscape. You can learn new business logic efficiently and mentor others on our systems and practices.
* Impact \& Ownership: You take ownership of your projects, solve problems independently, and have a thorough understanding of the product. You actively participate in production, review others' contributions, and have informed opinions on strategic decisions.
* Strategic Mindset: You think beyond immediate tasks, using data and insights to weigh trade\-offs and align decisions with long\-term goals.
* Security Focus: You have a deep understanding of security, how it affects your domain, and experience with risk assessments and mitigations.
* Team Growth: A passion for growing your team and helping them contribute to their goals.

* Experience with DevOps practices: Continuous integration / continuous deployment (CI/CD), containerization (Docker,) and orchestration (k8s).
* Rust Expertise: Deep professional experience building and scaling applications using Rust.
* Cloud Native Background: Proven track record migrating applications from on\-prem to cloud (AWS, Kubernetes, or similar tools).


**Preferred Skills**
* Previous experience with billing, financial systems, or high\-volume payment gateways.
* Experience in a formal or informal technical leadership role (Team Lead or Lead Engineer).

 Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision\-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data\-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

 Senior Software Engineer – Microservices and Data Pipelines, driving enterprise\-grade data services and. We are looking for hands\-on, self\-driven people who are ready to explore and learn different technologies and languages to get things done. People who have previous experience with writing high through put micro services, large scale datasets/databases, ETL pipelines, Data engineering, connector frameworks with strong Python, data management, and compliance\-minded delivery at scale would be a good fit for this position.

* Proven microservices experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and event\-driven patterns using message brokers or streaming platforms
* Robust SQL skills integrating with analytics warehouses such as Snowflake, including cost/performance tuning patterns

**Preferred Qualification** 



* Experience in leveraging Apache Spark for efficient processing and management of large\-scale distributed data workloads

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Bangalore, India
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.



Over 50 million people use Speechify's text\-to\-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text\-to\-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.


Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.


**Overview**



The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.



This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast\-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.



We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.



Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.


**What Yo****u'****ll Do**


* Design, develop, and maintain robust APIs including public TTS API, internal APIs like Payment, Subscription, Auth and Consumption Tracking, ensuring they meet business and scalability requirements
* Oversee the full backend API landscape, enhancing and optimizing for performance and maintainability
* Collaborate on B2B solutions, focusing on customization and integration needs for enterprise clients
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience


**An Ideal Candidate Should Have**


* Proven experience in backend development: TS/Node (required)
* Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
* Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
* Preferred: Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
* Preferred: Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes


**What We Offer**

* A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
* A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
* Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
* The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
* Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
* The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
* An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain


**Think you're a good fit for this job?**



Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
  

And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.


**Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?**



Refer them!


**Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.**



Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Core Experiences - Bangalore, India
description:
**Mission**


**Speechify is the easiest way to listen to the world's information.** Articles on the web, documents in the cloud, books on your phone. We absorb it all and let you listen to it at your desk, on the go, at your own speed, and with tools that make learning easier, deeper, and faster.



What streaming services have done for audio entertainment, we're doing for audio information. And whatever we're doing seems to be working. We're \#1 in our category, and experiencing exponential growth.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Core Experiences Team. This team builds and maintains the foundational services and SDKs that power Speechify's product experience across platforms. * Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Role \- Senior Software Engineer** 




**Location: Chennai** 




  





**Want to revolutionise fruit trade in the world?** 




 At Vegrow, we are using technology to transform one of the world's most complex and fragmented agricultural supply chains.
 



 We are building technology across the entire fruit journey — from how we source and move produce to how we monitor, inspect, pack and deliver it. Our engineering teams work across
 **scalable software systems, automation, AI and computer vision** 
 to solve real\-world problems at scale.
 



  





 One of the areas we are actively building is
 **AI\-powered voice automation for our supply operations** 
 . We are building voice agents that can interact with our supply network at scale, automate calling workflows and improve the way we engage with our partners. We are also exploring technologies such as
 **reinforcement learning to make these calling campaigns increasingly intelligent and adaptive** 
 .
 



  





 Alongside this, our broader technology organisation is building computer vision systems for
 **fruit inspection, defect detection, movement monitoring, packing and multi\-object tracking** 
 . These are examples of the kinds of challenging technology problems being solved across Vegrow.
 



 For this role, however,
 **the focus is primarily on building robust software systems and voice\-based applications** 
 . You will work as a hands\-on Senior Software Developer, owning problems end\-to\-end and contributing to the design, development and scaling of the systems that power these products.
 



  





 You do
 **not** 
 need prior experience building voice agents or working with AI. What matters most is strong software engineering fundamentals, the ability to solve complex problems, and the curiosity to learn and work with new technologies. Experience with voice, conversational AI, LLMs or related technologies is a plus.
 



  





**Who are we looking for?** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Senior Software Developer** 
 with 4–5 years of experience who enjoys building production\-grade software and solving challenging technical problems.
 



 You should be comfortable taking ownership of a problem — understanding the requirements, designing a solution, writing clean and maintainable code, testing it, taking it to production and improving it over time.
 



 You will work closely with product, design, QA and business teams, while also contributing to technical design and engineering decisions.
 



  





**Key Role Contours** 



* Design, develop and maintain scalable, reliable and high\-performance software systems.
* Own technically challenging projects from design through development, testing, deployment and production support.
* Contribute to system design, architecture and technical decisions.
* Understand system dependencies, limitations and performance bottlenecks, and design solutions that can scale.
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested and production\-ready code.
* Debug complex technical issues and improve system performance, reliability and maintainability.
* Participate actively in code reviews and help maintain strong engineering standards.
* Work closely with product, design, QA and business teams to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Break down ambiguous problems into well\-defined engineering tasks and provide reasonable estimates and implementation plans.
* Build prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts where required to validate technical feasibility and reduce risks.
* Document important technical decisions, system designs and engineering practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, engineering processes and system reliability.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through code reviews, technical discussions and hands\-on collaboration.
* Stay current with relevant technologies and continuously improve engineering practices.



  





**Voice \& AI Applications** 




 A key area of this role will be the opportunity to work on
 **voice automation and conversational applications** 
 as part of Vegrow's evolving technology stack.
 


* Prior experience building voice agents is a
 **nice\-to\-have, not a requirement** 
 .
* Experience with LLMs, conversational AI, speech technologies, APIs or AI\-powered applications is a plus.
* You may work on building and scaling voice agents and the backend systems that support them.
* You will have the opportunity to learn and work with emerging technologies as these products evolve.



  





**Success Profile** 



* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **4–5 years of professional software development experience.**
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages and modern software development technologies.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented programming and software engineering principles.
* Good understanding of system design, APIs, databases and building scalable backend systems.
* Experience building and operating production\-grade applications.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring or production systems is a plus.
* Understanding of performance, reliability and observability is desirable.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to take ownership and make sound technical decisions independently.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and work in a fast\-moving environment.



  





**What makes this role exciting?** 




 You will be solving
 **real\-world engineering problems at the intersection of software, automation and AI** 
 , with a direct impact on how fruit moves through India's supply chain.
 



 You will get the opportunity to build systems that interact with people and operations at scale — including
 **voice agents and automation systems** 
 — while working alongside teams building some of Vegrow's broader AI and computer vision capabilities.

description:
About us:

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.
What you'll do:

Viasat is developing a 3GPP NTN standards\-based Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Network to support standard based devices across key use cases such as Direct to Device, Automobile and UAVs.

  

RAN Apps team is responsible for the development of an ecosystem of AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent applications to configure, monitor and optimize the performance of Viasat’s LEO based satellite network especially that of the RAN subsystem in it, and integrate the ecosystem with the complete satellite ground network. These applications interface with various components of O\-RAN based NTN network – RU, DU, CU, RIC, SMO etc.

  

Team member responsibilities are end\-to\-end ownership of one or more intelligent RAN applications, from requirements refining to design, development and system integration.

  

This is a site‑based role, employees work 3\+ days (60%\+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day workweek.


The day\-to\-day:
* Refine initial requirements through brainstorming with peers in the team and external stakeholders.
* Develop Architecture and Design for AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent RAN applications utilizing O\-RAN framework, system performance, scalability and maintainability aspects.
* Develop test plans covering configuration, performance, stability, interoperability
* Implement the design with the support of AI productivity tools
* Test the applications at various level – unit, module, subsystem, system
* Integration with other network components (DU, CU, RIC, SMO)
* Maintain and automate CI/CD pipelines for build/testing/deployments
* Support production \& lab environments aligned with team’s responsibility
* Update and maintain existing production applications and networks


What you'll need:
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent
* 6\-10 years of hands\-on experience building and operating large\-scale cloud\-native, microservices\-based, event\-driven, distributed applications.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, fault tolerance, high availability, resiliency, consistency models, eventual consistency, and idempotent processing.
* Experience designing data\-intensive systems using relational and NoSQL databases.
* Deep understanding of event\-driven architectures, including asynchronous messaging, event streaming, pub/sub patterns, and event sourcing concepts.
* Strong experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and service\-to\-service communication patterns in distributed environments.
* Proven ability to build highly reliable and observable production systems, including monitoring, logging, tracing, disaster recovery, and incident resolution.
* Good understanding of Terrestrial and/or Satellite wireless system, SMO and RIC frameworks

  

Technical Expertise:

* Strong programming skills preferably in Golang or Python
* Containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
* API design and integration, including REST APIs, API versioning, backward compatibility, contract\-first development, API gateways, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and resiliency patterns.
* Event streaming and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Google Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, or equivalent.
* Public cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS.
* CI/CD and DevOps tooling, including GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Deployment automation using Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, CloudFormation or similar.

title: Developer Senior Specialist - WebOps - Web Routing & DNS
description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

**Role Overview**
 In this role, you will manage our web routing infrastructure, designing secure redirect strategies and domain mapping systems to ensure seamless traffic flow. You will be responsible for safely refactoring legacy codebases with zero downtime, troubleshooting complex network issues, and maintaining high engineering standards through clean, well\-documented code.
   

  

**Position Responsibilities**
* Architect and Execute Web Redirects: Design, implement, test, and manage web redirect strategies and routing rules. Ensure all configurations are optimized for seamless user transitions, minimal latency, and zero disruption to live traffic.
* Manage and Refactor Legacy Codebases: Comfortably navigate, analyze, and maintain legacy codebases. Safely modify environment variables, deployment configurations, and data serialization files as required to support infrastructure updates without breaking existing builds or production environments.
* Maintain High\-Quality Engineering Standards: Write clean, well\-documented, and highly testable code.
* Monitor and Troubleshoot Traffic Flow: Analyze server behavior, traffic patterns, and routing logs to diagnose and resolve complex redirection loops, broken links, or configuration anomalies that impact the user experience.
* Set Up and Manage Domain Mapping: Configure and maintain domain mapping systems to link custom domains, subdomains, and short URLs to web applications and CDNs.
* Manage Network Traffic and Routing: Oversee web request routing to ensure paths are secure, reliable, and fast across server networks.
* Update Older Configurations: Review and update existing codebases, configuration files, and deployment scripts to align routing setups without breaking live production systems.
* Keep Documentation Up to Date: Write clear configuration code and technical documentation for the team.
* Troubleshoot Routing Issues: Diagnose and fix common and edge\-case network issues, such as DNS propagation delays, SSL/TLS handshake errors, and certificate mismatches.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Professional Experience: 6\+ years of relevant technical experience working with web infrastructure, backend engineering, or systems operations.
* Deep Web Architecture Mastery: Complete, comprehensive understanding of modern web architecture, including client\-server models, the HTTP request/response lifecycle, DNS management, and content delivery networks (CDNs).
* Strong Backend Core Competency: Solid backend engineering knowledge necessary to execute, troubleshoot, and optimize complex server\-side redirect systems, proxy configurations, and underlying application logic.
* Expertise in HTTP \& Site Headers: Advanced understanding of HTTP site headers, including caching controls, security headers, routing protocols, and HTTP status codes (e.g., 301, 302, 404\), and how they influence browser behavior and search engine indexing.
* Strong Knowledge of DNS: Understanding of DNS management, including configuring standard records (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, NS) and managing domain registrars.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

* We support your family with gender\-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth\-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums

description:

------------------

This is an AI\-first position — you’ll be expected to approach every problem with an AI\-native mindset, exploring agent\-based solutions before falling back to traditional approaches.

------------------------

* Build and maintain AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar agentic toolkits.

* Integrate AI agents with third\-party services (databases, messaging platforms, REST APIs, etc.).
* Monitor and debug agent behavior in production, identifying failure modes and improving reliability.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and product teams to define agent capabilities and scope.

---------------------------

* 2\-3 years of software engineering experience; hands\-on AI/agent projects (personal, academic, or professional) are equally valued.

* Fluent with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) — skilled at providing clear context to get production\-quality output, and able to critically review, debug, and refactor AI\-generated code (your own and teammates’) rather than accepting it blindly.
* Strong code ownership — you understand and can explain every line of code you submit, regardless of how it was generated, and follow secure coding practices.
* Comfort working with REST APIs, JSON, and version control (Git).
* Actively experiments with new AI coding workflows and shares learnings with the team.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack).
* Exposure to vector databases or semantic search for agent memory/retrieval.
* Familiarity with workflow automation tools (n8n, Zapier, Airflow).
* Knowledge of both Golang and Python.
* Any personal AI projects, bots, or automation tools you’ve shipped.

* Experience building reliable, scalable, maintainable and production\-grade backend services.

title: Software Engineer, Business Systems
description:
**Function:** 
 Business Technology \& Security — Business Systems
   

  

**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

* Hybrid


**Reports to:** 
 Product Manager, Business Systems
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–4 years
   

  

**Short Description**
 Build and run the integrations, pipelines, automations and internal tools that connect Mindtickle's business systems — Salesforce, NetSuite, HRMS, Slack and Google Cloud. You take defined requirements and own the technical path end to end: design, build, ship, and keep it running.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Business Technology \& Security runs the systems, automation and security behind how Mindtickle operates.
 **Business Systems** 
 is its build engine — the team that turns requirements from GTM, Finance, People Success, IT, Legal and Security into shipped systems: integrations, data pipelines, automations, internal tools and agents.
   

  

 We are a small team. You will not be part of a traditional engineering squad with sprints and Scrum ceremonies. You will operate independently, usually owning a problem from a defined requirement through to a deployed, monitored solution — and then continuing to own it.
   

  

**The role**
 You are the engineer on the team. When a system needs to talk to another system, when a manual process needs to become an automated one, when a tool needs to exist and doesn't — you build it.
   

  

 Requirements come to you defined. The Product Manager and Business Systems Analyst own the business problem, the stakeholders, and the question of whether we should do it at all.
 **The technical path is entirely yours** 
 — how it's designed, what it's built on, how it's tested, how it fails safely, and how it's supported once it's live.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
**Building — about half your time** 
 Integrations between business systems. Data pipelines. Automations that remove manual work from Finance, People Success, IT, Security and GTM. Internal tools and lightweight services. AI\-backed workflows and agents where they are the right answer, and conventional code where they are not.
   

  

**Running it — about a fifth of your time** 
 You inherit a set of automations already in production and become their owner. Monitoring, alerting, incident response, and the unglamorous work of making inherited systems observable and documented. Nothing you build gets handed to someone else to support.
   

  

**Technical evaluation — about 15%** 
 When the team is deciding whether to build or buy, or whether a vendor's API can actually do what the demo claimed, you build the prototype that answers it. Deep technical spikes, integration feasibility, and performance and security reality\-checks — against a requirement the Product Manager and Analyst have already defined.
   

  

**Migrations — about 15%** 
 Data migration, field mapping, cutover scripts and system replacements as we move platforms.
   

  

**The shape of a typical week**
**Daily** 
 — Writing Python with Claude Code. Reading vendor API documentation. Wiring REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and event\-driven flows. Debugging a sync that silently dropped records. Deploying to Cloud Run.
   

  

**Weekly** 
 — Shipping an increment and demoing it. Working through requirements with the Product Manager and Analyst. Triaging what broke.
   

  

**Monthly** 
 — One meaningful capability live in production, with monitoring, a runbook, and documentation good enough that someone else could pick it up.
   

  

**Stack**
 Python
   

  

* Google Apps Script
* Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Firestore, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine)
* REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, OAuth and service\-account authentication
* Claude Code and modern AI tooling as a primary way of working
* Git and CI/CD


 Business systems you will integrate with: Salesforce, NetSuite, HRMS, Slack, Google Workspace, and the wider SaaS estate.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 We care about what you have built and kept alive, not the tools listed on your CV.
   

  

* 2–4 years building software, integrations or automations in a professional environment
* Strong Python, and real fluency with APIs — authentication, rate limits, retries, idempotency, pagination, webhooks and event\-driven patterns
* You have built integrations against SaaS APIs, not only configured them through consoles or drag\-and\-drop integration platforms
* Hands\-on cloud experience (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure is fine) with a working understanding of how to compose services rather than follow a tutorial
* End\-to\-end ownership you can point to — a system you designed, built, shipped and then operated. Something that broke in production and you fixed it.
* Debugging across system boundaries — when two systems disagree about the same record, you can work out why
* Testing and verification instinct — you know your output is correct because you measured it, not because it ran without erroring
* Fast on unfamiliar ground — you have picked up a stack you didn't know and shipped it. This matters more to us than prior exposure to any specific technology.
* Clear written communication — design notes, runbooks, and documentation are part of the job, not an afterthought


**Nice to have**
* Building AI agents, tool\-use, and agentic workflows; MCP servers
* Exposure to business systems — CRM, ERP, HRIS, ITSM — and the SaaS ecosystem around them
* Data and pipeline work (BigQuery, ETL/ELT)
* Infrastructure\-as\-code

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Job Description:
You will work with
Trading operations is integral to the success of BP's Trading \& Shipping organization. The operations team coordinates the safe, efficient, and reliable execution of the physical movements into and out of supply chain networks supporting our refineries, branded customer network, and trading business. We play a vital role in moving product between suppliers, refineries, terminals, and customers across all modes of transportation including pipelines, rail, truck, intra terminal movements, barges, and vessels.
This is a unique opportunity to partner with our commodities trading business, to deliver creative technology solutions, adding commercial value as well as achieving our carbon net\-zero goals.
We have an exciting and challenging, digital vision to support business growth while redefining the day\-to\-day activities of operators through increased automation.
As an engineer on this project, you will collaborate with Product Managers and partners to design, develop and maintain enterprise scale software systems and tools.
As part of a global team working on a global product, you will lead one of the squads. This role offers the opportunity to apply your technical expertise to build new features, enhance existing functionality, and ensure the product remains highly reliable. You will be able to share your technical expertise within and externally to your squad.
We follow an agile methodology. Multiple squads contribute to the product, and we continuously refine and prioritize requirements to deliver the greatest value to our clients as quickly as possible. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the direction of the product and the technology as the products are adopted by new markets over the coming months and years.
The role
As Senior Software Engineer, you will be a technical specialist, working within a highly effective team. You will input into project and squad goals, prioritize and complete initiatives, and deliver results in a product\-led environment. You will help create and maintain, a safe and collaborative culture, in which your software development and engineering experience will be important for success in this role.
What you will deliver
Collaborate with the product leads and other technical leads to understand requirements, estimation and help refine roadmap.
Help maintain a high technical bar for the team both in code quality as well as testing coverage, monitoring and observability.
Deliver customer value iteratively, serve as a technical lead, and own projects end\-to\-end. Communicating status and changes to partners, designing test automation, and collaborating with internal and external teams to bring new platforms to market are key responsibilities.
Maintain and enhance software frameworks and participate in code reviews, and resolve platform\-related issues.
Support and assist during production issues.
Support audit teams for security, software licensing, and regulatory audits, and implement new controls and procedures to address compliance gaps or risks.
What you will need to be successful (experience and qualifications)
Self\-starter with excellent communication skills, adept at handling ambiguity, navigating uncertainty, and influencing peers through to senior leadership.
Strong experience working on the backend of a technology product.
Strong experience in Java, Spring Boot Microservices including: writing unit tests (JUnit/Mockito), working with JPA/Hibernate, and debugging distributed applications.
Some experience with React or another modern frontend framework.
Solid understanding of SQL and relational database design.
Ideally experience with Kubernetes and AWS, including containerised deployment of JEE applications.
Experience working within a full stack team using agile delivery practices.
Skilled in troubleshooting large\-scale distributed production systems.
Product\-centric mindset with the ability to understand business needs and design scalable, resilient systems and solutions.
Strong empathy and curiosity to create exceptional user experiences.
Skills:
Core Technical Skills
Java (8\+) and JEE — advanced proficiency including concurrency, design patterns, and performance tuning
RESTful API design and development
Microservices architecture and design
PostgreSQL — query optimisation, indexing, schema design, and stored procedures
Relational data modelling and database design
Unit testing, integration testing, and TDD (JUnit, Mockito)
Object\-oriented design and SOLID principles
Cloud \& Infrastructure
AWS cloud services — EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM
Kubernetes and container orchestration (Docker, Helm)
CI/CD pipeline design and management (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent)
Configuration management and release management
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation — desirable)
Software Engineering Practices
Secure development and OWASP best practices
Source control and code management (Git, branching strategies)
Software design and development (clean code, code reviews)
Service operations and resiliency (fault tolerance, circuit breakers, observability)
Metrics definition, instrumentation, and monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent)
Scripting (Bash, Python — for automation and tooling)
Architecture \& Solution Design
Distributed systems design and architecture
Architectural awareness and contribution to solution design
NoSQL data modelling (desirable — DynamoDB or similar AWS\-native services)
Risk identification and technical risk management
Emerging technology awareness relevant to trading and data platforms
Collaboration \& Leadership
Mentoring and coaching junior and mid\-level engineers
Agile and Scrum delivery practices
Documentation and knowledge sharing
Communication and stakeholder engagement across business and technology
Product\-centric mindset — translating business needs into scalable technical solutions
Self\-starter, comfortable navigating ambiguity and influencing across seniority levels
Domain Knowledge (Desirable)
Understanding of physical commodity trading, planning, or scheduling workflows
Familiarity with trade lifecycle, contractual obligations, or supply chain operations
Experience working in regulated or enterprise financial/energy trading environments

**About TMF Group**
TMF Group is a leading global provider of high\-value business services to clients operating and investing globally. We focus on providing specialized and business\-critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds in different geographical locations.


TMF India is a Great Place to Work, ISO \& ISAE certified organization.

  

  

**Discover the Role**
The MS Dynamics CRM Developer is responsible for the design, development, customization, and ongoing support of Microsoft Dynamics CRM applications across TMF Group. This role focuses on translating complex business requirements into scalable, high‑quality CRM solutions that support business growth and operational efficiency.  

The developer acts as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) across Dynamics CRM, providing technical leadership, system enhancements, integrations, and application support. The position requires strong technical depth across CRM customization, .NET development, SQL Server, integrations, and modern application lifecycle practices, along with excellent communication and collaboration skills.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
### **CRM Application Development \& Support**

* Design, develop, customize, and support Microsoft Dynamics CRM applications and components
* Deliver ongoing enhancements and maintenance for custom CRM solutions
* Ensure CRM applications are stable, secure, scalable, and aligned with business requirements

### **Subject Matter Expertise \& Technical Leadership**

* Act as an SME for Dynamics CRM across technical requirements, system configuration, customization, and upgrades
* Provide guidance on CRM best practices, development standards, and platform capabilities
* Support architectural decisions related to CRM customization and integration design

### **Business Analysis \& Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Lead or participate in client and stakeholder analysis sessions to gather functional and technical requirements
* Translate user requirements into technical designs and CRM solutions
* Communicate effectively with internal teams and external business stakeholders to ensure clarity and alignment

### **CRM Customization \& Enhancements**

* Extend CRM functionality by creating custom entities, forms, workflows, business rules, dashboards, and reports
* Customize Dynamics CRM Web Client and Dynamics CRM for Microsoft Outlook
* Perform CRM application testing for configurations, customizations, and enhancements

### **Integration \& Solution Architecture**

* Design and implement business processes and integrations between Microsoft Dynamics CRM and other applications
* Architect CRM solutions involving server‑side code, plugins, workflow assemblies, business logic, and integration modules
* Identify and implement third‑party applications to enhance and support the CRM ecosystem
  

  

**Key Requirements**
### **Mandatory Technical Skills**

#### **Dynamics CRM \& Power Platform**

* In‑depth hands‑on experience with Microsoft Dynamics CRM
* Strong knowledge of Canvas and Model‑Driven applications and Dataverse / Common Data Service (CDS)
* Hands‑on experience with CRM API, REST / OData, and SOAP endpoints

#### **.NET \& Application Development**

* Extensive experience with the .NET Framework and C\# development
* Experience with ADO.NET, ASP.NET, and Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)
* Strong understanding of object‑oriented programming and Service‑Oriented Architecture (SOA)

#### **Database \& Reporting**

* Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL)
* Database tuning and performance optimization skills
* Experience working with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)
* Experience designing business solutions leveraging SQL Server databases and reporting/integration services

#### **Web \& Client\-Side Development**

* Extensive experience with JavaScript, HTML, and web\-based UI development
* Experience customizing CRM Web Client and Outlook Client

### **Development, ALM \& DevOps**

* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle
* Experience with Azure DevOps for work management, builds, and deployments
* Experience with source control management systems
* Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) environments

### **General \& Professional Skills**

* Proven ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Detail\-oriented, self\-directed, and highly accountable
* Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, client\-focused environment
  

  

**What’s in it for you?**
**Pathways for career development**

* Work with colleagues and clients around the world on interesting and challenging work.
* We provide internal career opportunities, so you can take your career further within TMF.
* Continuous development is supported through global learning opportunities from the TMF Business Academy.
**Making an impact**

* You’ll be helping us to make the world a simpler place to do business for our clients.
* Through our corporate social responsibility program, you’ll also be making a difference in the communities where we work.
**A supportive environment**

* Strong feedback culture to help build an engaging workplace.
* Regardless of where you are in your career, TMF Group opens a world of opportunity where you will be part of our team and is supported in your global career journey.
* Our inclusive work environment allows you to work from our offices around the world, as well as from home, helping you find the right work\-life balance to perform at your best.
* At TMF Group, it’s our people who make us who we are. Our company thrives on entrepreneurial spirit and is full of proactive people who combine enthusiasm with responsibility and accountability.
**Other Benefits**

* Anniversary \& Birthday Leave policy
* Be part of One TMF
* Paternity \& Adoption leaves
* Salary advance policy
* Work flexibility – Hybrid work model
* Talk about growth opportunities (we invest in talent)
* Well\-being initiatives

title: Lead Python Application Developer - Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


Role Overview


We are seeking a highly experienced, technically proficient, and execution\-focused **Senior Python Application Developer** with **12\+ years of hands\-on experience** to design, architect, and deliver critical, horizontally scalable, highly available, and performant applications. This role demands deep technical expertise in Python, distributed systems, and modern DevOps practices, combined with a strong background in quantitative computation and market risk domains.


The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical leader who can drive software engineering excellence, manage technical aspects of complex projects (including planning, governance, and budgeting), and collaborate effectively with globally matrixed teams, including Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, and Front Office (FO) teams.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**1\. Architecture, Design \& Hands\-on Development**
-----------------------------------------------------


* **Lead Implementation:** Lead the hands\-on implementation and architecture of robust Python frameworks to build horizontally scalable, highly available, highly resilient, and performant applications.
* **Platform Engineering:** Design and develop efficient software platforms for high\-throughput data computation, processing, and quantitative calculations.
* **Standards \& Alignment:** Develop solutions adhering to enterprise architectural standards, utilizing in\-depth technical and business domain knowledge.
* **Database \& API Design:** Design, develop, and secure high\-performance RESTful APIs, integration patterns, and database schemas (relational and NoSQL).

**2\. Technical Leadership, Governance \& Delivery**
----------------------------------------------------


* **SDLC \& Code Quality:** Enforce industry\-standard SDLC best practices and contribute to code quality through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.
* **Project Ownership:** Take full ownership of technical initiatives, including planning, forecasting, project tracking, governance, and managing technology budgets at the team level.
* **Change Management:** Drive continuous improvement, change management, and modern software engineering practices within the development team.
* **Independent Execution:** Work independently, multi\-task, and manage priorities effectively under pressure to meet tight deadlines or unexpected changes in requirements.

**3\. Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
-----------------------------------------------


* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Act as a key liaison and partner with Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, Front Office (FO), DevOps, and Production Support teams to ensure seamless IT deliveries.
* **Global Collaboration:** Work effectively in a globally matrixed environment, partnering with virtual teams and external partners across different time zones.
* **Executive Communication:** Consistently demonstrate clear, concise, and impactful written and verbal communication, ranging from technical discussions within the team to presentations for senior business executives.

**Required Technical Qualifications**
=====================================


**I. Core Python, DSA \& System Development**
---------------------------------------------


* **Experience:** 12\+ years of hands\-on application development experience, with a primary focus on Python, Data Structures and Algorithms.
* **Python Expertise:** Expert\-level Python 3\.x proficiency, with deep knowledge of core concepts, advanced computation libraries, and design patterns (OOP, SOLID).
* **Frameworks:** Advanced knowledge of Python web and API frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
* **Distributed Systems:** Strong understanding of software architecture principles and distributed system design (Microservices, Event\-Driven Architecture, caching strategies).
* **Database Systems:** Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis), including advanced SQL query writing and optimization.
* **Operating Systems:** Highly experienced with Unix/Linux\-based operating systems, shell scripting, and system\-level development.

**II. Cloud, DevOps \& Testing**
--------------------------------


* **Cloud Platforms:** Strong background in cloud platforms AWS or IBM symphony grid.
* **Containerization \& Orchestration:** Hands\-on experience with Docker containerization and contributing to Kubernetes orchestration.
* **CI/CD Pipelines:** Proven exposure to and experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) systems (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines) for automated deployment.
* **Testing \& TDD:** Proficiency in automated testing frameworks (Pytest, unittest) and Test\-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies.
* **Security:** Solid understanding of secure coding practices and application of security principles (OWASP Top 10\).
* **Version Control:** Expertise in Git (Bitbucket, GitHub) for advanced branching, merging, and pull request workflows.

**III. Quantitative \& Risk Domain**
------------------------------------


* **Quantitative Computation:** Multiple years of experience developing quantitative/calc\-intensive Python solutions with advanced computation libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, SciPy).
* **Risk Methodologies:** Sound understanding of and exposure to various Risk Methodologies (e.g., Market Risk, Stress Testing, Value at Risk (VaR), Sensitivities).
* **Domain Delivery:** Proven track record of delivering Stress Testing and Regulatory Risk projects in the Market Risk domain.
* **Mathematical Modeling:** Exposure to mathematical modeling and financial insights.

**IV. Artificial Intelligence (AI) Integration (Exposure)**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **AI/ML Frameworks:** Exposure to AI/ML tools and frameworks.
* **Development Workflows:** Practical experience utilizing AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Devin, Claude, Gemini, GPT) to optimize development workflows.
* **Agentic AI:** Experience with Agentic AI tools, including writing Agents and Skills, and contributing to Agentic frameworks.
* **Generative AI:** Understanding and practical application of Generative AI concepts in software development.

**Professional \& Leadership Skills**
=====================================


* **Agile/Scrum:** Deep understanding and practical experience working within Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Strong analytical, logical, systems thinking, and critical analysis skills.
* **Design Thinking:** Demonstrated design thinking skills to solve complex business and technical problems.
* **Ownership \& Adaptability:** Ability to take complete ownership of various parts of a project, adapt to changing priorities, and perform under pressure.

**Preferred / "Good to Have" Qualifications**
=============================================


* **Banking Domain:** Prior experience working within the banking/financial services domain, specifically in pricing, valuation, or risk management systems.
* **Certifications:** Relevant Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) or Industry Certifications.
* **Financial Certifications:** CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) or FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certification is a strong plus.

	+ A keen interest in or experience with leveraging **AI\-assisted development tools** to improve productivity and code quality.
	+ Deep understanding of **microservice architecture** and **RESTful API** development best practices.
	+ Experience working in Financial Services or another large, complex global environment is highly desirable.
	+ Consistently demonstrates clear, concise, and professional written and verbal communication.

description:
Trexquant is a growing systematic fund at the forefront of quantitative finance, with a team of world\-class researchers and engineers. As we continue to expand our trading operations, we are investing heavily in building the next generation of our quantitative research \& trading platform.
 



 Our
 **Infrastructure Engineers** 
 are embedded within the following teams{{:}}
 


- **C\+\+ Trading Engineer**
 As a member of the Engineering team, you will focus on developing high\-performance trading systems, designing and optimizing short\-term trading signals in a high\-frequency environment with strict latency and efficiency requirements. You will also support independent trading activities by building robust C\+\+ systems, collaborating with researchers and technologists, and delivering solutions that have a direct and measurable impact on trading performance

- **C\+\+ Simulation Engineer**
 As a C\+\+ Simulator Engineer, you will work closely with quantitative researchers and traders to design, develop, and optimize high\-performance systems for algorithmic trading. Your responsibilities will include building and maintaining the core infrastructure for trading simulations

- **Data Infrastructure Engineer**
 As a member of the Data team, you will focus on financial and market data development, building scalable, distributed pipelines for systematic web scraping and ingestion of diverse data sources, with strict latency and reliability requirements. You will also work on developing exchange connectivity solutions by creating high\-performance C\+\+ handlers to capture, process, and integrate real\-time market data feeds


 When you apply for an Infrastructure role at Trexquant, we will first assess you on the core skills required for the Engineering team.  During the interview process, we will be able to get to know you better, learn about your strengths and match you to the best team that closely aligns with your skills and preference.
   





**Responsibilities{{:}}** 



* Full lifecycle development of low\-latency/high\-throughput research and trading systems using C\+\+ \& Python
* Build and optimize data processing pipelines to ensure reliable access to large, high\-quality datasets
* Assist in developing tools for back testing, model training, and strategy evaluation
* Collaborate with researchers and traders to deliver technical solutions that improve research productivity and trading performance
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to maintain high\-quality standards
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, tools, and best practices, bringing innovative ideas to continuously improve our systems


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or a related STEM discipline
* Minimum 2 years of experience in C\+\+ software development within demanding, real\-time environments
* Strong expertise in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\), including advanced features such as template metaprogramming
* Demonstrated experience in building high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Strong understanding of Linux fundamentals and systems\-level programming
* Familiarity with distributed systems and related technologies (e.g., Kafka, Redis, HTCondor) is a plus
* Working knowledge of Python and its numerical ecosystem (NumPy, SciPy)
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to operate independently in a fast\-paced environment


**Good to Have{{:}}**
* Experience working with matrix computation and optimization (Blaze, OpenBLAS, LAPACK)
* Experience working with live market data and exchange feeds
* Experience profiling and tuning production Linux systems for high throughput
* Experience working with time\-series processing or event driven systems
* Experience working across C\+\+ and Python boundaries, such as with bindings (pybind11, C API), embedded Python, hybrid pipelines and orchestration
* A background in finance is preferred but not required


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performance
* Work in a collaborative and friendly environment, participate in the decision\-making process for research direction, and have the opportunity to lead on new ideas
* Comprehensive benefits including healthcare and insurance

title: Staff Software Engineer, Distributed Data Systems (India)
description:
**About Onehouse**
 Onehouse is a mission\-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock\-in. We deliver the industry’s most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud\-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute\-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real\-time AI / ML).
   

  

 We are a team of self\-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large\-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self\-optimizing data lake platform!
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 When you join Onehouse, you're joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2\-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category \- the transactional data lake. The Data Infrastructure team is the grounding heartbeat to all of this. We live and breathe databases, building cornerstone infrastructure by working under Hudi's hood to solving incredibly complex optimization and systems problems.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Drive:**
- As a foundational member of the Data Infrastructure team, you will productionize the next generation of our data tech stack by building the software and data features that actually process all of the data we ingest.

 Accelerate our open source enterprise flywheel by working on the guts of Apache Hudi's transactional engine and optimizing it for diverse Onehouse customer workloads.
 - Act as a SME to deepen our teams' expertise on database internals, query engines, storage and/or stream processing.

**A Typical Day:**
* Design new concurrency control and transactional capabilities that maximize throughput for competing writers.
* Design and implement new indexing schemes, specifically optimized for incremental data processing and analytical query performance.
* Design systems that help scale and streamline metadata and data access from different query/compute engines.
* Solve hard optimization problems to improve the efficiency (increase performance and lower cost) of distributed data processing algorithms over a Kubernetes cluster.
* Leverage data from existing systems to find inefficiencies, and quickly build and validate prototypes.
* Collaborate with other engineers to implement and deploy, safely rollout the optimized solutions in production.


**What You Bring to the Table:**
* Strong, object\-oriented design and coding skills (Java and/or C/C\+\+ preferably on a UNIX or Linux platform).
* Experience with inner workings of distributed (multi\-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational databases.
* You embrace ambiguous/undefined problems with an ability to think abstractly and articulate technical challenges and solutions.
* An ability to prioritize across feature development and tech debt with urgency and speed.
* An ability to solve complex programming/optimization problems.
* An ability to quickly prototype optimization solutions and analyze large/complex data.
* Experience running production services, at scale.
* Robust and clear communication skills.
* Nice to haves (but not required):
* Experience working with database systems, Query Engines or Spark codebases.
* Experience in optimization mathematics (linear programming, nonlinear optimization).
* Existing publications of optimizing large\-scale data systems in top\-tier distributed system conferences.
* PhD degree with 2\+ years industry experience in solving and delivering high\-impact optimization projects.


**How We'll Take Care Of You**
* Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan
* Health \& Well\-being; we'll invest in your physical and mental well\-being by reimbursing up to 20,000 INR for your monthly insurance premium
* Financial Future; we'll invest in your financial well\-being by making this role eligible for the provident fund of which Onehouse will contribute up to 1800 INR/month
* Location; we are a remote\-friendly company (internationally distributed across N. America \+ India), though some roles will be subject to in\-person requirements in alignment with the needs of the business
* Generous Time Off; unlimited PTO (mandatory 1 week/year minimum), uncapped sick days and 17 paid company holidays
* Food \& Meal Allowance; weekly lunch stipend, in\-office snacks/drinks
* Equipment; we'll provide you with the equipment you need to be successful and a one\-time $500 (USD) stipend for your initial office/desk setup
* Child Bonding!; 26 weeks off for birthing and 12 weeks for surrogate and adoptive parents \- fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition


**House Values**
**One Team**
 Optimize for the company, your team, self \- in that order. We may fight long and hard in the trenches, take care of your co\-workers with empathy. We give more than we take to build the one house, that everyone dreams of being part of.
   

  

**Tough \& Persevering**
 We are building our company in a very large, fast\-growing but highly competitive space. Life will get tough sometimes. We take hardships in the stride, be positive, focus all energy on the path forward and develop a champion's mindset to overcome odds. Always day one!
   

  

**Keep Making It Better Always**
 Rome was not built in a day; If we can get 1% better each day for one year, we'll end up thirty\-seven times better. This means being organized, communicating promptly, taking even small tasks seriously, tracking all small ideas, and paying it forward.
   

  

**Think Big, Act Fast**
 We have tremendous scope for innovation, but we will still be judged by impact over time. Big, bold ideas still need to be strategized against priorities, broken down, set in rapid motion, measure, refine, repeat. Great execution is what separates promising companies from proven unicorns.
   

  

**Be Customer Obsessed**
 Everyone has the responsibility to drive towards the best experience for the customer, be an OSS user or a paid customer. If something is broken, own it, say something, do something; never ignore. Be the change that you want to see in the company.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Software Engineer II
description:
**Company Overview:**
 Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 
   

  

 BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. 
   

  

 We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!
 


**About the Role** 

 You are an engineer who, above all, is excited to build products that give our customers the best possible experience purchasing prescription medications. You have professional experience working on a team turning ideas into reliable, maintainable code — and ideally, you are eager to apply
 **AI and machine learning** 
 to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and personalized.
 



 We believe in using a small number of well\-known tools like
 **AWS, Python, Javascript, MySQL/Postgres, and Linux** 
 . We are looking for engineers that value
 **simplicity, pragmatism, and a bias toward action** 
 , and who are passionate about building products that bring real value to our customers.
 



 Sr Software Engineers II at Blink are responsible for building our world\-class products. Your job is to take ownership over one of our hardest problems, envision and refine strategic solutions, and drive execution like an entrepreneur.
 



 You will collaborate closely with a talented, cross\-functional team of designers, product managers, data scientists, marketers, and operators. Through these partnerships, you’ll grow our business, build our core platform, and—above all—make sure that our customers have access to the least expensive and highest satisfaction pharmacy experience on earth.
 



 At Blink, we determine the specific focus of engineering roles through the interview process. Key potential areas of ownership include:
 


* Our telemedicine platform
* Our home delivery experience
* Our growth team
* Our core pharmacy platform
* New product line development
* ****AI\-powered personalization, automation, and decision\-support systems****



 We’ll work with you to find the right fit.
 


**How to Achieve Success / Acumen** 

 All Blinkers are expected to operate with our value of
 *“Good Giving”* 
 in mind. Our culture is infused with the dedication and enthusiasm of employees who continuously strive to make a difference. Here’s how you will do that in this role:
 


**Good Execution — Do your best work** 
* Design new APIs to power innovative features
* Fix performance problems and debug production issues
* Perform peer code and architecture reviews
* Build new features, write unit tests, and lead the release of these features to production
* Develop and A/B test new
 **ReactJS components** 
 to improve our user experience
* ****Design, build, deploy and use AI/ML solutions for telemedicine triage, prescription guidance, fraud detection, personalization, and operational automation****


**Good Owner — Be the CEO of your role** 
* Help the team ship new products and features successfully with the right skills, mentorship, and organizational resources to deliver amazing experiences for our patients
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers to reach individual goals while fostering cross\-functional collaboration and product success
* Take responsibility for the long\-term success of product projects and people
* ****Champion responsible adoption of AI across engineering and product teams, ensuring solutions are ethical, reliable, and scalable****


**Good Learning — Learn something new every day** 
* Demonstrate curiosity and an interest in learning new techniques and improving upon best practices to stay up\-to\-date with current and emerging trends
* Lead by example: put new ideas into action, fail fast, and learn from each experience
* ****Stay ahead of advances in AI/ML (including LLMs, NLP, recommendation systems, and predictive analytics) and apply them thoughtfully to our products****


**Good Feedback — Consider the perspective of others** 
* Listen actively and respond effectively through a variety of channels
* Give and receive candid and constructive feedback
* Promote trust and encourage teamwork to allow the product team to do their best work


**Desired Experience** 
* 7\+ years in a software engineering role
* You want to work in a highly collaborative environment: we believe a team can be stronger than its individual parts
* Independent and curious, comfortable owning features from design through delivery to production
* Experience with one or more modern programming languages (Python, JavaScript, etc.)
* Willingness to dive into a large code base and contribute immediately
* Enjoy writing code that is understandable, maintainable, and testable
* Strong product acumen
* Collaborative and communicative — you love being part of a diverse team, building consensus, and establishing credibility. You are a Class\-A communicator: curious, thoughtful, clear, and (mostly) correct.
* BE/BTech degree from a top institution


**AI\-Preferred Skills** 
* Experience with
 **AI/ML frameworks** 
 (e.g., MCP servers, n8n, Google ADK, Vector DBs and Langchain)
* Familiarity with
 **LLMs, Fine tuning,  and generative AI** 
 for personalization and patient support and order workflow
* Experience integrating AI into
 **production\-grade systems** 
 with measurable business impact
* Interest in applying AI responsibly in healthcare to maximize patient value and trust



**Why Join Us:**
 It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.

* Familiarity with Agile or SDLC testing cycles.

* Experience using source control tools (e.g., GitHub) for collaborative code development and maintenance.

Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

. Experience designing and developing RESTful services.

. Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or Azure
