title: Senior Python Application Developer - Vice President
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a highly experienced, technically proficient, and execution\-focused
 **Senior Python Application Developer** 
 with
 **12\+ years of hands\-on experience** 
 to design, architect, and deliver critical, horizontally scalable, highly available, and performant applications. This role demands deep technical expertise in Python, distributed systems, and modern DevOps practices, combined with a strong background in quantitative computation and market risk domains.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical leader who can drive software engineering excellence, manage technical aspects of complex projects (including planning, governance, and budgeting), and collaborate effectively with globally matrixed teams, including Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, and Front Office (FO) teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Architecture, Design \& Hands\-on Development
* Lead Implementation: Lead the hands\-on implementation and architecture of robust Python frameworks to build horizontally scalable, highly available, highly resilient, and performant applications.
* Platform Engineering: Design and develop efficient software platforms for high\-throughput data computation, processing, and quantitative calculations.
* Standards \& Alignment: Develop solutions adhering to enterprise architectural standards, utilizing in\-depth technical and business domain knowledge.
* Database \& API Design: Design, develop, and secure high\-performance RESTful APIs, integration patterns, and database schemas (relational and NoSQL).
* Technical Leadership, Governance \& Delivery
* SDLC \& Code Quality: Enforce industry\-standard SDLC best practices and contribute to code quality through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.
* Project Ownership: Take full ownership of technical initiatives, including planning, forecasting, project tracking, governance, and managing technology budgets at the team level.
* Change Management: Drive continuous improvement, change management, and modern software engineering practices within the development team.
* Independent Execution: Work independently, multi\-task, and manage priorities effectively under pressure to meet tight deadlines or unexpected changes in requirements.
* Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management
* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Act as a key liaison and partner with Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, Front Office (FO), DevOps, and Production Support teams to ensure seamless IT deliveries.
* Global Collaboration: Work effectively in a globally matrixed environment, partnering with virtual teams and external partners across different time zones.
* Executive Communication: Consistently demonstrate clear, concise, and impactful written and verbal communication, ranging from technical discussions within the team to presentations for senior business executives.


**Required Technical Qualifications**
 I. Core Python, DSA \& System Development
   

  

* Experience: 12\+ years of hands\-on application development experience, with a primary focus on Python, Data Structures and Algorithms.
* Python Expertise: Expert\-level Python 3\.x proficiency, with deep knowledge of core concepts, advanced computation libraries, and design patterns (OOP, SOLID).
* Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Python web and API frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
* Distributed Systems: Strong understanding of software architecture principles and distributed system design (Microservices, Event\-Driven Architecture, caching strategies).
* Database Systems: Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis), including advanced SQL query writing and optimization.
* Operating Systems: Highly experienced with Unix/Linux\-based operating systems, shell scripting, and system\-level development.


 II. Cloud, DevOps \& Testing
   

  

* Cloud Platforms: Strong background in cloud platforms AWS or IBM symphony grid.
* Containerization \& Orchestration: Hands\-on experience with Docker containerization and contributing to Kubernetes orchestration.
* CI/CD Pipelines: Proven exposure to and experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) systems (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines) for automated deployment.
* Testing \& TDD: Proficiency in automated testing frameworks (Pytest, unittest) and Test\-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies.
* Security: Solid understanding of secure coding practices and application of security principles (OWASP Top 10\).
* Version Control: Expertise in Git (Bitbucket, GitHub) for advanced branching, merging, and pull request workflows.


 III. Quantitative \& Risk Domain
   

  

* Quantitative Computation: Multiple years of experience developing quantitative/calc\-intensive Python solutions with advanced computation libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, SciPy).
* Risk Methodologies: Sound understanding of and exposure to various Risk Methodologies (e.g., Market Risk, Stress Testing, Value at Risk (VaR), Sensitivities).
* Domain Delivery: Proven track record of delivering Stress Testing and Regulatory Risk projects in the Market Risk domain.
* Mathematical Modeling: Exposure to mathematical modeling and financial insights.


 IV. Artificial Intelligence (AI) Integration (Exposure)
   

  

* AI/ML Frameworks: Exposure to AI/ML tools and frameworks.
* Development Workflows: Practical experience utilizing AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Devin, Claude, Gemini, GPT) to optimize development workflows.
* Agentic AI: Experience with Agentic AI tools, including writing Agents and Skills, and contributing to Agentic frameworks.
* Generative AI: Understanding and practical application of Generative AI concepts in software development.


 Professional \& Leadership Skills
   

  

* Agile/Scrum: Deep understanding and practical experience working within Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical, logical, systems thinking, and critical analysis skills.
* Design Thinking: Demonstrated design thinking skills to solve complex business and technical problems.
* Ownership \& Adaptability: Ability to take complete ownership of various parts of a project, adapt to changing priorities, and perform under pressure.


 Preferred / "Good to Have" Qualifications
   

  

* Banking Domain: Prior experience working within the banking/financial services domain, specifically in pricing, valuation, or risk management systems.
* Certifications: Relevant Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) or Industry Certifications.
* Financial Certifications: CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) or FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certification is a strong plus.

The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities.

* Conduct tasks related to feasibility studies, time and cost estimates, IT planning, risk technology, applications development, model development, and establish and implement new or revised applications systems and programs to meet specific business needs or user areas
* Monitor and control all phases of development process and analysis, design, construction, testing, and implementation as well as provide user and operational support on applications to business users
* Utilize in\-depth specialty knowledge of applications development to analyze complex problems/issues, provide evaluation of business process, system process, and industry standards, and make evaluative judgement
* Recommend and develop security measures in post implementation analysis of business usage to ensure successful system design and functionality
* Consult with users/clients and other technology groups on issues, recommend advanced programming solutions, and install and assist customer exposure systems

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About the Company** 




 Kamakhya Analytics is a technology\-driven research and consulting organisation helping leaders, parties, and institutions decode India’s political and policy landscape. We bring together survey science, data analytics, and strategic insight to answer complex questions about public opinion, governance, and performance. From ground\-level fieldwork to advanced modelling and interpretation, every project is built for clarity, accuracy, and impact. Our teams manage the complete research cycle, design, execution, data engineering, and delivery under a single framework of discipline, transparency, and speed. Quality and integrity define our work. We apply rigorous controls in sampling and verification, maintain secure and reproducible data systems, and communicate results that withstand scrutiny.
 



 At Kamakhya, our mission is simple: turn evidence into strategy and insight into action.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 We are looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Software Engineer to be the technical backbone of our engineering initiatives. You will be responsible for building robust backend systems and digital infrastructure using core languages like Python and JavaScript. You will play a pivotal role in designing scalable database architectures and spearheading projects related to cutting\-edge AI agentic development. This role is built for a hands\-on technical expert who thrives on solving complex infrastructure challenges and developing intelligent systems that automate and enhance large\-scale data processing.
 



  





**Role Overview** 



* **Backend Engineering:** 
 Design, develop, and deploy highly scalable and secure backend systems and APIs using Python/Javascript. Ensure the backend architecture can support high\-traffic internet applications and internal dashboards.
* **Database Infrastructure Management:** 
 Architect, manage, and optimize complex database infrastructures. Handle the ingestion, storage, and retrieval of high\-velocity structured and unstructured data across SQL, NoSQL, and Vector databases.
* **AI Agentic Development:** 
 Lead the technical implementation of AI\-driven projects, including the development of intelligent agents and LLM\-powered systems for automated reporting, sentiment analysis, and predictive modeling.
* **System Architecture \& Cloud:** 
 Design distributed systems and deploy applications utilizing modern cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) and containerization to guarantee high availability and fault tolerance.
* **Technical Mentorship \& Code Quality** 
 : Set the standard for engineering excellence by writing clean, maintainable code. Conduct rigorous peer code reviews and mentor junior developers on best practices in backend and AI engineering.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




**Education** 



* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.
* Relevant certifications in Cloud Architecture (AWS/GCP) or AI/Machine Learning are highly advantageous.



**Experience** 



* A minimum of 4 years of proven experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on backend development and system architecture.
* Hands\-on experience building database infrastructure from the ground up and integrating AI/ML models into production environments.



**Skills** 



* **Programming:** 
 Python and its backend frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django, or Flask), as well as JavaScript (e.g., Node.js, Express) for building robust, high\-performance APIs.
* **AI \& Machine Learning Integration:** 
 Practical experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or OpenAI APIs).
 **Database Management:** 
 Expert\-level proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), and familiarity with Vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, or Qdrant) for AI applications.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** 
 Extensive experience with cloud service providers (AWS/GCP), container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
* **Architecture:** 
 Strong understanding of microservices architecture, asynchronous programming, and message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka).

**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 Lead Developer — Angles for SAP from insightsoftware
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore, India (Remote)
 **Team:** 
 Angles for SAP Engineering
 **Reports to:** 
 Director of Engineering
   

  

**About Insightsoftware**
 insightsoftware empowers business leaders with accessible insights and connected solutions to drive actionable business strategy. With a global footprint spanning 40\+ countries, we build the tools that help finance and operations teams move faster, decide smarter, and deliver results.
   

  

 Angles for SAP from insightsoftware is our flagship ERP analytics solution — giving SAP customers direct, governed access to their business data without the complexity of traditional reporting stacks.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a Lead Developer to join the Angles for SAP engineering team. You will drive the technical direction of our product, mentor a team of engineers, and ensure we deliver high\-quality, scalable software that makes a real difference for our customers.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will write code, review architecture, guide technical decisions, and collaborate closely with product and customer success to shape what we build next.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Lead the design, development, and delivery of new features across the full stack
* Set and uphold engineering standards: code quality, testing practices, and architectural patterns
* Mentor and support developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical discussions
* Collaborate with Product Management to translate customer needs into technical solutions
* Evaluate and integrate AI\-powered tooling and agents to accelerate development workflows
* Contribute to our technical roadmap and participate in architecture decisions
* Work directly with customer\-facing teams to understand real\-world use cases and pain points


 What You Bring
   

  

 Core Skills
   

  

* Strong C\# and .NET backend development — you are fluent in modern C\# syntax, understand async patterns deeply, and apply SOLID and DRY principles by default
* React frontend knowledge — you can build and maintain frontend features, and you understand component design, state management, and API integration
* Design patterns and clean architecture — you recognize when to apply the right pattern and why, and you can articulate those choices clearly to your team


**Experience**
* Five or more years of professional software development experience, with at least one year in a tech lead or senior role
* Hands\-on experience developing with AI agents and modern AI\-assisted development workflows (GitHub Copilot, agentic coding, LLM integrations, or similar)
* Experience working in agile or product\-led engineering teams
* Hands\-on experience leveraging AI across the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, driving improvements in design, coding, testing, debugging, and delivery workflows.
* Proficient with AI\-powered engineering tools including GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT for code generation, automation, context engineering, and productivity optimization.
* Demonstrated success in integrating AI into engineering practices to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, increase test coverage, and achieve measurable business outcomes.


 Mindset
   

  

* Customer\-first — you build for real users, not for theoretical correctness. You ask "what problem does this solve?" before you write the first line of code
* Collaborative — you make the people around you better, not just the codebase
* Pragmatic — you balance technical ideals with delivery realities
* Curious — you stay current with the ecosystem, especially where AI is changing how we build software


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with enterprise data access patterns (direct database access, ERP APIs, or data extraction pipelines)
* Exposure to SAP or other ERP systems — you do not need to be an SAP expert, but you understand what ERP data looks like and why it matters to business users
* Familiarity with Power BI, reporting tools, or BI integrations
* Background in B2B SaaS product development
* Experience with TypeScript or other typed frontend stacks


 What We Offer
   

  

* A technically challenging product at the intersection of enterprise ERP and modern software engineering
* A team that values craft, collaboration, and continuous improvement
* Fully remote working from Bangalore with a flexible, outcome\-oriented culture
* Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with your experience and impact
* The opportunity to grow into broader technical leadership as the team scales


 Our Core Values
   

  

 At insightsoftware, we hire people who live these values — not just list them:
   

  

* Results Orientation — we recognize results trump effort
* Winning Attitude — we work hard, challenge ourselves, and get things done
* Be One Team — we are better together
* Disciplined Execution — we do what we say we will do
* Customer\-First Mindset — we put customers first, always


**Additional Information**
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Learn more about our high\-energy, high\-performance global team: Work With Us
   

  

 insightsoftware About Us: Hear From Our Team

title: Software Engineer I
description:
**Job Description**
 The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high\-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.
   

  

 Software Engineer I develops and maintains software applications, writes clean and efficient code, completes code reviews with guidance and automated testing to ensure high\-quality deliverables, debugs software components, and supports and monitors software across various environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop, enhance, and maintain software applications to support business and customer needs.
* Write clean, efficient, scalable, and well\-documented code that adheres to established engineering standards and best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and automated testing activities, incorporating feedback and guidance from peers and technical leaders to improve code quality.
* Design, build, and maintain responsive web applications using modern technologies and sound software engineering principles.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues in software components by identifying defects, analyzing root causes, and implementing appropriate fixes.
* Support, monitor, and maintain applications across development, testing, integration, and production environments to ensure reliability and performance.
* Collaborate effectively with product, business, and engineering teams to align technical solutions with organizational goals and customer requirements.
* Develop a strong understanding of system integrations, dependencies, and platform interactions within supported business domains.
* Manage priorities and deliverables effectively, demonstrating the ability to work independently while contributing positively within a team environment.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools and technologies in day\-to\-day development activities to improve productivity, code quality, problem\-solving, and overall engineering efficiency.
* Continuously learn and apply new technologies, tools, and best practices to support professional growth and team success.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Foundational understanding of the tools, processes, and methodologies used throughout the software development lifecycle, including planning, analysis, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.


**Technical Skills**
* 1–2 years of experience in software development with modern front\-end technologies, including React, Redux, ES6/ES7, React Testing Library (RTL), and Jest.
* Strong understanding of web development fundamentals, including HTML/XHTML, CSS, JavaScript, DOM manipulation, and JSON.
* Experience building adaptive, responsive, and user\-friendly web applications across multiple devices and platforms.
* Knowledge of developing and maintaining microservices using technologies such as Java, Vert.x, Spring Boot, or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, multi\-tier application architectures, algorithms, and relational database concepts.
* Experience with software testing practices, including automated, functional, integration, and performance testing, as well as maintaining technical documentation.
* Understanding of Agile software development methodologies and frameworks, including Scrum, Kanban, iterative development, and user story\-driven delivery.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, learn new technologies quickly, and apply engineering best practices to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Strong collaboration, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and the ability to leverage them to improve productivity, code quality, and development efficiency.


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
   

  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial\-well\-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on\-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities


 American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

title: System Software Engineer - Performance Verification Infrastructure
description:
Job Requisition ID JR2025205
   

  

 Job Category Engineering
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 Join NVIDIA's GPU Performance Infrastructure team and be part of a brand\-new journey in validating and shipping next\-generation GPU architectures. At NVIDIA, we empower our engineers to innovate and drive powerful performance through innovative infrastructure and workflows. This role is uniquely positioned to influence the entire lifecycle of GPU performance verification, from early\-stage modelling to post\-silicon validation. With our bold standards and extraordinary team, you'll have the chance to define a significant impact on the future of computing!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Design and maintain automated chip performance verification pipelines spanning workload trace generation, multi\-target test execution, results post\-processing, and correlation with architectural performance targets.
* Develop performance monitoring and measurement infrastructure that provides consistent observability across simulation, emulation, and silicon environments.
* Build scalable data pipelines and full\-stack dashboards to ingest, visualize, and compare performance metrics across builds and environments.
* Coordinate with GPU architects to craft infrastructure for performance verification of upcoming architectures.
* Work closely with HW teams to automate and accelerate verification workflows, enabling faster GPU build iteration.
* Empower GPU architects by providing insights to understand current performance and model industry\-leading performance for future builds.
* Improve the daily workflows of the world's top chip architects, contributing to the creation of the next greatest generation of GPUs!


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of software engineering experience, primarily in C\+\+, with Python for tooling and automation.
* Strong CS fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, OOP, and system design.
* Full\-stack experience with backend (Java/Python), REST APIs, and modern frontend (React/Ember) for data\-intensive applications is a plus.
* Proficiency in databases (SQL, MongoDB) for metrics storage and querying is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with Git, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, and messaging systems (RabbitMQ) is a plus.
* Exposure to GPU/CPU/SoC chip performance verification is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI development tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native NTN Applications)
description:
**About Us**
 One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Viasat is developing a 3GPP NTN standards\-based Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Network to support standard based devices across key use cases such as Direct to Device, Automobile and UAVs.
   

  

 RAN Apps team is responsible for the development of an ecosystem of AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent applications to configure, monitor and optimize the performance of Viasat’s LEO based satellite network especially that of the RAN subsystem in it, and integrate the ecosystem with the complete satellite ground network. These applications interface with various components of O\-RAN based NTN network – RU, DU, CU, RIC, SMO etc.
   

  

 Team member responsibilities are end\-to\-end ownership of one or more intelligent RAN applications, from requirements refining to design, development and system integration.
   

  

 This is a site‑based role, employees work 3\+ days (60%\+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day workweek.
   

  

**The day\-to\-day**
* Refine initial requirements through brainstorming with peers in the team and external stakeholders.
* Develop Architecture and Design for AI native, Cloud hosted intelligent RAN applications utilizing O\-RAN framework, system performance, scalability and maintainability aspects.
* Develop test plans covering configuration, performance, stability, interoperability
* Implement the design with the support of AI productivity tools
* Test the applications at various level – unit, module, subsystem, system

title: Principal Software Engineer, Prime Video Commerce Tech
description:
**Description**
 When a customer opens Prime Video anywhere in the world \- on a Fire TV in Mumbai, a phone in Tokyo, a browser in Berlin \- a commerce system determines if they are entitled to watch a content, what it costs, and how they pay. That system is ours.
   

  

 The Prime Video Commerce team in Bengaluru owns the offers and payments transaction path for hundreds of millions of customers globally. We process millions of requests per second across high double\-digit countries, spanning every device type, multiple currencies, and dozens of payment methods \- with four\-nines availability targets. We support the full spectrum of Prime Video monetisation: ad\-free and ad\-enabled subscriptions, transactional purchases and rentals, channel subscriptions, with how we pay for them – every payment method in a country, and payment type – at once, in installments.
   

  

 This is not a role where the architecture is settled, and you maintain it. We are at an inflection point \- evolving from product\-line silos into a unified orchestration platform, decoupling payment logic from the commerce stack, closing the gap to four\-nines availability, and shaping what comes next: better support for an agent interaction, better pricing rules and so on. We are hiring a Principal Engineer to own the end\-to\-end technical vision across both Offers and Payments, because a customer discovering an offer, selecting it, and completing payment is one continuous flow — and the leader who resolves the architectural fragmentation must span domains and Amazon verticals.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the technical direction for the commerce platform’s offer\-to\-payment architecture, making critical decisions on system design, service boundaries, and data contracts for performance, scalability, and resilience at millions of TPS
* Define and drive a multi\-year architecture transformation – to improve resiliency, monitorability, and to deliver flexibility and speed
* Be Hands on to deliver goals tracked at the Amazon executive bench level
* Drive innovation in AI/GenAI\-powered commerce \- designing agent\-callable service interfaces, AI\-native development workflows, and intelligent decision making systems
* Collaborate across multiple organizations to align technical vision and priorities, influencing decisions at VP level \& above without direct authority
* Define best practices for system architecture, operational excellence, and engineering processes — maintaining high standards for software quality, availability, and cost efficiency
* Mentor and develop senior engineers toward Principal\-level scope, fostering technical growth through design reviews, architecture guidance, and hands\-on pairing
* Lead engineering efforts that directly improve customer experience — reducing transaction failures, improving latency, and enabling commerce at global scale
* Establish and champion AI\-native engineering practices across the organisation, including spec\-driven development, GenAI\-assisted automation, and AI\-powered operational tooling


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your days are varied \- and that’s the point. This role sits at the intersection of deep technical work, delivery of business goals, organizational influence, and talent development. On any given week, you might be writing a technical vision document that dozens of engineers will build against; sitting with a fellow engineer to walk through a design and build their confidence to own bigger problems; challenges customer experiences we build; leading an architecture review where three teams with competing constraints need to converge on a shared interface; deep\-diving into a production incident to identify the systemic pattern and design the architecture that prevents the entire class of failure; or prototyping a proof\-of\-concept that validates a critical architectural assumption before the team invests months of execution.
   

  

 You hold a high technical bar and an equally high bar for how you treat people. You operate across time zones with genuine empathy. You’re as comfortable whiteboarding a distributed systems problem as you are coaching someone through a difficult career conversation. You don’t just set direction — you make the people around you capable of carrying it forward without you.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are the Prime Video Commerce Offers team in Bengaluru — engineers across all levels and managers who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We're proud of what we've built, and we're just getting started.
   

  

 We are a worldwide team, and we operate like one. That means working across time zones with genuine empathy — understanding that your counterpart in Seattle or London has a life outside of work, just as you do, and that great collaboration doesn't require anyone to sacrifice their personal time.
   

  

 Inclusivity isn't a value we list on a slide — it's how we work. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard, regardless of level, background, or tenure.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of software development experience with deep expertise in distributed systems
* Track record of leading architecture transformations across multiple teams and services (not just designing — driving adoption)
* Experience operating systems at large scale (millions of TPS) with high availability
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across organizational boundaries
* Hands\-on practitioner: you write code, review designs, and prototype — not just govern from a distance
* Experience with service\-oriented architecture evolution (decomposition, interface harmonization, platform building)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Commerce, payments, or subscription systems at global scale (multi\-currency, multi\-territory, regulatory complexity)
* Hands\-on experience with AI/GenAI — both as a development practice (AI\-native SDLC) and as a system capability (agent\-callable services, intelligent decision making)
* Experience with resiliency engineering (graceful degradation, blast\-radius isolation, chaos testing)
* Track record of mentoring senior engineers toward Principal\-level scope and judgment
* Rapid experimentation: building simulation/forecasting frameworks or ML\-driven recommendation systems
* International expansion experience (local payment methods, regulatory compliance, market\-specific adaptation)

title: Senior Guidewire Developer (ClaimCenter Configuration)
description:
India \- Bangalore


Professional Services/Full time/Hybrid

  



Guidewire Professional Services partners with customers and systems integrators worldwide to implement and extend Guidewire’s cloud platform for P\&C insurers, reducing implementation effort and accelerating time\-to\-value. As a ClaimCenter Senior Consultant, you will work as part of our Global Delivery team, configuring and integrating ClaimCenter to help customers modernize their claims operations and adopt Guidewire Cloud.  

  

You will be an internal implementation and configuration specialist focused on ClaimCenter, collaborating closely with architects, business analysts, developers, and QA to deliver high\-quality solutions that balance out\-of\-the\-box capabilities with customer needs. This role is ideal for someone with 6 \- 9 years of experience who enjoys hands\-on configuration, integration, and data migration in an Agile, consulting style environment. At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI, encouraging you to leverage emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.


**Job Description**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Configure Guidewire ClaimCenter (entities, workflows, rules, UI, product model) using recommended implementation patterns and out‑of‑the‑box capabilities wherever possible.
* Participate in requirement and design discussions with internal stakeholders (architects, BAs, developers, QA) to translate business and functional needs into ClaimCenter configuration and integration designs.
* Implement and support integrations between ClaimCenter and external/enterprise systems (policy, billing, document management, payments, third‑party services) using web services, REST APIs, messaging, and batch processes.
* Contribute to data migration activities including data mapping, transformation rules, migration scripts, test data preparation, and reconciliation/validation of migrated data.
* Develop and maintain functional and technical design documents, configuration workbooks, interface specifications, and deployment checklists to support repeatable delivery.
* Support system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT): clarify expected behavior, analyze defects, provide configuration fixes, and ensure quality prior to go‑live.
* Work within an Agile/Scrum delivery model, contributing to estimation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos for your assigned workstreams.

Collaborate with global PS colleagues to* best practices, templates, and accelerators that improve quality and reduce implementation effort over time.
* Actively use Guidewire tools, automation, and responsible AI capabilities to increase your productivity and improve the quality and consistency of project outcomes.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

***Required:***

* 6 \- 9 years of overall IT experience, including hands\-on experience implementing or enhancing core insurance systems for P\&C insurers.
* Practical experience with Guidewire ClaimCenter (cloud or on‑premise) on at least one implementation or major enhancement, ideally in a configuration or integration\-focused role.
* Solid understanding of P\&C claims lifecycle and processes (FNOL, coverage verification, reserving, litigation, recoveries, subrogation, and closure).
* Experience with ClaimCenter configuration concepts such as data model, workflows, rules, exposure and claim segments, and user roles/permissions.
* Familiarity with common integration patterns and technologies (REST/SOAP web services, messaging, batch, file\-based interfaces) used in enterprise environments.
* Exposure to data migration activities (source‑to‑target mapping, data cleansing, test data setup, validation) for core system replacement or cloud transformation programs.
* Comfort working in Agile/Scrum teams and collaborating across global, cross‑functional stakeholders in a Professional Services or consulting context.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to break down complex requirements into clear, testable configuration and integration tasks.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and data‑driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement in your current role.
* Very good verbal and written communication skills in English, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.

***Preferred:***
----------------

* Guidewire certification in ClaimCenter (e.g., ClaimCenter Specialist or Ace – ClaimCenter Configuration/Integration).
* Experience with other Guidewire InsuranceSuite applications (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ContactManager) or related integrations.
* Experience with cloud‑based implementations or modernization programs in P\&C insurance, ideally in a SaaS or multi‑tenant context.
* Prior experience working in a global Professional Services, consulting, or system integrator environment.

**Your Impact**


We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you will immerse yourself in an active BillingCenter implementation, take ownership of specific product configuration and integration workstreams, and lead technical design discussions with both Guidewire and customer teams to ensure solutions are aligned, scalable, and cloud\-ready. As you progress, you will help Professional Services advance its FY27 priorities by applying AI\-enabled methods, reusable accelerators, and automation to cut implementation effort and time, improve delivery quality, and support broader cloud and AI adoption across Guidewire’s customer base. Over time, your designs, code, and mentorship will shape how insurers run their businesses on our platform and how Guidewire fulfills its mission to transform the way the world’s P\&C insurers do business through digital, core, analytics, and AI innovation.


Interested in this position?


  
**About Guidewire**


Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.


As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.


For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.


Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

title: R&D Software Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


R\&D Team Manager **What We Believe In**


ABB's Energy Industries business enables customers across oil \& gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation, and water sectors to operate safer, smarter, and more sustainable industrial facilities.


We deliver integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that help customers improve operational efficiency, reliability, cybersecurity, and sustainability through advanced industrial software, control systems, and digital engineering technologies.

**Your Role and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------


In this role, we are looking for an R\&D Software Engineer – Industrial Automation to join our Energy Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of enterprise\-grade industrial automation software, supporting next\-generation SCADA, HMI, communication, and digital engineering platforms.


Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop scalable software solutions using C\+\+, .NET/C\#, ASP.NET Core, Angular/React, and modern cloud technologies while partnering with Product Management, Solution Architects, Test Engineering, and Domain Experts to deliver secure, reliable, and high\-performance industrial software.


This role is contributing to the Energy Industries – Research \& Development organization in Bangalore, India.


The work model for the role is: Hybrid

**You will be mainly accountable for**
--------------------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise\-grade industrial automation applications using C\+\+, .NET/C\#, ASP.NET Core, Angular/React, and modern engineering practices, ensuring scalable, secure, and high\-quality software delivery.
* Develop and support SCADA, HMI, historian, and industrial communication solutions by integrating PLCs, RTUs, Flow Computers, and third\-party systems using protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, IEC 60870\-5\-104, and DNP3, while optimizing system performance and reliability.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Architects, Test Engineering, and cross\-functional teams to deliver software through Agile methodologies, implement CI/CD practices, leverage AI\-assisted development tools, and support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and customer deployments.
* Drive engineering excellence by adopting software development best practices, performing root cause analysis, improving cybersecurity, enhancing application performance, maintaining technical documentation, and contributing to continuous innovation and product improvements.

**Qualifications for the Role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in industrial automation software development using C\+\+, .NET/C\#, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, and modern enterprise application development practices.
* Strong experience with Angular or React, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, NoSQL databases, object\-oriented programming, and enterprise software architecture.
* Knowledge of SCADA, HMI, historian systems, industrial communication protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, IEC 60870\-5\-104, DNP3\), Windows Server environments, and Industrial Cybersecurity principles (IEC 62443\) is preferred.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure or AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, cloud\-hosted industrial solutions, and AI\-assisted software development tools is considered an advantage.
* Understanding of process automation domains such as Oil \& Gas, Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Power Generation, or Water industries, along with high\-availability and disaster recovery architectures, is desirable.
* Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently in Agile teams while continuously learning emerging technologies and engineering best practices.

**More About Us**
-----------------


ABB's Energy Industries business enables safe, smart, and sustainable operations across the oil \& gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation, and water sectors. We deliver integrated automation, electrification, digitalization, and industrial software solutions that help customers improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, optimize energy consumption, and accelerate digital transformation.


Our R\&D organization develops innovative industrial software, cloud\-enabled applications, intelligent automation platforms, and advanced digital engineering solutions that empower customers to operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably. By combining deep domain expertise with cutting\-edge technologies, ABB continues to shape the future of industrial automation.


At ABB, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams to build next\-generation industrial software while advancing your expertise in automation, cloud technologies, AI\-assisted engineering, and digital transformation. We foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, diversity, and inclusion where every individual is empowered to make a meaningful impact.


ABB is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. Employment is subject to applicable background verification and pre\-employment screening in accordance with ABB policies.

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Windows/Desktop Applications - Noida, India
description:
**Mission**

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.



Over 50 million people use Speechify's text\-to\-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text\-to\-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.


Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies



**What You'll Do**
* Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C\#, XAML, and — when needed — C\+\+.
* Define and enforce best\-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross\-version compatibility (Windows 10/11\+), and maintainability.
* Drive accessibility efforts: integrate and validate support for accessibility APIs (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or other relevant Windows accessibility frameworks), ensure UI controls, focus management, keyboard navigation, screen\-reader support, and usability for users with disabilities.
* Collaborate closely with product designers, UX researchers, QA, and other stakeholders to shape feature planning, UI/UX architecture, and long\-term roadmap for the Windows platform.
* Take ownership of full lifecycle of features: conception design implementation testing release maintenance. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases.
* Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.


**An ideal candidate should have**
**Required:**


* 3\+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C\#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C\+\+, Win32/WinRT/COM).
* Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.
* Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production\-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.
* Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi\-threading or asynchronous programming (where relevant).
* Experience leading technical design, mentoring other engineers, conducting code reviews, and making architecture\-level decisions.
* Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and drive consensus.
* A user\-centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users.


**Preferred / Bonus:**


* Experience with writing automated tests for UI — unit tests, integration tests, UI automation tests; familiarity with relevant testing frameworks.
* Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high\-DPI support, responsiveness under load).
* Experience with localization/globalization, right\-to\-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.
* Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.
* Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.
* Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long\-term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management.


**What we offer**


* A high\-impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience.
* A collaborative, flat\-structure engineering culture — you are not just a coder, but a builder and a decision\-maker.
* Opportunities to lead — mentor others, steer technical direction, and grow into broader technical leadership (e.g. Tech Lead, Architect).
* Flexibility, autonomy, and responsibility: you define how to solve problems, own features end\-to\-end, and contribute to long\-term product vision.
* A purpose\-driven mission: building software that's reliable, accessible, and user\-centered — making a real difference for people.

**Think you're a good fit for this job?**



Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.  

And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.


**Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?**  

Refer them!

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Members of the distributed systems
description:
logcat.ai is the AI engineering layer for the operating\-system stack. We build agentic systems for Linux and Android devices: we ingest the diagnostic artifacts a device emits (bugreports, logcat, dmesg, modem traces, ramdumps, perfetto, pcap, CAN) and help device makers diagnose, remediate, test, and author features across their OS stack, grounded in their own BSP. A VC\-backed startup with a small, senior team — you work directly with the founders.
 



  





 We recently raised a $2\.55M pre\-seed. The product is scaling and the customer list is growing. The team is still small, so you'll own what you build.
 



  





 Own the core platform end to end: ingestion and processing of very large system\-log artifacts, the runtime under our AI investigation agents, and the infrastructure that keeps it all reliable for customers. This is a founding seat — architecture, tech selection, CI/CD, and reliability are your calls, and you'll have a real vote in what we build and who we hire next.
 



  





 We're not hiring for a traditional lane. We want someone who builds the automation, agentic workflows, and self\-scaling systems that let a small team ship like a large one.
 



  





**A note on location** 




 This role is hybrid, 2\-3 days a week in our Bengaluru office. We work this way because the platform team ships faster when engineers are in the same room. You must be eligible to work in India.
 



  





**The bar** 



* 4 plus years building backend or distributed systems at product companies — you've personally owned a system under real load and can talk concretely about its failure modes.
* Full\-stack capable: you'll ship the API, the pipeline, the infra, and sometimes the UI.
* AI\-native: you build harnesses and evals, not just accept autocomplete.
* Startup DNA: you've worked at an early or high\-growth startup, or genuinely want to now — ownership over lanes, speed over ceremony, many hats.
* Proficient in day\-to\-day work with CLI\-based AI coding tools like Claude Code (or an equivalent). It's how the team operates, not a nice\-to\-have.



  





**What you'll do** 



* Build ingestion and processing for very large system\-log artifacts, and the runtime our AI investigation agents run on.
* Own the infrastructure that keeps the platform reliable for customers: architecture, tech selection, CI/CD.
* Build the automation and agentic workflows that let a small team ship like a large one.



  





**Bonus** 



* Observability, logging, or tracing systems.
* eBPF, Perfetto, ftrace.
* OS internals.
* Public OSS track record.



  





**What we offer you** 



* A front seat as we scale. Customer calls, the roadmap, the pipeline, how the company is actually doing.
* Top\-of\-market salary and founding equity. You'll own a piece of what you build.
* The AI tools you need. We use AI across writing code, reviewing it, research, ops, and internal tooling. If something would help you work better, we'll get it.
* Early ownership, and full visibility. We move fast, and you'll help decide where.
* Comprehensive medical insurance for you and your family.
* Start\-up perks and flexible time off, the kind people actually take.
* A small team that's easy to work with. People here like solving hard problems and helping each other out.



  





**What to expect after you apply** 



* Screening call with Head of People \& Business Operations
* Technical conversation with Co\-founder/ Head of Engineering
* Technical exercise with Co\-founder/ Head of Engineering
* Final conversation with CEO
* References, then offer



  





 In your application, tell us what you'd own here, and the hardest thing you've shipped, a link to something you've built beats a resume.

title: AI Native Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an AI\-Native Software Engineer to help transform our software development process into an AI\-first engineering model. In this role, you will use AI tools as a primary development partner to convert requirements into working software solutions faster, while maintaining strong responsibility for quality, correctness, security, and production readiness.
   

  

 You will be expected to take business and technical requirements, create precise prompts and implementation plans, generate a significant portion of the initial solution using AI, and then carefully validate the output for hallucinations, prompt accuracy, missing logic, incorrect assumptions, and alignment with expected outcomes. The goal is not simply to generate code quickly, but to deliver reliable, maintainable, and well\-tested software using AI as an accelerator.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands\-on experience using AI tools for coding, design, testing, documentation, debugging, and refactoring. You should be comfortable working with ambiguity, breaking down requirements into AI\-executable tasks, reviewing AI\-generated code, and taking full ownership of the final solution.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to generate, test, document, refactor, and improve software solutions.
* Convert product and business requirements into clear technical prompts, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria.
* Generate 80–90% of initial solution drafts using AI tools, then review, validate, and refine the output.
* Detect and correct AI hallucinations, inaccurate assumptions, invalid code, security issues, and gaps in requirements.
* Create automated tests to verify expected behavior and business outcomes.
* Ensure all AI\-generated code meets company standards for architecture, security, maintainability, performance, and documentation.
* Build reusable prompt templates and AI\-native development workflows for common engineering tasks.
* Collaborate with product, QA, DevOps, architecture, and security teams to deliver production\-ready solutions.
* Document prompts, assumptions, validation steps, risks, and final implementation decisions.
* Help educate and guide other engineers in adopting AI\-native software development practices.


**Requirements**
* Strong software engineering background with experience building production\-grade applications.
* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages.
* Experience using AI coding tools or large language models for software development.
* Strong understanding of APIs, databases, cloud services, testing, CI/CD, and secure coding practices.
* Ability to write precise prompts and evaluate AI\-generated outputs critically.
* Strong debugging, testing, code review, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to identify hallucinations, incorrect logic, missing edge cases, and gaps between generated code and requirements.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Strong sense of ownership for final deliverables, regardless of whether the initial code was AI\-generated.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Amazon Q Developer, or similar tools.
* Experience creating prompt libraries, AI development workflows, or internal engineering automation.
* Experience with LLM applications, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, or workflow orchestration.
* Experience leading process transformation or helping engineering teams adopt new development practices.
* Knowledge of AI governance, data privacy, security, and responsible AI usage.


 What We Expect From This Role
   

  

 This role is designed for an engineer who can operate in a future\-facing development model. You will not only write code; you will design the way software is created with AI. You will be responsible for accelerating delivery while ensuring that every final output is correct, tested, secure, and aligned with business expectations.

title: Software Engineer, AI Product Engineering
description:
**Overview Of 73 Strings**
 73 Strings is an innovative platform providing comprehensive data extraction, monitoring, and valuation solutions for the private capital industry. The company's AI\-powered platform streamlines middle\-office processes for alternative investments, enabling seamless data structuring and standardization, monitoring, and fair value estimation at the click of a button. 73 Strings serves clients globally across various strategies, including Private Equity, Growth Equity, Venture Capital, Infrastructure and Private Credit.
   

  

 Our 2025 $55M Series B, the largest in the industry, was led by Goldman Sachs, with participation from Golub Capital and Hamilton Lane, with continued support from Blackstone, Fidelity International Strategic Ventures and Broadhaven Ventures.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We’re hiring software engineers at mid\-level and senior to build the AI features our clients use to run post\-investment operations: extracting financial data from documents, monitoring portfolios, and producing auditable valuations. These are the features people buy us for, and they’re the ones where getting it wrong is most expensive.
   

  

 AI is not a side project here and not an option. It shapes how we build, and it is what we ship. That means writing the deterministic machinery around probabilistic components, deciding where an agent belongs and where it absolutely does not, and building the evaluation and guardrails that let a finance professional trust an output enough to put their name on it.
   

  

 These are full\-stack roles weighted toward the backend. You’ll design systems, build the services behind them, and take the feature through the UI where it lands. You’ll work directly with product leadership and with engineers across our verticals, and senior hires will drive technical initiatives that reach beyond their own team.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

 Building AI\-Enabled Product Features
   

  

* Design and ship user\-facing features built on LLMs, retrieval, extraction models, and agentic workflows, from the first prototype through to something our clients depend on quarterly.
* Own the full path of a feature: data in, model or agent in the middle, deterministic validation around it, and an interface that makes the output reviewable by a human who has to sign off on it.
* Build the evaluation harnesses, regression suites, and offline test sets that tell you whether a change made the feature better or just different.
* Design for the failure modes that matter with probabilistic systems: hallucinated values, silent low\-confidence outputs, prompt injection through client documents, and drift after a model upgrade.
* Instrument features for quality in production — confidence, correction rates, human overrides, latency, cost per run — and act on what the numbers say.


 Deterministic vs Agentic: Drawing the Line
   

  

* Decide, deliberately and defensibly, which parts of a system must be deterministic and which can be probabilistic. Arithmetic, audit trails, permissions, and reconciliation are not places for a model to improvise.
* Keep probabilistic components inside deterministic boundaries: schema\-constrained outputs, validation, reconciliation against source data, and a clear path to human review.
* Push back on agentic designs that add nondeterminism without adding value, and make the case with reasoning rather than preference.
* Make the reasoning visible in design docs, so the next engineer understands why a step is a rule and not a prompt.


 System Design and Domain Modeling
   

  

* Design services and system boundaries that reflect the business domain rather than the current org chart or the shape of last year’s database.
* Apply domain\-driven design in practice: bounded contexts, aggregates, ubiquitous language, and context mapping between teams. We expect you to have used it, not just read about it.
* Model the private capital domain carefully — funds, portfolio companies, positions, valuations, as\-of dates, restatements — and keep the model honest as the product grows.
* Own your services end to end: implementation, tests, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and the on\-call that comes with them.


 Collaboration and Technical Leadership
   

  

* Work directly with product leadership to shape what gets built, challenge assumptions, and turn a vague opportunity into a scoped, shippable feature.
* Partner with Data Engineering, ML, and other product verticals on contracts and interfaces so the same problem doesn’t get solved three times.
* Drive technical initiatives across the domain, not just within your team: shared patterns for AI features, evaluation tooling, domain models, or the standards that keep our services consistent.
* Raise the bar around you through design review, code review, and mentorship. Senior engineers here are expected to make other engineers better.
* Write clearly. A design doc that survives review is part of the job.


 What You Bring
   

  

* Strong software engineering experience with production ownership of what you build. We hire at mid\-level and senior; what differs is scope and the breadth of what you’ve led, not the standard of craft.
* Full\-stack capability with real depth on the backend. You can design a service, reason about its failure modes, and still build the interface where the feature lands.
* Demonstrated system design ability: you can take an ambiguous problem, propose two or three viable architectures, and explain the trade\-offs without hiding behind diagrams.
* Strong practical understanding of domain\-driven design, and the judgement to know when a lighter approach is the right call.
* Language\-agnostic engineering strength. We use TypeScript, Java, and Python, and you should be productive in at least one of them and willing to work across all three. We care that you understand systems, not that you’ve specialised in our stack.
* Hands\-on experience building with LLMs or other probabilistic components in a product context: prompting and context design, retrieval, structured output, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, and evaluation.
* A clear point of view on where AI belongs in a system and where it doesn’t, formed by having shipped something and watched it behave in production.
* Comfort with modern delivery practice: automated testing, CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, and observability as a first\-class concern.
* Strong business sense. You understand who uses what you build and why it matters to them, and you make trade\-offs accordingly. SaaS or FinTech experience is not required; curiosity about the domain and the discipline to learn it is.
* Self\-direction. You find the important work, scope it, and drive it without waiting for a ticket.
* Experience in a fast\-growing company where the roadmap, the team, and the requirements all change at once is a strong plus.


 How You Work With AI
   

  

 We’re an AI\-first company, and that has to mean something more than having a coding assistant installed. We expect engineers here to have genuinely changed how they work.
   

  

* You use AI as a working tool across the job, not just in the editor: exploring unfamiliar code and data, generating test cases and edge\-case inputs, drafting and reviewing designs, triaging production issues, and writing the documentation nobody else wants to write.
* You go beyond prompt\-and\-paste. You’ve built or configured something (agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, custom tooling, MCP integrations, automated review or triage) that made a repeatable part of engineering measurably faster or more reliable.
* You know where AI output cannot be trusted. Generated code that handles the happy path and silently drops errors is worse than no code at all. You verify, you test, and you can explain how you verified.
* You apply the same judgement to AI\-generated code that you’d apply to a junior engineer’s pull request: read it, challenge it, own it once you ship it.
* You share what works. A technique you discovered that stays on your machine is worth a fraction of one the whole team adopts.


 If your answer to “how do you use AI” is autocomplete and the occasional chat window, this role will feel like a stretch — and we’d rather tell you that now.
   

  

 You Will Excel If You…
   

  

* Question everything. A prompt standing in for business logic, a metric nobody can define, an agent added because agents are interesting: you raise it rather than build it.
* Believe a feature isn’t done until someone can trust its output without checking every row.
* Are comfortable holding both the domain model and this sprint’s delivery reality in your head at the same time.
* Enjoy working with product leadership rather than waiting for a finished spec.
* Care that the numbers are right, because in our business a wrong number reaches an investment committee.
* Know the difference between pragmatic and sloppy, and won’t compromise on the former to avoid the latter.


 We cultivate a culture of innovation and collaboration, where your ideas matter. We empower our team members to take initiative, learn continuously, and thrive in a supportive environment.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
### **Description**

  

We are looking for an early\-career Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help us build and maintain the automated tests that keep our products reliable. You will work alongside developers and senior SDETs to write test automation, expand our regression coverage, and investigate failures in our CI pipelines. This is a hands\-on engineering role: you will spend most of your time writing code, not clicking through screens.
It is an ideal role for someone who enjoys breaking things on purpose, is comfortable in a codebase, and wants to grow into a strong quality engineer with a solid automation foundation.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Write, execute, and maintain automated API tests using Playwright and Robot Framework.
* Review requirements and user stories, design and document test cases covering functional and non\-functional scenarios.
* Execute manual exploratory testing on new features where automation coverage does not yet exist, and convert repeatable checks into automated tests.
* Triage failing tests in CI/CD pipelines, distinguish genuine product defects from flaky or environment\-related failures, and escalate appropriately.
* Log clear, well\-evidenced defects with reproduction steps, logs, and screenshots, and track them through to closure.
* Use Git for day\-to\-day version control\- branching, pull requests, and responding to code review feedback on your test code.
* Contribute to test data setup, environment configuration, and small automation utilities that reduce manual effort.
* Collaborate with developers and product managers on quality risks.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 0\-2 years of experience in software testing, test automation, or software development
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language \- Python preferred.
* Exposure to an automation framework such as PyTest, Playwright, or Robot Framework, through work, coursework, or personal projects.
* Understanding of REST API concepts (HTTP methods, status codes, JSON) and familiarity with a tool such as Postman or the requests library.
* Familiarity with Git and basic branching workflows.
* Solid grasp of software testing fundamentals: test case design, defect lifecycle, regression testing, and the difference between functional and non\-functional testing.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with clear written and verbal communication.

Willingness to learn quickly and take direction from senior engineers.  
* 

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Hands\-on experience with PyTest, Playwright (TypeScript or Python bindings) or Robot Framework.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Concourse, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Awareness of Agile/Scrum practices and tools such as Jira.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or Locust.

  


### **About Brivo**

  

Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises.  

  

As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.  

  

With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.  

  

*Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

We are looking for a strong **Platform Engineer** to help shape and evolve the enterprise platform that serves as the foundation for engineering teams across Candescent.  

Leveraging **GCP, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and modern observability practices**, you will design and operate scalable, secure, reliable, and automated platform services that accelerate software delivery, improve reliability, and provide a consistent developer experience.
