* Use observability data to troubleshoot complex production issues and identify reliability, performance, scalability, and capacity risks across cloud, platform, applications, networking, and service dependencies.
* Participate in incident response, problem management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Reduce operational toil through automation and self\-service capabilities.
* Establish and improve platform standards, operational readiness, runbooks, and engineering practices.
* Collaborate closely with SRE, Software Engineering, Security, and Architecture teams to drive adoption of platform, observability, and reliability best practices.


Basic Requirements

* 6\+ years of experience in **Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, SRE, DevOps, Observability Engineering, or related disciplines**.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **GCP and cloud architecture**.
* Strong experience with **Kubernetes/GKE** and cloud\-native platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with **Terraform / Infrastructure as Code**.
* Experience with **ArgoCD, GitOps, and CI/CD**.
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, IAM, compute, storage, and load balancing.
* Strong understanding of observability concepts, including **metrics, logs, distributed tracing, monitoring, alerting, Golden Signals, SLIs, and SLOs**.
* Hands\-on experience implementing or operating at least one modern observability platform such as **Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, AppDynamics, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar**.
* Experience designing dashboards, alerts, monitoring standards, and observability solutions for production environments.
* Experience with automation using Python, Shell, or similar technologies.
* Strong production troubleshooting, incident management, and root cause analysis experience.
* Ability to troubleshoot issues holistically across cloud platforms, applications, networking, and service dependencies.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.


Preferred Skills

* Experience building self\-service capabilities or reusable platform solutions for engineering teams.
* Experience with **OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar observability technologies**.
* Experience integrating observability platforms with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, or incident management workflows.
* Experience with cloud migration or modernization initiatives.
* Experience with highly available and scalable platform architectures.
* Experience working in financial services or other regulated environments.


What We Value

* Strong **platform ownership and reliability mindset**.
* Strong understanding of both **cloud platform engineering and observability**.
* Ability to use observability data to improve reliability and operational outcomes.
* Strong bias toward automation, standardization, and self\-service.
* Ability to think across the entire cloud and application ecosystem.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving reliability and performance issues.
* Focus on developer experience and operational simplicity.
* Strong collaboration and clear communication.

title: Software Dev Engineer-II, Infra Supply Chain Automation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

These are all greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up. You will be part of a new organization within AWS building large scale distributed applications. We will be designing and developing these systems from scratch utilizing technologies and frameworks like reactive micro services, serverless computing and distributed NoSQL data stores.  

  

If you have a solid understanding of fundamental algorithms and system design and are able to produce bulletproof code, we are looking for you. To succeed in this role, you must be passionate about delivering high\-quality designs and components. You must be creative in solving hard problems and unafraid to think out\-of\-the\-box.

1\. Solve complex architecture and business problems to come up with extensible solutions.  

2\. Write high quality code that are modular, functional and testable.  

3\. Formally mentor junior engineers on design, coding and troubleshooting.  

4\. Communicate, collaborate and work effectively in a global environment.

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Monday to Friday

Head of IT \& Managed Services / RPA Managed Services Lead

  

About the Role

  

We are looking for a Senior Production Developer – UiPath who will be responsible for managing and maintaining UiPath automations in a production environment.

  

This is not a developer\-only or task\-oriented role. The position requires strong hands\-on UiPath expertise combined with a production\-first mindset, analytical troubleshooting ability, incident ownership, client communication, and operational leadership.

  

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring process stability, timely job completion, production issue resolution, SLA adherence, and overall automation performance.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

1\. Production Support \& Stability

  

* Own the day\-to\-day production performance and stability of UiPath automations.
* Monitor production jobs, schedules, queues, triggers, and automation performance.
* Ensure timely and successful completion of scheduled automation processes.
* Identify recurring issues and implement preventive measures.
* Ensure production processes meet defined SLAs and business expectations.

  

2\. Production Troubleshooting

  

* Analyze UiPath Orchestrator logs, job execution details, exceptions, and process context to identify potential issues.
* Quickly assess limited information and determine the likely root cause before performing detailed debugging.
* Troubleshoot application, workflow, configuration, credential, infrastructure, and integration\-related issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement appropriate corrective actions.

  

3\. L2/L3/L4 Production Support

  

* Handle complex production incidents that cannot be resolved at the initial support level.
* Take ownership of critical and high\-priority incidents through resolution.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, application, development, network, security, and client teams when required.
* Provide technical guidance to junior developers and production support team members.

  

4\. Incident \& SLA Management

  

* Manage multiple production tickets, incidents, requests, and competing priorities.
* Prioritize issues based on business impact, severity, SLA, risk, and urgency.
* Ensure incidents are properly documented, tracked, resolved, and validated.
* Provide timely updates to internal stakeholders and clients during critical incidents.
* Participate in incident reviews and identify preventive actions.

  

5\. Solution\-Oriented Problem Solving

  

* Evaluate different technical solutions based on:
* + Business impact
	+ Risk
	+ Effort
	+ Timeline
	+ Maintainability
	+ Production stability
* Avoid temporary fixes where a sustainable solution is required.
* Recommend improvements to automation architecture, workflows, exception handling, and operational processes.

  

6\. UiPath \& Orchestrator Management

  

* Strong hands\-on experience with UiPath Studio and UiPath Orchestrator.
* Monitor and manage:
* + Processes
	+ Jobs
	+ Triggers
	+ Queues
	+ Assets
	+ Machines
	+ Runtimes
	+ Folders
	+ Robot configurations
* Troubleshoot deployment and execution\-related issues.
* Validate production configurations and support deployment activities.

  

7\. Production Code \& Quality

  

* Review automation implementations for stability, reliability, maintainability, and production readiness.
* Identify fragile workflows, inefficient implementations, and potential failure points.
* Ensure proper exception handling, logging, retry mechanisms, and recovery procedures.
* Support enhancements, change requests, and production fixes.

  

8\. Documentation \& Knowledge Management

  

* Quickly understand new processes through PDD, SDD, technical documentation, and KT sessions.
* Maintain accurate production support documentation.
* Create and update troubleshooting guides, process documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Ensure knowledge is effectively transferred to junior developers and support teams.

  

9\. Client \& Stakeholder Management

  

* Communicate clearly with clients, business teams, project managers, developers, and technical teams.
* Provide professional updates during incidents and production issues.
* Understand client priorities and business impact.
* Build confidence through timely communication, ownership, and effective resolution.

  

10\. Team Leadership \& Knowledge Sharing

  

* Guide and mentor junior developers and support engineers.
* Share technical knowledge and production troubleshooting practices.
* Participate in technical discussions and solution reviews.
* Contribute to improving team processes, standards, and operational efficiency.
* Work collaboratively rather than operating as an isolated individual contributor.

  

Required Technical Skills

  

* Strong hands\-on experience in UiPath development and production support.
* Strong knowledge of UiPath Studio and Orchestrator.
* Experience with UiPath Classic and Modern experiences.
* Strong understanding of:
* + REFramework
	+ Workflows
	+ Selectors
	+ Exception handling
	+ Logging
	+ Retry mechanisms
	+ Queues
	+ Assets
	+ Triggers
	+ Orchestrator jobs
	+ Robot/Machine configuration
* Strong debugging and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Experience handling production incidents and critical automation failures.
* Understanding of Windows applications, web applications, Excel, databases, APIs, and system integrations.
* Knowledge of deployment and production support processes.
* Ability to understand and work with PDD, SDD, KT, and operational documentation.

  

Key Competencies

  

* Production\-first mindset
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Incident ownership
* Problem\-solving ability
* Client\-focused approach
* Strong prioritization skills
* Excellent communication
* Decision\-making under pressure
* Team collaboration
* Leadership and mentoring
* Accountability
* Quality\-driven approach
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced production environment

  

Experience

  

Recommended: 5\+ years of overall RPA/automation experience with strong hands\-on UiPath experience, including significant exposure to production support and incident management.

  

Candidates should have demonstrated experience managing multiple production automations, critical incidents, SLAs, client escalations, and complex troubleshooting.

  

Qualification

description:

**AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. That aligns closely with external FDE market patterns focused on customer\-embedded technical ownership and end\-to\-end production deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.

* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.

**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.
* Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Strong working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with experience applying these to enterprise problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise\-grade solutions across cloud and hybrid environments, ideally on Azure, AWS, or GCP. Comparable FDE manager roles consistently require cloud\-native delivery, APIs, and production systems ownership.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/data protection tooling such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Purview, DSPM platforms, Python, and related enterprise engineering tools.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a professional services, solutions engineering, field engineering, or forward deployed model.
* Familiarity with regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or large multinational enterprises. External senior digital trust/privacy FDE roles explicitly value regulated\-industry depth.
* Experience with pricing inputs, solution estimation, and technical deal shaping.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
**Software Development Engineer II · Chennai, India · In office with remote flexibility · 2–3 years experience**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



We're looking for engineers two\-to\-three years in who are already building with agents — and want to do it on a product that Fortune 500 companies run on. If you want to own features end to end, debug your own code in production, and work on a team where the bar is high and the lanes are wide, read on.


**About Us**
------------



Chronus is the market leader in enterprise mentoring and connection software, trusted by Fortune 500 companies worldwide.



We are an AI\-native engineering organisation. Coding agents, automated review and machine\-assisted design are core to how we ship — not a side experiment someone is piloting in a corner. If you've been using Claude Code or Cursor in spite of your team's process rather than because of it, this will feel like an upgrade.


**The Team**
------------



Small, seasoned, and deliberately kept that way. You'll work with engineers who have deep technical backgrounds, a high bar for what ships, and the autonomy to move without asking permission three times.



You'll sit close to Product and Design, and close to an Engineering Lead whose job includes making you better. There is no layer of people between you and the decisions that affect your work.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------



This is a full\-stack individual contributor role, and "own" is the operative word.


* **Features, end to end.** From understanding the customer problem to running it in production. Not tickets handed to you pre\-chewed.
* **AI in the loop, daily.** Use coding agents to move faster while holding the quality bar. You'll be expected to have opinions about where they help and where they quietly make things worse.
* **Your surface of the product.** Know how it behaves live. Monitor it. Debug to the actual cause. Respond when it breaks — with the team behind you, not watching you.
* **Your teammates' code.** You review their pull requests. A second pair of eyes on everything that ships.

* Drive the firmware design, implementation and verification, in pre\-silicon and post\-silicon environments.

* Assist in identifying skills requirements and in hiring engineers, collaborating with other teams on platform bring\-up/debug/diags, firmware lifecycle, etc.

title: Senior Quant Developer
description:
**Senior Quantitative Developer**


8–12 Years \| Beacon by CWAN \| India

 **About Beacon Platform by CWAN**


Beacon is a cloud\-native, cross\-asset risk analytics and quantitative development platform used by top\-tier asset managers and banks. It provides a transparent, extensible environment for building, deploying, and scaling valuation models, pricing libraries, and risk analytics across asset classes — including derivatives, structured products and fixed income — combining pre\-built financial applications with a flexible developer infrastructure that enables quants and model developers to write custom pricing and valuation logic, run scenario analysis, and integrate models directly into front\-office and risk workflows, all without the constraints of legacy systems.

**About the Role**


As a Senior Quantitative Developer you will be a technical authority on Beacon's pricing and risk platform — setting the architectural direction for our model libraries, mentoring the team, and driving the delivery of complex quantitative features across fixed income, commodities, equities, and FX. You will own the quality, correctness, and performance of our core pricing engines, lead the design of scalable risk infrastructure, and act as the bridge between engineering, product, and clients.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead the architectural design of Beacon's Python pricing and risk libraries — establishing patterns for model extensibility, calibration frameworks, and performance optimisation.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of pricing models for complex fixed income instruments (exotics, structured credit, callable/putable bonds, swaptions, CMS) and commodity derivatives (Asian options, spread options, energy forwards), FX and Index products.
* Define and enforce standards for pricing model implementation, testing (unit, integration, regression), validation workflows.
* Serve as the primary technical reviewer for model implementations, architectural proposals, and code standards across the quant engineering team.
* Architect and manage scalable cloud infrastructure (AWS EMR, S3, Glue, Lambda, ECS) supporting quant research and front\-office production at scale.
* Ensure platform reliability through robust EOD processing pipelines, automated regression testing, and observability tooling.
* Design flexible infrastructure to support client\-specific configurations without compromising performance or maintainability.
* Implement market data pipelines to source data from various market data vendors.
* Act as a senior technical voice in client discussions, implementation scoping, and pre\-sales engagements where deep pricing expertise is required.
* Mentor mid\-level developers; conduct technical interviews and contribute to hiring decisions.
**What You Bring**

**Required**

* 8–12 years of experience in quantitative development or financial engineering, with a strong production track record in pricing and risk systems.
* Expert\-level Python — ability to design libraries from scratch, optimise hot paths (numpy vectorisation, Cython, multiprocessing), and set team\-wide coding standards.
* Deep fixed income pricing knowledge across multiple instrument types: rates derivatives (vanilla and exotic), credit products, structured products — including model calibration and Greeks.
* Strong commodities derivatives knowledge — energy, metals, or agricultural markets; seasonality models, multi\-factor commodity models.
* Proven experience owning a quant model or library end\-to\-end in a production fintech or financial services environment.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and production observability tooling.
* Proven ability to lead and grow technical teams — mentoring junior/mid developers and contributing to hiring.
* Degree (B.Tech / M.Tech / MSc / MFE) in a quantitative discipline — mathematics, physics, engineering, computer science, or financial engineering.
**Nice to Have**

* Experience with stochastic volatility models (SABR, Heston, LMM) and their numerical implementation, Monte\-Carlo Simulation.
* C\+\+ expertise — writing or maintaining shared pricing libraries consumed by Python wrappers (pybind11, ctypes).
* Familiarity with XVA (CVA, DVA, FVA) frameworks and their computational demands.
* Experience with real\-time risk (intraday VaR, P\&L attribution) pipelines at scale.
* Experience with distributed job orchestration (Airflow, Prefect) and large\-scale EOD risk workflows.
* Familiarity with real\-time data ingestion frameworks (Kafka, Kinesis).
* Experience with distributed computing frameworks (PySpark, Spark) for large\-scale data processing.
**What Will Make You Stand Out**

* Track record of delivering and operating robust quant systems at scale in a front\-office or risk platform environment.
* Experience designing systems for automated recovery, failover, and monitoring of analytics jobs.
* Prior experience integrating complex model libraries into production platforms while maintaining reliability and transparency.
* Demonstrated ability to act as a technical bridge between quant research, engineering, and client\-facing teams.
**Skills at a Glance**

*Expert Python · Fixed Income \& Exotic Derivatives · Commodities Pricing · SABR / HJM / LMM · AWS (EMR, S3, Glue, Lambda, ECS) ·**Risk Infrastructure Architecture · EOD Data**Pipelines ·**Data Governance ·**CI/CD \& Observability**·**C\+\+ (nice to have) · XVA (nice to have) ·**· Team**work,**Leadership \& Mentoring*

description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.



Over 50 million people use Speechify's text\-to\-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text\-to\-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.


Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.


**Overview**



We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high\-quality datasets at petabyte\-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.


**What You'll Do**


* Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline

title: DevRe - Intern
description:

------------


As a **Community \& Growth Intern**, you will help grow and support the researcher and developer community around Lexsi's open\-source tools. You will work closely with our DevRel \& GTM lead across outbound, Discord community management, launches, and user feedback.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work on the advanced tools and research from lexsi labs and create marketing artifacts \- cookbooks, tutorials, demos etc.
* Build and run outreach and community building activities
* Write and test outreach sequences and track replies, engagement, and calls
* Own day\-to\-day moderation of the Lexsi Discord
* Answer general and first\-line technical questions about our tools
* Route deeper questions on fine\-tuning, interpretability, alignment, and agents to the right research or engineering team
* Support AMAs, GitHub releases, product launches, and community initiatives
* Track community and outreach metrics and identify what is working
* Surface recurring questions, documentation gaps, and product feedback to the wider team

**Requirements**
----------------

* Strong written communication
* Comfortable writing targeted cold outreach that does not feel like spam
* Experience managing or moderating a Discord community
* Highly organised and comfortable owning multiple workflows
* Enough ML familiarity to follow conversations around LLMs, fine\-tuning, interpretability, agents, or alignment
* Comfortable working with researchers and engineers
* Self\-starter who can take ownership without constant direction

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in developer relations, growth, community, or technical marketing
* Familiarity with open\-source developer communities and GitHub
* Experience with Apollo, Reply.io, or similar outbound tools
* Prior projects or coursework in fine\-tuning, interpretability, evals, agents, or AI safety
* Experience writing technical or developer\-facing content

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* More relevant researchers and engineers discover and use Lexsi's tools
* Community questions are answered quickly and routed properly
* Outbound consistently creates high\-quality conversations
* Launches and releases generate meaningful developer engagement
* Community feedback improves our documentation, tooling, and content

title: Developer, AI Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one\-of\-a\-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.


Join the EisnerAI team, a fast\-growing organization within EisnerAmper that is redefining how professional services harness the power of Artificial Intelligence. As an AI Engineer specializing in MLOps and AIOps, you will play a critical role in deploying, operating, and optimizing enterprise\-grade AI solutions built on Azure, collaborating closely with AI Developers, Product Owners, Governance leaders and Cloud Architects to ensure these systems are reliable, scalable, and cost\-effective across tax, audit, advisory, and client\-facing applications. This role goes beyond traditional DevOps—it’s about engineering AI into the fabric of enterprise operations, enabling secure, observable, and governed machine learning deployments that deliver real business impact.

**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**
------------------------------------------

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards


	+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
	+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
	+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

**What Work You Will be Responsible For:**
------------------------------------------

* Deploy and monitor AI models across Azure services with robust telemetry for performance, drift, and availability.
* Manage model upgrades including APIs and UIs with structured rollout, version control, and rollback support.
* Optimize performance and cost through testing, profiling, and tuning of inference infrastructure and pipelines.
* Implement MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, deployment, and lifecycle management using Azure ML and GitHub Actions.
* Ensure compliant change management for all AI\-related deployments, with auditability, security, and governance controls.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical field
* 3\+ years in MLOps and/or AIOps, ideally within Azure cloud environment with hands\-on experience with Azure ML, Synapse, Data Lake, App Services, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Foundry

**Preferred/Desired Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* Consulting background with a strong bias for action.
* Workflow Design: Prompt flow, automation pipelines, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems
* Post\-Training Techniques: Fine\-tuning, instruction tuning, RLHF, and domain adaptation
* Azure DevOps, App Insights, Log Analytics, Key Vault, and Managed Identity integration.
* Tools for inference performance testing and profiling (e.g., locust, K6, or custom scripts).
* Model Evaluation: Performance metrics, benchmark development, and A/B testing frameworks
* Understanding of model observability, telemetry, and incident response for AI systems.

**About EisnerAmper:**
----------------------


EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with approximately 450 partners and 5000 employees across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long\-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.


Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start\-ups, global public firms, and middle\-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not\-for\-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.

**About EisnerAmper India:**
----------------------------


EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non\-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.


EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007\. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 900 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.

The candidate will design, develop, configure, test, validate, and support secure, scalable, and high\-quality ServiceNow IRM solutions including Risk Management, Policy \& Compliance Management, Audit Management, Issue Management, Controls Management, and Vendor Risk Management.
   

  

 The role also involves building and supporting enterprise ServiceNow IRM solutions in close collaboration with architects, business stakeholders, and project teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, configure, and implement ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) solutions leveraging ServiceNow out\-of\-the\-box capabilities.
* Configure and implement IRM capabilities including Risk Register, Risk Library, Control Library, Control Objectives, Policy \& Compliance Management, Compliance Monitoring, Attestation Frameworks, Audit Trail and Governance Processes.
* Develop and maintain ServiceNow applications using Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, and Workflow Automation to support approved business requirements and user stories.
* Design and develop integrations utilizing ServiceNow Integration Hub, REST APIs, SOAP services, and spokes to support enterprise data exchange requirements.
* Lead data migration activities related to risks, controls, policies, compliance records, audit data, issue records, and vendor risk data.
* Participate in solution design sessions and collaborate with architects and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Support all testing phases including Unit Testing, System Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and resolve defects throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Develop technical documentation, configuration guides, deployment procedures, and knowledge transfer materials for administrators and support teams.
* Provide deployment, go\-live, and hyper care support to ensure successful transition into production and stabilization of IRM solutions.


 Required Skills \& Experience
   

  

* 6\+ years of hands\-on ServiceNow development experience.
* Strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide API, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, Service Portal, ACLs, and platform security.
* Hands\-on experience implementing and testing IRM capabilities, including risk, policy and compliance, audit, issue, control testing, and vendor risk management.
* Strong understanding of governance, risk, compliance, control frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience with integration technologies including REST APIs, SOAP services, and third\-party application integrations.
* Experience with ServiceNow IRM data model, assessment framework, policy lifecycle management, compliance monitoring, and risk methodology implementation.
* Experience supporting utility, energy, public sector, or highly regulated environments preferred.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.


 Preferred Skills \& Experience
   

  

* Experience implementing ServiceNow IRM for utility organizations.
* Knowledge of risk and compliance processes within regulated energy environments.
* Experience with industry frameworks such as NIST, COBIT, SOX, NERC CIP, ISO 27001, or other regulatory compliance standards.
* Experience in utility, energy, public sector, or regulated industry environments.


**Qualifications \& Certifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
* ITIL Foundation Certification
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) – Risk and Compliance
* Shift Requirement 2\.00 To 11\.00 Pm IST

title: Information Systems Software Application Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

The vision of our Business Technology Organization is to be the trusted partner that fuels Workday's business technology innovations and products to enable company growth at scale.
  

  

Our team cultivates relationships with built on collaboration and trust to support a rapidly growing business. We strive to improve efficiency and operational effectiveness through technology, innovation and inspiration.
**About the Role**

Responsibilities: \- Software Application Troubleshooting at Application, Database, Network \& Integration layers \- Lead and deliver Automation of tasks/service requests \- Perform trend analysis, and develop action plans for improving SLAs and reducing case volume and problems \- Incident troubleshooting, resolution and technical root cause analysis to address the problem permanently \- Identify business risks, inefficiencies, issues and opportunities related to Salesforce platform. \- Document, maintain standardization and look for ways to constantly improve processes \& procedures. \- Develop expertise of Workday Go\-To\-Market business applications end\-to\-end \- Develop domain expertise of Workday’s Enterprise Applications including Integrations
**About You**

Basic Qualifications:
  

* 5\+ years in Enterprise Software Application Development
* Bachelor’s or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field

  

Other Qualifications:
  

* Deep technical knowledge of enterprise software application development and enterprise application integrations (Workday, Salesforce, Stripe, MuleSoft/SnapLogic)
* Workday Integration Administrator certification preferred
* Source\-to\-Pay(S2P)/Procure\-to\-Pay(P2P) functional experience preferred
* Hands on experience troubleshooting technical issues on Salesforce platform end\-to\-end (Application, Database, Network \& Integration layers)
* Knowledge of IT service management tools and best practices(preferred)
* Self\-motivated, flexible, teammate with proven multi\-tasking, time management \& organization expertise with the ability to handle multiple and often changing priorities.
* Attention to detail with the ability to analyze and tackle sophisticated problems as well as provide documentation, mentorship and instruction to users. Proven ability to learn and embrace new technologies, applications, and solutions.

  

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**  



With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.  



  

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.  



  

Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.  



  

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible.  



  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**

At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.  



Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.  



In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

title: IT ServiceMax Data Developer
description:
### **Job Description**


**ServiceMax Data Developer**



Johnson Controls is searching for a **ServiceMax Data Developer** to design, develop, and manage data integration and development processes between ServiceMax, Salesforce, and other enterprise systems. In this role, you will lead the development of data pipelines, integrate field service data, and ensure that the data infrastructure supports the needs of business stakeholders. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including data analysts, engineers, and business users, to ensure seamless and effective data workflows for field service management.


**What you do**


* Lead the design of data flows between ServiceMax, Salesforce, ERP, and other enterprise applications.
* Build data pipelines to support real\-time and batch data processing for reporting and analytics.
* Optimize and scale data workflows to handle large volumes of field service data while ensuring performance and data accuracy.
* Design and implement the data architecture for ServiceMax, ensuring data consistency, accuracy, and quality across systems.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to define data models, sources, and transformations that support field service operations and reporting needs.
* Manage and oversee the data integration process, ensuring that data from various sources is cleansed, transformed, and loaded correctly into the system.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security standards.


**How will you do it**


* Develop DB scripts to support specific Salesforce/ServiceMax data migration activities to meet business requirements.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data needs and provide technical solutions to enhance data quality in the ServiceMax platform.
* Implement data validation processes and ensure data integrity throughout the lifecycle of ServiceMax deployments.
* Work closely with ServiceMax administrators, developers, and data analysts to align data systems with business objectives.
* Coordinate with IT and business teams to troubleshoot data\-related issues and implement fixes in a timely manner.
* Monitor the performance of data workflows and integrations, proactively identifying bottlenecks or issues.
* Continuously optimize data processes to ensure fast, reliable access to field service data for reporting and analytics purposes.


**What we look for**


**Required:**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\&\#43; years of experience in data activities, with a focus on Salesforce and/or ServiceMax platform.
* Strong experience with data integration tools (e.g., Informatica, DM Amp, Snowflake. BI tools) and APIs for connecting different systems.
* Strong Experience with SQL and working with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, SQL Server).
* Strong knowledge of data transformation, cleansing, and validation processes
* Understanding of ServiceMax modules and how they integrate with Salesforce and other enterprise systems is a plus.


**Preferred:**


* Proficiency in programming languages like SQL along with data modelling, ETL processes
* Familiarity with field service management KPIs and operational reporting needs.
* Experience with advanced data processing technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) or machine learning integration is a plus.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
* Any certification related to MySQL/Oracle
* Salesforce/ServiceMax Certified Administrator is an added advantage

description:

**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏
  
  

Do

Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏

Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
  
  

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
  
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
  
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
  
͏
  
  

Deliver
  
  

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  
3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** Google Cloud DevOps .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .

description:
SAP MM Developer
**We offer:**
=============

**Expert Professional – SAP MM Developer**
==========================================

**Planning Processes \& Technical Integration**

**Location:** Pune, India
  

**Company:** KION India Pvt. Ltd.
  

**Department:** IT – Application Services / Supply Chain Planning
  

**Reporting to:** Manager Supply Chain Planning


**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an experienced **SAP MM Developer** to join our Supply Chain Planning IT team. In this role, you will be responsible for the **technical design, enhancement, extension, and development of SAP MM solutions** across **SAP ECC** and **SAP S/4HANA** environments, with a strong focus on **planning\-related processes** .


**Tasks and Qualifications:**
=============================

**You will act as a senior technical interface between business stakeholders, key users, internal consultants, architects, and external implementation partners. Your main objective will be to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable, and upgrade\-stable technical solutions aligned with** **Clean Core principles** **and modern SAP development standards.**


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Analyze business requirements and translate them into robust technical SAP MM solution concepts
* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain SAP MM\-related technical solutions in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA
* Implement custom developments supporting **MRP, material disposition, replenishment, and procurement\-related planning processes**
* Develop and enhance solutions using modern SAP technologies such as **ABAP, ABAP Objects, CDS Views, APIs, OData services, RAP services, and Fiori\-related concepts**
* Ensure solutions follow **Clean Core** , extensibility, architecture, and maintainability standards
* Support and develop integrations between SAP MM and connected systems, including **SAP IBP** where applicable
* Analyze and resolve technical defects, incidents, interface issues, and performance problems
* Support testing, deployments, documentation, and continuous improvement activities

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Strong technical expertise in **SAP development for SAP MM processes**
* Deep hands\-on experience with **ABAP, ABAP Objects, CDS Views, APIs, OData services, RAP services** , and modern SAP development approaches
* Good understanding of **SAP MM planning\-related processes** , especially **MRP, material disposition, replenishment planning, and procurement execution**
* Experience in developing scalable, maintainable, and standard\-oriented SAP solutions
* Sound understanding of **SAP S/4HANA development concepts** and **Clean Core principles**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, consultants, developers, architects, and management in international environments
* Very good command of **English** , written and spoken

**Experience \& Qualifications**
--------------------------------

* Minimum **7 years of relevant professional experience** in SAP development, technical implementation, or enhancement delivery
* Strong experience in **SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA development environments**
* Proven experience in **SAP MM\-related developments** , especially in planning and procurement\-related areas
* Several years of experience in custom developments, interfaces, reports, APIs, and service\-based solutions
* Experience in technical collaboration with business stakeholders, process owners, and project teams
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Informatics, Engineering, Supply Chain Management** , or a comparable discipline
* Knowledge of **SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite, IDocs, and APIs** is an advantage
* Experience with **SAP IBP integration** is desirable
* Relevant SAP certifications are a plus

**Why Join This Role?**
-----------------------

This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled SAP developer who wants to work at the intersection of **technology, planning processes, and business transformation** . You will contribute to modern, future\-oriented SAP solutions in a global supply chain environment and help shape scalable technical capabilities that support KION’s planning and procurement processes

Current\-State Assessment • Engage with stakeholders across ITSM, asset management, procurement, and operations to understand existing hardware asset lifecycle processes • Document current workflows covering request, procurement, receiving, inventory/stockroom, assignment, refresh, return, and retirement • Identify gaps in data quality, process efficiency, controls, and reporting

HAM Pro Capability Alignment • Provide expertise on ServiceNow HAM Pro capabilities and how they map to current processes • Educate stakeholders on out\-of\-box functionality vs configuration vs customization • Recommend standardized approaches aligned with ServiceNow best practices • Define opportunities to eliminate manual work, improve controls, and increase automation

4\. HAM Pro Configuration Implementation • Lead hands\-on configuration of HAM Pro from the ground up, including: o HAM Pro activation and foundational setup o Guided setup execution o Lifecycle workflows and process automation o Stockroom and inventory management o Asset tracking and movement controls • Configure hardware normalization and content services • Ensure proper setup of: o Model normalization o Manufacturer/product data standardization o Lifecycle attribute enrichment • Configure integrations or define requirements for upstream/downstream systems (e.g., procurement, discovery tools, HR systems)
  
5\. Process Mapping Gap Resolution • Map current processes to the proposed ServiceNow design • Identify mismatches between existing practices and HAM Pro capabilities • Recommend and drive process improvements or standardization • Ensure solution is operationally practical and sustainable
  
6\. Testing Validation • Develop and execute end\-to\-end lifecycle test scenarios • Validate: o Asset creation, receiving, assignment, movement, and retirement o Stockroom and inventory transactions o Data quality and normalization outcomes • Support UAT and resolve defects or gaps • Ensure a fully functional, production\-ready solution
  
**7\. Documentation Knowledge Transfer • Deliver:** o Solution design documentation o Configuration documentation o Process flows and SOPs • Conduct knowledge transfer sessions for platform and operations teams • Enable internal teams to independently operate and enhance HAM Pro post go\-live Required Qualifications • 5\+ years of ServiceNow platform experience • Proven experience implementing ServiceNow HAM Pro in an enterprise environment • Strong understanding of: o Hardware asset lifecycle management o CMDB and asset relationships o ServiceNow data model (assets, models, CIs) • Hands\-on experience with: o HAM Pro configuration and lifecycle workflows o Hardware normalization and content services o Stockroom and inventory management • Experience integrating HAM with: o Procurement systems o Discovery/CMDB data sources • Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills

title: SAP BW HANA ABAP
description:
Job Description
 



**Job Title: SAP BW / HANA / ABAP Developer** 




**Location: Remote** 




  





 Position summary
 



 We are looking for a strong SAP BW/HANA Developer with deep, hands\-on expertise across BW/BW4HANA data modelling, native SAP HANA development, and ABAP/ABAP\-on\-HANA programming. This role demands core technical strength — not surface familiarity — in all four pillars: BW, HANA, ABAP, and HANA SQL. The ideal candidate can independently design data models, write performant HANA SQL/SQLScript, and build custom ABAP logic across the data layer.
 



 Core Skills — Must Be Strong
 



 • SAP BW / BW4HANA — data modelling, ADSOs, CompositeProviders, transformations, process chains, query design.
 



 • SAP HANA — calculation views (graphical \& script\-based), analytic/attribute views, modelling best practices.
 



 • ABAP — core ABAP development, OOABAP, and ABAP on HANA (code pushdown, AMDP).
 



 • HANA SQL / SQLScript — advanced query writing, performance tuning, stored procedures, table functions.
 



 Candidates should be able to speak to real project depth in each of these four areas, not just one or two — this is a strong\-hands\-on\-all\-round profile, not a specialist in a single tool.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Design, build, and optimize BW/BW4HANA data models (ADSO, CompositeProvider, Open ODS View, InfoObjects).
 



 • Develop calculation views, analytic views, and complex SQLScript\-based logic in native HANA.
 



 • Write and maintain ABAP programs, function modules, and AMDP\-based transformation routines.
 



 • Tune HANA SQL queries and data models for performance — partitioning, indexing, and execution plan analysis.
 



 • Build and maintain DTPs, transformation rules, and process chains for reliable, monitored data loads.
 



 • Integrate BW/HANA outputs with reporting layers (BEx, SAP Analytics Cloud, or equivalent BI tools).
 



 • Troubleshoot data load failures, performance bottlenecks, and data reconciliation issues across the BW/HANA stack.
 



 • Collaborate with functional teams to translate business/reporting requirements into technical data models.
 



 • Document technical designs, data models, and transformation logic; support testing and go\-live activities.
 



 Required Qualifications
 



 Experience
 



 • 5\-8\+ years of overall SAP experience, with strong hands\-on exposure to BW/BW4HANA, native HANA modelling, and ABAP.
 



 • Demonstrated project experience writing HANA SQL/SQLScript for performance\-critical data logic.
 



 • Experience with ABAP on HANA — code pushdown techniques, AMDP, and HANA\-optimized ABAP.
 



 Technical Skills
 



 • Strong command of BW LSA/LSA\+\+ architecture, InfoObjects, transformations, and process chain monitoring.
 



 • Hands\-on HANA modelling: calculation views (graphical and SQLScript\-based), analytic/attribute views.
 



 • Proficient in Core ABAP, OOABAP, and debugging complex custom developments.
 



 • Strong SQL fundamentals with the ability to write and tune complex HANA SQL queries and stored procedures.
 



 • Familiarity with SAP source system extraction (ECC/S4HANA) and RFC\-based connections.
 



 Education
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
 



 Good to Have
 



 • Exposure to SAP Datasphere or SAP BW/4HANA migration/conversion projects.
 



 • Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) or other BI/reporting tool integration.
 



 • Knowledge of SAP BTP and OData\-based data consumption.
 



 • Exposure to S/4HANA data structures (Universal Journal / ACDOCA) is a plus.
 



 Preferred Certifications
 



 • SAP Certified Application Associate — SAP BW/4HANA
 



 • SAP Certified Development Associate — ABAP with SAP HANA
 



 • SAP Certified Technology Associate — SAP HANA
 



 Soft Skills \& Attributes
 



 • Strong analytical mindset with a bias toward performance and data accuracy.
 



 • Able to work independently on complex technical builds with minimal hand\-holding.
 



 • Good communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration with business and BI teams.
 



 • Comfortable in Agile/Scrum delivery environments handling multiple concurrent workstreams.

**Job Overview**

This position combines Salesforce development expertise with platform administration responsibilities to ensure a stable, efficient, and scalable environment.
   

  

 The role focuses on applying engineering best practices to automate routine administrative and deployment activities, minimizing manual effort and operational risk while enabling reliable, version\-controlled delivery through robust CI/CD processes.

In addition, the role supports the growth and technical management of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including platform operations, data management, user support, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Own core Salesforce administration activities including user management, permissions, security, configuration, data quality and declarative automation using Flow.

* Strong engineering and problem\-solving mindset, with a focus on automation, reliability and continuous improvement.

title: Software Engineer
description:
### **Location \- Hybrid**



This is a hybrid role based out of our Gurugram, India office, 3 days in the office, 2 days remote.


### **About Us**



Sauce Labs is the world's largest full\-lifecycle, test automation platform, and the company behind Selenium. Trusted by 80% of the world's top ten largest financial institutions and over 300,000 enterprise users, Sauce Labs provides the only AI platform capable of turning business intent into autonomous testing and quality assurance. With a proprietary dataset of 8\.7 billion test runs, Sauce Labs empowers the Fortune 2000 to bridge the gap between AI\-driven code generation and enterprise\-grade software quality. Learn more at http://saucelabs.com.


**Release Assurance at the Speed of AI \|****Meet the new Sauce Labs**


### **About the Team**



We're a small advanced tech team that takes ideas from "someone had a hunch" to "customers are using it"—usually in days, not sprints. This is a high ownership team: talking to whoever has the problem, deciding what's worth building, cutting scope, shipping, and then deciding whether to double down or move on.


### **Required Skills**



Deep fluency in at least one modern general\-purpose language—and the ability to pick up others quickly. We work across TypeScript/Node, Go, and Python, and you'll touch more than one. We care far more that you know one language inside out—its type system, concurrency model, testing story, etc.—than that you've used our specific stack. An ideal candidate would be comfortable:


* Reading and modifying an unfamiliar codebase without a guided tour
* Writing and maintaining tests that hold up in CI, not just on your laptop
* Publishing and versioning something other people depend on — a CLI, an SDK, a package
* Debugging across a boundary you don't own (a third\-party API, someone else's service, a CI runner)


Please note our Privacy Policy for Applicants when applying for a job at Sauce Labs.



Sauce Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity/expression/status, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.



Security responsibilities at Sauce



At Sauce, we will commit to supporting the health and safety of employees and properties, partnering with internal stakeholders to learn and act on ever\-evolving security protocols and procedures. You'll be expected to fully comply with all policies and procedures related to security at the department and org wide level and exercise a 'security first' approach to how we design, build \& run our products and services.

Panels and Systems, SCADA systems and Sub\-Station Automation Systems. Required energy reports are
  

provided as part of the system.


Our team of experts is available to dispense expert technical support, and provide technical solutions to
  

questions ranging from generic to complex. We consider excellence of products and service as a key to
  

gaining customer loyalty and satisfaction. We have pan India presence via dealer and distribution
  

network.

  

  

All the products we offer can be viewed on our website www.mbcontrol.com. We have clients such as in
  

power generation (wind, solar, hydro etc.), OEM, Transmission, IPP, CPP, Heavy Industries etc.


**Achieve your potential \- build an exciting career**  



Discover the opportunity to join a dynamic, and responsible company that fosters the development of
  

all its people and communities around the world. Every day, we challenge employees to achieve more
  

and experience exciting careers.

  

  

**JOB PROFILE:**

We are seeking a skilled IoT Engineer to design, develop, and integrate IIoT solutions for power,
  

renewable energy, SCADA, telemetry, and energy management applications. The role involves full\-
  

stack development, mobile applications, industrial protocols, field\-device integration, cloud and edge
  

systems, and real\-time data platforms. Experience with AI\-assisted coding agents, protocol
  

troubleshooting, MQTT, BLE, Python, and hardware validation is highly valued, along with strong
  

documentation, testing, and problem\-solving skills.


Designation: Cloud Native IOT Software Engineer


Department: Research \& Development


Reports to: Senior IOT Engineer


Location: Full Time On\-Site, Howrah


**Must have**  

  

* Node.js and JavaScript, with Express REST APIs in production
* React — hooks, routing, state management, a component library such as MUI
* Kotlin and Android, ideally Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose; iOS/Swift exposure
* MongoDB and Mongoose — schema design, queries, indexes
* TypeScript — or clear readiness to move to it; new work is TS\-first
* Git, code review, and writing tests that mean something
* Comfort reading a protocol spec and a message dump side by side, and trusting the dump
* Clear written English — our projects run on written specs, plans and open\-item registers

  

**Strong plus**  

  

* MQTT (Mosquitto, MQTT 5, QoS, retained messages) or similar pub/sub messaging
* Bluetooth Low Energy — GATT services, characteristics, MTU, notifications, connection lifecycle
* Python for tooling, test harnesses and simulators
* Industrial protocols and hardware — Modbus RTU, RS\-485, XBee, IEDs, inverters, energy meters, weather sensors
* SQLite and query builders such as Kysely
* SCADA, energy or utility domain experience
* Bash scripting, CLI tools and git hooks
* Building MCP servers or other API integrations in Python

  

**Agentic coding — required**  

  

We work with AI coding agents daily, mainly Claude Code, and it is part of the job rather than a side experiment.
  

  

**You should be able to**:
  

  

* Drive an agent through real work — multi\-file changes, refactors, debugging against live hardware — not just

autocomplete
  

* Write and maintain the context that agents run on: project specs, plans, open\-item registers

CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md files, and reusable skills
  

* Set up guardrails — hooks, gated workflows, permission settings — so an agent's output stays reviewable and safe
* Review agent output critically. You own every line that lands, and you are expected to catch the confident\-but\-wrong

answer. This matters more than speed
  

* Know when not to use one: hardware bring\-up, protocol reverse\-engineering and judgment calls still need a human at

the bench
  

  

Prior experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar is expected. Tell us about a non\-trivial piece of work you
  

shipped this way, including what the agent got wrong.
  

  

**How we work**  

  

* Written first — every project carries a spec, a plan and a single register of open items
* Small trunk\-based repos, reviewed commits, local CI checks before push
* Work tracked in Open Project
* Verify against real devices; a passing test on a simulator is not a finished feature

* Findings get written down and stay written down, so the next person isn't re\-deriving them
  

  

**Qualifications:**  



 Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science, or related
  

Engineering field.


 Minimum Exp. 3\-4 years


 Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.


 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.


 Good communication and documentation abilities.


 Ability to work independently and in multidisciplinary teams.
  

 Location: Howrah

title: Senior Developer - Python/LLMs/RAG/AI Agents (7-12 years)
description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* You have deep experience in distributed systems and scalable application design, with strong hands\-on skills in LLMs, advanced RAG patterns, and agentic workflows.
* Experience building agentic workflows on SAP AI Core and integrating LLM\-based features into CAP Java applications is expected.
* Proficiency in system design for scale, resiliency, and fault tolerance is required.
* Strong experience in performance optimization, cost management, and troubleshooting complex production systems is essential.
* A solid understanding of SRE principles, observability (logs, metrics, tracing), and incident management is expected — including Open Telemetry instrumentation and SAP Cloud Logging dashboards.
* Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI systems, validating model behavior, and applying agentic engineering patterns is critical.
* You use Claude\-style tools to generate code and ideas, but you read and challenge their output — you know when the AI is making the wrong call in both code and design.
* Familiarity with multi\-tenant SaaS architecture on SAP BTP (MTX, service\-manager, IAS/AMS) is a strong advantage.


**Four Values Matter At Every Level**
* Learning agility (non\-negotiable, and the most important value) — you rapidly pick up new models, frameworks, SAP Technologies, ontologies, and industry processes. You enjoy updating your mental model as the landscape shifts, which it will, frequently.
* Bias for action — you move quickly from ambiguity to a working prototype and learn through execution.
* Critical thinking — you ask the right questions, so we stay focused on the objective instead of just managing the day.
* End\-to\-end ownership — you own the outcome from problem definition through build, deployment, and evaluation.


**What You'll Build**
* You'll independently design and architect scalable, AI\-native application systems and components, including advanced RAG pipelines and multi\-agent workflows.
* You'll design and build AI agents integrated into GHRA's revenue accounting domain — including formula explanation, disposition computation assistance, and production volume analysis — using SAP AI Core and Python as primary programming language, CAP in Java will be secondary programming language.
* You'll contribute to the design of ontology\-grounded agents for the domain, encoding accounting rules, formula structures, and ownership relationships as structured knowledge that agents can reason over reliably, rather than relying on prompt\-only approaches.
* Evaluation and benchmarking frameworks to measure AI system quality, reliability, and performance are things you'll build and own. This includes domain\-specific test harnesses that validate LLM outputs against known good formula results and accounting rules — and the honest memo that explains why an idea shouldn't ship.
* You'll optimize latency, throughput, and cost efficiency across systems — including HANA Cloud query optimization and AI Core inference cost management.
* Observability and SRE practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root cause analysis, are areas you'll implement and improve — specifically enabling OTEL tracing across the CAP microservice fleet and building Cloud Logging dashboards for cross\-service visibility.
* You'll partner with platform, data, and AI teams to design robust, production\-ready solutions and improve system integration. System scalability, resilience, and maintainability are areas you'll continuously work to strengthen.


**Where you belong**
 If you need stable, well\-defined requirements before you can start, this role will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather supervise an AI than trust it blindly, and you want to be the technical bridge between a complex accounting domain and an AI platform, keep reading. You'll take end\-to\-end technical ownership of critical systems and contribute to engineering excellence across the team. You'll be the technical bridge between GHRA's domain logic (royalty, production volumes, ownership allocation) and the AI platform layer — translating accounting business rules into context that agents can reason over reliably. Mentoring less\-experienced engineers, guiding design and code quality, and building strong technical capabilities within the team are all part of the role. The team operates across global, cross\-functional groups in a culture that values continuous improvement, operational excellence, and knowledge sharing.
   

  

**Bring out your best**
