title: Junior/Senior or Staff Software Engineer, Inference / Compute Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**About The Role**
**REMOTE IN INDIA**
 We're looking for a software engineer to build the Kubernetes\-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. You'll design a manifest\-driven API where the inference team declares what they need, whether that's a cluster, a model deployment, or a capacity change, and our controllers handle the reconciliation, provider/runtime selection, and lifecycle management underneath, so the inference team never has to know or care which specific serving stack, scheduler, or hardware pool is doing the work. You'll also build the systems that keep the fleet efficient, not just running, including defragmentation and rebalancing logic that consolidates scattered workloads back into contiguous capacity, and scheduling/bin\-packing improvements that push GPU utilization up without hurting latency. The core value we're after is decoupling the people building on top of the platform from the operational and runtime complexity underneath, while squeezing more usable capacity out of the same hardware. You'll build the controllers, reconciliation loops, and self\-service surface (API/CLI, not tickets) that make that decoupling real, plus the event\-driven health, remediation, and utilization systems that keep it running and efficient without a human in the loop. Strong candidates have hands\-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, have built or operated a platform API that abstracts multiple backends behind one interface, understand GPU scheduling and capacity efficiency (fragmentation, bin\-packing, right\-sizing), and think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered.
   

  

 A product mindset \- you've built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.
 **You build it, you own it.** 
 You are not only responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build the provisioning state machine: design and implement the software that models the full lifecycle of a physical host from discovery, inference bring\-up to GPU driver/CUDA stack, health validation, and decommission/RMA — as explicit, versioned states and transitions.
* Build the self\-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.
* Automate self\-healing: detect degraded or failed nodes, drain them safely, trigger repair or replacement, and reintroduce healthy capacity into the pool automatically.
* Own reliability of the pipeline: idempotency, retries, rollback, and drift detection so the provisioning system is as dependable as any other production service.
* Partner with the inference/ML platform team: understand the cluster shapes they need — topology, interconnect, scheduling constraints — and encode them as first\-class abstractions in the platform.
* Engineer it like software: strong typing, automated tests, code review, versioning, and CI/CD for infrastructure code — this is a product, not a collection of Ansible playbooks.


**Requirements**
 Core requirements (all levels):
   

  

* Strong software engineering background in Go, Python, Rust, or similar — you write and test real software for a living.
* Experience with durable workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal, Cadence, or equivalent to run long\-lived, manifest\-driven workflows that survive failures and resume mid\-execution.
* Experience building software control planes or orchestration systems that model state and reconcile it over time (e.g., Kubernetes controllers/operators, custom reconciliation loops, workflow engines).
* Experience with event\-driven systems — designing and building software around message queues, event streams, or pub/sub (e.g., Kafka, NATS, SQS) rather than polling or cron\-driven scripts.
* A product mindset. You’ve built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.


**Nice To Have**
* Exposure to bare\-metal provisioning (PXE/iPXE, Redfish/IPMI, BMC) and/or networking fundamentals (VLANs, BGP, fabric design), or GPU/accelerator infrastructure.
* Experience with GPU cluster software stacks (NCCL, CUDA, InfiniBand/RoCE).
* Prior work at a hyperscaler, GPU cloud, or datacenter\-scale infrastructure organization.
* Systems programming in Rust or Go.


**About Together AI**
 Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

title: Senior Software Engineer- DataScience
description:
BOLD is seeking for newest addition to our existing Data Science team, you’ll combine your analytical skills and business knowledge to deliver key insights to our Product and Management teams. You’ll help drive product development using our vast user data sets to enhance our current products and to help us find inferences and relationships in this data to build new products – More towards the role required
   

  

**Job Description**
**ABOUT THIS TEAM**
 The Data Science department at BOLD is responsible for discovering patterns and trends in datasets to get insights, creating predictive algorithms and data models, improving the quality of data or product offerings by utilizing machine learning techniques, distributing suggestions to other teams and top management, and using data tools such as Python and SQL.
   

  

 The Data Science team actively collaborates with other vertical teams such as Engineering, Portals, BI, Product, Legal. Most of the projects are focused around problems that require a mix of natural language processing and machine learning. Some of the active projects are resume parsing, ranking, summary generation, data quality and scoring, content generation, job recommendations, and conversion analysis. Apart from the business initiatives, the team also explores state of the art methods and keeps them upto to date with technology.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
* Demonstrate ability to work on data science projects involving predictive modelling, NLP, statistical analysis, vector space modelling, machine learning etc.
* Leverage our rich data sets of user data to perform research, develop models and create data products with our Development \& Product teams
* Develop novel and scalable data systems in cooperation with our system architects that leverage datasets using machine learning techniques to enhance the user experience
* Evolve prompt engineering applications and benchmark different Large Language models to solve business problems.
* Implement and experiment with agentic workflows to improve the job seeker experience.


**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**
* Knowledge and experience using statistical and machine learning algorithms including regression, instance\-based learning, decision trees, Bayesian statistics, clustering, neural networks, deep learning, ensemble methods
* Expert knowledge in Python.
* Experience in feature selection, building and optimising classifiers.
* Experience working with backend technologies such as Flask/ Gunicorn etc.
* Experience on working with open source library such Spacy,NLTK,Gensim etc
* Experience on working with deep\-learning library such as Tensor flow, Pytorch etc
* Experience with software stack components including common programming languages, back\-end technologies, database modelling, continuous integration, services oriented architecture, software testability etc.
* Be a keen learner and enthusiastic about developing software.
* Experience with prompt engineering, chain\-of\-thought, retrieval augmented generation, vector databases and preferably llm agents.
* Langchain and/or Llamaindex.


**WHAT'S GOOD TO HAVE**
* Experience with Cloud infrastructure and platforms (Azure, AWS)
* Experience using tools to deploy models into the production environment such as Jenkins
* Experience with the ontology/taxonomies of the career/ recruiting domain e.g. O\*Net – NR


**EXPERIENCE\-**
* Senior Software Engineer\-4\.5 years\+


**BENEFITS**
**Outstanding Compensation**
* Competitive salary
* Tax\-friendly compensation structure
* Bi\-annual bonus
* Annual Appraisal
* Equity in company


**100% Full Health Benefits**
* Group Mediclaim, personal accident, \& term life insurance
* Group Mediclaim benefit (including parents' coverage)
* Online Health (OPD) Consultation Benefit
* Personal accident and term life insurance coverage


**Flexible Time Away**
* 24 days paid leaves
* Declared fixed holidays
* Paternity and maternity leave
* Compassionate and marriage leave
* Covid leave (up to 7 days)


**ADDITIONAL BENEFITS**
* Internet and home office reimbursement
* In\-office catered lunch, meals, and snacks
* Certification policy
* Cab pick\-up and drop\-off facility


**About BOLD**
**We Transform Work Lives**
 As an established global organization, BOLD helps people find jobs. Our story is one of growth, success, and professional fulfillment. We create digital products that have empowered millions of people in 180 countries to build stronger resumes, cover letters, and CVs. The result of our work helps people interview confidently, finding the right job in less time. Our employees are experts, learners, contributors, and creatives.
   

  

**We Celebrate And Promote Diversity And Inclusion**
 We value our position as an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire based on qualifications, merit, and our business needs. We don't discriminate regarding race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, national origin or citizenship, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other applicable characteristic protected by law.

 The Alexa AI org is looking for a Principal Engineer to join Aurora (Alexa Understanding, Runtime, ORchestration, and Applied Sciences) — Alexa's AI runtime backbone and horizontal intelligence organization.  You will be building AI experiences that work across the full spectrum of human interaction — multi\-modal (speech, text, image, video), multi\-lingual (global locales with distinct linguistic and cultural requirements), and multi\-model (orchestrating and routing across frontier and specialized AI models to optimize for accuracy, latency, and cost). * Define the long\-term technical strategy for how Alexa\+ delivers high\-quality, low\-latency AI experiences to a global customer base, including the evolution of model integration patterns as the AI landscape rapidly changes
* Shape AURORA’s platform vision to empower internal and external engineers and scientists worldwide with modular, reusable platforms that accelerate innovation — while delivering accurate, responsive, and reliable conversational experiences to millions of end\-users through operational excellence at scale

* Deep expertise in distributed systems, ML inference infrastructure, or large\-scale AI platform engineering
* Demonstrated ability to define technical direction in ambiguous, high\-stakes problem spaces with significant customer and business impact
* Experience driving cross\-functional alignment across science, engineering, and product organizations — particularly in environments where unified ownership across research, runtime, and evaluation accelerates delivery

* Passion for building AI that is genuinely useful and trustworthy for real people

* Define best practices for system architecture and engineering processes, maintaining high standards for software quality and operational excellence
* Lead engineering efforts that directly enhance customer experiences and business outcomes through Alexa\+ and GenAI powered services.

Senior Autonomous Systems / Flight Software Engineer (On\-Site)
   

  

**Location:** 
 R\&D Center \& Robotics Lab (Full\-Time, 100% In\-Office)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4–8 Years
   

  

**Department:** 
 Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) Flight Control \& Autonomy
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an expert
 **Autonomous Flight Software Engineer** 
 to build the onboard intelligence and navigation algorithms that power our next\-generation enterprise drone fleets. In this hands\-on, on\-site role, you will work directly inside our hardware robotics lab and engineering headquarters. You will bridge low\-level sensor integration with high\-level path planning, enabling uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) to execute complex, GPS\-denied, and fully autonomous missions for industrial inspection and logistics.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities \& Detailed Breakdown:** 
**1\. Flight Control \& Guidance Algorithm Development**
* Design, implement, and test advanced guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) algorithms for fixed\-wing and multi\-rotor UAV platforms.
* Integrate and tune open\-source flight controller stacks (such as PX4 or ArduPilot) with custom hardware payloads and companion computers (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson).
* Develop real\-time state estimation frameworks using sensor fusion techniques (Extended Kalman Filters combining IMU, GPS, LiDAR, and optical flow cameras).
* Autonomous Navigation \& Computer Vision Integration
* Build collision\-avoidance, obstacle\-detection, and real\-time path\-replanning algorithms using computer vision and point\-cloud data (OpenCV, PCL, ROS/ROS2\).
* Program autonomous mapping, waypoint navigation, and target\-tracking workflows designed for BVLOS (Beyond Visual Line of Sight) operations.
* Optimize edge\-AI inference pipelines running on drone companion boards to process imagery or telemetry locally in real\-time.
* Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) \& Lab Testing
* Conduct rigorous Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) and Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) simulation tests using tools like Gazebo or AirSim to validate flight safety before physical test flights.
* Partner face\-to\-face with electrical and mechanical hardware engineers in our robotics lab to debug sensor faults, actuator lags, and power\-distribution anomalies.
* Participate in ground\-station setup, telemetry logging analysis, and field\-test post\-mortems immediately following outdoor flight trials.
* Safety Compliance \& System Reliability
* Ensure all flight software meets rigorous safety\-critical fault\-tolerance standards, including fail\-safe return\-to\-home protocols and geofencing limits.
* Maintain clean version control, unit test coverage, and documentation for all onboard code modules in adherence to aviation and industrial compliance standards.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 
  

  

* Work Mode: 100% On\-site commitment with daily physical presence in our engineering lab, test bench facilities, and development hub.
* Core Technical Stack:
+ Advanced proficiency in C\+\+ and Python (Linux/Ubuntu environment).
+ Deep experience with ROS / ROS2 (Robot Operating System).
+ Hands\-on familiarity with flight control firmware (PX4 / ArduPilot) and MAVLink communication protocols.
+ Experience with simulation environments (Gazebo, AirSim) and sensor fusion frameworks.

* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of drone aerodynamics, coordinate frames (NED/ENU), PID controllers, and payload integration (thermal cameras, LiDAR, multi\-spectral sensors).
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or equivalent practical systems engineering experience.


**Why Join Us On\-Site?**
 Developing software for flying hardware requires tight coordination. Being physically present in our robotics lab allows you to push code, mount the companion computer directly onto the drone airframe, and test modifications on the physical test bench within minutes.

title: BI Developer
description:

 As a BI Developer, you will play a key role in enabling data\-driven decision making across Koch businesses by designing and delivering impactful visualization solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and global teams to transform complex data into intuitive dashboards and visual products that create value. This role offers the opportunity to work across multiple business domains while leveraging modern BI technologies to solve meaningful business challenges.

 The Analytics Visualization team is part of a global organization that designs, develops, and delivers innovative analytics solutions across Koch businesses. Supporting Koch Engineered Solutions (KES) and other Koch companies, the team partners with business leaders to create scalable reporting, visualization, and analytics products that improve decision making and business performance.
   

  

 Working within Koch Global Services in India, you will collaborate with colleagues across multiple regions and functions, gaining exposure to diverse business processes, global stakeholders, and advanced analytics initiatives.

* Share technical knowledge, mentor peers, and contribute to continuous improvement within the analytics community.
* Collaborate effectively with global teams across multiple time zones.

* 5\+ years of experience developing business intelligence and visualization solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik Sense.
* Experience creating dashboards that deliver actionable business insights and support decision making.
* Experience writing and optimizing complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
* Experience working with multiple data sources and integrating data into BI visualization platforms.
* Knowledge of data modeling concepts and techniques, including data model optimization.
* Experience implementing security models and role\-based access controls within BI solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment supporting multiple projects and priorities.


**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience visualizing and analyzing unstructured data.
* Experience working with SAP HANA.
* Experience within a Data Analytics Center of Excellence (CoE) environment.
* Experience supporting global business organizations and cross\-functional teams.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.


*At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.*

 At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical issues to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

* Effective communication and collaboration skills; ability to work as part of a team.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.

* Adaptable, detail\-oriented, and motivated to learn new ServiceNow and Gen AI/automation features as they emerge.

* Experience implementing additional ServiceNow modules such as Customer Service Management (CSM), Integrated Risk Management (IRM), HR Service Delivery (HRSD), or Security Operations (SecOps).

* Familiarity with Agile or SDLC testing cycles.
* Experience with day\-to\-day ServiceNow platform administration.

 Majorly look for resources who has handled migration projects \- Tableau to PBI. They should also have a decent grasp of PBI.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work on a broad range of data analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence initiatives across multiple industries. The role requires strong analytical skills, frequent client interaction, and the ability to translate business problems into effective analytical and BI solutions while collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on expertise in Tableau, along with a good understanding of Power BI and DAX, and practical experience in migrating Tableau dashboards and reports to Power BI.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Work on a wide range of data analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence problems across various industries.
* Engage with clients and business stakeholders to understand business context, objectives, and challenges.
* Analyze and document business processes, mapping end\-to\-end workflows using visual formats such as process flow diagrams.
* Translate business problems into analytical solutions by defining metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and reports.
* Develop, publish, and maintain interactive dashboards and visualizations using Tableau and Power BI.
* Perform Tableau\-to\-Power BI migration, including assessment of existing Tableau dashboards, reports, data sources, calculations, and business logic.
* Translate Tableau functionality such as calculated fields, LOD expressions, filters, parameters, and data models into equivalent Power BI implementations.
* Develop and optimize Power BI reports, data models, measures, and DAX expressions.
* Perform storyboarding to structure analytical insights and present clear, compelling narratives to stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams by providing clear and detailed requirements.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and adherence to best practices in reporting and analytics delivery.
* Perform QC checks and validation of reports and dashboards before client delivery, particularly during migration projects.
* Participate in regular client and internal meetings and prepare clear MoM (Minutes of Meeting) documentation.
* Maintain proper documentation for dashboards, metrics, data logic, business rules, and migration activities.
* Track work items, enhancements, and issues using JIRA.


**Mandatory Skills \& Requirements**
* 3–6 years of relevant Data Analytics / BI experience with a strong focus on problem\-solving and advanced BI solutions.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Tableau, including:
+ Dashboard development and publishing
+ Calculated fields, filters, parameters, and LOD calculations
+ Data blending and joins
+ Row\-Level Security (RLS)
+ Replacing and managing data sources

* Hands\-on experience in Tableau\-to\-Power BI migration projects is mandatory.
* Good hands\-on understanding of Power BI, including:
+ Report and dashboard development
+ Data modelling
+ Measures and calculated columns
+ Power Query
+ RLS
+ Report publishing and workspace management

* Strong understanding of DAX, including writing and optimizing measures, filter context, calculated tables/columns, and commonly used DAX functions.
* Ability to assess existing Tableau dashboards and translate their business logic, calculations, data models, and visualizations into Power BI.
* Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, validation, and analysis.
* Ability to perform QC checks and validation on dashboards and reports.
* Experience preparing MoM, requirement documents, functional documentation, and migration\-related documentation.
* Hands\-on experience working with JIRA for task tracking and project management.


**Desired Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to handle complex business problems.
* Proven experience interacting with clients and business stakeholders for requirement gathering and solution design.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly through effective storyboarding and data narratives.
* Ability to independently manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and deliverables.
* Experience in BI modernization, dashboard rationalization, or visualization migration initiatives.
* Understanding of best practices for Power BI performance optimization and DAX optimization.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in B.E., B.Tech, or an equivalent discipline.

title: BI Developer
description:
**Your Job**
As a BI Developer, you will play a key role in enabling data\-driven decision making across Koch businesses by designing and delivering impactful visualization solutions. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, and global teams to transform complex data into intuitive dashboards and visual products that create value. This role offers the opportunity to work across multiple business domains while leveraging modern BI technologies to solve meaningful business challenges.


**Our Team**


The Analytics Visualization team is part of a global organization that designs, develops, and delivers innovative analytics solutions across Koch businesses. Supporting Koch Engineered Solutions (KES) and other Koch companies, the team partners with business leaders to create scalable reporting, visualization, and analytics products that improve decision making and business performance.


Working within Koch Global Services in India, you will collaborate with colleagues across multiple regions and functions, gaining exposure to diverse business processes, global stakeholders, and advanced analytics initiatives.


**What You Will Do**  

  



* Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and visualization products using Power BI, Tableau, and other BI technologies.
* Create compelling visual storytelling solutions that highlight key business metrics, KPIs, and trends.
* Translate business requirements into scalable dashboard designs and data visualization strategies.
* Partner with business analysts and stakeholders to identify the most effective ways to communicate insights and analytical outcomes.
* Develop and optimize data models, visual layouts, calculations, and performance of BI solutions.
* Work with data from multiple domains including Supply Chain, Sales, Finance, Travel \& Expense, and Operational Excellence.
* Perform data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy, reliability, and usability of reporting solutions.
* Build and maintain dashboards supporting advanced analytics and predictive modeling initiatives.
* Implement and support role\-level security and enterprise reporting standards.
* Share technical knowledge, mentor peers, and contribute to continuous improvement within the analytics community.
* Collaborate effectively with global teams across multiple time zones.

  

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
* 5\+ years of experience developing business intelligence and visualization solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik Sense.
* Experience creating dashboards that deliver actionable business insights and support decision making.
* Experience writing and optimizing complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
* Experience working with multiple data sources and integrating data into BI visualization platforms.
* Knowledge of data modeling concepts and techniques, including data model optimization.
* Experience implementing security models and role\-based access controls within BI solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment supporting multiple projects and priorities.

  

**What Will Put You Ahead**
  

* Experience leading enterprise\-scale BI implementation projects.
* Experience managing or mentoring BI teams.
* Advanced expertise in Power BI or Tableau, including complex calculations, parameters, geographic mapping, and advanced visualization techniques.
* Tableau certification.
* Tableau Server Administration experience, including server setup, maintenance, migration, and high\-availability environments.
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Experience visualizing and analyzing unstructured data.
* Experience working with SAP HANA.
* Experience within a Data Analytics Center of Excellence (CoE) environment.
* Experience supporting global business organizations and cross\-functional teams.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.

  

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.
**Who We Are**

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.


Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

title: BI Developer – SSAS & MDX
description:
About This Role
**7 to 10 years of experience**  

**Skills: SSAS, MDX, SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, Power BI, DAX, Data Modelling, ETL, Dimensional Modelling, Star / Snowflake Schema, T\-SQL, Azure Analysis Services, Performance Tuning, Agile**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a Senior BI Developer with 7\-10 years of experience and strong hands\-on expertise in SSAS and MDX to design, build, and maintain enterprise\-grade business intelligence solutions. You will combine deep SSAS Multidimensional and Tabular model expertise with strong MDX and DAX skills — delivering high\-performance analytical solutions that support business decision\-making across the organisation.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain SSAS Multidimensional and Tabular models — building enterprise\-grade analytical cubes and models aligned to business reporting requirements.
* Write and optimise complex MDX queries and calculations — calculated members, named sets, KPIs, and performance\-tuned MDX expressions across SSAS Multidimensional solutions.
* Develop DAX measures and calculated columns for SSAS Tabular models and Power BI — ensuring accurate, performant, and reusable analytical calculations.
* Design and maintain dimensional data models — star and snowflake schemas — aligned to data warehouse and BI best practices.
* Build and maintain ETL pipelines using SSIS — data extraction, transformation, and loading from source systems into the data warehouse and SSAS models.
* Develop SSRS reports and Power BI dashboards — delivering clear, accurate, and actionable business insights from SSAS data sources.
* Conduct SSAS performance tuning — cube partition design, aggregation optimisation, MDX query tuning, and processing performance improvement.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders — gathering reporting requirements and translating them into well\-designed SSAS and BI solutions.
* Support SSAS model upgrades and migrations — including migration from Multidimensional to Tabular or Azure Analysis Services where applicable.
* Produce clear technical documentation — cube design documents, MDX calculation guides, and ETL specifications.

**What We're Looking For**


* 7\-10 years of BI development experience with deep, demonstrable expertise in SSAS and MDX in production enterprise environments.


* Expert\-level SSAS Multidimensional proficiency — cube design, dimension modelling, measure groups, partitions, aggregations, and KPI development.


* Strong MDX skills — complex calculated members, named sets, scoped assignments, and performance\-optimised MDX expressions.


* Solid SSAS Tabular experience — DAX measures, relationships, and tabular model design alongside Multidimensional expertise.


* Advanced T\-SQL and SQL Server skills — complex querying, stored procedures, and query performance tuning for BI and data warehouse workloads.


* Strong dimensional modelling expertise — star / snowflake schema design, slowly changing dimensions, and data warehouse best practices.


* Solid SSIS experience — ETL pipeline design, development, and performance optimisation for data warehouse loading.


* Good Power BI skills — report and dashboard development integrated with SSAS Tabular and Multidimensional data sources.


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — diagnosing SSAS performance issues, MDX query problems, and data quality defects.


* Good communication and stakeholder engagement skills — translating complex BI requirements into well\-designed analytical solutions.

description:

 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in Python and knowledge about Golang, working with AWS cloud platforms, and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be experienced in Terraform, Docker, and message\-driven architectures. Additionally, familiarity with DevOps, security best practices, and AI\-assisted coding tools is highly desirable.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and maintain scalable microservices using Python and Golang.
* Deploy, monitor, and manage applications in AWS and Azure environments.
* Implement and optimize Kubernetes\-based containerized workloads.
* Automate infrastructure deployment using Terraform and Docker.
* Develop unit, component, and contract tests to ensure software reliability.
* Work with message\-driven architectures and integrate message systems.
* Ensure secure development practices, leveraging tools like Snyk and Dependabot.
* Optimize observability with monitoring tools such as Grafana.
* Leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate development, code review, and testing.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to improve system performance, security, and scalability.


**Required**
 Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

* Strong proficiency in Python
* Skilled in Golang.
* Extensive experience with AWS services.
* Experience with Azure services.
* Hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes and Docker.
* Proficiency in Terraform for infrastructure automation.
* Experience with unit, component, and contract testing.
* Experience with message\-driven architectures.


**Desired**
* Experience with observability tools like Grafana.
* Knowledge of NATS for messaging systems.
* Familiarity with security tools such as Snyk and Dependabot.
* Practical experience using AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) for code generation, refactoring, and productivity gains.


 More about OutSystems
   

  

 OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission\-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform.
   

  

 As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise\-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high\-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact.

title: Software Engineer (Secrets Manager)
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at www.bitwarden.com.
   

  

 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced Engineers \& Senior Engineers. As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden’s Secrets Manager team, you will lead the development of our dedicated secrets engine, machine\-to\-machine (M2M) authorization protocols, and developer\-focused CLI/SDKs. Looking ahead, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the core infrastructure that extends Secrets Manager into our next\-generation
 **AI Identity and Access** 
 management platform—securing ciphers, credentials, and API keys against the unique custody risks of autonomous AI agents and headless workloads.
   

  

 In alignment with our modern
 **True Ownership** 
 model, our engineers are "T\-shaped" professionals who own their services end\-to\-end—from initial design and secure development to automated testing, deployment, and operational health in production \[cite: Transforming Engineering Through Ownership]. You will collaborate closely in a synchronous "Embedded Trio" (Product, Design, and Engineering) to design and ship elegant, secure, and resilient code.
   

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
* Platform \& Feature Development: Design, build, and maintain high\-performance APIs, SDKs, and CLIs for Secrets Manager and our future AI Identity and Access security frameworks.
* Machine \& AI Identity Custody: Implement secure, zero\-knowledge machine authentication, scoped access tokens, and runtime secrets injection gateways that protect credentials from being exposed to parent AI models or local execution environments.
* Decoupled Architecture: Work within our Decoupled Platform Architecture to ensure Secrets Manager operates as a highly scalable, independent tenant using its own dedicated data stores and asynchronous event\-driven message networks.
* End\-to\-End Ownership: Own the automated testing, deployment pipelines, and production SRE health of your team's services, participating in on\-call rotations and postmortem analyses to drive continuous operational improvement.
* Developer Usability: Build usable, highly developer\-friendly API endpoints, integration libraries, and comprehensive technical documentation to lower the friction of secrets enrollment and machine onboarding.
* Security \& Compliance: Proactively threat\-model new services, remediate security vulnerabilities, and ensure our secrets engine maintains our strict, audited compliance standards .


**WHAT YOU BRING**
* Overall Experience: 3\-6 years in Software Engineering
* Technical Stack: Strong proficiency and experience in AI\-Led Development in Rust, C\# / .NET, or TypeScript (our core Secrets Manager SDK is built in Rust).
* Identity \& Secrets Management: Practical experience designing or integrating machine identity platforms, vaulting services, OAuth/OIDC, or token\-based authorization structures (e.g., JWT, access tokens, API keys).
* AI/Agent Security Interest: Curiosity or experience with the security implications of AI agent architectures, large language model (LLM) memory isolation, or sandboxed execution environments.
* T\-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Experience writing robust automated integration tests, maintaining containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), and using modern APM and SRE logging tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Grafana) to monitor services in production.
* Cryptographic Foundations: Solid grasp of symmetric/asymmetric encryption, zero\-knowledge protocols, and OS\-level secure storage APIs.
* Collaborative Mindset: Excitement to work in a high\-velocity, outcome\-driven environment using rapid prototyping and data\-driven prioritization.
* Open Source \& Communication: Excellent written communication and a strong passion for open\-source software, developer tooling, and modern internet security.


**A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US**
* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our \#growth\-club to continue personal and professional development.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

description:

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated**Java Developer**to join our dynamic technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of high\-performance, scalable, and reliable enterprise\-grade Java applications.


You will collaborate closely with product managers, system architects, QA engineers, and DevOps specialists to deliver robust software solutions that align with our business objectives. * **Documentation:**Maintain clear and up\-to\-date technical documentation, including API specifications, system diagrams, and deployment guides.

**4\. DevOps \& Continuous Improvement**
----------------------------------------


* **CI/CD Pipeline Integration:**Support the automation of build, test, and deployment processes using CI/CD tools.
* **Performance Tuning:**Monitor and optimize application performance, memory usage, and resource utilization in production and non\-production environments.

**Technical Requirements**
--------------------------


**Core Skills (Required)**

* **Java Expertise:**Strong proficiency in Core Java (Java 8/11/17\+), including deep understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, Multithreading, Concurrency, Collections, and Exception Handling.
* **Frameworks:**Extensive experience with the**Spring Ecosystem**(Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud) and**Hibernate/JPA**for Object\-Relational Mapping.
* **Web Services:**Proven experience designing and consuming**RESTful APIs**(JSON/XML).
* **Databases:**
	+ **Relational:**Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle.
	+ **NoSQL (Preferred):**Familiarity with MongoDB, Redis, or Cassandra.
* **Build \& Version Control:**Proficiency with build automation tools (**Maven**or**Gradle**) and version control systems (**Git**).
* **Testing Frameworks:**Experience with**JUnit**,**Mockito**, or similar testing libraries.

**Preferred \& Cloud Skills (Highly Desirable)**
------------------------------------------------


* **Cloud Platforms:**Experience deploying and managing applications on cloud infrastructure (**AWS**,**Azure**, or**Google Cloud Platform**).
* **Containerization \& Orchestration:**Familiarity with**Docker**and**Kubernetes**.
* **Microservices Architecture:**Understanding of distributed systems, service discovery, API gateways, and message brokers (e.g.,**Apache Kafka**,**RabbitMQ**).
* **CI/CD Tools:**Experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.
* **Security Best Practices:**Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OAuth2, OIDC, and secure coding practices.

--------------------------------

-------------------------------


* **Analytical Thinking:**Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to dissect complex technical challenges.
* **Communication:**Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET / Windows Services)
description:

 The Senior Software Engineer (.NET / Windows Services) is a technical leader responsible for designing, developing, and supporting mission\-critical Windows Services, backend processing applications, and enterprise integration solutions built on Microsoft technologies. This role focuses on building highly reliable, scalable, and performant long\-running services that support core business operations, data processing, system integrations, and automation workflows.

**Windows Services \& Backend Application Development**

* Develop and maintain integrations with internal and third\-party systems using APIs, file\-based interfaces, messaging technologies, and database\-driven workflows.
* Lead modernization initiatives by refactoring or migrating legacy VB.NET and .NET Framework Windows Services to modern .NET platforms.
* Implement robust exception handling, retry mechanisms, fault tolerance, and service recovery capabilities.
* Apply engineering best practices including SOLID principles, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, and maintainable architectural patterns.
* Produce secure, testable, and high\-performance solutions that support business\-critical operations.


**Technical Leadership**
* Lead complex development initiatives and provide technical ownership for critical Windows Service applications.
* Guide architecture decisions related to performance, scalability, maintainability, and operational reliability.
* Conduct comprehensive code reviews and mentor team members on development standards and best practices.
* Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and operational concerns early in the development lifecycle.
* Drive application modernization and continuous improvement initiatives across legacy and current platforms.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Partner with QA teams to improve test automation, application stability, and release quality.
* Work closely with Infrastructure and DevOps teams to optimize deployments, service monitoring, and operational support processes.
* Support Production Support and Operations teams in troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and issue resolution.
* Participate in release planning, risk assessment, and production readiness reviews.


**Database \& Integration Engineering**
* Design, develop, and optimize SQL Server database solutions supporting enterprise\-scale applications and processing services.
* Develop complex T\-SQL stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, and ETL\-related processes.
* Perform database performance tuning, index optimization, execution plan analysis, and query optimization.
* Design and implement integration solutions using:
+ REST APIs
+ SOAP services
+ Message queues
+ File transfers (CSV, XML, JSON)
+ SFTP integrations
+ Windows scheduled processes

* Collaborate with DBAs and architects on schema design, performance optimization, data governance, and security best practices.


**Performance, Monitoring \& Supportability**
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize Windows Services running in production environments.
* Implement comprehensive logging, monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic capabilities.
* Analyze service performance, memory consumption, application health, and system resource utilization.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive measures for recurring production issues.
* Follow secure coding standards and ensure compliance with organizational security requirements.


**Mentorship \& Continuous Improvement**
* Mentor junior and intermediate engineers through coaching, code reviews, and technical guidance.
* Contribute to development standards, reusable components, and shared frameworks.
* Promote automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, support procedures, and operational runbooks.
* Foster knowledge sharing and technical excellence across the team.


**Required**
**Skills \& Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of professional experience developing enterprise applications using C\#, .NET Framework, and/or .NET 6\+.
* Strong experience designing, developing, and supporting Windows Services, background processing applications, and scheduled jobs.
* Extensive knowledge of C\#, multithreading, asynchronous programming, and object\-oriented design principles.
* Experience maintaining and modernizing legacy VB.NET and .NET Framework applications.
* Strong SQL Server expertise, including:
+ Stored procedures
+ Query optimization
+ Database design
+ Performance tuning
+ Indexing strategies

* Experience implementing system integrations using APIs, file\-based interfaces, messaging platforms, and database\-driven workflows.
* Strong troubleshooting and production support experience within enterprise environments.
* Proficiency with Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and release management processes.
* Experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) development environments.


**Preferred**
* Experience developing Windows Services using .NET Worker Services and Background Services.
* Experience with enterprise job scheduling and automation platforms.
* Knowledge of messaging technologies such as MSMQ, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Kafka.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, ELK, App Insights, Grafana, or Datadog.
* Experience with cloud\-hosted service workloads in Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and deployment automation.
* Exposure to Docker and containerized background services.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Nice\-to\-Have Domain Experience**
* High\-volume transaction processing systems.
* File processing and data migration platforms.
* Financial services, market data, insurance, or enterprise operations systems.
* 24/7 business\-critical production support environments.

 IFS certifications (IFS Cloud Technical or Functional certifications).

title: Salesforce Developer & Administrator, Amazon Business India
description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Business India Salesforce Team is looking for a smart, motivated, and hands\-on Salesforce Developer \& Administrator to own and operate our shared production Salesforce instance supporting 500\+ internal and external users. This is a hybrid role that combines technical Salesforce development (Apex, integrations, Lightning) with platform administration (configuration, user management, data quality). You will be responsible for day\-to\-day operations, new feature delivery, integrations with internal tools and AWS services, and ensuring a smooth experience for business teams across Sales, Operations, and Customer Advisory.
   

  

 You will use your business judgement and technical experience to design and build compelling solutions for hundreds of internal customers in a fast\-paced, innovative environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Administration
   

  

* Manage configuration of Salesforce features including user management, security, custom objects, page layouts, validation rules, workflows, Flows, and Process Builders.
* Own platform hygiene: environment refresh, notification announcements, AppExchange product management, and systems maintenance.
* Manage Salesforce support requests and escalated administrative needs — provide prompt and complete resolution to technical challenges.
* Collaborate with product owners and business stakeholders on major project roll\-outs, including training and troubleshooting for end\-users.
* Monitor system health and proactively identify opportunities to leverage Salesforce in innovative ways to improve business processes and increase productivity.


 Development
   

  

* Design and develop Apex classes, triggers, and batch jobs to support complex business logic.
* Build and maintain Lightning Components and Visualforce pages for custom user interfaces.
* Develop and manage integrations with internal tools and AWS services using REST/SOAP APIs.
* Write and optimize SOQL/SOSL queries for reporting and data operations.
* Implement JavaScript and Python scripts for automation and tooling.
* Maintain version control (Git) and follow release management best practices.
* Ensure compliance with security protocols including SAML 2\.0, OAuth 2\.0, and SSL.
* Design and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations to connect Salesforce with AWS, Retail, and Ads platforms — enabling AI\-powered workflows across multi\-cloud ecosystems.
* Build and manage Einstein AI Copilot (EAC) configurations, prompt templates, and agent actions to enhance user productivity within Salesforce.
* Design, build, and maintain data models and data pipelines for Salesforce — including ETL/ELT processes, data lake integrations, and real\-time sync with external systems.


 Cross\-Cutting
   

  

* Partner with system product owners to deliver tailored solutions that support business requirements and drive tangible business value.
* Document root cause analysis steps, findings, and recommended solutions for recurring issues.
* Consult with stakeholders on application performance, scalability, and usability.

 Amazon Business is revolutionizing B2B commerce — a rapidly growing $50 billion global business building a future where businesses of all sizes can find, discover, and purchase everything they need with unprecedented ease and intelligence. **Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in a business\-to\-business (B2B) environment, high\-tech products/services
* Knowledge of and proficiency in the use of Python scripting language
* Experience working with Git or an equivalent distributed version control system
* Experience in AWS services
* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields
* Must have managed a Salesforce instance of 500\+ users
* Proficiency in JavaScript
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations or similar AI/LLM orchestration frameworks.
* Familiarity with data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, and data management within Salesforce ecosystems.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Salesforce certifications: Administrator, Platform Developer I / II.
* Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
* Cross\-functional team collaboration and stakeholder management experience.
* Data migration and release management experience.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Einstein AI Copilot (EAC), Agentforce, or similar AI\-native Salesforce features.

title: Software Engineer, Business Systems
description:
**Software Engineer, Business Systems**
---------------------------------------


**Function:** Business Technology \& Security — Business Systems


**Location:** Pune, India · Hybrid


**Reports to:** Product Manager, Business Systems


**Experience:** 2–4 years


**Short description**

Build and run the integrations, pipelines, automations and internal tools that connect Mindtickle's business systems — Salesforce, NetSuite, HRMS, Slack and Google Cloud. You take defined requirements and own the technical path end to end: design, build, ship, and keep it running.


**About the team**

Business Technology \& Security runs the systems, automation and security behind how Mindtickle operates. **Business Systems** is its build engine — the team that turns requirements from GTM, Finance, People Success, IT, Legal and Security into shipped systems: integrations, data pipelines, automations, internal tools and agents.



We are a small team. You will not be part of a traditional engineering squad with sprints and Scrum ceremonies. You will operate independently, usually owning a problem from a defined requirement through to a deployed, monitored solution — and then continuing to own it.


**The role**

You are the engineer on the team. When a system needs to talk to another system, when a manual process needs to become an automated one, when a tool needs to exist and doesn't — you build it.



Requirements come to you defined. The Product Manager and Business Systems Analyst own the business problem, the stakeholders, and the question of whether we should do it at all. **The technical path is entirely yours** — how it's designed, what it's built on, how it's tested, how it fails safely, and how it's supported once it's live.


**What you'll own**
**Building — about half your time** Integrations between business systems. Data pipelines. Automations that remove manual work from Finance, People Success, IT, Security and GTM. Internal tools and lightweight services. AI\-backed workflows and agents where they are the right answer, and conventional code where they are not.


**Running it — about a fifth of your time** You inherit a set of automations already in production and become their owner. Monitoring, alerting, incident response, and the unglamorous work of making inherited systems observable and documented. Nothing you build gets handed to someone else to support.


**Technical evaluation — about 15%** When the team is deciding whether to build or buy, or whether a vendor's API can actually do what the demo claimed, you build the prototype that answers it. Deep technical spikes, integration feasibility, and performance and security reality\-checks — against a requirement the Product Manager and Analyst have already defined.


**Migrations — about 15%** Data migration, field mapping, cutover scripts and system replacements as we move platforms.


**The shape of a typical week**
**Daily** — Writing Python with Claude Code. Reading vendor API documentation. Wiring REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and event\-driven flows. Debugging a sync that silently dropped records. Deploying to Cloud Run.


**Weekly** — Shipping an increment and demoing it. Working through requirements with the Product Manager and Analyst. Triaging what broke.


**Monthly** — One meaningful capability live in production, with monitoring, a runbook, and documentation good enough that someone else could pick it up.


**Stack**

Python · Google Apps Script · Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Firestore, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine) · REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, OAuth and service\-account authentication · Claude Code and modern AI tooling as a primary way of working · Git and CI/CD



Business systems you will integrate with: Salesforce, NetSuite, HRMS, Slack, Google Workspace, and the wider SaaS estate.


**What we're looking for**

We care about what you have built and kept alive, not the tools listed on your CV.


* **2–4 years** building software, integrations or automations in a professional environment
* **Strong Python**, and real fluency with APIs — authentication, rate limits, retries, idempotency, pagination, webhooks and event\-driven patterns
* **You have built integrations against SaaS APIs, not only configured them through consoles or drag\-and\-drop integration platforms**
* **Hands\-on cloud experience** (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure is fine) with a working understanding of how to compose services rather than follow a tutorial
* **End\-to\-end ownership you can point to** — a system you designed, built, shipped and then operated. Something that broke in production and you fixed it.
* **Debugging across system boundaries** — when two systems disagree about the same record, you can work out why
* **Testing and verification instinct** — you know your output is correct because you measured it, not because it ran without erroring
* **Fast on unfamiliar ground** — you have picked up a stack you didn't know and shipped it. This matters more to us than prior exposure to any specific technology.
* **Clear written communication** — design notes, runbooks, and documentation are part of the job, not an afterthought

**Nice to have**
* Building AI agents, tool\-use, and agentic workflows; MCP servers
* Exposure to business systems — CRM, ERP, HRIS, ITSM — and the SaaS ecosystem around them
* Data and pipeline work (BigQuery, ETL/ELT)
* Infrastructure\-as\-code

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer – Treasury Systems (Findur)**
========================================================

**Sr. Software Engineer – Treasury**
------------------------------------

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics, generating approximately USD 50 billion in annual revenue and employing more than 100,000 people worldwide. Operating in nearly 130 countries, we connect and simplify supply chains for customers across the globe through our unique combination of ocean, logistics and terminal services. Guided by our vision to become the Global Integrator of logistics, we are transforming the way global trade moves by delivering seamless, end\-to\-end supply chain solutions.


This is an exciting career opportunity to work in a multinational, Global 500 company that makes global trade happen. You will be interacting daily with colleagues internationally, giving you the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a global environment. The environment is dynamic with focus on high performance, results, and respect for our employees. There will be the possibility of continuous professional and personal development and for gaining a professional and social network.


**About the Role**
------------------

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help digitise and automate both functional and non\-functional processes in our treasury system, Findur — delivered in close partnership with our highly experienced internal DevOps team. You will work with development teams and stakeholders in various locations, e.g., Pune, Bangalore, UK and Copenhagen.


You'll be involved early in feature discussions to help shape the best technical outcome and support the business case behind each change, and you'll be closely engaged in our agile processes — driving continuous improvement in code quality, review practices, and ceremonies.


While Findur/OpenLink expertise is the foundation of this role, we're equally interested in engineers with broad technical curiosity — people who understand, or are willing to learn, adjacent areas such as AI/ML and system integrations. We value adaptability and curiosity as much as a fixed skill set.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

As part of the DevOps team, you will:


* Own your code across the full software development lifecycle — from requirements and business analysis, through design, development and testing, to release — writing, delivering, and presenting code in walkthroughs against functional specifications.
* Write clean, scalable, high\-quality code that follows engineering best practices and aligns with our internal standards and processes.
* Build strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring a best\-in\-class experience for our users.
* Actively drive scope and user story definition, technical viability assessment, and best practice to meet requirements.
* Proactively flag risks and issues affecting system performance and availability.
* Share knowledge actively within the team, contributing to our shared knowledge base.
* Collaborate with vendors and DevOps team members on root cause analysis of incidents and reported issues.
* Work with a high degree of independence, while knowing when to seek a second opinion.
* Understand and champion the DevOps process, stay focused on team goals, and give feedback openly in a safe environment.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Must Have**

* 7\+ years of experience as a software developer on OpenLink Findur, or alternatively Endur.
* Solid domain knowledge of treasury operations: financial instruments, confirmations, settlements, cash management, and payment flows, including SWIFT and ISO 20022 concepts.
* Experience working in large, global teams with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Fluency in treasury business language, with the ability to translate business requirements from conversations with end users into Findur/Java code or system configuration.
* Solid understanding of Findur data modelling and system design.
* Strong ability to write clean, reusable, and efficient code that's easy for others to read and maintain.
* Broad technical curiosity — genuine interest in technology beyond Findur, including automation and integrations.
* Solid SQL foundation and familiarity with SQL Server.
* Genuine interest and willingness to learn AI/ML tooling; hands\-on experience building with it is a plus.

### **Advantageous**

* Experience with Agile practices and tools (Git, Jira, etc.).
* Knowledge of vendor\-hosted system setups and integrations.
* Diverse experience across different technologies and platforms, beyond Findur.

**Ways of Working**
-------------------

* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a commitment to maintaining a safe space for the team.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with an ownership mindset and the ability to work across teams.
* Collaborative, with strong mentoring, people skills, and personal impact.
* Highly motivated and able to perform well under pressure.
* Innovative, with the ability to think outside the box.
* Fact\-based and results\-oriented.

**As a Person**
---------------

* A self\-starter, highly motivated and proactive.
* Curious, with a drive to keep learning and stay current with emerging technology and business trends.
* Flexible and adaptable, comfortable pivoting into different roles as needs evolve.
* Culturally aware, with experience working in multi\-cultural teams.
* Willing to share knowledge, document work, and contribute as a true team player.
* Service\-minded, with a strong focus on business needs.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are seeking a **S****enior** Linux systems engineer with over 10 years of specialized experience in low\-level C/C\+\+ systems programming, cryptographic network security, and enterprise identity integration. In this role, you will architect, build, and secure core Linux infrastructure components. You will be responsible for designing high\-throughput Linux daemons, authoring custom PAM modules, automating X.509 certificate lifecycles, and hardening enterprise software against complex, system\-level vulnerabilities.


Key Responsibilities

* **Low\-Level Systems Development**: Architect and build high\-performance, fault\-tolerant Linux daemons using modern C/C\+\+ and POSIX APIs.
* **Identity \& Authentication Engineering:** Design and implement custom Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM) and integrate systems seamlessly with enterprise identity providers (Active Directory, LDAP, Kerberos, SSSD).
* **Cryptography \& PKI Management:** Implement robust end\-to\-end transport and storage security using OpenSSL/WolfSSL APIs; manage and automate X.509 PKI certificate lifecycles, mTLS configurations, and cryptographic operations.
* **System Hardening \& Security:** Enforce system safety across Linux environments using granular security policies (Seccomp, SELinux/AppArmor) and secure coding standards (constant\-time cryptographic execution, memory safety).
* **Network Analysis \& Debugging:**Diagnose, trace, and resolve complex network\- and protocol\-level bottlenecks or security flaws across TCP/IP stacks using advanced tools.

**Required Qualifications \& Technical Expertise**


Experience

* **10\+ years** of hands\-on experience in Linux systems programming, enterprise security engineering, or low\-level software architecture.


Technical Domain Capabilities

* **Languages \& Toolchains:** Proficient in C, C\+\+, POSIX APIs, CMake, Make, GCC/Clang, GDB, and advanced Shell Scripting (Bash).
* **Linux Systems Programming:** Deep knowledge of IPC (Unix Sockets, Shared Memory, Message Queues), Concurrency/Threading (pthreads), Asynchronous Event Loops (epoll, io\_uring), Custom Daemon development, and manual Memory Management.
* **Cryptography \& Security:**Direct API\-level experience with OpenSSL/WolfSSL, TLS 1\.2/1\.3, mTLS, X.509 PKI, PEM/DER encoding, symmetric/asymmetric ciphers, HMAC, and constant\-time cryptographic programming.
* **Authentication \& Identity Integration:** Demonstrated experience with PAM module development, Active Directory (AD), LDAP, SSSD, Kerberos/GSSAPI, and enterprise OAuth2/OIDC protocols.
* **Networking \& Linux Hardening:** Expert understanding of TCP/IP, socket\-level programming, Seccomp sandboxing, AppArmor/SELinux mandatory access control, and network tracing tools (tcpdump, Wireshark).
**AI\-Assisted Engineering Practice:**

* AI Collaboration: Demonstrated expertise leveraging advanced AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) as force\-multiplier co\-workers to accelerate low\-level engineering workflows. Spec\-Driven Methodology: Strong foundation in AI spec\-driven development practices (e.g., Plan/BMAD modes) to design, map, and implement full SDLC phases.
* AI Code Review \& Governance: Ability to critically inspect, profile, and audit AI\-generated code for zero\-trust security, memory safety, architectural integrity, and performance bottlenecks.

* Bachelor/Master’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Experience on test engineering is preferred.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills with great attention to details. (Must)
* Good at test strategy analysis systematically and delivery focused. (Must)
* Experience in Unit, Functional and Integration testing. (Must)
* Practical exposure in building and using test automation framework with Java. (Preferred)
* Experience testing across a variety of platforms: Microservices, Event Driven Applications, and Databases (Preferred)
* Experienced in different protocols testing (SFTP/sockets/HTTPs/RPC..etc) and familiar with CI/CD pipeline (Must)

* Passionate about emerging technologies and trends, especially Event Driven Architecture and modern caching/persistence mechanisms
* Experience in working with Digital Native Architecture, Spring Boot framework and Cloud technology (preferably Pivotal Cloud Foundry) (Preferred)
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills involving Business Owners, Architecture teams, Development/Test teams, Vendors etc.
* Understanding, inclination and experience of working in an Agile (SaFe) environment (Preferred)

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Join Vultr**

 **Dev Engineer** 
 to serve as the technical owner connecting our engineering alerting to Vultr's new Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai, India, and to build the consolidated single\-pane dashboard GIOC will operate from. This is a highly visible, focused role, requiring deep familiarity with Vultr's current architecture, monitoring stack, and operational workflows. **Role Overview**
 The
 **Senior Software Engineer — Tooling \& Automation** 
 will own the development of automation, integrations, and unified monitoring capabilities for Vultr’s GIOC in Chennai. The role will connect multiple monitoring, SIEM, infrastructure, and provider platforms into a
 **single operational view** 
 , while automating alert routing, ticketing, paging, escalation, and SLA tracking. The engineer will work closely with Systems, Network, Security, and GIOC teams to improve observability, reduce manual intervention, and enable reliable

* Architect a comprehensive single\-pane dashboard that aggregates monitoring across global providers like Equinix and Airtel, eliminating inefficient tool\-switching.
* Define the initial scope for visualization projects alongside leadership to meet aggressive technical and operational milestones.
* Maintain continuous infrastructure visibility by managing side\-by\-side operations of legacy and modern tools during the GIOC transition phase.
* Integrate health and performance metrics—such as escalation precision and aging—into reporting modules for executive\-level status updates.
* Produce detailed documentation for all routing systems and dashboards to ensure long\-term maintainability by global operations teams.


**Qualifications**
* 5–8 years of experience in Platform Engineering or similar domains, with significant expertise in NMS platforms, Grafana, and major SIEM environments.
* Profound understanding of Vultr’s existing monitoring ecosystem, infrastructure stack, and standard operational procedures across multiple technical pillars.
* Proven track record of building complex integrations using Python and RESTful APIs over the last three years.
* Extensive experience crafting or customizing sophisticated dashboards via Kibana, Power BI, or similar visualization toolsets.
* Deep knowledge of ITSM workflows—specifically Jira and Mattermost—and the technical mapping of event severity to incident metadata.
* Preference for candidates with experience in 24x7 global NOC/SOC environments and multi\-provider datacenter logistics.


**Inclusion \& Privacy**

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
