This role will assist in instructional design to enhance e\-learning content, analyze learning data, and work closely with key stakeholders to improve the effectiveness of digital learning. This position will also be responsible for managing and delivering new hire onboarding and department specific trainings to employees through the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring a seamless and user\-friendly experience for learners, instructors, and administrators.
   

  

 This position works in the Talent Management and Learning COE and reports to the Senior LMS Team Lead who is based in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
**E\-Learning Development \& Instructional Design:**
* Design and develop end\-to\-end courseware, including interactive eLearning modules, instructor\-led training materials, simulations, videos, and assessments aligned with defined learning objectives, using tools like Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, and similar platforms.
* Create and refine clear, engaging instructional content—including scripts, storyboards, assignments, and assessments—by converting SME\-provided content and technical documentation into learner\-ready training materials aligned with established learning frameworks such as ADDIE and Bloom’s Taxonomy. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop, implement, and maintain e\-learning courses and training materials.
* Conduct rigorous quality reviews of training content to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with instructional design and industry standards.
* Maintain and manage content updates, version control, and archival processes to ensure training materials remain current and relevant.


**LMS Administration And Support**
* Administer and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS) for a large user base, ensuring smooth operation and a user\-friendly experience.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for global new hires, managing the end\-to\-end onboarding training process and implementing automation to enhance efficiency.
* Coordinate and manage Instructor\-Led Training (ILT) sessions, including scheduling, attendance tracking, learner record updates, and communication with instructors and learners.
* Provide prompt and responsive technical support to learners, instructors, and stakeholders, resolving LMS\-related issues.
* Maintain and organize learning content within the LMS, SharePoint, and content repositories and ensure alignment of content structure across sites, programs, and folders
* Monitor enrollments, completions, and system usage metrics for accuracy and to ensure data integrity within the LMS.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Create detailed reports and dashboards to measure learner engagement, track course completions, and evaluate training effectiveness.
* Assist with compliance tracking and meet regulatory reporting obligations through accurate data analysis and documentation.
* Keep abreast of emerging trends and best practices in instructional design and e\-learning technologies.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by incorporating learner feedback and performance data to introduce creative and innovative solutions that enhance engagement and optimize the overall learning experience.


**Innovation and Continuous Improvement**
* Keep abreast of emerging trends and best practices in instructional design and e\-learning technologies.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by incorporating learner feedback and performance data to introduce creative and innovative solutions that enhance engagement and optimize the overall learning experience.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Instructional Technology, Information Systems, or a closely related discipline.
* 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in training, instructional design, learning experience design, or content development, ideally in a global or multicultural work environment.
* Proficient in using eLearning development tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Suite, Vyond, or other instructional technologies.
* Strong understanding of adult learning theories and instructional design principles.
* Familiarity with e\-learning standards including SCORM and xAPI.
* Proficient in data analysis and report generation using Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working with enterprise learning management systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms (i.e. Cornerstone, Docebo).
* Strong graphic design and multimedia development skills, supported by hands\-on proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and video editing tools, are highly desirable.
* Proficient in writing clear and engaging instructional content, including copy, video/audio scripts, and learning materials.
* Ability to develop storyboards and design visual layouts for instructional content and user interfaces.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders across the globe.


**Key Competencies**
* Innovation: Creative and innovative mindset, capable of designing engaging and impactful learning solutions.
* Adaptability: Adaptable and responsive to evolving priorities and constructive feedback in a fast\-paced environment.
* Problem Solving: Strong problem\-solving abilities with an analytical approach to identifying and addressing learning challenges.
* Planning and Organizing: Effective time management and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.
* Work Standards / Details Quality: High attention to detail in reviewing content for quality, accuracy, and alignment with learning goals.


**Working Conditions**
* The role may require attendance in meetings outside the site's standard business hours, as stakeholders and business representatives are located across multiple time zones.
* This is a hybrid position which requires working in the office 3 days a week.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Devices - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**
### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  


As we continue to grow JumpCloud internationally, we are hiring software engineers to expand our product. You’ll have the opportunity to play a key role in the success and development of our engineering teams in addition to growing your own career.

  


**About the Role:**

In this role, you will specifically work on the Device Management (MDM / Endpoint Management) vertical at JumpCloud, the role shifts focus from broad cloud microservices to deeply understanding operating system internals (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android) and how they communicate with the cloud.



In the Device Management vertical, you will build the software that allows IT administrators to remotely configure, patch, secure, and monitor thousands of endpoints from a single pane of glass. You will work on cross\-OS device management engines, mobile device management / Declarative Device Management(MDM/DDM) telemetry, custom system agents, and zero\-touch enrollment pipelines. This role balances local client\-side programming (interacting with the OS) and building high\-availability cloud APIs.

  


### **What you’ll be doing:**

* Primarily working with Go and Node.js for cross\-platform applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
* Gaining or utilizing expertise in areas like Windows services, kernels, Event Loggers, Mac Launch daemons, and macOS internals.
* Collaborating with architects, UX designers, and DevOps to ensure our systems are highly available, scalable, and deliver exceptional user experiences.
* Working within a Scrum framework to drive agile development.
* Learning and working with mTLS protocols and related security concepts. Prior experience in these areas is a plus.
* Using OAuth/OIDC flows for secure user authentication and service access.
* Writing Unit test cases, Functional test cases, acceptance tests along with automating these test cases.
* Contributing to the future of our Device Management services by participating in strategic planning and scoping sessions with product managers.
* Embodying our core values: building strong connections, thinking big, and striving to improve by 1% every day.

### **We’re looking for:**

* 7\-10 years experience developing MAC, Windows, or Linux applications (including integration with third\-party applications) in any modern language (Python, Java) or Golang. Experience in one of them is a must.
* Experience using one of the public cloud providers (AWS, GCP or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines (preferably Github Action) to build, test and deploy. Knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Strong hands\-on experience in backend software or full stack development is a must
* Working knowledge of Swift, C Sharp, C\+\+ would be an added advantage
* Working knowledge on device MDM would be an added advantage
* Willingness to mentor junior members of the team.
* Bonus points if you have experience with Services, event logger, Kernel in Windows OS and/or Launch demon, app hosting in Mac

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

**Language:**JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

\#LI\-Remote \#BI\-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Java Developer
description:
Date live: 09/09/2026


Business Area: Functions Technology


Area of Expertise: Technology


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000102791


  
At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future – we create it. Embark on a transformative journey as part of Functions Digital Channels Business Process Automation Centre of Excellence (FDC BPA CoE) is a strategic platform team that enables business process automation, digital workflow delivery, and integration\-led transformation across Functions. The team supports a portfolio of platforms and services that connect cloud platforms, SaaS products, enterprise applications, and internal systems to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient digital solutions.


The FDC BPA CoE platform team is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and supporting business\-critical applications and services, with a focus on Java development, Spring Boot microservices, API integrations, cloud/SaaS connectivity, platform reliability, and continuous engineering improvements across the portfolio.


We are seeking an experienced Java Developer to join the FDC BPA CoE platform team. The successful candidate will work closely with Business Analysts, business stakeholders, solution architects, developers, QA teams, and platform teams to analyse business requirements, design robust technical solutions, develop Java and Spring Boot services, and deliver secure, scalable, and high\-quality integrations across cloud platforms, SaaS products, and enterprise systems.


The role will involve hands\-on Java development, Spring Boot microservices, REST API design, and integration with cloud platforms, SaaS products, and internal enterprise systems, with a strong focus on engineering best practices, code quality, security, performance, maintainability and Barclays engineering standards.


The candidate will contribute to engineering best practices, support code reviews, mentor junior developers where required, and help maintain high standards for code quality, reliability, security, and operational readiness.


**To be successful as a Java Developer, you should have experience with:**


* Hands\-on experience in Java development, including strong knowledge of core Java, object\-oriented programming, collections, exception handling, concurrency, and design principles.
* Experience designing, building, and maintaining Spring Boot services, microservices, and reusable backend components.
* Strong experience in RESTful API design and development, including request/response modelling, error handling, authentication, authorization, versioning, and API documentation.
* Experience integrating applications with cloud platforms and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging, event\-driven patterns, or integration frameworks.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and source control practices, including GitLab, branching strategies, merge requests, automated build pipelines, and deployment processes.
* Good understanding of database concepts with the ability to write and optimize SQL queries and work with relational databases.
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, code quality tools, and secure coding practices to ensure maintainable and production\-ready solutions.
* Relevant experience working on distributed systems, high\-throughput services, application performance, scalability, reliability, monitoring, and operational support.

**Some of the highly valued skills may include:**


* Experience working in the Compliance, Colleague, or enterprise digital workplace domain.
* Experience with integration technologies and patterns, including REST APIs, messaging, event streaming, Kafka, queues, authentication flows, and data transformation.
* Good knowledge of Spring ecosystem components such as Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud, and dependency injection.
* Experience with containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or equivalent platform services.
* Ability to identify technical issues, dependencies, risks, and delivery blockers, and escalate appropriately to vendors, platform teams, or management as required.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot production and non\-production issues across application, API, database, and integration layers.
* Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies and collaborating with globally distributed teams.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, particularly in documenting technical designs, service behaviours, APIs, integration flows, and operational procedures.

Exposure to IBM i (AS/400) environments and to DB2 specifically, including reading and connecting to DB2 data. Data-processing experience with Pandas and NumPy.  We are looking for a motivated and curious Junior Developer Intern to join our development team. This role is ideal for freshers or early-career developers who want hands-on exposure to real-world product development across both frontend and backend systems. As a Junior Developer Intern, you will support the team in building, testing, and improving web applications. You will work with modern technologies such as React.js, Angular, Node.js, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap, while learning engineering practices, debugging workflows, and collaborative development processes. Along with core engineering skills, this role also expects comfort with AI-assisted development workflows to improve speed, learning, debugging, and documentation quality in day-to-day work. This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning quickly, and contributing to live projects in a fast-paced environment. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Assist in the development and maintenance of web applications across frontend and backend layers. Support the team in building responsive, user-friendly interfaces using HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, React.js, and Angular. Help develop and maintain backend APIs and server-side logic using Node.js. Write clean, readable, and maintainable code under guidance from senior developers. Participate in bug fixing, troubleshooting, testing, and performance improvements. Collaborate with designers, developers, and project stakeholders to understand requirements and implement solutions. Work with version control systems such as Git for code collaboration and tracking changes. Assist in integrating APIs, third-party libraries, and backend services. Use AI-assisted development tools to support coding, debugging, code review, documentation, test case generation, and faster issue resolution, while validating outputs for accuracy and quality. Leverage AI tools to improve development productivity, understand unfamiliar codebases, and accelerate learning of frameworks, libraries, and best practices. Learn and follow coding standards, development workflows, and deployment practices. Actively participate in team discussions, sprint planning, reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Must-Have Skills 
 Basic understanding of frontend-development concepts and responsive web design. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. Familiarity with at least one modern frontend framework such as React.js or Angular. Basic understanding of Node.js and backend development concepts. Understanding of REST APIs and client-server architecture. Familiarity with databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL at a foundational level. Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub or other version control tools. Understanding of debugging, testing, and problem-solving fundamentals. Comfort using AI-assisted developer tools for code suggestions, debugging support, documentation, learning assistance, and productivity improvement with proper human review. Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly in a project environment. Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team. 
 
 Preferred Traits 
 Strong learning mindset and enthusiasm for software development. Attention to detail and commitment to code quality. Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and follow through. Curiosity to explore both frontend and backend technologies. Positive attitude toward feedback and continuous improvement. 
 
 Who Should Apply 
 Fresh graduates or final-year students in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields. Candidates with internship, academic, freelance, or personal project experience in web development. Individuals looking to build a career in full-stack or web application development.

This role is a key part of establishing the company's new India Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Bengaluru, driving enterprise technology, digital transformation, and innovation for global operations. 
 Why this matters This role represents a rare opportunity to join the India GCC from its early stages, working alongside global teams, helping establish new capabilities, and contributing to the future of one of the world's largest, most comprehensive companies in its industry. 
 What you'll do: As a ServiceNow Developer, you will build and maintain solutions across ITSM, ITOM, Discovery & Event Management, and HRSD, working closely with the Development Tech Lead and Technical Architect to deliver against the platform roadmap. You will bring an AI-first mindset to every build, leveraging ServiceNow's native AI capabilities to automate and enhance processes alongside strong hands-on scripting, integration, and Service Portal development skills. 
 Key Responsibilities: Solution Development: Build and maintain solutions across ITSM, HRSD, ITOM, and Discovery & Event Management, configuring workflows and Flow Designer flows in line with an AI-first approach. Process Automation: Identify and implement opportunities to use ServiceNow's native AI capabilities (Virtual Agents, Predictive Intelligence, AI-powered search) to automate manual steps. Analytics & Reporting: Develop and analyze reports and Performance Analytics dashboards to surface data-driven insights for process governors and stakeholders. Portal Enhancement: Build and enhance Service Portal and Employee Center experiences, applying modern web technologies to deliver responsive, intuitive interfaces. Custom Scripting: Develop and maintain client-side and server-side scripts (Business Rules, Script Actions, Script Includes, Scripted REST Endpoints) following secure coding practices. Technical Debt Reduction: Analyze business requirements and map them to out-of-the-box (OOTB) functionality, transitioning custom configurations to standard modules. Platform Maintenance: Support ongoing platform maintenance, annual ServiceNow upgrades, SLA-based issue resolution, and continuous improvement across modules.

Strong proficiency in client-side and server-side scripting (Business Rules, Script Includes, Scripted REST Endpoints, GlideSystem/GlideRecord APIs). title: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes Controller & Go Systems
description:
Senior Software Engineer, Kubernetes Platform (Golang) 
 Experience: 3+ years
 Team: Platform Engineering Tuner for K8s Role Overview CloudKeeper is building a Kubernetes optimization platform that keeps clusters running lean automatically — right-sizing workloads and managing nodes without manual intervention. Two capabilities sit at its core: A recommender that analyses historical workload usage and applies corrected requests/limits automatically. Automated node management — provisioning, consolidation, and bin-packing for efficient cluster utilisation. This is a hands-on Go controller-author role: CRDs, controllers, admission/mutating webhooks, informer and reconcile loops, and a time-series layer for percentile-based sizing. You'll work in a small engineering team building distributed systems that integrate deeply with the Kubernetes control plane. The work rewards someone who is genuinely curious about how Kubernetes behaves under the hood and who writes production-grade Go. Responsibilities Workload & Node Optimization Build the workload right-sizing recommender — pull historical usage from the metrics pipeline (metrics-server / Prometheus) and compute corrected requests / limits using percentile / histogram methods. Implement safe automatic application of those corrections to live workloads — staged rollout, guardrails, and rollback so a running workload is never destabilised. Build node-side optimization — provisioning, consolidation, and bin-packing — for efficient cluster utilisation. Kubernetes Platform Engineering Design and build controllers, operators, and CRDs in Go using controller-runtime / client-go — informer caches, reconcile loops, and the object lifecycle. Integrate deeply with the Kubernetes API to observe and act on cluster state at scale. Build the backend services and APIs (REST; gRPC where an agent/control-plane split calls for it) that the platform runs on. Architecture & Scale Design for multi-cluster operation at scale. Hold platform services to a high bar for reliability, performance, and security — especially because the platform acts on live customer clusters . Participate in architecture and feature design as the platform grows. Required Skills Strong, production Go — you've shipped and operated real services in it. Deep understanding of Kubernetes internals — the controller / reconcile model, the API machinery, and the object lifecycle, not just kubectl usage. Hands-on experience building operators / controllers / CRDs (controller-runtime, Kubebuilder, or Operator SDK). Comfort with metrics / time-series data — ingesting and reasoning about historical resource usage (percentiles, histograms). Strong debugging and performance-optimization instincts. Preferred Skills gRPC and API design for distributed / agent-based systems. Familiarity with VPA, Karpenter, cluster-autoscaler, or the kube-scheduler internals — a real bonus if you've read their source. Hands-on experience with admission/mutating webhooks and their failure modes. Resource scheduling, autoscaling, bin-packing, or workload-placement systems. Interest in the cost/efficiency side — requests/limits economics, bin-packing efficiency, node cost. This is a cost-optimization product at heart. Multi-cluster / multi-cloud Kubernetes. Cloud-native security practices. IaC (Terraform) and CI/CD for platform tooling. What We Look For Controller-author instincts — at home in the reconcile / informer world, not just consuming the API. Safety and correctness when acting on live workloads — thinks in blast radius, staged rollout, and rollback before features. A bias for building things that run reliably without babysitting. Curiosity about how Kubernetes actually works under the hood. Comfort in a small, fast-moving team where the platform itself is still being built. Willingness to work on-site at our Noida office. Technology Stack Languages: Go Platform: Kubernetes — controller-runtime, client-go, CRDs, admission webhooks APIs: REST; gRPC where warranted Optimization: VPA-style right-sizing, Karpenter-based node management Data: time-series / metrics (metrics-server, Prometheus) Cloud: AWS (initial focus) Qualifications B.Tech / B.E / MCA in Computer Science, IT, or a related field. 5+ years building backend or infrastructure software. Strong experience with Kubernetes-based platforms or cloud-native systems.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure,Kubernetes
description:
Job Description About the role We are hiring a staff software engineer (IC4) for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse. We are distributed across Israel, India, and the Americas. This is a full stack role with its center of gravity firmly on the infrastructure side - expect roughly two-thirds of your time on telemetry infrastructure, data pipelines, Kubernetes and DevOps work, and the rest on the services and product surfaces on top. You will be equally comfortable designing a distributed system and owning it in production. If you like following a system from the event that fires to the chart that renders - and you want the pager for it - you will feel at home. You will lead design and delivery of complex, multi-service features, own technical decisions within a domain, and are fully self-directed - escalating only genuine ambiguities and driving decisions to closure. Of the ten critical skills at this level, incident response management is the only one set at Expert; the rest are Experienced. What you ll do Telemetry infrastructure and data pipelines Design, build, and own backend services for distributed data streaming and processing that handle high-volume, high-cardinality event data with predictable latency and no silent data loss. Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming pipelines and the pipeline components that feed ClickHouse. Own data modeling and query performance in ClickHouse - partitioning, sort keys, materialized views, retention, and the cost curve that comes with all of it. Partner with product and platform teams to shape requirements for telemetry ingestion and processing, then drive the solutions to production. Kubernetes, DevOps, and production ownership Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. Own observability for what you build - meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise. Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives. Full stack engineering and technical leadership Own the full development lifecycle for your work, and build the backend services and APIs that expose telemetry to internal consumers, product surfaces, and AI agents - including API contracts, data models, and schema migrations. Contribute to the analytics front end - dashboards, funnels, and exploration tools - with an eye on performance against large result sets, and improve the web and mobile capture SDKs. Lead the design of complex, multi-service features across team boundaries, drive decisions to closure, and write the design docs and postmortems that outlive the conversation. Raise the bar through code review, test strategy, and automation coverage, and mentor engineers on the team. Qualifications Experience and education requirements The job profile defines IC4 by scope, independence, and impact rather than years served. The minimums below are the screening bar for this requisition. Requirement Mandatory minimum 8+ years of Backend software engineering experience 4+ years of Designing and operating distributed systems 3+ years Kubernetes in production, including Helm and CI/CD 3+ years Kafka or equivalent streaming and data pipelines 3+ years On-call and production ownership Bachelor s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field Required A master s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable. Required qualifications Strong backend development experience in Java, Python, Go or equivalent, used in production at scale. Hands-on experience building distributed systems for data streaming, processing, and storage. Production experience deploying and managing services on Kubernetes, including Helm and CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of Kafka or an equivalent messaging and streaming system. Solid SQL skills and hands-on experience with a columnar or analytical data store, including query optimization and physical data modeling. Demonstrated depth in incident responseand customer escalations Enough front-end capability to build and debug a data-heavy interface: JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Angular. Desired qualifications Production experience with ClickHouse or another OLAP or columnar store - sharding, replication, materialized views, cost tuning. Exposure to observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, metrics and logging stacks, alerting platforms. Experience building product analytics or telemetry platforms, or with stream processing frameworks such as Flink or Spark. Client-side instrumentation - web or mobile SDK development, event capture, session and consent handling. AI skills Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency for IC4 - it applies to how you build and to what you build. Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other - catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt. Integrating LLM APIs into production features - and knowing when a model is the wrong tool for the job. Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores, and agent frameworks; familiarity with the Model Context Protocol is a plus. Exposing telemetry to AI agents through tool interfaces agents can use safely: predictable schemas, bounded results, clear error semantics, sane cost controls. Designing safeguards for non-deterministic components - retry logic, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - and hardening against latency spikes and hallucinated output reaching a customer. Instrumenting AI features in production and judging their quality from telemetry and evaluation rather than impressions.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Agents
description:
Workfabric AI is the enterprise simulation company. We build digital twins of every account, team, product, and persona — so the enterprise can simulate decisions before shipping them.
 



  





 Our product, ContextFabric, is the simulation layer that senses across your apps, synthesizes operational context, and grounds every twin in how your teams actually work. We believe operational context is the real competitive advantage in enterprise AI, and we're building the platform that turns it into decisions.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We simulate the enterprise by creating digital twins — of people, and of entities such as accounts, teams, and products. This role is about building them. You'll work on building one of these twins, and own problem statements within it — shaping the problem, designing the architecture, writing the code, and shipping it to production. You'll be accountable for the systems that ship, not just the pull request.
 



  





**What you'll be doing** 




 Three hard problems sit at the centre of this role:
 


* Ground every twin in real work. Make each twin reason from the enterprise's actual behavioural context, so its output stays grounded and defensible — per tenant, never crossing a boundary.
* Run thousands of twins in parallel. Build the runtime that executes twins at scale — thousands running concurrently and collaborating with each other to do the work.
* Give twins the right tools and permissions. Ensure every twin has the tool sit needs to do its work and the permissions to use them safely — governed by identity, policy, and an audit trail you could replay for a regulator.



  





 The surface area you'll own, and set the patterns for
 


* The twin runtime that executes and composes twins at scale.
* State management for execution history, checkpointing, and recovery across long\-running twin runs.
* Event streaming and messaging for real\-time progress, with logging, metrics, and tracing instrumented throughout.
* Authentication and identity across the platform — including access controls and approval workflows for twin operations, in partnership with security.
* The engineering patterns and quality bar for your area — through code review and pairing with the engineers around you.
* The operational backbone the platform runs on — deployment, CI/CD, autoscaling, and reliability as infrastructure\-as\-code.



  





**Who you are** 




 You may be a good fit if you have
 


* B.E. / B. Tech from a top university in India in one of the following departments (i) Computer Science, (ii) Information Sciences, (iii) Information Technology (iv) AI/ML
* 5\+ years building production software in Python, with strong backend fundamentals in API design and data modelling.
* Hands\-on experience building services with FastAPI as your primary framework.
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-backed applications in production —orchestrating multi\-step reasoning, retrieval, and state — with any orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent).
* Comfort designing for concurrency and latency — async, parallelism, and caching — so multi\-step systems stay fast under load.
* A track record of owning features or services end to end, from design through production.
* Clear communication and the ability to work autonomously in an ambiguous, fast\-moving space.



  





**Strong candidates may also have** 



* Depth with a specific orchestration framework such as LangChain or LangGraph, plus hands\-on RAG and vector databases.
* Experience building evaluations for LLM or agentic systems — measuring quality, catching regressions, and guarding against unsafe behaviour.
* Experience with React for building customer\-facing UIs and dashboards.
* Comfortable deploying, operating, and maintaining your own services in a production cloud environment (Azure a plus).
* Infrastructure\-as\-code with Terraform, plus Kubernetes and Helm for deployment.
* Observability — structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics.

**Position Overview:**
**Mastercam** 
 seeks a Software Engineer III who serves as the senior technical resource for Mastercam's customer\-facing WordPress environment and leads the design and delivery of its ecommerce capability.
   

  

 The Software Engineer III role independently architects complex solutions, including custom plugin development, payment processing integration, and custom purchase and fulfillment workflows, and is expected to make sound design and platform decisions with limited oversight. The position provides technical direction and mentorship to less experienced engineers and conducts code reviews across the team. Success in this role requires deep WordPress expertise combined with substantial ecommerce and broader web application experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Ecommerce Solution Design \& Development**
* Leads the technical design and delivery of the ecommerce solution within the WordPress environment, including catalog, checkout, payment processing integration, and custom purchase and fulfillment workflows.
* Architects and develops custom WordPress plugins, themes, and extensions to deliver business functionality that is not available through existing solutions.
* Designs and builds integrations between the WordPress environment and internal systems and third\-party services, including API design and data modeling.
* Translates business and compliance requirements provided by internal stakeholders into technical designs, and implements them so that the resulting behavior is testable and auditable.


**Platform Development \& Maintenance**
* Designs, develops, and tests software to resolve defects and implement user stories.
* Maintains and updates the existing codebase to address technical debt and legacy code; identifies areas of the system that require updating and writes user stories as appropriate.
* Evaluates and recommends tools, technologies, and processes for software development, including alternative platforms where the current approach will not meet requirements.


**Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Conducts code reviews, sharing experience and knowledge with others as appropriate.
* Mentors less experienced engineers, providing technical direction and supporting their professional growth.
* Produces written design documentation sufficient for a distributed team to work from asynchronously.
* Takes a lead role and actively participates in planning meetings, including writing, correctly sizing, and accurately detailing and breaking down stories and defects.
* Communicates project status regularly, inclusive of all pertinent details, with all necessary stakeholders.
* Continuously develops a deep expertise in Mastercam's critical business processes.
* Performs other duties as assigned.


**Requirements** 
 :
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 6 \- 9 years' experience developing web applications, with strong working knowledge of PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* 3\+ years' experience developing and supporting ecommerce applications, including payment gateway integration and handling of refund, failure, and reconciliation scenarios.
* Extensive experience developing custom functionality on WordPress, including custom plugin and theme development, the hooks and filters system, and the WordPress REST API.
* Demonstrated experience developing web applications outside of WordPress, evidencing breadth across more than a single platform.
* Experience designing and building APIs and relational data models.
* Experience deploying applications to a cloud platform.
* Experience with standard software development practices such as source control, peer reviews, and unit testing.
* Experience with agile software development.
* Experience mentoring or providing technical direction to other developers.
* Working familiarity with modern JavaScript libraries and frameworks, particularly React, is preferred given its use in the WordPress block editor and in WooCommerce checkout components.
* Experience leveraging AI\-enabled tools or automation to improve productivity and operational effectiveness, or a demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, evaluate, and apply such technologies at scale.


**Key Competencies**
* Above average communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to provide accurate and timely information in a succinct and easy to understand manner.
* Documents designs and decisions clearly and in sufficient detail for colleagues working in other time zones.
* A proven ability to drive projects to completion and a track record of delivering well\-designed, high\-quality software.
* Sound judgment about when to follow WordPress conventions and when a custom solution is warranted.
* Sufficient breadth of platform experience to evaluate WordPress objectively against alternatives when requirements demand it.
* Operates with a high degree of autonomy while escalating architectural and compliance questions appropriately.
* Problem solving and analysis skills.

**Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE)**

**About Pearson**

We deliver high\-quality content, assessments, and digital services to learners, educators, and institutions globally. Our mission is to empower every learner to achieve their potential.
 


  

  


**Role Summary**

* Design and contribute to scalable, resilient, secure, and cost\-effective cloud solutions.
  

  
* Follow cloud engineering and operational excellence practices.
  


  


**Secure\-by\-Design Engineering**

* Implement secure coding practices and security controls.
  

  
* Participate in threat modelling, vulnerability remediation, and security reviews.
  

  
* Apply DevSecOps practices, including automated security validation and compliance checks.
  

  
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise security and governance standards.

* Apply AI\-supported approaches for coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and automation.
  

  
* Contribute to agentic and automation initiatives where appropriate.
  

  
* Follow responsible AI and data governance practices.

* Lead code reviews, design reviews, and engineering discussions.
  

  
* Collaborate with architects, security teams, product teams, and cloud engineers.
  

  
* Influence technical decisions through technical expertise, collaboration, and data\-driven recommendations.
  


  


**Required Qualifications** 



  

  


**Customer Focus \& Business Acumen** 



  

  
* Strong customer\-centric mindset with a focus on delivering measurable business value.
  

  
* Experience engaging directly with customers, business stakeholders, and product teams to understand problems, validate assumptions, and shape technical solutions.
  

  
* Ability to balance customer experience, business priorities, technical constraints, security requirements, and operational considerations.
  


  


**Software Engineering** 



  

  
* Strong software development experience using Python, Java, TypeScript, or similar technologies.
  

  
* Experience building APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and cloud\-native applications.
  

  
* Understanding of microservices architecture and modern software engineering principles.

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Kubernetes, cloud automation, and deployment pipelines.
  

  
* Knowledge of observability, monitoring, logging, and operational excellence practices.
  

  
* Understanding of cloud security, scalability, resilience, and cost optimisation.

* Understanding of authentication, authorisation, data protection, encryption, and application security.
  

  
* Familiarity with DevSecOps principles and security automation.
  


  


**AI\-Assisted Engineering**

* Understanding of automation, agentic engineering concepts, and modern AI\-assisted delivery practices.
  

  
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices and governance considerations.
  


  


**Leadership \& Communication**

* Experience leading proof\-of\-concepts, pilots, or complex technical initiatives.
  

  
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  

  
* Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  

  
* Passion for continuous learning and innovation.
  


  


**Success Measures** 



  

  


**Success in this role is demonstrated through:** 



  

  
* Successful delivery of secure, scalable, production\-ready solutions.
  

  
* Effective execution of proof\-of\-concepts and technology validations.
  

  
* Positive customer, stakeholder, and business outcomes.
  

  
* High\-quality engineering practices and code quality.
  

  
* Adoption of cloud engineering, automation, security, and AI\-assisted development practices.
  

  
* Strong technical leadership and collaboration within teams.
  

  
* Contribution to reusable engineering patterns and continuous improvement.
  


  


**What This Role Is Not** 



  

  
* Not a pure Enterprise Architect.

* Requires 6 to 12 years of experience in software development and support.
* Experience in development in relevant programming languages (preferrable Java); using relational databases (Oracle, SQLServer, DB2, Snowflake), and underlying infrastructure elements, and current development processes and tools.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, ability to lead a diverse and globally located team
* The position requires the candidate to work a 5\-a day \-week schedule in the office.
* Shift: 01:00\-10PM IST

**Skill Descriptors**  

**Core Application Systems:** Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.  

**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.
* Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities.
* Investigates application\-related issues with both business and IT professionals.
* Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems.
* Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.

  

**Problem Solving:** Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  

**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact\-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

  

**Application Design, Architecture:** Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.  

**Level Extensive Experience:**  

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.


Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end\-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).  

**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
* Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
* Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
* Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

  

**System and Technology Integration**: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.  

**Level Working Knowledge:**  

* Assists with current and planned integration initiatives.
* Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
* Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
* Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.
* Plays an active role in local integration efforts.

  

**System Testing:** Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud\-enabled world.  

  

Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging \& real\-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data\-first applications and driving a data culture.

  

Within Microsoft Fabric, the Real\-Time Intelligence team enables organizations to act on data as it happens. By combining real\-time ingestion, streaming, event processing, and observability signals, the team delivers capabilities that help customers detect patterns, respond to events, and drive immediate action. These experiences are tightly integrated into Fabric to support modern applications and operational decision\-making in real time.


Microsoft Fabric Eventhouse is a key component of Fabric's Real\-Time Intelligence capabilities, enabling organizations to ingest, store, analyze, and act on high\-volume, time\-sensitive data and events at scale.  

  

Eventhouse builds on Microsoft's deep expertise in real\-time analytics and the Kusto Query Language (KQL), providing powerful capabilities for scenarios involving streaming data, operational telemetry, logs, IoT, application monitoring, and other time\-sensitive workloads. As Microsoft Fabric continues to grow its adoption globally, Eventhouse is playing an increasingly important role in enabling customers to build real\-time and event\-driven analytics solutions.

 We hire sprinters, not coasters—people who:
   

  

* Choose growth over comfort
* Lead through challenges
* Are energized by high expectations


 It's not for everyone, and that's intentional. If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.
   

  

 We are hiring 2 senior software engineers (alternative title: senior backend engineer). One will join our Infrastructure Team, and the other will join our Data Feeds Team.
   

  

**As Our Senior Software Engineer in the Infrastructure Team, You Will be Responsible for:**
* **ERP Data Connector Specialist** 
 : You'll be the one implementing connectors to fetch ERP data. It's like building a bridge to a treasure trove of information. And not just that, you've got to ensure this data has high availability. So, whether it's the crack of dawn or the dead of night, the ERP data should be accessible without a hitch.
* **Backend API Master** 
 : Customers' requirements are constantly evolving, and that's where you come in. You'll be implementing or upgrading backend APIs to fit these new demands like a custom\-made glove. Your work will be the driving force behind our ability to keep up with the market.
* **ERP Data Storage Maestro** 
 : Take charge of the ERP system's data storage. It's your kingdom, and you're responsible for all related improvements. Make sure the data is stored efficiently and securely, and is always ready for action.

 : Understand the business requirements inside out. Jump right into discussions with the team and bring your A\-game to design technical solutions. You'll be the one who bridges the gap between business needs and technical implementation.

 : Maintain our existing services like a pro. Dive into iterative upgrades, deploy improvements, and take charge of service governance. Your work will be the glue that holds our services together and keeps them evolving.
* **Global Team Player** 
 : Work hand\-in\-glove with our US/SG/China teams. Be flexible with work hours as the data world never sleeps, and we need you to be on top of your game, always!


**As Our Senior Software Engineer in the Data Feeds Team, You Will be Responsible for:**

 : You'll be responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining super\-scalable data pipelines. Whether it's structured data flowing like a well\-oiled stream or unstructured data that needs taming, you've got to make sure these pipelines are top\-notch for seamless processing.

 : Existing data systems and services. You bet you'll be the one maintaining and enhancing their stability, reliability, and ensuring high availability. Think of yourself as the shield that keeps our data world running smoothly.

 : Team up with our amazing crew to construct and refine an expandable, high\-performance data architecture. It's like building a digital skyscraper, but with data blocks!
* **Data Services Provider** 
 : Partner with different teams across the board. Your mission is to serve up high\-quality, rock\-solid data services to all our internal users. They'll be relying on you like a lifeline for their data needs.
* **Business\-Aligned Data Designer** 
 : Get the hang of product and business requirements. Then, design and implement data functionalities that are not only useful but also come with super\- intuitive data visualizations. Make data come alive!
* **Third\-Party Data Integrator** 
 : Oversee the integration and maintenance of collaborative data with our third\-party clients. Solve their data mining and analytical headaches, and you'll be the hero of the data realm.
* **Global Team Player** 
 : Work hand\-in\-glove with our US/SG/China teams. Be flexible with work hours as the data world never sleeps, and we need you to be on top of your game, always!
* **Data Governance Enforcer** 
 : Enforce the best practices in data governance, security, and compliance. You're the gatekeeper of sensitive information, and you've got to keep it safe at all costs.


**This is a fully\-remote opportunity based in India. Standard work hours are from 8 am to 5 pm IST.**
**You Are Likely To Succeed If you have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or related majors, 5\+ yrs backend experience.
* Solid computer foundation and programming skills, familiar with common data structures and algorithms.

**Experience in architecture and developing large\-scale distributed systems. (for Infrastructure Team)**

* Exposure to cloud infrastructure, such as kubernates/docker, Azure/AWS/GCP.
* Familiarity with ERP systems.

* We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, parental leave, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!

**About Pearson** 



  

  


 Pearson is the world’s leading learning company, dedicated to helping people make progress in their lives through education. We deliver high\-quality content, assessments, and digital services to learners, educators, and institutions globally. Our mission is to empower every learner to achieve their potential.
 


  

  


**Role Summary** 



  

  


 We are seeking a
 **Staff Software Engineer \- Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE)** 
 who thrives in ambiguity and is passionate about transforming complex business challenges into measurable outcomes.
 


  

  


 The Forward Deployment Engineer operates at the intersection of business strategy, product thinking, software engineering, cloud engineering, security, and AI\-assisted delivery. This role partners directly with business leaders, product teams, architects, engineers, and technology partners to discover problems, shape solutions, build production\-ready capabilities, establish reusable engineering patterns, and enable sustainable ownership across the organisation.

* Establish responsible AI guardrails covering governance, accountability, security, and data protection.
  

  
* Drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity and delivery velocity.
  

  
* Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and their practical application within enterprise environments.
  


  


**Engineering Excellence \& Reusable Patterns** 



  

  
* Establish reusable engineering patterns, accelerators, frameworks, and implementation blueprints.

* Enable permanent teams to independently operate and evolve delivered capabilities.

**Executive Communication \& Influence**

 **need problem capability solution implementation** 
 .

* Ability to influence business leaders, architects, engineers, and delivery teams.

**Success Measures** 



  

  


 Success in this role is demonstrated through:

* Production\-ready capabilities delivered within agreed timeframes.
  

  
* Increased engineering velocity through modern engineering and AI\-assisted practices.
  

  
* Reusable enterprise capabilities and engineering patterns.

**What This Role Is Not**

title: ABAP Workflow Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced ABAP Workflow Developer who specializes in designing, developing, and maintaining workflow solutions within SAP. You ensure business processes run efficiently through smart automation with SAP Business Workflow, and you know better than anyone how ABAP and SAP Workflow come together to build reliable, scalable solutions.
 



 In addition to your specialization in workflow development, you also have solid, hands\-on experience with ABAP reports and interfaces, as well as broader ABAP development, making you widely deployable within the organization's SAP landscape.

* Design, develop, and maintain workflow solutions within SAP Business Workflow to support and automate business processes
* Analyze existing business processes and translate them into efficient, robust workflow designs
* Build and configure workflow templates, tasks, agent determination, and business objects
* Debug and resolve workflow\-related issues in production and test environments
* Develop and maintain ABAP reports and interfaces to support integrations and reporting needs across the SAP landscape
* Build enhancements (user exits, BAdIs, enhancement points) and other custom developments as needed
* Collaborate with functional consultants, business analysts, and other developers to deliver end\-to\-end solutions
* Document technical designs and contribute to best practices within the development team
* Contribute ideas for further development and optimization of existing workflow solutions



  





**What you bring** 



* Demonstrable, extensive experience with ABAP Workflow Development within SAP Business Workflow
* Strong knowledge of workflow concepts such as business objects, tasks, agent determination, deadline monitoring, and workflow containers
* Proven experience with ABAP reports and interfaces, alongside enhancements (user exits, BAdIs, enhancement points) and other custom developments
* Understanding of how ABAP and SAP Workflow combine to build efficient and reliable process solutions
* Experience with debugging and performance optimization of workflow solutions and interfaces
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business processes into technical solutions

title: Senior Software Engineer (Java)
description:
**About Reveleer**


Reveleer delivers a unified platform spanning risk adjustment, quality improvement, clinical intelligence, and member management for health plans and provider organizations navigating the complexity of value\-based care. Trusted by 80\+ customer organizations nationwide, the platform integrates data, analytics, and intelligent workflow automation into one governed system designed to support traceable documentation across diagnoses, quality measures, and submissions. With regulatory expertise and transparent, human\-in\-the\-loop AI at its core, Reveleer supports organizations working to advance care quality, strengthen documentation integrity, and sustain the operational readiness needed to navigate audits with confidence.

**Why this role is important**  

  

The Senior Software Engineer (Java) at Reveleer is a highly experienced individual contributor working on Reveleer's encounter data processing and CMS submission systems for Medicare Advantage. This role focuses on strong execution, sound technical decision making, and delivering high\-quality software in a regulated, high\-data\-volume environment where submission accuracy and timeliness carry direct compliance and revenue impacts. Success means writing reliable, maintainable code, improving the throughput and stability of encounter processing, and owning customer outcomes.

**What success looks like**

* Data pipelines for CMS encounter data submission and response\-file processing run reliably and at high throughput, with issues surfaced and
* resolved before they reach CMS deadlines or customers.
* Features and services are well designed, implemented correctly, and operate reliably across a multi\-tenant platform.
* Technical decisions balance delivery speed with maintainability, performance, security, and regulatory accuracy.
* Legacy components are modernized safely, reducing security exposure and long\-term maintenance costs.
* Automated test coverage and delivery automation improve, reducing manual QA and operational toil for the team.
* AI\-assisted development accelerates delivery (refactoring, test generation) without lowering the quality bar.

**What you'll do**

* Design, develop, and maintain Java services for health care encounter data processing and CMS submissions (EDI X12\) within Reveleer's Medicare
* Advantage member management platform, using Spring, Hibernate, MS SQL, and RabbitMQ.
* Build and optimize high\-throughput batch and file\-processing pipelines for large\-volume EDI submission and response handling (837, 277CA, 999\), improving throughput, latency, and reliability.
* Contribute to the high\-scalability modernization goals of the platform: full infrastructure as code (IaC), session and authentication handling, and containerized deployment on AWS (EKS).\\
* Modernize legacy Java components safely, including version upgrades, dependency and security remediation, and migration behind tooling with rollback plans.
* Strengthen delivery quality by building automated tests and improving CI/CD pipelines, helping reduce manual QA and operational load across the team.
* Apply AI\-assisted engineering tools (such as Claude Code) across the development lifecycle (scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, code review).  

Contribute to system reliability, performance, and security; troubleshoot data and software problems in a compliance\-sensitive production environment and improve the systems so they require less manual intervention.
* Act as a technical subject matter expert within your domain, supporting other engineers through design input, problem\-solving, and code review.  

Work with product managers, analysts, and stakeholders to translate business and regulatory requirements into technical solutions.

**What you bring**

  

* 8\+ years of Core Java and J2EE enterprise web application development.
* Strong object\-oriented coding practices and design patterns.
* Spring Framework (MVC) experience highly preferred, along with Spring Batch or equivalent high\-volume batch processing experience.
* Demonstrated experience building high\-throughput data or file\-processing systems, with measurable improvements in throughput or latency.
* Hands\-on experience with EDI/X12 and CMS encounter data processing (EDPS/EDS), or comparable healthcare claims and submission systems.
* Advanced SQL, including database and query optimization (MS SQL preferred).
* Containerized, cloud\-native development on AWS (Docker and Kubernetes/EKS), including multi\-tenant SaaS architecture concerns such as tenant isolation and per\-tenant configuration.
* API development experience.
* Experience modernizing legacy Java codebases: version upgrades, dependency and security remediation, and migration tooling.
* Experience with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, observability and application instrumentation, and the full software development lifecycle in an Agile environment.
* Proficiency in AI\-assisted software engineering, with hands\-on use of tools such as Claude Code to accelerate development while maintaining a high bar for correctness, security, and maintainability.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and elevate quality through clear standards and practical coaching.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field required; Master's degree preferred

 **Desirable additional experience:**

* Message queues and streaming (RabbitMQ, AMQP, Kinesis, or equivalent).
* Infrastructure as Code and deployment pipeline configuration for cloud platforms.
* Continuous delivery practices (trunk\-based development, feature flagging).
* Front\-end development with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Familiarity with CMS submission channels (ConnectDirect, Edge server) and risk adjustment (HCC).

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Us:**
 YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e\-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
   

  

 Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high\-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
   

  

 We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View) APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award\-winning, people\-centric culture—recognized by
 *Inc.* 
 as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.
   

  

**What It's Like to Work at YipitData:**
 YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact\-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.
   

  

**Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:**
* **Ownership That Matters** 
 : You'll lead high\-impact projects with real business outcomes
* **Rapid Growth** 
 : We compress years of learning into months
* **Merit Over Titles** 
 : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
* **Velocity with Purpose:** 
 We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


**Who Thrives Here?**
 We hire sprinters, not coasters—people who:
   

  

* Choose growth over comfort
* Lead through challenges
* Are energized by high expectations


 It's not for everyone, and that's intentional. If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.
   

  

 We are hiring 2 senior software engineers (alternative title: senior backend engineer). One will join our Infrastructure Team, and the other will join our Data Feeds Team.
   

  

**As Our Senior Software Engineer in the Infrastructure Team, You Will be Responsible for:**
* **ERP Data Connector Specialist** 
 : You'll be the one implementing connectors to fetch ERP data. It's like building a bridge to a treasure trove of information. And not just that, you've got to ensure this data has high availability. So, whether it's the crack of dawn or the dead of night, the ERP data should be accessible without a hitch.
* **Backend API Master** 
 : Customers' requirements are constantly evolving, and that's where you come in. You'll be implementing or upgrading backend APIs to fit these new demands like a custom\-made glove. Your work will be the driving force behind our ability to keep up with the market.
* **ERP Data Storage Maestro** 
 : Take charge of the ERP system's data storage. It's your kingdom, and you're responsible for all related improvements. Make sure the data is stored efficiently and securely, and is always ready for action.
* **Business\-Tech Liaison** 
 : Understand the business requirements inside out. Jump right into discussions with the team and bring your A\-game to design technical solutions. You'll be the one who bridges the gap between business needs and technical implementation.
* **Service Maintenance and Upgrade Champion** 
 : Maintain our existing services like a pro. Dive into iterative upgrades, deploy improvements, and take charge of service governance. Your work will be the glue that holds our services together and keeps them evolving.
* **Global Team Player** 
 : Work hand\-in\-glove with our US/SG/China teams. Be flexible with work hours as the data world never sleeps, and we need you to be on top of your game, always!


**As Our Senior Software Engineer in the Data Feeds Team, You Will be Responsible for:**
* **Data Pipelines Maestro** 
 : You'll be responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining super\-scalable data pipelines. Whether it's structured data flowing like a well\-oiled stream or unstructured data that needs taming, you've got to make sure these pipelines are top\-notch for seamless processing.
* **Data Systems Guardian** 
 : Existing data systems and services. You bet you'll be the one maintaining and enhancing their stability, reliability, and ensuring high availability. Think of yourself as the shield that keeps our data world running smoothly.
* **Data Architecture Builder** 
 : Team up with our amazing crew to construct and refine an expandable, high\-performance data architecture. It's like building a digital skyscraper, but with data blocks!
* **Data Services Provider** 
 : Partner with different teams across the board. Your mission is to serve up high\-quality, rock\-solid data services to all our internal users. They'll be relying on you like a lifeline for their data needs.
* **Business\-Aligned Data Designer** 
 : Get the hang of product and business requirements. Then, design and implement data functionalities that are not only useful but also come with super\- intuitive data visualizations. Make data come alive!
* **Third\-Party Data Integrator** 
 : Oversee the integration and maintenance of collaborative data with our third\-party clients. Solve their data mining and analytical headaches, and you'll be the hero of the data realm.
* **Global Team Player** 
 : Work hand\-in\-glove with our US/SG/China teams. Be flexible with work hours as the data world never sleeps, and we need you to be on top of your game, always!
* **Data Governance Enforcer** 
 : Enforce the best practices in data governance, security, and compliance. You're the gatekeeper of sensitive information, and you've got to keep it safe at all costs.


**This is a fully\-remote opportunity based in India. Standard work hours are from 8 am to 5 pm IST.**
**You Are Likely To Succeed If you have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or related majors, 5\+ yrs backend experience.
* Solid computer foundation and programming skills, familiar with common data structures and algorithms.
* Excellent in one of the following languages: Go/Python
* Familiarity with one of open source components: Mysql/Redis/Message Queue/Nosql.
* Familiarity with ElasticSearch OR Spark (for Data Feeds Team)


**Experience in architecture and developing large\-scale distributed systems. (for Infrastructure Team)**
* Excellent logic analysis capabilities, able to abstract and split business logic reasonably.
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure, such as kubernates/docker, Azure/AWS/GCP.
* Familiarity with ERP systems.


**What We Offer:**
**Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:**
* We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, parental leave, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
* Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self\-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
