title: Senior AI Developer
description:
**Company Description** 
 CYBERTEQ is a cybersecurity technology company focused on driving digital and cyber resilience for clients globally. Through its flagship AI\-driven platform, MUNIT®, CYBERTEQ helps organizations build and maintain strong threat management postures. The company serves a diverse range of sectors, including finance, banking, insurance, telecommunications, manufacturing, and government. MUNIT® enables clients to defend their digital ecosystems, manage risk and resilience, and support sustainable business growth. CYBERTEQ offers a dynamic environment for professionals interested in advanced AI and cybersecurity solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Senior AI Developer will design, develop, and optimize AI models and algorithms that power CYBERTEQ’s MUNIT® platform and related cybersecurity solutions. This full\-time, on\-site role in Mumbai involves building and refining machine learning pipelines, implementing pattern recognition and neural network architectures, and creating intelligent features for threat detection, risk assessment, and resilience management. The person in this role will collaborate closely with cybersecurity experts, software engineers, and product managers to translate business and security requirements into robust AI solutions. Daily responsibilities include coding and testing production\-ready software, improving existing models based on performance metrics, conducting research on emerging AI techniques, and ensuring solutions meet scalability, reliability, and security standards. The Senior AI Developer will also mentor team members and contribute to architectural decisions and best practices across the AI and engineering teams.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Computer Science, including algorithms, data structures, and software design principles.
* Hands\-on experience in Software Development, with proficiency in one or more languages commonly used for AI (e.g., Python, Java, C\+\+).
* Practical expertise in Neural Networks and Pattern Recognition, including experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
* Applied experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), such as text classification, entity recognition, or conversational AI.
* Experience building and deploying machine learning models into production environments, preferably in cloud or hybrid infrastructures.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts, threat modeling, or risk management is highly advantageous.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
* Ability to work on\-site in Mumbai, collaborate in cross\-functional teams, and communicate complex technical ideas clearly.
* Experience in mentoring developers, reviewing code, and contributing to technical design and architecture.

Required Experience: 12\+ years
  

Skill set: Software design / Dev/ Java / J2EE / relational database
  

  

**Primary Skills**

* 12\+ years of hands\-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.
* 3\+ years of managing software development teams and providing direct guidance, mentorship, project leadership, and team development while fostering an engaging, collaborative environment and building strong cross\-team relationships
* Strong Java and Spring Boot experience
* Experience with microservices and distributed systems
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
  

Strong aptitude for highly efficient data structures and algorithms

Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. * Drive architectural decisions around scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and latency optimization.
* Ensure data quality, governance, privacy, and compliance across the performance advertising stack.

* Mentor engineers, set coding and design standards, and lead technical reviews across teams.

* Strong hands\-on experience with Golang in building low\-latency, high\-scale backend systems.
* Proven experience designing and operating real\-time bidding platforms, bidders, or ad serving systems.

* Experience with streaming and distributed systems (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming).

* Solid knowledge of SQL,PostgreSQL and large\-scale analytics platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar).

* Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and distributed system design.

* Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering (CS / IT) or equivalent degree from well\-known Institutes / Universities.

description:

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. We’re looking for a hands\-on Java engineer with 2\- 5 years of experience to design , build , and operate scalable, secure, and high\-performance services. * Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and Security to deliver features end\-to\-end.

**Required Qualifications (Must\-Have)**

* **Core Stack:**
* **Java 11/17\+** , **Spring Boot** , **Spring Data/JPA (Hibernate)** , **Spring Cloud** (config, discovery, resilience).
* **Microservices** architecture and inter\-service communication patterns.
* **RESTful API** design \& documentation ( **OpenAPI** **/Swagger** ).

* **Maven/Gradle** , **Git** , code reviews, and **CI/CD** pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps).

* Good knowledge in documenting APIs using **OpenAPI** **/Swagger** .

* **JUnit 5** , **Mockito** , **Testcontainers** ; knowledge of contract testing and integration testing.
* Familiarity with **SonarQube** and static analysis tools ( Checkstyle /PMD/ SpotBugs ).
* **Security \& Compliance:**
* **OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect** , **Spring Security** ; secure coding, handling secrets, and dependency management (OWASP basics).

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities; clear verbal and written communication.
* Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, Agile environment; manage multiple tasks.

* **API Gateways** (Kong, Apigee, Spring Cloud Gateway) and rate limiting .
* **Contract testing** with **Pact** ; **consumer\-driven contracts** .

* **Domain experience** in **payments/financial services** ; **Global** **PayPlus** exposure is a plus.

* Basic front\-end familiarity ( **HTML/CSS/JavaScript** ) for troubleshooting API integrations.
**Education**

* Bachelor’s in Computer Science , Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
**Tools \& Environment (Typical)**

* **Version Control:** Git (GitHub/Azure Repos)
* **CI/CD:** Jenkins / GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Azure DevOps
* **Build:** Maven or Gradle

* **Containers \& Orchestration:** Docker, Kubernetes
* **Collaboration:** Jira Boards, Confluence, Teams

title: Software Engineer (Secrets Manager & AI Identity)
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

**The Role**
 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced Software Engineers for our teams. As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden’s Secrets Manager team, you will lead the development of our dedicated secrets engine, machine\-to\-machine (M2M) authorization protocols, and developer\-focused CLI/SDKs \[cite: bitwarden\_teams\_charter\_strategy.md]. Looking ahead, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the core infrastructure that extends Secrets Manager into our next\-generation
 **AI Identity and Access** 
 management platform—securing ciphers, credentials, and API keys against the unique custody risks of autonomous AI agents and headless workloads.
   

  

 In alignment with our modern
 **True Ownership** 
 model, our engineers are "T\-shaped" professionals who own their services end\-to\-end—from initial design and secure development to automated testing, deployment, and operational health in production \[cite: Transforming Engineering Through Ownership]. You will collaborate closely in a synchronous "Embedded Trio" (Product, Design, and Engineering) to design and ship elegant, secure, and resilient code \[cite: elt\-modernization\-blueprint.md].
   

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
* Platform \& Feature Development: Design, build, and maintain high\-performance APIs, SDKs, and CLIs for Secrets Manager and our future AI Identity and Access security frameworks \[cite: bitwarden\_teams\_charter\_strategy.md].
* Machine \& AI Identity Custody: Implement secure, zero\-knowledge machine authentication, scoped access tokens, and runtime secrets injection gateways that protect credentials from being exposed to parent AI models or local execution environments.
* Decoupled Architecture: Work within our Decoupled Platform Architecture to ensure Secrets Manager operates as a highly scalable, independent tenant using its own dedicated data stores and asynchronous event\-driven message networks \[cite: elt\-modernization\-blueprint.md].
* End\-to\-End Ownership: Own the automated testing, deployment pipelines, and production SRE health of your team's services, participating in on\-call rotations and postmortem analyses to drive continuous operational improvement \[cite: elt\-modernization\-blueprint.md].
* Developer Usability: Build usable, highly developer\-friendly API endpoints, integration libraries, and comprehensive technical documentation to lower the friction of secrets enrollment and machine onboarding \[cite: bitwarden\_teams\_charter\_strategy.md].
* Security \& Compliance: Proactively threat\-model new services, remediate security vulnerabilities, and ensure our secrets engine maintains our strict, audited compliance standards \[cite: elt\-modernization\-blueprint.md].


**WHAT YOU BRING**
* Overall Experience: 3\-6 years in Software Engineering
* Technical Stack: Strong proficiency and experience in AI\-Led Development in C\# / .NET/ Rust, or TypeScript (our core Secrets Manager SDK is built in Rust).
* Identity \& Secrets Management: Practical experience designing or integrating machine identity platforms, vaulting services, OAuth/OIDC, or token\-based authorization structures (e.g., JWT, access tokens, API keys).
* AI/Agent Security Interest: Curiosity or experience with the security implications of AI agent architectures, large language model (LLM) memory isolation, or sandboxed execution environments.
* T\-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Experience writing robust automated integration tests, maintaining containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), and using modern APM and SRE logging tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Grafana) to monitor services in production \[cite: Transforming Engineering Through Ownership].
* Cryptographic Foundations: Solid grasp of symmetric/asymmetric encryption, zero\-knowledge protocols, and OS\-level secure storage APIs \[cite: Transforming Engineering Through Ownership].
* Collaborative Mindset: Excitement to work in a high\-velocity, outcome\-driven environment using rapid prototyping and data\-driven prioritization \[cite: elt\-modernization\-blueprint.md].
* Open Source \& Communication: Excellent written communication and a strong passion for open\-source software, developer tooling, and modern internet security \[cite: Transforming Engineering Through Ownership].


**WHY WORK WITH US**
* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our \#growth\-club to continue personal and professional development.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

Hiring: SAP Commerce (Hybris) Developer

**Experience:** 6–12 Years  
**Openings:** 5  
**Location:** Gurugram  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid – as per client policy  
**Shift:** Indian Shift Timing / 24×7 Rotational  
**Joining:** Immediate to 15 Days Preferred

Job Overview

We are looking for experienced **SAP Commerce (Hybris) Developers** to join our eCommerce development team for a dedicated project in Gurugram.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in **SAP Commerce/Hybris development**, Java, Spring, integrations, and eCommerce platforms. You will work closely with architects, product owners, business analysts, QA, and DevOps teams to build and maintain scalable and high\-performance commerce solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, customize, and maintain SAP Commerce (Hybris) solutions.
* Develop custom modules, extensions, and integrations within the SAP Commerce platform.
* Work on complex **B2C and/or B2B commerce implementations, migrations, and upgrades**.
* Optimize SAP Commerce applications for performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Develop and integrate **RESTful APIs** with ERP, CRM, PIM, payment gateways, and other third\-party systems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Work with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and containerization.
* Participate in technical design, development, testing, debugging, and production support activities.

Must\-Have Technical Skills

* **6\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP Commerce (Hybris) development.**
* Experience with SAP Commerce versions **6\.x, 1905 or above** preferred.
* Strong expertise in **Java, Spring Framework, and J2EE**.
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Hybris Core Platform
* Backoffice
* PCM
* Solr Search
* Impex / Hotfolder
* CronJobs
* WCMS
* SmartEdit
* Strong knowledge of **RESTful Web Services**.
* Good experience with **SQL and databases** such as MySQL, Oracle, or SAP HANA.
* Experience with **SAP integrations**, including SAP ERP, S/4HANA, and SAP Cloud Platform Integration.
* Hands\-on experience with **payment gateway integrations**, preferably Stripe, including credit card payments, digital wallets, and vouchers.
* Knowledge of frontend technologies such as **Spartacus** is preferred.

Additional Requirements – Senior Profiles

Candidates with **8–12 years of experience** should ideally have:

* Strong expertise in **product modeling, catalog structure, and workflows**.
* Experience designing and leading **B2C Hybris Accelerator implementations**.
* Strong experience integrating SAP Commerce with internal systems and third\-party vendor systems.
* Hands\-on experience with both **synchronous and asynchronous integrations**.
* Ability to independently handle complex technical requirements and production issues.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong hands\-on SAP Commerce/Hybris development experience.
* Good understanding of eCommerce architecture and commerce processes.
* Experience working in large\-scale enterprise projects.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and distributed teams.
* Candidates who can join **immediately or within 15 days** will be preferred.

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.**

Pay: Up to ₹1,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gurugram, Delhi

title: Senior Java Developer, Noida
description:
Lab49 is an award\-winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.
   

  

 We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high\-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud, and data science.
   

  

 Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier\-one investment banks and many of the largest buy\-side firms globally.
   

  

 Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers will work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build distributed systems that deal with actor\-based concurrency, reactive programming, distributed in\-memory data grids, messaging that goes beyond plain JMS as we fully expect to participate in shaping the future of financial technology stacks
* Work on server side JVM\-based projects
* Hit the ground running with the typical Java or Scala JVM ecosystem stack (Spring and its subprojects, Guice, Guava, Maven, Hibernate, Jetty, etc.)
* Retool continuously as the technology landscape changes every few years
* Be able to pick up other technologies along the whole development stack, including front\-end and other non\-JVM ecosystems
* Work with our clients in iterative, project\-based engagements, where self\-organizing and focused teams move quickly to build innovative solutions for the client
* Have the desire to collaborate, and like sharing and learning from your colleagues
* Be passionate about delivering quality code
* Demonstrate experience writing commercial\-grade software applications
* Have a deep understanding of multithreading and real\-time software architectures
* Have an abiding interest in and competence for solving real\-world business problems (with technology as an enabler)
* Be determined to succeed despite obstacles and challenges, as well as a positive attitude favoring achievement of goals over open\-ended investigation


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 8\+ years of recent hands\-on experience in designing and coding complex, enterprise, commercial\-grade applications in core, server\-side Java, ideally Java 8\+
* Experience building RESTful Web Services
* Test\-driven development, which includes Unit and End\-to\-End Testing
* Experience with Agile software development (e.g. SCRUM or KANBAN)
* Experience in a CI/CD environment
* Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Math, or related work experience
* Experience with, knowledge of, and strong demonstrated interest in, global financial markets and financial products.


 Why Lab49?
   

  

 Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49\. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.
   

  

 Lab49/ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.
   

  

 Lab49/ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.

title: Java Developer
description:
**Job Purpose:** 




  





 The Backend Software Engineer is part of a professional team developing critical business applications for the fund and banking industry. He/she uses current technologies, frameworks and tools in the field, as well as modern paradigms and architecture designs, such as microservices, containers, etc. He/she covers the full software development lifecycle including operations and maintenance and applies proven best practices to develop complex backend functionalities with high quality standards. In addition to new application development, the migration of existing software applications to distributed architectures is a key responsibility. The role requires an agile mindset and DevOps mentality, as well as autonomous coordination on requirements and issues with product management and support.
 



  





**Main tasks of the position:** 




  




* Implementation of change requests and maintenance of a multi\-tier Java application
* Developing business processes, complex business logic, and algorithms for the financial/fund industry as part of a software development team
* Performing software analysis, programming, testing, and debugging
* Creating well\-defined, efficient and well\-testable code
* Creation of unit/integration tests
* Documentation of designs, algorithms, APIs and processes
* Performance analysis and improvement of existing processes on database and Java code level
* Automation of processes through further development of CI/CD pipelines
* Execution of code reviews
* Active participation in architecture and design discussions and optimization as well as stabilization of existing services
* Evaluate new technologies, create prototypes, and assess existing software systems
* Assist our project managers/product owners with effort estimates and act as a point of contact for technical questions
* Coaching and guiding less experienced colleagues in general and in their own projects



  





**Side tasks of the position:** 




  




* Participation in the implementation of division and company\-wide initiatives for the strategic further development of processes, products and technologies



  





**Formal Education:** 




  




* Degree in (business) informatics or a comparable, successfully completed technical education, alternatively corresponding professional experience
* At least 3 to 6 years of professional experience at a software company or in a comparable position
* Successful supervision of software development projects as a senior/lead developer and significant contribution to the success of the team



  





**Qualifications/Skills/Personality Traits:** 




  






 Work experience
 




  




* Experience in software development of multi\-tier applications and complex backend workflows using Java 11 and above
* Experience in the development of REST APIs
* Solid knowledge of frameworks such as Spring, Hibernate (JPA)
* Knowledge of SQL and DML, PostgreSQL preferred
* Experience with development tools like git, SonarQube, Jenkins, IntelliJ or Eclipse
* Basic functional knowledge of the financial industry
* Up\-to\-date knowledge of topics and trends in the field of software engineering and its constant expansion
* Good knowledge of software engineering methods (UML, OOA, OOD, data modeling, etc.) and design patterns
* Sound practical knowledge of current container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift or Rancher
* Know and understand security challenges in the context of distributed software architectures, and identify and apply the right solution strategies



  





*Professional expertise and other knowledge*

 :
 




  




* Very good oral and written English skills



  






 Personality traits
 




  




* High quality awareness, open and goal\-oriented communication and the ability to quickly familiarize yourself with new topics
* Fun in software development and willingness to develop further, flexibility and team spirit
* DevOps mentality and open to collaboration within and across teams, including tasks/tools beyond programming such as deployment, automation and operations.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
**Compensation:** 
 INR 20\-35 LPA Base \+ Bonus \+ Equity
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon (Full time In\-office)
 



  





**What you need**



* 2\+ years shipping production backend code
* Strong Python and SQL
* Real experience integrating APIs across systems you do not control
* GCP (or AWS/Azure) and Docker
* Working knowledge of LLM systems: prompting, evals, retrieval, tool calling, agents
* Excellent spoken English. You will be on calls with US physicians weekly
* Comfort with ambiguity. Nobody hands you a spec



  






 Bonus:
 
 Voice/telephony (LiveKit, Twilio, ElevenLabs), EHR or RCM exposure (eClinicalWorks, Athena, HL7, FHIR), prior customer\-facing engineering, fluency with Claude Code or Cursor.
 



  





**About Us**




 We build the AI operating system for specialty medical practices in the US. Our voice agents answer patient calls, schedule appointments, chase prior authorizations and win back lapsed patients, live today across gastroenterology, nephrology, dermatology and radiology.
 



 Founded by AI/ML engineers from Google, Amazon and Snowflake. Small team, well funded, moving fast.
 



  





**The role**




 An AI Engineer ships production software inside a customer's reality. You take a live medical practice with its own EHR, its own scheduling rules and its own five exceptions to every rule, and you build the agent that works there.
 



  





 Half your week is code. The other half is calls with practice administrators figuring out what the code needs to do. You own accounts end to end and your name is on whether they succeed.This is not support or implementation. It is engineering with the customer in the room.
 



  





**You will:**



* Own deployments from scoping to go\-live for named US accounts
* Build integrations against EHRs, scheduling platforms and telephony
* Debug the full path: voice, LLM orchestration, EHR write\-back
* Own agent performance in production. Read transcripts, find failures, fix them, prove it with data
* Turn one\-off customer work into reusable tooling



  





**Why here**



* You hear your work. Listen to a real patient booking a colonoscopy with an agent you shipped last month.
* You write the playbook. The FDE team is small. Early hires define how we deploy, and the strongest lead pods within a year.
* No layers. Direct line to the founders, because you hold the field data.

The Lead SharePoint Developer will be responsible for building and maintaining custom solutions on O365 and 2013 – 2016 on\-premises farms using the Microsoft “stack” (ASP.NET, Azure, and C\#). This individual collaborates extensively with other developers and architects, as well as experienced project managers, user experience specialists, visual designers, analysts, and client resources to build enterprise systems that improve collaboration, business productivity, and support business operations. * Oversee unit and system testing, focused on features.
* Create, facilitate, and monitor results of acceptance testing procedures.
* Create and facilitate performance and load testing procedures and issue remediation.
* Transition projects to ongoing support/maintenance teams.
* Be able to perform custom deployments using PnP and/or PowerShell.

**Required Skills and Abilities**

* Have at least three years of experience customizing SharePoint platform with JavaScript and C\#.
* Have at least two years of experience administering and monitoring SharePoint with central administration (and/or O365 tenant administration).
* Have expertise in efficiently operating within Visual Studio and VSTS/TFS.
* Have expertise in object\-oriented development, architectural patterns, and software development best practices.
* Be able to collaborate with project team members and key client stakeholders to scope out projects. This includes facilitating work planning activities and technical envisioning activities that result in the execution of actionable and manageable phases of software development projects.
* Be able to facilitate requirements gathering and analysis activities such as storyboarding, use cases, and creating functional requirements specifications.
* Strong experience working with n\-tier architectures (UI, Business Logic Layer, Data Access Layer) along with some experience with service\-oriented architectures (SOA).
* Experience with Object Relational Modeling (ORM) with different tools such as Entity Framework (and/or nHibernate) and LINQ.
* Have a deep understanding of how to package and deploy a SharePoint JavaScript application using Visual Studio, gulp, webpack, etc.
* Be able to assist with legacy on\-premises solutions using WSPs, timer jobs, feature receivers, and full\-trust code.
* Be a self\-motivated, independent, detail\-oriented, responsible team\-player and exhibit exceptional relationship management skills.
* Operate within the dynamics of a team; exercise proper etiquette and citizenship during “team development” sprints.
* Have a passion for building high\-quality systems with software implementation best practices and mentoring others on how to do the same.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with all levels of the organization both internally and with clients.
* Knowledge of sound business practices and a proven track record of exceeding customer expectations and anticipating their needs.
* Willingness to travel to clients located throughout the Chicagoland area on a regular basis and a willingness for occasional travel to client sites located throughout the United States on an occasional basis.

**Nice to Have**

* Strong experience working with layered architectures (N\-Layer, Onion/Hex, DDD, CQRS) and an appreciation for appropriate layering and application structure.
* Hands\-on experience building scalable web applications, in particular high frequency and low latency web applications with optimal memory management, performance, and scalability as a key focus.
* Experience with Styling and Responsive Design techniques using technologies such as LESS, HTML5, Bootstrap, and SASS.
* Experience with native mobile application development on any platform.
* Experience with cloud ecosystems including Azure or AWS.
* Have prior consulting experience.

**Required Education**

* Bachelor of Science in Business/Computer Science or related field.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Security and Privacy, Detection AI, Core
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.

* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience in security systems, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.
* Experience as a technical lead with a proven track record of leading teams.
* Experienced in navigating high\-ambiguity environments and defining technical strategy for engineering teams.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



As a Senior Software Engineer (L5\) on the detection and response AI team, you will take end\-to\-end ownership of different workstreams across the Detection AI space. You will operate with high autonomy, translating ambiguous organizational goals into clear technical roadmaps. You will research, identify, and lead critical problems for the team to solve. Partnering alongside a peer Tech Lead, you will carve out multi\-quarter technical initiatives, establish architectural direction, and multiply the output of a talented pool of L3 and L4 engineers.


This team build multi\-agent systems to autonomously triage, investigate, and remediate security events, and architect governance frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and observability dashboards for security AI. We operate key enterprise platforms (Brief, Incident Communications) orchestrating critical communications during major Alphabet incidents.
The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Scope out problems in detection and response space and enable the organizational strategy to move left in the detection pipeline.
* Set technical direction, author comprehensive design documents, and lead design reviews for complex, multi\-quarter features within the team.
* Partner closely with cross\-functional peers and sister SWE teams to resolve architectural dependencies and align project timelines.
* Guide, mentor, and delegate tasks to adjacent junior and mid\-level engineers, fostering a collaborative engineering culture.

The Business Experimentation and Optimization (BE\&O) teams within Mastercard’s Services organization are building industry\-leading software that empowers business users around the world to make data\-driven decisions through advanced analytics and experimentation. As we expand our product offerings and modernize our technology stack, we are reimagining how we deliver scalable, cloud\-native solutions to our clients.  

  

We are seeking a hands\-on, technically strong Lead Software Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and development of our next\-generation experimentation platform. In this role, you will help define and evolve system architecture and non\-functional requirements—such as scalability, performance, security, and reliability—ensuring our solutions meet the highest engineering standards. As a technical leader, you will guide cross\-functional teams in building scalable services, APIs, and analytical capabilities that power our platform, leveraging technologies like Databricks and cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure. You will collaborate closely with your immediate team and partner with other development teams across programs to align on shared goals, define cross\-cutting initiatives, and deliver cohesive, enterprise\-grade solutions. You will also mentor engineers, work across global time zones, and champion engineering excellence through best practices in software development, observability, and continuous delivery.  

  

Our teams are small, agile, and empowered to choose the processes that work best for their goals. Every engineer contributes to the full development lifecycle—from ideation and design to implementation and testing—fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.  

  

Position Responsibilities:  

At Mastercard Services, you will serve as a senior technical leader and hands\-on engineer for BE\&O’s next\-generation experimentation and analytics platform. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead through technical influence, architectural judgment, and execution excellence to help modernize our platform and deliver scalable, secure, cloud\-native capabilities for global business users.  

  

Lead the technical design and delivery of complex, data\-intensive software solutions that enable advanced analytics, experimentation, and data\-driven decisioning for Mastercard clients.  

Define and drive technical strategy for modernization initiatives, including evolution of legacy systems toward scalable, cloud\-native, API\-driven, and service\-oriented architectures.  

Lead system design across multiple levels of detail, including platform architecture, high\-level design, detailed technical design, integration patterns, non\-functional requirements, and implementation approach.  

Serve as a hands\-on technical contributor, designing, coding, testing, debugging, and delivering production\-quality software across the full engineering lifecycle.  

Build and evolve scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and analytical capabilities using modern engineering practices, cloud platforms, and data technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, and related frameworks.  

Partner closely with product managers, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, QA, security, and operations teams to translate business and functional requirements into robust technical solutions.  

Coordinate and lead technical execution across globally distributed engineering teams, ensuring alignment across regions, time zones, dependencies, design decisions, and delivery milestones.  

Drive architecture and design reviews, code reviews, technical decision\-making, and engineering tradeoff discussions to ensure solutions are secure, resilient, observable, performant, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards.  

Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, developer productivity, operational readiness, and speed of delivery through modernization, automation, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices.  

Provide technical mentorship to junior and mid\-level engineers through design guidance, code review, pairing, knowledge sharing, and modeling strong engineering judgment.  

Navigate ambiguity in complex initiatives by clarifying technical direction, decomposing large problems, identifying risks, and driving alignment across stakeholders.  

Champion a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, ownership, collaboration, and high\-quality delivery across the team and partner organizations.  

Ideal Candidate Qualifications:  

  

8\+ years of software engineering experience delivering scalable, high\-performance, and reliable software in an agile environment.  

  

Strong hands\-on experience designing and building distributed systems, microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud\-native applications.  

  

Strong experience with data\-intensive applications and analytics platforms; experience with Databricks, Spark, or PySpark is highly desirable.  

  

Proven expertise leading system architecture, high\-level design, detailed design, and end\-to\-end technical delivery of complex software solutions.  

Experience driving technology modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, platform transformation, and modernization of legacy applications.  

  

Hands\-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes, observability, and modern software delivery practices.  

  

Demonstrated technical leadership as an individual contributor, influencing architecture decisions, driving technical strategy, and leading large cross\-team initiatives.  

Ability to translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.  

  

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, data science, QA, and operations teams.  

  

Experience leading and coordinating technical initiatives across globally distributed teams spanning multiple regions and time zones.  

  

Passion for mentoring and developing engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.  

  

Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and drive results through hands\-on execution.  

  

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus.  

  

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. Applicants will be considered and treated without regard to gender, gender identity, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disabled status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

-

title: Senior PHY Software Engineer – 2G/4G/5G
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced Senior PHY Software Engineer with 10\+ years of experience in cellular PHY software development, integration, debugging, and system troubleshooting across 2G, 4G, and 5G technologies.
   

  

 The role will primarily focus on PHY development, debugging, issue resolution, and integration within our cellular products. As part of our ongoing effort to improve engineering productivity and RCA capabilities, the engineer will also contribute to our AI\-assisted development and Root Cause Analysis initiative, helping build and fine\-tune AI\-based tools/agents for PHY log and crash analysis. The ideal candidate should be a strong PHY domain expert and problem solver, capable of going beyond linear debugging approaches and identifying root causes by correlating evidence across different sources and layers.
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Design, develop, debug, integrate, and maintain PHY software for cellular communication systems.
* Work across 2G, 4G, and 5G, understanding PHY behavior, implementation, and interaction with the overall system.
* Analyze complex PHY issues using logs, traces, crash dumps, KPIs, configuration, and system behavior to identify root causes.
* Develop and optimize PHY software and algorithms to improve performance, reliability, and product quality.
* Work with existing codebases and repositories, understand implementation flows, and extend or modify them without destabilizing existing functionality.
* Collaborate with MAC, RLC, RRC, RF, DSP, HW, and system teams to resolve complex product and field issues.


**What you should have:**
 10\+ years of experience in wireless communication / PHY software development, integration, debugging, or system troubleshooting.
   

  

 Strong hands\-on experience with 4G/LTE and/or 5G NR PHY, with working knowledge of other cellular RATs such as 2G.
   

  

 Good understanding of PHY architecture, algorithms, implementation, and interaction with other layers.
   

  

 Strong experience in PHY log analysis, debugging, issue isolation, and root\-cause analysis, including the ability to identify non\-obvious failure mechanisms.
   

  

 Ability to correlate logs, traces, configuration, KPIs, and system behavior rather than relying only on predefined or linear debugging procedures.
   

  

 Strong C/C\+\+ programming and debugging skills, with good Python/scripting skills for automation and analysis.
   

  

 Good understanding of DSP, digital communication, PHY/RF concepts, and relevant 3GPP specifications.
   

  

**AI \& Automation – Good to Have:**
 Exposure to AI/LLM\-based developer tools or coding assistants.
   

  

 Interest in applying AI to software development, debugging, log analysis, and RCA.
   

  

 Experience with automation, log\-processing, or internal debugging/analysis tools.
   

  

 Willingness to learn and adopt AI\-assisted development and agent\-based troubleshooting approaches.
   

  

 AI experience is not mandatory. Strong PHY domain expertise, development experience, and troubleshooting ability are the primary requirements.
   

  

 Nice to Have:
   

  

 Experience across multiple RATs, particularly 2G, 4G, and 5G.
   

  

 Experience with O\-RAN / Open RAN or advanced 5G PHY features.
   

  

 Experience with MATLAB or similar tools for PHY analysis, modeling, or simulation.
   

  

 Experience with Linux, Git, ARM, SIMD/NEON/AVX, or optimized DSP implementations.
   

  

 Experience with telecom debugging and analysis tools such as Wireshark, Kibana, or similar platforms.
   

  

 Role Evolution:
   

  

 The initial focus will be on understanding the existing PHY implementation, logs, failure patterns, and troubleshooting methodologies. Over time, the engineer will contribute to building and improving AI\-assisted RCA capabilities and use these capabilities as part of regular PHY development, debugging, and bug\-fixing activities.
   

  

 The objective is to combine deep PHY expertise with AI\-assisted engineering to improve debugging efficiency, RCA accuracy, and overall product quality.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Salesforce Developer
description:

In this role, you will play a crucial part in implementing end\-to\-end customer workflows using Salesforce Service Cloud and crafting highly responsive, custom digital touchpoints on Experience Cloud (Community Portals).  5\+ Years

 Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud (Portals), Salesforce DevOps Center, Robust API Integrations, Custom UI Design (LWC), Agentforce Configuration, and Azure CI/CD Pipelines.

* Service \& Portal Implementation: Implement and scale features within Salesforce Service Cloud (case management, productivity tools, Omni\-channel) and build custom\-tailored customer or partner\-facing portals on Experience Cloud.
* Custom UI Design \& Engineering: Build highly responsive, modern, and pixel\-perfect custom interfaces using Core Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, and Salesforce Lightning Design System (SLDS) to enhance user experience.
* API \& Backend Integration: Develop, optimize, and maintain custom inbound and outbound REST/SOAP API integrations to securely connect Salesforce with external applications and middleware systems.
* DevOps Lifecycle Execution: Execute routine release management tasks, sandbox syncs, and conflict resolutions utilizing Salesforce DevOps Center embedded within Azure CI/CD pipelines.
* Programmatic Excellence: Write clean, modular, and bulkified Apex code (Triggers, Classes, Asynchronous jobs) while strictly respecting Salesforce Governor Limits and system performance baselines.
* Agentforce Configuration: Configure, test, and tune autonomous AI agents using Salesforce Agentforce, setting up prompt templates, topics, and actions to streamline automated business interactions.
* Required Technical Skills
* Minimum 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience.
* Strong proficiency in Apex (Object\-Oriented design, bulk processing, exception handling) and custom Core LWC development.
* Practical design and implementation experience with Salesforce Service Cloud and Experience Cloud (Community Portals).
* Solid experience designing tailored, responsive user interfaces (UI Customization) using SLDS and modern CSS/JS frameworks.
* Proven track record of developing custom web services and handling REST/SOAP API integrations.
* Direct experience deploying metadata and applications via Salesforce DevOps Center and Azure CI/CD platforms (or equivalent Git\-based build pipelines).
* Practical exposure or functional training on Salesforce Agentforce architectures.



  





**Certifications (Required/Preferred):** 



1. Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (PD1\) is required; Platform Developer II (PD2\) is a strong advantage.
2. Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant or Experience Cloud Consultant.
3. Salesforce Certified Agentforce Consultant / Developer credentials are a major plus.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Video Platform
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
 
  
 


**Roku is changing how the world watches TV** 

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 



**What does the team work on?**
 You will be part of the Roku Video Platform Engineering team and responsible for building the next\-generation video services for the Roku Cloud TV Platform.
 



  

**What is the role?**
 Roku pioneered TV streaming and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The Roku Channel has us well\-positioned to help shape the future of streaming. Continued success relies on investing in the Roku Cloud TV Platform, so we deliver a high\-quality streaming TV experience at a global scale. In this role, you will work on key video services projects around video ingestion, encoding, VoD/live\-linear, Server Side Ads Insertion, and Video QoS, with the goal of delivering a best\-in\-class streaming TV experience across all Roku devices. The projects that you will work on will impact millions of Roku users around the world. All along, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with key product engineering stakeholders across Roku engineering teams, and lead the design of our video services platform. The ideal candidate will have endless curiosity and can pair a global mindset with locally relevant execution. You should be a gritty problem solver and self\-starter who can drive programs with the product and commercial teams within Roku and across external strategic partner organisations. The successful candidate will display a balance of hard and soft skills, including the ability to respond quickly to changing business needs.
 



  

**How will I use AI at Roku?**
 At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
   

 We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.  
 



  

**What are the responsibilities of the role?** 



* Design and implement highly scalable, and reliable web\-scale applications
* Translate functional specifications into logical, component\-based technical designs
* Key technical contributor to the design and implementation of core software backend components of video services platform
* Write and review code, evaluate architectural tradeoffs for performance and security for high\-performance, and high\-concurrency video infrastructure applications
* Collaborate with other engineering groups across the company towards supporting our video services initiatives
* Manage individual project priorities, deadlines and deliverables with limited supervision



  

**What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?** 



* Strong problem\-solving and analytical abilities
* 5\+ years of solid programming experience in Java core libraries and developing web server applications, object\-oriented design and design patterns, and passionate about writing high\-quality and well\-architected code
* Strong technical competency and experience in building high\-performance and cloud\-based scalable micro\-services
* Experience with design and implementation of modern micro\-services architectures and API frameworks (REST/JSON)
* Experience with web servers such as Apache, Tomcat, and building and deploying services on AWS cloud
* Experience with NoSQL data storage technologies such as Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redis, etc. as well as RDMBS like Oracle or MySQL
* Domain expertise in the area of Over\-the\-Top Video delivery technologies, On\-Demand/Live streaming, DRM, encoding, delivery, CDNs etc. is highly preferred
* Ability to handle periodic on\-call duty as well as out\-of\-band requests; strong written and verbal communication skills
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science plus 8 years of experience or equivalent; Master's degree preferred



  
 


**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.
 



  
 


**What are some of the benefits?** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**What should I know about Roku's culture?** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
 



 By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Technical Lead to drive the engineering vision and technical execution for our product. This role will be responsible for leading the engineering team in designing, developing, and delivering highly visible, business\-critical solutions using Microsoft Azure, .NET, Angular, and AI/ML technologies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership across the full software development lifecycle, champion cloud\-native architecture, and lead the adoption of Generative AI capabilities, AI\-assisted engineering practices, and modern DevOps methodologies to deliver scalable, secure, and high\-performing enterprise applications.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Provide technical leadership for the engineering team responsible for delivering high\-impact and business\-critical features for the high visibility products, ensuring solution quality, scalability, reliability, and maintainability
* Architect, design, and implement cloud\-native enterprise solutions using Microsoft Azure, .NET, and Angular, leveraging Azure services to build secure, scalable, and resilient applications
* Lead the design and implementation of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI initiatives that improve business processes, automate workflows, and enhance customer experiences across the product portfolio
* Drive the adoption and implementation of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, Prompt Engineering best practices, and AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph to develop intelligent enterprise applications
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Business Stakeholders, Data Scientists, Architects, and cross\-functional engineering teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions
* Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and coaching to software engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, design discussions, and technical knowledge sharing to foster engineering excellence
* Establish and enforce software engineering best practices, including secure coding standards, design patterns, performance optimization, testing strategies, and architectural governance
* Lead technical design discussions and contribute to strategic technology decisions, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, cloud strategy, and long\-term business objectives
* Drive DevOps maturity by implementing CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, observability, and release management practices to improve deployment efficiency and operational stability
* Champion the adoption of AI\-powered Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) tools to enhance developer productivity, automate repetitive engineering tasks, improve code quality, accelerate testing, and optimize software delivery
* Ensure applications meet enterprise standards for security, compliance, performance, scalability, and operational excellence while proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks
* Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and advancements in cloud computing, AI/ML, and Generative AI, recommending innovative solutions that deliver measurable business value
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, with solid expertise in Microsoft Azure, .NET, Angular, and AI/ML technologies
* Experience leading engineering teams and delivering enterprise\-scale cloud applications and AI\-driven solutions
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with a solid focus on continuous improvement and engineering best practices


**Technical Skills**
* Cloud \& Platform Technologies
+ Solid expertise in Microsoft Azure Cloud, including designing, deploying, and managing cloud\-native enterprise applications.
+ Experience with Azure services such as App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure SQL, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure API Management
+ Solid understanding of cloud architecture principles, microservices, distributed systems, scalability, security, and high availability

* AI/ML \& Generative AI
+ Hands\-on experience developing AI/ML\-enabled enterprise solutions
+ Solid understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and enterprise AI solution design
+ Expertise in Prompt Engineering techniques to optimize LLM performance for business use cases
+ Experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases, embeddings, document retrieval, and semantic search
+ Practical experience with LangChain and LangGraph for building AI agents, conversational applications, workflow orchestration, and intelligent automation
+ Familiarity with Azure AI services such as Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and Azure Machine Learning is highly desirable

* Application Development
+ Solid experience in .NET, ASP.NET Core, C\#, RESTful APIs, Web APIs, Entity Framework Core, and modern software design principles
+ Proficiency in Angular for building responsive, scalable, and maintainable front\-end applications
+ Experience developing enterprise\-grade applications using modern architectural patterns such as Clean Architecture, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), and microservices

* DevOps \& Engineering Practices
+ Experience with DevOps tools including Azure DevOps, Git, GitHub, Jenkins, YAML pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
+ Solid knowledge of Continuous Integration (CI), Continuous Deployment (CD), automated testing, release management, and monitoring practices
+ Experience integrating AI\-assisted engineering tools into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including AI\-powered code generation, automated code reviews, test generation, documentation assistance, and developer productivity solutions

* Leadership \& Collaboration
+ Proven ability to lead technical teams, mentor engineers, and drive engineering excellence across multiple initiatives
+ Solid analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills with the ability to balance technical innovation and business priorities
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with experience collaborating across engineering, product, architecture, and business teams


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer who can build, design, and scale Full\-Stack Apps \& AgenticAI systems, while also leading projects and engaging directly with customers. If you love solving tough/hard problems at scale, architecting modern distributed systems, and guiding teams to deliver impact, this role is for you.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Lead the design and development of complex Full\-stack apps and AgenticAI Platform/systems and applications using FastAPI, Node.js, and other modern frameworks.
* Drive system design and architecture decisions for highly scalable, distributed platforms.
* Build and maintain data pipelines and infrastructure, integrating data streaming technologies.
* Work across cloud environments (AWS and Azure), leveraging ECS, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments.
* Design and optimize databases, with strong focus on Postgres and vector databases such as Weaviate for search and AI\-driven applications.
* Develop agentic infrastructure and tooling for next\-gen AI workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers and internal teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering a culture of best practices in code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and scalability.



  





**Must Have Qualifications:** 



* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, with proven ability to deliver and scale systems in production.
* Strong knowledge of backend development, APIs, and microservices architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with system design at scale (high throughput, low latency, fault tolerance).
* Proficiency with databases (Postgres, MySQL, or others) and experience with vector DBs (Weaviate, Pinecone, or similar).
* Experience building data pipelines (batch \+ streaming) and working with modern data infrastructure. Using tools like Prefect and Temporal for scalable workloads.
* Familiarity with agentic platforms, AI tools, and workflow orchestration is a big plus.
* Strong experience with cloud infrastructure (ECS, EKS, AKS, Kubernetes, serverless).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Bonus points if you’ve worked with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi), observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry), or DevOps workflows (CI/CD, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Opportunity to shape architecture and strategy for critical systems.
* Work directly with customers and see your solutions in action.
* A culture that values autonomy, impact, and learning.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge AI infrastructure, data platforms, and agentic workflows.
* Fast\-track your entrepreneurial journey.
* Unmatched ownership, exposure, and impact.
* Shape the future of AI adoption.



  





 This is not a role for the faint\-hearted, we’re seeking someone who believes in the transformative power of AI and is driven to shape the future with it. If you’re deeply self\-motivated, technically strong, and want to wear the AI Planet badge with pride as we democratize AI for the world, read on.

description:

* Good technical/conceptual performance testing knowledge
* Proficient in any of the scripting languages

* Expertise in the utilization of AI and analytical tools based on the requirements

* Aptitude for understanding complex software from the functional and technical perspectives.
* Report progress against objectives on a periodic basis

* Individual Contributor

**What You’ll Bring**


* Strong programming skills with Python, Perl, Shell, etc.

 :

title: Quantitative Developer - C++/Rust
description:
**QUANTITATIVE DEVELOPER (CRYPTO HFT / MARKET MAKING)** 




  






 39k Group is a high\-frequency trading firm operating globally across centralized crypto exchanges. We specialize in ultra\-low\-latency strategies and market making, scaling infrastructure to handle billions of events daily with microsecond\-level performance.
 




  





**ROLE :** 




  






 \- Design, build, and operate ultra\-low\-latency automated trading systems for crypto market making and cross\-exchange hedging. The core mandate is tick\-to\-trade latency optimization \- from a market\-data frame arriving on the socket to an order leaving the wire \- in mission\-critical, latency\-sensitive codebases.
 




  





**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES :** 




  






 \- Design and maintain high\-performance, high\-throughput trading systems in Rust and C\+\+, built to process massive market\-data volumes with consistent, predictable performance under load.
 




  






 \- Apply metal\-level performance engineering : custom allocators, lock\-free and wait\-free concurrency, zero\-copy parsing, cache\- and branch\-aware data structures, aggressive compiler tuning (LTO, target\-CPU/instruction\-set tuning), and elimination of per\-tick/per\-order allocations on the hot path.
 




  






 \- Architect concurrency and runtime/threading models that isolate hot trading loops from background work to avoid tail stalls, scaling cleanly across available hardware.
 




  






 \- Build exchange connectivity and market\-data feed handlers across heterogeneous transports and protocols : TCP/UDP sockets, WebSocket, FIX, and SBE binary decoders; HMAC\-authenticated sessions, robust reconnect/dedup logic, and venue\-specific edge cases.
 




  






 \- Implement market\-making and order\-book imbalance strategies across many instruments concurrently, plus cross\-exchange hedging engines for real\-time inventory and risk offset.
 




  






 \- Build and maintain a low\-latency Order Management System (OMS) \- order placement, modification, and cancellation, lifecycle and state tracking, ack/fill handling, rate limiting, and reliable in\-flight order accounting under high message rates.
 




  






 \- Write clean, well\-structured, maintainable code with sound OOP and systems design, clear ownership of modules, and thorough testing of hot\-path correctness (including golden wire\-format tests).
 




  





**REQUIRED SKILLS :** 




  






 \- Strong C\+\+ and/or Rust with deep command of data structures, algorithms, and OOP; production track record on low\-latency, performance\-sensitive systems.
 




  






 \- Mastery of concurrency and asynchronous programming \- lock\-free techniques, memory ordering, synchronization, and their tail\-latency costs.
 




  






 \- Solid grounding in Linux, networking, and socket\-level programming \- TCP and UDP, kernel/userspace boundaries, TCP tuning (TCP\_NODELAY, etc.) \- and the cost of allocations, locks, and syscalls.
 




  






 \- Hands\-on with exchange protocols : WebSocket, FIX, SBE, and binary/HMAC\-authenticated APIs.
 




  






 \- Production observability (Prometheus / OpenTelemetry / Grafana) and Python for tooling and analysis.
 




  






 \- A bias toward clean, structured, well\-documented code and rigorous engineering discipline.
 




  





**NICE TO HAVE :** 




  






 \- Prior crypto or traditional HFT / market\-making / execution\-systems experience.
 




  






 \- Kernel\-bypass / NUMA / multi\-core optimization (e.g. DPDK, RDMA) and low\-level OS/network tuning.
 




  






 \- Experience integrating with centralized or decentralized exchange APIs.
 




  






 \- Comfortable with scripting languages such as Python and Bash for automation, tooling, and ops.

title: SDE 3
description:
**Software Development Engineer III** 
 (Backend) Build systems that move the world.
 



  





**Viamagus Technologies** 
 partners with high\-growth product and enterprise technology companies to bring exceptional engineering talent to teams solving real\-world problems at scale.
 



 If you’re an engineer who enjoys designing distributed systems, solving hard backend problems, debugging production issues, and seeing your code make an impact at massive scale — this role is for you. ⚡
 



**What You'll Do**




 You own the backend end to end. Design doc to deployment. Production to on\-call. Here's what that looks like day to day:
 


* **Architect** 
 and
 **ship** 
 backend systems that run in production at
 **enterprise scale** 
 .
* Build fault\-tolerant services with clear SLIs/SLOs, strong observability, and predictable performance.
* Drive
 **design** 
 and
 **implementation** 
 for microservices and distributed workflows messaging, async processing, retries, idempotency.
* **Work closely** 
 with a
 **team** 
 both Biological and Digital comprising Product, Frontend, QA/SDET, DevOps/SRE, and Data teams to turn business requirements into robust systems.
* **Raise engineering standards** 
 through design reviews, code reviews, and operational best practices.
* **Mentor junior engineers** 
 and lead by example on craft, ownership, and execution.



**What You Bring**




**Must\-Haves** 



* 7\+ years building
 **production backend systems SaaS or product environments** 
 preferred.
* **Strong fundamentals** 
 in distributed systems, concurrency, reliability, and scalability.
* Deep experience with
 **Java, Spring / Spring Boot preferred.**
* Proven track record
 **designing and building** 
**REST APIs and microservices** 
 .
* Strong hands\-on experience in
 **High\-Level Design (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD)** 
 — proven ownership of architecture decisions, not just implementation of designs handed down by others.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling
 **large\-scale, distributed systems** 
 capable of handling high transaction volumes and concurrent load.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **multi\-tenant architecture** 
 — designing systems that securely serve multiple clients/tenants on shared infrastructure without data leakage or performance interference.
* Working knowledge across the stack:
 **relational \+ NoSQL databases, messaging (Kafka/RabbitMQ), caching (Redis/Memcached).**
* Strong
 **debugging** 
 instincts, you resolve complex production issues with clarity and ownership.
* Exposure to
 **cloud platforms** 
 (AWS/GCP/Azure) and modern practices:
 **CI/CD** 
 , automated testing, observability.
* Track record of
 **shipping and coding** 
 and not just planning.



**Strong Signals \- We Actively Look for These**



* Degrees don't tell us much. These do:
* You've built something on your own time, open source, side project, internal tool.
* You've contributed to a top open\-source project.
* You've filed a patent or published research.
* You've written technical content others reference, or spoken at a conference.
* You've competed in or completed something grueling, ultra\-marathon, Ironman, competitive programming, hackathon wins.



***We don't fill seats. We hire builders who build for other builders.***




**What We Don't Care About**




 Which college you went to. Seriously.
 



 Whether your resume has Big Tech logos.
 



 How many years you've held exactly this job title.
 



  





***We care about what you built, why you couldn't stop, and how you think.***




  





**The Stack**




**Languages:** 
 Java, Spring / Spring Boot
 



**Infrastructure:** 
 AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch
 



**Data / ML:** 
 Spark, Airflow, optimization engines (routing, ETA, slotting)
 



**Scale:** 
 350\+ deployments · 30\+ countries · billions of deliveries · high\-volume daily computations
 



  





**Why This Role?** 




 Because you'll get to work on problems that are genuinely hard.
 



**Distributed systems. Massive scale. Reliability. Performance. Real\-world optimization.** 




 You'll have the opportunity to work alongside strong engineers, influence architecture, mentor others and still spend your time doing what great engineers love most —
 **building things.** 




  





 Ready to build what comes next??
 



  





 If you're ready to take ownership, solve problems that don't have obvious answers, and build backend systems that operate at global scale,
 **we'd love to hear from you.**
