 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on.  The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Following the acquisition of 1E, we are bringing our core remote connectivity platform and the DEX platform together into one unified product experience. Our team builds the platform services that connect both worlds — covering authentication \& authorization federation, user synchronization, and secure service\-to\-service communication between the platforms.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to play a key role in designing and building these platform integration services, trusted by large enterprise customers. As our core platform is built on Java, familiarity with Java Spring\-based (\& Kotlin) services is a welcome plus.
   

  

 As part of an Agile team, you’ll contribute as an individual contributor, working primarily with C\# .NET and SQL. Your work will power containerized services running on Azure Kubernetes. title: Senior Software Engineer Rust OR C++ Equities
description:
**Department Overview**
 The
 **Equities Technology** 
 division is responsible for building and maintaining the high\-performance, ultra\-low\-latency trading infrastructure that powers our global equities business. This includes market data dissemination, order routing, algorithmic execution, smart order routing (SOR), and real\-time risk management systems. We operate in a highly competitive environment where microseconds matter, requiring cutting\-edge software engineering practices, deep hardware\-software co\-design, and robust system reliability.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking an exceptional
 **Senior Software Engineer** 
 with deep expertise in
 **Rust** 
 and
 **C\+\+** 
 to join our Equities Low\-Latency Trading Technology team.
   

  

 In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize our next\-generation trading systems. You will lead the strategic transition of legacy high\-performance C\+\+ components to modern Rust where safety and concurrency are paramount, while continuing to maintain and optimize critical ultra\-low\-latency C\+\+ execution paths. This is a highly technical role requiring a strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, network protocols, and modern software engineering paradigms.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* System Design \& Development
* Architect, build, and maintain ultra\-low\-latency trading systems, including exchange connectivity gateways, market data feeds, and algorithmic execution engines using Rust and C\+\+
* Design clean, modular, and reusable APIs and libraries that can be leveraged across multiple trading desks.
* Lead the strategic migration of critical trading components from C\+\+ to Rust, leveraging Rust's memory safety and concurrency guarantees without sacrificing performance.
* Performance Optimization
* Profile and optimize systems to achieve sub\-microsecond latencies and deterministic performance.
* Apply low\-latency techniques such as CPU pinning, cache\-friendly data structures, lock\-free programming, memory\-mapped files, and custom memory allocators.
* Utilize kernel bypass technologies (e.g., Solarflare OpenOnload, DPDK, EF\_VI) to minimize network stack overhead.
* Concurrency \& Reliability
* Design and implement highly concurrent, thread\-safe, and lock\-free algorithms to handle massive throughput with minimal jitter.

* **Experience:** 9–12\&\#43; years in software engineering with strong focus on **cloud and iPaaS integrations**.

* **API Expertise:** Strong experience in **API architecture, governance, and lifecycle management**.
* **Integration Patterns:** Expertise in **event\-driven, microservices, and hybrid integration architectures**.
* **AI \& Copilot Skills:** (Good to have)


Hands\-on usage of **GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot** for development acceleration


* Understanding of **prompt engineering and AI\-assisted development workflows**
* Exposure to **Azure OpenAI / AI services integration**


**Delivery Experience:** Proven experience leading **large\-scale enterprise integration delivery**.


### **Preferred Skills**


* Experience with **MuleSoft architecture / coexistence strategies**.
* Exposure to **advanced AI/ML integration use cases and intelligent automation**.
* Knowledge of **data transformation standards (EDI, XML, JSON)** and large\-scale data pipelines.
* Familiarity with **AI governance, ethics, and secure AI adoption in enterprises**.

* **Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)**

 The Security \& Compliance Engineer will be responsible for overseeing the complete security and compliance workstream within our organization. * Implement NIST SP 800\-193 firmware integrity measures, focusing on detection, protection, and recovery mechanisms.
* Prepare security review packages for SSRB, LSRB, and BFSRB, including code review artifacts, architecture documentation, CVE posture reports detailing vulnerabilities and their mitigations, and managing remediation responses.
* Generate Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and conduct license audits for all Yocto/OpenBMC dependencies, preparing OSC submissions as required.
* Provide security review and sign\-off on CI/CD signing pipelines and management interface hardening, ensuring robust security measures are in place.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Proficient in firmware security architecture, including threat modeling and mitigation design.
* Security
* Strong understanding of FIPS 140\-2 compliance and experience with cryptographic library integration.
* Knowledge of NIST SP 800\-193 and its application in firmware integrity.
* Experience in preparing security review documentation, including CVE posture reports and remediation response management.
* Familiarity with open source license compliance, including SBOM generation and license audits.


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of the EU Cybersecurity Resilience Act (CRA) and its implications for product compliance.
* Experience with EAR/ECCN export control assessments for cryptographic components.
* Ability to coordinate or execute security penetration testing.
* Experience with HSM integration and signing infrastructure.
* Familiarity with CVE triage and patch backport workflow management.


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Electrical Engineering. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or CompTIA Security\+ are valued but not mandatory.
   

  

**Prior Work Experience — Examples That Would Be Helpful**
* Developed a formal threat model for an embedded firmware product or IoT device, addressing all network\-facing attack surfaces with documented mitigations.
* Integrated a FIPS 140\-2 validated cryptographic library into a Yocto\-based embedded Linux build and validated compliance.

 We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
   

  

 Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
   

  

 You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter\-personal skills to build the required relationships.

 ü Integrate with SAP and non\-SAP systems using SAP\-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
   

  

 ü Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
   

  

 ü Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in\-app/extensibility, key\-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean\-core approach where applicable).
   

  

 ü Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
   

  

 ü Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root\-cause analysis
   

  

**Qualification And Experience Required \-**

 ü 2\-5 years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
   

  

 ü Hands\-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
   

  

 ü SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
   

  

 ü SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
   

  

 ü Strong hands\-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
   

  

 ü Proven delivery experience with:
   

  

 ü RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
   

  

 ü CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
   

  

 ü OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
   

  

 ü Strong understanding of HANA\-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT\-in\-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
   

  

 ü Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
   

  

 ü Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).
   

  

**ü Preferred / Nice To Have**

**Preferred \-**

title: AI Lead, Security R&D
description:
Back to Careers
   

  

 Active Hiring
   

  

 AI Lead, Security R\&D
   

  

 Engineering Bengaluru, India Full\-time, 6\-12 years experience
   

  

 "We are building the technical core of Agentic SecOps."
   

  

**About Trench**
 Security Operations is entering a fundamentally different era. AI is changing how detection, investigation and response can be performed, while the scale and complexity of security telemetry continues to grow. Trench is building an agentic operating system for Security Operations.
   

  

 We are looking for an AI Lead, Security R\&D to build the technical foundation behind this vision: the security data platform, AI agent infrastructure and engineering systems that power Trench. This is a builder's leadership role. You will set technical direction, lead a small senior team and stay hands\-on.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 You will work across Security Data, AI Agents and Platform Infrastructure. You will solve hard technical problems around high\-scale security telemetry, AI agent infrastructure and reliable production systems. You will work closely with the CTO and product team to turn these systems into the foundation for Trench's next generation of Security Operations.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Security data platform: Architect and scale our security data platform across storage, schemas, partitioning, retention and high\-speed queries over security telemetry.
* Data pipelines: Build high\-throughput ingestion, parsing, normalization and enrichment across cloud, endpoint, identity, network and SaaS sources.
* AI agents \& infrastructure: Build the infrastructure and gateway layer powering detection, investigation and response agents, including orchestration, observability, cost controls and guardrails.
* Platform \& DevOps: Own the infrastructure that keeps Trench reliable and secure across cloud, IaC, CI/CD, containers and observability.
* Lead the team: Hire, mentor and grow engineers while setting technical direction and raising the engineering bar.
* Stay hands\-on: Write production Go and Python and use AI copilots and agentic tooling to accelerate how we build.


 MINDSET
   

  

* You are a builder. You solve hard problems and ship production systems.
* You think in systems. You can move across data, AI and infrastructure without losing the bigger picture.
* You use AI by default. You believe AI should fundamentally change how engineering teams build.
* You have strong technical judgement. You know when to build, when to use existing technology and when to go deep.
* You move fast. You are comfortable with ambiguity, take ownership and have a bias to ship.
* You want to build something new. We are not adding AI to another SIEM. We are building the technical foundation for a different way of doing Security Operations.


**What We're Looking For**
* 6 to 12 years building and operating data\-intensive backend or platform systems.
* Deep experience with data storage and processing at scale.
* Strong understanding of columnar, vector and key\-value databases.
* Experience building high\-throughput pipelines using Kafka, Pub/Sub or similar technologies.
* Strong Go and Python skills.
* Experience with data mesh or domain\-oriented architectures.
* Experience leading engineers while remaining technically hands\-on.
* High ownership, startup mindset and bias to ship.
* Cybersecurity exposure or the ability to quickly understand security data and SOC workflows.


 BONUS POINTS
   

  

* Open\-source database or infrastructure contributions.
* Experience building AI agents or agentic systems in production.
* AI gateway or agent orchestration experience.
* Strong use of Claude, copilots or agentic development tooling.
* SIEM, security data platform, detection engineering or MITRE ATT\&CK experience.


 WHY THIS ROLE
   

  

 You Will Help Build The Infrastructure Behind a New Operating Model For Security Operations. You Will Work On Problems Such As
   

  

* How do we process massive volumes of security telemetry efficiently?
* How do we build AI agents that can reason over security data reliably?
* How do we make those agents production\-ready, observable and controllable?


 If these problems excite you, this is the role.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Email career@trenchsecurity.ai with a short note about something hard you've built. It could be a data platform, high\-scale pipeline, open\-source contribution or AI\-agent system. Include your GitHub and LinkedIn.
   

  

 No formal cover letter needed. Show us what you've built. Show us how you think.

**About EnCharge AI:** 




 EnCharge AI is building the next generation AI platform. Our novel in\-memory\-computing architecture delivers a 10x step\-function improvement in compute energy efficiency and performance for AI inference workloads. As the demands of artificial intelligence move beyond today's models, we believe fundamental underlying infrastructure must evolve. We are an experienced team of AI researchers, silicon \& systems engineers, and architects backed by leading investors, poised to become the essential platform for the next wave of AI innovation.
 



**The Opportunity:** 




 Modern AI workloads—from large language models to diffusion\-based generators to multimodal systems—represent some of the most compute\-intensive frontiers in AI, and some of the most promising applications for our hardware’s energy efficiency advantages. We’re building a vertically integrated AI stack that will showcase the transformative potential of our silicon while delivering real value to customers today.
 



 We are seeking a Research Engineer to push the boundaries of AI model capability, quality, and efficiency. You’ll build fine\-tuning and post training pipelines, develop rigorous benchmarking frameworks, and work at the intersection of ML research and hardware\-aware optimization—ensuring our models run beautifully on our silicon.
 



 This is a role for someone who thrives at the boundary between research and engineering. You’ll read papers, implement techniques, and ship production\-quality code—all in service of making AI inference faster, cheaper, and better.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**

 Research and implement state\-of\-the\-art techniques to accelerate AI inference—quantization, sparsity, distillation, speculative decoding, caching strategies, and architectural modifications.  Partner closely with hardware, compiler, and quantization teams to ensure algorithmic improvements translate to real gains on our silicon. Identify optimizations aligned with our architecture's strengths—maximizing throughput while minimizing power. Shape the feedback loop between model development and hardware.

 Build profiling tools and comprehensive benchmarking frameworks to understand compute bottlenecks, measure model quality across standard and domain\-specific evals, and track efficiency metrics.

 globally. We're transforming how the world processes data by delivering
   

  

 innovative semiconductor solutions that enable our customers to differentiate

 development, design, verification, and customer support across multiple
   

  

 technical disciplines. We're building a culture of technical excellence,
   

  

 innovation, and collaboration.

 A modern computing platform is only as good as the firmware that brings it to life.

This role combines deep technical expertise with hands\-on development across multiple generations of Intel, AMD, and Arm platforms.

* Stay current with emerging firmware technologies, chipset architectures, security requirements, and industry standards

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
* 3\+ years of UEFI, BIOS development experience
* Strong understanding of Intel IA32 and x64 architecture
* Strong programming skills in C and Assembly language
* Extensive experience in BIOS, UEFI, PI, and EDK II development
* Deep understanding of PC architecture and platform initialization flows
* Experience enabling and debugging Intel, AMD, and/or AArch64\-based platforms
* Strong knowledge of platform firmware standards including PCIe, ACPI, SMBIOS, USB, and related specifications
* Experience reading hardware schematics and board\-level layouts
* Proven expertise in low\-level system debugging and hardware troubleshooting
* Hands\-on experience with platform debug tools
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Self\-starter capable of driving solutions independently and delivering results in a fast\-paced environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field
* 3\+ years of BIOS or firmware development experience
* Experience with Aptio V firmware architecture
* Experience enabling server, AI server, edge computing, embedded, or IoT platforms
* Knowledge of firmware security technologies including Secure Boot, TPM, TME, SEV, TXT, and related platform security solutions
* Familiarity with CRA, NIST, and emerging firmware security compliance requirements
* Experience working directly with OEMs, ODMs, silicon vendors, or hyperscale customers


**LOCATION**
 Chennai , India
   

  

**Additional Information**
 This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:
   

  

 India
   

  

 Lattice recognizes that employees are its greatest asset and the driving force behind success in a highly competitive, global industry. Lattice continually strives to provide a comprehensive compensation and benefits program to attract, retain, motivate, reward and celebrate the highest caliber employees in the industry.

* Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post\-incident review.

* Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing.
* Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer).
* Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders.

* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms.
* Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large\-scale data ingestion.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. We are now looking for ASIC Flow and Integration Engineer to drive design methodology, automation, and integration for our High Speed IO team.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 As one of the primary methodology engineer, you’ll work across all NVIDIA\-delivered projects, owning the integration process and collaborating with global teams to define and implement best\-in\-class methodologies. You’ll operate beyond RTL coding—building infrastructure and systems that are modular, reusable, and easily deployable across diverse silicon platforms. * Own the full\-chip and block\-level integration process across multiple NVIDIA SoC and GPU projects.
* Stitch together RTL units and ensure seamless connectivity, and hierarchy management.
* Define and evolve internal design methodologies to improve scalability, quality, and turnaround time.
* Build automation pipelines using Python/Perl to streamline integration, debug, and delivery.
* Develop modular and reusable systems that can be easily delivered and adapted across different SoC and GPU architectures.
* Collaborate extensively with RTL, verification, physical design, and architecture teams to ensure flow compatibility and design readiness.
* Drive full\-chip debug efforts, connectivity, and functional issues across multiple hierarchies and technology nodes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of internal standards and mentor engineers on flow usage and integration practices.


**What We Need To See**
* BS or B.Tech or MS or M.tech in EE, ECE, CS, or equivalent degree with 2\+ years or more experience in design integration and methodologies for ASIC design.
* Comprehensive understanding of IP development flows, build flows is a must
* Excellent influencing skills resulting in collaboration with cross\-cultural, multi geography and matrixed teams
* Good debugging, analytical and problem solving skills
* Great interpersonal skills and ability to work as an excellent teammate
* Working exposure with AI tools like Claude and Cursor would be a plus

 Role Title: Senior Quality Engineer I
   

  

 Position ID: 2026\_1597
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a highly skilled and detail\-oriented SDET to join our quality engineering team. This role requires strong experience in test automation, microservices testing, and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce. The ideal candidate will also have hands\-on expertise with tools like TOSCA and Postman, and a passion for delivering high\-quality, scalable software solutions.
   

  

 Candidate will work across multiple products \& engineering teams to deliver incremental value against Loyalty Platform roadmap. Help develop proof\-of\-concept implementations to help evaluate cutting\-edge technology to drive and meet Marriott business \& technology objectives. Candidate must have the ability to communicate upward to superiors and laterally to other departments.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
 Design and implement automated test frameworks for Salesforce applications, including UI, API, and end\-to\-end testing. Develop and execute automated tests for microservices\-based architectures, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance. Utilize TOSCA for model\-based test automation, including test case design, execution, and maintenance. Perform API testing using Postman, validating service contracts, data flows, and integration points. Collaborate with developers, product owners, and QA analysts to define test strategies and ensure comprehensive coverage. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, or Azure Dev Ops. Monitor test execution, analyze failures, and provide actionable feedback to development teams. Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Skill And Experience**
 4\+ years of experience in software testing and automation. Hands\-on experience with Salesforce testing, including declarative and programmatic components. Strong understanding of microservices architecture and testing strategies for distributed systems. Proficiency in TOSCA for test automation and test data management. Experience with Postman for API testing and automation. Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, or Java Script. Familiarity with test automation tools like Selenium, Cypress, Test NG, and JMeter. Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD tools. Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a passion for quality.
   

  

**Education And Certifications**
 Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent experience/certification
   

  

 Work location: Hyderabad, India.

As we change and grow, the beliefs that are most important to us stay the same—putting people first, pursuing excellence, embracing change, acting with integrity, and serving our world. title: Senior Design Verification Engineer
description:
**About SiFive**

 At SiFive, we are always excited to connect with talented individuals, who are just as passionate about driving innovation and changing the world as we are.
   

  

 Our constant innovation and ongoing success is down to our amazing teams of incredibly talented people, who collaborate and support each other to come up with truly groundbreaking ideas and solutions. Solutions that will have a huge impact on people's lives; making the world a better place, one processor at a time.
   

  

 Are you ready?
   

  

 To learn more about SiFive’s phenomenal success and to see why we have won the GSA’s prestigious Most Respected Private Company Award (for the fourth time!), check out our website and Glassdoor pages.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a
 **Senior Design Verification Engineer** 
 to own block‑ and subsystem‑level DV for advanced
 **out‑of‑order (OoO) CPU cores** 
 . You will work closely with micro‑architects and RTL designers to verify complex execution pipelines, memory systems, and coherence protocols using modern, coverage‑driven methodologies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Verification Planning \& Ownership**
* 
+ Drive verification for key OoO CPU blocks, such as:
+ Front‑end: fetch, branch prediction, decode.
+ Rename and register mapping.
+ Issue queues / schedulers and execution units.
+ Reorder buffer (ROB), retirement, exceptions, and flush/replay.
+ Load‑store unit (LSU), store buffer, atomics/LR‑SC, fences.
+ L1 caches, TLBs, MMU interfaces, and coherence interfaces.
+ Derive verification plans from architecture and micro‑architecture specs, with emphasis on:
+ Speculative execution flows and pipeline hazards.
+ Memory ordering / consistency model compliance.
+ Interaction with cache hierarchy and coherence.


**Testbench \& Environment Development**
* 
+ Develop and maintain SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches:
+ UVM agents, monitors, scoreboards, reference models.
+ Constrained‑random stimulus and directed tests for OoO corner cases.
+ Implement self‑checking mechanisms for:
+ Instruction retirement and architectural state.
+ LSU / memory ordering, atomics, and fence behavior.
+ TLB, page‑table, and privilege/protection flows as needed.


**Coverage \& Quality**
* Define and track functional, code, and assertion coverage; identify gaps and add tests/monitors to close them.
+ Create and maintain assertions (SVA) for key micro‑architectural properties:
+ No deadlock/livelock in scheduler, ROB, LSQ.
+ Correct handling of mispredicts, exceptions, interrupts, and flush paths.
+ Correct data forwarding and hazard resolution in the pipeline.

* Analyze regression results, triage failures, and drive issues to closure with design and architecture teams.


**Debug \& Collaboration**
* 
+ Debug complex failures in:
+ Speculation / replay (e.g., wrong‑path side‑effects, partial flushes).
+ Load‑store ordering and memory consistency violations.
+ TLB / MMU corner cases and privilege/protection issues.
+ Collaborate with:
+ Micro‑architecture \& RTL on fixes and design clarifications.
+ Performance / modeling teams to align micro‑architectural behavior and verification scenarios.
+ Post‑silicon / validation teams to correlate pre‑ and post‑silicon issues.


**Methodology \& Mentoring**
* Contribute to DV methodology improvements (UVM components, coverage strategies, regression flows).
* Provide guidance and code reviews to junior engineers on testbench design, stimulus generation, and debug.


**Required Qualifications**
* Education: BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
+ Experience:
+ Typically 5–10 years of ASIC/SoC/IP design verification experience.
+ Direct experience verifying out‑of‑order or superscalar CPU cores (or closely related high‑performance pipelines).
+ Technical Skills:
+ Strong proficiency in System Verilog and UVM (or equivalent class‑based DV methodology).
- Solid understanding of CPU micro‑architecture, including:
- Fetch/decode, rename, ROB, issue/execute, bypassing, commit.
- LSU, store buffer, atomics/LR‑SC, fences, and memory ordering.
- L1 caches, TLBs, page‑table walkers, and basic coherence concepts.
- Hands‑on experience with:
- Constrained‑random and coverage‑driven verification.
- Writing and debugging SVA assertions.
- Industry‑standard simulators (e.g., VCS, Xcelium, Questa) and debug tools (e.g., Verdi/DVE).

+ Soft Skills:
+ Strong problem‑solving and debug skills on complex, corner‑case bugs.
+ Effective communication and teamwork across DV, design, and architecture.
+ Ability to work independently on complex blocks while contributing to a larger project.


**Additional Information:**
 This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:
   

  

 India
   

  

 Any offer of employment for this position is also contingent on the Company verifying that you are a authorized for access to export\-controlled technology under applicable export control laws or, if you are not already authorized, our ability to successfully obtain any necessary export license(s) or other approvals.
   

  

 SiFive is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: SAP BDC Developer
description:
SAP BDC Developer

**Experience:** 5\+ Years  
**Role:** SAP BDC Developer  
**Employment Type:** Contractual Role ( 3months Reviewal )  
**Location:** Hyderabad/Pune/Bangalore

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **SAP BDC (Business Data Cloud) Developer** with 5\+ years of experience in SAP data and analytics technologies. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and maintaining data solutions using **SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and SAP Databricks**.

The role requires strong hands\-on experience in data modeling, data integration, analytics, reporting, and cloud\-based data engineering. The ideal candidate should be able to work across the complete data lifecycle—from extracting data from SAP and non\-SAP sources to building analytical models and delivering business insights through SAC.

Key Responsibilities1\. SAP Datasphere

· Design, develop, and maintain data models and analytical models in **SAP Datasphere**.

· Build **Spaces, Data Builder objects, graphical views, SQL views, and analytical models**.

· Develop data integration pipelines to extract and transform data from SAP and non\-SAP systems.

· Work with SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/BW4HANA, SAP HANA, and other enterprise data sources.

· Implement data federation, replication, and transformation based on business requirements.

· Develop reusable data models following SAP Datasphere best practices.

· Optimize data models and queries for performance and scalability.

· Troubleshoot data loading, transformation, connectivity, and performance issues.

· Implement appropriate security, access controls, and data governance within Datasphere.

2\. SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)

· Develop interactive dashboards, analytical applications, and reports using **SAP Analytics Cloud**.

· Create stories using optimized Datasphere models and other supported data sources.

· Develop calculated measures, dimensions, restricted measures, filters, and input controls.

· Implement SAC planning and analytical capabilities where required.

· Configure live and import data connections.

· Build executive dashboards and operational reports based on business requirements.

· Optimize SAC stories and queries for performance and usability.

· Work with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and convert them into analytical solutions.

3\. SAP Databricks / Data Engineering

· Develop and maintain data engineering solutions using **SAP Databricks**.

· Build data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, cleansing, and processing of large datasets.

· Work with **Apache Spark, SQL, Python/PySpark**, and Databricks notebooks.

· Develop scalable data processing solutions using Delta Lake and related Databricks capabilities.

· Integrate SAP and non\-SAP data sources with Databricks\-based data platforms.

· Perform data cleansing, transformation, aggregation, and enrichment.

· Implement data quality checks and validation processes.

· Optimize Spark jobs, SQL queries, and data pipelines for performance and cost efficiency.

· Support integration between Databricks, SAP Datasphere, and downstream analytics solutions.

4\. SAP Business Data Cloud

· Work on end\-to\-end **SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC)** solutions involving Datasphere, SAC, and SAP Databricks.

· Understand business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions.

· Participate in BDC architecture and solution design discussions.

· Develop integrated data pipelines across SAP and non\-SAP environments.

· Support data products and analytical use cases built on the BDC platform.

· Ensure data is available, governed, secure, and optimized for analytical consumption.

· Troubleshoot integration and data\-flow issues across Datasphere, Databricks, and SAC.

5\. Data Modeling \& SQL

· Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models.

· Develop complex **SQL queries, views, procedures, and transformations**.

· Implement dimensional modeling concepts such as **Star Schema, Fact and Dimension models**.

· Perform data profiling, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation.

· Analyze and optimize SQL queries and data processing workloads.

· Ensure consistency and accuracy of data across source and target systems.

6\. Integration \& Data Management

· Develop data integration solutions between SAP and third\-party systems.

· Work with APIs, OData, database connections, files, and other integration mechanisms.

· Monitor data pipelines and resolve failures within agreed SLAs.

· Implement error handling, logging, and data validation mechanisms.

· Support data migration and transformation activities when required.

7\. Collaboration \& Delivery

· Work closely with business analysts, functional consultants, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders.

· Participate in requirement gathering, technical design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

· Prepare technical documentation, data\-flow diagrams, and solution documentation.

· Participate in code reviews and follow development and deployment standards.

· Provide production support and root\-cause analysis for data and reporting issues.

· Mentor junior developers and contribute to the continuous improvement of development practices.

Required Technical Skills

**Must Have:**

· 5\+ years of experience in SAP Data \& Analytics technologies.

· Strong hands\-on experience with **SAP Datasphere**.

· Strong experience with **SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)**.

· Hands\-on experience with **Databricks / SAP Databricks**.

· Strong SQL skills.

· Good knowledge of data modeling and data warehousing concepts.

· Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/BW4HANA, or SAP HANA.

· Experience in data extraction, transformation, integration, and data quality.

· Knowledge of **Python/PySpark and Apache Spark**.

· Experience developing analytical dashboards and reports.

· Good understanding of cloud data platforms and modern data architecture.

Good to Have

· Experience with SAP Business Data Cloud architecture and concepts.

· SAP Datasphere certification.

· SAP Analytics Cloud certification.

· Databricks certification.

· Experience with SAP BTP.

· Knowledge of SAP HANA Cloud.

· Experience with APIs/OData and third\-party integrations.

· Knowledge of Delta Lake and Lakehouse architecture.

· Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices.

· Knowledge of data governance, security, and access management.

· Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Soft Skills

· Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

· Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

· Ability to work independently as well as within a team.

· Strong ownership and accountability for deliverables.

· Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

· Good documentation and presentation skills.

· Willingness to learn and adapt to evolving SAP BDC technologies.

Key Deliverables

The candidate will be expected to contribute to:

· SAP Datasphere data models and data products.

· SAP Databricks data pipelines and transformations.

· SAC dashboards, stories, and analytical applications.

· SAP and non\-SAP data integrations.

· Data quality and reconciliation processes.

· Performance optimization.

· Production support and issue resolution.

· End\-to\-end SAP Business Data Cloud implementations.

Ideal Candidate Profile

An ideal candidate is a **hands\-on SAP BDC Developer** who can work across **SAP Datasphere \+ SAP Analytics Cloud \+ SAP Databricks**, rather than being specialized in only one component.

The candidate should be comfortable working across the complete flow:

**SAP / Non\-SAP Sources → SAP Databricks → SAP Datasphere → SAP Analytics Cloud → Business Insights**

and should have the ability to understand both **data engineering and analytics requirements**.

Pay: ₹120,000\.00 \- ₹160,000\.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana (Hyderabad, Hyderabad District)

title: Software Engineer ( Python + PySpark + Agentic AI ) - 5 + Years
description:
### **Description**

  

 We are looking for an experienced Python \+ PySpark Developer with a strong background in designing, developing, and optimizing large\-scale data processing solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, PySpark, SQL, and big data technologies. You will build the large\-scale data pipelines and agentic AI features that power our platform on AWS. You will apply strong Python and PySpark skills to data processing on EMR on EKS, and build LLM\-based agents that assist and automate work on our data under human oversight.### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

* Write and tune PySpark jobs on EMR (EMR on EKS) and Delta Lake to prepare and transform data at scale
* Design and build LLM\-powered agents that plan tasks, call tools, and propose or apply actions against our services and data, under confidence thresholds and human\-in\-the\-loop review
* Define the tools and APIs agents can use, and connect agents to internal systems (e.g., via Model Context Protocol)
* Build retrieval\-augmented (RAG) pipelines: chunking, embeddings, vector search, and grounding responses in our data
* Design agent workflows with clear guardrails, confidence gating, human\-in\-the\-loop exception handling, and fallback behavior
* Write prompts and evaluation harnesses; run evaluation in CI and measure agent quality, cost, and latency, then iterate
* Build and maintain Python services and shared libraries, and Kafka producers/consumers for moving data between services
* Serve agents behind APIs and monitor them with LLM/agent observability (quality, cost, latency, failures)
* Write design docs and collaborate with engineers and data scientists on architecture decisions
* Use AI coding agents in your own day\-to\-day workflow while owning correctness and quality

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* These are the core skills we screen for. A strong candidate has all three.
* Python 3 — solid experience writing production code, with strong fundamentals and readable, tested code, using a web framework such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django
* PySpark \& SQL — hands\-on experience writing and tuning Spark jobs on EMR (we run EMR on EKS), reading/writing Delta Lake tables, and strong SQL for large\-scale data
* Agentic AI — hands\-on experience building LLM or agent\-based features: tool/function calling, multi\-step agent workflows, RAG, and grounding output in real data.
* Experience writing production Python 3, including designing and optimizing large\-scale data processing solutions
* Experience building services or APIs with a Python web framework such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django
* Hands\-on experience with Spark / PySpark, ideally on EMR (EMR on EKS a plus)
* Strong SQL and familiarity with big data technologies
* Hands\-on experience building LLM or agent\-based features (tool calling, function calling, or multi\-step agent workflows)
* Experience with an agent or LLM framework or platform such as Amazon Bedrock, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or the OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs
* Experience with RAG: embeddings, vector search, and grounding model output in real data
* Practical prompt engineering and experience evaluating LLM/agent output for quality and reliability
* Experience handling sensitive data and PII responsibly, including data\-governance and privacy considerations when sending data to external LLMs
* Experience with at least one database (MongoDB/DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, or similar)
* Experience with AWS services such as S3 and EMR
* Experience writing tests with pytest (or similar) and working with Git
* Comfortable with Docker and Linux
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents (e.g., Kiro, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) in real projects
* Strong communication: able to write design docs and collaborate across teams

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or wiring agents to external tools and data sources
* Experience keeping LLM systems reliable: guardrails, evaluation pipelines, cost/latency tuning, caching
* LLM/agent observability and lifecycle experience: prompt/version management, monitoring, and quality regression detection
* Solid ML fundamentals and quality metrics (precision, recall, F1\); familiarity with scikit\-learn, pandas, NumPy
* Delta Lake, AWS Glue, and Athena
* Kafka streaming pipelines
* Kubernetes / EKS, Helm, and GitOps deployment
* Experience in a polyglot microservice environment (Node.js / Python / Java)
* Awareness of bias and explainability in AI systems

 This role combines deep domain expertise with change management and transformation execution ownership. You will influence Product and Engineering roadmaps to ensure alignment with operational priorities and drive automation initiatives that deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, and customer experience. Success requires strong executive judgment, disciplined programme governance, and the ability to lead complex initiatives across multiple business units to completion.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 What Your Responsibilities Will Be
   

  

* Lead execution of tax compliance transformation programmes, ensuring alignment between Operations, Product, Engineering, and key stakeholders.
* Partner with Program Manager, overseeing Operational input, monitoring project boards, Kanban flows, tickets, and sprint progress to proactively manage risks, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
* Define and document comprehensive operational requirements aligned to the Product Roadmap, ensuring automation initiatives are scalable, measurable, and technically consumable.
* Design and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by Operations, coordinate progress updates, communicate feature releases, and ensure cross\-functional integration.
* Lead structured change management across Operations to ensure consistent adoption of new features, workflows, and platform enhancements.
* Design and implement performance dashboards and governance frameworks to monitor automation impact, SLA adherence, quality standards, and customer satisfaction.
* Identify systemic risks and operational inefficiencies, driving structural improvements that enhance scalability and resilience.
* Provide senior escalation oversight for platform\-related issues, minimizing disruption and safeguarding customer experience.

* Coach and develop senior analysts and team leads to elevate capability and operational maturity.
* Deputize for the Director in strategic forums and cross\-functional engagements as required.


**AI Bar Raiser**
 As an AI bar raiser, you will elevate how AI and automation are operationalized within compliance programmes by:
   

  

* Translating strategic automation priorities into high\-impact AI\-enabled initiatives across multiple tax types.
* Embedding an AI\-first operating model that strengthens scalability, operational resilience, and infrastructure readiness for business growth.
* Influence architectural decisions with Engineering to ensure AI solutions are embedded within workflow design at scale, without compromising compliance integrity, operational resilience, or quality standards.
* Ensuring AI adoption delivers measurable improvements in efficiency, accuracy, conversion, and customer experience.
* Building AI capability across the function by coaching leaders and embedding AI\-driven execution practices.


**Operational Bar Raiser**

* Designing scalable execution models that improve reliability, reduce risk, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Driving accountability for SLA performance, escalation governance, and cross\-functional programme delivery.
* Embedding data\-driven oversight to monitor quality, efficiency, and customer outcomes.
* Fostering a culture of disciplined execution, structured programme management, and continuous improvement.

* Strong understanding of registration platforms and tax technology ecosystems.
* Proven experience driving automation, product implementation, and Agile programme delivery at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively across multiple organizational levels.
* Strong analytical capability, executive communication skills, and a data\-driven decision\-making mindset.
* Experience applying AI and automation technologies to deliver measurable operational and customer outcomes.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

title: EDI / B2B Integration Analyst & Developer
description:
**Job Description**
**EDI / B2B Integration Analyst \& Developer**
 The
 **EDI / B2B Integration Analyst \& Developer** 
 plays a critical role in Vertiv’s digital and supply chain transformation, enabling scalable, reliable, and compliant business\-to\-business (B2B) integrations with customers, suppliers, logistics providers, and external partners.
   

  

 This role partners closely with business stakeholders and external trading partners to define, design, and deliver EDI and API\-based integration solutions that automate key business transactions (Order\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, Logistics). The position ensures seamless data exchange across platforms, improves operational efficiency, and enhances visibility across the partner ecosystem.
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative and learning\-oriented culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are encouraged.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**EDI / B2B Integration Delivery**
* Design, develop, and support EDI and B2B integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
* Build and maintain integrations across ERP (Oracle EBS), eCommerce platforms, and external partner systems.
* Develop and manage data mappings, transformations, and validations for structured (EDI) and API\-based exchanges.


**Partner Onboarding \& Lifecycle Management**
* Lead or support end\-to\-end onboarding of trading partners (customers, suppliers, 3PLs), including:
+ Requirements gathering and partner connectivity setup
+ Mapping specifications and testing coordination
+ Go\-live readiness and hypercare support

* Collaborate with VAN providers, network platforms, and third\-party integrators.
* Maintain partner profiles, communication protocols, and onboarding documentation.


**EDI Standards \& Transaction Management**
* Design and maintain EDI flows based on standards such as:
+ ANSI X12, EDIFACT, and partner\-specific formats

* Support core B2B transactions including:
+ Purchase Orders (850 / ORDERS)
+ Order Acknowledgements (855 / ORDRSP)
+ Advance Ship Notices (856 / DESADV)
+ Invoices (810 / INVOIC)

* Manage exceptions, reprocessing, acknowledgments (997/CONTRL), and data quality issues.


**Operational Excellence \& Support**
* Provide L2/L3 production support for EDI/B2B integrations, ensuring SLA adherence.
* Monitor transaction flows and proactively identify failures, performance issues, and bottlenecks.
* Drive incident resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.


**Integration Architecture \& Governance**
* Contribute to integration standards, design patterns, and governance for B2B/EDI solutions.
* Align EDI and API\-based integration strategies (e.g., hybrid EDI \+ API model).
* Ensure solutions comply with security, compliance, and audit requirements.


**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Work closely with Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Service, Logistics, and IT teams.
* Engage with external partners to define integration requirements and SLAs.
* Produce clear functional and technical documentation, including mapping specs and runbooks.


**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5–10 years of IT experience, with strong focus on integration.
* Minimum 3\+ years of EDI/B2B or integration development experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
**EDI / B2B Expertise**
* Strong understanding of:
+ EDI standards (ANSI X12, EDIFACT)

title: Sr Game Mathematician
description:
At Aristocrat, we believe in bringing happiness to life through the power of play! As a world leader in gaming content and technology, our mission is to build outstanding gaming experiences that captivate and entertain millions around the globe. We are looking for an ambitious and hardworking Sr Game Mathematician to join our versatile team. This role is pivotal to our success, ensuring our games are not only fun but also mathematically sound and engaging. If you are passionate about gaming, mathematics, and innovation, this is an outstanding and exciting chance to create a significant impact!
   

  

 What You'll Do
 * Develop and build mathematical models for slot games and other gaming products.
* Construct, enhance, and record mathematical models for slot and instant\-win games.
* Build pay tables, probability models, and simulations to define return to player, volatility, and hit frequency.
* Analyze game performance and player behavior to refine game mechanics.
* Continuously optimize game performance using data\-driven insights.
* Collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, and artists to implement mathematical concepts.
* Ensure smooth and accurate integration of mathematical models into game engines.
* Conduct detailed testing and debugging to maintain high\-quality standards.
* Support QA teams in validating game outcomes against encouraged mathematical results.
* Communicate complex mathematical concepts clearly to non\-technical team members.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions to contribute to new game ideas.
* Stay updated with industry trends and improve existing approaches.
* Document all mathematical models and processes clearly for future reference.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members.


 What We're Looking For
 * Proven experience in game mathematics or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of probability theory, statistics, and combinatorics.
* Experience with simulation tools such as Python, C\+\+, Excel, or similar.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Good communication skills to explain complex concepts in simple terms.
* Attention to detail and ability to work within timelines.
* Understanding of gaming regulations and compliance standards.


 Preferred:
 * Experience working on Class II games is an added advantage.
* Advanced degree or equivalent experience in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field.
* Proven track record of delivering successful game projects.


**Compensation Philosophy**
 We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay\-for\-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
   

  

 Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
   

  

 Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Senior System Software Engineer, Software Defined Networking
description:
We are looking for a Senior System Software Engineer, Software Defined Networking to design, build, and operate highly performant and scalable SDN solutions for NVIDIA's AI Clouds hosting GPU\-accelerated workloads — including hyperscale multi\-node training, inference, cloud gaming, and cloud functions. This role spans the full lifecycle of our SDN stack — from designing and developing new control and data plane software to ensuring operational excellence in production through reliability engineering, CI/CD, observability, and incident response.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Design and develop next\-generation multi\-tenant cloud SDN control and data plane software (OVS, OVN, OpenFlow)
* Build Infrastructure\-as\-a\-Service virtual network orchestration and services using gRPC and REST to support tenant workload security and performance SLAs for BMaaS, VMaaS, and Kubernetes
* Drive upstream contributions to OVN\-Kubernetes and related open\-source projects; Develop software for network observability — monitoring, telemetry, intelligent metering, and performance analysis
* Operate and support OVS\-OVN based SDN solutions in large\-scale NVIDIA AI Cloud environments
* Own end\-to\-end observability for the SDN stack — build and maintain monitoring, alerting, distributed tracing, and dashboarding to ensure real\-time insight into network health, performance, and tenant SLAs
* Design, enhance, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) across Linux host networking, OVS, OVN, and Kubernetes CNIs
* Implement GitOps approaches or related experience for secure, seamless integration with cloud infrastructure; Drive reliability through incident management, resource monitoring, and performance tuning
* Collaborate with SRE, DevOps, and network engineering teams on production readiness and operational tooling


**What We Need To See**
* BS/MS in Computer Science or related technical field, or a comparable blend of education and relevant experience
* 5\+ years of proven experience in software development for large\-scale distributed environments
* Expert\-level knowledge of OVN, OVS, OpenFlow, and modern network protocols
* Strong programming skills in C and Go; advanced scripting in Bash and Python
* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, practical experience deploying and supporting CNIs (OVN\-Kubernetes)
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and deployment tools (Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Flux)
* Experience designing and operating complex, multi\-stage CI/CD pipelines
* Hands\-on experience developing secure, high\-performance services using gRPC and REST with TLS and strong authentication
* Strong knowledge of datacenter routing, switching, and Linux host/VM networking


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Contributions to open\-source projects (especially OVS, OVN, OVN\-Kubernetes, or other Kubernetes networking projects)
* Experience with hardware acceleration (GPU, DPU or equivalent experience) for networking
* Practical experience with major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid/multi\-cloud deployments
* SRE/DevOps top\-level expertise — on\-call, incident management, operations focused on service reliability targets, production ownership
* Experience with observability platforms and tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry, ELK)

**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka, India


You will own product surfaces end to end: from design and implementation to production operation and debugging. The weight is on the frontend, but you are expected to build and own the APIs behind your own features.


**About the Team**
------------------


Converse is LeadSquared's conversation platform. It comprises the agent\-facing chat applications and the underlying channel layer that delivers messages across an expanding portfolio of communication channels.


Converse is shared infrastructure. Several LeadSquared products depend on it for message delivery, including products unrelated to chat. As a result, interface contracts, backward compatibility, and availability are first\-order concerns.


**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------


* Build and own agent\-facing interfaces that are live and event\-driven, with several conversations in flight at once.
* Build the internal configuration and authoring tools that determine how quickly a new customer or provider can be brought online.
* Build customer\-facing web surfaces, including those carrying consent and privacy requirements.
* Turn dense operational data into interfaces that people use to make decisions.
* Write and own the APIs behind your own features.
* Instrument the frontend for production diagnosis through error tracking, performance monitoring, and real\-user metrics.
* Work within a micro\-frontend architecture embedded inside the CRM.
* Operate your work in production, debugging issues with Product, QA, and DevOps.

**Expected Candidate Profile**
------------------------------


* 2\+ years of experience building production frontend applications used by real users.
* Strong React and TypeScript skills, including hooks, component composition, and state management, along with a working understanding of rendering behaviour and performance.
* Experience building real\-time or event\-driven UIs using technologies and patterns such as WebSockets, SSE, and optimistic updates, with an understanding of correctness when events arrive out of order.
* Strong CSS and layout skills for dense, information\-heavy interfaces.
* Enough backend experience, in any language, to build and own the API behind your own feature.
* Ability to debug across the browser, network, and service boundary.
* Sound problem\-solving and data structures fundamentals.
* Accountability for code you did not write by hand, including code produced with AI assistance.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------


* Experience with micro\-frontend architecture, module federation, or embedding an application inside another product.
* Experience building or contributing to a shared component library or design system.
* Experience with Preact, Signals, or other fine\-grained reactivity models.
* Experience with Web Workers, rendering performance, or bundle and load\-time optimisation.
* Experience with data visualisation or dense dashboard and table interfaces.
* Experience with accessibility and internationalisation.
* Experience with Node.js/TypeScript or Java backend development.
* Experience with messaging or communication platforms, or other integration\-heavy SaaS products.

**Technology Environment**
--------------------------


**Frontend:**
  

React 18, Preact, TypeScript, Signals, micro\-frontends, WebSockets, Web Workers


**Backend you will touch:**
  

Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, Express, Serverless Framework; REST and GraphQL


**Data and Infrastructure:**
  

MySQL, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, AWS, Docker


**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------


The agent surface is one of the few places in the product where someone sits for a full working day, and the configuration surfaces determine how quickly a new customer can be brought online.


The role offers broad exposure across the product surface, with direct ownership of what you build.

description:
Join Skillz and Level Up Your Career! Are you ready to take your career to the next level Join Skillz, the first publicly-traded mobile esports platform that hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide. Skillz is revolutionizing the gaming industry, providing the ultimate platform for competitive mobile games. By fostering social competition within games, Skillz empowers developers to create multi-million dollar franchises while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition. At Skillz, we firmly believe that everyone is born with unique skills and deserves to experience an epic win. We understand the thrill of achievement and the satisfaction of overcoming challenges. Thats why we passionately champion game developers and players alike, empowering them to unleash their full potential through the power of competition. Life @ Skillz Culture of Impact: Join a united team of builders, creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs driven by the desire to win. At Skillz, we create value and make a difference in the world. Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision expenses for both you and your entire family. Wellness Support: Enhance your well-being with our array of wellness initiatives, including meditation and mental health resources, physical fitness coaching and classes, family planning assistance, health and parenting guidance, virtual therapy sessions, and more. Perks: We believe in enhancing your work experience. Enjoy daily breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, Friday Happy Hours, insurance, and many more. We also offer competitive paid time off (PTO) & company holidays to help you recharge and pursue your passions. Why Skillz Pioneers of Skill-Based Competition: Skillz is not just any company in the gaming industry; we are the pioneers of skill-based competition, partnered with industry titans like UFC, NFL, T-Mobile, Buzztime, while also hosting renowned events like the Game Developer Conference (GDC). Join us in transforming the way people play games and building the home of competition for all. Impact Beyond Gaming: Skillz harnesses the power of its platform to support nonprofit organizations such as Susan G. Komen, American Cancer Society, the NAACP, and more. By participating in Skillz tournaments, you can make a difference and contribute to causes you care about. Recognized Success: Skillz has earned recognition as one of Fast Companys Most Innovative Companies, CNBCs Disruptor 50, San Francisco Business Times Best Places to Work, Forbes Next Billion-Dollar Startups, and the #1 fastest-growing company in America on the Inc. 5000 list, and many more. Talent Magnet: Join a team of talented professionals who are passionate about what they do. Our team includes experts from Meta, Apple, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Twitter (X), Roblox, Zynga, Samsung, Lyft, EA, Riot, Nexon, Gameskraft, PlayStation, Unity, Scopely, Tinder, Intel, Deloitte, EY, Twitch, DraftKings, and more. The Future of Gaming Awaits! The gaming industry is larger than movies, music, and books combined, with over 3 billion active gamers playing monthly and over 25 million active developers worldwide. Mobile gaming, in particular, is the fastest-growing segment, projected to reach $300 billion by 2025. At Skillz, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of this exciting industry and shape its future. About the Role Push notifications, email, and reactivation are Skillzs fastest available revenue levers. This role owns building the instrumentation, holdout-based measurement, and journey ownership needed to turn owned channels into an accountable, optimized growth engine. Responsibilities Own email, push notification and in-app messaging as a single lifecycle function for Skillz Platform - strategy, calendar, execution and measurement. Own reactivation marketing end to end: cohort definition, offer design, ROI gating against held-out controls, step-downs and exclusion rules for perpetual reactivators. Own CleverTap journey design and execution once ownership transfers from Product, and drive onboarding of remaining titles as SDK 26 coverage expands. Make every campaign measurable: holdout-audited incremental NGR per campaign, CTR by channel and game, deliverability, and unsub/opt-out guardrails. Enforce messaging hygiene - one notification per campaign per player, mutually exclusive segments, contextual interstitial triggers, and segment campaign attribution so no segment is orphaned. Design reactivation and win-back offers within the incentive rules: above-30% bonuses reserved for genuine reactivation, framed as rare and limited. Manage the Email Marketing Manager and build the lifecycle bench. Partner with Analytics for holdout design and reads, Game LiveOps for surface slates, Launch GTM for feature adoption campaigns, and Product (Rishabh) for messaging machinery and PN observability. Report weekly: what was sent, what it earned, what is being retired, and what needs unblocking. Key Competencies Incrementality-first thinking - instinctively asks what the control group did; treats sends, opens and pMAU as inputs rather than results. Lifecycle craft - journey design, triggers, frequency capping, suppression logic and deliverability, across push, email and in-app together rather than channel by channel. Offer economics - understands that a reactivated user arriving on bonus cash can be NGR -negative, and can defend a step-down against a stakeholder whose reactivation number it depresses. Hands-on tooling - configures journeys and segments themselves; can pull their own data in SQL or a BI tool. Player respect - treats notification volume as a finite asset and argues for fewer, better sends. Builds from zero - the function, the DL, the runbook and the measurement all need creating; comfortable with that rather than expecting an established machine. Experience 6-10 years in lifecycle / CRM / retention marketing for a consumer mobile product, including direct ownership of a reactivation or win-back programme . Deep hands-on experience with a lifecycle platform - CleverTap strongly preferred ; Braze, MoEngage, Iterable or WebEngage acceptable - including journey building, segmentation and frequency management. Ran holdout-based incrementality measurement on messaging campaigns and can evidence a campaign they killed on the number. Real-money gaming, online gambling, fantasy sports, fintech or e-commerce with a wallet/deposit economy strongly preferred. Owned push notification deliverability and opt-in economics, including double-dialogue opt-in patterns and the constraints of iOS re-enablement. Comfortable partnering with Product on instrumentation gaps and with Analytics on independent scoring; experience taking over tooling ownership from another function is a plus. title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
   

  

 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The TeamViewer ONE platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Over the past several years we have successfully built and released products which make IT administrators' day\-to\-day life easier. Our vision is to become a unified endpoint management solution for our customers.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to provide strong technical leadership and strategic direction in building and evolving our TeamViewer ONE and Remote Management capabilities, trusted by small and medium business customers. In this role, you will own critical technical decisions, influence architecture across multiple teams, and ensure long\-term scalability, reliability, and performance of our SaaS cloud platform.
   

  

 You will apply deep expertise in systems engineering and distributed architectures, using C\+\+, C\# and Java as primary implementation languages. Also play a central role in evolving the technical foundation of our products.

* Provide technical leadership and architectural ownership for core services of the TeamViewer ONE \& Remote Management platform
* Define, evolve, and govern system architecture and major technical decisions for new and existing components
* Guide teams in building high\-performance systems, while ensuring long\-term maintainability and operational excellence
* Partner with product management, engineering, and quality teams to design solutions that balance customer needs, performance, cost and technical sustainability
* Drive continuous integration, delivery and deployment practices from development to production
* Oversee development of clients, backend services, and partner APIs across multiple teams
* Establish architectural standards for common APIs, frameworks, and shared services
* Design and evolve highly available, high\-quality, and cost\-efficient data platforms
* Proactively identify technical risks and guide the organization toward sustainable solutions
* Ensure that all software is secure, stable, scalable and operationally excellent
* Stay ahead of industry trends and continuously improve platform capabilities
* Serve as mentor and technical authority for senior engineers and emerging technical leaders

**Requirements**

* Deep expertise in systems programming and distributed system design, with strong hands\-on experience using C\+\+, C\# and Java across complex platforms
* Proven track record of designing highly scalable, reliable, and high\-performance architectures for mission\-critical systems
* Cadence, identity \& access management, and secure system design, with responsibility for defining and enforcing platform\-wide security standards
* Strong experience designing and operating large\-scale databases, data pipelines, and modern analytical platforms, including data lakes or lakehouse architectures

title: Staff/ Senior Software Engineer C++
