title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**About Chargebee:** 




 Chargebee is a subscription billing and revenue management platform powering some of the fastest\-growing brands around the world today, including Lambda.ai, Zapier, Condé Nast, Pret\-a\-Manger, Freshworks, Okta, Study.com, and others. Thousands of SaaS and subscription\-first businesses process billions of dollars in revenue every year through the Chargebee platform.
 



 Headquartered in San Francisco, USA, our 1000\+ team members work remotely throughout the world, including India, the Netherlands, Paris, Spain, Australia, and the USA.
 



 Chargebee has raised over $480 million in capital and is funded by Accel, Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Sequoia Capital, Steadview Capital, and Sapphire Ventures. And we’re on a mission to push the boundaries of subscription revenue operations. Not just ours, but every customer and prospective business on a recurring revenue model.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 Chargebee is looking for a Lead Software Engineer to rethink the integrations between CRM and billing in an AI\-native way. This role will shape how customers automate sales processes and interact with Chargebee using AI. This team builds best\-in\-class capabilities that integrate Chargebee with enterprise CRM platforms such as Salesforce and HubSpot, simplifying sales workflows.
 



  





 This role requires a blend of strong technical expertise, exceptional system design skills, an AI\-Native mindset, and a passion for leading and mentoring engineers. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead the development and delivery of key product features, working closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure the successful execution of innovative, customer\-focused solutions. Your role will involve both architectural and hands\-on technical contributions to ensure the team delivers scalable, high\-quality products that meet business objectives. There will be a clear focus on building AI Native products, so experience in building them is ideal, but otherwise the ability to learn on the job and upskill quickly is mandatory
 



  





**The key responsibilities include:** 



* Build, inspire, and lead a high\-performing engineering team to design and deliver end\-to\-end products that power Chargebee's Sales\-Led Growth (SLG) capabilities.
* Champion AI adoption across the team and drive the development of AI\-native products and integrations.
* Lead the ideation, architecture, and development of CRM integration applications and services, with a strong focus on AI\-native design, data accuracy, security, and governance.
* Participate actively in cross\-functional forums, making well\-reasoned, opinionated decisions on integration architecture to ensure reliability, scalability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers to translate business requirements into robust, scalable CRM connectors and integration workflows.
* Write hands\-on, production\-quality code to build frameworks and middleware that underpin seamless integrations.
* Author and maintain technical documentation, API specifications, and implementation guides that serve as clear references for engineering and solution consulting teams.
* Own integration quality end\-to\-end — through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, data validation, and API automation, while proactively identifying and resolving data sync or API consumption issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve customer\-reported integration issues with urgency, transparency, and clear communication.
* Mentor and coach engineers on best practices for building scalable, resilient integrations, fostering a culture of technical excellence.
* Champion Agile practices within the team, driving iterative delivery and continuous improvement.



  





**What You Bring:** 



* 8\+ years of proven experience designing and building enterprise\-scale SaaS platforms, with solid exposure to both B2B and B2C distributed backend systems.
* 2\+ years of experience building, scaling, and managing high\-performing engineering teams, leading by example as a hands\-on engineer.
* Passionate about AI\-powered automation and curious about how agentic approaches can transform enterprise workflows.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in Java, RESTful APIs, OLTP databases, scheduled jobs, and JavaScript frameworks like React.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture, microservices, and industry best practices for operating at large scale.
* Experience building, supporting, and optimizing production systems, with a proven track record of identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks.
* Proficiency in enterprise\-scale monitoring and observability using modern tooling.
* Ability to balance pragmatism with vision, delivering incremental value today while laying the foundation for future scale.
* Demonstrated success in fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, accountability, and customer focus.
* Strong ability to identify gaps in requirements, evaluate alternatives, and guide your team through ambiguity.
* Thrives in fast\-paced, collaborative environments and can rally teams around complex technical missions.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with comfort engaging cross\-functional stakeholders at all levels.
* A role model for engineers on code quality, engineering discipline, and best practices.



  





**Added Advantage:** 




  




* Hands\-on experience building or contributing to AI\-native products.
* Prior experience building a CRM or integrating with enterprise CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.



  





**What makes us who we are:** 




  





 \-
 **We are Globally Local** 
 : With a diverse team across four continents and customers in over 60 countries, you get to work closely with a global perspective right from your own neighborhood.
 



  





 \-
 **We value Curiosity** 
 : We believe the next great idea might just be around the corner. Perhaps it’s that random thought you had ten minutes ago. We believe in creating an ecosystem that fosters a desire to seek out hard questions, figure out answers to them, and foster a continuous learning environment
 



  





 \-
 **Customer! Customer! Customer!** 
 : Everything we do is driven towards enabling our customers’ growth. This means no matter what you do, you will always be adding real value to a real business problem. It’s a lot of responsibility, but also a lot of fun.
 



 If you resonate with Chargebee, have a deep intellectual curiosity, and an insatiable urge to learn and build new things, we’re waiting for you!
 



 We value people from all backgrounds and are dedicated to hiring and employing a diverse and inclusive workplace.
 



  





**Come be a part of the Chargebee tribe!**

title: Software Engineer, AI
description:
SOFTWARE ENGINEER, AI — BENGALURU, INDIA
 



  





 ABOUT ARVYA
 



 Arvya is building AI software for investment banks and private equity firms. Deal teams work across email, meetings, CRM, spreadsheets and data rooms, but keeping everything current still takes significant manual work. We build tools that bring that context together and help teams turn it into useful, reviewable actions.
 



  





 Our work includes deal memory, answers backed by sources, tracker updates, CRM workflows, meeting follow\-ups and coordination. Reliability, permissions and human approval matter as much as the quality of an AI response.
 



  





 THE ROLE
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineer with an interest in applied AI to work directly with the founders. You will help turn real workflows into working product features, from the interface and API through to data handling, model calls and integrations. This role suits someone who enjoys building, debugging and taking ownership of a feature beyond its first demo.
 



  





 Location: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India. Applicants must currently be based in Bengaluru.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
 



 • Build and maintain product features, backend APIs and integrations with business tools.
 



 • Develop LLM\-powered workflows that retrieve relevant context, use tools and produce useful outputs.
 



 • Improve retrieval, document processing and structured deal memory.
 



 • Build interfaces that make AI answers, supporting sources and proposed actions easy to understand.
 



 • Add evaluations, tests, logging and error handling so features remain dependable as they evolve.
 



 • Handle authentication, permissions and data boundaries carefully.
 



 • Debug issues across the stack and improve performance, latency and cost.
 



 • Work with the founders to understand user feedback, make practical tradeoffs and ship improvements.
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



 • Strong programming fundamentals and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
 



 • Proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript, with a willingness to work across the stack.
 



 • Experience building applications, APIs and database\-backed features.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs, retrieval, agents or other applied AI projects. Personal projects count.
 



 • A practical approach to testing, debugging, version control and code review.
 



 • The ability to explain your decisions, ask good questions and follow through on work.
 



 • Care for user experience, reliability and the details that make software useful in everyday work.
 



  





 HELPFUL, BUT NOT REQUIRED
 



 Experience with React or Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, vector search, cloud deployment, Microsoft 365 integrations, or enterprise software workflows. Familiarity with finance is useful, but you do not need an investment banking background. We care about what you can build and how you approach problems.
 



  





 WHY THIS WORK
 



 You will work closely with the founders on an early product, contribute to technical and product decisions, and build AI features tied to concrete user needs. The challenge is making AI useful and dependable in workflows where context and accuracy matter.
 



  





 SIMPLE APPLICATION
 



 Apply directly on LinkedIn with your resume and four quick yes/no answers. No cover letter or lengthy written application is required. Please follow the Arvya, Inc. LinkedIn page before submitting and confirm this in the application. A GitHub or project link on your resume is welcome, but optional.

**About the Role** 




 You will be a senior engineer on the x360Sync team at ConnectWise, owning development of the macOS agent — a native desktop application at the heart of the x360Sync backup and file sync product. The application is primarily written in C\+\+, with Swift and Objective\-C used for macOS\-native components. You will be stepping into a mature codebase with real ownership and scope from day one.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 \- Design, implement, and maintain features in the x360Sync macOS agent, working primarily in C\+\+ with Swift and Objective\-C for platform\-native integrations
 



 \- Debug and resolve production issues, including deep\-dive investigation across the application stack and macOS system APIs
 



 \- Participate in architecture and design discussions, contributing technical recommendations grounded in macOS platform best practices
 



 \- Write clean, well\-tested code and take part in code reviews — both giving and receiving constructive feedback
 



 \- Collaborate with product managers, QA engineers, and cross\-functional teams to deliver features on schedule without cutting corners on quality
 



 \- Contribute to improving engineering standards, internal tooling, and development processes
 



 \- Help scope and break down complex problems into well\-defined tasks for yourself and the broader team
 



 \- Document technical decisions, system behavior, and processes clearly for teammates and future contributors
 



  





**Mandatory skills** 




  





 C\+\+, Linux, Linux System Programming, Multithreading, IPC OR XPC, Sockets OR "Socket Programming, macOS, Objective\-C OR "Objective\-C\+\+, Endpoint Security.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  





**Technical** 




 \- Solid professional experience writing C\+\+ in a production environment
 



 \- Strong working knowledge of macOS internals, frameworks, and platform APIs (e.g. NSFileProvider, FSEvents) or Linux
 



 \- Proficiency in Swift and/or Objective\-C for macOS\-native development
 



 \- Experience debugging complex, multi\-threaded, or multi\-process applications
 



 \- Experience with software development workflows, including version control (Git), code review, and CI/CD pipelines
 



  





**Non\-Technical** 




 \- Strong written and verbal English communication skills — you'll work with distributed teams and will need to articulate technical ideas clearly
 



 \- Ability to work independently and manage your own priorities in a remote or hybrid environment
 



 \- Comfortable working in an established codebase with existing design decisions you didn't author
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications** 




 \- Experience with file sync, backup, or storage\-related products
 



 \- Familiarity with Windows desktop development (the x360Sync agent also has a Windows counterpart)
 



 \- Exposure to cross\-platform C\+\+ codebases targeting both macOS and Windows
 



 \- Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team environment
 



 \- Background in developer tooling, performance profiling, or low\-level system programming on macOS
 



  





**Working Condition:** 
 Hybrid / Remote \- Depending on the location.
 



  





**Why Join the x360Sync Team** 




 The x360Sync team works on software that businesses genuinely depend on — keeping their files safe and in sync. You won't be building another internal dashboard; your work ships to real customers and has a clear, direct impact. The team values technical rigor, honest communication, and getting things done without unnecessary ceremony. If you enjoy owning hard problems in a native desktop environment and want your expertise in C\+\+ and macOS to be the main event rather than a footnote, this is the role for you.
 



  





 The Senior Software Engineer for x360Sync is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the macOS desktop agent application that keeps critical business data in sync for thousands of customers. Working in C\+\+, Swift, and Objective\-C, you will collaborate closely with a cross\-functional engineering team to deliver reliable, high\-quality software — from feature development through to production support. **About the Role** 




 SonicWall is seeking a
 **Software Dev Senior Engineer (Dataplane)** 
 with deep expertise in High Availability, Fast\-Path Packet Processing, and Distributed Systems to architect and optimize the
 **dataplane HA subsystem** 
 across SonicWall NGFW hardware and virtual firewalls — driving sub\-millisecond session state synchronization, zero\-packet\-loss failover, and line\-rate forwarding for IPsec, SSL\-VPN, and TCP/UDP flows at 10G–100G\+.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* **Dataplane HA Architecture** 
 — Own fast\-path HA engine design covering Active/Standby mirroring, Active/Active flow redistribution, and zero\-drop VMAC/VIP failover.
* **Stateful Session Mirroring** 
 — Build low\-overhead dataplane sync for TCP/UDP 5\-tuple tables, IPsec SA fast\-path, SSL\-VPN contexts, and L7 states across HA peers at line rate.
* **Lock\-Free Session Tables** 
 — Design NUMA\-aware, lock\-free (RCU/CAS/seqlock) session tables for multi\-core pipelines sustaining tens of millions of concurrent sessions at sub\-microsecond latency.
* **High\-Performance Sync Fabric** 
 — Engineer zero\-copy ring buffer / DPDK mempool\-based sync with prioritized queuing for IPsec/SSL\-VPN state at sub\-millisecond replication latency.
* **Asymmetric Flow Handling** 
 — Implement cross\-node packet redirect, flow pinning, and state sync for asymmetric TCP/UDP and IPsec traffic in Active/Active topologies.
* **Hardware Offload Integration**

* **Technical Leadership**

* **Protocol Fast\-Path**

* **Hardware Acceleration** 
 — Working knowledge of crypto offload engines (QAT, Marvell OCTEON, Cavium/Nitrox) or SmartNIC/DPU integration into packet pipelines.
* **Multi\-Core \& NUMA** 
 — Expert in cache\-line alignment, lock\-free concurrency, memory barriers, and NUMA\-aware data structures for packet processors.
* **Debugging** 
 — Proficient with perf, GDB, ftrace, eBPF, tcpdump, and Wireshark for diagnosing dataplane race conditions and session continuity failures.

**Job Description**
**Lead Software Engineer – C\# .NET Sortation \& Labeling Systems**
 Job Location – Pune (Hybrid)
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Lead Software Engineer will lead the design, development, and delivery of a Windows\-based sortation and labeling platform that integrates with PKMS/WMS systems, PLCs, and material handling equipment (MHE) across our distribution network. The system processes TCP socket messages for carton lifecycle events, persists data to enterprise databases, and coordinates downstream services. This role requires deep hands\-on C\#/.NET expertise, subject\-matter depth in warehouse automation and MHE, and close collaboration with cross\-functional business, DC operations, and third\-party vendor teams such as Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger/print\-and\-apply solution providers.
   

  

**Impact of the Role**
* Provide technical leadership for the sortation and labeling domain — designing, developing, and leading delivery of high\-throughput, low\-latency Windows services and desktop applications.
* Own application health in production — monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root\-cause resolution during peak fulfillment periods.
* Partner with Distribution Center operations, Supply Chain, and third\-party MHE vendors to translate operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve DC operations, production support, and business\-user productivity.
* Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team.


**Technology Platforms You Will Work On**
* .NET Framework 4\.8 and Visual Studio 2022\.
* Socket\-based services and Windows Service hosts.
* Integration with sortation devices, PLCs, MHE controllers, and WMS/PKMS via TCP.
* ZPL label print pipelines and event\-forwarding mechanisms.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide technical leadership for the sortation and labeling domain — designing, developing, and leading delivery of high\-throughput, low\-latency Windows services and desktop applications.
* Design and maintain TCP socket server/client components for high\-volume carton lifecycle messaging with PKMS/WMS and MHE controllers.
* Implement multithreading and asynchronous programming patterns for performance, responsiveness, and predictable throughput under peak volumes.
* Build and maintain desktop UI using WPF and coordinate with Windows Service hosts for end\-to\-end operational workflows.
* Lead integrations with PLCs, serial devices, scanners, print\-and\-apply, and material handling equipment, ensuring robust error handling, retry logic, and consistent state across data stores.
* Own ZPL label workflows and print pipelines, including label design, throughput tuning, and printer/applicator fault recovery.
* Define and enforce engineering standards for secure coding, unit testing, Git branching strategy, and code quality.
* Lead deployments, IIS configuration, and CI/CD automation, including automated testing and release readiness.
* Own application health in production — monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root\-cause resolution during peak fulfillment periods.
* Partner with Distribution Center operations, Supply Chain, and third\-party MHE vendors to translate operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve DC operations, production support, and business\-user productivity.
* Drive Agile delivery — sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking — adhere to IT change management, and mentor engineers to raise the bar across the team.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a technical lead or staff\-level role.
* Proven track record delivering enterprise\-scale .NET applications in a retail, supply chain, or logistics environment.
* Demonstrated experience as an individual contributor with strong ownership, self\-direction, and vendor coordination.
* Experience delivering in Agile environments using Jira for sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking.
* Strong knowledge of warehouse management, sortation, labeling, and Distribution Center operations.
* Hands\-on experience integrating with PKMS, Manhattan WMOS, or comparable WMS platforms.
* Experience leading third\-party vendor integrations, integration platforms, and enterprise web services.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to align technology solutions to throughput, accuracy, and cost goals.
* Subject\-matter expertise in material handling equipment and warehouse automation, with hands\-on integration experience across one or more OEM solution sets: Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger / print\-and\-apply systems.
* Deep understanding of MHE process flows — induction, singulation, scanning, sortation, diverts, put wall s, unit sortation, carton and bag creation, weigh\-in\-motion, and label print\-and\-apply.
* Experience defining and supporting MHE interface specifications and message contracts between WMS/WCS and equipment controllers, including carton lifecycle events, divert confirmations, no\-reads, exceptions, and recirculation handling.
* Hands\-on integration with PLCs, barcode scanners, scales, dimensioners, printers, and applicators over TCP/IP, serial, and OPC\-style interfaces.
* Working knowledge of Warehouse Control System (WCS) and Warehouse Execution System (WES) layers and how they interact with WMS and MHE.
* Ability to troubleshoot live MHE issues on the floor — jams, mis\-sorts, label misapplication, throughput degradation, and equipment/host message desynchronization — and drive root\-cause resolution with vendors.
* Experience participating in MHE implementations: interface testing, dry runs, integration and acceptance testing, commissioning, go\-live support, and post\-go\-live hypercare.
* Familiarity with MHE performance metrics — units per hour, sort accuracy, divert rates, read rates, and equipment uptime — and using them to tune application behavior.
* Ability to act as the technical point of contact and SME for MHE vendors, translating operational requirements into interface and application changes.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with C\#, .NET Framework 4\.8, multithreading, async/await, and TCP/IP sockets.
* Experience with message parsing, custom protocols, and high\-volume event processing.
* Desktop UI development with WPF, plus Windows Service hosting and deployment practices.
* Strong relational database skills and SQL data access patterns across SQL Server, Oracle, and DB2\.
* Knowledge of ZPL label workflows, logging, diagnostics, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Internet Information Services (IIS), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Working knowledge of secure coding standards, GitHub repository and branching strategies, and code quality tools such as Sonar.
* Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, and Grafana, including alert and notification setup.
* Familiarity with publisher/subscriber message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and an understanding of message acknowledgment and idempotent operations.
* Strong AI\-first mindset.
* Experience using AI tools, AI agents, and automation platforms to improve operations, production support, data validation, reporting, testing, and documentation.
* Ability to design AI\-agent led solutions for use cases such as issue triage, exception monitoring, MHE fault pattern detection, report generation, knowledge retrieval, regression testing support, and operational analytics.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, auditability, compliance, and validation of AI\-generated outputs.
* Demonstrated situational leadership — guiding teams, driving execution, and delivering measurable business value.
* Self\-driven with strong ownership; comfortable operating as a hands\-on individual contributor.
* Ability to facilitate productive discussions across DC operations, business, and vendor stakeholder groups and drive alignment.
* Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

title: SIEM Engineer - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking a SIEM Engineer specialising in Google SecOps log onboarding and integration to support the EU Markets Cyber Security function. This role focuses on onboarding security telemetry identified by EU cyber teams into the Google SecOps platform, ensuring reliable, high\-quality data is available for security monitoring, threat detection, investigations, compliance and operational reporting. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining data quality, governance standards and operational effectiveness across security telemetry pipelines while collaborating with cyber, engineering and operational stakeholders.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Onboard, transform, validate and deliver security telemetry, log and event sources into Google SecOps using scalable and reusable ingestion patterns.
   

  

 Configure, support, troubleshoot and optimise data ingestion pipelines and associated tooling to maintain reliable and high\-performing data flows.
   

  

 Implement and maintain data lineage, ownership tagging and metadata standards for onboarded data sources to support governance, compliance and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Work closely with EU market cyber teams to gather onboarding requirements, understand source\-system constraints and ensure successful integration outcomes.
   

  

 Validate end\-to\-end event flow and data quality across ingestion pipelines.
   

  

 Support parser maintenance, schema mapping and normalisation activities to ensure consistent and usable security telemetry.
   

  

 Identify and resolve issues relating to delayed, missing, duplicated or incorrectly parsed security events.
   

  

 Contribute to operational improvements through automation, documentation and standardised onboarding processes.
   

  

 Collaborate with security operations, engineering and platform teams to improve telemetry coverage and platform effectiveness.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Hands\-on experience with Google SecOps.
   

  

 Strong understanding of security log sources, including firewall, proxy, EDR, IAM, operating system, cloud audit, application and network telemetry.
   

  

 Experience with log parsing, normalisation and schema mapping.
   

  

 Knowledge of syslog, agents, APIs, event hubs, collectors, forwarders and similar ingestion technologies.
   

  

 Scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar technologies.
   

  

 Experience troubleshooting data ingestion pipelines and validating end\-to\-end event delivery.
   

  

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose data quality and ingestion challenges.
   

  

 Excellent stakeholder engagement and collaboration skills, with experience working across engineering, security and operational teams.
   

  

 Understanding of governance requirements relating to telemetry ownership, lineage and compliance controls.
   

  

**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to work on a strategic Google SecOps platform supporting multiple European markets.
   

  

 Exposure to a broad range of security technologies, telemetry sources and cyber security use cases.
   

  

 Collaboration with international cyber security, engineering and operational teams.
   

  

 Opportunity to contribute to regulatory compliance initiatives, including security telemetry coverage and governance requirements.
   

  

 A role that combines technical delivery, problem\-solving, automation and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Exposure to enterprise\-scale security operations and security data management practices.
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Advanced Google SecOps engineering and platform integration capabilities.
   

  

 End\-to\-end security telemetry onboarding and lifecycle management.
   

  

 Security log parsing, normalisation and schema mapping techniques.
   

  

 Security data governance, lineage management and compliance\-oriented telemetry controls.
   

  

 Automation and scripting approaches for large\-scale security operations environments.
   

  

 Cross\-functional stakeholder management within multinational cyber security organisations.
   

  

 Enterprise\-scale troubleshooting and optimisation of security data pipelines.
   

  

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
   

  

**Alert**
 Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
   

  

 \#JDEnhancedByTARA
   

  

**Follow us on social media**
 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/vois/

title: Oracle Fusion Subscription Management Consultant
description:
**Title** 
 : Oracle Fusion Subscription Management Consultant
 



**Location** 
 : Pune, Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai
 



***100% Work from Office (From Day 1st)***




  





**Job Details:**




 We are seeking an Oracle Fusion Subscription Management professional to support the design, configuration, integration, testing and ongoing improvement of subscription lifecycle processes. The consultant will work with business and technical stakeholders to translate recurring revenue requirements into reliable Oracle Fusion solutions covering subscription creation, amendments, renewals, termination, pricing, billing schedules and downstream integrations.
 



  





**Location requirement**




 The role may be aligned to Pune, Hyderabad, Bengaluru or Chennai based on project allocation. PAN India candidates may be considered, subject to final work\-location requirements confirmed by Client.
 



  





**Role responsibilities**



* Lead or support requirement workshops for subscription products, recurring and one\-time charges, usage\-based pricing, renewals, amendments, suspensions and terminations.
* Configure Oracle Fusion Subscription Management rules, profiles, product structures, renewal templates, pricing and billing\-related setups in line with approved solution designs.
* Map end\-to\-end processes across Subscription Management and relevant Oracle Fusion modules such as Order Management, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Management, Product Management and Pricing, where applicable.
* Design or support integrations using Oracle REST services, file\-based interfaces, Oracle Integration Cloud or other approved enterprise integration patterns.
* Prepare functional specifications, configuration workbooks, process flows, traceability matrices, test scenarios, user guides and deployment documentation.
* Execute or coordinate unit testing, system integration testing, regression testing and user acceptance testing; analyse defects and drive them to closure.
* Support data conversion and validation for customers, products, subscriptions, charges, billing schedules and related reference data.
* Troubleshoot issues involving pricing, billing schedules, renewals, subscription status, interface errors, security roles and scheduled processes.
* Work within change\-control, release and production\-support processes and communicate risks, dependencies and status clearly.
* Provide knowledge transfer to business users and support teams.



  





**Required qualifications and experience**



* Hands\-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud Subscription Management or a closely related Oracle Fusion CX or ERP subscription implementation.
* Strong understanding of the subscription lifecycle, recurring billing concepts, amendments, renewals, usage or rate plans and termination scenarios.
* Ability to translate business requirements into functional configuration and integration requirements.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion security, scheduled processes, REST APIs, reporting and data migration approaches relevant to the module.
* Experience creating test cases, executing end\-to\-end tests and supporting UAT and production issue resolution.
* Clear stakeholder communication and disciplined documentation.








**Preferred qualifications**



* Oracle Fusion implementation certification relevant to CX, Subscription Management, Order Management or Financials.
* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud, BI Publisher, OTBI, FBDI or HDL where relevant.
* Knowledge of revenue recognition, receivables, tax and order orchestration dependencies.
* Experience in Agile delivery and geographically distributed teams.








**Expected professional capabilities**



* Ownership and structured problem solving
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Ability to collaborate across business and technical teams
* Commitment to code, configuration or test quality
* Ability to work within client delivery, security and compliance processes

 In this role, you will manage the day\-to\-day operations of our NetSuite environment while developing customizations, integrations, and solutions to meet business requirements. * Configure the Netsuite modules as per company’s requirements
* Troubleshoot and resolve NetSuite\-related issues reported by end users
* Maintain system documentation, including configurations, customizations, and standard operating procedures
* Implement and manage data integrity controls and security protocols
* Perform regular system maintenance, updates, and testing
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements
* Work with the technical lead to design and develop solutions to enhance NetSuite functionality.
* Create and manage custom forms, fields, records, and workflows
* Develop and maintain custom reports, saved searches, and dashboards
* Lead NetSuite release testing and coordinate system upgrades
* Develop and support integrations between NetSuite and third\-party applications
* Support data migration projects
* Manage the full development lifecycle from requirements gathering to deployment and support.
* Develop test plans before deploying to production
* Stay current with NetSuite features and functionality to recommend process improvements.
* Mentor software engineers on NetSuite development best practices and enhance their technical expertise.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions
* Create and maintain documentation for development guidelines
* Review code and provide constructive feedback to improve team capabilities


**Desired Traits: Distinguished skills, abilities, features, character, and quality.**
* Strong understanding of NetSuite ERP
* 6\+ years of proven experience in designing, building and implementing solutions in NetSuite.
* In\-depth knowledge of NetSuite modules such as GL, Order to Cash, Inventory, AP, AR, Billing, Purchasing, Revenue Recognition, Asset Management, and OneWorld
* Proficiency in NetSuite configuration, customization, and scripting
* Knowledge of system integrations and data migration.
* Ability to work independently, handle multiple tasks, and adapt to changing priorities.
* Familiarity with Agile Software Development, Jira, Git
* Excellent problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Familiarity with PLM systems like Arena preferred.

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.

* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.

title: Language Software Engineer
description:
**Language Software Engineer** 




  





**Full\-time** 




**Location: Delhi / Remote** 




  





**About Chariot:** 
 Chariot is a frontier AI research lab based in India, building foundational AI models. We're one of four teams selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build models from India. We want our models to work as well in Indian languages as the best AI systems work in English.
 



  





**The Role:** 
 You'll build the software layer that trains our models to work across languages from the text processing and data pipelines to the systems that measure whether it's any good.
 



  





**This includes:** 



1. **Language infrastructure.** 
 The layer every model runs through: tokenization, Unicode and script handling, transliteration and romanization, and code\-switching between languages like Hindi and English.
2. **Data pipelines.** 
 Multilingual text and audio arrives messy. You build the pipelines that collect, clean, filter, deduplicate, and align it into training\-ready datasets, across dozens of languages and scripts.
3. **Evaluation.** 
 You build the harnesses that measure how well a model performs in each language, turning the test sets and error patterns our language researchers find into automated, repeatable evals.
4. **Working with research.** 
 You sit between the language researchers who know the languages and the ML researchers who train the models, incoparating what they find directly into how the models behave.



  





**Qualifications \& things we look for:** 



* **Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python.** 
 You write code other people can build on.
* **A real understanding of how language works in software:** 
 encodings, Unicode, scripts, tokenization, transliteration.
* **Experience building data pipelines** 
 that process large volumes of text or audio.
* **You know at least one Indic language well** 
 , or you're genuinely motivated to build for languages beyond English.
* **Experience with speech (ASR or TTS), NLP,** 
 or multilingual systems is a strong plus.
* **You're comfortable operating in an early, fast\-moving environment** 
 and can own projects end to end.
* **A degree in computer science or a related field** 
 , or equivalent practical experience.



  





**How to apply:** 
 Send us your resume, a link to code or projects you'd want to point to, the language(s) you know or care about building for, and a short note on why this role interests you.

We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role is responsible for the design, development, optimization, and operational management of Software Asset Management (SAM) capabilities within the ServiceNow SAMPro and Flexera ecosystem. The position partners with Software Owners, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and IT teams to build scalable processes, improve software lifecycle governance, ensure compliance, optimize software spend, and enable data\-driven decision\-making for Software and SaaS assets.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Ownership \& Application Development**
* Serve as the functional and technical lead for ServiceNow SAMPro and Flexera platforms, ensuring alignment with enterprise software asset management objectives.
* Design, configure, enhance, and support SAM workflows, integrations, data models, and reporting capabilities within ServiceNow and related platforms.
* Partner with ServiceNow administrators, developers, and architects to implement platform improvements, automation opportunities, and new SAM capabilities.
* Maintain awareness of software discovery and inventory technologies and ensure effective integration with SAM platforms to support accurate license reconciliation and compliance.
* Manage and optimize the ServiceNow Content Library, including publisher content requests, software models, and part number normalization activities.


**Software Asset Lifecycle Management**
* Manage the complete software and SaaS asset lifecycle, including procurement, deployment, usage monitoring, optimization, renewal, and retirement.
* Maintain accurate software license entitlement records, contracts, maintenance agreements, software models, and licensing metrics.
* Analyze software consumption, utilization, and spend data to identify optimization, rationalization, and cost reduction opportunities.
* Review top software publishers and products to ensure licensing accuracy, compliance, and cost optimization.
* Coordinate software maintenance and subscription renewals with software owners and stakeholders.


**License Compliance \& Governance**
* Interpret software licensing agreements and contractual terms to ensure compliant software usage across the enterprise.
* Support software publisher audits, license true\-ups, reconciliations, and compliance assessments.
* Provide advisory services to software owners regarding licensing risks, entitlement management, and audit defense strategies.
* Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Software Owners during contract negotiations, renewals, and dispute resolution activities.


**Data Quality, Analytics \& Reporting**
* Ensure integrity, completeness, and quality of software asset data across ServiceNow SAMPro, Flexera, and integrated systems.
* Develop dashboards, reporting solutions, KPIs, and analytics to measure SAM effectiveness, compliance posture, software utilization, and financial performance.
* Troubleshoot licensing, normalization, reconciliation, discovery, and entitlement\-related data issues within ServiceNow SAMPro.
* Deliver actionable insights on software entitlement, installation, usage, renewals, and optimization opportunities.


**SaaS Management \& Integration**
* Expand SaaS visibility through integrations with vendor portals and software publisher platforms.
* Validate integration accuracy through reconciliation activities and partnership with software product owners.
* Drive continuous improvement of SaaS subscription management, optimization, and consumption reporting capabilities.


**Demand, Procurement \& Contract Management**
* Create, maintain, and manage software demand records within ServiceNow to support budgeting, forecasting, and portfolio planning activities.
* Review software and SaaS purchasing requests, contract requirements, and approval workflows to ensure compliance with organizational policies.
* Support software request fulfillment processes, including requisition management, purchase orders, invoice validation, and contract administration.
* Coordinate communications among software owners, service providers, Finance, Procurement, and Legal teams throughout the software acquisition lifecycle.


**Strategic Planning \& Continuous Improvement**
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and SAM best practices to enhance platform capabilities and operational effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, automation, governance, and user experience across SAM services.
* Influence stakeholders and vendors to drive adoption of strategic SAM initiatives and achieve business objectives.
* Develop recommendations that balance cost, compliance, risk, scalability, and user experience considerations.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Required Experience**
* Extensive experience in Software Asset Management, Software License Management, and SaaS Asset Management.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow SAMPro, Flexera, and software discovery/inventory solutions.
* Strong understanding of software licensing models, entitlement management, publisher audits, and software compliance practices.
* Experience developing, enhancing, or supporting enterprise application platforms and workflow automation solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex software licensing and contractual agreements and translate requirements into operational processes.


**Technical Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform capabilities, ITSM processes, and ITIL practices.
* Familiarity with software discovery, normalization, reconciliation, and asset lifecycle management processes.
* Experience with reporting, analytics, KPI development, and data quality management.
* Knowledge of SaaS integrations, API\-based data exchange, and software consumption analytics.


**Leadership \& Business Skills**
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to influence business and technical stakeholders to drive effective software governance decisions.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a demonstrated track record of delivering business outcomes and simplifying complex processes.
* Growth mindset with continuous learning, adaptability, and focus on innovation.
* Experience managing vendor relationships and driving service improvements.


**Preferred Certifications**
* ServiceNow SAM Professional Certification.
* IAITAM Certifications (CSAM, CHAMP, or equivalent).
* Microsoft Licensing Certifications or equivalent software licensing credentials.
* ITIL Foundation Certification.

title: Senior Software Engineer – C/C++ & Network Systems
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Looking forward to getting an exciting start to your career? Catalyst Engineering IOS XE Platform Independent team, designs and develops high\-performance system software for various Cisco Platforms which includes Enterprise Switching \& Routers, Service Provider Routing Platforms. This is one of the team where we are leading the Enterprise Industry with several innovations; and we are in an exciting phase in the rapidly evolving market. The opportunities here are boundless, and we are sure you will add a character to the dynamism of this team!
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Software Engineer, you’ll build and integrate software that powers leading enterprise networking solutions deployed by organizations around the world. You’ll work on Cisco IOS XE, a critical operating system at the heart of many enterprise networking devices, while gaining hands\-on experience with emerging technologies and large\-scale platforms.
   

  

 You’ll be part of a vibrant, collaborative technical community where you can learn from experienced engineers, share ideas, and turn your expertise into meaningful solutions. From design and development to integration and deployment, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact while continuously learning and growing your career.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and test scalable, high\-quality software components for Cisco IOS XE.
* Develop control\-plane and data\-plane software for switching, routing, wireless, and IIoT products.
* Analyze requirements and create effective software designs, functional specifications, and solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex issues to ensure system stability, security, and performance.
* Drive engineering process improvements and adopt industry best practices.
* Innovate and contribute ideas that create intellectual property and patent opportunities.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 We are seeking a bachelor’s with 5\+ years of related experience, or Masters with 3\+ years of related experience, or PhD \+ 0 years of related experience.
   

  

* Good programming skills in C/C\+\+, with a focus on writing reliable, maintainable, and high\-quality code.
* Experience or understanding of networking software/firmware, including control plane, data plane, Linux/RTOS, or networking OS internals.
* Knowledge of data structures, software architecture, and system design, with the ability to translate requirements into effective solutions.
* Experience with wireless technologies (802\.11ac/ax/be) and network testing tools such as IXIA or packet analyzers
* A passion for innovation and emerging technologies, with experience in areas such as Python, AI/LLMs, RAG, MCP, or building intelligent network\-diagnostics solutions being an advantage.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and complex system architectures.
* Hands\-on experience in areas such as High Availability, IPC, memory management, distributed systems, containers, or virtualization.
* Ability to learn quickly, adapt to evolving requirements, and embrace new technologies.
* CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE certification is a plus; equivalent experience is valued.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
   

  

**Disclaimer**
**About**
 To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
   

  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx


 Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5\.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

We’re looking for an experienced backend software engineer to help drive and evolve our product. Our technology is new and rapidly evolving: you’ll be an early contributor with a substantial impact on the architecture and be solving multiple exciting technical challenges!

**What you’ll do**

* You'll design, extend and optimize a large\-scale, highly scalable, and fault\-tolerant system that handles large graph datasets at enterprise scale. Our product is processing billions of events from hundreds of thousands of endpoints in real\-time with sub\-second latency requirements
* You'll architect and implement Security products to protect customers data
* You'll be solving real\-world scaling problems that require thorough performance analysis and troubleshooting skills
* You get to work with a modern and constantly evolving microservices\-based software stack which includes Go, Kubernetes, BigTable, BigQuery, Spanner, Redis, Docker, Etcd

* If you have experience in building connectors that integrate at API level with SaaS applications commonly used in the enterprises let us know
* You have hands\-on experience with microservices and Kubernetes
* You have excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and you can be available to frequently communicate with distributed teams in Europe and US
* You thrive in fast paced environments tackling ambiguous challenges and you enjoying shipping with velocity
* You have a customer centric mindset and enjoy direct feedback from customers
* You are based in Bangalore for the India location (Remote for EU based talent)

title: Manager I - Senior Software Engineer, SAP Quality Management
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

 At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients’ lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care.
   

  

 The Senior Software Engineer, SAP Quality Management should have strong experience supporting and delivering SAP QM capabilities in an SAP S/4HANA environment, with working knowledge of manufacturing integration points across PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS. This role focuses on quality inspection processes, quality notifications, batch and material quality controls, master data, regulated validation expectations, and operational support in an FDA and GxP environment.
   

  

 If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!
   

  

 🚀 Shape the Future of Quality Technology \| SAP S/4HANA Quality Management Specialist
   

  

 Are you ready to make an impact where Quality meets Innovation?
   

  

 We're looking for a talented SAP Quality Management Specialist to join our global team and help drive the next generation of intelligent, compliant, and cloud\-enabled quality solutions. If you're passionate about SAP QM, digital quality transformation, AI\-enabled innovation, and regulated manufacturing excellence, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 💡 Delivering Smart Quality Solutions
   

  

* Design, implement, and support SAP S/4HANA Quality Management solutions across inspection planning, inspection execution, results recording, usage decisions, quality notifications, batch release, and quality certificate processes.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery across requirements, design, configuration, testing, deployment, validation support, and operational excellence.
* Provide scalable and compliant SAP QM solutions aligned with business and regulatory expectations.


 🔗 Connecting the Dots
   

  

* Partners with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Laboratory, and Enterprise Platform teams to deliver integrated quality processes.
* Support integrations with MES, LIMS, Batch Release Hub, BTP/BIAP, and other enterprise platforms.
* Ensure seamless execution of quality processes across manufacturing, inventory, warehouse, and laboratory systems.


 ☁️ Driving Cloud \& AI Transformation
   

  

* Support digital quality transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA and cloud technologies.
* Apply AI, GenAI, automation, process mining, reporting, and analytics to improve operational efficiency, accelerate documentation, strengthen quality compliance, and reduce manual effort across SAP QM processes.
* Identify and support AI\-enabled use cases including quality anomaly detection, proactive incident prevention, automated root cause analysis, intelligent incident resolution, quality trend analytics, and process mining insights.
* Use AI/GenAI responsibly in regulated environments to support GxP documentation, test script preparation, validation evidence reviews, audit\-readiness checks, and knowledge management while aligning with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) Teams, data integrity, and validation expectations.
* Contribute to enterprise modernization initiatives involving SAP RISE, BTP/BIAP, and digital manufacturing capabilities.


 🛡️ Keeping Us Compliant
   

  

* Support FDA, GxP, Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) compliant solution delivery, documentation, and operations.
* Produce and maintain GxP documentation including SDLC deliverables, validation plans, requirements traceability, test scripts, testing evidence, deviations, approvals, and audit\-ready records in alignment with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) expectations.
* Ensure quality processes and system changes meet regulatory, validation, inspection readiness, and compliance requirements.


 🤝 Collaborating \& Innovating
   

  

* Build strong relationships with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Validation, Enterprise Platform, IT Business Partners, and external partners.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote adoption of emerging technologies.
* Lead stakeholder communications and influence cross\-functional decision making.
* Mentor team members and contribute to organizational capability development.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* ✅ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* ✅ 5–7\+ years of SAP QM experience in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments.
* ✅ Strong experience in Inspection Management, Quality Notifications, Batch Management, Quality Master Data, and Quality Certificates.
* ✅ Experience supporting FDA\-regulated and GxP\-compliant environments, including Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) / Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) documentation, validation evidence, traceability, change control, and audit readiness.
* ✅ Knowledge of SAP QM integration with PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS.
* ✅ Experience supporting SDLC, validation, testing, deployment, and operational support activities.
* ✅ Ability to apply AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, and process mining to improve SAP QM delivery, documentation quality, incident prevention, testing efficiency, and compliance outcomes.
* ✅ Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
* ✅ Passion for continuous learning, innovation, and adoption of emerging technologies.


 Bonus Points If You Have...
   

  

* ⭐ Experience with SAP RISE, SAP BTP/BIAP, cloud transformation initiatives, or enterprise integration platforms.
* ⭐ Experience with Batch Release Hub and advanced quality release processes.
* ⭐ Hands\-on exposure to AI/GenAI, Copilot\-style productivity tools, automation, process mining, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, or intelligent operational support in SAP, Quality, Manufacturing, or regulated environments.
* ⭐ Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated manufacturing industry experience.
* ⭐ Experience supporting global SAP programs and enterprise\-scale deployments.


 What Makes You Stand Out

 These pillars and values are our foundation—shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.

title: Senior Moodle / Totara Developer
description:
Role Overview: As a Senior Moodle / Totara Developer, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, customizing, and maintaining our Totara/Moodle-based learning management systems. You will play a key role in extending Totara/Moodle's core functionality, managing version upgrades (including Totara upgrades), integrating it with other critical systems, and ensuring optimal performance, security, and scalability. This role requires not only hands-on development expertise but also a strong understanding of Totara/Moodle's underlying structure to deliver high-quality, sustainable solutions. Key Responsibilities: Totara/Moodle Development & Customization: Lead the development, customization, and maintenance of Totara/Moodle plugins, themes, and core functionalities to meet diverse business and educational requirements. LMS Upgrade Management: Plan and execute Totara/Moodle and Totara version upgrades, including pre-upgrade assessments, dependency validation, database migrations, regression testing, and post-upgrade stabilization. PHP Development: Write clean, efficient, reusable, and scalable PHP code to extend and enhance the Totara/Moodle platform. Totara/Moodle Architecture & API Expertise: Leverage an in-depth understanding of Totara/Moodle's modular architecture, APIs, and database structure to design and implement robust solutions. System Integration: Integrate Totara/Moodle with various third-party applications, including other LMS, CMS, CRM, HRMS, and external services using RESTful APIs and other integration methods. Performance Optimization: Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, optimize database queries (MySQL/PostgreSQL), implement caching strategies (e.g., Redis, Memcached), and ensure the scalability and reliability of Totara/Moodle instances. Troubleshooting & Support: Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues related to Totara/Moodle installations, configurations, integrations, and customizations. Provide technical support to internal teams and, at times, to clients. Security & Compliance: Ensure the Totara/Moodle system is secure, compliant with the latest security standards, and apply necessary patches and updates. Safeguard against common web vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, SQL injection). Code Review & Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough code reviews, adhere to coding guidelines, and ensure best practices in Totara/Moodle development. Contribute to automated and manual testing efforts (e.g., PHPUnit, Behat) to maintain high code quality. Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for code, processes, and system configurations. Collaboration & Leadership: Work closely with instructional designers, content developers, project managers, system administrators, and other developers. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers. Required Skills & Experience: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of proven professional experience in Moodle development and customization. Hands-on experience with Totara LMS, including Totara version upgrades and maintenance. Strong expertise in PHP programming. In-depth knowledge of Moodle's architecture, core APIs, and database structure. Should be using co-pilot/AI in this work This is a client facing role so he/she should have worked with overseas customer and interacted with the customer Extensive experience with Moodle plugin and theme development. Proficiency in web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (including modern JS frameworks like jQuery, React, Angular, or Vue.js is a plus), and AJAX. Strong experience with database management systems, particularly MySQL (and/or PostgreSQL), including schema design and query optimization. Familiarity with version control systems, especially Git. Experience with RESTful APIs and third-party service integrations. Ability to work with Linux-based servers and hosting environments. Experience with Moodle upgrades and managing large-scale Moodle implementations. Solid understanding of web security best practices. Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills. Strong communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment. Desired Skills (Good to Have): Experience supporting large-scale Moodle and Totara enterprise implementations . Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Familiarity with SCORM, LTI, and xAPI standards. Experience in Agile/Scrum development methodologies. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for code deployment and testing. Proficiency in PhpStorm or similar IDEs.

Key Skills: Moodle,Totara LMS,CSS,Performance Optimization,Moodle architecture,PostgreSQL,HTML,code reviews

title: Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application
description:
Job Description Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application Position Summary The Senior Firmware Developer - Thermal Application will be responsible for electrical and electronics engineering activities for screw chiller machines and thermal products. The role involves close coordination with cross-functional teams to ensure reliable, efficient, and compliant machine operation, including control systems integration and basic software interaction. Key Responsibilities Design and develop electrical systems for HVAC machines, including screw chillers and thermal products. Prepare and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, GA drawings, and BOMs. Select and integrate electrical components such as MCCBs, contactors, relays, VFDs, sensors, heaters, and protection devices. Support control panel design, power distribution, earthing, and safety interlocks for chiller systems. Support in PLC and HMI programming activities , including basic logic modifications, I/O mapping, tag management, and parameter settings. Coordinate BMS integration (e. g. , BACnet/Modbus) and support testing, signal mapping, and system validation. Participate in dry testing, DVT, and performance testing of machines in lab and factory environments. Troubleshoot electrical and control-related issues during development, production, and site commissioning. Coordinate with Mechanical, Controls, Software, QA, Sourcing, and Service teams for system integration and issue resolution. Ensure compliance with applicable electrical standards, safety guidelines, and company processes. Support component localization and cost optimization initiatives without impacting quality or performance. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Electronics Engineering or equivalent. 4-6 years of relevant industry experience (Engineer II level). Strong machine-level experience in HVAC systems, especially screw chiller machines. Good knowledge of industrial electrical systems, control panels, and VFD-based applications. Working experience or exposure to PLC and HMI programming in industrial applications . Knowledge of BMS integration protocols such as Bacnet and Modbus is preferred. Basic knowledge of programming languages such as C, C++, Structured Text (ST), and Function Block Diagram (FBD). Hands-on experience in testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting HVAC equipment. Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, and documentation. Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

title: Software Engineer 3, AI Framework Integrations
description:
Job Summary AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Software Engineers to be among its founding members. The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it. This is a strong role for an engineer who wants to grow into the AI space with real ownership. You'll own well-scoped projects from design through release, work with fast-moving and sometimes unproven technologies, and get a clear view of how the ecosystem is evolving. Priorities shift as frameworks change and customer demand moves, so we're looking for engineers who are adaptable, ask good questions, and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and participating in developer communities as MongoDB. You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, with senior engineers and your manager close at hand as you take on larger pieces of it. MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. Position expectations Build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra Own well-scoped projects end to end on weekly-to-quarterly timelines, taking responsibility for the scope, schedule, and quality of your own work and communicating progress and trade-offs clearly Solve day-to-day technical problems with growing independence, using the team's established patterns and past practice to guide your decisions, and seeking guidance on non-standard problems Contribute to exploratory work on new frameworks: help evaluate an integration's feasibility, build a first working version of the piece you own, and share what you learn with the team Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, following the team's contribution practices and maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy through external maintainer review cycles Work within and improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility checks, and release steps. Suggest improvements where you see repeated friction Help keep the integrations you work on healthy: monitor for upstream breaking changes, handle upgrades, triage incoming issues, and follow through after release Coordinate with adjacent teams, including DBX, when your work depends on driver, platform, or product capability, and escalate cross-team dependencies and risks early rather than working around them Collaborate with product management, product design, and other partners to understand what users need from an integration and how your work connects to the team's objectives Write clear documentation, give useful code reviews, share what you know with teammates, and follow through on your commitments Develop specialized knowledge of the Python or TypeScript AI builder ecosystems frameworks, agent and retrieval patterns, vector search and bring interesting developments back to the team Qualifications 3+ years of experience building backend systems, libraries, or other developer-facing software, with solid proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript Experience designing, writing, testing, and debugging software in a shared, long-lived code base, with an eye for the tests and documentation that make it maintainable Track record of delivering scoped projects reliably and on time, with growing independence and good judgment about when to ask for help Demonstrated ability to work on several projects at once and keep quality and commitments intact as priorities shift Clear interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, or vector search Solid verbal and written technical communication, including the ability to write things down clearly for teammates and partners you won't always overlap with in real time Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest Eager to learn, with a strong technical foundation and an interest in deepening it Nice to Have Open source contributions, especially any work that landed in a repository you don't own Experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications, professionally or as side projects Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it Experience with CI/CD and automated testing for libraries that support multiple versions or platforms Experience working with databases; familiarity with MongoDB query patterns Exposure to vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust Experience with containerization tools (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and libraries Familiarity with Jira and related tools Success measures In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, how our integrations are structured, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and how we build, test, and release. You'll have landed your first code contribution and know who to ask when you're blocked In three months, you will be delivering scoped work on one or more integrations with growing independence, will have landed an upstream contribution, and will be comfortable running the team's testing and release process for your own changes In six months, you will own a well-defined area or project end to end, deliver against quarterly objectives with limited oversight, and have made at least one concrete improvement to the quality or efficiency of how the team works In twelve months, you will be a dependable owner of a piece of the portfolio, will have delivered multiple meaningful features or integrations, will be handling upstream and customer issues in your area with confidence, and will be helping teammates get up to speed on what you know best
