title: Senior Software Engineer – Forecasting & Recommendations
description:
**Senior Software Engineer – Forecasting \& Recommendations** 




**About the role:** 




 We are hiring a hands\-on Senior Software Engineer to build and operate backend services for our Forecasting and Recommendations platforms, with a focus on production\-grade AI and data\-driven decisioning systems.
 



 This role focus on designing, building, and maintaining high\-throughput, low\-latency distributed systems that power forecasting, recommendations, and Performance Advisor capabilities at scale. You will work deeply in backend systems, APIs, event\-driven services, and cloud infrastructure, while contributing to reliability, observability, and operational excellence.
 



 We are looking for an engineer who can contribute immediately, has strong experience building scalable production systems, and brings sound judgment around developing reliable, maintainable, and high\-performance software, including systems that integrate machine\-learning and AI capabilities 
 



**What You’ll Do :** 



* Design, build, and operate backend services supporting forecasting, recommendations, and Performance Advisor workflows in production.
* Write production\-quality code daily; own significant services and components from design through deployment, support, and incident resolution.
* Build low\-latency, high\-throughput SaaS services, including APIs, event\-driven pipelines, data\-processing services, and model\-integration workflows.
* Develop and maintain scalable backend components that support AI\- and machine\-learning\-driven product capabilities.
* Collaborate with data science, platform, and product teams to integrate forecasting, recommendation, and AI decisioning capabilities into production systems.
* Work with technologies such as Kafka, Elasticsearch, NoSQL databases, and AWS to build resilient distributed systems.
* Ensure product quality through rigorous code reviews, unit tests, debugging, and continuous improvement.
* Champion observability and reliability through metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and root\-cause analysis.
* Participate in production incident response, retrospectives, and systemic fixes.
* Identify performance, scalability, and reliability risks early and contribute practical solutions.
* Reduce complexity across services, infrastructure, and processes to improve stability and team velocity.
* Collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams in a large, distributed development.



**What We’re Looking For :** 



* 8–12 years of professional software engineering experience building and operating scalable, robust backend systems.
* A strong track record of hands\-on ownership of production services, including improvements in performance, reliability, scalability, or cost.
* Strong expertise in distributed systems design, including service boundaries, concurrency, data modeling, failure handling, and scalability tradeoffs.
* Experience developing high\-throughput, event\-driven systems and backend APIs.
* Experience supporting machine\-learning\-driven systems, forecasting, recommendations, or similar datadriven applications is strongly preferred.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS and cloud\-native system design and operations.
* Experience with Kafka, Elasticsearch, NoSQL databases such as Aerospike, Thrift, and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with container\-based solutions and microservices architectures.
* Proficiency in one or more backend languages commonly used for large\-scale systems, such as Python, Java, Ruby, Go, or Scala.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-enabled applications, LLM integrations, or agentic workflows is a plus.
* Strong object\-oriented programming, system design, problem\-solving, critical\-thinking, and communication skills.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



**Senior\-Level Expectations** 




**In this role, you are expected to:** 



* Be a strong, hands\-on contributor who delivers high\-quality software and sets a strong engineering example.
* Take ownership of significant services, components, or features from design through production operation.
* Build a deep understanding of the systems and domains you own.
* Simplify and improve existing systems to increase team velocity, reliability, and maintainability.
* Balance technical, analytical, and product constraints to deliver practical solutions.
* Make sound technical decisions within your domain and raise architectural or operational risks early.
* Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and collaborative problem solving.
* Ship meaningful services, features, and infrastructure improvements that advance the Performance Advisor platform.



**Why Join This Team** 



* Build and operate mission\-critical systems that power forecasting and recommendations at scale.
* Build and operate mission\-critical systems that power forecasting, recommendations, and Performance Advisor capabilities at scale.
* Work on high\-throughput distributed systems with meaningful business impact.
* Collaborate with experienced engineers, product leaders, and AI/data teams.
* Work in an environment that values execution, pragmatism, and modern engineering workflows.
* Solve complex backend and systems problems while building skills in cloud\-native and AI\-powered applications.



**Company Summary** 




 Zeta Global is a data\-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi\-Cola, the Company combines the industry’s 3rd largest proprietary data set (2\.4B\+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth.
 



 Zeta Global is a leading AI\-powered marketing technology company that enables enterprise brands to acquire, grow, and retain customers through intelligent, data\-driven engagement. At the center of its innovation is the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), which unifies customer data, identity, and advanced analytics to transform billions of data signals into actionable marketing intelligence and measurable business outcomes.

description:

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

 We are seeking a highly experienced Lead Software Engineer to join Visa’s Shared Services and Cloud Product Development organization. This role is ideal for a senior technologist who thrives as a lead generalist, operating across infrastructure, security, scalability, and platform engineering, while building foundational services that enable Visa’s global product ecosystem.
 



  





 In this role, you will design and deliver Java/J2EE\-based shared services that power multiple Visa products and platforms, influencing internal engineering standards for scalability, security, reliability, and reusability. You will collaborate across Product, Engineering, Security, SRE, and Architecture teams to build resilient, cloud\-native systems that support Visa’s mission at global scale.
 



 The Work Itself
 


* Design, build, and evolve core shared services that support Visa’s product development ecosystem and reach approximately 40% of the world’s population.
* Lead the development of scalable, secure, and reusable Java/J2EE\-based services that serve as foundational platforms for multiple product teams.
* Act as a lead generalist, contributing across application architecture, infrastructure, security, and scalability to ensure shared services are enterprise\-grade and future\-ready.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to create architecture and design artifacts and deliver best\-in\-class software solutions used across Visa’s technical offerings.
* Drive continuous improvements in product quality, platform reliability, and operational excellence across shared services.
* Develop robust, highly available systems serving diverse use cases, including consumer\-facing products, B2B platforms, and business\-to\-government solutions.
* Leverage modern technologies to build the next generation of Payment Services, Transaction Platforms, Real\-Time Payments, and Buy Now Pay Later capabilities.
* Contribute to team and organizational growth through mentorship, technical leadership, and continuous learning initiatives.
* Essential Functions
* Provide deep technical leadership within Shared Services and Cloud Product Development, with a strong understanding of how shared platforms enable downstream product innovation.
* Lead discovery and design sessions with product partners to translate business requirements into scalable, secure shared\-service architectures.
* Define and formalize best practices and standards for Java/J2EE development, API design, security, and service scalability.
* Lead planning, piloting, and integration of new platform capabilities, including infrastructure enhancements, security controls, and AI\-enabled tooling.
* Design and implement cloud\-native, containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and elastic scalability.
* Partner closely with Security teams to implement secure API gateways, authentication and authorization mechanisms, and compliance\-driven architectures.
* Analyze systemic patterns across defects, incidents, and performance metrics, driving long\-term platform improvements.



 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
 



 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Basic Qualifications: 10\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 7 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 4 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 13\+ years of relevant work experience.
* Preferred Qualifications: 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8\-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6\+ years of work experience with a PhD 10\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree, or 7\+ years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master’s, MBA, JD, MD), or 4\+ years of relevant experience with a PhD, or 13\+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree. Proven ability to define technical needs, develop execution plans, coordinate resources, and deliver results across multiple initiatives.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple projects simultaneously and resolving priority or scheduling conflicts.
* Strong understanding of container based cloud architectures, including Kubernetes and Docker.
* Experience with cloud migration and multi\-cloud strategies. Experience designing elastic, scalable architectural patterns for high\-traffic web applications.
* Solid understanding of Service and IT Operations Management and DevOps operating models, including deployment and capacity planning.
* Strong experience with enterprise integration, including RESTful web services and API\-first architectures.
* Deep understanding of security requirements, industry standards, and modern security threats and mitigation strategies.
* Experience designing and implementing secure API gateway solutions with dynamic security standards. Experience with CI/CD\-driven architectures and automation\-first development practices.
* Experience developing commercial software on Unix/Linux platforms.
* Proven track record in a technical leadership role, including ownership of system design and delivery.
* Experience with consumer facing application development at scale. Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Demonstrated passion for mentoring, team building, and continuous improvement.
* The Skills You Bring Technical Leadership: Proven experience leading complex software initiatives across distributed systems and shared service platforms. Primary Language Expertise: Strong expertise in Java (Core Java, J2EE, RESTful services).
* Architecture \& Scalability: Experience designing highly available, scalable, and secure distributed systems.
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Hands\-on experience with container\-based architectures using Docker and Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Security: Strong understanding of secure API design, authentication/authorization, secure gateway patterns, and enterprise security standards. DevOps \& Operations: Experience with CI/CD, deployment automation, observability, capacity planning, and production operations.
* AI Enablement: Familiarity with integrating AI tools and services to improve platform intelligence and developer productivity.
* Collaboration: Strong partnership skills working with Product, QA, DevOps, SRE, and Agile/Scrum teams.
* Mentorship: Experience coaching engineers on technical excellence and career development.



  





**Visa is an EEO Employer** 




 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

description:

title: Software Engineer III
description:
**Software Engineer \- III**
**About The Role**
 GHX is building a next\-generation Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) platform powered by LLMs and AI\-native document understanding. We extract structured data from complex healthcare procurement documents — Purchase Orders, invoices, contracts — at scale across cloud environments. As a member of the IPA engineering team, you will bridge strong software engineering with applied AI. You will design and ship Python services, integrate LLM APIs, build AI agents, create skills and validate the output of LLMs to build document extraction pipelines, and own evaluation infrastructure that ensures production quality. This is not a research role — it is a hands\-on engineering role where AI fluency amplifies solid software craft.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**Python Development \& Automation**
* Build and maintain Python\-based automation services and IPA workflows
* Develop platform\-agnostic solutions supporting future migration across automation tooling
* Build reusable libraries, frameworks, and components for automation projects
* Integrate automation solutions with REST APIs and enterprise applications
* Deploy and monitor automation bots on AWS (Lambda, ECS, SQS, S3\)


**AI \& LLM Integration**
* Integrate LLM APIs (like Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure AI) into production pipelines
* Design classification and extraction prompts for diverse document types (POs, invoices, contracts)
* Write prompts that function as formal specifications — unambiguous, edge\-case\-aware
* Build and iterate few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, and structured output templates
* Own prompt library versioning, rollback strategy, and prompt lifecycle management


**AI \& LLM Integration**
* Integrate LLM APIs (like Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure AI) into production pipelines
* Design classification and extraction prompts for diverse document types (POs, invoices, contracts)
* Write prompts that function as formal specifications — unambiguous, edge\-case\-aware
* Build and iterate few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, and structured output templates
* Own prompt library versioning, rollback strategy, and prompt lifecycle management


**Document Processing \& IDP**
* Implement OCR/IDP workflows to extract and validate structured and unstructured data
* Build confidence scoring frameworks for extracted fields with multi\-factor validation
* Design and curate ground truth datasets for classification and extraction tasks
* Build automated evaluation pipelines tracking precision, recall, and field\-level accuracy
* Validate model outputs against intent — catch what is technically correct but conceptually wrong


**Software Engineering**
* Design and build production\-grade APIs and services around LLM capabilities
* Apply Clean Architecture or equivalent — design for testability and maintainability
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, observability tooling, and deployment processes
* Conduct code reviews, establish coding standards, and mentor junior engineers
* Troubleshoot and optimize existing automation workflows and Python services


**Collaboration \& Communication**
* Work closely with business analysts and stakeholders to understand process requirements
* Participate in Agile ceremonies — sprint planning, retrospectives, and estimation
* Communicate system constraints in product language; translate product needs into system boundaries
* Surface quality metrics and model behaviour clearly to non\-technical stakeholders


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 5–9 years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years in Python
* Strong Python skills — Pandas, NumPy, Flask/Django, async programming
* Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (like Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Azure AI)
* Prompt engineering experience — structured outputs, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought
* 2\+ years of experience with SQL and NoSQL databases
* Experience deploying applications on AWS — Lambda, SQS, S3, ECS
* Knowledge of Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or equivalent)
* Familiarity with REST API design and tools like Swagger and Postman
* Understanding of OCR/IDP tools — AWS Textract, UiPath Document Understanding, or ABBYY


**Desired Qualifications**
* Experience with AI agent orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, or MCP
* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (precision, recall, F1 at field level)
* NLP / text classification background
* UiPath Associate or Advanced RPA Developer certification (or equivalent)
* Exposure to Clean Architecture, DDD, or equivalent design patterns
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies


**What Good Looks Like**
* Prompt as specification — treats prompts like contracts: precise, unambiguous, edge\-case\-aware from the start
* Verification instinct — reads AI output critically; catches the subtly wrong answer before it becomes a data quality incident
* Evaluation\-first mindset — doesn't trust a prompt in production without a test suite; builds measurement as part of the feature
* Engineering rigour — applies the same discipline to Python services as to LLM pipelines; Clean Architecture is the default, not the exception
* Communication range — can speak to a non\-technical ops manager and a distributed system design at the same level of precision

title: Senior Developer
description:
**About Premium Parking**




 Premium Parking is industry leader in the USA and transforming urban mobility with a techfirst platform that blends AI, IoT, enterprise urban mobility, and elegant design to deliver scalable, frictionless parking and compliance solutions. As part of our Product Innovation, you’ll work alongside global product, engineering, and strategy teams to build intelligent, modular solutions that operate seamlessly across kiosks, mobile apps, IoT devices, and integrated systems.
 



  





**Role**




 Independently deliver complex, cross\-cutting features across our web, kiosk, and mobile front ends, mentor mid\-level engineers, and own the quality of what you ship
 



  





**Responsibilities**




 • Own front\-end features end to end: design handoff, component build, API integration, tests, release, and the fixes that follow.
 



 • Build and maintain the shared component library and design system behind the web app, kiosk screens, and mobile app.
 



 • Turn Figma designs into pixel\-accurate, responsive, accessible interfaces that hold up on kiosk touchscreens and small phones.
 



 • Own client\-side data flow: REST and GraphQL integration, caching, pagination, optimistic updates, and offline\-tolerant behaviour.
 



 • Handle every state a screen can reach: loading, empty, partial, expired, and error, and settle the payload contract with backend engineers.
 



 • Diagnose production defects from error reports and session data: reproduce the issue, isolate the root cause rather than the symptom, ship the fix, and leave a regression test behind.
 



 • Hold the performance budget: bundle size, render profiling, image and font loading, and smooth interaction on low\-end kiosk hardware.
 



 • Write unit, component, and end\-to\-end tests, and keep the suite fast and green in GitHub Actions behind lint and type\-check gates.
 



 • Instrument the front end with error tracking, product analytics, and experiments, then act on what the numbers show.
 



 • Review code and mentor mid\-level engineers, holding the team to its typing, testing, and accessibility standards.
 



 • Work with product and design from discovery: question unclear requirements, offer options, and estimate honestly.
 



 • Support releases, triage front\-end incidents on call, and write postmortems that lead to a concrete change.
 



  





**Skills Required**




 • 5\-10 years of relevant experience
 



 • Expert in React.js (hooks, context, component architecture, state management) and mobile app development with React Native / Expo.
 



 • TypeScript or similar typed language, modern JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and accessibility.
 



 • Frameworks: Next.js, Expo, Webpack, Redux Toolkit, React Query, and Storybook.
 



 • Testing in React: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress or Playwright, MSW mocking.
 



 • Bug fixing: reproduce, root\-cause with React DevTools, fix with a regression test.
 



 • Git and GitHub Actions: build, test, lint, and deploy workflows with caching.
 



 • Strong REST and GraphQL API design, versioning, and backwards\-compatibility skills.
 



 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills on ambiguous, production\-critical issues.
 



 • Performance tuning: bundle size, render profiling, caching, and mobile responsiveness.
 



 • Flexible across products; mentors engineers, reviews code, and picks up new stacks.
 



  





**Why Join Us**




 • Work directly on AI\- and GenAI\-powered product \& design workflows
 



 • Shape multi\-platform user experiences across kiosks, mobile, IoT devices, and 3rdparty integrations
 



 • Collaborate with a global team while enjoying the agility of GCC India’s start\-up\-style environment
 



 • Bring your own tools — we encourage innovation and adoption of new in\-house capabilities
 



 • Direct impact on products used by cities, universities, and enterprises across North America

 Building scalable middleware, API integrations, and production\-grade applications that connect our data stack to business tools (CRM, Marketing Automation, Support/Ticketing).
2. **AI Engineering (30%):** 
 Implementing Agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and LLMs to process unstructured data at scale.

 Leveraging SQL and B2B SaaS metrics to ensure all automation is grounded in accurate, governed data.

**2\. AI Logic \& Agent Implementation** 



* Architect "Agentic" workflows where LLMs are granted permission to perform tasks
* Implement advanced RAG to ground AI outputs in company documentation, historical data, and strategic context.
* Ensure rigorous evaluation and guardrails for non\-deterministic models to prevent "hallucinations" in critical business workflows.



**3\. Data Engineering \& Governance** 



* Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to ensure the underlying data pipelines support real\-time or near\-real\-time AI applications.
* Maintain security and privacy standards, ensuring that AI agents respect data access permissions across different departments.

* **B2B Domain Expertise:** 
 Understanding of the interplay between Sales, Product, and Customer Success.



**Competencies** 



* **The "Builder" Mindset:**

* **Systemic Thinking:**

**ANSR is hiring for one of its clients.** 




**ABOUT UNDER ARMOUR:** 




 Our story is a classic American entrepreneurial journey, born from a simple, unmet need identified by an athlete. In 1996, founder Kevin Plank, then captain of the University of Maryland football team, set out to solve the problem of sweat\-soaked cotton shirts by creating a moisture\-wicking synthetic alternative. That innovation – HeatGear – redefined the athletic base layer and laid the foundation for what is today a global leader in performance apparel, footwear, and accessories.
 



 Headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland, Under Armour is driven by a clear mission – to make all athletes better. This relentless pursuit of better defines who we are, shaping our focus on performance, innovation, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**OUR PURPOSE:** 




 Building on this global foundation, Under Armour India is purpose\-built to access India’s top\-tier talent and embed the brand’s culture into scalable, tech\-driven solutions. At its core, this is about empowering those who strive for more – a belief reflected in our values: Act Sustainably, Celebrate the Wins, Fight on Together, Love Athletes, and Stand for Equality.
 



 These values serve as a shared framework that guides how we think, build, and collaborate. They connect teams across geographies, reinforce our purpose, and ensure that everything we do is aligned to a common goal – enabling better outcomes for athletes and the business.
 



 At Under Armour India, this translates into an environment where individuals have the freedom to go further, regardless of role. Teams are empowered to develop and deliver state\-of\-the\-art products and digital solutions that enhance performance and drive impact at scale.
 



  





**VALUES \& INNOVATION:** 




 Across Under Armour globally, our values act as the thread that unites every teammate, shaping a culture grounded in purpose, accountability, and shared ambition. They are not just principles, but active drivers of how we operate, innovate, and grow together.
 



 This culture is deeply anchored in innovation – a continuous pursuit of better that pushes boundaries and challenges convention. Whether through product innovation or digital transformation, teams are enabled to create solutions that elevate performance and redefine possibilities for athletes everywhere.
 



  





**PURPOSE OF ROLE:** 




 The Software Engineer \- Data \& AI Platform owns the design, development, deployment, and operational excellence of complex data ingestion and transformation domains within the enterprise cloud data platform.
 



 This role builds scalable, high\-volume data pipelines while elevating technical standards across development and deployment practices. You are accountable not only for delivering production\-ready solutions, but for ensuring they are reliable, secure, performant, and aligned with enterprise governance and AI\-readiness requirements.
 



 You serve as a technical leader within the engineering team who guides architectural decisions within your domain, influencing best practices, and mentoring engineers while remaining deeply hands\-on in building and optimizing data products that power Analytics, AI, and Automation across global business functions.
 



 You partner closely with Global IT, Business Stakeholders, Data Governance, Security \& Privacy, AI \& Automation Engineers, Data Analysts, Marketing Technology, and FinOps to translate evolving business needs into scalable, compliant, and cost\-efficient platform capabilities.
 



 You continuously apply modern DevOps and GenAI\-assisted engineering practices to enhance solution quality, accelerate delivery, and strengthen the long\-term resilience of the platform.

* Lead ingestion and integration efforts across enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and various specialized global technology data sources.
* Establish and enforce data engineering and data security design patterns, coding standards, and deployment best practices.
* Partner with Global IT, Data Governance, Security \& Privacy, AI \& Automation Engineers, Data Analysts, FinOps, and business stakeholders to influence scalable and secure solution design.
* Serve as technical lead during development and deployment cycles, guiding implementation decisions and troubleshooting complex issues.
* Act as escalation point for high\-impact production incidents within assigned domains and participate in a responsive on\-call rotation process to resolve critical production issues as needed upholding data contract SLAs.
* Drive improvements in data quality, observability instrumentation, and reliability engineering practices.
* Apply and champion GenAI\-assisted engineering workflows to improve development velocity, automated testing, and data product quality.
* Continuously improve platform and data pipeline performance, cost efficiency, and scalability.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS:** 




**Education:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering or a closely related field with 2\+ years of relevant experience OR Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or closely related technical field and 3 years of progressively responsible data and/or software engineering experience OR 7\+ years of relevant experience without a degree.

* Strong Snowflake expertise.

* Ability to provide written, visual, and oral interpretation of highly specialized technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Basic understanding of GDPR, CCPA, or data privacy principles preferred.
* Experience enabling AI/GenAI workloads at scale preferred.
* Experience partnering with FinOps on cost optimization preferred.

**Location:**

 office.

description:
**Job Title:** 
 AEP Developer
 



 Experience Range : 6 to 8 years
 



 WalkIn Location : Chennai
 



 DATE : 19\-SEP\-26
 



**Job Requirements** 




 We are looking for an experienced Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Developer/Lead who can design, build, and optimize end‑to‑end customer data solutions using Adobe’s Real‑Time CDP, Data Collection, Journey Optimizer, and associated Adobe Experience Cloud products. The role requires strong expertise in data modelling, schema design, identity management, and integration across channels.
 



**Key Responsibilities\*** 




**Platform Development \& Implementation** 



* Design and implement AEP XDM schemas, datasets, identities, mixins, and dataflows.
* Configure and optimize RT\-CDP, AEP Data Collection, and Tags/Launch for data capture.
* Build and manage source and destination connectors, including batch and streaming integrations.
* Implement AEP Segmentation and configure activation workflows to downstream systems.
* Develop and optimize AJO (Adobe Journey Optimizer) journeys, rules, templates, and triggers (if part of scope).



**Data Engineering \& Architecture** 



* Work with cross‑functional teams to identify data requirements and map source systems to XDM.
* Manage data ingestion using APIs, ETL pipelines, and event forwarding where applicable.
* Ensure data quality, identity stitching, deduplication, and governance compliance.

title: Pre-Silicon Firmware & Platform Software Engineer (IRT510ST RM 4410)
description:
**Position: Pre\-Silicon Firmware \& Platform Software Engineer (IRT510ST RM 4410\)**
**Work mode : Hybrid**
**Education : B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, or related discipline**
**Position Summary**
 Enable early firmware, BSP, driver, and software development on the virtual platform before silicon availability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* AI Infrastructure System Modelling Support: Define software\-visible behavior of virtualized hardware, and support integration of virtual devices and system components.
* Customer Software / Firmware Enablement: Develop BSP and low\-level firmware; develop device drivers and initialization sequences; enable boot flows on the virtual platform; develop software for PCIe/CXL/connectivity and memory components; execute software workloads against the VDK/VP; debug hardware/software interaction issues.


**Required Technical Skills**
* 5–10\+ years of embedded / pre\-silicon software experience.
* C/C\+\+.
* Embedded Linux.
* BSP development and device drivers.
* Firmware development.
* PCIe/CXL.
* SoC architecture.
* Virtual platforms.


**Preferred Skills**
* SystemC/TLM.
* Synopsys Virtualizer.
* UCIe.
* Bootloader development.
* ARM/RISC\-V.
* AI accelerator software stack.
* Python.


**Project Experience** 
**: Hands\-on BSP/firmware/driver development against a virtual platform or VDK ahead of silicon availability.**
**Soft Skills**
* Comfort operating in ambiguity before silicon/hardware is final.
* Strong hardware/software debugging mindset and close collaboration with the platform architecture team.


**Good to Have**
* Experience bringing up boot flows entirely on a virtual platform (Virtualizer/VDK) before first silicon.
* ARM or RISC\-V bootloader development experience.


**Expected Deliverables**
* BSP, low\-level firmware, and device drivers running on the virtual platform.
* Validated boot flows and software workloads executed against the VDK/VP.
* Documented hardware/software interaction issues and debug findings.


**Growth Path**
* Progress into Senior Pre\-Silicon Software Lead or Platform Software Architect roles

title: Senior Software Engineer, SaaS Control Plane IRC303076
description:
**Description**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most
   

  

 forward\-thinking companies. We promise a people\-first culture of caring, flexibility, and personal and professional growth.
   

  

 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company and trusted digital engineering partner, promises a people\-first culture of caring,
   

  

 flexibility, and growth. GlobalLogic invites passionate problem solvers to join us in engineering impact through intelligent
   

  

 products, platforms, and services.
   

  

 GlobalLogic is the digital engineering company that promises a people\-first culture of professional and personal growth. We seek
   

  

 passionate problem solvers who are energized by meaningful challenges. Using the power of design and complex software
   

  

 engineering, we create a better future for people and the planet.
   

  

 Our customer is a global pioneer in media technology, delivering industry\-leading video and audio editing solutions to premier entertainment brands and major hollywood studios. Recognized with accolades ranging from Oscars and Grammys to NAB’s Product of the Year, they continue to set the standard for digital media innovation.
   

  

 For over 15 years, the strategic partnership with GlobalLogic has been instrumental for our customer in driving product development across their core platforms in audiovideo editing and media workflow management. Our customer is expanding its collaboration with GlobalLogic to engineer next\-generation, cloud\-based, and AI\-augmented media lifecycle management solutions. This effort is supported by a growing team of specialized engineering talent in India dedicated to accelerating Client’s cloud and AI roadmap.
   

  

**Requirements**
 We are looking for a talented CloudPython Developer to be a member of the Media Products development team, which creates and maintains several products in our Media product portfolio on audiovideo editing, media workflow management areas.
   

  

 You should have
   

  

 8\+ years building backend services for cloud\-based SaaS products.
   

  

 Solid AWS fundamentals: IAM, ECS/EKS, RDS/Aurora, SQS/SNS, Secrets Manager, and CloudWatch.
   

  

 Experience with multi\-tenant systems and the patterns that keep tenants isolated and operations manageable.
   

  

 Comfort working in Python or Go (or both) and writing well\-tested service code.
   

  

 Familiarity with async/event\-driven patterns and why they matter in a distributed control plane.
   

  

 A habits of writing things down — ADRs, runbooks, API contracts.
   

  

 ice to have: Kubernetes operator patterns, ArgoCD or similar GitOps tooling, Temporal or Step Functions for workflow orchestration, or experience onboarding enterprise customers with SSO and SCIM.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Software Engineer, SaaS Control Plane
   

  

 We’re building the control plane that manages every tenant, user, and resource across our SaaS platform. You’ll work on the core services that handle customer onboarding, principal lifecycle, entitlements, and the operational workflows that keep the platform running reliably at scale.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 – Build and maintain control plane services: tenant provisioning, principal management (users, service accounts, API keys), and entitlement/subscription enforcement.
   

  

 – Own the onboarding flow end to end — from account creation and identity setup through resource provisioning and first\-use readiness.
   

  

 – Design APIs and async workflows that coordinate across services reliably, handling failure and retries gracefully.
   

  

 – Instrument services for observability: structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing so on\-call is tractable.
   

  

 – Partner with the auth, database, and platform teams to deliver features that are consistent and secure across the full stack.
   

  

 – Contribute to operational health: runbooks, alerts, and iterative improvements to reduce toil.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Sr. Terraform Developer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Terraform Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing our cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with a primary focus on Terraform. This role requires a deep understanding of cloud platforms, automation, and DevOps methodologies to ensure scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Exp\- 6\+** 




**Location\- Bangalore(hybrid)** 




**Immediate joiners only** 




  





**Mandate skill\- AWS, Azure, Terraform Coding, Ci/CD, AI exp** 




  





 Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure using Terraform across various cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
 



 Implement and manage continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for infrastructure code, ensuring automated testing and deployment.
 



 Collaborate closely with development, operations, and security teams to define infrastructure requirements and integrate solutions seamlessly.
 



 Automate operational tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
 



 Ensure infrastructure adheres to security best practices, compliance standards, and organizational policies.
 



 Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues, identifying root causes and implementing preventative measures.
 



 Participate in code reviews for Terraform configurations and other infrastructure\-related code to maintain high quality and consistency.
 



 Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for infrastructure designs, configurations, and operational procedures.
 



 Stay current with emerging cloud technologies, Terraform features, and industry best practices, recommending and implementing improvements.
 



 Manage and optimize cloud resource utilization and costs.

 • Hands\-on experience with microservices, API\-first architectures, caching strategies, and transaction integrity (idempotency, dedup).
 



 • Solid grasp of cloud\-native design (AWS preferred), containers/K8s, CI/CD, and infrastructure reliability
 



 . • Strong understanding of security for web and APIs (authentication, authorization, secrets, data protection).
 



 • Excellent system design skills and ability to influence architecture across teams.
 



 • Background in BFSI, payments, or cybersecurity platforms preferred

title: WordPress Developer
description:
**Purpose**  

The WordPress Developer, Site Integrity is responsible for the ongoing health of every live client site across the fleet. This is a proactive role: the team reviews sites on a regular cadence to catch and fix issues before a client ever sees them, rather than waiting on client\-reported tickets. The role handles direct backend and visual fixes (plugin conflicts, plugin alternatives, layout/design drift), and triages security and WordPress\-core issues for DevOps to action. Every review is logged on a shared dashboard so the team's activity is fully traceable, giving the org a clear accountability trail in the event of a client escalation.  

  

**Scope**  

Applies to WordPress Developers on the CWD Site Integrity team, covering all live client sites post\-launch across the fleet (Signature 1\.0 and 2\.0 builds), regardless of which POD originally built the site. Pre\-launch readiness and post\-launch/migration QA are owned by the Launch team.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

**1\. Proactive Fleet Monitoring \& Auditing*** Conduct scheduled, recurring reviews of assigned site segments (not just reactive to tickets).
* Check for broken links, layout breaks, plugin conflicts, outdated plugins/themes, expired SSL/domains, and console/PHP errors.
* Monitor uptime, error logs, and security scanner alerts (e.g. Sucuri) for assigned sites.
* Run 404/broken\-link monitoring through the existing UptimeRobot / Percy / Lumar stack rather than ad hoc manual checks, so the team works off one shared source of truth with other teams already using that stack.
* Log every scan in the Site Integrity Dashboard the moment it's completed, whether or not an issue was found.

**2\. SEO \& Technical Configuration Audits*** Run a recurring technical SEO pass per site: RankMath configuration, meta titles/descriptions, H1 hierarchy, robots.txt, and llm.txt.
* Extend the existing 404\-detection agent spec to also flag no\-index/crawl discrepancies (pages unintentionally no\-indexed, or indexed pages that should be excluded).
* Log SEO/crawl findings the same way as other audits — dashboard entry plus a SiteFlow ticket for anything requiring a fix.
* Escalate ambiguous SEO decisions (e.g. intentional vs. accidental no\-index) to the CWD Manager rather than resolving unilaterally.

**3\. Issue Diagnosis \& Direct Resolution*** Diagnose and fix backend issues within the team's authority: plugin conflicts, broken integrations, theme errors.
* Research and implement plugin alternatives when a plugin is deprecated, unsupported, or conflicting with other tools.
* Fix visual/front\-end issues: responsive breakpoints, broken elements, spacing or design drift from the approved comp.
* Prioritize fixes so client\-facing issues are resolved before the client notices or reports them.

**4\. Plugin \& Theme Maintenance*** Apply routine theme and plugin updates (functionality/compatibility, non\-security) on a regular cadence per site.
* Test updates on staging before pushing to production to avoid breaking changes.
* Maintain a current plugin inventory per site/segment; flag redundant or high\-risk plugins.
* Support migration of legacy Beaver Builder / Classic Editor sites toward the current Signature 2\.0 standard where flagged.

**5\. Security \& Core Update Triage*** Proactively monitor for outstanding WordPress core/plugin vulnerabilities and pending updates across the fleet, not just what surfaces incidentally during a scan.
* Raise a ticket to DevOps for any security patching or WordPress core update; this team triages and hands off, it does not apply core/security fixes directly.
* Assign every flagged vulnerability or pending update a named owner and a tracked ticket status until DevOps closes it, closing the gap where issues fall between Dev and DevOps.
* Verify security scanner and 2FA coverage on assigned sites; flag gaps to DevOps.
* Verify backup integrity and restore points on a regular schedule; escalate failures to DevOps.

**6\. Performance \& Quality*** Monitor Core Web Vitals / PageSpeed scores; flag and fix degradation within the team's scope.
* Run periodic cross\-browser and cross\-device checks on assigned sites.
* Feed recurring defect patterns back to the CWD Manager for process/SOP improvement.

**7\. Tracking, Documentation \& Accountability*** Log every site review in the Site Integrity Dashboard: site, date/time, reviewer, findings, action taken, and DevOps escalation status.
* Treat the dashboard as the system of record for “was this site checked and when” across fleet scans and SEO/crawl audits.
* Log all findings and fixes as SiteFlow tickets, cross\-referenced with the matching dashboard entry.
* Keep an audit trail per site so recurring issues are visible across review cycles.
* Escalate client\-facing or scope\-ambiguous issues to the CWD Manager / OB per protocol.

**8\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** Raise security and WordPress core update issues to DevOps and track them through to resolution.
* Coordinate with OBs (Onboarding Specialists) when a fix requires client communication, approval, or content input.
* Coordinate with the Design team on visual fixes that need comp\-level reference.
* Support the Launch team on post\-launch monitoring handoff (first 7–14 days after go\-live).
* Surface plugin\-risk or legacy\-site findings to the Tech Team Lead for fleet\-wide visibility.

**9\. Renewal\-Client Scope Exceptions (Governance)*** Follow a defined SOP for evaluating requests from renewal clients that fall outside standard maintenance scope, rather than each developer making an independent scope call.
* Route any renewal\-client scope\-exception request to the designated single point of contact (SPOC — TBD, likely the CWD Manager) for a decision.
* Log the request and the SPOC's decision so scope exceptions are consistent and auditable across the team.

**Tools \& Systems**  

WordPress (Gutenberg) — block\-based development  

Astra \+ Spectra Pro — theme and block framework  

MyAdvice Framework — proprietary plugin and feature set  

SiteFlow — ticketing, issue logging, and QA checklists  

Site Integrity Dashboard (proposed) — logs scan activity, fix status, and DevOps escalation trail per site; tool TBD  

UptimeRobot / Percy / Lumar — existing monitoring stack for uptime, visual regression, and 404/broken\-link detection  

RankMath — SEO configuration and technical audit  

DevOps escalation channel/ticketing — for security and WordPress core update hand\-off  

Staging environments for pre\-production testing  

Google Chat — team communication  

  

**Ideal Qualifications**  

2\+ years experience building or maintaining WordPress websites on modern block themes.  

Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across HTML, CSS, basic PHP/JS, and Gutenberg architecture.  

Working knowledge of the plugin ecosystem, including how to vet and select alternatives.  

Working knowledge of technical SEO fundamentals (RankMath, meta/H1 structure, robots.txt, indexing behavior).  

Comfortable working within a structured, dashboard\-logged workflow and triaging (rather than personally resolving) security/core issues.  

Comfortable managing a high volume of sites independently with a proactive, checklist\-driven approach.  

Detail\-oriented, with an eye for visual and functional accuracy across many sites at once.  

  

**MyAdvice***"We are going to relentlessly chase perfection, knowing full well we will not catch it, because nothing is perfect. But we are going to relentlessly chase it, because in the process, we will catch excellence.”* — Vince Lombardi  

  

MyAdvice helps medical, dental, and legal practices grow more efficiently. Our Success Center brings marketing, automation, and business insights into one platform so clients can convert more opportunities, improve their operations, and generate measurable returns on their investment.  

  

We’ve spent more than 20 years evolving alongside the practices we serve, from our roots in digital marketing to a broader platform focused on sustainable business growth. We’re building a company for the next stage of that journey, and we’re looking for people who want to help shape it.  

  

Our culture is grounded in grit, accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement. We set ambitious goals, speak honestly about what’s working and what isn’t, and expect people to take ownership of outcomes. In return, you’ll have room to contribute ideas, develop your skills, and make a visible impact on our clients and our company.  

  

We also believe stronger teams are built from different perspectives and experiences. If the role interests you but you don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. We care about what you’ve accomplished, how you think, and your willingness to learn.

 Improve Core Web Vitals, including LCP, CLS, and INP, across desktop and mobile.

 Deliver fast, stable, and technically clean websites.
 



  





**SEO and Technical Setup** 




 Implement SEO friendly page structure, headings, metadata, image alt text, internal linking, canonical URLs, and schema markup.

 Build polished layouts using Elementor or similar page builders.
 



 Maintain consistent spacing, typography, alignment, and responsiveness across all screen sizes.
 



 Manage plugin updates, backups, site health, layout issues, plugin conflicts, DNS, hosting, SSL, and domain related tasks when required.

 WordPress, Elementor, HTML, CSS, basic JavaScript, responsive design, speed optimisation, SEO friendly development, plugin integrations, lead capture forms, schema markup, and GEO fundamentals.
 



 Experience with ACF, WooCommerce, GTM, GA4, HubSpot CRM, Cloudflare, CDN configuration, UI and UX, B2B websites, and entity SEO will be an advantage.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




 You think beyond design and ask, “Will this page convert?”
 



 You are proactive, detail oriented, reliable, and comfortable working in a fast moving startup environment.
 



 You have 2 to 4 or more years of relevant practical experience. A strong portfolio and proven website results matter more than years alone.

 Please share your resume, portfolio or live website links, examples of relevant WordPress work, current availability, expected monthly salary or hourly rate, and a short note on how you approach website speed and conversion optimisation.

title: Global IT Software Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As an IT Software Engineer Manager you will be a core developer on INFOex, BCG's custom\-built case team data management platform and one of the most business\-critical applications in the Digital Collaboration portfolio. INFOex combines a bespoke full stack application estate with native Microsoft 365 capability to ensure that case team folders and data adhere to our strict internal and external regulatory requirements, guaranteeing to our clients that we manage their information safely and responsibly throughout the case team lifecycle. You will build and maintain that platform: designing and developing features from inception to production, and keeping them dependable for the case teams and office staff who use them every day.
   

  

 The work is genuinely full stack. On any given sprint you may be extending the .NET services and APIs behind INFOex, working in the React frontends, modelling data in Azure SQL and Dataverse, building or refactoring a Power App and the Power Automate flows around it, or wiring provisioning and lifecycle logic against the Microsoft Graph API for SharePoint and Teams. INFOex sits alongside BCG's information protection tooling, so you will also work with Microsoft Purview capabilities such as sensitivity labelling, retention and data lifecycle policies, so that what the platform provisions stays compliant by design rather than by manual intervention.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on development role. You will spend the majority of your time writing clean, modular, reusable and thoroughly tested code, and reviewing the code of others. You will work closely with the Product Owner to turn an evolving risk and compliance agenda into well\-scoped stories and workable solutions, contribute to technical design discussions alongside the squad's senior engineers and the portfolio architects, and take features through to release yourself. You are expected to propose solutions proactively rather than wait for a specification.
   

  

 You will share in the day\-to\-day running of the platform. That covers the CI/CD pipelines and quality gates our releases pass through, correct handling of secrets and access, the vulnerability findings and access reviews assigned to the squad, and the support escalations that reach us from users or vendors. Because the data INFOex handles is client confidential, engineering rigour and a security\-first instinct matter here more than raw delivery speed. Over time you will also mentor junior and vendor engineers and take a growing role in guiding technical decisions within the squad.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* At least 8 years of full stack software engineering experience, including work on an enterprise product with a live user base
* At least 4 years of hands\-on engineering within Microsoft Power Platform — Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse — including its CI/CD and Azure DevOps approach; experience with custom plugins is an advantage
* Languages and frameworks: C\# / .NET and Python, and confidence in a modern JavaScript or TypeScript frontend codebase such as React
* Solid Azure engineering across App Services, Storage, Key Vault and Azure SQL, and the identity fundamentals that bind them together
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 and the Microsoft Graph API, particularly SharePoint Online and Teams provisioning, permissioning and lifecycle management
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview or comparable information protection tooling — sensitivity labels, retention policies and data lifecycle — is a strong advantage
* Experience delivering compliance\-driven or data protection products in a regulated or client\-confidential setting is preferred
* Experience in agile processes, particularly Scrum methodology, and the ability to understand requirements and proactively propose software solutions
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science engineering or technology preferred
* Microsoft PL\-900 is a must; AZ\-900 and SC\-900 are preferred
* Excellent written and spoken English, and the flexibility to collaborate with colleagues across European, American and Asian time zones


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will sit in the INFOex squad and report into the Software Engineering Chapter within the Digital Collaboration portfolio. Day to day you will work with the Product Owner, the squad's engineers and QA, and the vendor partners who support the platform. Beyond the squad you will work with our Collab Security and Sustaining Engineering teams to keep the platform protected and serviceable, with the portfolio and enterprise architects on technical design, and with our Infrastructure and IT Service organisations on changes that cross into their estate.
   

  

 You will also collaborate with the wider Risk Product Portfolio, with Legal, Risk and Information Security colleagues who set the requirements INFOex has to satisfy, and with the case teams and office staff who rely on the platform every day and who are the ultimate judge of whether what we build works.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You're Good At**
* Building full stack applications end to end — backend services and APIs, a modern web frontend, and the data model underneath — and keeping the code clean, modular, testable and maintainable
* Developing solutions within Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse, including custom plugins and the application lifecycle management around them
* Implementing role\-based security and least\-privilege access patterns for sensitive client data
* Integrating with Microsoft 365 through the Graph API — SharePoint site and library provisioning, Teams lifecycle, permissions and archival
* Working with information protection and compliance capability, including Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, retention and data lifecycle management
* Working confidently with CI/CD: GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines, static analysis and code quality gates, secrets handling through Azure Key Vault, and promotion across development, QA, pre\-production and production
* Supporting a live platform — investigating incidents, fixing defects at the root cause, and closing vulnerability and access\-review findings promptly
* Collaborating to gather and understand requirements, and contributing to the technical design of the product
* Scoping development effort on user stories and giving reliable estimates in an agile environment
* Analysing and resolving technical and product problems, and optimising what you build
* Communicating clearly with non\-technical stakeholders across BCG's global offices, in writing and in person


 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
   

  

 BCG is an E \- Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E\-Verify.

description:
**Overview**
**Developer 2**
**📍 Location:** 
 Kolkata, India \|
 **Hybrid – 2 Days in the Office**
**About The Role**
 The Developer 2 is responsible for the overall performance of the product by applying principles of software engineering to the design, development, maintenance, testing, and evaluation of software. In this role, you will ensure the timely delivery of high\-quality software within release timelines and guidelines.
   

  

 This is a role for a motivated, technically curious engineer who is eager to grow — someone who writes clean, thoughtful code, contributes meaningfully to team processes, and takes pride in building software that works reliably and at scale.
   

  

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
* Develop code based on functional specifications and a thorough understanding of product code; identify refactoring opportunities and architectural improvements while completing logic and algorithm design in alignment with established standards.
* Test code to verify it meets technical specifications and is working as intended before submitting to code review; create and apply automated tests and test principles to software changes, including unit tests.
* Perform moderately complex peer code reviews; read and interpret software requirements to understand their impact on design specifications, contributing data\-driven recommendations for internal process improvements and product documentation.
* Contribute to the implementation of the delivery pipeline including test automation, security, and performance; support adherence to established standards and processes applicable to software development methodology.
* Contribute to team standards and processes — including planning, work estimation, solution demos, and reviews — as applicable to the software development methodology in use across the team.
* Provide troubleshooting support for moderately complex production issues and software code issues to ensure the ongoing stability and reliability of the application.


**Technology Tools You'll Use**
**Programming Languages**
* Java, C/C\+\+, C\#, Objective\-C, Python, JavaScript


**Development Environments**
* Windows, Linux, Open Source Tools \& Platforms


**Build \& Delivery**
* Build Environments, Delivery Pipelines, Continuous Software Delivery


**Testing \& Quality**
* Test Automation Frameworks, Continuous Integration Tools, Software Application Testing Tools \& Methodologies


**Role Essentials**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with 3–6 years of software engineering experience; demonstrated experience with data structures, algorithms, and software design, with practical exposure to continuous software delivery and engineering best practices.
* Experience with one or more general\-purpose programming languages including Java, C/C\+\+, C\#, Objective\-C, Python, or JavaScript, with hands\-on experience working in Windows/Linux development environments using open source tools and platforms.
* Experience with build environments, delivery pipelines, test automation, and continuous integration tools; working knowledge of software application testing tools, methodologies, and process frameworks.
* Good oral and written communication skills that demonstrate a professional demeanor and the ability to interact with others with discretion and tact; good collaboration skills applied successfully within the team as well as with other areas of the organization.
* Good critical thinking and problem\-solving skills; self\-motivated with the ability to manage projects to completion with oversight, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment with strong attention to detail.


**What We'd Like to See**
* Passionate, competitive, and intellectually curious with a demonstrated drive to learn and stay current professionally; a sharp, fast learner with strong technology curiosity and aptitude for emerging tools, platforms, and engineering practices.
* Ability to provide technical and constructive feedback to team members, with a collaborative and growth\-oriented mindset that contributes positively to team dynamics, code quality, and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Experience identifying refactoring opportunities and architectural improvements within existing codebases, with a proactive approach to improving code quality, maintainability, and long\-term scalability across the product.
* Demonstrated ability to make data\-driven recommendations for internal process improvements and product documentation, with a solid understanding of business application context and how coding tasks connect to broader product goals.
* Flexibility to support up to 10% travel for in\-person collaboration, team engagements, or project needs, with an openness to working across distributed teams and time zones as required.

* Lead and participate in production incident response, retrospectives, and systemic fixes.

* Reduce complexity across services, infrastructure, and processes to improve stability and team velocity.
* Provide technical guidance across teams and participate in architectural reviews beyond your immediate domain.

* 12\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production\-grade distributed systems.

* Deep expertise in systems design, including service boundaries, concurrency, data modeling, failure handling, and scalability tradeoffs.
* Production experience supporting machine learning–driven systems (forecasting, recommendations, or similar), with emphasis on serving, pipelines, and infrastructure.
* Expert\-level experience with AWS, including designing, deploying, and operating large\-scale cloud\-native systems.

* Fluency with modern AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and comfort working in “vibe coding”–style workflows that favor fast iteration, tight feedback loops, and continuous refactoring.
* Proficiency in one or more backend languages commonly used for large\-scale systems (e.g., Python, Java, Go, Scala).
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



**Staff\-Level Expectations** 




 In this role, you are expected to:
 


* Be a prolific, hands\-on contributor who raises the bar through example.
* Own and deeply understand large portions of the codebase and system architecture.
* Simplify complex systems to increase team velocity and reliability.
* Balance technical, analytical, and product constraints to deliver pragmatic solutions.
* Set short\- to medium\-term (6–12 month) technical direction for your domain.
* Influence standards and architectural decisions across teams through credibility and collaboration.
* Ship multiple large services, shared libraries, or major infrastructure improvements.



**Why Join This Team** 



* Build and operate mission\-critical systems that power forecasting and recommendations at scale.
* Work in an environment that values execution, pragmatism, and modern engineering workflows.
* Operate at true Staff scope with real architectural ownership and hands\-on impact.
* Solve hard systems problems with meaningful business outcomes.

 Zeta Global is a data\-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi\-Cola, the Company combines the industry’s 3rd largest proprietary data set (2\.4B\+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth.
 



 Zeta Global is a leading AI\-powered marketing technology company that enables enterprise brands to acquire, grow, and retain customers through intelligent, data\-driven engagement. * Perform source\-to\-target data validation after migration.

* Identify data discrepancies and assist in root\-cause analysis.
* Support application teams in resolving database\-related issues.

* Maintain migration scripts, validation scripts, and database documentation.
* Support SIT, UAT, data verification, and Go\-Live activities as required.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Good knowledge of **PostgreSQL** and/or **MySQL**.
* Strong SQL programming skills.
* Good understanding of relational database concepts.
* Knowledge of:
* Primary Keys / Foreign Keys
* Constraints
* Indexes
* Views
* Functions
* Procedures
* Sequences
* Joins and subqueries
* Aggregate queries
* Knowledge of database normalization and relational data modelling.
* Hands\-on experience in **data migration and data cleansing**.
* Experience with **source\-to\-target data mapping**.
* Ability to develop SQL scripts for data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading.
* Basic understanding of query optimization and database performance.
* Basic Linux knowledge is an advantage.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in an **ERP implementation project**.
* Experience in **legacy database migration**.
* Experience working with large datasets and data reconciliation.
* Exposure to PostgreSQL migration tools, staging databases, or ETL processes.
* Experience working with Functional, Development, Testing, and Data Migration teams.

* Ability to understand business data and ERP processes.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.

**Job Description:** 




 As the Data Scientist, you will play a pivotal role in driving data\-driven decision\-making and advancing our organization's AI and analytical capabilities.  :

* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business objectives and identify opportunities for leveraging data to achieve strategic goals.
* Develop and execute a data science roadmap, ensuring alignment with overall business and technology strategies.
* Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data science.



**Advanced Analytics and Statistical Modeling:** 



* Design, develop, and implement advanced machine learning models and statistical algorithms to extract insights and solve complex business problems.
* Apply robust statistical process control (SPC), univariate and multivariate analysis, and both parametric and non\-parametric statistical techniques.
* Conduct hypothesis testing, PCA, Shapiro\-Wilk test, Anderson\-Darling test, Box\-Cox transformation, and other statistical methods to ensure data quality and model validity.
* Work extensively with batch genealogy data and large manufacturing datasets to uncover patterns and optimize operational efficiency.
* Ensure strong statistical analysis support for both normal and non\-normal distributions.



**R Shiny Application Development:** 



* Develop and maintain robust, interactive R Shiny applications to support dynamic data exploration and decision\-making platforms.
* Build scalable and user\-driven front\-end interfaces for real\-time statistical analysis and visualization.
* Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate R Shiny platforms with Redshift and other data sources for seamless analytics delivery.



**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** 



* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, software engineers, and domain experts, to integrate data science solutions into business processes.
* Communicate complex analytical findings to non\-technical stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner.



**Data Governance and Quality:** 



* Establish and enforce data governance standards to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and security of data used for analysis.
* Work with data engineering teams to enhance data quality and integrity throughout the data lifecycle.



**Project Management:** 



* Oversee the end\-to\-end execution of data science projects, ensuring timelines, budgets, and deliverables are met.
* Provide regular project updates to stakeholders and manage expectations effectively.



  





**Technical Expertise:** 



* Provide technical guidance and execution for the latest GenAI technologies, including but not limited to LLM/SLM/VLM and Multi\-modal AI Algorithms. Leverage Transformers for complex natural language processing\-based tasks.
* Lead the development of deep learning technologies like computer vision for image processing, OCR/IDP, object detection and tracking, segmentation, Image generation, Convolutional Neural Networks, Capsule Networks, etc
* Development of core Machine Learning algorithms like time series analysis with Neural ODEs; Variational Autoencoders for Image Generation and anomaly detection;
* Provide oversight for core deep learning algorithms like Neural Architecture Search for optimization and Graph Neural Networks for molecular structures.



**Qualifications:** 



* 3\+ years of experience in developing and deploying R Shiny applications for real\-time analytics and statistical platforms.
* In\-depth experience with SPC, hypothesis testing, PCA, Shapiro\-Wilk test, Anderson\-Darling test, Box\-Cox transformation, and batch genealogy analysis.
* Experience in developing statistical solutions for both normal and non\-normal distributions and applying both univariate and multivariate techniques.
* Experience with GenAI, Agentic AI, LLM Training, and LLM\-driven workflow development. Knowledge of large multi\-modal models is a must.
* Experience in MLOps, Statistical Modeling, and Data Visualization.
* Must have experience with the development and implementation of various core Machine Learning algorithms mentioned above.
* Must have hands\-on experience with Deep Learning technologies for computer vision and image processing, as well as core neural network applications like optimization.
* Experience in developing ML, AI, and Data Science solutions and putting solutions in production, with proficiency in Data Engineering, is desirable.
* Experience in the development and implementation of scalable and efficient data pipelines using AWS services such as SageMaker, S3, Glue, and/or Redshift.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Experience with big data technologies and cloud platforms is a plus.
