title: Global IT Software Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As an IT Software Engineer Manager you will be a core developer on INFOex, BCG's custom\-built case team data management platform and one of the most business\-critical applications in the Digital Collaboration portfolio. INFOex combines a bespoke full stack application estate with native Microsoft 365 capability to ensure that case team folders and data adhere to our strict internal and external regulatory requirements, guaranteeing to our clients that we manage their information safely and responsibly throughout the case team lifecycle. You will build and maintain that platform: designing and developing features from inception to production, and keeping them dependable for the case teams and office staff who use them every day.


The work is genuinely full stack. On any given sprint you may be extending the .NET services and APIs behind INFOex, working in the React frontends, modelling data in Azure SQL and Dataverse, building or refactoring a Power App and the Power Automate flows around it, or wiring provisioning and lifecycle logic against the Microsoft Graph API for SharePoint and Teams. INFOex sits alongside BCG's information protection tooling, so you will also work with Microsoft Purview capabilities such as sensitivity labelling, retention and data lifecycle policies, so that what the platform provisions stays compliant by design rather than by manual intervention.


This is a hands\-on development role. You will spend the majority of your time writing clean, modular, reusable and thoroughly tested code, and reviewing the code of others. You will work closely with the Product Owner to turn an evolving risk and compliance agenda into well\-scoped stories and workable solutions, contribute to technical design discussions alongside the squad's senior engineers and the portfolio architects, and take features through to release yourself. You are expected to propose solutions proactively rather than wait for a specification.


You will share in the day\-to\-day running of the platform. That covers the CI/CD pipelines and quality gates our releases pass through, correct handling of secrets and access, the vulnerability findings and access reviews assigned to the squad, and the support escalations that reach us from users or vendors. Because the data INFOex handles is client confidential, engineering rigour and a security\-first instinct matter here more than raw delivery speed. Over time you will also mentor junior and vendor engineers and take a growing role in guiding technical decisions within the squad.

  

What You'll Bring

* At least 8 years of full stack software engineering experience, including work on an enterprise product with a live user base
* At least 4 years of hands\-on engineering within Microsoft Power Platform — Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse — including its CI/CD and Azure DevOps approach; experience with custom plugins is an advantage
* Languages and frameworks: C\# / .NET and Python, and confidence in a modern JavaScript or TypeScript frontend codebase such as React
* Solid Azure engineering across App Services, Storage, Key Vault and Azure SQL, and the identity fundamentals that bind them together
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 and the Microsoft Graph API, particularly SharePoint Online and Teams provisioning, permissioning and lifecycle management
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview or comparable information protection tooling — sensitivity labels, retention policies and data lifecycle — is a strong advantage
* Experience delivering compliance\-driven or data protection products in a regulated or client\-confidential setting is preferred
* Experience in agile processes, particularly Scrum methodology, and the ability to understand requirements and proactively propose software solutions
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science engineering or technology preferred
* Microsoft PL\-900 is a must; AZ\-900 and SC\-900 are preferred
* Excellent written and spoken English, and the flexibility to collaborate with colleagues across European, American and Asian time zones

  

Who You'll Work With


You will sit in the INFOex squad and report into the Software Engineering Chapter within the Digital Collaboration portfolio. Day to day you will work with the Product Owner, the squad's engineers and QA, and the vendor partners who support the platform. Beyond the squad you will work with our Collab Security and Sustaining Engineering teams to keep the platform protected and serviceable, with the portfolio and enterprise architects on technical design, and with our Infrastructure and IT Service organisations on changes that cross into their estate.


You will also collaborate with the wider Risk Product Portfolio, with Legal, Risk and Information Security colleagues who set the requirements INFOex has to satisfy, and with the case teams and office staff who rely on the platform every day and who are the ultimate judge of whether what we build works.

  

Additional info

**You're Good At**

* Building full stack applications end to end — backend services and APIs, a modern web frontend, and the data model underneath — and keeping the code clean, modular, testable and maintainable
* Developing solutions within Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse, including custom plugins and the application lifecycle management around them
* Implementing role\-based security and least\-privilege access patterns for sensitive client data
* Integrating with Microsoft 365 through the Graph API — SharePoint site and library provisioning, Teams lifecycle, permissions and archival
* Working with information protection and compliance capability, including Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, retention and data lifecycle management
* Working confidently with CI/CD: GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines, static analysis and code quality gates, secrets handling through Azure Key Vault, and promotion across development, QA, pre\-production and production
* Supporting a live platform — investigating incidents, fixing defects at the root cause, and closing vulnerability and access\-review findings promptly
* Collaborating to gather and understand requirements, and contributing to the technical design of the product
* Scoping development effort on user stories and giving reliable estimates in an agile environment
* Analysing and resolving technical and product problems, and optimising what you build
* Communicating clearly with non\-technical stakeholders across BCG's global offices, in writing and in person

  

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.  

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.  

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Quickbase Developer
description:
**About the Project** 




 We are building a new relationship\-management (CRM\-style) business application on Quickbase for a US\-based client, in their existing Quickbase environment.
 



 Typical functionality includes:
 


* Organizations, locations and contacts
* Activity logging and follow\-up task management
* A multi\-stage pipeline with stage history and conversion reporting
* Recurring data imports from external files, with record matching and reconciliation
* Manager dashboards and KPIs, automated notifications, and role\-based permissions



 You will be part of a small WalkingTree team working directly with the client's business users and leadership.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Design and build Quickbase tables, relationships, fields, forms and reports based on documented requirements
* Build summary, lookup and formula fields to calculate things like last\-activity dates, pipeline aging and roll\-up totals
* Set up Quickbase Pipelines and automations for reminders, alerts and follow\-up task creation
* Import and clean existing business data, including matching records and producing exception reports for anything that doesn't match
* Build repeatable import processes for recurring external data files
* Create dashboards and reports for managers, staff and finance users
* Configure user roles and permissions, including restricting sensitive financial fields
* Join discovery and working sessions with US stakeholders to clarify requirements, demo progress and gather feedback
* Document the data model, automations and admin procedures so the client can maintain the app



**Must\-Have Skills** 



* 2\+ years of hands\-on Quickbase development: tables, relationships, forms, reports and role permissions
* Comfort with Quickbase formula fields, summary and lookup fields
* Working experience with Quickbase Pipelines or automations
* Solid understanding of relational data modeling (parent/child records, avoiding duplicate data)
* Experience importing and cleaning data from Excel/CSV files
* Good spoken and written English and confidence working directly with US business users



**Nice\-to\-Have Skills** 




*We don't expect one person to have all of these. Any of them will make a candidate stronger.* 



* Experience building CRM, sales pipeline or relationship\-management apps (on Quickbase, Salesforce, Zoho, Dynamics or similar)
* Quickbase API, webhooks, JavaScript or code pages
* Email integration with Outlook / Microsoft 365, or email templates within Quickbase
* Data matching and de\-duplication techniques
* Financial reconciliation or commission tracking
* Quickbase certification (Builder or Expert)
* Dashboard and KPI design experience



**What Success Looks Like** 



* First week: review the requirements, get access to the Quickbase environment and start building the core tables and relationships
* By week 2: organizations, locations and contacts working, with the data model confirmed with the team
* By weeks 4–6: pipeline, activity and task features in the client's hands; existing data imported
* Ongoing: import, reconciliation and dashboard features delivered, with the client team able to administer the app themselves



**Why Join** 



* Direct exposure to a US client and their leadership
* Build a complete business application end to end, not just maintenance tickets
* Work with experienced WalkingTree engineers and grow into broader low\-code, integration and AI work

* Advocate for quality and operational excellence, ensuring systems are monitored, tested, and maintained to meet the highest reliability standards.

**You Have**
* Proven experience in system architecture and the design of scalable, high\-availability systems across multiple programming languages and frameworks (Python, Go, Java, C/C\+\+, SQL).
* Deep, hands\-on expertise in Identity and Access Management — including authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2\.x), SCIM\-based provisioning, session management, and multi\-factor enforcement at enterprise scale.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior executives.

* Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, driving initiatives forward while aligning with business objectives.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, driving engineering best practices across teams.
* Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis.
* Fluency in English is required.


**Get To Know Us**
 At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

**Insurity’s Next** 
**Lead Software Engineer**
 We are looking for a Lead Engineer to join the Policy Decisions engineering team in our Noida office. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for an engineer who can move comfortably from product intent and technical design to working code, automated tests, deployment, and production support.

We expect you to be comfortable using tools such as Replit and Claude—or comparable tools—to explore ideas, build prototypes, develop applications, troubleshoot issues, and deploy production\-ready solutions. **Lead Software Engineer** 
**Will Do**

* Translate product and business requirements into clear, scalable technical solutions that fit Policy Decisions and broader Insurity architecture.

* Lead design discussions, technical reviews, code reviews, and solution trade\-off decisions across engineering, product, architecture, UX, QA, and delivery stakeholders.
* Break complex problems into implementable increments and help the team maintain momentum in an evolving product environment.
* Build maintainable, scalable, reusable, operable, and usable software while reducing technical debt and unnecessary complexity.
* Develop automated tests and partner with QA to identify impact, improve coverage, and left\-shift quality.
* Support CI/CD, cloud deployment, environment management, troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and production issue resolution.
* Mentor engineers, provide technical guidance, and raise the team’s standards for design, coding, testing, and documentation.
* Contribute to estimation, planning, technical documentation, delivery forecasting, and communication with stakeholders.


**Who We’re Looking For**
* Recommended: 8\+ years experience
* Demonstrated experience leading the technical delivery of complex software capabilities.
* Strong hands\-on experience with C\#/.NET and Web API development.
* Experience building modern web applications with React or a comparable front\-end framework.
* Strong SQL and relational database skills, including the ability to work with complex business data and troubleshoot data\-related issues.
* Experience designing and deploying applications and services in Azure or a comparable cloud environment.
* Experience with APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and production\-grade application development.
* A track record of making sound design decisions, balancing speed with maintainability, and reducing technical risk.

* Strong understanding of software development practices, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and secure development.
* Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, architects, product managers, QA, UX, and business stakeholders.

In this role, you’ll have the unique opportunity to drive the next generation of construction platform initiatives in a global SaaS infrastructure. You’ll work with our dedicated and talented team spanning Engineering, Product Management, UX and Architects to create and scale the next generation Procore experience on our web platform. You’ll bring your deep experience in Web, Backend, UI/UX, Micro Front\-end and MicroServices to evolve our platform.
   

  

 As a Sr Principal Software Engineer, you will be primarily responsible for establishing the strategic technical direction, creating reference patterns, and will be additionally responsible for actively hands\-on execution of that strategy for one of Procore’s core product areas. This is a great opportunity to use your leadership, interpersonal, and organizational skills to build highly effective systems and practices, foster collaborative relationships, and measure value delivered to our customers.
   

  

 This position reports to the Sr Engineering Director with the opportunity to be located in the Bengaluru office. We’re looking for someone to join our team immediately.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
 At Procore, AI isn’t a specialized tool, it's a core competency. We expect every team member to be AI\-literate, leveraging generative tools and agentic workflows to move faster and work smarter. You won’t just use AI; you’ll be building the agentic future of construction and set the technical direction the rest of engineering follows.
   

  

* Own the multi\-year technical vision and architecture for foundational platform services that power the industry's most complex construction workflows — spanning products, organizations, and modalities (web, mobile, API, and agentic surfaces)
* Set company\-wide architectural direction, standards, and patterns; identify and resolve the highest\-leverage, highest\-ambiguity technical problems across the engineering organization before they become blockers
* Act as the final technical authority on the most consequential design decisions, driving alignment across multiple engineering divisions on distributed systems, platform, data, and AI/agentic architecture
* Serve as a force multiplier: mentor and grow Principal and Staff engineers, cultivate the next generation of senior technical leaders, and raise the engineering bar through architecture reviews, design councils, and technical strategy forums
* Define Procore's approach to AI\-native engineering — from agentic development workflows in the SDLC to production agentic systems in the product — and evangelize adoption across P\&T
* Remain hands\-on where it matters most: prototyping high\-risk/high\-reward bets, unblocking critical initiatives, and writing code and design documents that serve as exemplars for the organization
* Partner directly with the VPs, and product/UX/business executives to shape corporate and product strategy; translate strategic objectives into a coherent, durable technology strategy and hold the organization accountable to it


**What we’re looking for:**
* Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, a related field, or comparable work experience
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience building and operating large\-scale, distributed, full\-stack systems, including 5\+ years operating at Principal level or above with organization\-wide or company\-wide technical scope
* A track record of defining and delivering multi\-year technical strategies that materially changed the trajectory of a business — including platform consolidations, re\-architectures, or new\-category product platforms at scale
* Deep, current expertise across the modern stack (e.g., Ruby on Rails, Go, Java, Node.js, Python; React, TypeScript) with mastery of distributed systems design, resilience, scalability, and operational excellence
* Demonstrated leadership in AI\-native engineering: hands\-on experience architecting agentic AI systems, integrating LLMs into products, and transforming SDLC practices with AI tooling — not just prototyping, but shipping and operating at scale
* Recognized technical authority beyond your immediate organization — evidenced by influence across divisions, industry presence, patents, publications, open\-source leadership, or comparable impact
* Exceptional judgment in navigating ambiguity: the ability to identify the problems that matter most, frame them for executives and engineers alike, and drive decisions that stick
* Executive\-level communication and influence: comfortable presenting technical strategy to the C\-suite and board\-level audiences, aligning stakeholders across the enterprise, and championing a culture of engineering excellence and well\-managed systems

title: Senior OIC and OPA Developer
description:
**About Us**
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
   

  

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI\-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
   

  

 Available Locations
   

  

* Bengaluru, India


**About The Role**
 The Senior OIC and OPA Developer is the definitive technical expert responsible for developing, governing, and standardizing all data movement and orchestration involving the Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud environment. This role designs the most complex and critical integration patterns using Oracle Integration Cloud and Oracle Process Automation ensuring technical solutions adhere to Enterprise Architecture and security standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Complex Integration Design: Architect and develop the most challenging, cross\-functional, and real\-time integration patterns for the Oracle Fusion program using Oracle Integration Cloud.
* Architecture \& Governance: Act as the technical gatekeeper for all Oracle integration and process automation design, ensuring strict adherence to enterprise standards. Define the long\-term technical roadmap for the OIC/OPA platform.
* Technical Development: Personally drive the design and development of technical solutions (Interfaces, Conversions, Orchestrations and Workflows) within OIC, utilizing REST, SOAP, ERP, FTP, Other Application\-specific Standard and Database adapters. Leverage Oracle AI Data (a.k.a Oracle ATP Database) for data staging and integration. Build BIP reports and ATP objects as needed to meet the requirements.
* Security \& Performance: Define and validate the technical security protocols for all endpoints and interfaces (e.g., OAuth, API Gateway configuration), ensuring data transmission is compliant and performant.
* Technical Mentorship: Serve as the top integration expert, providing technical leadership and direction to developers building integrations.


**Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience**
* 10\+ years of direct experience architecting, designing, and governing enterprise\-level integrations for major ERP/SCM/GTM systems.
* Expert\-level, hands\-on knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud including strong familiarity with its various adapters, mapping, and orchestration capabilities.
* Proven experience working directly with a central Enterprise Architecture organization to define and enforce integration standards.
* Deep understanding of SOA, microservices, API management, and security protocols.
* Experience in an organization transitioning to Oracle Cloud Ecosystem.
* Hands\-on experience with other integration tools like GoLang, Boomi, etc.
* Experience setting up/using CI/CD tools like FlexDeploy
* General awareness of built\-in adapter based integrations in various 3rd party softwares.
* Exposure to the Data Center Infrastructure industry
* Relevant professional product/functional certifications (e.g., OIC/OPA, Database)
* Working knowledge of AI Agent Studio for Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications.


**What Makes Cloudflare Special?**
 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
   

  

**Project Galileo** 
 : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers\-\-at no cost.
   

  

**Athenian Project** 
 : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
   

  

**1\.1\.1\.1** 
 : We released 1\.1\.1\.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy\-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use \- it is the first consumer\-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal \- we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
   

  

 Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in\-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
   

  

 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
   

  

 Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
   

  

 Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e\-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107\.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.


As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase as a part of Consumer and community banking technology team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way.

* Ensure engineering best practices: code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, security\-by\-design, and operational readiness.

* Strong working knowledge of Snowflake including loading/unloading patterns and performance considerations.

**Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* Experience with data orchestration frameworks and pipeline automation.
* Experience with data governance concepts (lineage, cataloging, access controls, PII handling) and production operations.
* Exposure to streaming/event\-driven patterns and incremental processing strategies.
* Experience designing reusable data products, frameworks, or platform components used by multiple teams.
* Domain experience in highly regulated environments (risk, audit, compliance, privacy).
* Experience with lakehouse patterns, table formats (e.g., ACID table layers), and data platform modernization programs.
* Experience with cost optimization and FinOps\-style controls for big data workloads.

**ABOUT US**

title: Principal Software Engineer – AI Systems for Engineering Workflows
description:
This role owns the technical vision and execution for applying AI at scale across DevOps and productization workflows, with a mandate to fundamentally improve how software and firmware are built, tested, released, and operated. The position sits at the intersection of AI systems, developer platforms, and operational excellence, driving the design and rollout of intelligent, automated pipelines that move beyond static CI/CD toward predictive, self\-healing, and data\-driven execution. The focus is on replacing high\-cost manual processes with scalable AI\-powered mechanisms, improving end\-to\-end quality and velocity, and enabling reliable delivery across large, multi\-team engineering environments. Success in this role requires operating at platform and ecosystem scale, setting architectural direction, and ensuring AI\-enabled systems are secure, observable, governable, and resilient in long\-lived production environments.  



**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:*** Lead the design and delivery of AI\-enabled solutions for building, test, and release workflows of software products using approved enterprise technologies and enterprise\-ready solution patterns.
* Identify engineering workflows that can be fully or partially offloaded to AI systems, reducing or eliminating repeated manual engineering effort.
* Design and implement scalable AI\-powered solutions in engineering workflows such as build and test triage, failure analysis, flaky test intelligence, debugging assistance, and release decision support.
* Work hands\-on with engineering teams to turn ideas into working solutions that can be rolled out in production.
* Own key initiatives from concept and architecture through development, rollout, validation, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
* Help define technical direction, propose practical architecture improvements, and influence how AI is introduced into critical engineering systems.
* Develop tools, supporting systems, and infrastructure that improve engineering productivity and enable sustainable AI adoption.
* Review technical designs and implementations, provide strong feedback, and mentor junior engineers.
* Establish practical approaches for evaluation, telemetry, monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement of AI\-enabled systems.
* Design solutions that account for operational constraints such as rate limits, retry behavior, error handling, and production supportability.
* Collaborate with internal teams, domain experts, and junior talent to build solutions that can scale across the organization.
* Ensure all automation and intelligence align with Emerson’s reliability, safety, and regulatory commitments
* Act as a key technical leader, shaping the long\-term roadmap for AI driven DevOps transformation across T\&M. • Partner with engineering leaders, architects, and operational teams to drive adoption of intelligent automation and data driven decision\-making.
* Mentor teams on AI/ML fundamentals, emerging practices, and how to leverage automation to enhance product quality and operational performance.
  

**Who You Are:*** You are an application\-focused AI engineering leader who enjoys solving real workflow and engineering problems.
* You are comfortable operating as both an architect and a builder.
* You can take an ambiguous problem, create a practical solution approach, and drive it through execution.
* You understand what it takes to deploy systems at an organizational scale, including rollout, adoption, governance, observability, and long\-term maintainability.
* You work well across teams, influence technical direction, and help raise the capability of the engineers around you.
* You are self\-driven, pragmatic, and able to make sound trade\-offs in evolving situations.
  

**For This Role, You Will Need:*** B.E / B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science / Electronics / Electrical / Instrumentation / Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning / related technical discipline.
* 8\+ years of proven experience in software engineering, systems design, AI application engineering, or related technical roles. Minimum 3\+ years experience developing AI based applications.
* **Hands\-on experience with** retrieval\-augmented generation architectures, workflow automation, evaluation methods, platform integration, agentic systems, cost\-aware AI design, and operationalizing AI\-enabled systems in production, including monitoring, observability, feedback loops, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of AI training fundamentals, including how models are developed, adapted, evaluated, and improved, even if your primary industry experience has been in building and deploying AI\-enabled applications rather than training foundation models directly.
* Strong experience building AI\-enabled applications or workflow solutions in enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of DevOps and modern software delivery systems, including CI/CD pipelines, build and release workflows, automation, observability, and production operational considerations.
* Proven experience designing, deploying, and operating systems or workflow solutions on an organizational scale, including rollout across multiple teams or large engineering groups.
* Strong problem\-solving ability, including diagnosing technical issues and proposing practical, high\-quality solutions.
* Good understanding of enterprise constraints such as governance, approved technologies, security, observability, and production\-readiness.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering teams that have deep domain expertise but limited AI maturity.
  

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:*** Experience applying AI to build systems, test systems, CI/CD workflows, release engineering, software delivery, and engineering productivity workflows.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms, internal developer platforms, or similar shared engineering platforms used to operationalize AI solutions at scale.
* Familiarity with Agile software development practices, CI pipelines, and workflow automation.
* Understanding of NI software tools or related internal engineering ecosystems.
* Exposure to fine\-tuning, model adaptation, data preparation, evaluation pipelines, or other AI training\-related workflows.
* A strong track record of driving large, ambiguous technical initiatives to successful completion.
* Ability to work effectively in a diverse, multi\-cultural engineering environment and communicate well with both engineering teams and management.
**Why This Role Is Important:**

* This role is intended to bring external AI expertise into the organization and apply it in practical, high\-value engineering workflows.
* The focus is not on research alone, but on delivering enterprise\-ready AI systems that save developer time, improve decision\-making, and create reusable internal capability.
* This is a Principal\-level individual contributor role for someone who can influence architecture, build solutions hands\-on, and help scale AI adoption responsibly.

Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. With Phoenix, data can be stored indefinitely with limitless snapshots and flexible retention policies, while at the same time significantly lowering your backup costs. * Ensure timely builds and effectively manage product deployments.

title: Software Development Engineer, RBS Tech
description:
**Description**
 Are you interested in designing and delivering solutions for complex and high impact business problems?
   

  

 Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon’s Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems.
   

  

 We believe in “Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History” value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.
   

  

 At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA.
   

  

 We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business.
   

  

 We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use cutting\-edge technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first\-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.
   

  

 If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us!
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 RBS Tech team puts a high value on work\-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one\-on\-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal \& Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are looking for a sharp, experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE\-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short\-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over\-engineering. You make appropriate trade\-offs, re\-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You take on projects and make software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new team\-mates on how your team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Knowledge of professional software engineering \& best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

title: Senior Software Engineer, Demand Bidder, Ad Serving Platform
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
 
  
 


**Roku is changing how the world watches TV** 

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 


 What does the team work on?
 
  

 Roku's Ad Serving Team builds and operates the real\-time advertising platform that powers all of Roku’s ad monetization across video, display, and native ad formats. Within Ad Serving, the Demand Bidder team owns the high throughput and low latency systems responsible for serving relevant ads for tens of thousands of campaigns through targeting, scoring, bidding, auctions, measurement and more. Every millisecond and every decision carries direct, measurable revenue impact, and the team operates with the high engineering rigor that this demands.
 


  What is the role?
 
  
 



 We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help scale and evolve this platform. Demand Bidder is a large, high\-throughput system driving our next phase of growth. As we onboard a rapid wave of new businesses, we are actively scaling and advancing our architecture — including our pacing engine, scoring/ML engine, and modularizing for agentic development. You'll work alongside a strong team of engineers tackling meaningful technical challenges at scale.
   




 How will I use AI at Roku?
 
  
   

 At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.
   

 We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.
 


  What are the responsibilities of the role?
 * Design, build, and contribute to core components of a large\-scale, real\-time distributed decisioning system with strict latency requirements
* Own features and drive them end\-to\-end in partnership with product and other engineering teams
* Build a working mental model of a highly distributed, complex production system and make meaningful contributions
* Help identify opportunities to evolve the system and tooling over time
* Partner with engineers and applied scientists working at the intersection of distributed systems and statistical/ML\-driven decision\-making
* Help diagnose and resolve subtle, often timing\- or statistics\-related issues in a highly concurrent, multi\-region distributed system
* Communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and collaborate across engineering, product, and business partners
* Be an evangelist for best practices across development, testing, and operations



  
 


 What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
 * 10\+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale, low\-latency distributed systems
* Experience owning features or subsystems through design, build, testing, deployment, and iteration based on production feedback
* Ability to ramp into unfamiliar, complex, large codebases and become productive — you enjoy the “figure it out” part of the job as much as the “build it” part
* Comfort contributing to live, business\-critical systems without compromising uptime or correctness
* Strong command of Java, with a solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, concurrency/multi\-threading, and performance optimization
* Experience with distributed caching, high\-throughput messaging/streaming systems, and SQL/NoSQL datastores
* Comfort operating in cloud infrastructure (GCP or AWS) at scale
* Exposure to statistical, control\-theory, or ML\-driven techniques within production decision\-making systems is a plus
* Real\-time bidding / ad\-tech domain experience is a plus, but experience in adjacent high\-stakes, low\-latency domains (trading systems, ranking/recommendation, matchmaking, risk/fraud systems) is equally valued
* B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* Self\-motivated, critical thinker, comfortable operating with some ambiguity
* Low\-ego, nonpolitical, and genuinely collaborative
* You've used AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in real work — deep prior experience isn't required, curiosity is what matters most



  
 


**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.
 



  
 


**What are some of the benefits?** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**What should I know about Roku's culture?** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
 



 By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

description:
Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Description: Engineer/Senior Engineer/Technical Lead**
**Role Overview:**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Embedded Software Engineer to execute the development of complex embedded systems. This role focuses on the intersection of low\-level hardware abstraction and high\-level applicative software. You will be responsible for the entire software lifecycle, from initial board bring\-up and driver development to implementing robust network stacks and application\-level logic. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in the ARM architecture and the Yocto Project ecosystem.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Platform Initialization: Board bring\-up process for new ARM\-based hardware platforms, including boot\-loader configuration and hardware\-to\-software integration.
* Kernel \& Driver Development: Design, develop, and debug custom Linux device drivers and manage Device Tree configurations to support various hardware peripherals.
* System Integration: Use the Yocto Project to create, maintain, and optimize custom Linux distributions, including recipes, layers, and SDK generation.
* Applicative Software: Develop high\-performance application software in Embedded C, ensuring seamless interaction with the underlying Linux kernel and hardware.
* High\-Speed Interconnects: Implement and optimize communication over PCIe and Ethernet interfaces, including tuning the network stack for reliability and low latency.
* Full Lifecycle development: Perform the software development process from requirements gathering, architecture design to HW\-SW Integration, testing and defect resolution
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support software integration and certification activities.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Languages: Strong, hands\-on expertise in Embedded C
* OS \& Build Systems: Advanced experience with Embedded Linux and Yocto Project, FreeRTOS or bare metal programming
* Architecture: Deep understanding of ARM Cortex\-A/R/M architectures, including memory management units (MMU) and interrupt handling.
* Kernel Space: Proven experience in Device Driver development and working with Device Trees.
* Hardware Interface: Solid experience with Board Bring\-up, UBoot and debugging using JTAG/GDB, Lauterbach
* Protocols: In\-depth knowledge of PCIe and Ethernet protocols, including the Linux TCP/IP network stack.
* Tools: Proficiency with configuration management tools like Git and build tool chain like cmake,


**Desired Skills**
* Security: Familiarity with Secure Boot, TrustZone, and hardware\-level encryption.
* Methodology: Experience working in regulated industries (e.g., Avionics, Automotive) with standards such as DO\-178C or ISO 26262\.
* Scripting: Proficiency in Python or Bash for automation and testing.
* Automation: Experience in python or similar languages


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

**Why Join This Team**

* Build and operate mission\-critical systems that power forecasting and recommendations at scale.
* Work in an environment that values execution, pragmatism, and modern engineering workflows.
* Operate at true Staff scope with real architectural ownership and hands\-on impact.
* Solve hard systems problems with meaningful business outcomes.

Zeta Global is a data\-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi\-Cola, the Company combines the industry's 3rd largest proprietary data set (2\.4B\+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth.

description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Core Platform Team is responsible for the comprehensive management of our operating systems, Azure cloud infrastructure, and container environments. We specialize in the creation, deployment, and maintenance of containers, as well as the automation of daily platform tasks. Our team ensures seamless integration and optimal performance across our technology stack, driving efficiency and innovation in all our operations.
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Description**

**We are seeking a skilled and experienced Red Hat/Linux Administrator to join our dynamic Platform team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Linux administration, container technologies, and scripting. This role involves maintaining, upgrading, and securing our Linux environments, as well as managing Docker containers and writing scripts to automate tasks.**

**Basic Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities:**  

**1\. Red Hat/Linux Administration:**  

**a) Perform day\-to\-day Linux administration tasks, ensuring system stability, performance, and security.**  

**b) Manage OS patching processes, including planning, execution, and troubleshooting.**  

**c) Conduct upgrade and rollback validations to ensure system integrity.**  

**d) Implement quarterly security patch upgrades to maintain compliance and protect against vulnerabilities.**  



**2\. Docker and Container Management:**  

**a) Write Dockerfiles from scratch to create custom Docker images tailored to specific application requirements.**  

**b) Build, manage, and deploy Docker images in various environments.**  

**c) Perform Docker container upgrades and rollbacks, ensuring minimal downtime and service continuity.**  

**d) Understand Docker networking concepts and configure container networks for optimal performance.**  

**e) Debug and resolve Docker\-related issues efficiently, ensuring smooth operation of containerized applications.**  



**3\. Scripting and Automation:**  

**a) Develop and maintain shell scripts to automate system administration tasks and improve efficiency.**  

**b) Write Ansible scripts for configuration management and deployment automation.**  

**c) Utilize Python for advanced scripting needs (is an added advantage).**  



**4\. Lead Responsibilities:**  

**a) Provide technical leadership and mentorship to team members.**  

**b) Drive architectural improvements and best practices for system scalability.**  

**c) Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to align platform roadmap with business goals.**  

**d) Lead incident response and root cause analysis for critical system outages.**  

**e) Oversee complex project deliveries to ensure high\-quality standards.**  



**Qualifications:**  

**1\) B.Tech in Computer Science or a related field with Computer science as one of the core subject**  

**2\) Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.**  

**3\) Strong communication skills and the ability to document processes and procedures clearly.**

  

**Experience:**  

**1\) Overall experience of 8\+ years.**  

**2\) Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in Linux administration.**  

**3\) Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience with Docker or other container technologies.**  

**4\) Minimum 3 \- 4 years of Experience with shell scripting and Ansible automation tools.**

**Preferred Certifications:**  

**Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)**

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

Git ops, kubernetus, cloud, Ansible, Shell scripting

None
**Relocation Provided**
-----------------------

None
**Position Type**
-----------------

Experienced

-------------------------


Yes

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
=================


We are looking for an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** with **7\+ years of software development experience**, strong expertise in **POS and payment systems**, and hands\-on experience developing secure, reliable, and scalable payment applications.


The ideal candidate will have a strong combination of **C/C\+\+ payment/POS development** and **Java/Kotlin\-based Android application development**, with a solid understanding of **ISO 8583, Terminal Management Systems (TMS), payment transaction processing, the Android SDK, and modern Android architecture**.


The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, debugging, and maintaining POS/payment solutions while collaborating closely with product, QA, hardware, and backend teams.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================


We are looking for a **hands\-on Senior Software Engineer** who can work across the complete POS software stack — from **payment transaction processing and ISO 8583 messaging to Android applications, APIs, device integration, and debugging**.


The successful candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of complex technical problems, driving solutions independently, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to deliver **secure, reliable, and high\-performance POS payment solutions**.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Design, develop, and maintain **POS and payment applications** for Android\-based payment terminals.
* Develop and maintain payment\-related components using **Android, C, and C\+\+**.
* Implement and integrate **ISO 8583** message formats and transaction flows.
* Work with **Terminal Management Systems (TMS)** for terminal configuration, application deployment, updates, and management.
* Develop Android applications using **Java and Kotlin**.
* Design robust and maintainable Android applications using **MVVM and Repository architecture**.
* Implement asynchronous operations using **Kotlin Coroutines** and **WorkManager**.
* Develop local data persistence using **SQLite**.
* Integrate backend services using **Retrofit**, **Volley**, and **JSON**.
* Work with Android components including **ViewModel, LiveData, Navigation Component, and Jetpack Compose**.
* Integrate and maintain third\-party libraries and SDKs such as **Firebase, Glide, and Picasso**.
* Develop responsive and user\-friendly POS interfaces following **Material Design and UI/UX best practices**.
* Integrate payment SDKs, device SDKs, and hardware\-related APIs as required.
* Analyse and resolve complex application, transaction, integration, and device\-level issues.
* Perform debugging and root\-cause analysis across application, middleware, and POS/device layers.
* Collaborate with backend teams on API design and payment transaction integration.
* Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.
* Write unit/integration tests and support QA teams in troubleshooting and defect resolution.
* Use **Git** for source\-code management and version control.
* Use **Postman** for API testing, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Work with **Android Studio and Visual Studio** for development and debugging.
* Contribute to technical design, architecture decisions, documentation, and development estimates.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers and provide technical guidance to the development team.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Technical Skills**
=============================

**POS Payment Technologies**
----------------------------

* Strong hands\-on experience in **POS / payment systems**.
* Good understanding of **payment transaction processing and POS transaction flows**.
* Strong knowledge of **ISO 8583** messaging and transaction processing.
* Experience with **Terminal Management Systems (TMS)**.
* Experience working with payment terminals, POS devices, or similar embedded/payment environments.
* Experience with **C and C\+\+** development.

**Android Development**
-----------------------

* Strong experience with **Java and Kotlin**.
* Hands\-on experience with the **Android SDK** and Android application development.
* Strong understanding of **MVVM architecture**.
* Experience with:
* Kotlin Coroutines
* SQLite
* Retrofit
* Volley
* JSON
* Firebase
* Glide
* Picasso
* ViewModel
* LiveData
* Jetpack Compose
* Navigation Component
* Repository Pattern
* WorkManager

**API Integration**
-------------------

* Strong experience with **REST API integration**.
* Experience with **JSON\-based web services**.
* Hands\-on experience using **Postman** for API testing and debugging.
* Understanding of client\-server communication and API error handling.

**Development Tools Technologies**
----------------------------------

* **Android Studio, Visual Studio**
* **Git, Postman**
* **XML, Material Design**
* **Jetpack / Android Architecture Components**

**Software Engineering Skills**
-------------------------------

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent debugging and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Ability to understand and work across **application, payment, API, and device layers**.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming and software design principles.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, reusable, and production\-quality code.
* Experience with the software development lifecycle, code reviews, testing, and release processes.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced product development environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, or a related field**.
* 7\+ years of professional software development experience.
* Previous experience in **payment, banking, fintech, retail, POS, acquiring, or transaction\-processing systems** is highly desirable.
* Experience working with **Android\-based POS/payment terminals** will be an advantage.
* Experience integrating payment, hardware, or device\-specific SDKs is preferred.

**Key Competencies**
====================


POS Payments \| ISO 8583 \| TMS \| C/C\+\+ \| Java \| Kotlin \| Android \| Android SDK \| MVVM \| Coroutines \| Room \| SQLite \| REST APIs \| Retrofit \| Volley \| JSON \| Firebase \| Jetpack Compose \| ViewModel \| LiveData \| Navigation Component \| Repository Pattern \| WorkManager \| Git \| Postman \| Android Studio \| Visual Studio \| XML \| Material Design \| UI/UX \| Debugging

 Lead Engineer SCADA \& EDGE is a cross\-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs.
   

  

 The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.
   

  

 Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance.
   

  

**Job Description**

* Perform requirements engineering for new farm level closed loop EDGE applications and analytics, including quantification and documentation of requirements and design tradeoffs for wind turbine / wind\-farm level applications using Industrial and GEV standard protocols. The goal is to develop scalable, reliable and robust farm level applications for SCADA \& EDGE software platforms working together with Design and Development teams considering system level impact and lifecycle aspects that meet customers’ requirements and quality standards.

 Deploy and follow established process to containerize algorithm as an app and deploy in an actual wind farm in the Renewables EDGE / Other industry standard EDGE OS environment and verify the algorithm performance.
   

  

* Execute routine analyses using vested methods and technologies and/or contributes to technological developments in teams under supervision.
* Contribute to product configuration management, sustaining and customer support. Support product development program, design review discussions and present relevant design details to chief engineers for evaluation and approval.
* Collaborate with other Engineering and Global Research Center teams on new energy system control technology and lead design implementation efforts. The applicant may be called to travel up to 10% of the time to support product validation, product and customer discussions.


**Required Qualifications**
* Master / Bachelor's degree in Controls/ Computer Science Engineering with Renewable Energy Emphasis preferred.
* Experience in software development (C\#, .NET, Python) testing, validation, and deployment.
* Experience of working with dockers and Kubernetes environment
* Experience relevant to wind turbine systems, Industrial SCADA \& EDGE systems and Control system design
* Experience with MATLAB Simulink, C/C\+\+/C\#, Python, GEV Renewables SCADA \& EDGE Software Platforms

description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category


Software Engineering
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


**Software Engineering SMTS, Identity \& Access Management**  



**About the team**  

The Salesforce Enterprise Security Engineering team builds and operates highly scalable, fault\-tolerant, distributed systems that deliver cloud\-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) services across our Enterprise network, public cloud infrastructure, and internal data centers. We provide the core building blocks for identity lifecycle, governance, authentication, authorization and privileged access management that protect customer trust and empower every Salesforce engineer to operate securely, regardless of environment.


We are seeking a full\-stack software engineer with a track record of building modern, secure services and applications following the Software Development Life Cycle and best security development practices. You'll work across the IAM domain, so a solid understanding of identity concepts in the authentication, authorization, and identity governance space is important for this role.  

  



**About the position**  

This is a hands\-on software engineering role with a focus on the IAM domain. You will design and build end\-to\-end capabilities from backend services and APIs to the user\-facing experiences that power identity lifecycle (human/non\-human), access requests, provisioning, entitlement/role management, access certifications, and policy\-driven access decisions at enterprise scale.
  

You will secure the emerging agentic enterprise by designing controls for AI agents and autonomous workloads, including agent identity, privilege, least privilege, just\-in\-time access, time\-bound access, separation of duties, and continuous risk\-based access decisions.


You will also own features through the full development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement. You'll partner across application owners, product management, and governance to translate identity and compliance requirements into intuitive, reliable, and scalable solutions. This work is foundational to advancing Salesforce's Zero Trust architecture, enabling dynamic, real\-time access decisions based on employment status, role change, and device or user trust.  

  



**Responsibilities**  

Design, build, and operate scalable IAM services and APIs spanning identity lifecycle, access requests, entitlement/role management and access certifications.
  

Build privileged access management (PAM) capabilities — credential vaulting/rotation, session control, and secrets management and just\-in\-time (JIT) access flows that grant elevated, time\-bound entitlements and revoke them automatically.
  

Model and secure non\-human/workload identities (NHI) — service accounts, agents, workloads, and machine credentials — including issuance, rotation, and lifecycle governance.
  

Develop full\-stack features, backend services and modern web front\-ends that deliver intuitive self\-service and administrative experiences for IAM.
  

Build and manage containerized workloads with Kubernetes, Docker, and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform); operate services in a full DevOps model (monitor, troubleshoot, continuously improve).
  

Integrate across identity sources, directories, and downstream applications using SCIM, REST, and event\-driven patterns.
  

Partner with governance and compliance teams to embed SoD, least\-privilege, and audit controls (SOX, NIST, SOC 2\) into the platform.
  

Write clean, maintainable, secure code; participate in design and code reviews; and champion secure SDLC practices.
  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across security, infrastructure, product, and engineering to ensure platform integrity and trustworthiness.
  

Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and enablement materials.
  

Design for significant features, mentor junior engineers, and drive technical direction and continuous improvement across the platform.  

  

  



**Required Skills/Experience**

SMTS: 5\+ years of professional software development experience building distributed systems in SaaS, PaaS, or IaaS environments.
  

Full\-stack development proficiency: strong backend skills in Java, Go, and/or Python, plus front\-end experience with modern frameworks (e.g., React).
  

Solid understanding of the IAM domain, identity governance/lifecycle, authentication, authorization, RBAC/entitlement models, privileged access management including just\-in\-time access and common protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, LDAP).
  

Experience designing and consuming REST APIs (JSON/XML, OpenAPI/Swagger) and integrating heterogeneous systems.
  

Strong experience on public cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), including containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform).
  

Hands\-on experience with CI/CD and source control (Git, Jenkins, or equivalent), including secure coding and defensive programming.
  

Solid grasp of DevOps practices, monitoring, and ownership of production systems in high\-availability environments.
  

Strong problem\-solving, debugging, communication, and collaboration skills.
  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience integrating AI/agentic capabilities into IAM workflows or user experiences.
  

Experience with globally distributed teams and large enterprises.
  

Familiarity with commercial IAM platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Okta, CyberArk, Active Directory/EntraID) as a consumer or integrator, not required as a specialty.
