When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Manager, Software Engineering – Data Platform, Hyderabad**  

  

**About Warner Bros.****Discovery :**


Warner Bros. Discovery's Global Technology organization sits at the intersection of technology, entertainment, and everyday utility. Our platform powers experiences across streaming, content delivery, personalization, subscriptions, commerce, and analytics for millions of customers worldwide. As a technology organization, we build scalable, data\-driven products that enable Warner Bros. Discovery's continued growth and support our streaming platforms.


For more information, please visit www.wbd.com

**Meet Our****Team:**


The DICE (Data Insights, Collection \& Engineering) team at Warner Bros. Discovery powers data\-driven experiences across global products like Max, Discovery\+, Sports, Studios, and News. The team builds and operates a scalable, multi\-tenant data ecosystem that enables analytics, real\-time insights, and machine learning use cases across the organization. Positioned at the core of the data journey, the team is responsible for ingesting, processing, and transforming large volumes of client and server\-side data into reliable and high\-quality datasets. Operating at the intersection of data and platform engineering, the team focuses on building robust pipelines, ensuring data quality and governance, and driving innovation in real\-time processing, observability, and modern data infrastructure. The team collaborates closely with product, analytics, and engineering stakeholders to enable data\-driven decision\-making at scale.

 **About the****Role:**


Warner Bros. Discovery is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a small team of 2\-5 engineers delivering critical Data \& Audience Platform capabilities across data processing, self\-service enablement, metadata, reliability, and operational excellence. This is a frontline engineering leadership role for a manager who can create clarity for a small team, drive execution discipline against a clear roadmap, and operate production systems with strong reliability and cost awareness.


The candidate must be well versed in modern data platform concepts, distributed systems, cloud platforms, engineering operations, and enterprise\-grade governance, and must retain enough hands\-on depth to review designs and guide the team’s technical decisions.

**Role Scope**

* Lead a small team of 2\-5 engineers responsible for foundational Data \& Audience Platform capabilities used across analytics, data engineering, business intelligence, operational workflows, and AI/ML enablement.
* Own execution across data collection, batch and streaming data processing, metadata, observability, cost efficiency, and self\-service platform capabilities within the team’s domain.
* Partner closely with engineering, product, program management, analytics, data science, operations engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
 **Roles \& Responsibilities:**

**Engineering Leadership**

* Build a strong engineering team culture focused on ownership, customer impact, reliability, inclusion, and high standards.
* Coach engineers to improve technical judgment, execution quality, stakeholder communication, and operational discipline.
* Hire, develop, and retain engineers on the team, and grow tech leads and emerging technical leaders.
* Regularly engage stakeholders to communicate status, risks, and key decisions for the team’s space.
**Delivery and Execution**

* Own the team’s backlog and delivery roadmap, translating departmental goals into prioritized, well\-scoped work matched to available engineering capacity.
* Modernize platform capabilities across storage, compute, orchestration, ingestion, access, metadata, and self\-service workflows within the team’s scope.
* Partner with peer managers to align priorities across overlapping platform workstreams and reduce duplication of effort.
**Operational Excellence**

* Establish and maintain strong operational practices across owned systems, including SLIs/SLOs, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, incident response, RCAs/COEs, and post\-incident learning.
* Improve alert quality, reduce manual toil, and increase automation across platform operations.
* Drive a culture of proactive reliability engineering, cost\-aware design, and continuous improvement.
**Governance, Metadata, and Data Trust**

* Drive adoption of metadata, lineage, ownership, classification, data quality, access review, and lifecycle management practices.
* Improve the discoverability and trustworthiness of data assets through cataloging, documentation, schema management, and data product standards.
* Partner with governance, privacy, and security stakeholders to embed controls into platform workflows rather than treating them as manual afterthoughts.
**Self\-Service and Developer Experience**

* Deliver initiatives that reduce manual engineering dependency through self\-service onboarding, automated access workflows, reusable templates, and standard platform patterns.
* Improve developer experience for teams building, deploying, operating, and governing data products.
* Apply consistent platform standards that help teams move faster while staying within reliability, privacy, security, and cost guardrails.
**What to Bring:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of professional software or data engineering experience.
* 3\+ years of experience directly managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
* Hands\-on experience building and operating large\-scale data platforms, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure, with a strong understanding of modern data platform concepts such as batch and stream processing, data lakehouse architecture, metadata, governance, access control, orchestration, observability, and cost management.
* Proven ability to lead delivery of technical programs across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong operational excellence mindset, including incident management, monitoring, SLOs, runbooks, RCA/COE practices, and production readiness.
* Experience driving automation, developer productivity, and scalable engineering workflows.
* Sufficient hands\-on depth to review designs and code and make sound technical trade\-offs, without needing to be the deepest expert in every technology.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for leadership and cross\-functional partners.
 **Good to****Have:**

* Experience with large\-scale data platforms using technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Flink, Kafka, Airflow, Apache Iceberg, Spark, Kubernetes, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Experience with metadata, catalog, lineage, governance, and data quality platforms such as DataHub, Unity Catalog, Monte Carlo, or similar tools.
* Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI platform enablement, including governance, observability, model or prompt lifecycle, or data readiness for AI use cases.
* Experience supporting data products, semantic layers, data certification, and self\-service onboarding.
* Experience working in media, streaming, advertising, consumer product, or high\-scale digital platform environments.
* Experience leading and developing a team within a globally distributed organization across India and United States time zones.
**What We Offer:**

* A Great Place to work
* Equal opportunity employer
* Fast track growth opportunities
 **How We Get Things Done…**


This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

**Championing Inclusion at WBD**


Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

title: Senior Structural Engineer, Design Automation
description:
**Job Description:**

The **Senior Structural Engineer, Design Automation** will be based in **Hyderabad, India** . In this position, you will report to **Senior Manager\- Structural Engineering** . In this role, the candidate will contribute to the structural design and development and will be part of the team responsible for structural R\&D activities at Nextpower. The ideal candidate will possess strong structural engineering fundamentals with the ability to perform load calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), develop structural analysis models, and support component testing to ensure products meet applicable performance and design standards prior to release.


The candidate is also expected to have a good understanding of programming and design automation, with the ability to develop and improve engineering calculation tools and workflows. This role will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to integrate structural engineering, product development, testing, and design automation efforts.


Watch “ Culture is our Passion ” to learn more about us.


**We are looking for someone who demonstrates:**

* Passionate drive to innovate and create
* Integrity to the core
* Enthusiastic customer focus
* Consistent interactive teamwork
* Desire for continuous improvement and top performance.

**Here is a glimpse of what you will do:**

* Contribute to the design and development of the next generation of Nextpower tracking products.
* Perform structural design and analysis of tracker components and evaluate their structural behaviour.
* Estimate and evaluate structural loading conditions, including dead, live, wind, snow, and seismic loads.
* Perform wind speed and wind load calculations for structures in accordance with applicable standards, including IS 875 and ASCE 7\.
* Design structures and components for wind and seismic forces, considering both static and dynamic behaviour.
* Perform failure\-mode analysis based on product testing, field observations, and reverse engineering.
* Perform member and connection design, including bolted, welded, and riveted connections, in accordance with applicable standards such as IS 800, IS 875, ASCE, ACI, and AISI.
* Support material testing, component testing, and reliability analysis of steel products.
* Develop, maintain, and improve standardized engineering calculation and design automation tools to support product development, bids, and sales activities.
* Apply programming and automation techniques to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of structural engineering workflows.
* Perform and manage engineering analyses using structural engineering software to solve problems involving structural and mechanical design, finite element analysis, design optimization, fatigue, structural dynamics, kinematics, vibration, and other relevant engineering disciplines.
* Develop and validate analytical and finite element models against test data where applicable.
* Prepare engineering calculations, technical reports, proposals, and technical papers.
* Participate in brainstorming and design\-review sessions with cross\-functional teams to identify and evaluate concepts for future products.
* Develop and maintain engineering best practices that promote innovation, design consistency, and efficient product development.
* Identify and implement continuous\-improvement opportunities to improve the efficiency and quality of the structural design process.

**Here is some of what you will need (required):**

* Master’s Degree or Ph.D. in Structural Engineering with excellent academic record
* (3\-5\) years of experience in structural analysis and engineering software such as Staadpro, SolidWorks, RISA, ETABS, ANSYS, or similar tools
* Strong knowledge of structural dynamics, analysis, and design.
* Experience in the design of structural members, including columns, beams, plates, and girders, as well as connection design in accordance with applicable standards such as IS 800, IS 875, ASCE, ACI, and AISI.
* Strong engineering aptitude and intuition for structural and mechanical failure analysis.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with structural steel, sheet metal, and/or cold\-formed steel sections.
* Experience in wind engineering, wind\-load evaluation, and/or wind testing.
* Experience with programming languages such as Python or MATLAB, with an interest in engineering design automation.
* Working knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks and their potential application to engineering workflows.
* Experience with the Open Sees/Open Sees Py environment is a strong advantage.

**Here are a few of our preferred experiences**

* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Self\-motivated, collaborative, and comfortable working in cross\-functional teams.
* Experience in the renewable energy industry is a plus.
* Experience developing structural engineering calculation tools or automated design workflows is preferred.
* Familiarity with object\-oriented programming and software development practices for engineering applications is a plus.
* Experience with design thinking and strong technical presentation skills is highly desirable

title: AI Model Governance Specialist (Risk)
description:
**Job Summary** 




 The role will be responsible for independently evaluating AI/LLM systems, identifying potential risk vectors, designing robust evaluation frameworks, and establishing controls to support responsible and secure enterprise AI deployment.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Conduct RAG \& GenAI risk assessments across end\-to\-end RAG pipelines, including knowledge\-base ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector retrieval, context grounding, and generation.
* Identify AI/LLM risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, context contamination, retrieval failures, and hallucinations.
* Design and execute LLM evaluation and benchmarking frameworks to assess hallucination rates, toxicity, robustness, model calibration, fairness, and bias.
* Curate golden/reference datasets and design evaluation test cases with reference answers.
* Implement and validate LLM\-as\-a\-Judge evaluation pipelines.
* Establish AI governance and risk mitigation controls covering data preprocessing, pre\-deployment validation gates, and post\-deployment observability.
* Independently inspect, evaluate, and validate AI/LLM model outputs.
* Conduct technical audits of AI/LLM systems and assess model performance against defined evaluation criteria.
* Support the development of enterprise AI control frameworks covering data provenance, model sign\-off, rate\-limiting, and continuous drift monitoring.
* Evaluate automated AI assessment and hallucination detection tooling, including Ragas, TruLens, and DeepEval.



  





**Qualifications** 



* B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science, Quantitative disciplines, or MCA.
* Strong quantitative and/or Computer Science foundation.
* Thorough understanding of AI/ML taxonomy and modern Generative AI workflows.
* Deep understanding of RAG architecture and associated risks, including vector search, embeddings, relevance scoring, and context grounding/grounding boundaries.
* Hands\-on familiarity with reference\-based testing, LLM\-as\-a\-Judge frameworks, red\-teaming fundamentals, and semantic similarity evaluation.



  





**Experience \& Skills** 




  





 9 to 12 years of relevant experience
 



  





 Required Technical Skills:
 


* Strong expertise in Generative AI / GenAI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Strong understanding of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Experience in LLM evaluation, model validation, AI risk assessment, and AI governance.
* Understanding of AI risk vectors including prompt injection, hallucination, data leakage, and retrieval failures.
* Familiarity with enterprise LLM orchestration and deployment platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service, and Vertex AI.



  





 Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills:
 


* Working knowledge of Python for querying APIs, parsing JSON outputs, and independently auditing model evaluation scripts.
* Practical experience with NLP evaluation metrics such as ROUGE, BLEU, BERTScore, and semantic distance metrics.
* Ability to construct enterprise AI control frameworks covering data provenance, model sign\-off, rate\-limiting, and continuous drift monitoring.
* Familiarity with automated hallucination detection and AI evaluation tools such as Ragas, TruLens, and DeepEval.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

**Role** Senior Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer (AWS) **Function** Engineering \& Cloud Infrastructure  

**Reporting to** CTO **Location** Remote (India)  

**About XED**  


XED is a premier global executive education organization established in 2015, committed to empowering senior leaders across the Middle East, Far East, LATAM, and South Asia. We collaborate exclusively with Ivy League universities to design and deliver high\-impact online and hybrid programs in strategy, leadership, entrepreneurship, innovation, digital, and finance. With a focus on immersive learning and technology, XED has empowered over 15,000 senior leaders from Fortune 500 companies and global brands. *XED is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of gender, background, age, or belief.* *Website: http://xedinstitute.org*  

**Role Purpose**  


XED is launching Athena, our compute\-intensive, AI\-powered platform \- built to handle thousands of concurrent users. This hands\-on individual\-contributor role owns the AWS infrastructure end to end — designing, building, and operating it — with a focus on rapid scalability, high availability, fault tolerance, security, and cost efficiency. Athena delivers its AI capabilities through managed third\-party APIs (LLM and embeddings via hosted APIs; real\-time voice and avatar via third\-party providers) rather than self\-hosted models. The core engineering challenge is therefore orchestrating expensive, rate\-limited, latency\-sensitive third\-party services at high concurrency. The ideal candidate is a senior engineer (5\+ years) who can both architect and operate production AWS infrastructure, available to join within two weeks, in a fully remote environment.  

**Detailed Responsibilities**  

* Design, build, and operate end\-to\-end AWS infrastructure (compute, networking, storage, databases, security) for Athena and XED's wider product suite.
* Architect for rapid scalability, high availability, and fault tolerance: multi\-AZ deployments, auto\-scaling, graceful degradation, and disaster recovery.
* Orchestrate high\-concurrency integration with rate\-limited, real\-time third\-party APIs : queuing, backpressure, connection pooling, retries, circuit breakers, and fallbacks.
* Build resilient real\-time media streaming infrastructure (WebSocket / WebRTC, low\-latency edges, media relays) to serve voice and avatar sessions at scale.
* Implement and own infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK) for reproducible, reviewable, auditable provisioning.
* Extend and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines) enabling safe, frequent, low\-risk deployments.
* Establish end\-to\-end observability (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting); lead incident response and post\-incident hardening.
* Own security and compliance posture: IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, and encryption, supporting XED's GDPR data\-processor obligations.
* Drive cost efficiency across both AWS spend and third\-party API usage: right\-sizing, savings plans, and per\-session / per\-call cost instrumentation and controls.
* Manage core AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, ECS/EKS, CloudFront, Route 53\) alongside Athena's stack (Node.js/Next.js, MongoDB, Qdrant).
* Conduct architecture reviews and security audits; track AWS and relevant tooling updates and recommend improvements to leadership.

  

**Educational Qualification \& Certifications**  


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. **AWS certifications are preferred, not mandatory.** Demonstrated experience scaling and operating production systems outweighs certification. The most relevant credentials are the **AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional (DOP\-C02\)** and **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP\-C02\)**; the Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA\-C03\) and Security – Specialty (SCS\-C02\) are also valued.  

**Experience**  


5\+ years of hands\-on experience both designing and operating AWS cloud infrastructure in production. The ideal candidate will have personally scaled a production system to thousands of concurrent users and operated latency\-sensitive, API\-dependent services in production. Strong infrastructure\-as\-code, containerisation, CI/CD, and observability practice is expected. Prior experience in a fully remote engineering team is preferred. ***Early joiners strongly preferred — candidates available to start within two weeks will be prioritised.***  

**Professional Growth \& Career Advancement**  


This role offers a compelling opportunity to architect and own the cloud backbone of a globally operating executive education platform at its defining launch\-and\-scale moment. High performers who demonstrate measurable impact on infrastructure reliability, cost efficiency, and engineering velocity may be considered for senior or lead roles within the Engineering function at XED.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Beacon Platform by CWAN**
=================================


Beacon is a cloud\-native, cross\-asset risk analytics and quantitative development platform used by top\-tier asset managers and banks. It provides a transparent, extensible environment for building, deploying and scaling valuation models, pricing libraries and risk analytics across asset classes — including derivatives, structured products and fixed income. It combines pre\-built financial applications with a flexible developer infrastructure that lets quants and model developers write custom pricing and valuation logic, run scenario analysis, and integrate models directly into front\-office and risk workflows.

**The role**
============

* You will own the reliability of Clearwater's risk and analytics applications in engineering terms — designing and building the automation, tooling and operational architecture that keeps the overnight and intraday pipelines correct and on time for asset managers and insurers who need to see their portfolios each morning.
* This is a senior engineering role on the application layer. The distinction that matters at this level: you are expected to retire classes of failure, not instances of them. When the same problem appears for the third time, we want the engineer who stops patching it and builds the thing that makes it impossible to fail. That work competes for time with the model and feature changes the quant and risk teams are asking for, so you will also need to argue for it in their terms — what the recurring failure is costing them now, and what fixing it properly buys them. Cloud fluency matters because the applications run on AWS and you need to operate them competently there, but you will not be provisioning the infrastructure beneath them.
* You will be based in Mumbai alongside the market data team — a group with front\-office training who partner on the genuinely hard analytics questions, not only on data plumbing. That adjacency is the point of the placement: you will sit with the quant, risk and market data teams and be expected to learn what the systems actually compute. When a curve build fails or an end\-of\-day risk run finishes late, we want engineers who can reason about which clients are affected and what the number means.
* The team is part of a globally distributed platform organisation spanning Mumbai, Tokyo and the US, with US\-based coverage for the London close, so every major market cutoff falls inside a staffed window. You will join and help shape a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation covering the end\-of\-day cycles of multiple regions. We are explicit about this because the three\-region model is what keeps it sustainable — there is no permanent night shift.
* You will have real ownership of the services you support and direct influence over how reliability is engineered into them. You will report to the support lead in Mumbai.

**What you'll do**
==================

**Design and build the tooling layer**
--------------------------------------

* Own the diagnostic tooling strategy — including AI\-assisted tooling — so that establishing whether an issue is infrastructure or market data, and which clients it touches, takes seconds rather than a manual trawl through logs and jobs. Tooling, not documentation alone, is how we intend to get response times down.
* Write and review production\-quality Python that eliminates toil: runbook automation, health checks, self\-service diagnostics and remediation used across the team.
* Design automated recovery and self\-healing for analytics jobs, so a single failed task does not become a missed client deliverable.
* Set the observability standard — design monitoring and alerting around business outcomes (late valuations, missing risk measures, stale prices) rather than host and container metrics, and drive alert noise down so pages are actionable and rare.

**Own production and lead incidents**
-------------------------------------

* Own incident response for client\-impacting issues: command the incident, mitigate, communicate, and run blameless postmortems that end in fixes rather than findings.
* Investigate at the application level — logs, stack traces, job histories and the code itself — to establish root cause, then fix it or hand the development team a diagnosis precise enough to act on.
* Track service commitments and recurring pain: report on timeliness and failure trends, and push through the fixes that retire repeat issues.
* Set the boundary for first\-line infrastructure work — stale hosts, memory pressure, connectivity failures, host loss — so routine cases are remediated locally and deeper platform work escalates cleanly.

**Harden the batch and end\-of\-day architecture**
--------------------------------------------------

* Own and harden large\-scale batch and EOD processing: job orchestration, dependency management, retries, idempotency, backfills and safe reruns.
* Keep the overnight window on schedule — find where time is going across stages and drive the fixes with the development teams.

**Own the data and market data interface**
------------------------------------------

* Support the reference data, market data and timeseries stores behind pricing and risk — schema and index design, replication, retention and query performance in NoSQL and timeseries systems.
* Operate data quality and reconciliation controls with the market data team: completeness checks, stale\-data and anomaly alerting, vendor feed failure handling.
* Debug data\-shaped production problems — a missing fixing, a bad identifier mapping, a holiday calendar difference, a failed download job, a partial vendor file — traced through to the affected downstream analytics.
* Act as a single escalation path with the market data team on front\-office\-facing issues, sharing triage and root cause rather than passing tickets between functions.

**Lead and influence**
----------------------

* Partner with quant developers and risk engineers to make reliability a design input rather than a post\-launch concern.
* Mentor engineers on incident triage, investigation technique and on\-call practice, and set the standards for automation and operational readiness.
* Contribute to production readiness reviews for new services and client onboardings.
* Support client escalations on risk and analytics output, and be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Document architecture, runbooks and failure modes.

**What you'll bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* **7\+ years** in software engineering for a business\-critical platform, with real ownership of services.
* **Strong Python**, plus shell. You must be comfortable reading and debugging application code to find root cause — this role is not runbook execution.
* **Demonstrated troubleshooting depth** — working from a vague client symptom through logs, job histories, data and code to a precise diagnosis.
* **Hands\-on experience operating batch and scheduled workloads at scale**, including workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Step Functions or equivalent).
* **Solid grounding in distributed systems** — you can reason about partial failure, retries, idempotency, consistency, and queue and backpressure behaviour under load.
* **Working knowledge of AWS** — enough to operate applications confidently (compute, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, basic networking) and to tell an infrastructure problem from an application one.
* **Practical NoSQL experience** (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra or similar): data modelling, indexing, replication and performance troubleshooting.
* **Observability in practice** — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry or equivalent — and sensible alert design.
* **On\-call experience with structured escalation and postmortem writing**, and the judgement to lead an incident rather than only participate in one.
* **A general understanding of financial systems and genuine appetite to learn the business.** You should be able to hold a conversation about what a valuation or a risk number is for, and be willing to go deeper.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Degree (B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MSc) in computer science, engineering or a related field.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with timeseries data at scale — storage and partitioning strategies, retention, and query patterns for large historical datasets.
* Experience supporting trading systems, order management systems, risk management systems or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with financial data concepts — instrument reference data, curves and fixings, corporate actions, EOD valuation cycles, VaR and sensitivities.
* Kubernetes and containerised workloads in production, from an operations perspective.
* Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI — enough to make and review changes when the work calls for it.
* Streaming and event\-driven infrastructure (Kafka, Kinesis, MSK) and distributed compute (Spark, EMR, Dask, Ray).
* MongoDB Atlas, Redis / ElastiCache, or managed timeseries and analytical stores (Timestream, ClickHouse, Redshift).
* Working in a regulated financial environment — change management, access controls, audit evidence and client\-facing SLAs.
* Fluency with AI\-assisted development and operations tooling — using LLM\-based agents and assistants to build diagnostics, automate investigation and accelerate delivery.
* Experience mentoring engineers and setting operational standards across a team.

**What will make you stand out**
================================

* A track record of turning a fragile, hand\-held process into a stable service with measurably less manual intervention.
* Experience designing automated recovery, failover and monitoring specifically for analytics or compute\-heavy batch jobs.
* Tooling you built that measurably shortened time\-to\-diagnosis — and a view on where AI\-assisted tooling genuinely helps in an operations context and where it does not.
* The ability to translate a technical failure into client impact, and to be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Curiosity about the domain: engineers who ask what the model is doing and why the number matters build far better reliability into these systems.

If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 UBISOFT is seeking an Intermediate R\&D Engineer to prototype and validate new technologies that improve game testing and quality control. This role focuses on building rapid prototypes and running experiments using GenAI, VLMs (Vision\-Language Models), and AI/ML to explore automation opportunities across QC. You will work closely with the R\&D Manager and cross\-functional partners to translate ideas into measurable experiments, evaluate feasibility, and iterate toward proof\-of\-value prototypes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in software development, automation, and quality control processes within the gaming industry.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
**Job Duties / Responsibilities**
* Build rapid prototypes using GenAI/VLM/ML to address QC and testing pain points.
* Design and execute experiments: define hypotheses, datasets/inputs, evaluation criteria, baselines, and success metrics (accuracy, precision/recall, latency, cost, robustness).
* Implement data pipelines for experiments: data collection, cleaning, labeling support, and dataset versioning (as needed for proofs\-of\-concept).
* Explore and compare approaches and document trade\-offs.
* Integrate prototypes with existing internal tools/test systems at a lightweight level (APIs, CLIs, plugins) to enable user trials and feedback.
* Analyze experiment results, identify failure modes, and iterate quickly based on findings and stakeholder input.

* Learn about CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.


**Core Competencies**
* Eager to Learn: Highly motivated and quick to grasp new concepts.
* Experimental Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity; able to form hypotheses and learn quickly through iteration.

* Analytical Thinking: Interprets results critically; understands bias, variance, and common evaluation pitfalls.
* Collaboration: Works well with technical and non\-technical stakeholders; communicates trade\-offs clearly.
* Adaptability: Keeps pace with rapidly evolving AI/ML tooling and best practices.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Curiosity: Passion for exploring new technologies and their applications.
* Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.
* Adaptability: Willingness to take on new challenges and adapt to changing priorities.

title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Director, Software Engineering
Who is Mastercard?  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

Overview  

Payments Network Technology is seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering teams delivering secure, reliable, and scalable payment\-network capabilities. The role combines people leadership, technology direction, delivery accountability, and cross\-functional partnership.  

Roles and Responsibilities  

* Lead and develop multiple engineering teams, including managers and senior technical leaders.
* Set engineering direction aligned with product priorities, architecture standards, resiliency, security, and operational objectives.
* Own delivery outcomes across a portfolio of services, balancing customer commitments, technical investment, risk, and capacity.
* Build an inclusive, accountable engineering culture through hiring, coaching, succession planning, and career development.
* Partner with Product Management, Architecture, Operations, Security, and dependent programs to resolve priorities and delivery risks.
* Establish measurable standards for quality, automation, release readiness, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Communicate portfolio status, risks, trade\-offs, and decisions to senior leadership.


Essential Skills  

* Experience leading managers and multiple software engineering teams.
* Experience with large\-scale, highly available platforms and modern software engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, APIs, event\-driven systems, cloud\-native delivery, CI/CD, and observability.
* Ability to translate business strategy into executable engineering plans and organizational priorities.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


All About You  

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle.
* Clear communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams.
* Experience managing two or more software development teams.
* Proven experience leading complex technology solutions from concept through design, delivery, and production adoption.
* Experience building resilient, operable solutions, with operational readiness considered from the start of development.
* People\-management experience covering performance management, conflict resolution, coaching, and career development planning.
* Payments or financial\-services domain knowledge is preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

You will combine deep expertise in machine learning, deep learning, Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI solution architecture with solid engineering judgment to translate emerging AI capabilities into scalable, reliable and responsible enterprise solutions.

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Lead AI solution architecture for complex, enterprise\-scale AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, translating business problems into scalable technical architectures and implementation strategies

* Drive experimentation with emerging approaches such as prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning, model adaptation, synthetic data generation and AI agents to improve solution performance
* Architect cloud\-native AI/ML solutions using Azure, GCP and/or AWS, leveraging managed AI services, scalable compute, GPU infrastructure, containerization, APIs and modern deployment patterns
* Define scalable patterns for LLMOps/MLOps, including experimentation, model and prompt versioning, CI/CD, model deployment, observability, evaluation, monitoring and governance
* Research and evaluate emerging AI technologies, foundation models, open\-source frameworks and industry trends, and translate relevant advancements into practical enterprise capabilities
* Establish technical standards, reusable frameworks, reference architectures and engineering best practices that improve the quality and velocity of AI development across teams

* Communicate complex AI concepts, architectural decisions, experimental findings and trade\-offs effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders

The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* 14\+ years of experience in AI/ML, Data Science, or Software Engineering, including 5\+ years in AI solution architecture and technical leadership
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying Generative AI, LLM, RAG, Agentic AI, and NLP\-based solutions at enterprise scale
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), MLOps/LLMOps, vector databases, and modern AI frameworks such as PyTorch and Hugging Face
* Solid expertise in machine learning, deep learning, transformer models, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and AI evaluation frameworks
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams, influence stakeholders, and deliver secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions in enterprise environments


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. title: Power BI Lead
description:
About the Role
 




 We are looking for a Power BI Lead to own the design, development, and governance of our Power BI reporting ecosystem. Our platform ingests data from multiple sources in near real time via Databricks, which feeds Power BI reports delivered to end users through Power BI Embedded. This role requires someone who is technically strong in Power BI end\-to\-end — data modelling, DAX, performance tuning, embedded delivery, and governance — and comfortable working closely with a Databricks\-based data engineering stack.
 



  






 What You'll Do
 



* Own the Power BI architecture and roadmap, including semantic/dimensional models, workspace structure, and governance standards.
* Lead the design and development of complex reports and dashboards, ensuring performance, scalability, and usability.
* Work closely with Databricks engineers to understand upstream data pipelines, near real\-time refresh patterns, and how they impact report design and data model choices.
* Own and optimize Power BI Embedded implementations, including capacity planning, row\-level security (RLS), authentication, and licensing considerations.
* Define and enforce best practices for data modelling (star schema, relationships, measures), DAX optimization, and report performance.
* Troubleshoot complex performance issues — query folding, refresh failures, capacity bottlenecks, DAX inefficiencies — across the Power BI and Databricks layers.
* Partner with Product Owners/Business stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into scalable BI solutions.
* Set up and oversee data quality checks and validation processes for reports, working with engineering to resolve upstream issues.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to other BI developers on the team.
* Own Power BI governance: workspace management, access controls, version control, and deployment pipelines (Power BI deployment pipelines / DevOps).



  






 What We're Looking For
 



* 6–8 years of experience in BI/reporting roles, with deep, hands\-on Power BI expertise (data modelling, DAX, Power Query, RLS, performance tuning).
* Proven experience with Power BI Embedded — capacity management, authentication (service principal/master user), embedding patterns, and licensing.
* Working knowledge of Databricks — understanding how data pipelines, near real\-time ingestion, and Delta tables feed into Power BI, and how to design models/refreshes accordingly.
* Strong understanding of dimensional/semantic modelling principles and best practices.
* Experience with data quality practices — validation, monitoring, and resolving data issues in a reporting context.
* Experience working on a reporting platform, data product, or analytics migration program (e.g., legacy BI tool to Power BI, on\-prem to cloud).
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with data engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders.
* Strong troubleshooting and performance optimization skills across the BI stack.



  






 Good to Have
 



* Experience in patient services, specialty pharmacy, hub operations, or another regulated healthcare domain.
* Familiarity with data governance/compliance considerations relevant to healthcare data (e.g., HIPAA).
* Experience with CI/CD for BI (Power BI deployment pipelines, Azure DevOps, or similar).
* Exposure to other Microsoft Fabric/Azure data services.

Demand for their services is higher than ever and we need experienced people who will grow and succeed with us.


You will take a developer role in our established Digital Solutions team, working with the latest Microsoft PowerBI technologies, helping deliver high quality, bespoke solutions to our clients. The role is a blend of development, operations \& system administration to assist in expanding the deployment of our templated solutions.


  
* Collaborating with a UK\-based team of digital specialists to design, develop, and deploy scalable Power BI reporting solutions.
* Supporting the ongoing enhancement and maintenance of Power BI dashboards and data models aligned with business requirements.
* Developing and maintaining interactive reports and dashboards using Power BI, ensuring high data accuracy and performance optimization.
* Working with various data sources (e.g., SharePoint, SQL, Python script, ArcGIS, APIs) to transform and model data using Power Query and DAX.
* Assisting in the design, development, and delivery of complex, customized reporting solutions, both independently and as part of a team.
* Implementing automated data refresh processes and monitoring data pipelines to support business reporting needs.
* Applying governance best practices, including data security, workspace management, version control, and deployment pipelines.
* Creating and maintaining documentation such as data dictionaries, report specifications, and user guides for Power BI solutions.

**REQUIRED ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND EXPERTISE**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modeling, DAX calculations, and performance optimization.
* Strong experience in building interactive and insightful visualizations using Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.
* Strong understanding of data modeling concepts including relationships, measures, calculated columns, and star schema design.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL (queries, joins, and basic optimization), along with experience in integrating data from multiple sources such as SharePoint Online, APIs, SQL and enterprise systems.
* Experience working with REST APIs and integrating external data into Power BI through connectors and automated workflows. Good to have, if any exposure to ArcGIS integration.
* Familiarity with Power Query (M language) for data transformation, cleansing, and shaping.
* Knowledge of JSON, OData queries, and REST\-based integrations for dynamic data retrieval.
* Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and requirement translation skills, with exposure to GitHub or Azure DevOps for version control and basic ALM practices.
* Ability to design clean, intuitive, and visually appealing dashboards following UI/UX best practices, accessibility standards, and consistent enterprise styling.
* Skilled in creating user\-friendly dashboards using advanced visuals, filters, drill\-throughs, bookmarks, and reusable report components.
* Good to have knowledge about the integrating Power BI with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse for unified and scalable business solutions.
* Understanding data refresh mechanisms, gateway configuration, row\-level security (RLS), and workspace management for enterprise reporting.
* Knowledge of Power BI deployment pipelines, governance, and best practices for report lifecycle management.
* An interest in, or experience with, AI\-driven insights within Power BI (e.g., AI visuals, Copilot features) and emerging technologies is desirable.

  
**Education / Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field (or equivalent experience)
* With at least 5\+ years of experience in Microsoft Power BI Platform Technology.

description:
Nwaresoft stands at the forefront of technology, offering a comprehensive suite of IT Services, Consulting, IoT Solutions, and IT Outsourcing. We take pride in our long\-standing partnerships with esteemed clients like Fiserv, ICICI Bank, GMR, HPCL, IOCL, Nayara, C3Centricity, IRCTC, AMU, IONFS, Secure Parking, SDMC, and MP Tourism. Our enduring relationships with these major players are a testament to our consistent delivery of successful projects and our ongoing commitment to their evolving needs. Our expertise and dedication have made us a trusted partner in driving their digital transformation journeys.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a skilled **Microcontroller Programmer** with expertise in **STM32, ESP32, and Arduino.** The ideal candidate should have a strong background in **embedded systems development, firmware programming,** and **PCB design.** This role requires working on cutting\-edge IoT and industrial automation projects, designing efficient hardware\-software interfaces, and ensuring seamless communication between microcontrollers and peripheral devices.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

* Develop, test, and optimize firmware for STM32, ESP32, and Arduino\-based systems.
* Interface microcontrollers with sensors, actuators, and communication modules (UART, SPI, I2C, RS485, CAN, LoRa, BLE, WiFi, MQTT).
* Work with Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) and bare\-metal programming for performance\-critical applications.
* Implement power management strategies for low\-power embedded devices.
* Develop and debug PCB designs using tools like EasyEDA, Altium, KiCad, or Eagle.
* Conduct circuit debugging, hardware troubleshooting, and firmware optimization.
* Work with communication protocols such as Modbus, MQTT, CAN, RS485, and LoRaWAN.
* Integrate firmware with cloud\-based IoT platforms and mobile applications.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to design and validate custom PCBs for embedded systems.
* Develop and document technical specifications, schematics, and firmware updates.

**Required Skills:**

* Proficiency in C/C\+\+, Embedded C, and Python for microcontroller programming.
* Experience in PCB design and layout using Altium, KiCad, or Eagle.
* Strong understanding of hardware debugging tools (Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, JTAG, SWD).
* Experience in writing bootloaders, firmware encryption, and OTA updates.

title: Global IT Software Engineer Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


BCG is transforming the way we deliver on our customer relationship management agenda. As the EventBridge Engineering \& App Integration Engineer for our end\-to\-end client platform, you will provide the integration engineering capacity needed to connect a wide set of systems, as well as delivering on the implementation of our eventbridge platform itself.

  

This programme requires simultaneous integration engineering across a wide set of connected enterprise systems spanning CRM, contract management, finance, and HR. Each of these requires its own integration design, API configuration, and testing in parallel with the event layer being built. This role provides the capacity to run these workstreams concurrently rather than sequentially, ensuring key delivery milestones remain achievable.

  

* Design, build, and test integrations across a range of connected enterprise systems spanning CRM, contract management, finance, and HR.
* Own API configuration and integration design for each connected system, working in a connected approach on the event architecture.
* Run integration workstreams concurrently across systems to keep the programme's delivery milestones on track.
* Test each integration touchpoint end to end to ensure data flows correctly between the client platform and its connected systems. Delivering automated testing where possible.
* Partner closely with the EventBridge Engineer to ensure integration patterns are consistent with the target event\-driven architecture.
* Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues across environments, escalating architectural risks where needed.
* Document integration designs and configurations to support maintainability and handover as the platform matures.

  

What You'll Bring

* Demonstrable experience in integration engineering for large internal or enterprise platforms.
* Experience with the following technologies:
	+ integration design and API configuration across CRM, contracting, ERP, or HR systems.
	+ Ideally experience of MS Dynamics, SAP, and Azure functions.
* Working knowledge and experience of event\-driven architecture (e.g. AWS EventBridge, message brokers) is critical.
* Strong knowledge of SDLC principles, CI/CD pipelines, and modern engineering practices.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to partner across engineering, product, and system\-owner teams.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  

Who You'll Work With


You will be part of the Commercial Technology \& Services team, embedded in the client platform engineering squad. You will partner closely with Product, the Lead Engineer, and engineers working on platform integrations and front end delivery, as well as the wider teams that depend on our core client relationship management systems. Together, you'll deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that support BCG's global relationship management technology.

  

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Designing and building integrations across a wide range of enterprise systems (CRM, contracting, ERP, HR).
* Working in parallel across multiple integration workstreams without becoming a bottleneck to the core platform build.
* API configuration, testing, and troubleshooting across environments.
* AWS Eventbridge and standard function engineering.
* Collaborating closely with engineering teams to keep integration patterns consistent with the target architecture.
* Prioritizing and sequencing work to hit concurrent delivery deadlines across several systems.
* Clear documentation and handover of integration designs.


At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:
**About the Role**   
We're looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to lead our shift from manual QA to a modern, automation\-first, CI/CD\-integrated and AI\-assisted quality engineering function. **Responsibilities**

● Establish testing across unit, API, integration, UI, regression, smoke, and performance levels; define what to automate vs. keep manual.  
● Build strong API/backend testing capability — REST APIs, JSON/XML, DB validation, contract and microservices testing.  
● Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Docker).  
● Evaluate and introduce practical AI\-assisted testing — test generation, self\-healing automation, intelligent failure/root\-cause analysis, and LLM\-based workflows (e.g., requirements → test cases, failure → RCA).

● Mentor manual testers and QA engineers, building a strong automation\-first culture within the team.

**Required Technical Skills**

● 5\+ years of software QA experience, including significant hands\-on automation experience.  
● Strong programming skills in at least one of: Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C\#.

● Solid API testing experience using Postman, RestAssured, or similar tools.  
● Working knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps) and Git.

● Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to identify root causes of failed automation. Good to have

● Performance testing (JMeter) and mobile automation (Appium).  
● Test orchestration, parallel execution, and visual regression testing.

**Education**  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline. Relevant professional experience may substitute for formal education.

title: QuickBase Developer
description:
**Experience** \- 03 to 07 years

**About the Project**

We are building a new relationship\-management (CRM\-style) business application on Quickbase for a US\-based client, in their existing Quickbase environment.

Typical functionality includes:

* Organizations, locations and contacts
* Activity logging and follow\-up task management
* A multi\-stage pipeline with stage history and conversion reporting
* Recurring data imports from external files, with record matching and reconciliation
* Manager dashboards and KPIs, automated notifications, and role\-based permissions

You will be part of a small WalkingTree team working directly with the client's business users and leadership.

**What You'll Do**

* Design and build Quickbase tables, relationships, fields, forms and reports based on documented requirements
* Build summary, lookup and formula fields to calculate things like last\-activity dates, pipeline aging and roll\-up totals
* Set up Quickbase Pipelines and automations for reminders, alerts and follow\-up task creation
* Import and clean existing business data, including matching records and producing exception reports for anything that doesn't match
* Build repeatable import processes for recurring external data files
* Create dashboards and reports for managers, staff and finance users
* Configure user roles and permissions, including restricting sensitive financial fields
* Join discovery and working sessions with US stakeholders to clarify requirements, demo progress and gather feedback
* Document the data model, automations and admin procedures so the client can maintain the app

**Must\-Have Skills**

* 2\+ years of hands\-on Quickbase development: tables, relationships, forms, reports and role permissions
* Comfort with Quickbase formula fields, summary and lookup fields
* Working experience with Quickbase Pipelines or automations
* Solid understanding of relational data modeling (parent/child records, avoiding duplicate data)
* Experience importing and cleaning data from Excel/CSV files
* Good spoken and written English and confidence working directly with US business users

**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**

*We don't expect one person to have all of these. Any of them will make a candidate stronger.*

* Experience building CRM, sales pipeline or relationship\-management apps (on Quickbase, Salesforce, Zoho, Dynamics or similar)
* Quickbase API, webhooks, JavaScript or code pages
* Email integration with Outlook / Microsoft 365, or email templates within Quickbase
* Data matching and de\-duplication techniques
* Financial reconciliation or commission tracking
* Quickbase certification (Builder or Expert)
* Dashboard and KPI design experience

**What Success Looks Like**

* First week: review the requirements, get access to the Quickbase environment and start building the core tables and relationships
* By week 2: organizations, locations and contacts working, with the data model confirmed with the team
* By weeks 4–6: pipeline, activity and task features in the client's hands; existing data imported
* Ongoing: import, reconciliation and dashboard features delivered, with the client team able to administer the app themselves

**Why Join**

* Direct exposure to a US client and their leadership
* Build a complete business application end to end, not just maintenance tickets
* Work with experienced WalkingTree engineers and grow into broader low\-code, integration and AI work

Pay: Up to ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* How many days is your current notice period?

* QuickBase: 2 years (Required)

description:

The role is a blend of development, operations \& system administration to assist in expanding the deployment of our templated solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborating with a UK\-based team of digital specialists to design, develop, and deploy scalable Power BI reporting solutions.
* Supporting the ongoing enhancement and maintenance of Power BI dashboards and data models aligned with business requirements.
* Developing and maintaining interactive reports and dashboards using Power BI, ensuring high data accuracy and performance optimization.
* Working with various data sources (e.g., SharePoint, SQL, Python script, ArcGIS, APIs) to transform and model data using Power Query and DAX.
* Assisting in the design, development, and delivery of complex, customized reporting solutions, both independently and as part of a team.
* Implementing automated data refresh processes and monitoring data pipelines to support business reporting needs.
* Applying governance best practices, including data security, workspace management, version control, and deployment pipelines.
* Creating and maintaining documentation such as data dictionaries, report specifications, and user guides for Power BI solutions.


**Required Essential Skills And Expertise**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modeling, DAX calculations, and performance optimization.
* Strong experience in building interactive and insightful visualizations using Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.
* Strong understanding of data modeling concepts including relationships, measures, calculated columns, and star schema design.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL (queries, joins, and basic optimization), along with experience in integrating data from multiple sources such as SharePoint Online, APIs, SQL and enterprise systems.
* Experience working with REST APIs and integrating external data into Power BI through connectors and automated workflows. Good to have, if any exposure to ArcGIS integration.
* Familiarity with Power Query (M language) for data transformation, cleansing, and shaping.
* Knowledge of JSON, OData queries, and REST\-based integrations for dynamic data retrieval.
* Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and requirement translation skills, with exposure to GitHub or Azure DevOps for version control and basic ALM practices.
* Ability to design clean, intuitive, and visually appealing dashboards following UI/UX best practices, accessibility standards, and consistent enterprise styling.
* Skilled in creating user\-friendly dashboards using advanced visuals, filters, drill\-throughs, bookmarks, and reusable report components.
* Good to have knowledge about the integrating Power BI with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse for unified and scalable business solutions.
* Understanding data refresh mechanisms, gateway configuration, row\-level security (RLS), and workspace management for enterprise reporting.
* Knowledge of Power BI deployment pipelines, governance, and best practices for report lifecycle management.
* An interest in, or experience with, AI\-driven insights within Power BI (e.g., AI visuals, Copilot features) and emerging technologies is desirable.

**Education / Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field (or equivalent experience)

title: Senior Software Engineer – Product Engineering

 AvancerPI Solutions is an enterprise technology engineering company focused on helping organizations modernize, automate, migrate, and operate complex IT environments.
 



  





 Founded in 2020, we have built strong capabilities across infrastructure, automation, cloud native and Kubernetes, migration, disaster recovery, platform engineering, and AI\-led solutions. Today, AvancerPI is primarily a technology services company, while also building our own products and intellectual property based on real enterprise problems we encounter in the field.
 



  





 Our growing product portfolio includes Veloce, Praxis, and Allocent, with a focus on migration automation, intent\-based deployment, and workforce and organizational management.
 



  





**Our Mission** 




 To simplify enterprise technology transformation through deep expertise, intelligent automation, and engineering.
 



  





**Our Vision** 




 To become a trusted global technology partner, transforming complex IT environments into intelligent, automated, and resilient digital platforms.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Senior Software Engineer who can help architect and build AvancerPI’s enterprise products while establishing the engineering discipline required to scale the product team. This role combines architecture, implementation, code/design review, technical decision\-making and mentoring.
 



  





**What You’ll Build** 



* Enterprise B2B products for migration, infrastructure/platform automation, cloud operations and resource/program management.
* Backend services, APIs and long\-running orchestration workflows.
* Modern customer\-facing web applications.
* Integrations with virtualization, cloud, Kubernetes and enterprise\-management APIs.
* Multi\-tenant capabilities, RBAC, auditability and secure service boundaries.
* AI\-assisted product capabilities, RAG and agentic workflows where appropriate.
* Observability, logging, reliability and operational tooling.



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own architecture and technical design for significant product capabilities.
* Write production\-grade frontend/backend code and remain hands\-on.
* Design maintainable APIs, data models and service boundaries.
* Build asynchronous and long\-running workflows with clear failure/retry semantics.
* Design secure authentication, authorization, tenancy and audit models.
* Containerize and deploy services on Kubernetes.
* Establish CI/CD, automated testing, code\-review and release practices.
* Improve product observability, reliability, performance and supportability.

title: Principal Statistical Programmer
description:

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Principal Statistical Programmer to join our team in
 **Remote** 
 capacity. As a Principal Statistical Programmer, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert, providing technical leadership, strategic programming expertise, and trusted consultation to both internal teams and external sponsors. This role is central to the successful delivery of clinical trial programming activities, supporting high\-quality analysis, reporting, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across clinical development programs.
   

  

 You may serve as a Statistical Programming Coordinator on projects, partnering closely with sponsors, Data Operations Leads, and cross functional stakeholders to guide study execution. Responsibilities include overseeing statistical programming deliverables, ensuring quality and compliance, supporting programming standards and technologies, leading project level programming activities, and contributing to the successful delivery of complex clinical trial and submission programs.
   

  

 You will join a collaborative, growth\-oriented environment where your expertise will help advance clinical research and support the development of therapies that improve patient outcomes. This position offers opportunities to expand your leadership influence, strengthen sponsor partnerships, and contribute to innovation across statistical programming and clinical development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver high value, high\-quality statistical programming services that support successful clinical trial execution.
* Serve in the Statistical Programming Coordinator role, including negotiating timelines, coordinating programming teams, monitoring resources and budgets, and identifying scope changes.
* Provide technical leadership, expert advice, and consultancy support to internal teams and external sponsors.

* Maintain study documentation to ensure traceability, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance.
* Lead or participate in process and quality improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, and productivity.
* Provide guidance on industry technologies and technical standards, including CDISC, 21 CFR Part 11, and electronic submissions.
* Support project teams in resolving technical and operational challenges encountered during clinical trial execution.

* Provide oversight and guidance for multiple trial programs, complex clinical studies, and submission projects, including Integrated Summary of Safety and Integrated Summary of Efficacy deliverables.

* Contribute to the production and quality review of analysis plans, TLF mock shells, derived dataset specifications, programming specifications, and related study documents.
* Development and quality control derived datasets, tables, figures, and listings using efficient programming techniques.
* Create standard macros, applications, and process enhancements that improve departmental effectiveness and consistency.

* Mentor, train, and support other members of the Statistical Programming organization.
* Lead, supervise, create, implement, and execute import and export programming activities and develop mapping specifications in accordance with applicable standards.


**You’ll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**
* Strengths in SAS programming, technical leadership, analytical problem solving, and scientific communication.
* Experience working within clinical trials and regulated clinical research environments.
* The ability to collaborate effectively across global and virtual teams while also working independently when needed.
* A strong commitment to quality, continuous improvement, and attention to detail.
* Comfort working with statistical programming processes, regulatory standards, clinical systems, and evolving technologies.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent work experience.
* Relevant clinical trial industry experience.
* Proven record of leading teams and large scope projects within a GRO, technical, clinical, medical, or statistical environment.
* Proficiency in SAS.
* Knowledge of statistical programming and reporting processes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in end\-to\-end programming with CDISC standards.
* Experience supporting complex clinical trial programs and regulatory submission activities.
* Demonstrated success driving process improvements and programming efficiencies.
* Experience developing and delivering technical training, mentorship, or knowledge sharing initiatives.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Developer Productivity
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data\-driven.
   

  

**About Us**
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry\-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
   

  

 Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
   

  

 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
   

  

 During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a
 **Sr Software Engineer** 
 to join the Platform Ops team (Platform Engineering) and enable developer productivity by building and improving developer tooling and environments, and by improving other productivity tools around observability. Our team builds the shared systems and workflows engineers rely on every day—internal developer environments and self\-serve tooling that makes the recommended way to ship changes the easiest way. This is a platform tooling role with a focus is on reusable capabilities and self\-service workflows adopted across teams.
   

  

 You’ll also help develop AI\-based workflows for productivity and efficiency, including automation that improves infrastructure operations (for example, faster triage, automated runbook steps, and better self\-service for common issues). You’ll prioritize the highest\-impact problems by looking at where time is being lost today (slow builds, flaky tests, manual release steps, repetitive operational work) and turning that into concrete projects. You’ll set clear success metrics up front and use them to guide design decisions and rollouts.
   

  

 Expect to partner closely with engineering teams to drive adoption, document changes, and iterate based on feedback. You’ll drive cross\-team work across internal tooling, developer environments, observability, and reliability, focusing on measurable improvements (for example: shorter lead time, fewer incidents, and faster recovery). You’ll add automation and enable developer workflows across all three major cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP).
   

  

 Over time, you’ll own medium\-sized projects end\-to\-end: identify the highest\-friction workflows with partner teams, build and ship improvements, roll them out safely, and iterate based on adoption and measurable outcomes (for example: faster builds, fewer flaky tests, shorter time to debug, and less operational toil). You’ll collaborate closely with Platform Engineering, Release Engineering, Security, and product engineering teams to make improvements that are easy to adopt and maintain.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build internal tools and services in Python and/or Go
* Build tooling for our internal developer platform (self\-service workflows, shared patterns, developer\-facing interfaces)
* Add automation and enable developer workflows across all three major cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP)
* Develop AI\-based workflows that improve developer experience and reduce repetitive manual work, including efficiency gains in infrastructure operations
* Improve developer feedback loops through better observability (metrics/logs/traces), making failures easier to diagnose
* Automate common engineering workflows (scaffolding, environment setup, releases, operational runbooks)
* Improve observability for platform services (metrics, logs, traces) to make issues easier to detect and debug
* Integrate tools into existing workflows (CLI, Slack, GitHub, dashboards) where it reduces time\-to\-resolution
* Participate in on\-call/incident response as needed and drive follow\-up automation to prevent repeat issues


**Skills We’re Looking For**
* Professional software engineering experience in Python and/or Go
* Experience building developer productivity tooling (CI systems, build tooling, developer portals, workflow automation)
* Experience with at least one cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Strong fundamentals: testing, code review, debugging, and operating production services
* Ability to work effectively in a remote, cross\-team environment


 You'll have an edge if you have:
   

  

* Kubernetes experience
* Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/OpenTofu), including reusable modules and safe state management
