Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion \& belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world\-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

description:

 The Cloud Operations Engineering team ensures the reliability, security, and scalability of cloud platforms through automation, observability, incident management, and continuous optimization. The team enables faster innovation by providing resilient cloud services, improving operational efficiency, and delivering an exceptional customer and developer experience across multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 GCP Infrastructure \& Operations
   

  

* Build, configure, manage, and support highly available GCP environments.
* Own day\-to\-day technical operations of production and non\-production cloud infrastructure.
* Deploy and manage workloads running on GKE and other GCP services.
* Implement infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code best practices.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, application deployment, scaling, and availability issues.
* Support migration and modernization of workloads from on\-premises environments to GCP.


 Kubernetes \& Container Platform
   

  

* Deploy, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize Kubernetes/GKE clusters.
* Troubleshoot pods, services, deployments, ingress, networking, storage, resource utilization, and cluster\-level issues.
* Support Docker\-based containerized applications.
* Implement scalable and highly available container platforms.
* Work closely with application teams to resolve deployment and runtime issues.


 CI/CD \& Automation
   

  

* Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, deployment, and operational activities.
* Develop automation using Terraform, Python, Bash, and related tools.
* Improve deployment reliability through standardization and automation.
* Integrate CI/CD pipelines with Kubernetes/GKE and cloud infrastructure.


 Networking \& Security
   

  

* Troubleshoot GCP networking issues involving VPCs, subnets, routing, NAT, DNS, firewall rules, and load balancers.
* Implement and troubleshoot IAM roles, policies, service accounts, and access controls.
* Apply cloud security best practices across GCP environments.
* Diagnose complex connectivity issues across cloud, hybrid, and application environments.


**Qualifications**
* 10–15 years of overall IT/Infrastructure/Cloud experience.
* Strong hands\-on expertise across GCP core services, including:
+ Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
+ IAM
+ Cloud Monitoring and Logging
+ Cloud SQL
+ Pub/Sub
+ VPC and networking services
+ Load Balancing
+ Compute and storage services

* Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform, preferably including Terraform Enterprise (TFE).
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, GKE, Docker, and containerized platforms.
* Experience with scripting and automation using Python and Bash.
* Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated infrastructure provisioning.
* Hands\-on experience implementing and supporting end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, or GCP\-native CI/CD services.
* Strong knowledge of monitoring, logging, observability, and alerting solutions.
* Good understanding of cloud security, IAM, encryption, access controls, and compliance requirements.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, applications, networking, security, Kubernetes, and cloud services.
* GCP certification is mandatory.

description:
**Job Description**
**We are Omnissa!**
 Omnissa is the first AI\-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work\-from anywhere experiences. We integrate industry\-leading solutions—including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security \& Compliance—into a seamless, autonomous workspace that adapts to how people work. Our platform boosts employee engagement while optimizing IT operations, security, and cost.
   

  

 Guided by our Core Values—
 **Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value** 
 —we’re growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact. If you're passionate about shaping the future of work, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Omnissa is seeking an exceptional
 **Staff 2 Engineer (15\+ Yrs)** 
 to join our
 **Unified Endpoint Management (UEM)** 
 organization. As a senior technical leader, you will architect, design, and guide the evolution of our next\-generation UEM platform that powers secure, scalable, and intelligent endpoint management for customers worldwide for Apple platform.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex distributed systems problems, driving cross\-team technical strategy, and mentoring engineering teams to deliver world\-class enterprise software.
   

  

**What will you bring to Omnissa?**
* Deep understanding of Apple MDM protocol
* A passion for building secure, resilient, and elegant enterprise systems.
* A mindset for innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Actively promotes and cultivates an AI‑first engineering culture by mentoring team, sharing best practices, leading workshops
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and influence without authority.


**Core Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and scale backend services that integrate with Apple’s MDM ecosystem (APNs, DEP/ADE, VPP/Apps \& Books, declarative management).
* Implement secure device lifecycle workflows including enrollment, policy enforcement, compliance, and telemetry ingestion.
* Optimize high\-throughput systems handling millions of device events with strong reliability and performance guarantees.


**Skills/experience**
* Strong backend engineering experience with deep hands\-on knowledge of Apple MDM protocols and services (APNs, ADE/DEP, VPP, MDM payloads).
* Experience building distributed systems, REST/gRPC APIs, and event\-driven pipelines (Kafka or similar).
* Solid grounding in security, certificates, authentication flows, and large\-scale cloud services.
* Strong proficiency in one or more backend languages like C\#, Java, Go etc
* Proven experience designing and scaling microservices deployed on cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Solid understanding of networking, security protocols, authentication (OAuth, OpenID Connect), and data compliance.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and technical leadership abilities


**AI \& Innovation Leadership**
* Demonstrated experience in designing and delivering practical AI‑driven solutions, leveraging LLMs, automation frameworks, or intelligent workflows to solve real engineering or customer problems.
* Strong hands‑on ability to prototype, experiment, and ship AI‑powered features, tools, or internal accelerators.
* Ability to identify high‑impact opportunities where AI can enhance product capabilities, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.


**Senior/ownership angle**
* Architect and own end\-to\-end design of core UEM platform components, spanning device management, policy orchestration, identity, security, and cloud scalability.
* Lead and influence architectural decisions across backend services, mobile/desktop agents, and SaaS delivery infrastructure.
* Define and evolve technical vision, long\-term roadmap, and engineering best practices for the UEM product line.
* Partner with platform, mobile, and SRE teams to deliver highly available, secure, and performant device management services.
* Guide complex debugging, system performance optimization, and triage of production issues.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Collaborate closely with product management, UX, SRE, security, and customer engineering teams to shape feature requirements and deliver high\-quality releases.
* Influence technical direction across multiple UEM sub\-teams, ensuring architectural alignment and quality.


**Mentorship \& Influence**
* Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers, promote a strong engineering culture, and champion best practices in code quality, testing, and design.
* Lead technical deep dives, RFC reviews, and design reviews across the org.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience driving org\-wide architectural initiatives or modernizing legacy systems.
* Prior experience/understanding of Workspace ONE, Intune, JAMF, MobileIron, or similar MDMs would be advantageous.

Create and maintain custom reports, dashboards, and workflows to provide actionable insights to business leaders.
  
Perform data analysis to support business decisions and track performance metrics.

Ensure Salesforce data integrity and security by adhering to Salesforce best practices.
  
Provide guidance on CRM best practices and support continuous process improvement.
  
  

**Desired Skills:**  

Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  
Experience with Agile methodologies and tools like Jira.
  
Knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Marketing Cloud is a plus.
  
Familiarity with Salesforce AppExchange solutions.
  
Proficiency in Salesforce Lightning experience.
  
Strong knowledge of Salesforce features like Reports, Dashboards, Process Builder, Flows, Workflow Rules, and custom objects.
  
Proficiency in Apex, SOQL, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components.
  
Understanding of integration technologies (REST/SOAP APIs).
  
Experience with data migration and management tools (e.g., Data Loader, Workbench).
  
  

**Qualifications:**  

Masters/Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a relevant field.
  
Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Platform Developer I.
  
5 years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator/Developer

All Support needed for the realization of business goals,

title: Senior Salesforce developer
description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG** 
 is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in\-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
   

  

 As part of the ASX\-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market\-wide rates, unique added\-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
   

  

**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019\-2011\),** 
 FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
 **Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time** 
 ! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid\-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
   

  

 A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings \& Events.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Salesforce Developer to join our team and support the growth of our GBS, FinOps, Treasury, Fraud and Finance operations. In this role, you will work closely with the Product Owner, Stakeholders and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to assess existing financial processes, identify opportunities for automation and optimisation, and develop robust Salesforce solutions. You will be instrumental in expanding the Salesforce platform across our GBS footprint, creating a more efficient, compliant, and user\-friendly environment.
   

  

**Day In The Life**
* System Administration
* Manage day\-to\-day operations of Salesforce orgs including user setup, roles, profiles, and permissions.
* Maintain data quality through regular data audits, deduplication, and data management processes.
* Monitor system performance, scheduled jobs, and integrations.
* Configuration \& Automation
* Configure objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, and approval processes.
* Design and implement automation using Flows, Process Builder, and Validation Rules.
* Create reports, dashboards, and analytics to provide actionable insights for business teams.
* Support \& Maintenance
* Serve as the primary contact for Salesforce\-related issues, enhancements, and support requests.
* Conduct regular system checks and manage release updates and sandbox refreshes.
* Document system configuration, business processes, and user procedures.
* Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management
* Work with business stakeholders to gather requirements and provide scalable solutions.
* Partner with developers and architects to implement enhancements or integrations.
* Provide user training, create user guides, and promote Salesforce adoption across teams


**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**
* Experience: 4–7 years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator in Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud environments.
* Certifications (Preferred):
* Salesforce Certified Administrator – required.
* Advanced Administrator or App Builder certifications – preferred.
* Technical Skills:
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data model, security model, and automation tools (Flows, Validation Rules, Reports \& Dashboards).
* Familiarity with integration basics (email\-to\-case, web\-to\-lead, connected apps).
* Experience with user management, territory management, and case management.
* Soft Skills: o Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in cross\-functional teams. Education
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. Preferred Experience
* Experience supporting multi\-cloud Salesforce environments (Sales \+ Service \+ Experience Cloud).
* Knowledge of Salesforce Flow orchestration, Data Loader, and change sets.
* Exposure to Agile or Scrum methodologies.


**Work Perks! \- What’s in it for you:**
 FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
   

  

 You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
   

  

**Market Aligned remuneration structure** 
 and a highly competitive salary
   

  

**Fun and Energetic culture** 
 : At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
   

  

**Work life Balance** 
 : We believe in “No Leave \= No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
   

  

**Great place to work** 
 \- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
   

  

**Wellbeing Focus** 
 \- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
   

  

**Paternity Leave:** 
 We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
   

  

**Travel perks** 
 : You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
   

  

**A career, not a job** 
 : We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
   

  

**Reward \& Recognition** 
 : Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering \- You'll have to experience it to believe it!
   

  

**Love for travel** 
 : We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
   

  

**We value you...**
 Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
   

  

 As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe \- 20\+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
   

  

 We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
 **Brightness of Future.**
 We encourage you to
 **DREAM BIG** 
 through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
   

  

**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**

title: Software Developer
description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.
   

  

 If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!
   

  

 Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a
 **Software Developer** 
 to be part of making this happen.
   

  

**Position Overview And Objective**
 As a Developer for Arctic Wolf’s Data Platform, you’ll work on the team that focuses on building the systems that enable the storage and rapid searching of cybersecurity data. This telemetry data is collected from customers by leveraging endpoint, network, and cloud data sources both inside and outside our customers’ networks. Our team designs, builds, and manages large\-scale systems that allow both our customers and our employees to leverage these various data sets to better understand and improve security posture.
   

  

 You’ll work at the intersection of big data, distributed computing, and cloud technologies. Our existing stacks include both custom\-built and open\-source components written in Python, Go, or Java, deployed within Amazon Web Services. We leverage Kubernetes and other containerized platforms. Some major components we use include Kafka, Elasticsearch, Databricks, and Spark, along with various other components and additional custom application services developed in\-house.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Contribute to the implementation and design of new data storage and search solutions, taking customer requirements into account.
* Maintain and enhance our existing Python, Go, and Java\-based systems.
* Deploy, configure, and support open\-source components and platform services.
* Take ownership of features and services from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and operational support.
* Identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities within assigned areas and work with senior engineers to address them.
* Collaborate with teammates and stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify ambiguities, and deliver practical solutions.
* Improve our capabilities to operate, monitor, and scale systems reliably as we grow.
* Contribute to software quality through automated testing, code reviews, observability, and operational excellence practices.
* Participate in knowledge sharing through documentation, technical discussions, design reviews, and incident investigations.


**Experience \& Requirements**
* 2\-5 years of experience working on backend systems or distributed applications.
* Excited about working in the big data space and learning large\-scale data platform technologies.
* Relevant experience with Python, Go, Java, or other object\-oriented programming languages.
* Experience working with RESTful API interfaces and service\-oriented architectures.
* Experience writing SQL queries and working with relational databases; familiarity with joins, aggregations, query tuning, and troubleshooting is preferred.
* Exposure to Elasticsearch DSL or similar query languages and search technologies.
* Experience working within containerized environments and platforms such as Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, or Docker.
* Experience with columnar and/or time\-series databases (e.g. Databricks, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, etc).
* Exposure to Amazon Web Services and cloud\-native technologies.
* Understanding of software quality practices including automated testing, code reviews, observability, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to work cohesively within a team and habitually share knowledge through collaboration and documentation.


**Nice\-to\-have Experience**
* Understanding of query execution and optimization concepts, including query planning, partition pruning, indexing strategies, and performance troubleshooting.
* Experience with modern data lake and analytics technologies such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Databricks, Trino, Spark, or similar large\-scale data processing and query platforms.
* Experience with message queue systems such as Amazon SQS, Kafka, or similar technologies.


**On\-Camera Policy**
 To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
   

  

**About Arctic Wolf**
 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021\-2025\), Best Places to Work – USA (2021\-2025\), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021\-2024\), Great Place to Work – UK (2024\-2026\), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024\-2026\). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
   

  

 We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.
   

  

 We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.
   

  

 All
 **India** 
 wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:
   

  

* Equity for all employees
* Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* Fertility support and paid parental leave
* Employee Assistance Program


 Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience asaccessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.
   

  

**Security Requirements**
* Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
* Background checks are required for this position.

Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.

**About HPE Networking, SASE \& Security**
 HPE Networking Business Unit and Axis Security portfolios, delivers secure, AI\-driven networking solutions that connect users, devices, applications, and data across campus, branch, data centre, WAN, data centre, and cloud environments. HPE Networking BU enables organizations to modernize infrastructure through on\-prem, hybrid and cloud\-native management, automation, AIOps\-driven operations, and high\-performance wired, wireless, routing, and switching and security solutions, while supporting seamless hybrid work experiences with scalability, resiliency, and operational simplicity.
   

  

 HPE Networking BU’s SASE and Security Group develops solutions that provide a unified, cloud\-delivered architecture that combines networking and security capabilities for the modern edge\-to\-cloud enterprise. The portfolio integrates SD\-WAN, Secure Service Edge (SSE), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Next Generation Firewall (NGFW), CASB, Secure Routing, Unified Endpoint Client and AI\-Native network operations capabilities to deliver secure and optimized access for users regardless of location.
   

  

 Our technologies help enterprises reduce complexity, improve operational efficiency, strengthen cyber resilience, and accelerate digital transformation initiatives. By leveraging AI\-powered insights, centralized policy enforcement, intelligent network automation, and identity\-based security, HPE delivers comprehensive edge\-to\-cloud networking and security solutions that enable secure, agile, and future\-ready digital infrastructure for enterprises worldwide.
   

  

**Job Family Definition**
 Designs, develops, tests, and maintains software solutions for network security products and services. Contributes to the architecture, implementation, and lifecycle management of cloud\-native security applications and networking software. Works on complex technical problems involving distributed systems, networking protocols, and high\-performance packet processing to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable solutions.
   

  

**Management Level Definition**
 Applies advanced technical knowledge to solve complex engineering problems with minimal supervision. Independently owns feature design and implementation, drives technical decisions within a project, and collaborates across teams to deliver high\-quality software. Mentors junior engineers, participates in architecture discussions, and influences engineering best practices while contributing to product and technology roadmaps.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design, develop, and maintain cloud\-native microservices for network security services.
* Build scalable, highly available, and resilient distributed systems deployed in containerised environments.
* Develop software components for network security products, with emphasis on performance, reliability, and security.
* Collaborate with architects, product management, and cross\-functional engineering teams to define technical solutions and implementation plans.
* Develop, review, and optimise software for Linux\-based platforms.
* Drive software quality through design reviews, code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and automation.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed services, networking stacks, and production deployments.
* Analyse and optimise application performance, resource utilisation, and system scalability.
* Participate in CI/CD automation and DevOps practices to improve software delivery efficiency.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical knowledge sharing across the organisation.
* Stay current with emerging technologies in cloud\-native networking, network security, and distributed systems.


**What You Need To Bring**
* Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, NAT, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and HTTP/HTTPS.
* Experience designing and operating scalable microservices and distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes, Docker, service discovery, and container networking.
* Knowledge of network security technologies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, application identification, web filtering, and SSL/TLS inspection.
* Understanding of Layer 4–Layer 7 protocols and deep packet inspection concepts.
* Experience with software debugging, profiling, performance optimisation, and troubleshooting in production environments.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated testing, and Agile development practices.


**Education And Experience Required**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
* Typically 8\-12 years experience.


**Good to Have**
* Hands\-on experience in Next\-Generation Firewall (NGFW) development.
* Experience working on both control plane and data plane software components.
* Experience with cloud\-native network security platforms and service\-oriented architectures.
* Exposure to high\-performance packet processing frameworks such as DPDK

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Join Visa’s Technology Organization, a dynamic community of problem solvers and innovators dedicated to redefining the future of commerce. We manage one of the world’s most advanced processing networks, handling over 65,000 secure transactions per second across 80 million merchants, 15,000 financial institutions, and billions of individuals.


In this senior role, you will drive the development of generative AI (GenAI) solutions. You will provide technical leadership across teams to define and enforce best practices, bring a product\-driven mindset, and ensure our GenAI platforms and applications are robust, scalable, and aligned with business needs. This role requires a hands\-on leader with a passion for AI innovation, strong mentorship skills, and deep expertise in Python, LangChain, Azure cloud services, and vector databases.


Key Responsibilities:


Technical Architecture \& System Design

* Work with architects to design and implement core components of GenAI systems, including LLM agent orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, prompt\-engineering frameworks, and model fine\-tuning workflows. Make sound architectural decisions, evaluate alternative approaches, and ensure solutions meet enterprise expectations for performance, reliability, scalability, and security.


Hands\-on Solution Development

* Lead end\-to\-end development of GenAI solutions from concept through production. Prototype and build critical components in Python, integrate large language models and frameworks such as LangChain, and operationalize embeddings, vector stores, and RAG pipelines. Ensure AI systems address real\-world use cases and deliver measurable business impact.


Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Drive cross\-team alignment, influence architectural decisions across departments, and champion adoption of AI in high\-value use cases. Ensure GenAI initiatives remain aligned with the broader enterprise technology strategy.


Technical Leadership \& Mentorship

* Provide senior technical leadership and mentorship to engineers at all levels. Conduct code reviews, support pair programming, guide architectural discussions, and lead micro\-teams or pods to deliver complex features. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and learning\-oriented engineering culture.


Engineering Excellence

* Establish and enforce coding standards, rigorous testing practices, and high\-quality documentation. Drive consistent adoption of CI/CD pipelines and strengthen secure coding practices. Maintain high test coverage and ensure solutions meet enterprise expectations for security, reliability, performance, and compliance. Apply strong engineering fundamentals end\-to\-end by writing clean, maintainable, well\-tested code; following modern design patterns; implementing robust unit, integration, and functional tests; and ensuring operational reliability through monitoring, observability, and resilient error handling. Review code developed by other engineers and provide actionable feedback to ensure adherence to best practices.


Agile Project Leadership

* Lead and actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Manage work through Jira, optimize deployments via CI/CD pipelines (for example, Jenkins), remove execution blockers, and maintain alignment across teams to ensure timely delivery of GenAI features.


Product Mindset \& Innovation

* Identify opportunities where GenAI can create user value or improve internal workflows. Propose, design, and deliver innovative AI\-driven features and enhancements. Anticipate future business needs, develop proof\-of\-concepts, and transition them into scalable, production\-ready solutions while balancing rapid experimentation with sound architecture.


Responsible AI \& Governance

* Ensure all GenAI solutions adhere to responsible AI principles. Integrate privacy, fairness, safety, and security considerations throughout the development lifecycle. Partner with governance, legal, and security teams to establish guardrails and standard practices for the safe enterprise deployment of large language models.


Continuous Learning \& Thought Leadership

* Stay current with emerging advancements in AI and machine learning, including new LLMs, vector database technologies, open\-source frameworks, and cloud AI capabilities. Evaluate and adopt techniques that strengthen the platform, and represent the GenAI team in knowledge\-sharing forums while communicating innovations to broader engineering groups and leadership.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**


Basic Qualifications

* 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience.


Preferred Qualifications:

* 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience.
* 7\+ years of software development experience, including substantial hands\-on work in AI/ML or GenAI projects (preferably 2–3 years focused on building applications with LLMs or related technologies). Prior experience as a technical lead or senior engineer is expected, with a demonstrated ability to guide teams through complex, ambiguous projects.
* Education
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. A Master’s degree or PhD in AI/ML or a related specialization is a plus, or equivalent hands\-on experience building AI systems at scale.
* Technical Expertise
* In\-depth understanding of large language models and generative AI techniques, including prompt engineering, model fine\-tuning, embeddings, and retrieval\-augmented generation for knowledge\-based systems. Proven ability to design and build systems that incorporate LLMs, agent workflows, or NLP services. Experience building AI agents capable of multi\-step reasoning or tool use is a strong plus.
* Programming Skills
* Advanced proficiency in Python for AI/ML development, with familiarity in Java or other object\-oriented languages. Experience using GenAI frameworks and libraries—such as LangChain, CrewAI, or OpenAI\-compatible APIs—to develop and integrate AI capabilities. Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms, with the ability to write efficient, production\-quality code.
* Cloud \& Infrastructure
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and deploying AI solutions at scale. Knowledge of containerization and microservices architectures is beneficial. Experience working with vector databases or similar technologies for embedding storage and semantic search is required.
* Agile \& DevOps
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in Scrum teams. Proficiency with tools such as Jira for project tracking and CI/CD pipelines (for example, Jenkins and Git\-based workflows) for automated build and deployment. Comfort with test\-driven development, continuous integration, and continuous delivery practices is expected.
* Leadership \& Communication
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with a track record of mentoring engineers and influencing teams beyond direct ownership. Ability to set technical direction, gain stakeholder buy\-in, and clearly communicate complex technical concepts to product managers, partners, and senior executives.
* Problem\-Solving \& Strategic Vision
* Demonstrated ability to tackle ambiguous problems and decompose them into actionable plans. A forward\-looking mindset to anticipate challenges and opportunities in the GenAI space, balancing short\-term delivery with long\-term architectural and strategic investments.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**Software Engineer**

Automotive cabin electronics (ACE) software team’s charter is to develop/lead technology domains with highly differentiated sensing, signal processing and network solutions for automotive infotainment in general and digital signal processors (DSPs) and in\-vehicle connectivity (GMSL, A2B, Ethernet – E2B).


**Position Summary and Job Responsibilities:**

This position will be responsible for developing production ready software following a defined software development process. Products that will be developed are audio/sensor connectivity with proprietary ADI networks like E2B, etc. Position will consist of developing automotive SW solutions – embedded, written in C/C\+\+ and PC/host based supporting tools, written in C\#. * Develop production ready embedded solutions and ROM based firmware for automotive products
* Develop middleware software stacks for Ethernet based protocols \& ADI proprietary bus protocols like E2B.

title: Java Developer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


We are seeking a talented and motivated**Java Developer**to join our core engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, test, and maintain robust, high\-performance, and scalable enterprise applications. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, architects, UI/UX designers, and DevOps engineers, to deliver high\-quality software solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.


**2\. Key Responsibilities**
----------------------------


**Software Design \& Development**
----------------------------------


* Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable, and testable Java/J2EE applications and microservices.
* Write clean, maintainable, efficient, and well\-documented code adhering to object\-oriented programming (OOP) principles and SOLID design patterns.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs, SOAP services, and event\-driven messaging systems.
* Optimize application performance, throughput, latency, and memory utilization.

**Architecture \& System Integration**
--------------------------------------


* Participate in architectural discussions and system design reviews.
* Integrate backend services with relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis) databases.
* Integrate enterprise systems with message brokers (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ).
* Ensure seamless integration with third\-party APIs and microservice ecosystems.

**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
--------------------------------


* Implement comprehensive automated unit and integration tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, and Testcontainers.
* Participate in peer code reviews to ensure adherence to software engineering standards, security practices, and quality metrics.
* Proactively identify bottlenecks, address bugs, and remediate security vulnerabilities.

**DevOps \& Deployment**
------------------------


* Collaborate with DevOps teams to design and optimize Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
* Package and deploy containerized applications using Docker and orchestrate them via Kubernetes/OpenShift.
* Monitor application health and system performance using observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk).

**3\. Required Qualifications \& Skills**
-----------------------------------------


**Technical Skills**
--------------------


* **Core Java \& Frameworks:**
	+ Strong proficiency in Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21\) and Core Java concepts (Multithreading, Concurrency, Collections, Generics, Stream API).
	+ Hands\-on experience with Spring Framework ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Spring Cloud).
* **Database Management \& ORM:**
	+ Solid understanding of relational database design, SQL indexing, and query optimization (PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL).
	+ Experience with Object\-Relational Mapping (ORM) tools (Hibernate, JPA, MyBatis).
	+ Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis) is a plus.
* **Microservices \& API Design:**
	+ Experience designing, securing, and implementing RESTful APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger) and Microservices architecture.
	+ Familiarity with API Gateways, Service Discovery, and Circuit Breaker patterns.
* **Messaging \& Event Streaming:**
	+ Experience with message queues and event streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ.
* **Build Tools \& Version Control:**
	+ Experience with build and dependency management tools (Maven, Gradle).
	+ Proficiency with Git and modern branching workflows (Gitflow, trunk\-based development).

**Professional \& Educational Qualifications**
----------------------------------------------


* **Education:**Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Experience:**3\+ years of professional software development experience in Java\-based environments (Mid\-level) or 5\+ years (Senior\-level).
* **Problem Solving:**Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and algorithmic thinking capabilities.
* **Communication:**Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams.

**4\. Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skills**
-----------------------------------------


* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
* Hands\-on experience with containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
* Knowledge of secure coding practices (OWASP Top 10\) and static analysis tools (SonarQube, Checkmarx).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence).

title: Developer Relations & Growth Associate
description:
\[Demand Gen / DevRel hybrid, open to data, analytics, platform or software engineers]
 




  





**Location:** 

 Bengaluru (in\-office / hybrid) 
 
**Team:** 

 Marketing / GTM 
 
**Experience:** 

 1\-3 years
   





**About the role** 

  






 We're building OLake, an open\-source CDC ingestion tool that replicates production databases into Apache Iceberg lakehouses and helps maintain them. Our audience is data engineers and data platform teams, the kind of people who read benchmarks, check the repo, and can smell marketing fluff from a mile away.
 




  






 This role is for someone with hands\-on data experience, whether that's data engineering, analytics engineering, platform engineering, or software engineering work that touched pipelines, who wants to spend less time shipping and more time getting other practitioners to hear about OLake, try it, and stick around. You know this audience because you've been part of it, so we're looking for someone who can bring that credibility to our top of funnel, not a marketer trying to learn CDC from scratch. Think of it as a DevRel\-flavored growth seat. Half the job is showing up daily as a real, technical voice on LinkedIn, X, Reddit and in developer communities. The other half is running the programs that turn that attention into signups. It's hands\-on: you'll be working in a team of three, writing posts and shipping campaigns yourself.
   





**What you'll do** 

  





***Distribution \& community (the core of the role)***




  




* Be a genuine, technical voice for OLake in developer communities (Reddit, Slack groups, dev.to, Hacker News), answering questions, sharing benchmarks, and contributing in ways that earn attention instead of pitching.
* Own the day\-to\-day publishing calendar across LinkedIn, X and YouTube. You write the posts from real technical understanding (not a brief handed to you), pick the visuals, and hit publish.
* Build a light employee and founder amplification motion so the team's own accounts carry reach.
* Watch the conversation: competitor moves, Iceberg and data engineering discourse, and what the audience is actually complaining about that week.



  





***Demand generation (you'll grow into this)***




  




* Help run programs across paid and organic social, search, and newsletter sponsorships, from creative and copy to reporting metrics. You bring the technical judgment on what will land with data practitioners, and we'll help you pick up the channel mechanics.
* Run newsletter and creator partnerships in the data engineering space (sponsorships, co\-marketing, guest content).
* Maintain lifecycle nurture: email sequences, retargeting, and follow\-up flows that move people from “starred the repo” to “running a sync in production.”
* Support event demand: pre\-event promotion, on\-ground capture, and post\-event follow\-up for meetups and conferences.



  





***Measurement***




  




* Own reporting on pipeline\-relevant metrics: qualified traffic, trials, signups, active users, and channel\-level cost efficiency.
* Report weekly on what's working and what isn't.



  




**What we're looking for** 

  




* 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience with data, as a data engineer, analytics engineer, platform engineer, or software engineer who has worked on data pipelines or infrastructure. This is the core qualification. Marketing experience is not required.
* A real, demonstrated pull toward writing, community and distribution. You've written technical posts, threads, or blogs, answered questions in developer communities, or built some kind of audience, even informally.
* Comfort with the subject matter goes without saying. You should be able to read a benchmark and write about CDC and Iceberg without being corrected by the engineering team, because this is close to work you've already done.
* Strong writing. Clear, specific, no jargon padding, with an original voice.
* Curiosity about the numbers side of marketing: GA4 or equivalent, campaign analytics, basic spreadsheet work. You don't need to arrive fluent, but you should want to be able to answer “did that work?” with data.
* Willingness to learn paid social and search platforms and a marketing automation or email tool on the job.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience using or contributing to an open\-source project, as a user, contributor, or maintainer.



  





**Great to have** 



* Some prior public writing or speaking: a blog, a conference talk, a well\-followed X or LinkedIn presence, even if it was built casually rather than professionally.



  




**What success looks like** 

  




* **First 30 days:** 

 you're writing and publishing in your own technical voice, you've audited our current channels, and the social calendar is running on schedule.
* **First 90 days:** 

 you're co\-running two to three demand gen programs end to end, social output and engagement are measurably up, and reporting is clean enough that we can make budget decisions from it.
* **First 6 months:** 

 you own a defined pipeline contribution number and a repeatable playbook for launches and events, and you're a recognizable voice in the data engineering community in your own right.

title: Lead Software Engineer -(4 wall Tech)
description:
Lead Software Engineer - C# .NET Sortation & Labeling Systems Job Location - Pune (Hybrid) Role Overview The Lead Software Engineer will lead the design, development, and delivery of a Windows-based sortation and labeling platform that integrates with PKMS/WMS systems, PLCs, and material handling equipment (MHE) across our distribution network. The system processes TCP socket messages for carton lifecycle events, persists data to enterprise databases, and coordinates downstream services. This role requires deep hands-on C#/.NET expertise, subject-matter depth in warehouse automation and MHE, and close collaboration with cross-functional business, DC operations, and third-party vendor teams such as Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger/print-and-apply solution providers. Impact of the Role - Provide technical leadership for the sortation and labeling domain - designing, developing, and leading delivery of high-throughput, low-latency Windows services and desktop applications. - Own application health in production - monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution during peak fulfillment periods. - Partner with Distribution Center operations, Supply Chain, and third-party MHE vendors to translate operational requirements into scalable technical solutions. - Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve DC operations, production support, and business-user productivity. - Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team. Technology Platforms You Will Work On - .NET Framework 4.8 and Visual Studio 2022. - Socket-based services and Windows Service hosts. - Integration with sortation devices, PLCs, MHE controllers, and WMS/PKMS via TCP. - ZPL label print pipelines and event-forwarding mechanisms. Key Responsibilities - Provide technical leadership for the sortation and labeling domain - designing, developing, and leading delivery of high-throughput, low-latency Windows services and desktop applications. - Design and maintain TCP socket server/client components for high-volume carton lifecycle messaging with PKMS/WMS and MHE controllers. - Implement multithreading and asynchronous programming patterns for performance, responsiveness, and predictable throughput under peak volumes. - Build and maintain desktop UI using WPF and coordinate with Windows Service hosts for end-to-end operational workflows. - Lead integrations with PLCs, serial devices, scanners, print-and-apply, and material handling equipment, ensuring robust error handling, retry logic, and consistent state across data stores. - Own ZPL label workflows and print pipelines, including label design, throughput tuning, and printer/applicator fault recovery. - Define and enforce engineering standards for secure coding, unit testing, Git branching strategy, and code quality. - Lead deployments, IIS configuration, and CI/CD automation, including automated testing and release readiness. - Own application health in production - monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution during peak fulfillment periods. - Partner with Distribution Center operations, Supply Chain, and third-party MHE vendors to translate operational requirements into scalable technical solutions. - Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve DC operations, production support, and business-user productivity. - Drive Agile delivery - sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking - adhere to IT change management, and mentor engineers to raise the bar across the team. Qualifications - 10-15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a technical lead or staff-level role. - Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale .NET applications in a retail, supply chain, or logistics environment. - Demonstrated experience as an individual contributor with strong ownership, self-direction, and vendor coordination. - Experience delivering in Agile environments using Jira for sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking. - Strong knowledge of warehouse management, sortation, labeling, and Distribution Center operations. - Hands-on experience integrating with PKMS, Manhattan WMOS, or comparable WMS platforms. - Experience leading third-party vendor integrations, integration platforms, and enterprise web services. - Strong business acumen with the ability to align technology solutions to throughput, accuracy, and cost goals. - Subject-matter expertise in material handling equipment and warehouse automation, with hands-on integration experience across one or more OEM solution sets: Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger / print-and-apply systems. - Deep understanding of MHE process flows - induction, singulation, scanning, sortation, diverts, put wall s, unit sortation, carton and bag creation, weigh-in-motion, and label print-and-apply. - Experience defining and supporting MHE interface specifications and message contracts between WMS/WCS and equipment controllers, including carton lifecycle events, divert confirmations, no-reads, exceptions, and recirculation handling. - Hands-on integration with PLCs, barcode scanners, scales, dimensioners, printers, and applicators over TCP/IP, serial, and OPC-style interfaces. - Working knowledge of Warehouse Control System (WCS) and Warehouse Execution System (WES) layers and how they interact with WMS and MHE. - Ability to troubleshoot live MHE issues on the floor - jams, mis-sorts, label misapplication, throughput degradation, and equipment/host message desynchronization - and drive root-cause resolution with vendors. - Experience participating in MHE implementations: interface testing, dry runs, integration and acceptance testing, commissioning, go-live support, and post-go-live hypercare. - Familiarity with MHE performance metrics - units per hour, sort accuracy, divert rates, read rates, and equipment uptime - and using them to tune application behavior. - Ability to act as the technical point of contact and SME for MHE vendors, translating operational requirements into interface and application changes. - Extensive hands-on experience with C#, .NET Framework 4.8, multithreading, async/await, and TCP/IP sockets. - Experience with message parsing, custom protocols, and high-volume event processing. - Desktop UI development with WPF, plus Windows Service hosting and deployment practices. - Strong relational database skills and SQL data access patterns across SQL Server, Oracle, and DB2. - Knowledge of ZPL label workflows, logging, diagnostics, and performance tuning. - Experience with Internet Information Services (IIS), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. - Working knowledge of secure coding standards, GitHub repository and branching strategies, and code quality tools such as Sonar. - Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, and Grafana, including alert and notification setup. - Familiarity with publisher/subscriber message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and an understanding of message acknowledgment and idempotent operations. - Strong AI-first mindset. - Experience using AI tools, AI agents, and automation platforms to improve operations, production support, data validation, reporting, testing, and documentation. - Ability to design AI-agent led solutions for use cases such as issue triage, exception monitoring, MHE fault pattern detection, report generation, knowledge retrieval, regression testing support, and operational analytics. - Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, auditability, compliance, and validation of AI-generated outputs. - Demonstrated situational leadership - guiding teams, driving execution, and delivering measurable business value. - Self-driven with strong ownership; comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor. - Ability to facilitate productive discussions across DC operations, business, and vendor stakeholder groups and drive alignment. - Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team. - Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center - Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family. - Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact. - Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale. - Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges. - Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
This role is intended for an experienced Cloud Architect with strong cloud and backend development expertise who enjoys building reliable software systems that integrate with industrial equipment. The Cloud Solutions Architect will implement, deploy, and sustain cloud-connected applications, backend services, software infrastructure, and shared technology platforms supporting NOV's Service Equipment product portfolio. Working closely with engineering leadership and system architects, this individual will translate architectural direction into scalable, production-ready solutions while providing technical mentorship, promoting software engineering best practices, and taking ownership of the reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement of the software platform. 
 Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and support cloud-based software platforms and backend services supporting NOV Service Equipment products. Design, implement, and maintain AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, containerized applications, and production software environments. Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate industrial equipment with cloud services, databases, APIs, and enterprise applications. Troubleshoot complex software, infrastructure, networking, and system integration issues across development and production environments. Establish and promote software engineering best practices including code reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment processes. Mentor software engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and collaborative problem solving. Develop reusable software frameworks and shared platform capabilities that support multiple product lines. Support software validation, release management, and remote deployment activities for production systems. Take technical ownership of assigned software platforms and proactively identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability. 
 Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or applicable experience. Minimum of 10 years of professional software engineering experience developing and supporting production software systems. Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-based applications using Amazon Web Services (AWS). Strong experience developing backend software, REST APIs, databases, containerized applications, and modern software development practices. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote engineering environment. United State travel Visa preferred. 
 Success Factors: Demonstrates technical ownership by taking responsibility for software platforms and driving complex technical issues through resolution. Builds reliable, maintainable, and scalable software systems with a long-term product mindset. Communicates proactively, collaborates effectively across distributed engineering teams, and mentors other engineers through technical leadership. Continuously evaluates opportunities to improve software architecture, development processes, deployment practices, and operational reliability. Approaches technical challenges with curiosity, professionalism, and a commitment to delivering high-quality engineering solutions.

Key Skills: Scalability,AWS Cloud,Reliability,AWS,Rest APIs,Security,API,Cloud

title: Software Development Test Engineer
description:
Role: Software Development Engineer in Test - II Location: IBC Knowledge Park, Bengaluru Reporting to: Manager - SDET Team name: Fullstack 
 About the Team and the Role The Software Team team at Ather is responsible for building, scaling, and validating high-quality software solutions and web applications across the digital ecosystem. This role is for a Software Development Engineer in Test - II who will drive end-to-end testing, build automation frameworks from scratch, address complex testing challenges in low-code platforms, and advocate for quality engineering best practices across fast-paced release cycles. Responsibilities Break down high-level business cases and PRDs into achievable, traceable, and executable comprehensive test suites alongside manual and automated test cases. Design, update, and execute robust, scalable automation scripts across WebApps, APIs, and various operating systems using Playwright or Selenium. Address testing challenges specific to LCNC applications daily, including handling dynamic UI locators, shadow DOMs, and complex third-party API integrations. Own QA metrics and perform deep-dive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on raised bugs while sharing daily/weekly automation updates. Utilize code and test management tools such as GitLab, Jira, or TestRail, and integrate automated test suites into CI/CD execution pipelines. Engage early in design walkthroughs, shift testing processes left, and collaborate closely with developers and product owners to prevent defects before deployment. Track end-to-end releases to ensure they meet quality standards required for rapid Agile sprint cycles. Continuously advocate for QA best practices while operating with high ownership in a fast-paced environment. Experience and Qualifications Bachelors Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. 4 to 6 years of experience with E2E test automation tools. Must Have Competencies Advanced proficiency in building scalable automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright or Selenium WebDriver. Expertise in API testing strategies and tools such as Rest Assured. Strong command over version control systems, with extensive hands-on experience in GIT. In-depth knowledge of core software testing methodologies, debugging, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) techniques. Good to have Competencies Familiarity with Mendix low-code application testing and strategies for testing dynamic applications. Understanding of continuous integration and deployment pipelines within CI/CD delivery models. Experience with test management and issue-tracking platforms such as GitLab, Jira, and TestRail. Exposure to cross-platform testing execution across various operating systems and web applications. 
 Want to know more? 
 At Ather, we’ve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex, and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and re-imagining end-to-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and our Substack. 
 Be You, With Us 
 The Ather story doesn't write itself - our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives - all united by a shared passion to shape the Ather journey.

 Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain embedded software using Embedded C/C++ for automotive applications. Develop and integrate MCU peripherals, drivers, and hardware interfaces. Work with CAN/CAN-FD, LIN, UART, SPI, I2C, PWM, ADC, GPIO, timers, and watchdogs. Implement and integrate application-level control algorithms and embedded functionalities. Develop and debug real-time software using interrupts, timers, RTOS/tasks, and scheduling concepts. Perform software integration, debugging, and issue resolution at bench, HIL, dyno, and vehicle level. Analyze software requirements and convert them into detailed software design and implementation. Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and root-cause analysis. Use debugging and development tools such as Lauterbach, CANoe/CANalyzer, oscilloscopes, and MCU toolchains. Implement diagnostic functions based on UDS / ISO 14229. Participate in code reviews and ensure compliance with MISRA C/C++ and project coding standards. Support static analysis, code quality, software verification, and requirements traceability. Maintain software requirements, design documents, test cases, and development records. Collaborate with Hardware, System, Motor Control, Validation, Functional Safety, and Project teams. Support ASPICE-based software development activities and deliverables. 
 Required Technical Skills Programming: Strong Embedded C; good C++ knowledge is an advantage. Embedded fundamentals: pointers, structures, memory, bit manipulation, interrupts, timers, ADC, PWM, DMA, GPIO, watchdog, reset/start-up, and memory concepts. Automotive communication: CAN/CAN-FD and LIN; good understanding of UDS diagnostics; XCP is an advantage. MCUs: experience with at least one automotive MCU family such as Renesas RH850, Infineon TLE/AURIX, TI C2000, NXP, or ST. Tools: CANoe/CANalyzer, Lauterbach TRACE32 or equivalent, Git, compiler/debugger environments, and static-analysis tools such as Parasoft or Polyspace. Automotive Software Knowledge V-Model software development and software lifecycle activities. Software requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, verification, and traceability. MISRA C/C++ and secure coding practices. Basic to good understanding of Automotive SPICE (ASPICE). Basic understanding of ISO 26262 Functional Safety. Basic understanding of ISO/SAE 21434 Cybersecurity. AUTOSAR knowledge is an advantage.

PWM / SVM and real-time motor-control ISR execution. Resolver and Hall sensor interfaces. Over-current, over-voltage, under-voltage, over-temperature, and other protection functions. CAN-based motor-controller communication and diagnostics. Calibration and measurement using CANape or equivalent tools. Bench, dyno, HIL, and vehicle-level software validation.

title: SDE + Associate Instructor (DSA)
description:
NEWTON SCHOOL OF TECHNOLOGY
 



 SDE \+ Associate Instructor — DSA \& Competitive Programming
 



 Full\-Time  ·  Onsite  · Sonipat
 



**About Us** 




 Newton School of Technology is on a mission to redefine tech education in India. Backed by global investors (RTP Global, Nexus Venture Partners, Kunal Shah, and more), we are building a Tech Institute to solve the employability gap for millions of graduates. Through our campuses at Rishihood University (Sonipat), Ajeenkya DY Patil University (Pune), and S\-VYASA University (Bengaluru), we are creating the next generation of industry\-ready tech leaders.
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a DSA \& Competitive Programming Instructor (SDE \+ Associate Instructor) who lives and breathes problem\-solving. This is a full\-time, onsite role — not part\-time and not online — based at one of our Bengaluru, Sonipat, or Pune campuses. You will spend your days coaching students to think like competitive programmers and build like software engineers. If you are equally passionate about cracking hard algorithmic problems and helping others learn to do the same, this role is for you.
 



 Who You'll Work With
 



 You will join an elite team of problem\-solvers and work directly alongside Deepak Kumar Gour and Ashwin Krishnamoorthy—both ICPC World Finalists: learning from some of the sharpest competitive programming and engineering minds in the country. Together, you will set the standard for how DSA and competitive programming are taught in India.
 



**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Course Development \& Delivery: Design and deliver in\-depth lectures and labs on Data Structures \& Algorithms (DSA), Competitive Programming, and System Design (HLD/LLD), aligned with the hiring standards of top product\-based companies.
* Practical Learning: Run live coding sessions, contest\-style problem\-solving, debugging walkthroughs, and hands\-on projects that help students apply DSA and CP concepts to real challenges.
* Competitive Programming Coaching: Coach students for ICPC, Codeforces, LeetCode, CodeChef, and other contests, sharpening their speed, accuracy, and depth in problem\-solving.
* Mentorship: Provide one\-on\-one and group mentorship through mock interviews, coding assessments, hackathon guidance, and placement preparation.
* Collaboration: Engage with industry professionals for guest lectures, live projects, and curriculum enrichment that bridges academic learning with real\-world practice.
* Innovation \& Research: Continuously update course content with emerging trends in algorithms, system design, and competitive programming platforms (LeetCode, Codeforces, CodeChef, and more).
* Student Success: Empower students to master problem\-solving, build scalable systems, and gain the confidence to excel at top product\-based companies.



**Eligibility Criteria (Must\-Haves)** 




 This is a role for serious problem\-solvers. To be considered, you should meet all of the following:
 


* 0\- 4 years of experience in DSA, competitive programming, and/or teaching (or a strong combination of these). Given the contest for last a few years.
* Codeforces rating of 1800\+ (minimum).
* A proven, demonstrable track record in competitive programming — ICPC, Codeforces, LeetCode, CodeChef, or equivalent.
* Exceptional problem\-solving ability — you can break down hard problems and clearly explain your approach.
* Genuine passion for both competitive programming / DSA and teaching.



 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's / Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from a Tier\-1 / Tier\-2 institute (IITs, NITs, IIITs preferred).
* Strong programming skills in C\+\+, Java, and Python.
* Advanced knowledge of Data Structures \& Algorithms — arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, dynamic programming, recursion, sorting \& searching, and advanced algorithms.
* Solid grasp of System Design (HLD, LLD, microservices, caching, DB scaling).
* Strong communication skills and the ability to engage, inspire, and simplify complex concepts for students.



**Good to Have** 



* Active participation in hackathons, coding clubs, and competitive programming communities.
* Experience organizing, judging, or mentoring at hackathons, coding contests, or student coding clubs.
* 1–2 years of experience teaching or mentoring students / professionals in DSA or Software Engineering.
* Industry experience as an SDE at a product\-based company, building scalable, high\-performance systems.



**Why Join Us? (Perks \& Benefits)** 



* Competitive salary aligned with (or above) industry standards.
* Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with ICPC World Finalists and a team of elite problem\-solvers.
* Access to modern labs, classrooms, and collaborative facilities.
* Direct contribution to India's most innovative tech education ecosystem.
* Collaboration with leading universities and industry experts.
* A chance to shape not just students — but the future of tech education in India.



**The Impact You'll Make** 




 At Newton School of Technology, you won't just teach — you will inspire, innovate, and shape the next wave of engineers and competitive programmers, all while staying at the forefront of problem\-solving and technology.
 



 Please note: This is a full\-time, onsite position based at our Bengaluru, Sonipat, or Pune campus. It is not a part\-time, online, or remote role.
   

  

**An Opportunity to train India’s next competitive programmer!**
