title: Network Software Engineer - Observability & AI
description:
### **Network Software Engineer - Observability & AI**

* JR-163881
* Hybrid

* Bengaluru

* Technology

* Full time

**Who are we?**

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Network Software Engineer to join the Network Observability team within Equinix's platform engineering organization. This role sits at the intersection of network engineering, AI-native development, and Observability platform development. You will design and build intelligent Network APIs grounded in real-time observability data, network asset intelligence, and inventory systems — then expose those capabilities via Model Context Protocol (MCP), API’s, Streams and autonomous agents that power self-service experiences for Equinix customers and internal operators.

  

You will work closely with Network architects, product teams, platform architects, and data engineers to translate raw network telemetry into programmable, AI-consumable services. You will mentor junior engineers and set the technical direction for how network intelligence is surfaced, automated, and governed across Equinix's global infrastructure.

  

What you will build

In this role, you will have direct ownership over a genuinely novel engineering problem: making Equinix's global network intelligence programmable by both humans and AI. Concretely, you will ship:

  

* AI-native Network APIs — high-fidelity, low-latency APIs that expose real-time observability signals and network asset data as structured, agent-queryable surfaces

* MCP Servers for Network Capabilities — production MCP implementations that let any compatible AI agent safely query network health, inspect topology, validate configurations, and trigger network self-service workflows

* Autonomous Network Agents — intelligent agents that help Equinix customers and operators accomplish network tasks through natural language: diagnosing circuit issues, modeling capacity scenarios, and automating routine change workflows

* Observability-Grounded Intelligence — systems that ground every AI inference in live, authoritative network data, ensuring agents operate with current topology, accurate asset inventory, and real-time health signals
  

**Responsibilities**

Requirements Analysis

* Translate complex network and observability requirements into clear API contracts and data models

* Partner with product managers and business analysts to convert network observability use cases — latency anomaly detection, capacity thresholds, topology drift — into actionable engineering requirements

* Evaluate feasibility across the full data stack: streaming telemetry pipelines, asset inventory systems, and AI inference layers
  

  

Software Architecture & Design

* Participate in and drive architectural reviews for AI-native Network API platforms

* Define reference architectures for exposing network intelligence via MCP servers, ensuring agents can safely query, reason over, and act on live network data

* Design systems that integrate observability data sources (streaming telemetry, SNMP, flow data, topology graphs) with inventory and asset repositories as a unified programmable layer

* Lead the design of AI-native Network APIs that serve both human developers and autonomous AI agents as first-class consumers

* Architect MCP tool and resource definitions that expose network capabilities — topology queries, health checks, capacity lookups, change simulations — as structured, agent-callable interfaces

* Design agentic workflows for network self-service: automated troubleshooting, circuit provisioning assistance, and proactive anomaly remediation

* Evaluate and recommend open source frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenTelemetry, gRPC, GraphQL) to accelerate network intelligence delivery
  

  

Development & Coding

* Build production-grade Network APIs in Python or Java that consume observability telemetry, asset inventory, and topology data

* Implement MCP servers that expose network capabilities as callable tools and data resources for LLM-powered agents

* Develop agentic pipelines — using frameworks such as LangGraph or similar — that enable customers to perform network self-service tasks through natural language and structured tool calls

* Integrate across observability stacks (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Kafka, Grafana Loki) and network asset systems to create coherent, queryable data surfaces

* Apply AI-native development practices: prompt-engineered tool definitions, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) from network knowledge bases, structured outputs for agent decision loops

* Participate in peer code reviews and champion standard coding practices across the team
  

  

Testing

* Develop unit and integration tests for Network APIs, MCP server endpoints, and agent tool invocations

* Build test harnesses that simulate agent interactions with MCP-exposed network capabilities to validate safety, accuracy, and latency bounds

* Define testing strategies for agentic systems — including adversarial prompts, tool misuse scenarios, and multi-step reasoning failures

* Recommend and adopt appropriate testing frameworks (pytest, contract testing, LLM evaluation suites)
  

  

DevOps

* Define deployment and release guidelines for AI-native network services, including canary strategies for MCP server rollouts

* Manage environment planning for observability data pipelines, agent runtimes, and network API backends

* Document software configuration management practices and educate cross-functional teams on agentic deployment patterns and MCP lifecycle management
  

  

Software Reliability & Support Engineering

* Maintain and continuously enrich the inventory of production network APIs, MCP servers, agent workflows, and observability pipelines

* Prepare application support documentation covering agent failure modes, tool call error handling, and network API degradation runbooks

* Troubleshoot production issues across the AI-native stack: data pipeline gaps, agent reasoning failures, and MCP tool contract violations
  

  

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

* Collaborate with Equinix customers and internal NOC teams to co-design self-service network experiences powered by AI agents

* Translate customer network pain points — capacity planning friction, manual troubleshooting cycles, slow provisioning — into agent-driven automation capabilities

* Represent Network Observability engineering in cross-functional forums on AI platform strategy and network developer experience
  

  

R&D & Innovation

* Continuously evaluate emerging AI and networking technologies: new LLM capabilities, MCP protocol evolution, network foundation models, and vector-native data systems

* Prototype and evaluate AI-native approaches to network observability: anomaly detection agents, natural language network queries, and predictive capacity agents

* Contribute to Equinix's internal AI engineering community by sharing learnings from agentic network system design
  

  

**Qualifications**

Skills Required

* 5+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on platform, infrastructure, or network software systems

* Demonstrated experience building APIs that consume observability, telemetry, or network data at scale

* Proficiency in Python and/or Java for backend API and data pipeline development

* Hands-on experience with AI/LLM application development: prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG pipelines, or agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent)

* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — either as a server implementer or consumer — or demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt structured AI tool interface specifications

* Experience with observability stacks: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Kafka, or similar streaming/metrics platforms

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  

  

Preferred

* Networking Certification or demonstratable understanding of network concepts: BGP, MPLS, VLANs, IP addressing and similar

* Familiarity with network inventory systems, CMDB/DCIM platforms, or graph-based topology data stores

* Background in agentic system design: multi-agent orchestration, tool safety guardrails, and structured agent output validation
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate) for RAG-backed network knowledge retrieval

title: Software Engineer II (JVM)
description:
### **Nexla, briefly**

Nexla is the data layer for enterprise AI. We give AI apps and agents the connectivity, context, and governance to work across more than 1,000 enterprise systems in real time, and we process over a trillion records a month doing it. DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, Instacart, and LiveRamp run mission-critical data on us. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running. Founded 2016, remote-first, headquartered in San Mateo.

Our values are short and we actually use them: Have Empathy. Be Curious. Be Intellectually Honest. Achieve Excellence. Remember to Relax.

**Role**  
You would work on the backend systems that move data through Nexla: JVM services, the streaming runtime on Kafka, and the distributed processing underneath it. Production Java every day. You take a problem, shape the design, build it, and own it through deploy and on-call. You debug it when it breaks. Small, focused team, which is why the ownership is real rather than nominal. This role sits closest to the integration layer, where the platform meets everything outside it, so the problem below is the one you would live in.

**What you'll own**

* Core framework features, designed and shipped by you. Schema evolution, pagination, rate limiting, circuit breaking, and the automated retries and self-recovery that keep pipelines running without a human watching. The SDKs and interfaces other teams build on sit here too: you write them, document them, and use them yourself.
* The streaming and processing path in production. Kafka, Spark, and Flink workloads, checkpointing, backpressure, and failure recovery. You operate what you build.
* Design decisions inside your scope, and a real voice in the ones above it. Multi-tenancy, concurrency, and latency show up in almost everything here, and you would be expected to have views on the tradeoffs rather than only implementing someone else's.
* The hard debugging. Trace failures across Kafka clusters, distributed runtimes, and flaky third-party APIs, fix them, then build the guardrails so they do not come back.

*Roughly 70% building and shipping, 15% design and technical discussion, 15% code review and the RFCs, runbooks, and docs that come with it.*

**The hard problem**  
Our platform integrates with more than a thousand external systems, each with its own schema quirks, auth scheme, rate limits, and retry semantics. The framework problem is the N+1 one: making the thousandth integration as cheap to add as the tenth. That means absorbing the differences into the abstraction rather than special-casing them, while the data underneath keeps moving at production volume.  
  
**Must-Haves**

* 5 to 8 years of software engineering, with some of it on backend platforms, services, or SDKs rather than only end-user applications.
* Strong Java. You understand JVM memory management, concurrency models, and non-blocking I/O, and you can work your way to the cause of a thread starvation issue from a heap dump.
* Hands-on experience with distributed systems in production: Kafka, Spark, Flink, or similar. You have run them, not only built against them.
* Comfort with the modern data stack and the protocols around it: Snowflake, Databricks, gRPC, GraphQL, webhooks, and CDC.
* You have owned production systems and know what good operational discipline looks like.
* You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.

**Bonus points**

* Contributions to open-source data projects such as Airbyte, Flink, Debezium, or Arrow.
* Time at an iPaaS or ELT company: MuleSoft, Fivetran, Informatica, Airbyte, or similar.
* Deep Kubernetes and cloud-native experience, including Strimzi for Kafka.
* Security architecture: OAuth 2.0, mTLS, and encrypted credential management at scale.

**You'll thrive here if**

* You want ownership and will take it. You write code every day and you carry what you ship, through deploy and on-call.
* You are comfortable defining scope on the fly and shipping before the full picture is clear.
* You would rather build the guardrail than fix the same failure twice.
* You raise the quality of what is around you through review and pairing, not just the quality of what you write yourself.

*One thing to be clear about: our product definition is still moving as AI reshapes data integration, and the platform has to move with it. If you want a stable, well-defined surface to work on, this is not it.*

**How we hire**  
Four conversations, about two weeks end to end.

* **Coding.** Working through real code rather than a puzzle.
* **Low-level design.** How you structure a system at the class and interface level, and the tradeoffs you would defend.
* **High-level design.** Distributed systems design on a problem close to what we run in production.
* **Hiring Manager.** Ownership, clarity of thinking, and how you actually use AI in your work.

**On AI in the coding round.** Use it the way you would on the job, ours or anyone else's. We build AI tooling and we expect you to use AI tooling, so watching you work without it would tell us nothing useful. What we dig into is your judgment: what you delegated, what you verified, and what you threw away.

*You will hear from us either way.*  
  
**The practical stuff**  
Bengaluru, hybrid, 2 days a week in office. Compensation includes base salary and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title. You will need to overlap with morning Pacific hours for syncs, design reviews, and collaboration with our US-based leadership and engineering teams.

**Worth a look before you apply**

* **What we are building now.** MCP Studio and Express, our two newest bets.
* **Who uses us, and why.** nexla.com/customers
* **The product in engineer terms.** docs.nexla.com
* **Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax" seriously.** Read the founder story
* **Everything else.** nexla.com · Blog · All open roles

### **Why Nexla? Why now?**

A few large companies - DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably.

The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it." That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer." That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone.

A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one.

That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express.dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires.

The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

title: Software Engineer - Model API Platform
description:
**About Sarvam**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC and LIC.

**About the role**

Sarvam's model APIs (ASR, TTS, Vision, LLM, Translate) are how developers and enterprises ship products on our foundation models. The platform handles tens of millions of API calls every day, over HTTP and WebSockets, with metering, billing, prepaid wallets and rate-limiting all part of the same stack.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to own major parts of this platform end to end, working closely with the Staff Engineer who leads its architecture. You will take an area such as speech to text pipeline,or text to speech pipeline, and be accountable for its reliability, performance and end-to-end latencies. This role is for someone who is obsessed with latencies, optimizes services and network paths to shave off milliseconds, ships fast, reasons from first principles, and treats AI as the default way to get engineering work done.

**What you will do**

**Own a platform area end to end**

* Own one or more major parts of the platform, such as the WebSocket streaming layer, a speech recognition pipeline, or text to speech pipeline: build, operate and improve them.
* Turn loosely defined goals into RFCs, milestones and shipped results, and write down the decisions and trade-offs.
* Be accountable after launch: on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis and follow-through on fixes.
* Make the call when a decision is needed, and own the outcome.
* Obsessed with latencies, dissecting existing services to understand the system, and tuning the right knobs to optimize performance.
* Bring services across without regressions in customer-facing APIs, latency or reliability.

**Build real-time and model-serving pipelines**

* Build and operate streaming infrastructure: WebSocket connections, long-lived sessions queue-based batch processing, backpressure and low-latency model invocation.
* Engineer audio pipelines: TTS chunking around model context limits, sample-rate conversion and format encoding, and VAD-based silence detection for ASR.
* Hold your services to sub-100ms latency SLOs in a multi-tenant environment, and know where every millisecond goes.

**Think in systems and from first principles**

* Reasons from constraints: latency budgets per hop, throughput, cost per request, failure modes and tenant isolation.
* Use back-of-the-envelope estimates to decide what to build, what to optimize and what to leave alone.
* Prefer simple designs you can fully explain over clever ones you cannot.
* Build in observability from day one: logging, metrics and tracing that let anyone debug production quickly.

**Raise the bar for the team**

* Strengthen the integration testing harness so the team can ship fast without breaking customer-facing APIs.
* Partner with the Inference and MLOps teams on making model serving fast, reliable and operable.
* Mentor junior engineers through RFC reviews, code review and pairing.
* Practice design-first, documentation-first engineering: RFCs before code, no tribal knowledge.

**What we are looking for**

* 4–6 years of building and operating production backend systems.
* At least one service you owned end to end under real load, including what broke and what you changed.
* Strong distributed-systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, queues, caching, consistency and failure modes.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput services, and comfort reasoning about p95 and p99 latency.
* Solid fundamentals with a relational database and a cache, such as PostgreSQL and Redis: schema design, query performance and caching strategy.
* Fluency in at least one backend language and willingness to work in both Python and Golang.
* Experience running services with containers, CI/CD and production monitoring.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI tools in your engineering workflow, with concrete examples of what you automated or sped up.
* A bias for action: fast on reversible decisions, careful on irreversible ones.
* Clear writing, especially RFCs and design docs that others can act on.

**Good to have (not required)**

* Voice AI or real-time audio experience: WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming ASR or TTS, or audio processing with FFmpeg or pyav, codecs, sample rates and VAD.
* Production experience in Go, or in Python with FastAPI.
* Experience serving LLM, ASR, TTS or vision models in production.
* Experience building metering, billing, wallet or payments infrastructure.
* Running services on Kubernetes in production.
* Time at an early- or growth-stage startup.

**Why Sarvam**

* A fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, with real population-scale impact.
* Researchers, engineers, builders and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar.
* High ownership and high impact from day one.
* AI-first in everything, from how we build and ship to how we think about problems

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **About Okta**

Okta is an enterprise grade identity management service, built from the ground up in the cloud and delivered with an unwavering focus on customer success. With Okta you can manage access across any application, person, or device. Whether the people are employees, partners, or customers, or the applications are in the cloud, on premises, or on a mobile device, Okta helps you become more secure, make people more productive, and maintain compliance.

The Okta service provides directory services, single sign-on, strong authentication, provisioning, workflow, and built in reporting. It runs in the cloud on a secure, reliable, extensively audited platform and integrates deeply with on premises applications, directories, and identity management systems.

### **About the Team**

The Data Platform team is responsible for the foundational data services, systems, and data products for Okta that benefit our users. Today, the Data Platform team solves challenges and enables:

* Streaming analytics
* Interactive end-user reporting
* Data and ML platform for Okta to scale
* Telemetry of our products and data

Our elite team is fast, creative and flexible. We encourage ownership. We expect great things from our engineers and reward them with stimulating new projects, new technologies and the chance to have significant equity in a company. Okta is about to change the cloud computing landscape forever.

### **About the Position**

This is an opportunity for experienced Software Engineers to join our fast growing Data Platform organization that is passionate about scaling high volume, low-latency, distributed data-platform services & data products. In this role, you will get to work with engineers throughout the organization to build foundational infrastructure that allows Okta to scale for years to come. As a member of the Data Platform team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and deploying the systems that power our data analytics and ML. Our analytics infrastructure stack sits on top of many modern technologies, including Kinesis, Flink, ElasticSearch, and Snowflake.

We are looking for experienced Software Engineers who can help design and own the building, deploying and optimizing the streaming infrastructure. This project has a directive from engineering leadership to make OKTA a leader in the use of data and machine learning to improve end-user security and to expand that core-competency across the rest of engineering. You will have a sizable impact on the direction, design & implementation of the solutions to these problems.

* Work with engineering teams, architects and cross functional partners on the development of projects, design, and implementation
* Conduct and participate in design reviews, code reviews, analysis, and performance tuning
* Coach and mentor engineers to help scale up the engineering organization
* Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack

* 4+ years of experience of software development

* Proficient in at least one language while comfortable in more than one of the backend languages, preferably Java or Typescript, Ruby, GoLang, Python.

* Demonstrable knowledge of computer science fundamentals with strong API Design skills.
* Comfortable working on a geographically distributed extended team. Brings the right attitude to the team: ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and customer focus.
* Track record of delivering work incrementally to get feedback and iterating over solutions.
* Comfortable in React or similar front-end UI stacks; if not comfortable yet, you are willing to learn

### **Nice to have**

* Experience using a cloud-based distributed computing technologies such as
* + Messaging systems such as Kinesis, Kafka
  + Data processing systems like Flink, Spark, Beam
  + Storage & Compute systems such as Snowflake, Hadoop
  + Coordinators and schedulers like the ones in Kubernetes, Hadoop, Mesos
* Maintained security, encryption, identity management, or authentication infrastructure
* Leveraged major public cloud providers to build mission-critical, high volume services
* Hands-on experience in developing Data Integration applications for large scale (petabyte scale) environments with experience in both batch and online systems.
* Contributed to the development of distributed systems or used one or more at high volume or criticality such as Kafka or Hadoop

* B.E or B.Tech or MCA

At Undocked, we help companies excel in e-commerce by delivering bespoke optimizations and cutting-edge analytics. Our experiences in retail and supply chain product strategy, technology and operations have helped organizations succeed in their e-commerce and digital transformation journeys.

We are seeking a Java Developer with strong hands-on Kafka and microservices experience to design and build event-driven, scalable backend services for retail and supply chain platforms. A key aspect of this role is the ability to develop and troubleshoot complex distributed systems.

title: Associate - Software Engineer Investment Systems and Integration (.Net Engineer)
description:
**Investment and Trading Technology**
**Job Description**
**Our Company**
As a part of Brookfield’s $416B credit platform, Oaktree is a premier credit manager emphasizing an opportunistic, value-oriented, and risk-controlled approach to investing across credit, equity, and real estate.
  
  
Oaktree is committed to cultivating an environment that is collaborative, curious, inclusive and honors diversity of thought. Providing training and career development opportunities and emphasizing strong support for our local communities through philanthropic initiatives are essential to our culture.
  
  
Oaktree is wholly owned by Brookfield, a leading global investment firm with more than $1 trillion in assets under management. Brookfield owns and operates high-quality businesses and real assets that provide essential services and form the backbone of the global economy. It invests on behalf of institutions and individuals around the world across infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity, real estate, and credit.
  
  
For additional information, please visit Oaktree’s website at http://www.oaktreecapital.com/
  
  
**Work Mode:**
Hybrid (3/2)
  
  
**Shift timings:**
1PM-10PM or 2PM-11PM
  
  
**Role purpose.**
We are seeking a senior engineer to build new applications, modernize existing platforms, and design integrations across our investment technology environment. The role will deliver cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure and will also help connect the Charles River Development investment management platform with internal and external systems.
  
  
**Core expertise**

* NET engineering, application development and modernization, systems integration, messaging, Microsoft Azure

**Domain**
Investment management, order management, trading, compliance, and investment data
  
  
**Platform Experience**
Broad investment technology experience; Charles River IMS or CRD experience is highly desirable
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support new applications for portfolio management, trading, compliance, risk, data, and other investment technology functions.
* Modernize existing applications by improving architecture, user experience, scalability, maintainability, security, deployment, and cloud readiness.
* Build secure and resilient applications and services using C#, modern .NET, REST APIs, SQL, and Azure-native technologies.
* Design and develop integration services connecting CRD and other investment platforms with security master, accounting, data, risk, reporting, and external service providers.
* Develop event-driven and message-based integrations using technologies such as Azure Service Bus, Event Hubs, Kafka, MQ, or comparable enterprise messaging platforms.
* Implement integrations using APIs, message queues, database interfaces, managed file transfer, SFTP, and batch processes when appropriate.
* Support investment-industry protocols and workflows, including FIX, SWIFT, trade and order messages, positions, cash, security reference data, allocations, and settlement instructions.
* Partner with investment teams, business analysts, CRD, implementation consultants, and internal engineering teams to translate business workflows into supportable technical solutions.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, data contracts, error handling, reconciliation, observability, and operational controls.
* Troubleshoot production issues across interconnected systems, identify root causes quickly, and implement durable fixes.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, code reviews, automated testing, CI CD pipelines, cloud security, and engineering standards.
* Use firm-approved AI-assisted development tools to accelerate solution design, coding, testing, documentation, application modernization, troubleshooting, and code review while maintaining security, data protection, and human oversight.
* Create clear technical documentation, interface specifications, support procedures, and transition materials.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* Eight or more years of software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on work with enterprise systems integration.
* Strong C# and .NET development skills, including service design, asynchronous programming, dependency injection, testing, performance tuning, and production support.
* Experience designing and delivering enterprise applications using sound architecture, reusable components, automated testing, and maintainable engineering practices.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including several of the following: App Service, Functions, Service Bus, Event Hubs, API Management, Key Vault, Azure SQL, SQL Managed Instance, Storage, Data Factory, Monitor, Application Insights, or Kubernetes.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, messaging patterns, event-driven architecture, integration security, identity, encryption, retries, idempotency, and fault tolerance.
* Experience with SQL Server, data modeling, query optimization, stored procedures, and high-volume transactional or investment data.
* Experience building CI CD pipelines and automated tests using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tooling.
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants and agentic development tools across the software development lifecycle, with the ability to evaluate, test, secure, and take ownership of AI-generated code.
* Ability to diagnose complex issues that span applications, messages, networks, databases, and external vendors.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work directly with global technology and investment stakeholders.

**Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on experience with Charles River IMS or CRD, particularly interfaces, data services, order and trade workflows, compliance, positions, cash, security master, or downstream integration.
* Experience with another institutional investment platform such as Aladdin, SimCorp, Bloomberg AIM, Allvue, or a comparable OMS or PMS.
* Experience modernizing legacy desktop or monolithic applications into web-based, service-oriented, or cloud-native solutions.
* Experience using AI to analyze and modernize legacy applications, generate automated tests, improve technical documentation, identify defects, and increase developer productivity.
* Experience with React, TypeScript, AG Grid, or another modern web application framework is beneficial.
* Knowledge of public fixed income, bank loans, derivatives, foreign exchange, or private credit workflows.
* Experience integrating with custodians, accounting platforms, market data providers, trading venues, data lakes, or enterprise reporting platforms.
* Familiarity with Azure landing zones, infrastructure as code, containers, Kubernetes, and modern observability practices.
* Experience operating business-critical investment systems with global users and time-sensitive trading or compliance processes.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Rapidly develops a working understanding of the firm’s investment workflows, applications, data, and technology landscape.
* Delivers valuable new applications and practical modernization improvements to existing platforms.
* Delivers reliable, secure integrations that are observable, supportable, and reusable across the platform.
* Reduces manual file handling, point-to-point dependencies, and recurring production issues.
* Becomes a trusted technical partner to investment, trading, compliance, operations, and data teams.
* Raises engineering quality through strong coding practices, documentation, automation, and thoughtful technical leadership.

Candidate Profile
  
  
The strongest candidate will combine deep engineering ability with practical integration experience and an understanding of how investment systems exchange orders, trades, positions, cash, securities, and compliance data. This is a broad investment technology engineering role. CRD experience is highly desirable, but the candidate must also be capable of building new applications and modernizing existing ones using .NET and Azure.

title: Principal Application Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced Principal Platform Software Engineer to provide technical leadership within the AI Platform and Productivity Engineering team. You will drive AI innovation by architecting, developing, and delivering platform capabilities and applications that improve employee productivity across Oracle.
  
  
This role will lead the technical design and implementation of AI control plane and data plane services, Codex enablement, AI plugins and skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools, GPT integrations, memory capabilities, and model routing. You will design and develop backend services and APIs, integrate AI models with enterprise systems, and establish reusable patterns for employee support, knowledge discovery, task automation, and collaboration.
  
  
Working with engineers, product managers, security teams, and partner organizations, you will translate complex requirements into practical technical solutions and guide projects from prototyping through production operation. You will establish architecture and engineering standards, lead design reviews, resolve complex technical issues, and mentor engineers while remaining actively involved in implementation.
  
  
Lead the design of AI cost, token, and usage intelligence capabilities, including telemetry, cost attribution, forecasting, token budgets, threshold alerts, and model-cost optimization. These capabilities will help teams evaluate AI investment and scale adoption safely and efficiently.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, development, integration, and operation of secure, scalable AI platforms, enterprise applications, backend services, and APIs.
* Drive technical delivery across multiple teams, clarify requirements, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies and technical blockers.
* Define and implement AI control plane and data plane architecture, Codex integrations, memory capabilities, and model routing.
* Architect and develop reusable AI plugins, skills, GPT integrations, MCP servers and tools, and enterprise AI workflows.
* Establish technical guidance for integrating AI models with enterprise applications, data sources, and services, including authentication, authorization, and access controls.
* Use AI development tools to accelerate engineering delivery and establish practices for validating generated code and maintaining software quality.
* Lead architecture and code reviews, contribute to complex implementations, and mentor engineers on design, debugging, testing, and operational practices.
* Define runtime, middleware, and API standards that support interoperability and multi-tenant scale, including versioning, compatibility, deprecation, and safe rollout practices.
* Establish automated testing and AI evaluation approaches that assess functionality, output quality, security, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Diagnose and resolve complex cross-service issues, guide performance optimization, and translate employee and stakeholder feedback into product improvements.
* Drive shared observability, service-level objectives, capacity planning, resilience, and operational improvements across AI workloads.
* Lead the design and delivery of AI usage telemetry, cost attribution, forecasting, token budgets, threshold alerts, and reporting that supports informed investment decisions.
* Define and implement model selection and usage controls that balance cost, quality, risk, and performance.
* Establish token and context optimization patterns, including caching, context management, and workload-specific routing.
* Create architectural guidance, migration plans, and adoption playbooks that improve platform consistency and make shared AI capabilities easier to adopt.

**Minimum Job Qualifications Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) or another bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Information Systems, Information Systems, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field, and at least 7 years of software development experience.
* 7+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable distributed systems, backend services, APIs, developer platforms, or cloud services.
* 7+ years of experience developing or operating applications on cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* 7+ years of programming experience in one or more languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript or Go.
* 7+ years of experience with relational or NoSQL databases, including data modeling, querying, and integration with backend services.
* Experience leading technical design and delivery across teams, reviewing architecture, and mentoring engineers.
* Experience with API design and integration, automated testing, secure coding, complex debugging, and performance optimization.
* Experience operating production services, including observability, logging, monitoring, incident response, service reliability, and capacity planning.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, architecture, security, product, and business stakeholders to deliver shared platform capabilities.

**Preferred Skills: AI Engineering and Platform Development**

* Experience architecting, developing, or operating AI-enabled applications, generative AI platforms, developer tools, or enterprise productivity solutions.
* Experience using Codex or similar AI coding tools and establishing engineering practices for their effective use.
* Experience with LLM application patterns, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, agents, memory, evaluations, and model routing.
* Experience designing AI control plane and data plane services, reusable plugins, skills, GPT integrations, and enterprise AI enablement platforms.
* Experience designing and developing MCP servers and tools that connect AI applications and agents with enterprise APIs, backend services, and data sources, including authentication, authorization, testing, and observability.
* Experience implementing AI governance, security, privacy, model-access controls, and policy-based model selection.
* Experience establishing AI evaluation frameworks and production monitoring for quality, task completion, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Experience with AI cost optimization, including token and context management, usage telemetry, cost attribution, forecasting, budgeting, caching, and model-performance optimization.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.  
  
WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.  
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.  
  
As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.  
  
We are looking for software engineers with 5+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.  
  
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance of software systems consisting of multiple features, ensuring solutions are scalable, extensible, and secure.
* Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating trade-offs across scalability, maintainability, performance, and security, and guide future technology choices that align with business goals.
* Collaborate with engineers on related teams to define system interfaces, resolve cross-team dependencies, and create the right checkpoints for successful delivery of multi-engineer projects.
* Drive adoption of engineering best practices across your team, including code quality standards, operational excellence through proper alarms, telemetry, and runbook processes, and effective use of generative artificial intelligence tools to augment productivity.
* Actively mentor and coach other engineers by providing technical guidance on system design, code reviews, and career development, raising the overall capability of your team.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

The Windows + Devices Fundamentals team improves the reliability, performance, responsiveness, battery life, memory efficiency, and overall health of Windows devices. We build and operate the services, telemetry systems, and data pipelines that transform signals from labs and the installed base into trustworthy metrics, actionable diagnostics, and measurable engineering improvements.

We are seeking a **Principal Software Engineer** to define the technical direction for critical Windows Fundamentals data and service capabilities. You will shape architecture across backend services, telemetry platforms, data pipelines, metrics, and diagnostic workflows; solve the portfolio's most complex technical problems; and influence engineering investments that improve Windows health at scale.

This role is ideal for a deeply technical engineering leader who combines distributed-systems and data-platform expertise with solid product judgment, hands-on problem solving, and the ability to align and inspire engineers across organizational boundaries.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Salesforce Agentforce engineering team at Williams-Sonoma, Inc.

• Department: Technology – Agentforce / Supply Chain • Location: Pune / Hyderabad, India • Experience: 5–8 Years • Employment Type: Full-Time

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in Salesforce application development, particularly Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flows, and enterprise integrations.

The role involves designing, developing, and enhancing Salesforce-based solutions, including AI-powered customer service capabilities, case management workflows, conversational agents, and enterprise integrations.

The engineer will work closely with product managers, architects, and cross-functional engineering teams to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent solutions that improve customer experience and business operations.

Impact of the Role

• Independently develop and deliver Salesforce features and integrations. • Contribute to Agentforce and AI-powered customer service initiatives. • Build secure, scalable, and maintainable enterprise solutions. • Take technical ownership of assigned components and features. • Collaborate across engineering, QA, product, and architecture teams. • Continuously improve engineering quality through automation and AI-assisted development.

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

• Salesforce, Salesforce Service Cloud, and Salesforce Agentforce • Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Salesforce Flows • Salesforce Data Cloud, Salesforce Einstein AI, and Prompt Builder • Salesforce Case Management and workflow automation • REST APIs, JSON, OAuth 2.0, and enterprise integration mechanisms • Asynchronous Apex, triggers, batch processing, and platform events • Conversational AI, chatbots, generative AI, and AI agents • Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) • Voice platforms, contact center applications, and conversational AI solutions • Order Management Systems (OMS), customer service applications, and backend microservices • Java, Spring Boot, and microservices • Event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and asynchronous integrations • Salesforce development tools, Git, CI/CD pipelines, debugging, and unit testing • AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Codex

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Application Development

• Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Salesforce Flows. • Build and enhance Salesforce Service Cloud capabilities, including Case Management, workflow automation, and customer service processes. • Develop reusable components, custom business logic, and integrations following Salesforce best practices. • Optimize application performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Agentforce & AI-Powered Solutions

• Develop and enhance Salesforce Agentforce capabilities to support AI-powered customer interactions. • Work on conversational AI solutions, including chatbots, order tracking, customer assistance, and knowledge-based responses. • Configure and integrate Agentforce topics, actions, instructions, and business workflows. • Collaborate with the team to improve agent accuracy, reliability, and customer experience. • Explore opportunities to automate business processes using Agentforce and generative AI.

Enterprise Integration & API Development

• Design and develop integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using REST APIs and other integration mechanisms. • Integrate Salesforce with Order Management Systems (OMS), customer service applications, and backend microservices. • Implement secure API communication, authentication, error handling, and asynchronous processing. • Collaborate with backend engineering teams to ensure reliable data exchange across enterprise systems.

Case Management & Customer Experience

• Develop and enhance Salesforce Case Management workflows, including case creation, routing, assignment, escalation, and resolution. • Implement business rules, validations, approval workflows, and service automation. • Support customer service use cases such as order status, delivery inquiries, and customer support requests. • Work with product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Voice Integration & Data-Driven AI

• Contribute to integrating Agentforce with voice-based customer service and conversational AI platforms. • Support the development of AI-powered interactions across chat and voice channels. • Work with Salesforce Data Cloud and enterprise knowledge sources to improve contextual customer interactions. • Participate in implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge-based AI capabilities.

Engineering Excellence & Ownership

• Take ownership of assigned features from technical design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design sessions. • Develop unit tests and support automated testing to ensure software quality. • Troubleshoot complex application issues and perform root-cause analysis. • Follow CI/CD, secure coding, and engineering best practices. • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity. • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

• 5–8 years of software development experience, with strong hands-on Salesforce development expertise. • Strong proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and Salesforce Flows. • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, including Case Management and workflow automation. • Strong understanding of Salesforce data models, security, permissions, and application architecture. • Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST APIs, JSON, and authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2.0. • Experience with asynchronous Apex, triggers, batch processing, and platform events. • Good understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and software engineering principles. • Experience with Salesforce development tools, Git, CI/CD pipelines, debugging, and unit testing. • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities. • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce, including agent configuration, topics, actions, and conversational workflows. • Exposure to Salesforce Einstein AI, Prompt Builder, and generative AI capabilities. • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, knowledge integration, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). • Understanding of large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI agent concepts. • Experience integrating Salesforce with voice platforms, contact center applications, or conversational AI solutions. • Familiarity with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and enterprise integration architectures. • Experience with Order Management Systems (OMS), customer service platforms, or retail/e-commerce applications. • Knowledge of event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and asynchronous integrations. • Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Codex. • Salesforce Platform Developer I/II, Salesforce Agentforce Specialist, or relevant Salesforce certifications.

Professional Skills

• Strong communication and collaboration skills. • Ability to independently handle moderately complex technical assignments. • Good understanding of business requirements and ability to translate them into technical solutions. • Proactive approach to identifying technical risks and resolving issues. • Willingness to learn emerging Salesforce and AI technologies. • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on quality, reliability, and timely delivery. • Ability to collaborate effectively with distributed onshore and offshore teams.

Educational Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. • 5–8 years of relevant software engineering experience. • Strong practical experience delivering enterprise Salesforce applications.

Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

• Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.

• Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.

• Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.

• Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.

• Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

  

**Williams-Sonoma India Pvt. Ltd.**

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide.

Williams-Sonoma India sourcing office was established in 2013. We are based in Gurugram, India. We are sourcing premium products across all categories of Home Furnishing and recorded double digit year-on-year growth. We have a dynamic team of over 100 members handling versatile vendors across India, Nepal & Bangladesh. We are looking to onboard talented people and create successful professional journey.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Sirion**
Sirion is the world’s leading
**AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform**
. Global enterprises use Sirion to author, negotiate, manage, and extract value from their contracts, using generative AI for extraction, conversational search, and AI-assisted negotiation. With more than 7 million contracts and close to $800B in contract value under management, Sirion is recognized as a leader by Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters.
  
  
**Power the Future of AI & Why This Role Matters**
We are looking for an
**AI Automation Engineer**
with
**4–6 years of Python development experience**
and hands-on experience building
**AI-powered and agentic automation solutions**
. The ideal candidate combines strong Python backend skills with practical knowledge of
**LLMs, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, and workflow orchestration**
.
  
  
As part of Sirion’s Automation team, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent automations in which AI agents reason over contracts and business data, call APIs and tools, and execute multi-step processes end-to-end, with appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Design, develop, and deploy agentic AI automations that use LLMs, tool/function calling, memory, and multi-step reasoning to automate business processes end-to-end.
* Build agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.
* Build AI agents that interact with APIs, databases, documents, web applications, and external tools.
* Design and implement RAG-based solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Integrate OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other LLM APIs into production systems, including prompt engineering and structured outputs.
* Develop scalable backend services and APIs in Python using FastAPI, Flask, or Django REST Framework.
* Build human-in-the-loop checkpoints, guardrails, and error-handling/retry logic so automations run reliably in production.
* Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows where required.
* Evaluate agent quality, accuracy, latency, and cost; monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize automations in production.
* Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis.
* Deploy and maintain solutions using Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* Write clean, maintainable, testable, production-ready Python code.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Stay current with developments in Generative AI and Agentic AI.

**Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table**
**Python & Backend Development**

* 4–6 years of professional experience in Python development.
* Strong understanding of OOP, data structures, exception handling, and concurrency (asyncio/threading).
* Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Django REST Framework.
* Strong experience developing and consuming REST APIs.
* Good understanding of SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL); MongoDB/Redis experience preferred.

**Agentic AI / GenAI**

* Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications beyond proofs of concept.
* Understanding of agentic AI architecture, including planning, tool use, memory, and autonomous multi-step workflows.
* Experience with one or more agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Experience with tool/function calling and integrating external APIs and tools with LLMs.
* Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent.
* Good understanding of prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI tool integrations.
* Experience building multi-agent systems.

**Cloud & DevOps**

* Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with logging, monitoring, debugging, and production deployments.

**Education & Soft Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with RPA or workflow automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or n8n.
* Experience with document AI: extracting and processing data from PDFs, contracts, or other unstructured documents.
* Exposure to Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Experience with task and message queues such as Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka.
* Experience with Kubernetes.
* Experience working with open-source/local LLMs and Hugging Face models.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, and cost optimization.
* Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

**What We Are Looking For**
The ideal candidate is
**strong in Python backend development and has built real AI/agentic automation solutions**
, not just theoretical knowledge of Generative AI. Candidates should be able to demonstrate projects that combine
**LLMs + tools/APIs + orchestration + backend services**
, preferably deployed in production.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law, and we provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. These principles apply across all of our employment practices.

We’d love to hear from you! Apply through the
**Sirion Careers page**
and follow the steps listed there.

• Knowledge of SQL optimization and information retrieval principles (TF-IDF, BM25)

• Advanced RAG patterns: hybrid search, re-ranking

• Knowledge of knowledge graphs and LLM safety/hallucination mitigation

Category Technologies

Vector DB AlloyDB, PgVector, Qdrant

Embeddings OpenAI, Google text-embedding, HuggingFace, Cohere

RAG Frameworks LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow, RAGAS

GCP Services Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Compute Engine

Semantic, Hierarchical, sliding window, recursive, and token-aware chunking strategies; metadata preservation

Index optimization (HNSW, IVFFlat, ScaNN), similarity search algorithms, query performance tuning, hybrid search

End-to-end system design, query processing, relevance ranking, context management, prompt engineering

Retrieval metrics (Precision@k, Recall, MRR, NDCG), generation quality metrics (ROUGE, semantic similarity), production monitoring

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the semantic model architecture at the heart of our data platform. The semantic layer is the single source of truth for business metrics and logic, and it powers critical data products such as Reporting, and Agentic Analytics. This role sits at the intersection of data modeling, platform engineering, and product thinking — you’ll define how data is modeled, governed, and consumed at scale across multiple product surfaces.
  
  
This is a T-shaped role: deep expertise in semantic modeling and data architecture, with the breadth to operate across the full data platform stack at the principal level. You’ll partner closely with our Data Foundations team (which owns ingestion and storage), our Reporting team (which owns the reporting experience), and teams building agentic AI capabilities; ensuring the semantic layer is the performant, scalable, and extensible foundation they all depend on.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Semantic Model Architecture**
: Design and evolve the semantic modeling layer that serves as the single source of truth for metrics, dimensions, entities, and business logic across all data products. Define the standards for how semantic models are authored, versioned, tested, and governed. Evaluate and drive the semantic layer technology strategy (e.g., dbt MetricFlow or equivalent).
  
  
**Data Product Enablement**
: Architect how the semantic layer is consumed across distinct product surfaces such as Reporting (high-performance BI platform for customers), and Agentic Analytics (metadata-rich, discoverable interfaces that enable AI agents to reason over and query the semantic layer). Partner with adjacent teams to ensure the semantic layer meets each product’s unique requirements.
  
  
**Performance & Scale**
: Own query performance, materialization strategies, pre-aggregation patterns, and cost optimization. Ensure the semantic layer is highly performant and scalable as data volumes and consumer demand grow.
  
  
**Platform & Governance**
: Build the semantic layer as a true platform experience: self-service metric onboarding, developer-friendly abstractions, clear documentation, data validation, and governance guardrails. Make it easy for other teams to extend the semantic layer without compromising consistency or quality.
  
  
**Technical Leadership**
: Operate as a technical leader across the Data & Reporting Platform organization. Participate in and drive design sessions across teams. Mentor engineers, manage stakeholder and leadership alignment. Contribute to architecture decisions that span from data foundations through reporting and analytics. Champion high-quality code with corresponding test coverage.
  
  
**AI-Augmented Engineering**
: Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) as a core part of your daily workflow. Drive adoption patterns, build team-specific contexts and workflows, and set the standard for how the team multiplies velocity through AI-assisted development.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering or Data Engineering roles, including experience with large-scale, high-traffic, fault-tolerant systems.
* Deep experience with semantic modeling, data engineering, data lakehouse, and data product development. Track record of building platform-level abstractions consumed by multiple product teams.
* Strong experience with the DBT ecosystem. Experience with semantic layer technologies (e.g., dbt MetricFlow or similar) is highly preferred.
* Expert-level SQL and Python skills. Experience with query optimization, materialization strategies, and performance tuning at scale.
* Experience with modern data platform technologies: Snowflake, ClickHouse, or similar OLAP/columnar engines. Familiarity with Spark and streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis).
* Experience designing APIs and interfaces for domain specific data products.
* Demonstrated proficiency with AI coding tools (eg Claude, Cursor) as part of your regular engineering workflow; not just familiarity, but active daily use.
* Experience leading the architecture and design of systems (architecture, design patterns, reliability, and scaling).
* Strong communication and technical writing skills. Ability to empathize with users and champion for their experience.
* B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science or a related field.

Highly preferred
  
  
  

* Experience building semantic layers that serve both human analysts and programmatic/AI consumers.
* Experience with data governance frameworks, metric versioning, or data product catalogs.
* Familiarity with LLM-friendly data interfaces; designing schemas and metadata that enable AI agents to discover and query data effectively.
* Experience with data validation and quality frameworks (e.g., Monte Carlo, Great Expectations).

To effectively support our international teams, this position requires flexibility to overlap with US working hours as needed.
