title: Oracle Tech Architecture and Middleware-APIGEE Senior Developer-senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS - Delivery Excellence Senior position-APIGEE Senior Developer**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are offering you a demanding role. You will use the most advanced Quality models to implement the newest delivery excellence solutions. This position includes possibility to interact within international environment and work with the most recognizable and influential players in Delivery Excellence space.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting enterprise API solutions using Apigee, ensuring secure, scalable, and high-performing API ecosystems.
* Accountable for API lifecycle management including API design, development, security, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and governance.
* Assess, design, build, test, deploy, and document API integrations between enterprise applications, cloud platforms, third-party vendors, and partner systems.
* Design and implement reusable API proxies, shared flows, security policies, and common integration components.
* Must be comfortable working in Agile methodology, driving technical discussions, gathering requirements from multiple stakeholders, and preparing technical solution specifications.
* Develop API management solutions including traffic management, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, caching, and threat protection.
* Identify root causes of production issues and provide technical solutions for performance optimization and operational stability.
* Forecast technical risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans and communicate them proactively with architects and delivery managers.
* Ensure API governance standards, security compliance, and enterprise integration best practices are followed across projects.
* Contribute to organization assets, accelerators, frameworks, reusable components, and process improvements.
* Deliver Proof of Concepts (PoCs), conduct code reviews, and mentor junior developers.
* Implement DevOps and CI/CD practices for API development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Support integration testing, performance testing, security testing, and user acceptance testing activities.
* Collaborate with business, security, infrastructure, and application teams to deliver scalable API-led connectivity solutions.

**Key skills:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in API Management and Integration projects with at least 3+ years of hands-on experience in Apigee development.
* Must have implementation experience using Apigee in at least 2 enterprise-scale projects.
* Strong experience with Apigee Edge and/or Apigee X.
* Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and API-first architectures.
* Strong hands-on experience with API Proxy development, Shared Flows, Flow Hooks, API Products, Developers, Apps, and Monetization concepts.
* Experience implementing API security standards including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, SAML, API Keys, mTLS, and SSL/TLS.
* Experience with API Gateway policies such as Spike Arrest, Quota, Caching, Threat Protection, Traffic Management, Message Transformation, and Logging.
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript and policy-based API development within Apigee.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications, ERP systems, CRM applications, SaaS platforms, and cloud-native services.
* Experience with REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, Microservices, and Event-Driven Architecture.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting API performance, latency, scalability, and security issues.
* Experience with logging and monitoring tools such as Splunk, ELK, Dynatrace, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, or equivalent platforms.
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools including Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Maven, and automated deployment pipelines.
* Experience working with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (preferred), AWS, or Azure.
* Understanding of API Governance, API Analytics, Developer Portals, and API Lifecycle Management.
* Multi-domain expertise and experience with other integration platforms is an added advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Apigee API Engineer Certification or related Google Cloud certifications are preferred.
* Should be capable of mentoring team members and handling customer interactions independently.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team-player and self-started attitude.
* Ability to create quality process documentation.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in API development, integration, and API management projects.
* Strong understanding of API Security, API Governance, and Enterprise Integration Patterns.
* Experience handling production support, incident management, and root cause analysis.
* Ability to manage technical risks and customer escalations.
* Ability to interact effectively across business, technical, and leadership teams.
* Experience working in Agile Scrum and DevOps environments.

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* Experience with other API Management platforms such as IBM API Connect (APIC) and DataPower will be an added advantage.
* Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or Pub/Sub.
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, and Confluence.
* Exposure to DevOps automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud-native architectures.
* Knowledge of SDLC, Waterfall, Agile, SAFe Agile, and Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with API monetization and partner onboarding solutions.
* Understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital transformation programs.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Ability to define processes for teams.
* Experience in project audits and reviews.
* Ability to analyse risks and metrics of projects.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY ServiceNow practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are looking for a passionate and experienced
**Senior Salesforce Developer**
to join our growing team and play a key role in building a next-generation
**Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**
powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, and MuleSoft.
  
  
This role is ideal for
**strong Individual Contributors (ICs)**
who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, building scalable enterprise solutions, and continuously learning emerging technologies. You will have the opportunity to shape innovative service experiences while working across Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, and enterprise integration ecosystems.
  
  
If you are someone who thrives in a hands-on development role, enjoys taking ownership, and wants to be part of an organization on a strong growth journey, this role is for you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting a modern Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Build intelligent service experiences leveraging Agentforce, conversational workflows, AI-driven automation, and enterprise service management capabilities.
* Design and develop scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, and Salesforce APIs.
* Drive the implementation of service management processes including incident, request, knowledge, change, and employee support workflows.
* Develop reusable and scalable integration frameworks using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and API-led connectivity patterns.
* Integrate Salesforce with enterprise applications including ITSM, HR, collaboration, monitoring, knowledge, and business platforms.
* Design and implement conversational experiences that enable autonomous issue resolution, intelligent routing, and self-service capabilities.
* Partner with architects, product owners, business stakeholders, and AI teams to define and deliver innovative business solutions.
* Contribute to technical architecture decisions, design reviews, code quality standards, and platform governance.
* Optimize application performance, scalability, security, and maintainability across Salesforce and integration ecosystems.
* Mentor junior developers through technical guidance, code reviews, and best-practice adoption while remaining a hands-on contributor.
* Stay current with Salesforce innovations including Agentforce, AI capabilities, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and enterprise automation technologies.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 5 to 8 years of Salesforce development experience.
* Strong hands-on expertise in:

+ Sales Cloud
+ Service Cloud
+ Experience Cloud

* Deep understanding of:

+ Apex Development
+ Lightning Web Components (LWC)
+ Salesforce Flows
+ SOQL/SOSL
+ Platform Events
+ REST/SOAP APIs

* Strong experience with Salesforce integrations and enterprise application connectivity.
* Experience designing scalable and maintainable Salesforce solutions.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data architecture, sharing models, and governance.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps-driven delivery environments.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) or IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions.
* Experience with MuleSoft and API Management.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I & II certifications.
* Experience leading technical workstreams and driving development best practices.

**Added Advantage**

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce.
* Experience building conversational AI solutions, copilots, virtual assistants, or agentic workflows.
* Exposure to Generative AI, prompt engineering, RAG-based architectures, and AI-powered service automation.
* Experience working on Digital Transformation or Enterprise Automation initiatives.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking professionals who:
  
  

* Are passionate technologists and lifelong learners.
* Prefer to grow as strong Individual Contributors while influencing technical direction.
* Enjoy building products and platforms rather than simply implementing requirements.
* Are excited by the potential of Agentforce, AI, Conversational Platforms, and Intelligent Automation.
* Take ownership, demonstrate accountability, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
* Want to be part of a growing organization where innovation, learning, and impact are highly valued.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on a strategic enterprise initiative focused on building a Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Gain hands-on exposure to Agentforce, MuleSoft, AI, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Enterprise Automation.
* Be part of a high-growth organization where your contributions directly influence the platform's success.
* Collaborate with talented architects, engineers, and business leaders solving business-critical challenges.
* Accelerate your career through continuous learning, innovation, and exposure to cutting-edge Salesforce technologies.
* Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.

**Join Us**
If you are a
**Senior Salesforce Developer**
looking to deepen your technical expertise, embrace AI-driven innovation, and contribute as a high-impact Individual Contributor while growing with a rapidly expanding organization, we would love to hear from you. Together, we are building the future of
**Conversational Agentic ITSM on Salesforce**
.
  
  
**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.
  
  
****Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion****
At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.
  
  
Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.
  
  
We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.

It has come to our attention that unauthorized individuals and entities are impersonating Milestone Technologies, Inc. on various job boards/portals,
**specifically Naukri.com and Linkedin.com**
**Please be advised of the following official Milestone Technologies recruitment policies:**
**Official Communication Channels**
All legitimate email communications from our recruitment team will originate ONLY from the domains:
**@milestone.tech.**
We do not use generic email services (e.g. @gmail.com, @yahoo.com, @outlook.com) or unofficial third party messaging apps to conduct formal business.
  
  
**No Recruitment Fees**
Milestone Technologies never requests any form of payment, "security deposit", "laptop/equipment fee", or "processing fee" at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any request for money in exchange for an interview or job offer is a scam.

title: Senior Agentic AI Developer
description:
**Company Description**

Passio Communications is a 360-degree integrated marketing agency where passion, creativity, and innovation drive branding and digital experiences. The team brings together digital marketing specialists, branding experts, and web design professionals to help clients grow and transform their online presence. With strong capabilities in custom web design, UI/UX, packaging, and logo design, Passio serves clients across Dubai, the UAE, and Kerala. The agency focuses on delivering impactful, tailored solutions that align with each brand’s unique needs and aspirations. Joining Passio means contributing to bold, high-impact work that turns brand stories into measurable success.

We are looking for a Senior Agentic AI Developer to join our team and lead the charge in bringing complex multi-agent architectures to life.

**What You Will Do**

* **End-to-End Delivery:**
  Design, build, and ship robust multi-agent systems from the initial client brief straight through to production using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n, or similar.
* **Knowledge Architecture:**
  Architect and construct scalable RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and rich knowledge bases utilizing modern vector databases.
* **System Integration:**
  Connect intelligent agents to enterprise ecosystems—including CRMs, ad platforms, and complex APIs—leveraging advanced tool calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* **Quality & Observability:**
  Set up rigorous guardrails, continuous evaluations, and robust observability pipelines using platforms like Langfuse, LangSmith, or equivalent.
* **Leadership:**
  Lead by example through comprehensive code and prompt reviews, and actively mentor junior developers to elevate the team's capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  2–3 years of professional experience in software engineering and AI development.
* **Core Stack:**
  Strong, production-level proficiency in
  **Python**
  or
  **TypeScript**
  .
* **AI Expertise:**
  Deep, hands-on experience working directly with modern LLM APIs.
* **Track Record:**
  You must have successfully shipped at least one AI agent to real users in a production environment

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Technical Expert** with a strong background in **Java** and **React (preferred) / Angular** . The ideal candidate will be a proactive and dynamic individual who excels at solving complex technical problems and driving development projects to completion. In addition to the core technologies, cloud experience is a plus, Requires a good understanding of Software Architecture , Message queue pattern , microservice development.

As a **Technical Expert** , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and support high-quality software solutions. You will also provide technical guidance, mentorship, and support to other developers.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Full Stack & Software Engineering Expertise**

* **Full Stack Development:** Design, develop, test, and maintain robust, full-stack applications leveraging **Spring Boot (Java)** , and modern frontend frameworks including **ReactJS** .
* **Scalability & Performance:** Develop and optimize backend systems with a core focus on **scalability, performance, and reliability** .
* **API Design:** Design and implement high-quality **RESTful APIs** to meet business requirements, documented using the **OpenAPI specification** , and tested with tools like **Postman** .
* **Microservices & Containers:** Implement resilient **Microservices architecture** and manage application deployment using container technologies like **Docker** and orchestration with **Kubernetes** .
* **Architecture Understanding** : Have good exposure to Message queue based architecture , RabbitMQ , DRY concepts , focus on Code quality , security topics

**DevOps, Testing, & Quality Assurance**
----------------------------------------

* **DevOps Mindset:** Champion a **100% DevOps mindset** and collaborate across teams to manage workflows and deployment.
* **Testing & Quality:** Ensure high-quality code through the development and execution of **unit tests** for Java and React applications, utilizing relevant testing frameworks, and participating in rigorous **code reviews** .
* **Source Control & CI/CD:** Manage source code version control using **Git** and utilize comprehensive DevOps toolsets, including **GitHub** , **Jenkins** , **Containers** , and **OpenShift** .
* **System Deployment:** Deploy highly available, scalable, maintainable, and **monitored systems and services** .

**Data & Database Management**
------------------------------

* **Relational Databases:** Design and implement relational databases using **PostgreSQL** , with strong expertise in writing **SQL queries and stored procedures** for efficient data access.
* **Data Integrity:** Ensure robust **data integrity and performance** across all database systems.

**Agile & Cross-Functional Collaboration**
------------------------------------------

* **Agile Methodology:** Proficiently work within the product delivery lifecycle using **Agile/Scrum and SAFe methodologies** , leveraging tools such as **VersionOne/JIRA** .
* **Product Lifecycle:** Participate in **all phases of the product development lifecycle** , including analysis, design, testing, and integration.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** **Collaborate effectively** with product management and cross-functional teams (e.g., gathering requirements, creating technical specifications, and communicating technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders).
* **Continuous Improvement:** Proactively stay current with the latest technologies, research and evaluate new tools, and support the adoption of **tooling and industry best practices** .

  
  
  

### **Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Full Stack Software Engineer**
--------------------------------

### **Core Expertise & Experience**

* Experience: Engineering graduate with 3-6 years of professional experience in full stack development.
* Fundamental Principles: Strong foundational knowledge in Data Structures, Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), and the SOLID principles.
* Agile Methodology: Proficient in agile development, specifically experienced with SAFe and SCRUM methodologies.

### **Backend & Java Ecosystem**

* Java Proficiency: Strong expertise in the Java programming language (including JDK 8+) and its ecosystem.
* Frameworks & Tools: Extensive experience with the Spring Framework, including Spring Boot and Hibernate, and build automation using Maven.
* Architecture: Proven ability to develop multithreaded, scalable applications and implement Microservices using Java/Spring Framework.
* API Development: Skilled in designing and implementing APIs, including RESTful web services and SOAP-based web services.

### **Frontend & Database Skills**

* Frontend Proficiency: Proficient in front-end development utilizing the React framework, npm, and JavaScript.
* Database Knowledge: Knowledge of SQL databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL).
  + *Good to have:* Specific experience with PostgreSQL and knowledge of NoSQL databases like MarkLogic.

### **DevOps & Collaboration**

* DevOps Tools: Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and setting up CI/CD pipelines.
* Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving skills, high attention to detail, and proven ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
Communication: Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Full Stack Software Developer to join our growing engineering team, building cloud-native SaaS platforms for the insurance industry.
  
You will help design and develop scalable distributed systems and shared services that support multiple products used by insurers, suppliers, police forces and supporting organisations across the UK and internationally.
  
Our platform is evolving towards a modern AWS-native architecture, making extensive use of serverless technologies, microservices and event-driven systems to deliver highly scalable and reliable solutions.
  
You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from architecture and design through to deployment and operational support, collaborating with engineers, product managers and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
  
This role is ideal for developers who enjoy building scalable cloud services, solving complex technical problems, and continuously improving how software is delivered.

  

You will work with technologies such as:
  

* AWS Lambda, Step Functions and API Gateway
* .NET-based microservices
* RESTful APIs and shared platform services
* Event-driven integrations
* CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments
* Scalable SaaS systems used across the UK insurance market

The work you contribute to will help insurers process claims faster, improve decision making and deliver better outcomes for customers.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Design and develop cloud-native SaaS applications and shared platform services
* Build scalable microservices and serverless components using modern development practices
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrations with internal systems and third-party platforms
* Contribute to the design and evolution of distributed and event-driven architectures
* Work across new product development, enhancements and platform evolution
* Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives
* Collaborate with Product Managers to refine requirements, estimate work and deliver features iteratively
* Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes
* Investigate and resolve production issues, providing third-level technical support where required
* Produce and maintain technical documentation and architectural artefacts
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices, tooling and platform reliability

  

Qualifications
  
Essential Requirements
  

* 3+ years professional experience building commercial software systems
* Strong experience developing server-side applications using C# and .NET Core
* Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and JSON-based integrations
* Experience working with SQL databases (Microsoft SQL Server or PostgreSQL preferred)
* Experience building or deploying applications on AWS cloud infrastructure
* Familiarity with microservices or distributed system architecture
* Experience using Git or modern source control systems
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments, such as ADO
* Experience using Visual Studio or equivalent development environments
* A passion for technology and a desire to continuously learn and improve

Highly Desirable
  

* Experience working with AWS serverless services (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway)
* Front-end development experience with Vue.js, React, Angular or modern JavaScript frameworks
* Experience working within Agile / Scrum development environments
* Knowledge of event-driven architecture or message bus technologies
* Experience implementing Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Understanding of software design patterns and clean architecture principles
* Experience building microservices-based platforms
* Familiarity with AI development tools or AI-assisted engineering workflows
* Knowledge of Low Code / No Code platforms
* Experience working within the insurance or financial services industry

What We’re Looking For
  
We’re particularly interested in developers who enjoy building scalable cloud services and shared platform capabilities, and who are comfortable working with modern distributed architectures on AWS.
  
You should be someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, and contributing to the evolution of engineering practices within the team.

  

**Our People, Our Culture**

For more than 50 years, Verisk has helped property and casualty insurers make smarter decisions about risk through AI-powered risk modeling, advanced analytics, and technology solutions spanning the entire policy lifecycle. We are a leading strategic data, analytics, and technology partner to the global insurance industry, guided by core values of learning, caring, and results while maintaining the highest ethical standards as stewards of the industry's most comprehensive datasets. Learn more about Verisk and what we are doing within the insurance industry.

For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.

**Our Culture** : Explore our inclusive, people-first culture that fosters innovation, collaboration, and belonging.

**Awards & Recognition** : See why Verisk is consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work™ around the world.

**Our Businesses** : Learn about the diverse industries we serve — from insurance and energy to financial services and beyond.

**Life at Verisk** : Discover what it’s like to work at Verisk through employee stories, team highlights, and culture moments.

**Careers at Verisk** : Join a global team of problem-solvers and innovators doing meaningful work that’s shaping the future of industries. Whether you're just starting out or looking to take your career to the next level, Verisk offers growth, purpose, and a people-first culture

Let’s build something meaningful together!

All members of the Verisk Analytics family of companies are equal opportunity employers. title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
**Overview**

The Senior .NET Developer is responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, testing, and maintaining secure, scalable, performant, and maintainable software solutions using modern Microsoft technologies. The role requires a strong hands-on engineer with 6–9 years of relevant software development experience, ownership of assigned modules or features, and the ability to contribute to technical design, estimation, code quality, troubleshooting, and delivery outcomes. The role requires strong expertise in C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, Web API, RESTful services, SQL Server or Oracle, and modern engineering practices, with practical understanding of Azure hosting, deployment, monitoring, configuration, and cloud security concepts. The Senior .NET Developer will work closely with technical leads, architects, business analysts, testers, delivery managers, support teams, and other developers to deliver enterprise-grade solutions, mentor junior team members, support production stability, and contribute to gradual modernisation of legacy platforms where required.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Take ownership of assigned modules, features, and technical deliverables while contributing to modern, secure, scalable, and maintainable applications using C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST APIs, Entity Framework or similar data-access patterns, and relational databases.
* Apply and promote engineering best practices including clean coding, SOLID principles, design patterns, unit testing, peer reviews, maintainable documentation, performance awareness, source control discipline, and secure development practices.
* Support technical leads and architects in solution design decisions, technical risk identification, estimation, modernisation initiatives, automation, Azure adoption, cloud readiness, and operational improvement activities.

Operational Management

* Analyse business and technical requirements, challenge assumptions constructively, identify dependencies and risks, and translate requirements into practical technical designs with appropriate guidance from technical leads and architects.
* Design, build, enhance, and maintain application components across backend services, APIs, database objects, integrations, batch/background processes, and front-end features using React or similar modern UI frameworks where applicable.
* Write clean, efficient, reusable, testable, and production-ready code using modern C#, ASP.NET Core, RESTful API patterns, asynchronous programming, LINQ, dependency injection, secure configuration, structured logging, exception handling, and SQL Server or Oracle.
* Develop, secure, and consume RESTful APIs, including validation, authentication and authorisation checks, versioning considerations, API documentation, structured logging, resilient error handling, and integration with internal or external systems.
* Work confidently with SQL Server or Oracle, including complex queries, joins, indexes, stored procedures, execution plans, transactions, data fixes, query optimisation, and troubleshooting production or environment-related data issues.
* Contribute to full-stack delivery using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, including component development, API integration, form validation, state handling, accessibility awareness, and practical usability improvements.
* Create and maintain meaningful unit tests, support automated testing where applicable, review test scenarios, investigate defects, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes that reduce recurrence.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, estimation, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, technical discussions, and delivery planning.
* Support maintenance, enhancement, troubleshooting, and modernisation of existing legacy .NET applications, including .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, Web Forms, WCF, or older enterprise application patterns where required.
* Apply practical Azure knowledge when developing and supporting cloud-hosted applications, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, environment configuration, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Use Git-based source control, branching strategies, pull requests, code review feedback, CI/CD pipelines, build and release processes, deployment controls, and environment promotion practices in line with team standards.

Collaboration & Team Contribution

* Work collaboratively with developers, technical leads, architects, business analysts, testers, delivery managers, support teams, DevOps engineers, and security stakeholders to deliver quality software outcomes.
* Communicate progress, estimates, risks, blockers, trade-offs, and technical considerations clearly and in a timely manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor junior developers, support peer learning, contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing, and help build a positive engineering culture focused on quality, ownership, learning, and continuous improvement.

Governance & Risk

* Ensure development practices align with secure coding, data protection, accessibility, audit, compliance, source control, and information security requirements relevant to enterprise financial technology applications.
* Apply secure cloud development practices including managed identities, role-based access control, least-privilege access, secure application configuration, secrets management, and awareness of basic cloud cost, resilience, and operational risks.

You will build interactive, playable ads, prototypes and reusable creative systems that help our teams test ideas, showcase game mechanics and deliver engaging experiences for User Acquisition campaigns.
  
  

* Build interactive playable ads, prototypes and lightweight game experiences for mobile User Acquisition campaigns
* Translate creative briefs, game mechanics and visual concepts into engaging, responsive and production-ready playable experiences
* Develop playable content using Unity, C#, HTML5, JavaScript/TypeScript and relevant game frameworks
* Work directly with 2D and 3D assets, including characters, environments, UI, animation, VFX, lighting, materials and camera setups
* Adapt and optimize assets from existing game projects for use in lightweight playable experiences
* Make thoughtful decisions around composition, colour, motion, pacing, interaction design and visual clarity
* Create intuitive onboarding flows, gameplay interactions, end cards and calls to action that communicate the core mechanic quickly
* Iterate rapidly on different creative concepts, gameplay variations, visual treatments and performance-driven improvements
* Package and deliver playables for platforms and ad networks such as AppLovin, Unity Ads, Google and other relevant environments
* Optimize experiences for strict technical constraints, including file size, loading time, memory usage, frame rate, draw calls, texture compression and responsive layouts
* Test and debug playables across different devices, screen sizes, orientations and input methods
* Collaborate closely with Creative Strategy, User Acquisition, Production, Engineering, artists and designers
* Help develop reusable templates, components, workflows and tools that increase the speed and consistency of playable production
* Contribute to documentation, technical standards and best practices for playable ads and interactive creative
* Explore the use of AI and automation to accelerate prototyping, asset preparation, iteration and playable production

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3+ years of experience building interactive experiences, game prototypes, playable ads, mobile games or similar creative technology products
* Strong hands-on experience with Unity and C#, or an equivalent game engine and programming environment
* A strong artistic eye and practical understanding of visual composition, animation, color, timing, UI and interaction design
* Experience working directly with 2D and/or 3D game assets and integrating them into interactive experiences
* Understanding of mobile performance constraints, including build size, load time, memory, FPS, texture compression and asset optimization
* Experience working with tools or frameworks such as Cocos, Phaser, PixiJS, PlayCanvas, Godot or other relevant technologies is valuable
* Comfortable taking ownership from an initial brief through implementation, optimization, QA and final delivery
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical teams
* Pragmatic, curious and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where ideas need to be tested and improved quickly
* A portfolio of playable ads, interactive prototypes, games or other relevant creative technology work

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with HTML5, JavaScript or TypeScript, and an understanding of how interactive experiences run in constrained mobile environments
* Experience working with AppLovin, Unity Ads, Google Ads, Meta or other playable ad networks
* Knowledge of User Acquisition metrics such as CTR, IPM, CPI, retention and conversion
* Experience creating or optimizing 3D WebGL experiences
* Experience with Blender, Maya, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Spine or similar creative tools
* Knowledge of animation systems, shaders, particles, lighting, materials and post-processing
* Experience creating responsive UI and interaction systems for different mobile aspect ratios
* Experience building reusable templates, components, editor tools or export pipelines
* Familiarity with Node.js, build automation, Git and basic testing workflows
* Experience using AI tools to support code generation, prototyping, asset iteration or creative production

**About Scopely**
Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
  
  
Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
  
  
Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

* Strong technical leadership and mentoring abilities

title: Staff Software Engineer, Developer Experience
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**About the Team**
------------------

Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service.

FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers.

Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models.

**About the role**
------------------

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. You'll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Set the direction:**

* Define and drive the technical direction for FGA DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team.
* Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community
* Mentor the team's senior engineers, and raise the level of everyone around you.
* Establish how a new team builds software, from design reviews and coding standards to how we test and ship, and set the quality bar.
* Make the calls that are hard to undo: when an API is ready to ship across every language, how it evolves, and when to deprecate.
* Be the voice of developer experience across FGA: partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it.

**Own the Platform:**

* Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from.
* Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting.
* Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples.
* Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions
* Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 8+ years as a software engineer, including time leading the technical direction of a team or a significant area, with or without the title.
* Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/.NET, Python or Java, and the curiosity to work across several.
* Experience building software other developers use: SDKs, API clients, libraries, developer platforms, CLIs or tooling.
* A strong sense of API design and ergonomics, and of how an interface should feel in different languages.
* Clear communication and a track record of influencing decisions across teams and with outside contributors, without relying on authority.

**Nice to have**

* Contributing to, maintaining or leading open source projects.
* Building with code generation tools such as OpenAPI Generator and templating frameworks.
* Designing resilient clients: authentication flows, retries and rate limiting.
* Setting up GitHub Actions and release automation.
* Working in authorization or identity, such as OAuth, RBAC or ReBAC.

Cross-functional leadership and influence.

title: Senior Avaloq Developer
description:
##### **Project description**

We are looking for a Senior Avaloq Developer to design, build and enhance trading and settlement functionality on the Avaloq Banking Suite. You will work on the end-to-end securities trade lifecycle, from order capture through execution, STEX (stock exchange) processing and settlement. A key part of the role is order and settlement pooling: aggregating, allocating and netting instructions efficiently and accurately. You will work with onshore and offshore teams, business analysts and operations stakeholders to deliver robust, compliant solutions for a wealth management client.

##### **Responsibilities**

Design, develop and unit-test Avaloq customisations for trading, STEX and settlement processes in line with the architecture.

Implement and enhance order handling for exchange-traded and OTC products, including order routing, execution, confirmation and booking.

Build and maintain STEX and settlement workflows, covering instruction generation, matching, status handling, fails management and reconciliation.

Apply pooling logic: aggregating orders into block or pooled orders, allocating executions back to underlying client orders, and netting or consolidating settlement instructions where appropriate.

Develop and maintain connectivity with exchanges, brokers, custodians and CSDs/depositories using ISO 20022, SWIFT, FIX and APIs.

Analyse requirements, produce technical designs and estimates, and take part in solution workshops.

Investigate and resolve complex production incidents, performing root cause analysis and delivering permanent fixes.

Support testing cycles (SIT, UAT, regression), release management and deployment activities.

Review code, mentor junior developers and promote best practices in coding, performance and documentation.

Work with Operations, Compliance and Risk teams so solutions meet regulatory and control requirements.

##### **Skills**

Must have

6 to 10+ years in software development, with 4+ years of hands-on Avaloq experience.

Strong working knowledge of the Avaloq securities trading module, covering order management, execution, STEX and settlement.

Practical experience with order pooling or aggregation, allocation and settlement netting in a securities environment.

Proficiency in PL/SQL and the Avaloq development stack (Avaloq Script/AvqScript, Avaloq Workbench, Oracle).

Solid understanding of the securities lifecycle: pre-trade, trade, post-trade, clearing, settlement, corporate actions and reconciliation.

Experience with ISO 20022 and SWIFT messaging (MT/MX) and, ideally, FIX connectivity.

Familiarity with the product range, including equities, bonds, funds, FX and OTC derivatives.

Strong analytical and debugging skills, with experience of performance tuning in high-volume batch and real-time environments.

Experience working in Agile/DevOps teams using tools such as Jira, Git and CI/CD pipelines.

Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with distributed teams across time zones.

Nice to have

Avaloq certification (such as Avaloq Academy certifications).

Experience with crypto asset trading and settlement on Avaloq.

Exposure to Avaloq data extraction and integration approaches, including APIs.

Knowledge of regulatory requirements affecting trading and settlement (for example MiFID II, CSDR settlement discipline).

Experience migrating or upgrading Avaloq versions.

Prior wealth management or private banking domain experience.

title: Senior Developer (Oracle CPQ Developer)
description:
**Overview**  
**About Business Unit:**  
Relied upon by leaders, associates and various verticals within Epsilon, the Finance team plays a key role in shaping our outcome-focused business culture. They devise solutions and provide insights that help keep our business on track, by collaborating and communicating with other teams. Empowered with an excellent ERP and forecasting system, this team of trusted partners support Epsilon India's day-to-day requirements and long-term business goals.
  
  
**About the Role:**  
We are looking for a
  
**Senior**
  
**Oracle CPQ Developer** to join our
  
**Pricing team**. The ideal candidate will be playing a lead role ensuring our partners' requirements are translated into actionable technical designs to be implemented and supported within the Oracle CPQ architecture. The person will work closely with our other developer(s) and pricing operations team to determine how best we can continue to scale our Oracle instance and improve the overall customer experience.
  
  
This role will provide guidance to the junior team members and will work as a liaison between technical, functional, business and system integrator teams.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision, 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* **Product Catalog Ownership:** Ensure that the product catalog within Oracle CPQ is complete and up to date. Define product attributes and classifications that will be used in pricing rules.
* **Create Pricing Lists and Rules:** Define pricing lists and rules in Oracle CPQ including specifying conditions that trigger the application of pricing rules.
* **Technical Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues related to Oracle CPQ, such as system errors, configuration problems, and integration issues. Work with Oracle Support to address system issues.
* **Rule Logic and Formulas:** Use Oracle CPQ's rule engine to implement pricing logic and formulas. Update configurator models and rules to support business requirement changes.
* **Discount Structures:** Set up discount structures to determine how discounts are applied based on Epsilon's overall pricing strategy, including discount levels and thresholds.
* **Ongoing Monitoring and Maintenance:** Continuously monitor pricing performance and gather feedback. Make adjustments and updates to pricing rules as business objectives and product offerings change. Support Oracle CPQ quarterly updates to ensure system stability.
* **System Deployment** - Responsible for deploying monthly code releases to the Production environment, outside of standard US working hours.
* **User Support** - Provide timely technical support to end-users and ensure minimal downtime. Collaborate with teams to implement patches, upgrades, and configurations.
* **Optimization** - Assist in database performance optimization and query tuning. Identify and recommend process improvements for Oracle systems. Stay up to date with Oracle product releases and patches to determine the impact to the business.
* **CPQ Architecture & Strategy Ownership:**  
  Own the end-to-end Oracle CPQ solution architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, and alignment with long-term pricing, sales, and digital commerce strategies. Define and maintain CPQ technical roadmaps.
* **Stakeholder & Executive Partnership:**  
  Act as a trusted technical advisor to Pricing, Sales Operations, Finance, IT, and leadership teams. Proactively translate business strategy into CPQ capabilities and influence prioritization decisions.
* **Technical Governance & Best Practices:**  
  Establish and enforce CPQ development standards, design patterns, and coding best practices. Review and approve solution designs, rule logic, integrations, and release plans to ensure quality and consistency.
* **Release & Change Management Leadership:**  
  Lead CPQ release planning, risk assessment, and deployment strategy across environments. Own rollback plans, production readiness reviews, and post-release validation to minimize business disruption.
* **Mentorship & Team Development:**  
  Coach, mentor, and upskill junior and mid-level developers.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Proven experience in supporting Oracle systems and applications. Experience developing Oracle CPQ, integrations, and developing and implementing data migrations.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the Oracle CPQ platform's core features.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies, as well as hands-on experience in CPQ capabilities.

title: Principal Software Engineer in Test — C#.NET Distributed Systems
description:
**Hyderabad, India | Hybrid — 3 days onsite**
Role Overview
  
  
Nasuni is expanding the DryvIQ engineering team in Hyderabad. DryvIQ brings intelligent content discovery, classification, sensitivity detection, and policy-driven governance to enterprise unstructured data across cloud and on-premises repositories.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Principal Software Engineer in Test (SDET)**
to lead the evolution of test automation architecture and engineering quality across Nasuni's DryvIQ Kubernetes-based distributed application environment.
  
  
This is a
**hands-on principal engineering role**
with C#/.NET as the primary automation development stack. You will own critical architectural decisions, modernize and scale established automation frameworks, and establish engineering practices that improve reliability, testability, and release confidence across teams.
  
  
We're looking for someone who can combine deep software engineering expertise with sound technical judgment and the ability to influence others. You do not need to have built an automation framework from scratch. What matters is demonstrated ownership of complex automation systems and measurable improvements to their architecture, scalability, and effectiveness.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Own the technical direction and architecture of established C#/.NET automation frameworks, improving scalability, reliability, maintainability, and execution efficiency.
* Design and implement reusable test libraries, API clients, fixtures, test-data capabilities, diagnostics, and shared automation infrastructure.
* Define risk-based testing strategies across APIs, microservices, asynchronous processing, integrations, system workflows, and end-to-end scenarios.
* Establish automated validation for Kubernetes-based distributed applications, including deployments, upgrades, service dependencies, recovery, concurrency, and failure scenarios.
* Lead test architecture reviews and influence product designs to improve observability, testability, and defect prevention.
* Partner with Engineering and DevOps to strengthen CI/CD quality gates, execution parallelism, environment reliability, and actionable release feedback.
* Lead root-cause investigations of difficult cross-system failures using logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes evidence, and application behavior.
* Drive improvements in flaky-test reduction, coverage of critical product risks, test execution performance, and diagnostic effectiveness.
* Establish reusable engineering patterns and help other teams adopt them through code reviews, pairing, technical guidance, and collaboration.
* Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test design, code development, debugging, and analysis, independently validating correctness, security, and suitability.
* Develop robust validation approaches for AI-enabled or non-deterministic product behavior, where applicable.

**Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* 9+ years overall Software Engineering Experience with a a focus on QA Automation and Tools Engineering.
* Deep hands-on programming and automation development expertise in C# and .NET.
* Proven experience owning significant architectural improvements to established automation frameworks.
* Strong understanding of software design, reusable components, asynchronous programming, debugging, and maintainable test-code architecture.
* Hands-on experience validating Kubernetes-based, containerized, distributed applications, including microservices and asynchronous workflows.
* Experience designing automated API, integration, system, and end-to-end testing with sound judgment about appropriate testing layers.
* Experience improving CI/CD automation reliability, execution efficiency, test infrastructure, and engineering quality feedback.
* Advanced root-cause analysis skills using logs, metrics, Kubernetes/container evidence, APIs, and system diagnostics.
* Demonstrated technical leadership across teams, including influencing engineering decisions, establishing standards, and mentoring engineers.

**Preferred**

* Python/PyTest experience, especially reusable utilities, tooling, fixtures, or shared libraries.
* AWS or Azure, including EKS, AKS, or comparable Kubernetes environments.
* Enterprise connectors, SMB/NFS, S3, Azure Blob, or cloud/on-premises data integrations.
* Experience with performance, resilience, fault-injection, or failure-recovery testing.
* Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or comparable UI automation tools.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering workflows with disciplined validation.

Ideal
  
  

* Experience leading automation modernization for a complex enterprise SaaS product.
* Demonstrated cross-team adoption of automation frameworks or engineering standards.
* Experience with enterprise storage, content management, data governance, or security platforms.
* Experience validating AI-enabled classification, sensitive-data detection, or other non-deterministic functionality.

**About Nasuni**
Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits.
  
  
As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform—turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration.
  
  
Why Work at Nasuni — Hyderabad
  
  
With Vista Equity Partners' backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders, cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities—combining the pace of a growing product company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor.
  
  
In this role, you'll help
**evolve and scale the automation foundation**
for an increasingly important enterprise product. You'll work at the intersection of cloud, Kubernetes, distributed systems, AI, content intelligence, data governance, and enterprise infrastructure while collaborating with DryvIQ and Nasuni engineering teams globally.
  
  
**Benefits At Nasuni Hyderabad**
As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers
**competitive benefits**
designed to support every stage of your life and career:
  
  

* Competitive compensation programs
* Flexible time off and leave policies
* Comprehensive health and wellness coverage
* Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
* Employee referral and recognition programs
* Professional development and learning support
* Inclusive, collaborative team culture

title: Dynamics 365 CCaaS Developer
description:
Dynamics 365 CCaaS Developer — Job Description

\*\*Experience- 3–5 Years

\*\*Employment Type- Full-Time

\*\*Location- Delhi (Onsite)

About the Role

Today, complaint and service intake is fragmented: Facilities Management runs its call centre on plain telephony with no caller ID or history lookup, and all in-unit tenant work is tracked through messaging groups and spreadsheets rather than any system of record. We are hiring a Dynamics 365 CCaaS Developer to help close that gap — building the contact-centre, IVR, omnichannel and case-routing capability that sits behind Dynamics 365 Customer Service, so that a call, chat or WhatsApp message from a tenant, owner or vendor becomes a tracked case, routed to the right desk (Facilities, Leasing or Sales), the same way a preventive-maintenance job already flows automatically today.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, configure and build contact-centre solutions on Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Omnichannel for Customer Service, covering voice, chat and WhatsApp channels.
* Integrate the CCaaS/telephony platform with Dynamics 365 via CTI, so inbound calls resolve caller identity and case history automatically instead of being keyed by hand.
* Design and build IVR flows and conversational bots (Copilot Studio / Power Virtual Agents) for common tenant, owner and vendor journeys — complaint logging, payment status, service-request tracking.
* Build case-routing and automation workflows (Power Automate, business rules) so an intake case lands with the right desk — Facilities Management, Leasing or Sales — without manual triage.
* Integrate CRM, IVR/CCaaS and backend systems via APIs and webhooks, including the facilities and leasing platforms already in use across the group.
* Configure and extend Dataverse entities, forms, views and business rules to support case management across verticals.
* Monitor call quality, system performance and case SLAs; build and maintain analytics dashboards to track contact-centre KPIs.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the CRM, CCaaS and integration layers, including production incidents.
* Support UAT planning and execution with business stakeholders (Facilities, Leasing, Sales) and translate business requirements into functional, Dynamics-365-aligned solutions.
* Work within an Agile delivery model — sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives — alongside the wider Dynamics 365 programme team.

Required Skills & Experience

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) / Customer Service, including entity, form, view, workflow and business-rule configuration.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering CCaaS/contact-centre solutions — IVR flows, call routing, chatbots — integrated with a Dynamics 365 or comparable CRM.
* Practical experience integrating CRM with telephony/CCaaS platforms and external systems via REST APIs and webhooks.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform: Power Automate for workflow automation, Power Apps / Power Portal, and Copilot Studio or Power Virtual Agents for conversational AI.
* Comfortable working directly in Dataverse — data model, security roles, and case management configuration.
* Experience deploying and supporting cloud-based solutions, including basic monitoring, troubleshooting and performance tuning of contact-centre systems.
* Exposure to Azure services (Logic Apps, Azure Functions) for lightweight integration and automation work.
* Able to translate business requirements (from Facilities, Leasing or Sales stakeholders) into functional configuration without heavy hand-holding.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams — sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives — and comfortable owning a workstream rather than just a ticket queue.
* Clear, confident communication in English, written and spoken, for direct client/stakeholder interaction.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

* Microsoft certification MB-230 (Dynamics 365 Customer Service Functional Consultant) and/or PL-200 (Power Platform Functional Consultant).
* Prior experience with WhatsApp Business API or other messaging-channel integrations into a CRM or CCaaS platform.
* Experience in real estate, property/facilities management, or another asset-heavy service business with a field workforce.
* Exposure to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Copilot or other AI-driven customer-service automation features.
* Experience supporting a live, multi-department contact centre (not only greenfield builds).
* PL-200 (Power Platform Functional Consultant) preferred.

The incumbent will identify suitable funding opportunities and develop proposals for: Research & Development Advanced drone technologies Indigenous drone components Prototyping and product development Testing and certification infrastructure Manufacturing infrastructure Technology commercialisation Defence and dual-use technologies Artificial intelligence and autonomous systems Robotics and swarm technologies Agriculture and precision applications Mapping, surveying and geospatial applications Communication, navigation and sensing technologies Battery, propulsion and power systems Electronics, avionics and flight-control systems Technology transfer and industry-academia collaboration Start-up and MSME innovation programmes Key Responsibilities 1. Government Funding Identification Continuously identify and track relevant Government of India funding schemes, calls for proposals, grants, soft loans, equity/innovation support, challenge programmes and other eligible financial instruments. The role will monitor programmes and institutions including, as applicable: Department of Science & Technology (DST) Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund Technology Development Board (TDB) Ministry of Defence / Department of Defence Production iDEX Innovations for Defence Excellence Technology Development Fund (TDF) Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), where relevant to biotechnology/agri-biotech drone applications Ministry of Civil Aviation Other Central Government Ministries and Departments State Government innovation and industrial-development programmes Government-supported incubators and technology missions Relevant public-sector and development-finance institutions The employee shall verify the current eligibility, funding structure, application window, eligible expenditure, matching contribution requirements, intellectual-property provisions and milestone requirements of each scheme before recommending it. 2. RDI Fund / ANRF Funding Develop a specialised funding pipeline under the Government's Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) framework , including opportunities routed through authorised Second-Level Fund Managers. The position shall: Track RDI funding calls relevant to drones, advanced manufacturing, electronics, AI, robotics and strategic technologies. Identify eligible private-sector, start-up and industry-led projects. Coordinate preparation of technical and financial proposals. Develop project-level funding requirements and milestone plans. Coordinate with authorised Fund Managers and implementing agencies. Maintain documentation required for due diligence and appraisal. Track sanctioned projects, disbursements and utilisation. Ensure that proposals are aligned with the applicable RDI guidelines and financial rules. The RDI Scheme is particularly relevant because the Government has structured it to catalyse private-sector investment in R&D and innovation, with the framework operationalised through ANRF and designated fund managers. R RDI Fund+1 3. Defence Innovation Funding Identify appropriate opportunities under iDEX, TDF and other Ministry of Defence innovation programmes for eligible drone and dual-use technologies. Responsibilities include: Monitoring iDEX challenges and defence problem statements. Identifying technologies suitable for defence applications. Supporting access to testing facilities and defence users where applicable. Tracking procurement/commercialisation opportunities following successful technology development. iDEX provides funding support for eligible innovation proposals and encourages expenditure on R&D, prototyping, pilot implementation and market assessment. TDF is another relevant channel for indigenous defence technology development, including industry-academia/research-institution collaboration. 4. Government Grant Proposal Development Lead preparation of high-quality funding proposals covering: Executive summary Problem statement Technology description Innovation and technology-readiness level R&D methodology Work packages Project milestones Project implementation schedule Human-resource requirements Capital expenditure R&D expenditure Prototype-development costs Testing and certification costs Manufacturing scale-up requirements Domestic value addition Commercialisation strategy Intellectual-property strategy Market opportunity Employment-generation potential Export potential Strategic relevance Risk analysis Financial projections Funding requirement Co-funding/matching contribution, wherever applicable Expected measurable outcomes 5. Funding Strategy for the Drone Manufacturing Hub Develop a 5 year Government Funding Roadmap for the Hub. * Create unit, integration, and process\-level tests and support automated build, deployment, and release pipelines.
* Participate in solution design, code reviews, technical documentation, estimation, sprint planning, and Agile delivery ceremonies.
* Collaborate with business analysts, architects, product owners, developers, QA engineers, and DevOps teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Support production deployments, monitoring, incident resolution, and continuous improvement of workflow services.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex business processes.
* Sound understanding of software engineering principles, reusable design, clean coding, testing, and secure development practices.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders and explain workflow designs clearly.
* Self\-motivated, adaptable, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
* Ability to work iteratively within cross\-functional Agile teams and manage competing priorities.



  





**To qualify for the role, you must have** 



* BTech, BE, MTech, MCA, or an equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

* Experience in financial services, regulated environments, or large\-scale digital transformation programmes.

**What we look for** 



* Professionals who combine hands\-on Flowable engineering expertise with a strong understanding of business processes and enterprise integration.
* People who take ownership, deliver dependable solutions, and proactively improve workflow quality, performance, and maintainability.
* Team players who are enthusiastic about learning and contributing within a fast\-moving, multidisciplinary global environment.
