* Lead the full integration lifecycle—requirements, design, configuration, development, unit testing, system/UAT support, cutover, and hypercare—for Workday feature releases, bi\-annual updates, and project\-based enhancements.
* Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes for Workday integrations (including error handling, retries, and data reconciliation), and drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes for production issues.
* Maintain and optimize data flows between Workday and other enterprise applications (e.g., identity and access management, ATS, compensation, benefits, and data warehouse platforms), ensuring data quality, timeliness, and consistency.
* Establish and enforce Workday integration development best practices, including code review standards, naming conventions, configuration management, and re\-usable integration patterns.
* Create and maintain high\-quality technical documentation (design specs, interface contracts, configuration guides, dependency maps) and provide knowledge transfer to peers, admins, and support teams.
* Proactively identify opportunities to streamline business processes through Workday automation, calculated fields, condition rules, and integration\-driven workflows, and build business cases for proposed improvements.
* Track and evaluate new Workday integration features and product roadmap changes, assess potential impact to LiveRamp’s ecosystem, and lead experiments or POCs to validate value and feasibility.
* Define and track key success metrics (e.g., integration uptime, incident volume/MTTR, data defect rate, batch processing times, and audit findings) and regularly report progress to stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted advisor to HR, FINs, and business stakeholders on Workday data structures, integration constraints, and downstream impacts to reporting, controls, and compliance.
* Apply AI\-assisted development and troubleshooting tools (e.g., code copilots, log analyzers) to speed up integration design, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high quality.
* Analyze integration telemetry with AI/ML techniques to identify recurring failure patterns, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for smarter alerting and auto\-remediation.


******Your Team Will:******
* Partner with People Operations, Payroll, Finance, Security, and other Business Applications teams to build and maintain the core HR technology foundation that powers the full LiveRamp employee lifecycle—from hire to retire. The team owns the Workday platform roadmap for integrations and is responsible for ensuring data flows are accurate, compliant, and resilient across our global systems landscape.
* You will join a small, highly\-collaborative group of Workday and SaaS application experts who:
* Lead key cross\-functional initiatives such as new country/entity rollouts, M\&A onboarding, org restructuring, and global HR process standardization, ensuring Workday integrations are ready to support business change.
* Provide level 2/3 application and integration support, working closely with our internal help desk and operations teams to triage issues, resolve incidents, and continuously improve the stability and usability of our FIN \& HR technology stack.
* Maintain strong partnerships with vendors and implementation partners, coordinating technical work, managing release impacts, and ensuring external integrations adhere to LiveRamp’s security and privacy requirements.
* Continuously refine our operating model, development standards, and delivery practices (Agile/iterative) so the team can ship high\-quality changes quickly while protecting a mission\-critical production environment.
* Introduce and standardize AI\-enabled practices (log summarization, impact analysis, test generation) that make it easier for the broader team to operate and evolve complex integrations.
* Partner with security, data, and platform teams to safely adopt AI capabilities that improve observability, resilience, and developer productivity in the Workday integrations space.


******About You:******
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, building, and supporting Workday integrations in a production environment, using tools such as EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio, and Workday Web Services/REST APIs.
* Demonstrated experience owning end\-to\-end integration flows across at least two domains (e.g., HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Security, or Financials), including requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
* You are deeply curious about how systems, data, and business processes fit together, and you naturally dig into payloads, mappings, and logs rather than treating integrations as black boxes.
* You are hungry to learn and a true lifelong learner—you actively seek out new Workday integration features, patterns, and best practices, and you enjoy sharing what you learn with others.
* You are a go\-getter who takes ownership of integrations end\-to\-end, follows through on commitments, and is comfortable driving work forward without needing constant direction.
* You are an experimenter who prototypes, tests, and iterates; you’re comfortable trying new integration patterns or tooling, measuring outcomes, and quickly adjusting based on what you learn.
* You are systems\-minded and enjoy thinking in terms of interfaces, dependencies, and edge cases; you naturally anticipate downstream impacts before changing mappings or schedules in production.
* You are detail\-oriented and disciplined, especially around documentation, testing, monitoring, and change control, and you understand that small integration changes can have big, cross\-system consequences.
* You are a strong collaborator and communicator, able to translate between business language and technical behavior so stakeholders understand both the “why” and the “how” of data flows and changes.
* You are calm under pressure and comfortable troubleshooting ambiguous or complex integration issues, methodically working through hypotheses until you find and fix the root cause.
* You are service\-oriented, finding energy in helping HR, Finance, and business partners be successful through reliable integrations, high\-quality data, and thoughtful support.
* Curious about AI and automation and comfortable learning new tools (e.g., copilots, log analyzers, or analytics platforms) to boost your impact even if you haven’t used them formally before.
* Confident in asking questions, running small AI\-assisted experiments (such as log summarization, test generation, or code suggestions), and using data/AI\-generated insights to challenge the status quo and propose better, safer ways of working.


******Preferred Skills:******
* Workday Pro or Workday Integration/HCM/Financials certification(s), or equivalent advanced hands\-on experience with Workday integration tools (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, REST/SOAP APIs) across both HCM and Financials domains.
* Experience integrating Workday with identity and access platforms (e.g., Okta / Azure AD), ATS/HR tools, payroll/benefits providers, and finance/data platforms (e.g., ERP, billing/collections, Snowflake or similar data warehouse) in a SaaS environment.
* Familiarity with other SaaS applications commonly integrated with Workday at LiveRamp, including ticketing/ITSM, HR service delivery, performance/engagement, learning, and finance\-adjacent tools (e.g., sourcing, CLM, or billing systems), and how they exchange data with Workday HCM and FINS.
* Experience with modern integration and automation tooling, ideally including an iPaaS/middleware platform such as Workato or SnapLogic, plus basic scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or Shell) to support data pipelines, file transformations, and operational tasks.
* Exposure to both HR lifecycle processes (hire\-to\-retire, org changes, compensation cycles, security/role lifecycle) and finance processes (Source to Pay, Contract to Cash, GL/close), and how these translate into Workday configuration and integrations.
* Prior participation in Workday bi\-annual releases and major projects, including impact analysis on HR and FINS integrations, regression testing of critical interfaces, and rollout of new capabilities with appropriate monitoring.
* Familiarity with SOX, GDPR, and other privacy/security frameworks that impact HR and finance data, and experience designing integration\-level controls, logging, and audit evidence to support compliance across both domains.
* Experience using AI copilots or automation tools in a development or integration context (e.g., generating code snippets, test cases, or documentation) or a strong desire to ramp quickly.

* Demonstrate strong knowledge of EnergyIP components including SAP, DTS, Activity Gateway, LVOMS, Framing, UAA, Gateway Services, and MultiSpeak adapters.
* Design, support, and troubleshoot integrations between EnergyIP and IT/OT, AMI, CIS/Billing, OMS, SAP, HES, and other enterprise systems.
* Analyze EnergyIP application logs, transactions, workflows, data errors, and system behavior to perform root\-cause analysis.
* Provide technical guidance on EnergyIP configurations, components, customizations, and solution design.
* Lead technical workshops and translate business/functional requirements into technical designs and integration solutions.
* Prepare technical specifications, configuration documents, interface specifications, GAP analysis, workflow/sequence diagrams, and operational documentation.
* Support EnergyIP customizations, enhancements, deployments, upgrades, patches, and release activities.
* Design and execute unit, integration, regression, functional, performance, and non\-functional testing.
* Provide technical knowledge transfer, training, and operational support documentation to project and client teams.
* Troubleshoot Kafka/Confluent Kafka including topics, partitions, replication, ISR, consumer groups, offsets, lag, message size, connectivity, authorization, and KRaft\-related issues.
* Provide working knowledge of Apache ActiveMQ, including queues, producers, consumers, message delivery, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Perform Oracle SQL/PLSQL analysis and basic\-to\-intermediate troubleshooting of database connectivity, sessions, locks, services, open cursors, tablespaces, and resource issues.
* Administer and troubleshoot RHEL/Linux environments including CPU, memory, disk, processes, services, networking, ports, and application logs.
* Troubleshoot Data refresh, security certificates and upgrade related issues.
* Develop and maintain monitoring and dashboards using Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, Splunk etc.
* Support EnergyIP deployments and integrations across AWS/Azure cloud environments and related services.
* Develop Shell/Python automation scripts, tools, and accelerators to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Provide L2/L3 production support, incident troubleshooting, RCA, performance analysis, and continuous improvement for MDM environments.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, architects, developers, infrastructure, database, integration, security, business, and product teams for end\-to\-end solution delivery.


**Qualifications**
**Qualification \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 7\+ years of experience in MDM, enterprise application engineering, utility technology, or production support.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on EnergyIP/MDM experience preferred.
* Experience in electricity, gas, or water utility environments is preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of EnergyIP MDM platform and its components.
* Strong knowledge of Java with working knowledge of Python and Shell scripting.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle SQL/PLSQL and RDBMS concepts.
* Working knowledge of Kafka/Confluent Kafka, KRaft, and ActiveMQ.
* Strong RHEL/Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, web services, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Working knowledge of security certificate.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Kibana, and/or Elasticsearch.
* Working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure is preferred.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture, design principles, integration patterns, scalability, high availability, and system troubleshooting.
* Experience with CI/CD and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Git, Harness, Terraform, or CloudFormation is an advantage.

You will work closely with the Layout design teams to increase their productivity and work efficiency.

* Develop methodologies for highly reliable layout with faster Time to Market approach.
* Lead layout flows implementation using AI‑assisted and automated workflows, applying copilot‑based assistants, agentic AI flows, and rule‑aware automation to accelerate placement, routing and optimization.
* Continuously evaluate and implement new tools and technologies to improve the current layout development flows.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior members of the team.
* Develop and deploy AI‑enabled methodologies for Semi\-automated floorplanning, parasitic estimation,

* Working experience of Physical Verification flow and analyzing/debugging DRC, ERC, LVS, DFM, Antenna Calibre/ICV rule deck issues is plus.
* Good understanding of advanced CMOS process manufacturing and layout design rules, EMIR, RC\-Extraction, ESD, and Latch\-up.
* Good understanding of programming fundamentals, as well as exposure to various programming languages including Skill (Cadence), Perl, Python, Tcl.

* Excellent problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work in a dynamic environment.

* Proficiency in working effectively with global teams and stakeholders.


**Education**
* A bachelor’s or a master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical or Computer Engineering.

**Zycus** 
 is looking for an Senior Implementation Consultant with expertise in eProcurement implementation. The ideal candidate will have 6\-10 years of experience in end\-to\-end implementation of procurement software and a strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) or Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) solutions like SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Basware, Jaggaer, or similar platforms.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead complex, global implementations for Fortune 1000 enterprises, driving successful deployment, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. You will also play a key role in enabling AI\-driven procurement transformation, leveraging intelligent automation, analytics, and emerging technologies.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will own the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle of our procurement SaaS platform. You will work closely with clients, product teams, and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable, integrated, and intelligent procurement solutions.
 



 You will also contribute to embedding AI capabilities into procurement workflows, enhancing efficiency, decision\-making, and user experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Implementation \& Delivery
 



  




* Lead end\-to\-end implementation of procurement SaaS solutions for global clients.
* Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into scalable solution designs.
* Configure and customize the platform to align with client\-specific procurement processes.
* Drive integration with ERP and third\-party systems using APIs and middleware.
* Manage and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring high\-quality deployments.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high customer satisfaction.



  





 Client Engagement \& Enablement
 



  




* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on procurement transformation and best practices.
* Conduct training sessions, workshops, and enablement programs to drive adoption.
* Provide post\-go\-live support and continuous improvement recommendations.



  





 AI \& Digital Transformation Initiatives
 



  




* Collaborate with product and data teams to implement AI\-powered features such as:
* Intelligent invoice processing and automation
* Predictive spend analytics and insights
* Supplier risk scoring and recommendation engines
* Identify opportunities to embed AI/ML into procurement workflows to improve efficiency and decision\-making.
* Drive adoption of automation, chatbots, and AI assistants within procurement processes.
* Analyze client data to recommend data\-driven optimizations and process improvements.
* Contribute to defining AI use cases, solution design, and value realization frameworks.
* Stay current with advancements in AI, GenAI, and automation within procurement and enterprise SaaS.



  





 Collaboration \& Leadership
 



  




* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Project Management.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to knowledge sharing and best practices.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including solution demos and client workshops, where required.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education
 



  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field.



  





 Experience
 



  




* 6–10 years of experience in SaaS implementation, preferably in procurement or supply chain solutions.
* Strong expertise in S2P and P2P processes.
* Hands\-on experience with any one of these platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, Basware, or similar.
* Proven experience in system configuration, customization, and ERP integrations.
* Exposure to APIs, data integration, and cloud technologies.



  





 Preferred Skills
 


* Experience working with AI/ML\-enabled enterprise applications or automation tools.
* Understanding of data analytics, reporting, and visualization tools.
* Familiarity with Agile/Waterfall project methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, global environment.



  





 Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work with leading global enterprises to drive digital and AI\-led procurement transformation.
* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS organization at the forefront of AI innovation in procurement.
* Thrive in a collaborative, high\-impact, and innovation\-driven environment.
* Opportunity to shape next\-generation intelligent procurement solutions.

title: Linux Kernel Driver Engineer (Filesystems/vfs)
description:
About the job
 
  





  





**Job description** 
 :Linux Kernel Driver Engineer (Filesystem / VFS)
 



**Location** 
 : Pune, MH or Gandhinagar, GJ
 



**Experience** 
 : 5–10 years
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-time
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Linux Kernel Engineer to develop and maintain kernel\-mode driver (KMD), a DKMS\-packaged loadable kernel module that hooks the VFS layer to transparently intercept file operations, manage stub files, and enable seamless cloud tiering of surveillance video — without modifying the VMS or requiring embedded NVR/DVR hardware.
 



  




* **Key Responsibilities**



  




* Design, implement, and maintain a Linux kernel module (LKM) built and distributed via DKMS across supported Ubuntu Server kernel versions
* Implement and evolve VFS\-layer hooks covering inode, dentry, and superblock operations, and core filesystem entry points (open, read, getattr, etc.)
* Use kprobes/kretprobes (e.g. on vfs\_getattr\_nosec) to intercept and modify kernel behavior for stub\-file size reporting without breaking VMS retention logic
* Own kernel\-side synchronization (spinlocks, mutexes, RCU where applicable) across concurrent file access paths
* Debug kernel\-level issues using dmesg, ftrace, crash/kdump, and /proc / /sys inspection; verify module identity via srcversion after every change
* Coordinate the kernel/userspace boundary (shared memory, ring buffers) with the Linux Systems Programming team
* Maintain strict versioning discipline (module version, module params) and produce round\-numbered RCA design docs for significant fixes



  




* **Mandatory Skills Must\-Have**



  




* Linux kernel module (LKM) development in C, packaged and distributed via DKMS
* Deep working knowledge of the VFS layer: inode, dentry, superblock, file\_operations
* Experience with kprobes/kretprobes or equivalent dynamic kernel instrumentation techniques
* Filesystem driver / stackable filesystem concepts and standard entry points (open, read, write, getattr, release)
* Kernel debugging proficiency: dmesg, ftrace, crash/kdump, /proc and /sys inspection
* Solid grasp of kernel\-space synchronization primitives (spinlocks, mutexes, RCU) and IRQ/atomic\-context constraints
* Familiarity with kernel module versioning, signing, and safe load/unload lifecycle management



  




* **Nice\-to\-Have Skills Good\-to\-Have**



  




* FUSE internals knowledge, to reason about the kernel/userspace split cleanly
* eBPF programming experience
* Familiarity with mainstream filesystem internals (ext4, overlayfs, btrfs)
* Prior experience on backup, antivirus, or hierarchical\-storage\-management (HSM) kernel drivers

description:
**Sponsor\-dedicated**
 Working fully embedded within one of our pharmaceutical clients, with the support of Cytel right behind you, you'll be at the heart of our client's innovation. As a Senior Statistical Programmer you will be dedicated to one of our global pharmaceutical clients; a company that is driving the next generation of patient treatment, where individuals are empowered to work with autonomy and ownership. This is an exciting time to be a part of this new program.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 As a Senior Statistical Programmer, you will leverage your advanced SAS programming skills and proficiency in CDISC standards (SDTM \& ADaM) to support or lead one or more Phase I\-IV clinical trials. This role can be performed as fully remote.

* We believe in applying scientific rigor to reveal the full promise inherent in data.
* We nurture intellectual curiosity and encourage everyone to approach new challenges with enthusiasm and the desire for discovery.
* We believe in collaboration and invite a diversity of perspectives, drawing on a variety of talents to create a wealth of possibilities.

* Generating and validating SDTM and ADaM datasets/analysis files, and tables, listings, and figures (TLFs)
* Production and QC / validation programming

 Here At Cytel We Want Our Employees To Succeed And We Enable This Success Through Consistent Training, Development And Support. To Be Successful In This Position You Will Have

* At least 5 years of SAS programming working with clinical trial data in the Pharmaceutical \& Biotech industry with a bachelor’s degree or master’s degree or equivalent.
* Study lead experience, preferably juggling multiple projects simultaneously preferred.
* Strong SAS data manipulation, analysis and reporting skills.
* Solid experience implementing the latest CDISC SDTM / ADaM standards.
* Strong QC / validation skills.
* Good ad\-hoc reporting skills.

* Familiarity with drug development life cycle and experience with the manipulation, analysis and reporting of clinical trials’ data.

**Job Title** 




 Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)About the Job Are you passionate about building high\-quality software through automation and engineering excellence? Do you enjoy solving complex testing challenges, developing scalable automation frameworks, and leveraging the latest technologies to improve software quality? We're looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Quality Engineering team. In this role, you'll work alongside developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to ensure our products are reliable, scalable, and deliver an exceptional customer experience. As an SDET, you'll play a key role in designing and building modern automation frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript, driving quality throughout the software development lifecycle, and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. You'll have the opportunity to influence engineering best practices, mentor team members, and explore emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted testing, to improve efficiency and test coverage.
 



  





**Experience** 
 : 4–8 Years
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a highly skilled Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) with 4–8 years of experience in designing and developing scalable test automation solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Playwright, TypeScript, API automation, and CI/CD practices. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to build reliable automation frameworks, improve product quality, and enable faster software delivery.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript.
* Develop automated test suites for UI, API, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end (E2E) testing.
* Build data\-driven, modular, and maintainable automation solutions following industry best practices.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar tools.
* Improve automation stability, execution speed, and maintainability through continuous framework enhancements.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, DevOps, and QA teams to define effective test strategies and quality gates.
* Develop utilities, reusable libraries, and test data management solutions to improve automation productivity.
* Perform API testing using REST APIs and validate responses, schemas, and database records.
* Create meaningful automation reports, dashboards, and quality metrics to provide visibility into product quality.
* Review automation code, mentor junior team members, and promote engineering best practices.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release activities.
* Stay current with emerging testing tools, AI\-assisted automation techniques, and modern quality engineering practices.



**AI\-Driven Engineering Expectations** 




 Engineers are expected to actively incorporate AI\-assisted workflows into daily development, including test generation, defect analysis, and coverage improvement. AI\-generated outputs must be reviewed, validated, and owned by the engineer.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Must\-Have Qualifications:
 



 4\-8 years of hands\-on software development experience in full\-stack roles.
 



 Experience with Playwright or equivalent test automation tools (e.g., Cypress, Selenium).
 



 Experience with microservices architecture, Docker, and Kubernetes.
 



 Working knowledge of SQL for backend data validation, and basic familiarity with NoSQL databases.
 



 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
 



 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
 



 Proven experience working on SaaS\-based applications with high availability and scalability.

🚀 We’re Hiring at Autodesk (CCTech Pune)!
 





 Role: C\# Developer – Localization Engineering (Windows Desktop Applications)
 





 🔹 About the Role
 





 Join us in building a migration workflow for large\-scale Windows desktop applications. You’ll work hands\-on with localization/globalization across multiple resource file types, directly contributing to migration, testing, and delivery pipelines. If you love working close to the system level and have strong C\# \+ Windows desktop experience, this role is for you.

 Implement and validate localization using resource files (.rc, .resx, XAML, XML).
 





 Debug and compare localized builds in Visual Studio for stability and correctness.
 





 Handle partial localization scenarios and runtime string issues.
 





 Work with C\+\+ DLLs as a consumer for localization and debugging.
 





 Participate in a tight testing \+ defect\-fixing loop: find → fix → validate → repeat.
 





 Collaborate with localization, QA, and cross\-functional teams.
 





 🔹 Must\-Have Skills
 





 2–4 years of Windows desktop application development.
 





 Strong hands\-on experience in C\# and WPF (MVVM).
 





 Experience with .rc and .resx resource files for localization/globalization.
 





 Proficiency in Git and Visual Studio.
 





 Ability to debug, trace, and fix issues independently.
 





 🔹 Good to Have
 





 Exposure to MFC/Win32 (even if only debugged/read code).
 





 Basic familiarity with C\+\+ for DLL navigation.
 





 Experience with XAML/XML\-based localization.
 





 Understanding of encoding, code pages, multi\-language string handling.
 





 🔹 Minimum Qualifications
 





 Bachelor’s in CS/Mechanical/Electrical (or equivalent hands\-on experience).
 





 Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology.
 





 🔹 The Ideal Candidate
 





 You’re a C\# developer who thrives on Windows desktop applications, but isn’t afraid to dive deeper — whether it’s reading legacy C\+\+ code, understanding DLL structures, or tracing tricky localization bugs. Curiosity, systematic thinking, and willingness to learn are key.

 The

While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people**

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 About the job About Camley Camley is building the agentic infrastructure for private markets. Our clients are leading private equity and infrastructure investment firms, and we are at the forefront of transforming a $55T asset class that still runs on spreadsheets and software built in the 1990s. What Harvey did for legal, we are doing for private markets. We are building the multi\-agent architecture that operates funds end\-to\-end, solving the highest\-stakes problems investment firms face with accuracy and speed. Our agents are not just chatbots \- they move money and execute workflows autonomously. We are backed by top VCs, incl. the first investor in Lovable and one of the most technical AI investors in Silicon Valley responsible for building Uber’s core algorithm. Camley is built by a team from Stanford, Harvard, IIT Delhi, and Penn, with decades of industry experience at McKinsey, SquarePoint, and Deutsche Bank \+ building foundation models for an Accel\-backed startup. About the role We are hiring a founding full\-stack AI engineer. You will build products end\-to\-end and shape agent architecture and technical decisions alongside the CTO. You’ll build the core intelligence layer \- language models for reading documents, a knowledge graph \& vector DB for storing data and relationships, a calculation engine for the fund mathematics and an orchestration layer that coordinates these into workflows that an auditor can sign. You'll own high\-impact features across the stack, from model integration to infrastructure. We are a small team working across London and New York. We are open to remote/hybrid for the right candidate. We are a lean team with a high bar for excellence, and hours will at times be intense as in any high\-growth startup. In return, you get the autonomy to do some of the best work of your life, and a founding team that values openness, empathy, and not taking ourselves too seriously. What you will do Design and integrate LLM\-powered pipelines and build agents that execute multi\-step workflows reliably Build the agent harness: orchestration, tool use, retries, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and optimise agent performance across prompts, models, tools, and context Own the evals, validation, audit trails, and observability that keep agent behaviour correct, explainable, and improving Ship features across our React frontend and Python backend, from database schemas and APIs to polished UI, from idea to production Work directly with the founders and early customers to understand real fund workflows, and turn operational pain into shipped product What we are looking for We are looking for an exceptional engineer who wants the autonomy to shape a product from day 0, who loves the challenge of maintaining a strong quality bar while shipping extremely quickly, and who knows how to make smart tradeoffs to get features in front of customers. Strong candidates have: Built products from 0 to 1 5\+ years of experience building production software Strong full\-stack fundamentals across frontend, backend, and infra Proficiency in Python and production experience building LLM systems/agent frameworks High ownership: you do not wait for a spec to start solving a problem Made AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) a core part of how they work Passion for building effective domain\-specific agents Bonus points if you have: Experience in finance or financial services Data\-intensive backend work Early\-stage startup experience Technology stack Typescript/React, Python (FastAPI), Postgres, AWS, and an agent orchestration layer you will help design. How to apply Apply through Wellfound and we will see it. Include your CV with the role title in the subject line. You can include your portfolio, GitHub, and what excites you about the role. Please do not submit AI generated applications.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 \['Python TypeScript React.js Generative AI Agentic AI']
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 NA

 Apollo is seeking a quantitative analyst with strong business acumen and exceptional technical skills as part of its Global Quantitative Analytics function (referred to as the Quant function hereafter). The Quant function is responsible for the design, development and maintenance of quantitative tools and the production and support of quantitative metrics across the firm and as such is a critical part of the firm’s business strategy.
   

  

 As part of this team, you will be responsible for validating quant outputs by working through quantitative libraries for risk, valuation and stress for use across Apollo entities. Key asset classes include Structured Credit (vanilla as well as exotic asset backed securities), Derivatives (rates, credit, equity, FX and commodities), public and private equity, and typical fixed income instruments (with or without embedded options) spanning the whole range of credit assets such as corporate bonds, leveraged loans, emerging market debt, private credit, commercial and residential real estate debt, infrastructure debt, convertible bonds, preferred stock, and government bonds.
   

  

 You will leverage your product/markets experience and programming skills to help develop tools that will validate risks appropriately. You will be responsible for working with the Portfolio Managers to model security risks, respond to inquiries, and make recommendations that will ultimately influence investment choices and portfolio construction.
   

  

 In addition, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy of daily risk analytics by developing tools to identify any potential issues and by investigating and rectifying any identified issues in the daily risk analytics.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Ensure the accuracy of daily risk analytics by developing tools to identify any potential issues.
* Investigate and rectify any identified issues in the daily risk analytics.
* Utilize existing proprietary model libraries for generating portfolio exposures, stress testing, risk metrics and performance attribution.
* Develop robust quantitative risk and stress models with analytical outputs that fully reflect the key risks of each position and meet the risk management objectives of portfolio managers and senior management.
* Conduct detailed reviews of existing models and propose solutions to enhance the model output.
* Partner with Technology teams to deliver state\-of\-the\-art risk analytics and models.
* Clearly and concisely articulate complex ideas to target audiences including portfolio managers, traders and executive management.
* Build and manage relationships with senior global stakeholders, and with local and regional business leaders, including internal and external parties.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 2\+ years of experience as a Quant in a Front Office Pricing team in large Investment Banks or Asset Managers with focus on traded credit products and Asset Backed Securities. A few years of this experience (but not all) could be in a model validation team validating front office models.
* Deep expertise in credit market dynamics including cash, synthetics, and structured products.
* Strong understanding of quantitative credit methodologies and traded credit analytics.
* Strong conceptual and mathematical knowledge of financial engineering, stochastic modeling, simulation techniques, derivatives pricing, and risk analytics.
* Deep experience in designing risk and valuation models for credit securities, structured products and complex derivatives.
* Proven expertise in stress testing and scenario analysis to assess risk exposures.
* Strong programming skills: Python, R, SQL, and Excel (required) and C/C\+\+ (preferred).
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution is required.
* Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, computer science, financial engineering, and econometrics is preferred.
* Practical and hands\-on experience in financial markets.
* Strong communication and diplomatic skills are required to guide, influence, and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively and independently across different businesses and functional areas with thorough attention to detail in a potentially high paced environment.
* Collaborative, organized, flexible and results driven.
* Must have strong drive and initiative, be collaborative to effectively liaise with senior stakeholders and colleagues.
* A forward thinking, creative individual who challenges the status quo and takes initiative to reengineer processes.
* Strong project management skills
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, including the ability to resolve conflict and observe confidentiality.
* Be nimble and flexible to balance multiple tasks simultaneously.


*Apollo provides equal employment opportunities regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, veteran status, gender/sex or sexual orientation, or any other criterion or circumstance protected by applicable law, ordinance, or regulation. The above criteria are intended to be used as a guide only – candidates who do not meet all the above criteria may still be considered if they are deemed to have relevant experience/ equivalent levels of skill or knowledge to fulfil the requirements of the role. Any job offer will be conditional upon and subject to satisfactory reference and background screening checks, all necessary corporate and regulatory approvals or certifications as required from time to time, and entering into definitive contractual documentation satisfactory to Apollo.*

title: Senior Performance Advertising Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a results\-oriented Senior Performance Advertising Engineer to own and drive the optimization of our buyer\-side and performance marketing systems. In this role, you will be directly responsible for designing algorithms, building data systems, and refining optimization loops that drive Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for our Advertisers and Agencies.You will own the technical architecture and end\-to\-end evaluation, implementation, and scaling of robust data pipelines for attribution data. This position spans our complete omnichannel environment, requiring expert\-level performance engine development across Mobile App (including privacy\-aware frameworks like SKAdNetwork and Privacy Sandbox), Video, Connected TV (CTV),and Desktop environments.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* ROAS Optimization \& Algorithmic Design: Develop, benchmark, and deploy real\-time bidding (RTB) algorithms, pacing controls, and predictive models aimed squarely at maximizing ROAS and conversion tracking across all screens (CTV, Mobile App, Video, and Desktop).
* Attribution Data Pipelines: Design, evaluate, and implement scalable, low\-latency streaming and batch data pipelines that ingest, validate, and process complex conversion and multi\-touch attribution (MTA) datasets.
* Omnichannel Execution: Advance PubMatic’s performance capabilities across specific programmatic formats.
* Mobile: Build robust mechanisms that thrive within SKAdNetwork, Attribution API, and Android Privacy Sandbox constraints.
* CTV \& Video: Implement precise cross\-device graph integrations, household\-level frequency capping, and server\-to\-server attribution systems.
* Desktop: Innovate alternative identity framework integrations (e.g., UID2, LiveRamp ATS) to sustain high attribution fidelity post\-third\-party cookies.
* Data Pipeline Evaluation: Constantly audit existing data ingestion points for architectural flaws, data loss, or systemic latencies that negatively skew attribution accuracy and campaign performance.
* Scalable Systems Engineering: Write high\-performance, low\-latency, and memory\-efficient code (Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+) matching our ultra\-scaled backend layer that processes trillions of monthly events.


**We'd Love For You To Have**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience focusing on performance advertising, programmatic bidding, or large\-scale user\-conversion optimization loops.
* Attribution Domain Expertise: Demonstrated track record of evaluating and implementing multi\-touch attribution (MTA), last\-touch attribution (LTA), or incrementality testing frameworks in a production environment.
* Data Engineering \& Scale: Hands\-on experience engineering pipelines handling terabyte\-to\- petabyte scale data via distributed frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Kafka, and cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Format Versatility: Strong technical familiarity with technical specs supporting Mobile App (IDFA/GAID loss mitigations), CTV (App Transport Security, IFA standards), and Desktop environments.
* Deep understanding of the OpenRTB protocol, DSP/SSP mechanics, and supply\-path optimization (SPO).
* Experience deploying production\-grade Machine Learning frameworks for CTR/CVR prediction.
* Strong system\-level performance benchmarking skills (profiling memory allocation, reducing I/O bottlenecks.


**Qualification**
 Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute/university.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office** 
 : PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!.
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

title: AI Platform Staff Engineer
description:
**Job Title: AI Platform Staff Engineer – Application** 




  





**About Accrete:** 




 Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high\-stakes, judgement\-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor.
 



  





 At the core is Accrete’s Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization’s tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high\-stakes decisions — not just answer questions about them.
 



 From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement.
 



  





**About Role:** 




 We are seeking an AI Staff Engineer who is excited about building the next phase of our platform with an agent\-first, AI\-native approach, grounded in clean code and strong architectural thinking. This role goes beyond traditional backend or data engineering. You will design and build systems where LLMs can reason, plan, and act, working alongside well\-structured, deterministic services and workflows. The goal is simple and demanding at the same time: ship systems that work reliably in production, scale with real usage, and solve real customer problems. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys building, not just designing on paper. You should be deeply comfortable with Python\-based systems, and have strong experience building cloud\-native, microservices\-driven platforms, including data pipelines and distributed systems. You will work closely with product, ML, and platform teams to deliver enterprise\-scale solutions, improve backend performance and reliability, and raise the technical bar through thoughtful design, ownership, and execution across teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Technical Leadership \& Hands\-On Contribution** 



* Design and implement backend services, data integration layers, and distributed systems using Python and modern frameworks.
* Build scalable microservices and REST/gRPC APIs for both real\-time and batch workloads.
* Lead technical design and architecture reviews while remaining deeply hands\-on with code.
* Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, component flows, design docs, and API specs.
* Communicate technical decisions clearly to engineers, product partners, and non\-technical stakeholders.



**Agentic Systems \& AI\-Native Architecture** 



* Design and build agent\-first systems where LLMs reason, plan, and act alongside deterministic services.
* Implement and evaluate agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar open\-source tools.
* Apply agentic design patterns including planners, routers, evaluators, memory, tool\-use, and feedback loops.
* Integrate Model Context Protocols (MCP) or equivalent mechanisms to standardize tool access, context sharing, and orchestration across agents.
* Balance probabilistic AI behavior with deterministic workflows to ensure reliability, observability, and production safety.
* Collaborate closely with ML teams to move models from experimentation into scalable, production\-grade systems.



**Cloud\-Native Development** 



* Build and deploy services on AWS using EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, DynamoDB, and managed AI services where appropriate.
* Design systems using Kubernetes, containers, serverless, and event\-driven patterns.
* Ensure reliability, observability, security, and cost awareness across cloud workloads.



**ETL \& Data Pipelines** 



* Design data\-intensive systems including ingestion pipelines, stream processing, and transformation workflows.
* Work with tools such as Apache Kafka, Airflow, Dagster, AWS Step Functions, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
* Design and operate systems using multiple databases such as MongoDB, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, and similar technologies.



**Code Quality, CI/CD \& Operational Excellence** 



* Write high\-quality, testable code with strong unit and integration test coverage.
* Build and maintain Git\-based CI/CD pipelines to support fast, reliable releases.
* Own production outcomes by monitoring systems, diagnosing issues, and fixing root causes.



**Collaboration \& Mentorship** 



* Work closely with product managers, ML engineers, platform teams, and stakeholders to align on outcomes.
* Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, and raise the engineering bar through example.
* Advocate for security\-first development, operational discipline, and strong engineering culture.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 10\+ years of backend and data engineering experience with a strong focus on microservices and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2, RDS), Azure (Azure Functions, Blob Storage, Virtual Machines), or GCP (Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine).
* Strong hands\-on experience with Python and frameworks like Flask, FastAPI, or Django and related libraries/frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, PyDantic etc.
* Strong knowledge of data engineering technologies, including ETL tools (Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, Google Dataflow), data warehouses (Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake), and big data platforms (Hadoop, Apache Kafka, Apache HBase).
* Familiarity with asynchronous and synchronous integration patterns and frameworks (RESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets).
* Strong understanding of system design patterns, caching, rate\-limiting, and queuing mechanisms.
* Proficiency in backend and server\-side technologies such as: Web frameworks: Flask, Django, FastAPI
* Messaging protocols: HTTP, AMQP
* Database systems: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle), NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, OpenSearch), Graph Databases like MemGraph or Neo4j
* Caching systems: Redis, Memcached
* Serverless computing: AWS Lambda, Azure Functions
* Containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes
* MCP, Claude Agents, Google ADK
* Knowledge of microservices architecture and design principles.
* Experience with version control systems such as Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience in setting up and using automated testing tools and frameworks, such as Selenium, PyTest, or JUnit.
* Ability to create and maintain detailed sequence diagrams and architectural documentation. Proficiency in developing effective strategies to debug issues that arise in production environments.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams. Ability to adapt to new technologies and methodologies quickly.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.



  





**Impact** 




 You take full ownership and accountability for your work, consistently seeing projects through from inception to completion with a strong bias for action. Proactively identifying challenges, you drive solutions rather than waiting for direction, and hold yourself and others to the highest standards for delivering results. With strategic thinking and a problem\-solving mindset, you make informed decisions leveraging data and expertise, always looking for ways to improve processes, optimize workflows, and enhance outcomes beyond your immediate responsibilities.
 



  





**Collaboration** 




 You work seamlessly across teams, prioritizing shared goals and team success over individual credit. Engaged listening and open, candid communication are at the heart of your approach, ensuring alignment and synergy throughout the organization. You value diverse perspectives, seeking input from others to drive better results. By treating colleagues with respect and professionalism, you help build a culture of trust, supporting each other through challenges, celebrating successes, and constructively addressing conflicts to strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.
 



  





**Passion for AI \& Innovation** 




 You are deeply excited about the transformative potential of AI and committed to contributing to a company shaping the future of work. With curiosity and a growth mindset, you continuously seek to learn, adapt, and stay at the forefront of new developments. Your enthusiasm for innovation drives you to explore new ideas, challenge the status quo, and find creative solutions that deliver meaningful impact. You approach your work with energy and a desire to advance both technology and the way we work.
 



  





**Career Progression** 




 At Accrete we value professional growth and development of our employees. As a AI Staff Engineer \- Application, you will have access to a variety of career advancement opportunities and growth within the organization. We provide ongoing training, mentorship, and opportunities to take on leadership roles within your team and work with leaders across departments.
 



  





**Company Benefits** 




 Competitive Salary: Aligned with experience and market standards
 



 Mediclaim: 10 Lacs coverage for you and your family
 



 Flexible PTO \& Hybrid Work: Take time off when needed and enjoy remote flexibility per company guidelines
 



 Growth \& Development: Access professional learning opportunities and career advancement support
 



 Onsite Perks: Enjoy catered lunches, snacks
 



 Team Bonding: Company\-sponsored social events to connect and unwind

title: SoC Hardware Architect
description:
**Business Line Description**
* NXP's MPU Engineering (ACE) team is a central engineering organization responsible for developing and delivering Systems\-on\-a\-Chip (SoCs) for NXP's Automotive, Edge, and Radar Processing business lines. MME's SoC Hardware Architecture team produces architectural solutions covering the very wide\-range of SoCs required by the business lines. The team is challenged to produce industry\-leading solutions covering very cost\-sensitive, low power devices to highly\-integrated, high performance, multi\-domain devices compliant with the latest automotive and industrial safety and security standards.


**Job Summary**
* Experience in architecting complex SoCs in leading\-edge process nodes involving multiple processors, coherent/non\-coherent interconnects, memory controllers, Ethernet interfaces, high bandwidth accelerators, high speed connectivity peripherals like PCIe etc
* Work with cross\-functional architecture teams to develop holistic system\-level SoC platform architectures targeting a specific product class or developing a specific technology solution which is scalable across a wide\-range of product types and tiers.
* Deliver architecture specifications which include detailed system\-level use\-case definitions, hardware/software partitioning, alignment with existing industry standards, and relevant key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Collaborate with design and execution teams throughout the entire product development cycle to ensure your solution is successfully deployed in commercial product.
* Developing specifications for both internal and 3rd\-party IP, participating in make v. buy analysis, and selecting the right IP.


**Key Challenges**
* Experience in designing or architecting complex SoCs in leading\-edge process nodes with multiple independent compute environments.
* Exposure to ISO26262\-compliant and mixed\-criticality architectures.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Role: Solution Architect – Semantic Governance AI Platform
   

 Engagement: Project / Contract / Strategic Collaboration
   

 Experience: 8\+ years preferred
   

 Domain: Enterprise Data Governance \| AI/ML \| Semantic Architecture \| Knowledge Graphs
   

 Location: Remote / Hybrid
   

  

 About the Project
   

  

 We are building an enterprise Semantic Governance AI Platform that establishes authoritative business definitions, manages semantic conflicts, maintains regulatory and decision provenance, and ensures approved definitions are consistently implemented across data warehouses, BI platforms, ML systems and enterprise applications.
   

  

 The platform will integrate with technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, Collibra/Alation and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect who can own the end\-to\-end technical architecture and work closely with business stakeholders, Data Governance teams, Data Scientists, Data Engineers and development teams.
   

  

 The architect will translate business governance requirements into a scalable architecture covering semantic modeling, workflow, AI, knowledge graphs, integrations, security, APIs and enterprise data platforms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture
   

  

 \* Design the end\-to\-end architecture for the Semantic Governance Platform.
   

 \* Define application, data, integration, semantic and AI architecture.
   

 \* Design the canonical semantic registry and concept/version model.
   

 \* Define architecture for ontology and knowledge\-graph components.
   

 \* Design workflow architecture for proposal, review, approval, escalation and deprecation.
   

 \* Define APIs and integration patterns for enterprise platforms.
   

  

 Data \& Semantic Architecture
   

  

 \* Design semantic models for business concepts, relationships, formulas and dependencies.
   

 \* Define metadata, lineage and provenance architecture.
   

 \* Design mechanisms for identifying conflicting definitions.
   

 \* Define semantic impact\-analysis architecture.
   

 \* Establish standards for canonical definitions and version management.
   

  

 AI Architecture
   

  

 \* Design AI/LLM components for:
   

 \* Semantic similarity
   

 \* Concept matching
   

 \* Conflict detection
   

 \* Regulatory document analysis
   

 \* Impact analysis
   

 \* AI\-assisted governance
   

 \* Define appropriate use of LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG and knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Establish human\-in\-the\-loop controls so AI recommendations do not automatically become authoritative definitions.
   

 \* Define evaluation, explainability and guardrail mechanisms.
   

  

 Enterprise Integration
   

  

 Design integration patterns with:
   

  

 \* Snowflake
   

 \* Databricks
   

 \* Power BI
   

 \* Tableau
   

 \* Collibra / Alation
   

 \* Data catalogs
   

 \* Feature stores
   

 \* Enterprise APIs
   

 \* Existing Claims, Underwriting and Finance systems
   

  

 Security \& Compliance
   

  

 \* Design RBAC and fine\-grained access controls.
   

 \* Define authentication/authorization architecture.
   

 \* Design immutable/tamper\-evident audit architecture.
   

 \* Address encryption, secrets management and data protection.
   

 \* Ensure architecture supports enterprise security and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 \* Create HLD and LLD architecture documentation.
   

 \* Produce architecture diagrams using Draw.io, Lucidchart or Mermaid.
   

 \* Create API, integration and data\-flow specifications.
   

 \* Participate in technical discussions with client stakeholders.
   

 \* Guide engineering teams during implementation.
   

 \* Conduct architecture reviews and identify technical risks.
   

 \* Make technology and architectural trade\-off decisions.
   

  

 Required Technical Skills
   

  

 Must Have:
   

  

 \* 8\+ years of enterprise solution architecture experience.
   

 \* Strong experience with data platforms and enterprise integration.
   

 \* Strong understanding of Data Governance and Metadata Management.
   

 \* Experience with cloud architecture — AWS, Azure or GCP.
   

 \* Strong SQL and data architecture knowledge.
   

 \* REST APIs and event\-driven architecture.
   

 \* Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks.
   

 \* Experience integrating BI platforms such as Power BI/Tableau.
   

 \* Understanding of ontology, semantic models or knowledge graphs.
   

 \* Strong understanding of AI/ML architecture and LLM\-based applications.
   

 \* Experience with security, RBAC and enterprise architecture patterns.
   

  

 Good to Have:
   

  

 \* Neo4j / Amazon Neptune / other graph databases.
   

 \* RAG and vector databases.
   

 \* Python.
   

 \* LangChain / LlamaIndex or equivalent frameworks.
   

 \* Collibra / Alation.
   

 \* Microsoft Purview.
   

 \* Data lineage platforms.
   

 \* Regulatory/compliance technology.
   

 \* Insurance, Banking, Financial Services or Risk domain experience.
   

  

 Expected Deliverables
   

  

 The Solution Architect will be responsible for producing:
   

  

 1\. End\-to\-End Solution Architecture
   

 2\. Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
   

 3\. High\-Level Architecture (HLD)
   

 4\. Low\-Level Architecture (LLD)
   

 5\. Semantic/Knowledge Graph Architecture
   

 6\. AI/LLM Architecture
   

 7\. Integration Architecture
   

 8\. Security Architecture
   

 9\. API Architecture
   

 10\. Data Flow \& Sequence Diagrams
   

 11\. Deployment Architecture
   

 12\. Technology Selection \& Trade\-off Analysis
   

 13\. POC Architecture
   

 14\. Implementation Roadmap
   

 15\. Technical Standards for Engineering Teams
   

  

 Key Question We Expect the Architect to Solve
   

  

 The architect should be able to answer:
   

  

 How do we take an approved business definition such as “Loss Ratio”, represent it as a canonical semantic object, map it to regulatory requirements, detect conflicting implementations in Snowflake/Power BI/ML systems, perform impact analysis when the definition changes, and propagate the approved version across the enterprise — while keeping humans accountable for the final decision?
   

  

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can operate at both levels:
   

  

 Business → Architecture → Engineering
   

  

 and can confidently sit with:
   

  

 CDO / CFO / CRO → Data Governance → Enterprise Architects → Data Scientists → Data Engineers → Developers
   

  

 and convert the business requirement into an executable technical architecture.

title: Informatica MDM Developer
description:
Job Summary Synechron is seeking an Informatica MDM Developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting Master Data Management solutions. The role will focus on implementing and maintaining Informatica MDM capabilities that improve data quality, governance, consistency, and accessibility across enterprise systems. The successful candidate will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, support reliable data operations, and contribute to business objectives through accurate and trusted master data. Software Requirements (Required and Preferred) Required Informatica MDM Hub: 3+ years of hands-on development, configuration, customization, and production support experience using a current or organization-supported version. Informatica Data Director (IDD): Experience configuring and supporting user interfaces, workflows, and data stewardship activities. Match and Merge Configuration: Experience developing and managing match rules, merge rules, trust frameworks, survivorship logic, and validation rules. Hierarchy Manager: Experience designing and maintaining relationships, hierarchies, and organizational structures within Informatica MDM. SQL and PL/SQL: Strong practical experience with data analysis, validation, troubleshooting, and database programming. Relational Databases: Working experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent relational database technologies. Web Services and REST APIs: Experience integrating Informatica MDM with source and target applications. Data Modeling and Governance Tools or Practices: Experience applying data models, data quality standards, metadata principles, and governance controls. Development and Testing Tools: Experience using source control, defect tracking, testing, deployment, and production support tools relevant to Informatica MDM delivery. Preferred Informatica PowerCenter or IICS: Experience developing or supporting ETL workflows and data integration processes. Informatica Cloud (IICS): Exposure to cloud-based data integration and MDM-related capabilities. Informatica Data Quality (IDQ): Experience with data profiling, cleansing, validation, monitoring, and quality rules. Data Governance Tools: Exposure to tools supporting stewardship, metadata management, lineage, or governance workflows. Agile/Scrum Tools: Experience working with sprint planning, backlog management, collaboration, and delivery tracking tools. Informatica MDM Certification: Certification is an added advantage. Cloud Platforms: Exposure to enterprise cloud environments used to host or integrate data management solutions. Overall Responsibilities Design, develop, configure, customize, and maintain Informatica MDM solutions in line with approved business and technical requirements. Configure and support Informatica MDM Hub, Informatica Data Director, Hierarchy Manager, match and merge rules, trust frameworks, validation rules, and related components. Develop data models, business rules, survivorship logic, and governance controls that support consistent and reliable master data. Work with business stakeholders, data stewards, architects, analysts, and delivery teams to understand master data requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Perform data analysis, profiling, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation to improve data quality. Integrate Informatica MDM with source and target applications using ETL tools, web services, REST APIs, and other approved integration methods. Analyze and resolve development, testing, integration, and production issues within agreed service levels. Participate in requirements gathering, solution design, estimation, code and configuration reviews, testing, deployment, and post-production support. Ensure implementations follow applicable data governance, data quality, security, privacy, and access-control standards. Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, data mappings, test evidence, operational procedures, and support knowledge. Contribute to efficient solution design by reducing unnecessary data processing, supporting responsible use of infrastructure, and considering sustainability impacts where relevant. Deliver maintainable solutions that support business continuity, operational efficiency, data transparency, and measurable improvements in master data quality. Technical Skills (By Category) Programming Languages Essential Strong SQL skills for querying, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and data validation. Strong PL/SQL skills for database procedures, functions, troubleshooting, and data processing. Ability to interpret and implement business rules using Informatica MDM configuration capabilities. Preferred Scripting experience for automation, deployment support, monitoring, or data analysis. Experience working with programming languages used to support REST API integrations or enterprise data services. Databases and Data Management Essential 3+ years of practical experience with Informatica MDM development. Strong experience with Informatica MDM Hub and Informatica Data Director. Experience with data modeling, cross-reference data, base objects, relationships, hierarchies, and business rules. Experience configuring match and merge rules, trust frameworks, validation rules, and survivorship logic. Working knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent relational databases. Understanding of data quality, data governance, data stewardship, metadata, and master data lifecycle concepts. Experience performing data profiling, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis. Preferred Experience with Informatica Data Quality or equivalent data quality platforms. Exposure to metadata management, data lineage, reference data management, or data catalog capabilities. Experience working with large, complex, or highly regulated data environments. Cloud Technologies Essential Ability to support integrations and deployments in the organizations approved environments. Understanding of secure connectivity and data movement between Informatica MDM and enterprise applications. Preferred Exposure to Informatica Cloud (IICS). Experience with cloud-based data integration, data quality, or data governance solutions. Familiarity with enterprise cloud environments, deployment patterns, and monitoring practices. Frameworks and Libraries Essential Informatica MDM Hub framework and related configuration components. Informatica Data Director framework for data stewardship and operational workflows. Experience implementing business rules, validation logic, match and merge processing, trust, and hierarchy management. Preferred Informatica PowerCenter or IICS integration frameworks. Informatica Data Quality capabilities. Experience using approved API frameworks or enterprise integration patterns. Development Tools and Methodologies Essential Experience with requirements analysis, solution design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Experience with defect tracking, source control, release management, technical documentation, and environment coordination. Ability to work within structured delivery processes and follow change-management controls. Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices or equivalent iterative delivery methods. Preferred Experience with automated testing, deployment automation, monitoring, or configuration management. Experience contributing to code reviews, technical estimations, sprint planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities. Security Protocols Essential Understanding of role-based access, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure handling of master data. Ability to apply security and access controls within Informatica MDM and integrated systems. Understanding of secure API integration, protected data transmission, auditability, and least-privilege access principles. Ability to follow applicable organizational data governance, security, and regulatory requirements. Preferred Experience supporting data solutions in regulated environments. Exposure to security reviews, audit controls, data masking, encryption practices, or compliance-related documentation. Experience Requirements Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Informatica MDM development, configuration, integration, testing, and support. Demonstrated experience with Informatica MDM Hub, Informatica Data Director, match and merge configuration, trust and validation rules, Hierarchy Manager, and data governance concepts. Experience translating business requirements into technical designs, data models, configuration specifications, mappings, test cases, and deployable solutions. Experience integrating Informatica MDM with enterprise applications using ETL tools, APIs, web services, or REST interfaces. Experience analyzing data quality issues, investigating root causes, and implementing measurable improvements in data completeness, accuracy, consistency, or duplication rates. Experience with relational databases and strong SQL and PL/SQL skills. Experience supporting production incidents, performing impact analysis, documenting resolutions, and meeting agreed service expectations. Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, or Healthcare is preferred. Experience in Agile/Scrum delivery environments is preferred. Candidates may qualify through equivalent practical experience in MDM, data integration, data quality, or data governance where they can demonstrate comparable technical capability and relevant delivery outcomes. Day-to-Day Activities Configure, develop, test, and maintain Informatica MDM Hub, Informatica Data Director, match and merge rules, trust frameworks, hierarchies, validation rules, and related data management components. Analyze source data, perform profiling and reconciliation, investigate quality issues, and collaborate with data stewards, business stakeholders, analysts, architects, and integration teams. Participate in requirements discussions, design reviews, sprint ceremonies, testing activities, deployment planning, defect resolution, and post-production support. Make implementation decisions within approved standards and designs, escalate risks appropriately, and remain accountable for the quality, security, documentation, and operational readiness of assigned deliverables. Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Management, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered. Minimum 3 years of professional experience developing and supporting Informatica MDM solutions, with demonstrated experience delivering production-ready outcomes. Informatica MDM certification is preferred but not required. Completion of role-relevant training in Informatica MDM, data quality, data governance, SQL, secure integration, and applicable delivery practices is expected. Commitment to continuous professional development through product updates, technical learning, certification opportunities, and evolving data management practices. Professional Competencies Apply critical thinking and structured problem-solving to analyze data issues, identify root causes, assess impacts, and implement sustainable resolutions. Collaborate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, data stewards, and delivery partners while contributing to shared outcomes. Communicate requirements, designs, risks, progress, technical decisions, and support findings clearly through written and verbal channels. Adapt to changing business requirements, technology updates, delivery priorities, and new data management practices through continuous learning. Identify opportunities to improve data quality, automation, maintainability, operational efficiency, and responsible use of technology resources. Manage time and priorities across development, testing, documentation, stakeholder engagement, incident resolution, and delivery commitments.

title: Sr Software Engineer - NVEX
description:
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us. If youre creative, passionate and self-motivated, we want to hear from you! We are looking for an experienced system engineer, who will play a dual role on the NVIDIA Enterprise Experience (NVEX) team. An awesome candidate is highly technical who can triage customer software issues and resolve customer problems as well as someone who can develop key enhancements and tools for the DGX Platform Software, Container Orchestrators, Deep Learning containers, and potentially other Enterprise related system software. This individual should have proven grasp of platform and systems engineering who understands Linux internals, knowledge about servers and has the ability to resolve hardware and/or OS internal issues. This person will also focus on NVIDIA AI Enterprise SW, a cloud-native suite of AI and data analytics software optimized for the development and deployment of AI. NVIDIA AI Enterprise is the operating system of the NVIDIA AI platform, essential for applications built with an extensive library of frameworks: NVIDIA Riva for speech AI, NVIDIA Merlin for recommenders, NVIDIA Clara for medical imaging, and more. We are also looking for someone who has superb interpersonal and communication skills, given you would be working closely with our customers and engineers to understand, explain and resolve issues, and collaborate with the team to build scalable software. If you have a real passion for technology, and you are interested in a role that you can make a difference in and contribute at all different levels, this may be a phenomenal position for you. What youll be doing: Develop features and tools as part of solution engineering efforts to support all Enterprise Service offerings including, but not limited to NGC, Container Orchestrators (such as Kubernetes), GPU accelerated applications, and Deep Learning frameworks. Work with NVIDIA Enterprise customers and internal users to improve the availability, reliability, and overall experience of working with NVIDIA servers, system software stack and Deep Learning Framework containers on NVIDIA GPUs. Take ownership and drive customer issues on system software components, containers, Deep Learning frameworks, and Cloud deployment from inception to resolution. Build upon the opportunity to research new use cases with GPUs for emerging container technologies and Deep Learning frameworks. Bring independent analysis, communication, and problem-solving to customer experience. Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance. What we need to see: BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). At least 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing. Intellectual curiosity, positive attitude, flexibility, analytical ability, self-motivation, and team-oriented. Strong computer science concepts and excellent knowledge of Python and scripting methodologies. Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers, servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers/containerization (ie Docker, Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (ie AWS, GCP). Youd have cultivated a deep Linux knowledge, and be very comfortable working in various Linux environments as well as with Windows OS s. Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Proven experience in developing, triaging and debugging on Linux and Containers and deep learning frameworks. Experience working with distributed systems especially container orchestrators. Any exposure to system level debug and triaging experience. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are expanding fast. If youre a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you.
