title: Software Developer
description:
About Position: 
 We are looking for an experienced C++ Developer to join our platform engineering team and own the shared distributed messaging and networking library that serves as the communication backbone of our analytics platform. This highly scalable library enables seamless communication between packet capture, protocol analysis, decryption, and downstream processing systems with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability. 
 Role: Software Developer (Senior C++ Developer Distributed Messaging & Networking) Location: Gurugram, Bengaluru Experience: 8 to 12 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Design, develop, and maintain a unified Pub/Sub abstraction layer supporting multiple backends including ZeroMQ, Apache Kafka, Apache Pulsar, and Redis. Build and enhance high-performance distributed messaging components used across the analytics platform. Maintain and evolve Java and Python bindings for the core C++ library while ensuring API consistency across languages. Design and implement scalable service discovery mechanisms using DNS-based endpoint resolution and REST APIs. Develop partition assignment and message routing strategies for Kubernetes-based deployments. Optimize performance-critical components including lock-free data structures, ring buffers, time-reorder queues, and thread affinity management. Implement and maintain compression capabilities using ZSTD and related technologies. Manage Redis and Redis Cluster integrations including connection management, protocol handling, and operational monitoring. Develop and support REST server and client components along with OpenAPI-based code generation frameworks. Define, maintain, and evolve Protocol Buffer schemas while ensuring backward and forward compatibility. Develop and maintain traffic filtering and event processing frameworks for efficient data delivery. Write comprehensive unit, integration, and performance tests across C++, Java, and Python ecosystems. Troubleshoot complex distributed system issues involving networking, messaging, performance, scalability, and reliability. Collaborate closely with platform consumers, architects, and engineering teams to evolve APIs and platform capabilities. Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and technical documentation activities. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing practices, and release management processes. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 8-12 years of software development experience with strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later). Extensive experience designing and maintaining reusable libraries, SDKs, or platform components. Strong understanding of memory management, smart pointers, RAII, ABI stability, and performance optimization. Experience with multithreading, concurrency, atomic operations, and lock-free programming techniques. Strong knowledge of STL containers, algorithms, and modern C++ design principles. title: SAP Fiori ,ABAP-Sr Application Developer - 11257
description:
Job Summary Job Title: Sr Application Developer - SAP Fiori ABAP. Experience: 8+ yrs exp. Location: Pune, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Hyderabad. Role Type: Permanent. Work Mode: Hybrid. Shift: 2 PM-11 PM IST. Role Overview A technical role delivered under a strict clean-core mandate. The program has deliberately constrained its build: 79% of requirements are met by standard configuration, and the WRICEF objects will be gated behind conditions precedent a validated requirement, a quantified benefit, and confirmation that no standard alternative exists and extensions are delivered on SAP BTP rather than by modifying the core. This role needs judgment as well as skill: the largest technical risk on the program is over-customization, specifically rebuilding a legacy shop-floor system's bespoke lot-numbering and lot-handling logic one-for-one inside SAP. You will be expected to resist that. Key Responsibilities Translate functional specifications from all workstreams into technical designs, honest estimates and clean-core-compliant build approaches; challenge designs better solved by configuration. Develop the report backlog using CDS views, RAP services and analytical Fiori applications in preference to classical ABAP list reports. Develop enhancements using released extension points BAdIs, key-user and developer extensibility rather than core modifications or implicit enhancements. Design and build interfaces between S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation and edge systems and the analytics layer, using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) plus IDoc, OData, REST and file patterns. Build custom and extended Fiori applications with SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English language support. Build the traveler / batch-card print program and forms carrying resolved machine, tool, hardness, mold, cavity and lot detail; implement quality, hold and disposition approval workflows; build the flexible master-data maintenance application if it clears its gate. Build the composite KPI CDS layer and the post-Material-Ledger allocation engine in the agreed architecture; enforce clean-core governance extension registry, released-API discipline, upgrade-safety review, code review and document objects so client IT can maintain them. Hands-on batch management and end-to-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch and classification data structures in S/4HANA batch master, characteristics and classification, batch determination and status and how to read, extend and report on them without breaking standard behavior. Batch number assignment: standard internal/external number ranges, the batch number BAdI, and the judgment to say honestly when a bespoke lot-number format genuinely cannot be met by standard next-number maintenance. Replicating legacy lot-numbering one-for-one is this program's largest over-customization risk. Batch characteristic copying and re-derivation on split and merge, including enhancement programs that update collected data each time a shop-floor control number is split. Cavity-level and sub-lot data: carrying mold, machine and cavity identity onto batch characteristics and onto planned/production orders via custom fields, and surfacing it on travelers, labels and packing documents. Traceability reporting: building forward/backward genealogy queries over batch data with CDS, integrating with the Batch Information Cockpit and Global Batch Traceability rather than rebuilding them. Interfaces that carry batch identity SFC-to-batch one-to-one mapping with the digital manufacturing layer, vendor batch capture, batch data on delivery documents and the handling of long (up to 40-digit) lot numbers through splits, an open design decision on this program. Required Qualifications 6+ years SAP technical development with 3+ full-lifecycle implementations, including at least 1 on S/4HANA. Strong ABAP OO and ABAP on HANA: CDS views, AMDP, code pushdown and performance optimization; hands-on RAP and modern extensibility (key-user and developer extensibility, released APIs, BAdIs). Demonstrable clean-core delivery: extensions that survive upgrades, and the discipline to refuse core modifications. SAPUI5 / Fiori development including Fiori Elements, annotations, custom controls and launchpad configuration. Hands-on SAP BTP including Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management) and event-based integration; Cloud Foundry or Kyma application development is an advantage. SAP integration technologies: OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc, ALE/EDI, the Data Replication Framework and file-based interfaces; forms and print output (Adobe Forms or SmartForms) for travelers, labels and packing documents. Development against PP, QM and MM/IM/WM with a working functional understanding of what those modules do. Preferred Qualifications Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan, including multi-language UI and print output. Integrating SAP Digital Manufacturing or an MES with S/4HANA, and machine/edge connectivity patterns (OPC UA; bridging non-standard protocols such as CC-Link via middleware or an edge gateway is a distinct advantage). Analytical CDS models consumed by SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud. SAP Build Process Automation or SAP Workflow Management. ABAP Test Cockpit, abapGit, gCTS and CI/CD for SAP. SAP certification in ABAP for S/4HANA, Fiori application development, or BTP Integration Suite. Language Requirement Language Requirement: Bilingual English/Japanese Preferred, Not Required. Fluent professional English is required for design documentation, deliverables and steering-committee communication. Business-level Japanese is a strong advantage many process owners, shop-floor personnel and legacy-system custodians work primarily in Japanese, and much current-state documentation exists only in Japanese but it is not a condition of appointment. Interpretation support, bilingual design documentation and pairing with bilingual business analysts are provided, and strong candidates will be considered regardless of Japanese-language ability. Engagement Details Full-time consulting assignment across the Explore, Realize and Deploy phases. Hybrid delivery with periodic on-site presence at the Japan sites during validation workshops, integration testing, cutover and hypercare. Reports to the workstream lead, working alongside client SMEs, client IT and the corporate global SAP template and clean-core governance teams. Top 4 Job Requirements For This Role Clean-core development discipline CDS, RAP and released extension points only, with the discipline to refuse core modifications and challenge builds better solved by configuration. SAP BTP Integration Suite Cloud Integration, API Management and event-based integration to SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation systems and the analytics layer. Fiori and SAPUI5 delivery Fiori Elements and custom applications, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English support. Batch and lot data expertise batch classification, the batch number BAdI, characteristic re-derivation on split, and the judgment to resist rebuilding legacy lot logic. Relocation Supported: No Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

Ability to work in a global, fast-paced environment. Strong interpersonal skills, experienced building strong cross-functional working relationships. Strong computer aptitude and proficiency in MS Office applications is a must. Ability to work in a global, fast-paced environment.

description:
Job Summary Synechron is seeking an experienced CyberArk Engineer with 4+ years of CyberArk administration and engineering experience to manage, enhance, and support the organizations Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. The role will focus on CyberArk implementation, privileged account onboarding, enterprise integrations, automation, platform maintenance, and operational support. This position contributes to business objectives by protecting privileged accounts, strengthening access controls, supporting compliance requirements, and reducing risks associated with unauthorized or unmanaged privileged access. Software Requirements (Required and Preferred) Required CyberArk Vault: Hands-on administration, configuration, support, and maintenance experience using the organizations supported version. Password Vault Web Access (PVWA): Experience managing administrative access, user workflows, account access, and platform operations. Central Policy Manager (CPM): Experience configuring password policies, account management, password rotation, and reconciliation. Privileged Session Manager (PSM): Experience configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting privileged sessions. Privileged Threat Analytics (PTA): Experience supporting privileged access monitoring, analytics, alerts, and investigation activities. Active Directory and LDAP: Experience integrating CyberArk with directory services and enterprise identity platforms. Windows Server and Linux Administration: Experience onboarding and supporting privileged accounts across Windows, Linux, and Unix environments. PowerShell and Scripting: Experience developing scripts for automation, administration, validation, and operational support. REST APIs and CyberArk APIs: Experience using APIs to support integrations, automation, account management, or monitoring activities. IAM and Security Tools: Practical understanding of identity and access management technologies, privileged access controls, authentication, authorization, and security operations. Defect, Incident, and Change Management Tools: Experience using approved tools to document incidents, service requests, changes, investigations, and operational activities. Preferred CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager (EPM): Experience with administration, policy configuration, endpoint privilege controls, or support. Cloud Identity and Infrastructure Platforms: Experience integrating CyberArk with Azure, AWS, or GCP environments. Automation Tools: Exposure to automation frameworks, infrastructure automation, configuration management, or deployment tools. CyberArk Defender Certification: Preferred. CyberArk Sentry Certification: Preferred. CISSP, CISM, or Security+ Certification: Preferred. Security and Compliance Tools: Experience supporting audit, compliance, vulnerability management, security assessment, or privileged access review activities. Overall Responsibilities Administer, configure, monitor, and support the CyberArk PAM platform, including Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, and PTA. Onboard privileged accounts, servers, applications, databases, network devices, cloud platforms, and other supported systems into CyberArk. Design and implement PAM solutions aligned with approved security standards, access control requirements, operational procedures, and compliance expectations. Configure password management, password rotation, reconciliation, session management, monitoring, alerting, and privileged account controls. Integrate CyberArk with Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, and other enterprise identity and access platforms. Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or CyberArk APIs to improve onboarding, validation, reporting, and operational efficiency. Perform CyberArk upgrades, patches, health checks, configuration reviews, maintenance, and platform optimization activities. Troubleshoot CyberArk platform issues and provide L2/L3 support within agreed service and response requirements. Collaborate with Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Identity, and other technical teams to onboard systems and resolve access-related issues. Participate in incident response, privileged access investigations, session reviews, and remediation activities when required. Support audits, compliance reviews, security assessments, access certifications, and evidence collection. Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, configuration records, and support procedures. Track platform health, onboarding progress, operational risks, defects, and improvement opportunities. Apply efficient and sustainable operational practices by reducing manual processing, reusing automation, and optimizing platform resources where applicable. Technical Skills (By Category) Programming Languages Essential PowerShell scripting for CyberArk administration, account onboarding, validation, reporting, and operational automation. Basic Python scripting for automation, data processing, validation, monitoring, or support activities. Working knowledge of REST APIs and CyberArk APIs for integrations and automated operations. Ability to interpret scripts, API responses, configuration parameters, and platform logs. Preferred Experience with additional scripting or automation languages used in enterprise infrastructure and security operations. Experience developing reusable automation utilities for large-scale account onboarding and platform administration. Databases and Data Management Essential Understanding of privileged account data, account ownership, platform assignments, safe or vault structures, access permissions, password policies, and reconciliation data. Ability to validate account inventories, onboarding information, access records, session data, and audit evidence. Experience onboarding databases and managing privileged database accounts through CyberArk. Understanding of data confidentiality, retention, integrity, and controlled access requirements. Preferred Experience supporting database platforms in regulated or large enterprise environments. Exposure to reporting, dashboards, data extraction, or operational metrics related to PAM activities. Cloud Technologies Essential Experience onboarding or supporting privileged accounts and systems in cloud environments. Understanding of cloud identity, access, administrative accounts, service accounts, and privileged access risks. Experience working with at least one of Azure, AWS, or GCP environments. Preferred Experience integrating CyberArk with cloud identity services, cloud infrastructure, virtual machines, applications, and platform services. title: Quantitative Developer
description:
Quantitative Developer : 

A Quantitative Developer, often called a "Quant Dev," is a highly specialized professional who works at the intersection of finance, mathematics, and computer science.

This role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing algorithms and software solutions for complex financial problems, such as trading strategies, risk management, and pricing models.

A successful Quant Dev combines deep programming expertise with a strong grasp of quantitative finance principles. 
 Key Responsibilities : 
 - Develop, implement, and maintain complex quantitative models and algorithms for high-frequency trading, risk management, or portfolio optimization.

 - Write high-performance, low-latency code in languages like C++ or Java to ensure real-time system efficiency.

 - Collaborate closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and other stakeholders to translate mathematical models into production-level code.

 - Design and build data pipelines for efficient data acquisition, cleaning, and processing from various financial market sources.

 - Conduct thorough backtesting and validation of models to ensure accuracy and reliability under various market conditions.

 - Optimize and refactor existing codebases to improve performance, scalability, and security.

 - Utilize statistical analysis and machine learning techniques to extract actionable insights from large datasets.

 - Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and contribute to the team's knowledge sharing. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications : 
 - Master's or Ph.D. in a highly quantitative field such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Financial Engineering.

 - Exceptional programming skills in a high-performance language, preferably C++ or Java.

 - Proficiency in Python for prototyping and data analysis is also essential.

 - Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity.

 - In-depth knowledge of financial markets, instruments (derivatives, equities, etc.), and quantitative finance concepts.

 - Experience with multi-threaded programming and low-latency systems.

 - Familiarity with statistical analysis, machine learning techniques, and relevant libraries (e.g., NumPy, pandas).

 - Experience with large datasets and database systems (SQL, NoSQL).

 - Excellent problem-solving abilities and the capacity to work in a fast-paced, demanding environment.

 - Strong communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
description:
Job Description Role summary The Senior Staff Software Engineer (IC5) on HR Service Delivery sets and owns the technical direction for model-driven capability across the HR domain and the surfaces adjacent domains build on top of it. The work is agentic and conversational experiences that interpret an employees, managers, or HR agents intent, reason over profile, case, catalog, policy, and knowledge context, invoke tools, and act on the users behalf - but the unit of ownership is the architecture, the standards, and the evaluation infrastructure that let multiple teams ship those experiences safely, not a set of features. This is not a machine learning or AI research role; the engineer does not train foundation models. It is also distinct from traditional staff-level full-stack engineering, where systems follow deterministic logic rather than selecting execution paths at runtime. Two consequences shape the work. First, the most important logic often lives in natural language - instructions, prompts, tool descriptions, guardrails, escalation rules - which must be engineered, versioned, and reviewed with the same discipline as code, and which needs an architecture once more than one team is authoring it. Second, because behavior is probabilistic, correctness is established by measuring behavior at scale rather than by asserting fixed outputs, which makes evaluation a platform investment rather than a per-feature activity. HR sharpens both points along two independent axes. Accuracy. An agent answering on payroll, benefits, leave, or a lifecycle event touches statutory entitlement, jurisdiction-specific policy, and an employees pay. A confidently wrong output is not a bad answer; it is a missed enrollment window or an incorrect leave balance acted on in good faith. Audience. HR data is among the most sensitive on the platform, and correctness of content is not sufficient. An answer grounded in a record or knowledge article the requestor is not entitled to read is a data exposure even when every fact in it is true, and manager-scope and employee-scope views of the same question have different correct answers. Enforcement belongs in the retrieval and tool layer, not in a request to the model, and at this level you own that being true by construction across every team building in the domain. The distinguishing expectation at IC5 is that the hardest problems arrive unframed. You decide what the domain should do about them, commit the organization to an approach, and are accountable for that approach across releases - including for the decisions that turn out wrong. What you do Set the AI architecture for the domain Own the architecture of model-driven capability across the employee lifecycle: how agents are decomposed and composed, where reasoning happens, how context is assembled and bounded, how tools are exposed and described, and how autonomy is delegated and revoked. Establish the reference patterns other teams build against, and the boundaries between what is a shared platform concern and what each product area owns. Make the calls with multi-release consequences - model selection and migration, orchestration approach, build-versus-adopt, and the cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs behind each - and own the outcome. Define where autonomy goes, and where it does not Decide, as a matter of domain policy rather than per-feature design, which HR actions an agent may take, which require a human decision point, and which no agent should attempt. Anything that changes pay, employment status, or a restricted record, and anything touching employee relations or investigation, needs a human in the path by construction. Then build the mechanisms that make those constraints structural and hard to violate accidentally, so that a team shipping a new capability inherits the boundary instead of re-deriving it. You hold the authority to refuse a shipping decision on these grounds, and are expected to use it. Own the shared instruction and tool-description architecture HRSD ships as product: customers configure, extend, and override the instruction and tool surface on their own instances, and adjacent domains build against it. Treat it as a versioned contract with upgrade-safe extension points, deprecation paths, and compatibility guarantees. Own how that surface is structured, reviewed, and evolved across teams - including the authoring standards, the review bar, and the regression coverage that make natural-language logic maintainable at organizational scale rather than only within one codebase. Build the evaluation infrastructure the organization ships against Own evaluation as leverage: the golden datasets, multi-turn suites, judge calibration, CI gates, and drift detection that let many teams change behavior safely and quickly. Extend coverage to the HR-specific failure classes - access-boundary violations in retrieval and citation, cross-scope leakage, jurisdictional and policy-variant correctness - and keep it meaningful across the range of customer configurations rather than a single reference environment. Define the resolution, containment, and quality metrics the domain is measured on, be the person who can say whether they are instrumented correctly, and raise the standard of evidence required before a behavioral change ships. Frame problems the organization has not yet framed Identify the risks, gaps, and structural weaknesses in model-driven behavior that no one has articulated yet, quantify them, and drive them to a decision. This includes the failure classes that only appear at scale or in specific customer environments, the second-order consequences of a model or platform change, and the places where current practice will not survive the next generation of capability. Bring these to product and engineering leadership with the analysis and the recommendation, not the problem alone. Direct AI coding agents, and set how the organization does Convert ambiguous problem statements into testable specifications with explicit scope, constraints, non-goals, and acceptance criteria; decompose work into agent-sized tasks; and supervise parallel workstreams. Beyond your own delivery, define what accountable agent-assisted engineering looks like for the domain - specification standards, review expectations, verification harnesses - and hold the line on it. You own the result regardless of what produced it, and you own the norm. Own production quality, safety, and reliability across the domain Own the observability and safety posture for agentic behavior: conversation quality, containment, hallucination rate, tool-selection error, unsafe or unauthorized action, and the paths where user-supplied content - case notes, inbound email, attachments, authored knowledge - enters agent context as an injection vector. Because HR conversation content is itself restricted, design diagnosis that works without exposing what was said. Lead root-cause analysis on the incidents no one else can resolve, hold the distinction between a genuine model failure and a platform or configuration failure presenting as one, and close the loop from production failure back into specification and evaluation. Deliver hands-on where it matters Stay in the code on the load-bearing parts: the hard integration, the risky migration, the prototype that settles an architectural argument, the incident nobody else can unblock. Delivery at this level is selective and deliberate rather than continuous, and the expectation is that your hands-on work resolves uncertainty for others rather than absorbing feature scope. Influence beyond the team Represent the domains technical position to engineering and product leadership, to customers, and to partner organizations. Communicate capability and risk to non-engineering audiences without flattening either. Build alignment across teams that do not report to you and whose priorities compete. Grow staff-level engineers, raise the bar in technical review and hiring, and make the domains practices around instruction authoring, evaluation, and accountable agent use durable enough to outlast your involvement in any one project. Qualifications Required experience and skills Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AIs potential impact on the function or industry. 12+ years software engineering experience (backend, frontend, or full stack) Strong JavaScript/Node.js, React and API integration skills Automated testing (unit + integration) and CI/CD pipeline experience Solid understanding of data modelling and query optimization Agentic delivery experience: Hands-on experience with AI/GenAI or ML-driven features (LLM prompting, NLU, 
 classification models, or similar) Hands-on experience with LLM-integrated features: prompt design, context injection, output tuning, guardrails. Experience with NLU/intent classification or conversational AI systems Familiarity with ML-driven automation (classification, clustering, recommendation 
 systems) Production AI integration. Experience integrating large language model APIs and retrieval-grounded features, including agent orchestration, tool and function calling, and structured output enforcement. Applied machine learning literacy. A working command of the concepts that govern how these systems behave - evaluation, embeddings, and the probabilistic output and failure modes of modern models - sufficient to reason about, debug, and verify model-driven behaviour in production. Accountable use of AI coding agents. Current, effective use of AI coding assistants and agents with evidence of accountable delivery: precise specification, critical review of generated output, and verification harnesses. Operational experience. Hands-on CI/CD, containerized workloads, and observability experience, plus direct on-call and incident-command experience with customer-facing systems. Mentorship. Demonstrated mentorship of less-experienced engineers and a record of raising quality through code review. Education. Bachelors degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees are a plus but not a substitute for a record of shipping reliable AI-native applications. Preferred experience HR domain depth. HR case management, the employee lifecycle, or payroll, benefits, leave, and absence, at a depth sufficient to challenge a requirement rather than only implement it - including why the same policy question resolves differently by jurisdiction, employment type, or plan year. HCM and downstream integration. Integration with core HR, payroll, and benefits systems of record, including the reconciliation and eventual-consistency problems that come with treating an external system as the authority on employment data. Extensible product engineering. Building capability that customers configure, extend, and override on their own instances, where instruction and tool surfaces are versioned contracts rather than internal implementation. Evaluation and observability tooling. Evaluation frameworks, prompt and instruction management tooling, tracing for model-driven applications, and analysis of production transcripts at scale, particularly where transcript content is itself access-restricted. Conversational channel breadth. Employee self-service portals, virtual agent or chat shells, workplace messaging clients, and voice, including handoff between automated and live agents. Conversation design partnership. Working alongside conversation or content designers on dialogue flow, tone, and error-recovery design - with attention to how an HR answer is worded when the subject is the employees own pay, health coverage, or employment status. Forward deployed delivery. Building against a customers data, integrations, and channels, and tuning instructions and evaluation sets in their environment. Now Platform depth. Scoped applications, ACLs and platform security rules, Flow Designer, UI Builder, Automated Test Framework, and upgrade-safe extension patterns.

title: Software Engineer – Automation & CRM
description:
**Company:**
Schengen Visa Consultancy Limited

**Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India (Hybrid)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
2–4 years

**Salary:**
Competitive, based on experience

**About Us**

Schengen Visa Consultancy Limited is a UK-based visa consultancy helping customers with visa appointments, documentation, and application support. We are improving our technology platform to automate operational processes, enhance our internal CRM, and build more efficient systems as the business grows.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Software Engineer to work directly with the founder on appointment-booking automation, CRM development, backend integrations, and maintenance of our existing software platform.

The primary focus will be
**building reliable automation systems and improving our CRM**
. Website development and maintenance will be secondary responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Appointment Automation**

* Develop and maintain browser automation using Playwright or Selenium.
* Automate repetitive booking and operational workflows where permitted.
* Troubleshoot failed scripts, session issues, timeouts, and website changes.
* Improve automation reliability through error handling, logging, retries, and monitoring.
* Test and maintain existing automation systems.

**2. CRM and Backend Development**

* Develop new features and maintain our existing CRM.
* Fix bugs and improve customer records, appointment tracking, and internal workflows.
* Build and integrate REST APIs with internal and third-party systems.
* Work with databases, write SQL queries, and maintain data consistency.
* Develop scheduled tasks and background jobs to automate repetitive processes.

**3. Website and System Maintenance**

* Maintain existing company websites and related backend functionality.
* Fix technical issues and implement small enhancements when required.
* Support integrations involving payments, email, messaging, and other services.
* Assist with deployments, application logs, debugging, and basic server maintenance.
* Follow good practices for testing, version control, security, and documentation.

**4. Collaboration**

* Work directly with the founder to understand requirements and priorities.
* Convert business requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Provide regular progress updates and communicate blockers early.
* Document important changes and ensure new features work reliably.

**Required Skills**

* Strong programming fundamentals in Java, JavaScript, or a comparable language.
* Practical experience with Playwright or Selenium and browser automation.
* Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP requests, JSON, and API integrations.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases such as MySQL or MariaDB.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub, debugging, testing, and reading existing codebases.
* Ability to investigate problems independently and develop maintainable solutions.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Java, or Spring Boot.
* Familiarity with Linux servers, scheduled jobs, background workers, and deployments.
* Experience integrating payment gateways, email, telephony, or messaging services.
* Experience using AI coding tools while being able to understand and test the code produced.

Candidates do not need to know every technology listed above. Strong fundamentals and relevant practical experience are more important.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone with
**approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience**
who enjoys solving technical problems, improving existing software, and building reliable automation.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role, not a CTO or engineering management position. The candidate should be comfortable working independently on assigned tasks
**while collaborating closely with the founder.**

**Working Details**

* Full-time position based in
  **Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India**
* Hybrid working arrangement.
* Direct collaboration with the founder.
* Compensation based on experience and technical assessment.
* Working hours and any support expectations will be discussed during the hiring process.

**How to Apply**

Please share your CV, current location, availability, and a brief introduction outlining your experience with automation, backend development, and API integrations. Relevant project examples or GitHub repositories are welcome.

**Email: info@schengenvisaconsultancy.co.uk**

We are looking for someone interested in growing with the business and helping us build efficient, reliable technology systems over the long term.

title: ServiceNow Developer – TPRM / IRM / GRC
description:
**ServiceNow Developer – TPRM / IRM / GRC**

**Claidroid — Pune / Thiruvananthapuram, India (Hybrid)**

**Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**

**Location:**
Pune / Trivandrum

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

We're Hiring: ServiceNow Developer – Third Party Risk Management (TPRM)

Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is hiring an experienced
**ServiceNow Developer – Third Party Risk Management (TPRM)**
for a strategic enterprise technology engagement with a leading global BFSI client.

The role involves end-to-end responsibility for designing, developing, configuring, implementing and supporting
**ServiceNow Third Party Risk Management (TPRM)**
solutions within the
**ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM/GRC)**
suite.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with strong hands-on expertise in
**ServiceNow TPRM, IRM/GRC, Vendor Risk Assessments, Policy & Compliance Management, Risk Management, Flow Designer, JavaScript and enterprise integrations**
.

You will work on developing and enhancing enterprise risk management capabilities, supporting vendor onboarding, due diligence, third-party risk assessments, remediation tracking, regulatory compliance and continuous monitoring.

Candidates with experience in
**Financial Services, Insurance, Information Security, Enterprise Risk Management and Regulatory Compliance**
will be particularly relevant.

**About Claidroid Technologies**

Claidroid Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a global digital transformation and technology services partner built around
**Cloud, AI, Automation and Enterprise Platforms**
.

We work with leading enterprises to modernize technology platforms, improve operational efficiency, strengthen governance and deliver high-quality technology solutions.

Our expertise spans ServiceNow, Identity and Access Management, Cloud Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Automation, DevOps, DevSecOps, AIOps and Enterprise Digital Transformation.

**Role Overview**

As a
**ServiceNow Developer – TPRM**
, you will work closely with enterprise Risk, Procurement, Security, Compliance and Technology teams to design, develop and implement effective Third Party Risk Management solutions on the ServiceNow platform.

You will be responsible for configuring and enhancing ServiceNow IRM/GRC modules, with particular emphasis on vendor risk assessments, third-party onboarding, due diligence, risk evaluation, issue remediation and continuous monitoring.

The role requires strong hands-on experience in
**ServiceNow scripting, workflow automation, application configuration, API integrations and platform governance**
.

You will collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable ServiceNow solutions.

You will also contribute to application enhancements, integration development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting and ongoing production support.

The position combines
**ServiceNow Development, Third Party Risk Management, Risk & Compliance Automation, Enterprise Integration and Platform Engineering**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

ServiceNow TPRM & IRM Implementation

* Design, develop and implement ServiceNow Third Party Risk Management solutions aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Configure and customize ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM/GRC) capabilities.
* Develop and enhance Third Party Risk Management workflows and associated platform functionality.
* Configure Policy & Compliance Management processes.
* Support Risk Management capabilities, including risk identification, assessment and associated controls.
* Configure Vendor Risk Assessments and assessment workflows.
* Implement Issue Management processes for tracking identified risks and remediation activities.
* Support Audit Management functionality where applicable.
* Ensure solutions follow ServiceNow development standards and enterprise governance requirements.

**Third Party Risk Management & Vendor Assessments**

* Configure vendor onboarding and third-party due diligence processes.
* Design and maintain vendor risk assessment questionnaires.
* Configure assessment methodologies, scoring models and risk calculations.
* Automate vendor risk assessment workflows, approvals and notifications.
* Support third-party risk evaluation and remediation tracking.
* Implement workflows for continuous monitoring of third-party risks.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Risk, Security and Compliance stakeholders to understand and implement business requirements.
* Improve the transparency, consistency and efficiency of vendor risk management processes.

**ServiceNow Application Development & Configuration**

* Develop and customize ServiceNow applications using platform best practices.
* Design and implement Business Rules, Script Includes and Client Scripts.
* Configure UI Policies and Access Control Lists (ACLs).
* Build automated workflows using ServiceNow Flow Designer.
* Configure Service Catalog components, Catalog Items and Notifications.
* Develop reusable components using JavaScript and ServiceNow Glide APIs.
* Implement custom business logic and application enhancements.
* Troubleshoot ServiceNow configuration and scripting issues.
* Maintain technical documentation covering configurations, customizations and integrations.
* Ensure solution quality, maintainability and adherence to platform governance.

**ServiceNow Integration & API Development**

* Design and develop integrations between ServiceNow TPRM and external enterprise applications.
* Implement REST and SOAP web service integrations.
* Develop integration workflows using ServiceNow IntegrationHub.
* Configure and support MID Server-based integrations.
* Implement secure authentication mechanisms, including OAuth.
* Work with Import Sets and Transform Maps for data integration.
* Support integration with vendor management, procurement, risk management and security platforms.
* Troubleshoot integration failures and data synchronization issues.
* Collaborate with enterprise application owners and integration teams.

**Risk Management, Compliance & Governance**

* Support implementation of enterprise risk assessment and compliance processes.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into ServiceNow technical solutions.
* Configure risk assessment, mitigation and remediation workflows.
* Support policy compliance and issue management activities.
* Apply understanding of Information Security and Operational Risk concepts.
* Support alignment with industry and regulatory frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST and GDPR.
* Contribute to platform governance, auditability and compliance requirements.
* Support risk and compliance reporting.

**Reporting, Dashboards & Performance Analytics**

* Develop and maintain ServiceNow dashboards supporting third-party risk management.
* Configure reports for vendor assessments, risk exposure, issue remediation and compliance activities.
* Support ServiceNow Performance Analytics functionality.
* Provide visibility into outstanding vendor risks and assessment progress.
* Work with stakeholders to understand reporting and analytics requirements.
* Ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.

**Testing, Deployment & Production Support**

* Perform impact analysis for new requirements and platform changes.
* Conduct unit testing and support system testing.
* Participate in production deployment and release activities.
* Investigate and resolve application defects and platform issues.
* Provide ongoing technical support for ServiceNow TPRM and IRM/GRC applications.
* Ensure appropriate testing and documentation before production releases.
* Follow established ServiceNow development and release-management practices.
* Collaborate with global teams to resolve technical issues.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Technical Consulting**

* Work closely with Risk, Procurement, Security, Compliance and IT stakeholders.
* Participate in business requirement discussions and technical workshops.
* Analyse functional requirements and recommend ServiceNow solutions.
* Collaborate with architects and technical teams on solution design.
* Communicate technical approaches, development progress and implementation challenges.
* Work effectively with global delivery teams.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum development and delivery processes.
* Take ownership of assigned technical deliverables.

**Must-Have Skills**

We are looking for professionals with strong hands-on ServiceNow development experience and expertise in
**Third Party Risk Management and Integrated Risk Management**
.

**ServiceNow TPRM / IRM / GRC**

* Strong experience in ServiceNow development and administration.
* Hands-on expertise in ServiceNow Third Party Risk Management (TPRM).
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM/GRC).
* Experience configuring Vendor Risk Assessments.
* Knowledge of Policy & Compliance Management.
* Understanding of Risk Management and Issue Management.
* Experience with vendor onboarding, due diligence and risk assessment workflows.
* Knowledge of assessment questionnaires, scoring models and risk calculations.

**ServiceNow Development**

* Strong JavaScript programming and scripting skills.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Glide APIs.
* Experience developing Business Rules and Script Includes.
* Strong knowledge of Client Scripts and UI Policies.
* Experience with ServiceNow Flow Designer.
* Knowledge of Service Catalog, Notifications and Catalog Items.
* Understanding of Access Control Lists (ACLs).
* Experience customizing and extending ServiceNow applications.

**Enterprise Integrations**

* Experience developing REST and SOAP web service integrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow IntegrationHub.
* Experience with MID Server integrations.
* Understanding of OAuth authentication.
* Experience using Import Sets and Transform Maps.
* Strong troubleshooting capabilities for enterprise integrations.

**Risk Management & Compliance**

* Understanding of the Third Party Risk Management lifecycle.
* Experience with vendor onboarding and due diligence processes.
* Knowledge of vendor risk assessments and risk controls.
* Familiarity with Information Security and Operational Risk principles.
* Understanding of regulatory compliance requirements.
* Awareness of frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST and GDPR.

**Reporting & Support**

* Experience with ServiceNow dashboards and reporting.
* Knowledge of Performance Analytics.
* Familiarity with risk and compliance reporting.
* Experience in application testing, deployment and production support.
* Understanding of ServiceNow platform governance and development best practices.

**Professional Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management abilities.
* Ability to collaborate with business, risk and technical teams.
* Experience working in global delivery environments.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery models.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned deliverables.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

Candidates with experience in the following areas will have an added advantage:

* **ServiceNow Certifications:**
  CSA, CAD or Certified Implementation Specialist – Risk & Compliance.
* **ServiceNow TPRM Implementations:**
  Experience implementing end-to-end TPRM solutions.
* **Audit Management:**
  Experience configuring ServiceNow Audit Management capabilities.
* **Financial Services / Insurance:**
  Understanding of vendor risk assessment processes in BFSI environments.
* **DORA:**
  Knowledge of the Digital Operational Resilience Act.
* **SOX:**
  Familiarity with Sarbanes-Oxley compliance requirements.
* **ServiceNow SecOps:**
  Experience with Vulnerability Response or Security Incident Response.
* **Enterprise Integrations:**
  Experience connecting TPRM with Procurement, CMDB and external risk systems.
* **Risk Platforms:**
  Exposure to Archer, SAP Ariba, OneTrust, SecurityScorecard or BitSight.
* **ServiceNow Transformation:**
  Participation in large-scale ServiceNow implementation or modernization programmes.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for
**experienced ServiceNow Developers who combine strong platform development capabilities with practical expertise in Third Party Risk Management and enterprise risk governance**
.

The ideal candidate should have:

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in ServiceNow development and implementation.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow TPRM and IRM/GRC.
* Experience configuring vendor risk assessments, questionnaires and risk scoring models.
* Strong scripting expertise in JavaScript and Glide APIs.
* Experience developing Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts and UI Policies.
* Strong knowledge of Flow Designer and ServiceNow workflow automation.
* Experience developing enterprise integrations using IntegrationHub, REST and SOAP APIs.
* Understanding of vendor onboarding, third-party due diligence and risk remediation processes.
* Knowledge of risk management, information security and regulatory compliance.
* Experience with dashboards, reporting and production support.
* Strong ability to translate business and compliance requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Candidates should be comfortable working at the intersection of
**ServiceNow Engineering, Enterprise Risk Management, Vendor Governance, Regulatory Compliance and Business Process Automation**
.

**Why Join Claidroid Technologies?**

At Claidroid Technologies, you will work on enterprise technology initiatives for global clients in an environment that values technical excellence, innovation, ownership and continuous improvement.

This role provides the opportunity to build expertise in ServiceNow's risk management ecosystem while contributing to enterprise governance, third-party risk management and compliance initiatives.

**This role provides strong exposure to:**

* ServiceNow Third Party Risk Management
* ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM/GRC)
* Vendor Risk Assessments
* Policy & Compliance Management
* Risk Management & Issue Management
* Vendor Onboarding & Due Diligence
* Risk Scoring & Assessment Automation
* ServiceNow Flow Designer
* JavaScript & Glide APIs
* ServiceNow IntegrationHub
* REST & SOAP Integrations
* ServiceNow Performance Analytics
* Risk & Compliance Reporting
* Regulatory Compliance Frameworks
* Information Security & Operational Risk
* Global BFSI Technology Initiatives

You will collaborate with experienced ServiceNow engineers, solution architects and enterprise risk management professionals while strengthening your expertise in a specialized area of the ServiceNow ecosystem.

**Work Location**

**Pune / Trivandrum – Hybrid**

Candidates should be willing to work in a hybrid model from the designated project location as required by the client.

**Apply Now**

If you have strong hands-on expertise in
**ServiceNow TPRM, IRM/GRC, JavaScript, Flow Designer and enterprise integrations**
, we would like to hear from you.

Join Claidroid Technologies and contribute to developing robust, scalable and compliant third-party risk management solutions for global enterprises.

* **Knowledge of evaluation metrics for LLM outputs (e.g., accuracy, relevance, latency, and robustness).**
* **Exposure to automation frameworks or tools for validating AI/ML model behavior.**

description:
JD: Senior PHP Developer

Senior PHP Developer — Job Description

CodeIgniter 4, PHP 8 and application modernisation

Position Details

Field Details

Job Title Senior PHP Developer

Experience 4–7 years

Openings 1

Employment Type Full-time

Department Engineering — Product Development

Location Chennai (in-office)

About ColorPodge

ColorPodge develops cloud-based colour-management software for the apparel and homewares industries. Its

SaaS products support colour development, approvals, supply-chain collaboration, and specialised business

processes for international customers.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced PHP developer to join a product team that is modernising an established,

business-critical web application on CodeIgniter 4, PHP 8 and MySQL. The work is upgrading existing modules

to the current framework and language versions while the application stays in use, with existing features, data

and user workflows preserved exactly.

The role owns modules end to end: understanding the existing code and its database usage, re-implementing it

on CodeIgniter 4 following the team's established structure, verifying that behaviour is unchanged, and getting

the work tested and merged. This is not a greenfield role. It suits a developer who reads and understands

existing code carefully, converts it faithfully, and improves it where that can be done safely.

Key Responsibilities

Code Analysis and Conversion

Verification and Testing

Engineering Practice

Read and understand existing CodeIgniter controllers, libraries, models, views and helpers, and document

the business rules and role-based behaviour they implement.

Re-implement modules on CodeIgniter 4 using the team's patterns: explicit routes, base controllers,

models, services for business logic, filters for authentication and security, and language files.

Preserve existing URLs, form actions, AJAX endpoints and API contracts so that links and integrations keep

working after the upgrade.

Refactor large controllers and models into maintainable units without changing business outcomes.

Upgrade legacy PHP code to PHP 8: replace deprecated and removed functions, fix type and null handling,

and apply modern PHP where it improves clarity.

Migrate database access to CodeIgniter 4 models and query builder, and handle MySQL version

differences such as SQL modes, strict types, dates and collations.

Compare each upgraded page and workflow with the existing version, role by role, and confirm the same

controls, data, validations, calculations, database writes and emails.

Raise defects found in the existing code separately rather than silently reproducing or silently fixing them.

Write and maintain PHPUnit tests for services and models, and Playwright end-to-end tests for pages, and

keep the regression suite passing.

Work with the QA team on test cases, defect reports and retesting for each module before it is merged.

Write database migrations and seeders with working rollback where schema or data changes are needed.

Keep email, file upload and third-party integrations working through the application's service layer and the

safety rules for non-production environments.

Follow the Git workflow: feature branches, small reviewable commits, pull requests, code review and

merge; resolve merge conflicts in shared files carefully.

Deploy and verify changes on containerised staging environments and investigate issues using application

and server logs.

Improve the user interface progressively while upgrading: modernise legacy jQuery code, improve forms,

tables and dialogs, and add responsiveness and accessibility, without removing features or changing

navigation.

Collaboration and Reporting

Required Skills and Qualifications

Apply secure coding practices (input validation, output escaping, CSRF protection, role-based

authorisation) and fix weaknesses found in existing code.

Work to a module-by-module plan with the team lead, report progress against milestones, and flag early

when a module is slipping or blocked.

Take part in requirement clarification with the technical lead and business stakeholders when existing

behaviour is ambiguous.

Document the modules upgraded: structure, decisions taken, agreed changes in behaviour, and anything

the support team needs to know.

Use company-approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly, within the review and testing process,

and never as a substitute for understanding the code.

4–7 years of professional PHP development, including at least 2 years of hands-on work on production

applications built with CodeIgniter, and demonstrable experience with CodeIgniter 4 (routing, controllers,

models, services, filters, validation, migrations).

Direct experience maintaining or upgrading legacy PHP applications: reading unfamiliar code, mapping its

behaviour, and refactoring without breaking it. Experience with a CodeIgniter 3 to 4 or PHP major-version

upgrade is a strong advantage.

Strong PHP 8 knowledge: type declarations, null handling, exceptions, namespaces, Composer and PSR

standards.

Strong MySQL skills: schema design, joins, indexes, query optimisation, transactions, and version

differences.

Solid front-end skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery, including AJAX-driven pages, and willingness to

modernise legacy front-end code.

Experience writing automated tests (PHPUnit; Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and working with a

regression suite.

Proficiency with Git in a branch, pull-request and code-review workflow, including conflict resolution.

Working knowledge of Linux, a web server such as Nginx or Apache, PHP-FPM and Docker, and the ability

to read application and server logs.

Understanding of web application security: authentication, session handling, role-based authorisation,

CSRF, XSS, SQL injection, and secure file handling.

Disciplined, careful working style: small verifiable changes, evidence before claiming a module is complete,

and clear written communication.

Preferred Skills

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Relevant certifications are a plus.

ISMS / ISO/IEC 27001 Responsibilities

Practice good cyber hygiene by following the established policies and procedures:

Experience with role-based business applications in supply chain, retail, manufacturing or approval

workflows.

Experience with cloud storage, transactional email services and single sign-on integrations.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines.

Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools and the practices needed to review and verify their output.

Awareness of confidentiality, privacy and data-security considerations when working with customer data

and AI-assisted tools.

Keep your devices and applications patched and up to date.

Use strong, unique passphrases — make them long, complex, or both.

Secure all devices with a strong password or PIN, and set them to lock after a few minutes of inactivity as

per IT policy.

Encrypt anything that stores sensitive information.

Turn on built-in anti-malware software and firewall.

Back up important files and data.

Use separate accounts for privileged (administrator) and non-privileged (user) access.

Complete required cybersecurity training.

Report security incidents and respond to security notices.

Refrain from sharing or discussing company information with external parties both during and after your

employment.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: Senior Software Engineer (Autofills Coverage)
description: Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that “we are all in this together” – we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog.As a Senior Software Engineer on the Autofills side of this team, yyou will help make autofill work reliably on the sites people actually use, and keep it fast and unobtrusive as the product evolves. Autofill is the Bitwarden capability that fills logins, payment details, and identities into web forms across browsers. The Autofill Coverage team maintains and expands a curated dataset of site-specific autofill rules, builds automation that continuouslychecks autofill across popular websites, and builds lab-based measurement of autofill’s performance in the browser. Every engineer on the team works across all of this, so we value curiosity and range over a perfect match to any single tool. This is a hands-on role.You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code, alongside your teammates and in close partnership with the wider Autofill team.WHAT YOU WILL DOEnd-to-End Delivery & Ownership: Own substantial pieces of the team’s work from design through production: the site-specific rule dataset and its tooling, theautomation that continuously checks autofill on real websites and turns failures into fixes, and the benchmarking harness that measures autofill’s performance impact and responsiveness. Stay with your work once it is live.Automation at Scale: Design browser automation that runs reliably against real, constantly changing websites. Handle flakiness, dynamic content, and anti-bot measures, and turn results into actionable signal rather than noise.Performance Measurement: Build and improve lab-based benchmarks that measure how autofill affects page responsiveness, rendering, and memory. Treat measurement as engineering: control noise, question surprising numbers, and make sure a metric means what it claims before anyone acts on it.Engineering Standards and Automated Quality: Build and maintain the validation, versioning, and CI checks that catch bad data and misleading results before they ship. Review teammates’ pull requests with care and invite the same scrutiny of your own. Keep documentation and contribution guidance in our open source repositories clear.Decoupled Architecture and Service Boundaries: Design the dataset so it can evolve independently of client release cycles, with backward compatibility across supported client versions. Keep test and measurement tooling cleanly separated from the product code it exercises.Technical Mentorship: Pair on hard problems, share what you learn, and help SDETs and newer engineers find their footing in a security-sensitive codebase.AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants effectively in daily engineering and exercise judgement about where they help and where they do not. Build assistive tooling that speeds up rule authoring, with a human always reviewing and approving the result.Operational Stewardship: Triage autofill defects from support, internal reports, automated checks, and benchmarks. Fix what belongs to the team and route the rest to the right owner with clear attribution.Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration: Partner closely with the Autofill team, Product, Security, and SDET teammates to design and validate solutions before implementation begins.WHAT YOU BRING Overall Experience: 5–9 years building and operating production software, with a track record of owning substantial, technically demanding work end to end as an individual contributor.Technical Stack: We hire for strength and mindset, not an exact tool match. You should be strong in at least one of browser automation or front-end performance, and keen to grow into the other.Expertise – TypeScript or JavaScript, and Node.js – The DOM, HTML forms, and CSS selectors, including how real-world pages diverge from spec – Browser automation with Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Cypress, or front-end performance analysis with Chrome DevTools, Lighthouse, and Core Web Vitals – CI/CD with GitHub Actions or a similar platformExperience – Shell scripting and Docker – Data validation with JSON Schema or similar, and maintaining versioned datasets or configuration – Reading performance data: percentiles, run-to-run variation, and telling a real regression from noise – Dashboards and alerting with Datadog, Grafana/Prometheus, New Relic, or similar – AI-assisted development, preferably Claude CodeFamiliarity – Browser internals such as rendering, garbage collection, the Chrome DevTools Protocol, and Performance APIs (PerformanceObserver, Long Tasks, User Timing) – Browser extension architecture (Manifest V3, content scripts, extension messaging) – Front-end frameworks and tooling such as Lit, React, RxJS, and webpackT-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Depth in one area and genuine range across others. You ask why, not just what; you treat a flaky test or a surprising number as something to understand rather than hide; and you pick up new tools quickly.Practical experience with containerized environments, automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.Secure Coding: Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards, and threat-modeling methodologies, and an understanding of why vetted, human-authored rules and heuristic-based autofill carry different security postures.Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops.Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet.Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions.Why Join UsThis is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world.If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.Equal Opportunity EmployerWe are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

Equilend's 1Source platform presents the opportunity to implement new technologies that can allow the Securities Lending industry to completely reimagine how platforms work and share information, and how true single-source data can be experienced.

We are now seeking a Senior Developer to join us in the Bangalore office on our Ledger team, a key component in the delivery of the firm's Distributed Ledger Technology strategy. In this team we are working on a cutting-edge greenfield development to represent Securities Lending contracts and their lifecycle events.

In this role you will be designing and developing our on-ledger Smart Contracts in DAML and off-ledger supporting components to shape the future of the Securities Lending industry, this project is still at its early phases and the successful candidate will get the opportunity to shape the future of Securities Lending in Web3. If this sounds interesting, then please read on!

**What** **you'll** **do**

* Designing and developing our core Smart Contracts in DAML for our Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)
* Developing off-ledger supporting components in Java and Python leveraging microservice containers in AWS & Kubernetes.
* Deliver complex enterprise solutions with high code standards including unit testing and e2e testing
* Participate in Agile software development projects and tasks include coding, testing, debugging, documentation, peer-review, deploying, monitoring, and support
* Participate in task identification, work effort estimates, and work schedules for development and maintenance activities
* Collaborate with a cross-functional team of developers, project managers, product managers, quality assurance, management and operations

**What** **we're** **looking for**

* 3+ years of commercial experience with recent development experience building Smart Contracts in a distributed ledger environment
* Commercial experience developing smart contracts in DAML
* Experience working with either Canton 2.x or 3.x architecture
* Experience developing Java and/or Python leveraging microservice architectures
* Leveraged AI (Claude, Cursor etc.) tooling within the development lifecycle
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate with stakeholders from across the business (such as Project Managers, Product Owners, Quality Assurance and DevOps)
* Excellent problem solving abilities with the ability to break down complex problems into workable solutions
* Experience in an agile and modern development environment

**Why** **EquiLend****?**

* Be recognised for your contribution through a discretionary annual cash bonus, linked to individual and company performance.
* Work flexibly with up to 100 remote working days per year.
* Take time to recharge with 32 days of paid leave per year, comprising paid, casual, and sick leave, plus public holidays.
* Access comprehensive health insurance for you and your dependents from your first day.
* Receive personal accident insurance from the start of your employment.
* Connect with colleagues at an annual company-sponsored team retreat, hosted at a new location each year.
* If relocating from more than 40 miles away, receive hotel accommodation and travel ticket reimbursement.

**About Equilend**  
Equilend sits at the centre of the securities finance industry. Since 2001, we've built the infrastructure that financial institutions rely on to trade, manage, report and analyse their securities finance activities. We connect 145+ firms across 30+ markets, with around $230 billion in notional traded every day on our platform.  
  
We work with banks, broker-dealers, hedge funds, asset managers, custodians and more across North America, EMEA and Asia-Pacific, bringing greater efficiency, transparency and automation to the securities finance lifecycle. If you join us, you'll be building technology that runs at real scale for some of the world's biggest financial institutions.  
  
We are proud to be Great Place to Work Certified™ in the U.S., UK, Ireland, and India, and were named Trading System of the Year, Americas Data Provider of the Year, and Asian Data Provider of the Year at the Securities Finance Times Industry Excellence Awards 2026.  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**  
The best ideas come from teams who bring different perspectives, backgrounds and ways of thinking. We build that into how we hire, develop, and support our people.  
  
We work to ensure our teams reflect the global markets and clients we serve, creating an environment where everyone can do their best work.  
  
If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process please let us know and we will work with you to make it happen.
