description:
Technical Support Analyst Position Information Job Title: Technical Support Analyst Function: Production Support / Salesforce Support Employment Type: Full-time Location: Bangalore Reports To: Cloud Support Manager Role Purpose The Technical Support Analyst is a hands-on member of the Production Support team, responsible for supporting and maintaining Salesforce applications used across Cigna International Health . 
 The primary focus of the role is day-to-day Salesforce administration across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud , including user lifecycle management, access and permissions, declarative configuration, data maintenance, reporting, and operational support. The role also investigates and manages application incidents through ServiceNow, working with business users, technical teams, and senior support colleagues to restore service, meet agreed service levels, and provide a high standard of customer support. The successful candidate will work with appropriate autonomy , prioritize their workload, and deliver accurate , controlled, and well-documented outcomes. They will escalate work requiring development, architecture decisions, elevated privileges, or higher-risk production changes. Key Responsibilities Salesforce Administration and User Access Create, update, activate, freeze, and deactivate Salesforce users in accordance with approved access requests and user lifecycle procedures. Maintain user access through profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, public groups, and other approved access mechanisms. Investigate and resolve common login, visibility, permission, object-access, field-access, and record-access issues. Maintain access hygiene by reviewing assignments, identifying inappropriate or obsolete access, and supporting periodic access reviews. Apply least-privilege and segregation-of-duties principles, escalating privileged, unusual, or high-risk access requests to the appropriate security , identity-management, or senior Salesforce resource. Maintain clear evidence of approvals and completed access changes where required for audit or control purposes. 
 Declarative Configuration and Platform Maintenance Configure and maintain Salesforce using approved declarative, clicks-not-code capabilities . Support routine changes to standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, queues, assignment rules, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and other administrative configurations . Assist with basic Salesforce Flow configuration and troubleshooting where the requirement is within the role s approved administrative scope. Perform configuration and operational support across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud. Validate changes in an appropriate lower environment before production implementation, following established testing, approval, deployment, and post-implementation validation procedures. Monitor the impact of routine Salesforce releases and support low-risk readiness or validation activities. Escalate requirements involving Apex, Lightning Web Components, complex integrations, architecture changes, or development-intensive solutions. 
 Data Maintenance and Reporting Maintain Salesforce data accurately and securely, including approved record creation, updates, corrections, ownership changes, and controlled bulk activities. Support data imports, exports, and mass updates using authorized tools and documented procedures. Complete appropriate validation and reconciliation before and after data changes. Identify duplicate, incomplete, obsolete, or inconsistent information and work with data owners to improve data quality. Create and maintain standard reports and dashboards to support operational and business requirements. Protect sensitive information and avoid unapproved data deletion, extraction, or other high-risk data activity. Maintain traceable records of approvals, test results, data files, outcomes, and rollback information where required . Incident and Application Support Monitor and manage incidents and support requests assigned through ServiceNow. Review ticket information, confirm the reported symptoms and business impact, and gather any additional information required to investigate the issue. Validate that the correct application or configuration item is recorded and ensure the incident is assigned to the appropriate support group. Investigate common Salesforce and supported application issues, including user access, permissions, configuration, data, workflow, and functional errors. Reproduce issues where appropriate , review available documentation and known issues, and identify a resolution, workaround, or appropriate escalation path. Maintain accurate ticket states and remain aware of applicable responses and resolution of SLAs. Record meaningful internal investigation details, actions taken, dependencies, and escalation of information in work notes. Provide clear and timely customer updates through the appropriate customer-visible ServiceNow fields. Reassign incidents promptly when another team is required , documenting the reason for reassignment. Complete accurate resolution information and clear resolution notes before resolving a ticket. Escalate major, high-impact, recurring, security-related, or technically complex incidents in accordance with established support procedures. 
 Documentation, Automation, and Continuous Improvement Create and maintain clear operational documentation, runbooks, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles. Identify repetitive, manual, or error-prone activities that may be suitable for controlled automation. Contribute to the design, testing, documentation, and ongoing monitoring of low-risk automation solutions. Recommend improvements that increase support efficiency, data quality, customer experience, control effectiveness, or service reliability. 
 Collaboration and Customer Service Work effectively with geographically distributed colleagues across business, production support, identity and access management, security, product, engineering, and development teams. Translate technical issues into clear, practical information for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Manage assigned work with appropriate autonomy , balancing priorities, risk, business impact, and SLA commitments. Provide accurate , professional, and customer-focused communication throughout requests and incidents. Seek guidance when requirements are unclear and escalate promptly when an issue exceeds the role s authority or technical scope. Required Skills and Experience Minimum of three years of professional experience working as a Salesforce Administrator. Practical administration experience across: Sales Cloud Service Cloud Experience Cloud Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce user provisioning, deactivation, access management, profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, and public groups. Experience configuring standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, validation rules, assignment rules, reports, and dashboards. Experience with declarative Salesforce administration and basic Flow configuration or troubleshooting. Experience performing controlled data imports, exports, corrections, bulk updates, and data-quality activities. Demonstrated experience supporting production applications and investigating user, access, configuration, data, and functional issues. Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation, ticket records, change evidence, and audit trails. Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to security, data protection, operational risk, and change control. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Ability to prioritize assigned work, work independently within defined procedures, and recognize when escalation is required . Preferred or Desirable Skills Working knowledge of ServiceNow , including incident handling, work notes, customer updates, resolution information, and SLA awareness. Salesforce Certified Administrator credential . Experience supporting Salesforce in a health insurance, healthcare or other regulated environment. Experience with access reviews, audit evidence, segregation-of-duties controls, or identity and access management processes. Familiarity with Agile delivery, Jira, Confluence, knowledge management, release-readiness activities, user acceptance testing, and smoke testing. Exposure to application-monitoring or log-analysis tools such as Dynatrace or Splunk. Experience identifying opportunities to automate recurring administrative or support activities. Behaviors and Competencies Customer focused: Provides responsive, accurate , and professional support. Team player: Collaborates openly across geographic, business, and technical boundaries. Problem solver: Investigates methodically and uses evidence to reach sound conclusions. Autonomous: Takes ownership of assigned work while escalating appropriately. Process minded: Follows documented controls and maintains complete, traceable records. Security and risk aware : Protects access, data, system stability, and audit integrity. Curious and adaptable: Learns unfamiliar applications and business processes confidently. Continuous-improvement driven: Challenges inefficient manual processes and proposes safe, practical improvements. Clear communicator: Explains technical matters effectively to different audiences. Dependable: Manages priorities and delivers work to agreed time and quality expectations. 
 Scope of the Role This is primarily a Salesforce administration and production-support position , not a Salesforce developer or solution-architect role. description:

 About the Role We are looking for a highly hands-on Platform Engineer who can move seamlessly between SRE/platform responsibilities and production application development . GCP and AWS experience are mandatory. 
 What You'll Do Own production reliability, availability, observability, incident response, and root-cause resolution across GCP and AWS. Build, operate, and improve Kubernetes/GKE environments, Terraform infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation. Design, develop, debug, and maintain production applications, APIs, backend services, and automation using Python, Go, or similar backend languages. Operate and optimize distributed data workloads using BigQuery, Pub/Sub/Kafka, Airflow/Cloud Composer, Cloud Run, and related services. Strong application development and debugging skills in Python, Go, or another modern backend language . Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform/IaC, CI/CD , and cloud-native production systems. Ability to independently troubleshoot distributed systems across application, infrastructure, networking, and data layers. Strong Linux, monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident-management experience. 
 Preferred Skills GCP Associate or Professional certification. Deep experience with GKE and production Kubernetes operations. Experience with BigQuery, Pub/Sub/Kafka, Airflow/Cloud Composer, and high-throughput data platforms. Experience building highly available and fault-tolerant distributed systems. title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure,Kubernetes
description:
Job Description About the role We are hiring a staff software engineer (IC4) for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse. We are distributed across Israel, India, and the Americas. This is a full stack role with its center of gravity firmly on the infrastructure side - expect roughly two-thirds of your time on telemetry infrastructure, data pipelines, Kubernetes and DevOps work, and the rest on the services and product surfaces on top. You will be equally comfortable designing a distributed system and owning it in production. If you like following a system from the event that fires to the chart that renders - and you want the pager for it - you will feel at home. You will lead design and delivery of complex, multi-service features, own technical decisions within a domain, and are fully self-directed - escalating only genuine ambiguities and driving decisions to closure. Of the ten critical skills at this level, incident response management is the only one set at Expert; the rest are Experienced. What you ll do Telemetry infrastructure and data pipelines Design, build, and own backend services for distributed data streaming and processing that handle high-volume, high-cardinality event data with predictable latency and no silent data loss. Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming pipelines and the pipeline components that feed ClickHouse. Own data modeling and query performance in ClickHouse - partitioning, sort keys, materialized views, retention, and the cost curve that comes with all of it. Partner with product and platform teams to shape requirements for telemetry ingestion and processing, then drive the solutions to production. Kubernetes, DevOps, and production ownership Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. Own observability for what you build - meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise. Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives. Full stack engineering and technical leadership Own the full development lifecycle for your work, and build the backend services and APIs that expose telemetry to internal consumers, product surfaces, and AI agents - including API contracts, data models, and schema migrations. Contribute to the analytics front end - dashboards, funnels, and exploration tools - with an eye on performance against large result sets, and improve the web and mobile capture SDKs. Lead the design of complex, multi-service features across team boundaries, drive decisions to closure, and write the design docs and postmortems that outlive the conversation. Raise the bar through code review, test strategy, and automation coverage, and mentor engineers on the team. Qualifications Experience and education requirements The job profile defines IC4 by scope, independence, and impact rather than years served. The minimums below are the screening bar for this requisition. Requirement Mandatory minimum 8+ years of Backend software engineering experience 4+ years of Designing and operating distributed systems 3+ years Kubernetes in production, including Helm and CI/CD 3+ years Kafka or equivalent streaming and data pipelines 3+ years On-call and production ownership Bachelor s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field Required A master s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable. Required qualifications Strong backend development experience in Java, Python, Go or equivalent, used in production at scale. Hands-on experience building distributed systems for data streaming, processing, and storage. Production experience deploying and managing services on Kubernetes, including Helm and CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of Kafka or an equivalent messaging and streaming system. Solid SQL skills and hands-on experience with a columnar or analytical data store, including query optimization and physical data modeling. Demonstrated depth in incident responseand customer escalations Enough front-end capability to build and debug a data-heavy interface: JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Angular. Desired qualifications Production experience with ClickHouse or another OLAP or columnar store - sharding, replication, materialized views, cost tuning. Exposure to observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, metrics and logging stacks, alerting platforms. Experience building product analytics or telemetry platforms, or with stream processing frameworks such as Flink or Spark. Client-side instrumentation - web or mobile SDK development, event capture, session and consent handling. AI skills Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency for IC4 - it applies to how you build and to what you build. Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other - catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt. Integrating LLM APIs into production features - and knowing when a model is the wrong tool for the job. Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores, and agent frameworks; familiarity with the Model Context Protocol is a plus. Exposing telemetry to AI agents through tool interfaces agents can use safely: predictable schemas, bounded results, clear error semantics, sane cost controls. Designing safeguards for non-deterministic components - retry logic, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - and hardening against latency spikes and hallucinated output reaching a customer. Instrumenting AI features in production and judging their quality from telemetry and evaluation rather than impressions.

title: AT&T Databricks - Lead
description:
Overview
 
 We are looking for a Senior Lead - Databricks Data Modernization to lead the design and implementation of a data modernization program involving both new data feature development in Databricks and the migration of existing capabilities from Palantir Foundry to Databricks . The role requires a strong combination of Databricks engineering, data architecture, technical leadership and program execution skills . The candidate will be responsible for translating business and technical requirements into scalable Databricks solutions, guiding the engineering team, driving the Palantir-to-Databricks migration, and ensuring high-quality delivery. The Senior Lead will work closely with customer stakeholders, enterprise/data architects, product owners, engineering teams and AI/ML teams and will be expected to take ownership of technical decisions and end-to-end delivery. 
Responsibilities
 
 

 1. Technical Leadership Solution Design 
 Lead the design and development of scalable Databricks-based data solutions . Translate business requirements into technical architecture, data models and implementation plans. Define appropriate patterns for data ingestion, transformation, processing, storage and serving. Establish engineering standards, coding standards and reusable frameworks for the Databricks development team. Make technology and design decisions balancing performance, scalability, maintainability, security and cost . Review technical designs and code produced by the engineering team. Identify opportunities to modernize and simplify existing solutions. 

 2. Palantir Foundry Databricks Migration 
 Lead the technical assessment and migration of existing Palantir Foundry capabilities to Databricks . Analyze existing Foundry pipelines, datasets, transformations, business rules and dependencies. Develop migration strategies and target-state architectures for different Foundry capabilities. Define appropriate Databricks-native replacements rather than simply performing a one-to-one migration. Identify migration complexity, dependencies, risks and technical gaps. Develop migration plans covering: Data ingestion Data transformation Data quality Data comparison/reconciliation Data models APIs/integrations Downstream analytics and applications Lead source-to-target mapping and functional/data validation. Establish approaches for achieving data and functional parity between Palantir and Databricks. Identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability and maintainability during migration. 

 3. Databricks Engineering 
 Provide hands-on technical leadership using: Databricks Apache Spark PySpark Spark SQL Python Delta Lake Unity Catalog Lakeflow / Spark Declarative Pipelines Databricks Workflows Design and implement batch and near-real-time data pipelines. Implement incremental processing, CDC and SCD patterns. Design and optimize Medallion Architecture implementations. Implement data quality, validation, reconciliation and error-handling frameworks. Optimize Spark workloads and Delta tables for performance and cost. Ensure production-grade engineering practices across the team. 

 4. Data Architecture Governance 
 Work with enterprise architects to define the target Databricks data architecture . Define appropriate Bronze, Silver and Gold data layers. Establish data modelling and data integration standards. Ensure appropriate use of Unity Catalog for governance, access control and lineage. Define standards for data quality, metadata, lineage and observability. Ensure solutions comply with enterprise security and governance requirements. 

 5. Team Leadership Mentoring 
 Lead and mentor a team of Databricks/data engineers. Break down requirements into technical tasks and assign work across the team. Provide technical guidance and unblock engineers on complex issues. Conduct design and code reviews. Establish engineering best practices and reusable components. Support capability development and knowledge sharing within the team. Act as the primary technical escalation point for the engineering team. 

 6. Customer Stakeholder Management 
 Work directly with customer technical and business stakeholders. Lead technical discussions, requirement clarification and solution workshops. Present architecture, migration approaches and technical recommendations to senior stakeholders. Translate complex technical issues into clear business implications. Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively. Work with customer teams to prioritize migration and new feature development. Build strong working relationships with customer architecture, data and application teams. 

 7. Delivery Program Execution 
 Own technical delivery for assigned workstreams. Develop technical delivery plans, estimates and milestones. Identify technical risks, dependencies and mitigation strategies. Track progress against technical deliverables. Ensure solutions meet agreed quality, performance and security standards . Coordinate with project/program managers to ensure successful delivery. Support release planning, production deployment and transition to operations. 

 8. DevOps Production Engineering 
 Establish CI/CD practices for Databricks solutions. Implement Git-based development and deployment processes. Use Databricks Asset Bundles and appropriate deployment automation. Define automated testing strategies for data pipelines. Establish monitoring, logging and alerting standards. Lead root-cause analysis of production issues. Drive performance and cost optimization of Databricks workloads. 
Requirements
 
 

 Databricks - Mandatory 
 Strong hands-on experience with Databricks Apache Spark / PySpark Spark SQL Delta Lake Unity Catalog Databricks Workflows / Jobs Lakeflow / Spark Declarative Pipelines Databricks Asset Bundles Databricks performance optimization Medallion Architecture 

 Data Engineering 
 Large-scale data processing ETL/ELT architecture Data modelling Batch and incremental processing CDC SCD Type 1 / Type 2 Data quality and reconciliation Data integration Structured and unstructured data processing 

 Programming 
 Strong Python Strong SQL Good understanding of software engineering principles Experience developing reusable and production-grade frameworks 

 Cloud 
 Strong experience in Azure Cloud Experience with cloud storage, networking, security and cloud data services is preferred. 

 DevOps 
 Git CI/CD Automated testing Databricks deployment automation Infrastructure-as-code concepts Production monitoring and operational support Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry will be strongly preferred because the project involves migration of existing Foundry capabilities.

title: Embedded Software Engineer BSP Platform
description:
Job Title 
 Embedded Software Engineer BSP Platform Location: Bengaluru 

 Job Summary 
 Who Are We At HyPrix, were building attritable payload delivery systems for autonomy. Things that fly fast, were enabling them with conscious software. Replicating the capabilities of expensive conventional frontline systems, were building the cheapest micro and cruise missile systems on the planet. Built for a war of attrition, built for the era of software-defined warfare, built to cater to the front lines of battlefields where no man should stand in the future. 

 What You'll Do 
 The Embedded Software Engineer II - BSP Platform writes and maintains the low-level platform software on the HyPrix flight computer. This software is the layer between the silicon and the RTOS. Startup code and clocks. Write and maintain the reset path, vector table and stack set-up for each processor. Configure the oscillators, PLLs and bus clock. Memory, MPU and caches. Write the linker scripts and the memory map. Configure the MPU, caches and FPU, and set the cache rules for DMA buffers. Interrupts, timers and multicore. Configure the interrupt controller from the interrupt priority map. Start the secondary cores and configure lockstep on Cortex-R, C2000 processors. Linux BSP. Configure U-Boot, the device trees and the kernel for the Cortex-A processors. Build the root filesystem with Yocto or Buildroot. Board bring-up. Do the first power-on of new and revised boards with the staged bring-up checklist. Test the clocks, memory, flash and each peripheral in turn. Record each result in a bring-up report, and improve the checklist after each board. Board revisions, errata and defects. Port the BSP to each new board revision and processor, and keep the board and software compatibility matrix. Implement a software workaround for each silicon or board erratum. Write clear defect reports for the avionics hardware team. HAL and drivers. Implement the HAL and the drivers for UART, RS-422/485, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet, ADC, PWM, timers and DMA. Each driver must be RTOS-independent and use static memory allocation. Bootloader and firmware update. Implement the bootloader, dual-bank (A/B) images and rollback. Make sure that the unit boots after a power cut at any point in an update. Watchdogs, resets and BIT. Configure the hardware watchdogs and record the reset cause at each boot. Write fault handlers that save a fault record before reset. Write the power-on BIT tests for the processor, memory and peripherals. Non-volatile storage. Write the flash and eMMC drivers, and the partitions for images, configuration. Make sure that a power cut during a write does not corrupt data. Time base. Set up the hardware time base and the PPS capture that each timestamp uses. Latency and execution time. Measure the worst-case interrupt latency and the execution time of each driver on the target. Record the results in the driver documentation. Board documents. Keep the memory map, interrupt priority map, DMA channel map, pin map and errata log current and in version control. Test support. Write unit tests for each driver, and the host build and simulation back-ends for SIL tests. Give fault-injection points to the test team for HIL tests. 

 Requirements 
 Minimum Experience (Years): 3 to 4 years of embedded software or firmware development on microcontrollers or SoCs. This includes hands-on bring-up of at least one custom board. HyPrix prefers this experience, but it is not mandatory. Demonstrated capability is more important than years. Embedded C. Strong C for bare-metal and RTOS firmware. Good knowledge of C++. ARM Cortex-M. Hands-on work with startup code, linker scripts, vector tables, NVIC priorities, the MPU and caches. ARM Cortex-R. Hands-on work with Cortex-R5 or Cortex-R52 cores, for example TI Sitara AM64x or the Zynq UltraScale+ RPU. Knowledge of TCM, the GIC or VIM, ECC, lockstep and the Cortex-R MPU. ARM Cortex-A. Worked with Cortex-A53 or similar, for example NXP i.MX 8 or the Zynq UltraScale+ APU. Knowledge of the MMU, exception levels and the boot flow to the kernel. TI C2000 or F29x. Hands-on work with TI C28x or C29x real-time MCUs, their ePWM, eCAP, ADC and CLA peripherals, and C2000Ware. Embedded Linux. Hands-on work on at least one embedded Linux system, with U-Boot, device trees, kernel configuration and Yocto or Buildroot. Drivers. Production drivers for UART, SPI, I2C and CAN, with interrupt and DMA designs. Board bring-up. First power-on with peripheral tests and memory tests. RTOS. Production experience with an RTOS such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr or ThreadX. Bare metal. Production firmware without an operating system, with interrupt-driven designs. Hardware literacy. Ability to read schematics and datasheets, and to debug with JTAG or SWD, an oscilloscope and a logic analyser. Tools. Experience with GCC or a vendor toolchain, Make or CMake, Git and Python scripts. Software quality. Knowledge of MISRA C, static analysis, unit tests and code review. A bachelor's degree in electronics, electrical, computer engineering or computer science.

title: Embedded Software Engineer Mission Computer RT linux
description:
Job Summary 
 Embedded Software Engineer - Mission Computer, RT Linux owns the middleware on the Linux mission computer, and the data link between the mission computer and the flight computer. The position holder works to the platform architecture that the Avionics firmware/software team sets. The Linux kernel, the BSP, drivers, payload algorithms, video compression and the air-to-ground link are not in the scope of this role. Job Type: Full time. Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. 

 Responsibilities 
 Process model. Define the process set, the startup order, the systemd units, the cgroup limits, the real-time classes and the CPU affinity on the PREEMPT_RT kernel. Process supervision. Detect crashed or hung processes, restart them with backoff, and report each restart to the health framework. Escalate repeated faults to a defined degraded state. IPC middleware. Select and integrate the middleware for the mission computer: DDS, ROS 2, Zenoh or a shared-memory library. Bridge it to the message model of the flight computer with the same topic definitions. Flight computer link. Design the transport above the link driver, with frames, sequence numbers, integrity checks, rate limits and topic bridges. Add a data dictionary version handshake at each connection. Isolation of the flight computer. Bound the inbound rates and buffers, and detect loss of the mission computer. Prove by test that a flood, a disconnect, a reboot or invalid data from the mission computer does not cause a deadline miss on the flight computer. Onboard message security. Authenticate the messages between processors with message authentication codes and replay protection. Apply an allow-list of the topics and commands that the flight computer accepts from the mission computer. Application sandbox. Run each application as an unprivileged user with minimum capabilities, seccomp filters and a read-only image. Isolate the applications that handle external data from the process that talks to the flight computer. Time, logs and health. Supply the PTP or PPS time-sync client, and report the clock offset as a health item. Supply the event log and the data recorder on Linux, aligned in time with the flight computer. Report CPU, memory, temperature, storage and process health to the flight computer. Integration and test. Help payload, vision and mission engineers put their applications on the platform. Run the platform in SIL and on the HIL bench with the Testing team. Write the mission computer platform specification and the onboard communication security design. 

 Requirements 
 Minimum experience (years): 4 years of Linux systems software or robotics middleware development, with 2 years on embedded Linux targets. This includes middleware or IPC layer in a product. 

 Required Skills 
 Modern C++. Strong C++17 or later on Linux, with unit tests, code review, Git and CI pipelines. Linux systems software. Processes, threads, signals, sockets, shared memory and epoll in user space. Middleware. Production work with at least one of DDS (Fast DDS, Cyclone DDS or RTI Connext), ROS 2, Zenoh, ZeroMQ, or gRPC with Protobuf. Real-time Linux. systemd, cgroups, real-time classes and CPU affinity on PREEMPT_RT kernels. Embedded Linux targets. Hands-on work with NVIDIA Jetson, AMD Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+, NXP i.MX 8, TI AM6X or similar SoCs. Networks. UDP, TCP and multicast, with packet analysis in Wireshark. Linux security controls. Users and groups, capabilities, seccomp, namespaces and file permissions. Debug and tools. Debug with gdb, strace, perf and system logs. Python for tools and test scripts. A bachelors degree in electronics, electrical, computer engineering or computer science is preferred but not mandatory. 

 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience with Rust on Linux. Knowledge of PTP (IEEE 1588), chrony or PPS time synchronisation. Knowledge of HMAC, AES-GCM, and TPM or HSM interfaces. Experience with Docker or Podman on embedded targets, and with Yocto or NixOS images. Experience with MAVLink or STANAG 4586 between an autopilot and a companion computer. Experience with GStreamer, CUDA or DeepStream pipelines. Experience with MCAP, Foxglove or PlotJuggler. Experience on UAV, robotics or defence mission computers.

This isn't just about maintaining systems. We run tens of thousands of automated tests for every single commit . As Okta grows, this CI/CD workload presents a monumental engineering challenge. Your primary goal will be to attack this problem head-on. You will be a key builder in our quest to shrink massive, distributed compute jobs from hours or days down to just minutes . What You'll Do (The Impact) As a Staff Engineer, you are a technical leader, architect, and hands-on builder. Kubernetes is a Must: You have deep, practical experience building, running, and troubleshooting workloads on Kubernetes. You understand pods, operators, scheduling, and networking inside and out. title: Software Engineer - Java & Kubernetes
description:
**About Us**
One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Our team builds and maintains the core backend architecture and orchestration engines that power our high-scale production systems. We bridge traditional backend software engineering with modern cloud-native deployment and automated workflow pipelines.
  
  
In this role, you will be exposed to enterprise-scale distributed systems, container orchestration at scale, and end-to-end data pipeline automation. You will use your Java expertise to build robust backend microservices while leveraging Python and Apache Airflow to orchestrate complex scheduled workflows. By deploying and managing these components within Kubernetes, you will ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and smooth deployment cycles.
  
  
Your work directly controls how our core application logic and automated workflows run in production. By keeping our Kubernetes deployments resilient and our Airflow pipelines performing efficiently, you ensure seamless service uptime, rapid deployment of new features, and reliable data delivery for end users.
  
  
**The day-to-day**

* Feature Integration & Development: Writing clean, scalable, and well-tested Java code to build and extend core backend microservices.
* Workflow Orchestration: Designing, building, and maintaining Apache Airflow DAGs and Python scripts to automate multi-step processing jobs and background tasks.
* Kubernetes Orchestration: Writing and updating Kubernetes manifests and Helm charts to manage application pods, service configurations, and scaling strategies.
* Continuous Deployment: Automating build, test, and release processes to support zero-downtime continuous deployment to production users.
* Operations & Monitoring: Troubleshooting container performance, monitoring cluster health, and resolving production bottlenecks across Java services and Airflow runners.

**What You'll Need**

* Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional software development experience.
* Core Language: Strong proficiency in Java and its ecosystem, with a solid understanding of object-oriented programming.
* Orchestration: Hands-on commercial experience with Docker and Kubernetes (K8s). You should be comfortable managing pods, deployments, services, and configurations.
* Workflow Tools: Practical experience building and maintaining pipelines in Apache Airflow.
* Secondary Language: Proficiency in Python for scripting, data processing, and Airflow DAG creation.
* Version Control & CI/CD: Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).

**What Will Help You On The Job**

* Ability to work on distributed remote agile teams with a high degree of self-motivation and ability to work independently.
* Exposure to GraalVm is an additional plus
* Experience with cloud platforms GCP
* CI/CD and Devops exposure is a strong plus
* Travel Requirement: Up to 10%

title: Lead Developer - Java and Microservices
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically accomplished
**Application Dev Lead**
to join our team, responsible for architecting, developing, and leading our core banking integration strategies and modern microservices ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert in integration technologies, possess deep, hands-on expertise in
**Java Microservices and enterprise Database engineering (Oracle/SQL)**
, have extensive knowledge of the financial services domain, and demonstrate a proven track record of leading technical teams to deliver robust, scalable, and secure solutions.
  
  
This role requires a unique blend of hands-on technical excellence, architectural vision, database performance optimization, and strong people management skills to drive the modernization and stability of our mission-critical banking systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Leadership & People Management**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of developers, backend engineers, and integration specialists, fostering technical capability, career growth, and engineering excellence across Java microservices and middleware platforms.
* Project & Delivery Ownership: Take full ownership of technical delivery across complex integration initiatives, including architectural scoping, task breakdown (WBS), accurate sprint estimation, resource planning, and milestone prioritization.
* Quality Assurance & Engineering Governance: Enforce best-in-class engineering practices by conducting rigorous code reviews, pull request audits, and comprehensive architectural design reviews (TDRs).
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate seamlessly across business lines, enterprise architecture, database administrators, infrastructure, Information Security, and third-party vendor teams to align technical delivery with strategic business goals.
* SME & Agile Delivery: Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for complex escalations, production incident triage (Sev-1/MIM), and root-cause analysis, while driving Agile/Scrum ceremonies to ensure predictable, high-quality, and timely delivery.

**Technical & Domain Responsibilities**

* Java Microservices Architecture: Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, containerized Java microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and RESTful/gRPC APIs, implementing distributed resilience patterns (Saga orchestrations, Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads, Outbox pattern).
* Database Engineering & Query Performance: Design robust database models and persistence layers (Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, JDBC), execute query tuning, analyze execution plans (EXPLAIN PLAN), optimize indexing strategies (B-Tree, Bitmap, composite), and resolve connection pool (HikariCP) and row-level locking contentions in enterprise Oracle/SQL environments.
* High-Availability Integration Design: Design and implement resilient, distributed integration solutions prioritizing active-active high availability (HA), fault tolerance, multi-region disaster recovery (DR), recoverability, and minimal business disruption.
* Legacy-to-Cloud Modernization: Lead the architectural evolution and phased decomposition of legacy centralized middleware (TIBCO BusinessWorks, IBM MQ) into distributed, event-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka and cloud-native Java microservices.
* Banking Domain Systems Integration: Apply deep expertise in banking and financial services to integration architecture, specifically in real-time fraud detection, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT, Fedwire, ACH), clearing and settlement, and core enterprise banking ledgers.
* Security, Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all integration services strictly comply with enterprise security baselines, audit controls, regulatory mandates (OCC, Fed, PRA, MAS), data protection rules (PII, PCI-DSS), Mutual TLS (mTLS) certificate management, and operational resilience standards.
* High-Volume Real-Time Messaging: Oversee the architecture, throughput tuning, and management of real-time transaction flows, high-volume messaging pipelines, dead-letter queue (DLQ) automation, and sub-second SLA routing.

**Recommended Qualifications**
**Core Technical Skills**

* Java & Microservices:

+ Advanced proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), Multithreading, Concurrency, and JVM tuning (Memory management, Garbage Collection - G1GC/ZGC).
+ Hands-on mastery of Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch).
+ Deep experience with Microservices patterns (Saga Orchestration/Choreography, CQRS, Circuit Breaker via Resilience4j, API Gateway routing).
+ Containerization and orchestration experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.

* Database & Data Persistence:

+ Advanced expertise in Relational Databases: Oracle (19c+), SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers.
+ Deep knowledge of Query Performance Tuning, Execution Plan analysis (EXPLAIN PLAN), index design, partitioning, and stats gathering.
+ Mastery of connection pool management (HikariCP), lock contention mitigation, deadlock resolution, and transaction isolation levels (READ COMMITTED, SERIALIZABLE).
+ Solid understanding of ORM frameworks (Hibernate, JPA) and mitigation of ORM antipatterns (N+1 queries, dirty checks).

* Enterprise Middleware & Messaging:

+ Subject Matter Expertise in TIBCO technologies: TIBCO BusinessWorks (BW 5.x / 6.x), TIBCO Enterprise Message Service (EMS), TIBCO Administrator/TEA.
+ In-depth experience with enterprise queuing and streaming: IBM MQ and Apache Kafka (Topic design, Partitioning, Consumer Groups, Schema Registry).

* APIs & Protocols:

+ Contract-first API development: RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger, SOAP Web Services, gRPC.
+ Data formatting & transformation: JSON, XML, XSD, WSDL, XPath, XSLT, and Canonical Data Modeling.

* Security & Cryptography:

+ Solid foundation in transport and application security: SSL/TLS 1.3, Mutual TLS (mTLS), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Keystores/Truststores, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, and API Key/Token management.

* DevOps, CI/CD & Observability:

+ Build & CI/CD toolchains: Git, Maven, Gradle, Harness, TeamCity, Jenkins, uDeploy.
+ Comprehensive monitoring & logging: Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Micrometer, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Zipkin).

**Good To Have Skills**

+ Automated Testing & Quality Engineering:

- Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).
- Familiarity with unit and integration testing frameworks such as JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers, and Spring Boot Test.
- Experience with API contract testing tools (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract) and performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling).
- Knowledge of automated code quality gates and static analysis tools (SonarQube, Checkstyle).

**Banking Domain Expertise**

- Deep expertise in banking and financial services integration architecture and enterprise application patterns.
- Proven experience with real-time fraud detection pipelines, payment processing rails (ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, Fedwire, NACHA/ACH, RTP), core ledger accounting, and trade/transaction processing systems.
- In-depth knowledge of real-time transactional flows, straight-through processing (STP), guaranteed exactly-once delivery, idempotency key patterns, and high-volume messaging resilience.
- Hands-on familiarity with global banking regulations, audit readiness, operational resilience standards, and data protection frameworks (GLBA, GDPR, PCI-DSS).

**Leadership & Management**

- Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams of developers, backend engineers, and integration architects.
- Proven ability to manage full end-to-end technical delivery, including architectural roadmapping, scope definition, backlog grooming, estimation, and task prioritization.
- Track record of establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, reducing technical debt, and elevating team capabilities in modern technologies.
- Exceptional stakeholder management, technical communication, and presentation skills across technical teams and executive business sponsors.
- Strong proficiency in driving agile project delivery using Scrum/Kanban methodologies, sprint planning, and release governance.

title: Lead Developer- Python, Cloud
description:
REMOTE/HYBRID Lead Developer- Python, Cloud

**About the Role**

We build AI-powered products for startups and scale-ups — from conversational AI agents embedded in enterprise SaaS (legal tech, fintech) to parametric insurance platforms running ML on credit card transaction data. We’re Ignite Solutions, and we operate as the full technology team for our clients: not a dev shop, but a strategic engineering partner.

We’re looking for a Lead Developer who loves building as much as leading. You’ll own technical direction on client engagements, but you’ll also be in the code every day — writing it, reviewing it, and setting the standard for it. You’ll work across domains — AI agents, cloud platforms, mobile apps, and web based apps, and you’ll be as comfortable challenging a client’s assumptions as you are shipping production Python.

**What You’ll Work On**

* Architecting and building AI-native products, agents, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, agentic tool use — that solve real business problems, not demos.
* Working directly with clients to understand their domain, define the right solution, and set realistic technical expectations
* Recommending technology stacks, cloud architectures, and API designs, and then building them yourself
* Integrating with third-party systems (industry-specific APIs, government data sources, payment platforms, lab systems, and more)
* Leading small engineering teams: hands-on coding, code reviews, mentoring, and day-to-day problem-solving
* Representing the technical capability of Ignite in client conversations, including at founder and C-suite level

**What Makes You a Strong Fit**

*Non-negotiable*

* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time in a lead role where you were still writing code daily.
* Deep, hands-on Python experience: Flask, Django, or FastAPI; comfortable owning backend architecture and API design end to end
* Solid experience with one or more major cloud platforms (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP also relevant)
* Proficiency across SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, MongoDB; Redis and ElasticSearch are a plus)
* Strong communication skills: you can explain a technical decision to a non-technical founder and a senior engineer in the same conversation

*Strong differentiators:*

* **Frontend architecture fluency**
  : you don’t need to be a frontend engineer, but you understand how modern frontends are structured, what React (or React Native or Flutter) can and can’t do well, where the performance and integration constraints live, and how to make good full-stack decisions with that knowledge. This will set you apart.
* Experience building AI agents or agentic systems (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent)
* Working knowledge of LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and LLMOps (LangFuse or similar)
* DevOps competence (CI/CD, cloud infrastructure management, deployment pipelines)
* Exposure to ML or data science in applied, production settings

****About Us****

Ignite Solutions is a product engineering firm that works as the embedded technology team for startups that don’t want to – or can’t – build one in-house. Our clients span insurtech, legal tech, fintech, healthtech, and AI SaaS. In practice, we provide fractional CTO leadership, solution architecture, product engineering, AI engineering, UX design, and DevOps — often all on the same engagement.

We’re a small, experienced team. You’ll work on technically demanding problems with real client impact and meaningful autonomy. If you want to be handed a spec and told exactly what to build, this isn’t the right place. If you want to help figure out what should be built, and then build it well, it is.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:

As a leading provider of K–12 core curriculum, supplemental and intervention solutions, and professional learning services, HMH partners with educators and school districts to uncover solutions that unlock students’ potential and extend teachers’ capabilities.
  
  
HMH serves more than 50 million students and 4 million educators in 150 countries. For more information, visit www.hmhco.com
  
  
Staff Software Engineers are the technology leaders of our highest impact projects. Your high energy is contagious, you actively collaborate with others across the engineering organization, and you seek to learn as much as you like to teach. You personify the notion of constant improvement as you work with your team and the larger engineering group to build software that delivers on our mission. You use your extraordinary technical competence to ensure a high bar for excellence while you mentor other engineers on their own path towards craftsmanship. You are most likely T-shaped, with broad knowledge across many technologies plus strong skills in a specific area. Staff Software Engineers embrace the opportunity to represent HMH in industry groups and open-source communities.
  
  
**Area Of Responsibility**
You will be working on the HMH Educational Online/Digital Learning Platform. The team builds highly scalable and available platform using Microservices Architecture, Java microservices backend, REACT JavaScript UI Frontend, REST APIs, Postgres Database, AWS Cloud technologies, AWS Kafka, Kubernetes or Mesos orchestration, DataDog for logging/monitoring/alerting, Concourse CI or Jenkins, Maven etc.. You will need experience in Agent AI development and proficiency in using AI-assisted engineering tools like OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, and similar platforms. The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading a team of developers and AI engineers to build intelligent, autonomous, and highly scalable solutions leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Be the technical lead for feature development in a team of 5-10 engineers and influencing the technical direction of the overall engineering organization.
* Decompose business objectives into valuable, incrementally releasable user features accurately estimating the effort to complete each.
* Contribute code to feature development efforts demonstrating to others efficient design, delivery and testing patterns and techniques.
* Review and structre code generated code by AI agents as well as developed by team
* Work on incorporating business logic, integration points and other conditions not captured by the agents in the generated code.
* Strive for high quality outcomes, continuously look for ways to improve team productivity and product reliability, performance, and security.
* Develop the talents and abilities of peers and colleagues. Create a memorable legacy as you progress toward your personal and professional objectives.
* Foster your personal and professional development continually seeking assignments that challenge you.

**Skills & Experience**
Successful Candidates must demonstrate an appropriate combination of:
  
  

* 6 – 10+ years of experience as a software engineer.
* 3+ years of experience as a Staff or lead software engineer.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a STEM field.
* A portfolio of thought leadership and individual technical accomplishments.
* Full understanding of Agile software development methodologies and practices.
* Good exposure to AI Agentic development and reated tools
* Strong communication skills — both verbal and written.
* Extensive experience working with technologies and concepts such:
* Behavior-driven or test-driven development
* JVM-based languages such as Java and Scala
* Development frameworks such as Spring Boot
* Asynchronous programming concepts, including Event processing
* Database technologies such as SQL, Postgres/MySQL, AWS Aurora DBs, Redshift, Liquibase or Flyway
* No-SQL technologies such as Redis, MongoDB and Cassandra
* Streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka, Apache Spark or Amazon Kinesis
* Unit-testing frameworks such as jUnit
* Performance testing frameworks such as Gatling
* Architectural concepts such as micro-services and separation of concerns
* Expert knowledge of class-based, object-oriented programming and design patterns
* Development tools such as GitHub, Jira, Jenkins, Concourse, and Maven
* Cloud technologies such as AWS and Azure
* Hands-on expertise with AI-powered development tools like Codex, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, or similar.

* Monitoring and operational data analysis practices and tools such as DataDog, Splunk and ELK

The Information Technology organization is transforming to realize our mission: Become a leader in HMH’s digital transformation, and as a strategic partner, innovate and deliver highest value, competitive advantage solutions across all corporate and business functions. Our ambition is to be a digital leader through innovation and develop and deliver leading edge technology such as robotic process automation and artificial intelligence to solve some of HMH’s greatest operational business challenges. Our professionals will have business relevant skills to connect our HMH partners to technologies that propel the businesses to deliver the greatest value for HMH and our customers.
  
  
We are building a team of IT professionals with an insatiable appetite to learn, a relentless focus on customer service, a technological curiosity toward future possibilities, and a creativity in solving business challenges with leading technologies. Our team will find ways to work together, create a sense of community where it’s safe to take risks and learn together, develop our careers, and all have an opportunity to work on new technologies. We will work together, learn together and have fun together. As a team, we will lead HMH’s digital transformation.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Software Engineer
  
  
**Overview**
This role operates within a globally distributed delivery model, partnering closely with established onshore teams to deliver and maintain high-availability, mission-critical systems.
  
  
The successful candidate will contribute to the ongoing evolution and stability of key payment platforms within a scaled Agile (SAFe) environment.
  
  
Role
  
  
**The Software Engineer Will Be Responsible For**

* Agile Delivery (SAFe Framework): Working within an established Scrum team aligned to SAFe, contributing to sprint planning, execution, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Distributed Team Collaboration: Collaborating closely with onshore engineering teams to deliver features, resolve defects, and ensure seamless integration across the delivery lifecycle.
* Application Development & Maintenance: Designing, developing, and maintaining solutions across a multi-technology stack.
* Production Support & Reliability: Supporting critical live systems, ensuring performance, resilience, and adherence to enterprise standards and controls.
* Continuous Improvement: Contributing to engineering best practices, automation, and process enhancements to improve delivery efficiency and quality.

**All About You**
We are looking for a technically strong and collaborative Software Engineer who thrives in a complex, enterprise-scale environment.
  
  
**Key Requirements Include**

* Proven experience with Java-based backend development and relational databases (Oracle)
* Experience with Spring-Boot framework
* Knowledge of TDD and BDD testing frameworks
* Working knowledge of frontend technologies such as Angular and JavaScript
* Familiarity with SQL scripting and data handling
* Exposure to Devops tooling
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments, ideally within SAFe
* Strong problem-solving skills and ownership mindset
* Ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience with REST, Messaging and Event Driven frameworks/solutions
* Knowledge of security mechanisms
* Exposure to payment systems or financial services environments
* Experience supporting mission-critical, high-availability platforms

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Platform Engineer - Internal Developer Platform
description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**
Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.
  
  
Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**
Why This Role Matters
  
  
Evolent is transforming how it builds and operates infrastructure under a refreshed Platform Engineering & Operations operating model, grounded in four principles: Architecture First, Automation by Default, Reliability is a Shared Responsibility and Golden Paths Over Custom Solutions. You will turn approved designs into provisioned, automated, and documented platforms, and you will do it transparently, through formal handoffs, Office Hours reviews, and documentation your peers can actually rely on.
  
  
**Agentic AI**
: Platform Engineering is moving toward agentic AI as a standard part of how the organization works. As agentic AI transforms the way we work, we expect our engineers to be at the forefront of that change, designing and building intelligent solutions rather than simply consuming them. This builder mentality is a core attribute we assess from the first conversation.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Provision and change infrastructure exclusively as code, so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and free of manual drift.
* Reverse engineer the applications and infrastructure you inherit: trace dependencies, integrations, and data flows end to end until you can explain how a system actually works.
* Design and build agentic AI solutions for platform, delivery, and operations work: identify the toil worth automating, then build, evaluate, and harden the agent that removes it.
* Build security and compliance into the delivery path: least-privilege access, secrets handling, policy-as-code guardrails, and audit evidence produced by design rather than assembled under deadline.
* Independently design, build, and ship platform features, self-service workflows, and APIs in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, C#, or Python, applying modularity, design patterns, and sound software design principles.
* Own your Git and GitHub workflow end to end—feature branches, meaningful commits, rebasing, and merge conflict resolution—and both author high-quality pull requests and review others' for correctness, readability, test coverage, and security.
* Design and document REST APIs, including contract and schema design, versioning, error semantics, and backward compatibility.
* Write unit and integration tests and build CI/CD pipelines as code (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), with automated build, test, static analysis, and dependency scanning.

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of
**50 Mbps**
and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business.

title: Senior Software Engineer Rust- Assistant Vice President
description:
**Department Overview**
The
**Equities Technology**
division is responsible for building and maintaining the high-performance, ultra-low-latency trading infrastructure that powers our global equities business. This includes market data dissemination, order routing, algorithmic execution, smart order routing (SOR), and real-time risk management systems. We operate in a highly competitive environment where microseconds matter, requiring cutting-edge software engineering practices, deep hardware-software co-design, and robust system reliability.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an exceptional
**Senior Software Engineer**
with deep expertise in
**Rust**
and
**C++**
to join our Equities Low-Latency Trading Technology team.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize our next-generation trading systems. You will lead the strategic transition of legacy high-performance C++ components to modern Rust where safety and concurrency are paramount, while continuing to maintain and optimize critical ultra-low-latency C++ execution paths. This is a highly technical role requiring a strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, network protocols, and modern software engineering paradigms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Skills**
**8+ YOE is a must have**

* System Design & Development
* Architect, build, and maintain ultra-low-latency trading systems, including exchange connectivity gateways, market data feeds, and algorithmic execution engines using Rust and C++
* Design clean, modular, and reusable APIs and libraries that can be leveraged across multiple trading desks.
* Lead the strategic migration of critical trading components from C++ to Rust, leveraging Rust's memory safety and concurrency guarantees without sacrificing performance.
* Performance Optimization
* Profile and optimize systems to achieve sub-microsecond latencies and deterministic performance.
* Apply low-latency techniques such as CPU pinning, cache-friendly data structures, lock-free programming, memory-mapped files, and custom memory allocators.
* Utilize kernel bypass technologies (e.g., Solarflare OpenOnload, DPDK, EF\_VI) to minimize network stack overhead.
* Concurrency & Reliability
* Design and implement highly concurrent, thread-safe, and lock-free algorithms to handle massive throughput with minimal jitter.
* Implement rigorous testing methodologies, including unit testing, integration testing, property-based testing (in Rust), and high-fidelity simulation/back testing environments.
* Ensure the high availability and operational resilience of trading systems through robust error handling and failover mechanisms.
* Collaboration & Support
* Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and product managers to translate complex trading strategies and business requirements into robust, production-ready software.
* Build real-time telemetry, monitoring, and alerting tools to ensure operational visibility.
* Provide level-3 escalation support for production systems during market hours.

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**
**Programming Languages**

* C++: Expert-level proficiency in C++ (C++11/14/17/20), with a deep understanding of template metaprogramming, RAII, move semantics, smart pointers, and the standard library (STL).
* Rust: Strong proficiency in Rust, including ownership/borrowing concepts, lifetimes, unsafe Rust boundaries, macro systems, and the Cargo ecosystem.

**Systems Programming & Low-Latency**

* Deep understanding of Linux operating system internals (kernel tuning, memory management, virtual memory, page faults, system calls).
* Experience with low-latency networking (TCP/IP, UDP, Multicast) and socket programming.
* Familiarity with hardware-level concepts: CPU cache hierarchies (L1/L2/L3), TLB, branch prediction, and memory barriers.

**Concurrency**

* Proven experience in multi-threaded programming, memory models (sequential consistency, acquire-release), and lock-free data structures.

**Equities Domain Knowledge**

* Solid understanding of Equities market structure, order types, exchange protocols (FIX, OUCH, ITCH), and trading lifecycles.

**Tools & Infrastructure**

* Experience with profiling and debugging tools (gdb, valgrind, perf, VTune, heaptrack).
* Proficiency with build systems (CMake, Cargo) and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with FPGA integration or hardware acceleration.
* Experience with kernel bypass technologies (Solarflare EF\_VI, OpenOnload, DPDK).
* Knowledge of market-making, smart order routing (SOR), or statistical arbitrage execution strategies.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

**Core Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex systems and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment.
* Adaptability: Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving business requirements and market conditions.
* Quality Focus: Commitment to writing clean, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code.

title: Product Engineer (Junior)
description:
**Product Engineer (Junior) — VenXR**
VenXR builds AdsGPT: brands plan, run and optimise their ad campaigns by talking to it. We're hiring a Product Engineer, one to two years in, who builds
*with*
LLMs rather than around them.
  
  
**What You'll Build**
Features, end to end — from a half-formed idea to production, and you own what happens after it ships. Most of what you build will have a model in the loop: campaign planning that reasons about a brand's goals, interfaces that assemble themselves from whatever the model surfaced, agents calling real tools against real ad platforms.
  
  
**Tech Stack**
Frontend: React.js
  
  
Backend: Python, Django
  
  
AI: Claude and other frontier models, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP
  
  
**AI-native, and we mean it literally**
Most job ads get this wrong, so plainly: using Claude to write code is not what we mean. Everyone does that. We mean LLMs as the material the product is built from. You'll need working knowledge of:
  
  

* Fundamentals — tokens, context windows, cost, latency, structured outputs, why a confident model is often wrong
* Orchestration — LangGraph or equivalent: state, nodes, conditional routing, persistence, interrupts. Not just prompts in a for loop
* Multi-agent patterns — when splitting work across agents helps, and the commoner case where it just multiplies failure modes
* Context engineering — what the model sees at each step: retrieval, compaction, selective injection. Where most of the quality lives
* Memory management — multi-turn state without the window or the bill growing unbounded
* MCP — connecting models to tools and APIs
* Evaluation — knowing whether what you built works, which is harder than building it

What we want is someone who has built at least one real thing with an orchestration framework — past the tutorial, into the part where it broke. Self-taught side projects count; show us.
  
  
**What You Need**

* One to two years shipping product
* React.js, Python with Django — or FastAPI plus the obvious ability to get to Django in a fortnight.
* At least one LLM-backed feature real users touched, where you owned the prompt, the orchestration and the failure modes
* REST APIs, SQL or NoSQL, and enough system design to know when your approach won't survive scale
* Strong debugging, and comfort with ambiguity and almost no hand-holding

Your work speaks louder than your degree. Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, or projects you’ve shipped. That’s what we’ll look at first.
  
  
**What Helps**
Each one moves you up the list.
  
  

* Conversational interfaces, and multi-turn state across channels
* LLM evaluation and monitoring — Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or your own harness
* Working knowledge of Generative UI.
* AdTech, MarTech domain knowledge is a plus.
* Cloud infra, Docker, CI/CD
* Explainable or compliance-aware AI in a regulated domain

**How We Work**

* Customer obsession — curiosity about what your code does to someone's day
* Ownership — chase blockers rather than wait on them
* Stakeholder sense — know when to pull in Product, Design or Business
* High standards — hold your work to a bar nobody is checking
* Disagree and commit — argue the call hard, then back it fully
* Simplify relentlessly — the simplest thing that works beats the cleverest thing that works
* Solidarity — show up for teammates unasked
* Vitality — energy that holds up in month six

In practice: ship fast, test in production more than is strictly comfortable, and sit close enough to the founders that "I'll ask Product" means turning around.
  
  
**The process**
The take-home is the real filter, so here's what it's for.
  
  

* Tech screening round — 30 minutes.
* Take-home — a small orchestrated LLM system. Using AI is expected; being unable to defend what it wrote is disqualifying.
* Interview round 1 — we walk through your submission and argue about it.
* Interview round 2 - Technical + Managerial

**Baner, Pune.**
Health cover, team offsites, and a culture that's flexible in the ways that matter rather than the ways that photograph well.
  
  
Skills: mcp,django,react.js,langgraph,system design,sql,orchestration,langchain,docker

description:
Powering the world's payments ecosystem
  
ACI powers the payments ecosystem globally, and you power ACI. You'll innovate, collaborate, and grow in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers at every level are empowered to make a meaningful impact while working on solutions that process billions of transactions worldwide.
  
As a Software Engineer in India, you will join a diverse and passionate engineering team responsible for delivering highly reliable card and merchant payment solutions that serve financial institutions across the globe.
  
About the Role
  
Join ACI's Card & Merchant Management (CMM) engineering team and help build, enhance and support mission-critical payment solutions used by leading financial institutions worldwide. This role combines deep Mainframe and COBOL expertise with modern software engineering practices to deliver scalable, secure and highly reliable card payment processing solutions.
  
You will work on complex payment systems that process high volumes of transactions while contributing to product innovation, quality, operational excellence and AI-driven engineering practices.

- Design, develop, test and maintain high-quality software solutions.

- Contribute to technical documentation, solution designs and product specifications.

- Drive continuous improvement in performance, resiliency, maintainability and operational excellence.
  
- Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development efficiency, quality and productivity.#
  
  
Required Skills & Experience
  
- 3+ years of software development experience.
  
- Strong expertise in COBOL, JCL and DB2 development.
  
- Good experience using Linux or Unix platforms.
  
- Unix shell scripting.
  
- Willingness to learn, both old and new technologies, to solve problems and take the product in new directions
  
- Experience using AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing and problem-solving.
  
- Hands-on IBM Mainframe development experience.
  
- Experience with Git or similar source control systems.
  
- Strong debugging, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
- Experience working in Agile software development environments.
  
- Familiarity with AI tools and their application within software development workflows.
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
Preferred Skills
  
- Knowledge of card issuing, acquiring and/or interchange processing.
  
- Java development experience.
  
- VSAM knowledge and experience.
  
- Ability to effectively apply AI solutions to software development, testing, automation and operational workflows.
  
- Experience working with high-volume, mission-critical transaction processing systems.
  
- Experience supporting performance engineering, resiliency and operational excellence initiatives.
  
- Familiarity with cloud-hosted payment platforms and modernisation of legacy systems.
  
- Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  
  
Core Capabilities
  
We seek colleagues who embody ACI's core capabilities and contribute to our innovative engineering culture:
  
- Ensure Accountability: Hold yourself and others accountable to meet commitments.
  
- Drives Results: Consistently achieve results, even under challenging circumstances.
  
- Customer Focus: Build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions.
  
- Cultivate Innovation: Create new and better ways for the organization to succeed.
  
- Collaborates: Build partnerships and work effectively across teams and geographies.
  
- Courage: Step up to address difficult issues and say what needs to be said.
  
  
  
AI Readiness
  
At ACI, AI is becoming an integral part of our engineering culture. Successful candidates should demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and practical application of AI technologies in software engineering. Candidates should be prepared to discuss:
  
- How they currently use AI tools in their development workflow.
  
- Examples of AI-assisted coding, testing, automation, or problem-solving.
  
- Their approach to responsible and effective AI adoption.
  
- Opportunities they see for leveraging AI to improve engineering productivity and software quality.
  
  
Work Authorization
  
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in India on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status now or in the future.
  
  
Why Join ACI?
  
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
  
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com
  
ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally.
  
Important Notice About Recruitment Scams
  
Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.

**We are seeking an experienced Vision Systems Automation Engineer to support the implementation and integration of advanced machine vision solutions within a highly automated manufacturing environment. **The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in industrial machine vision technologies, image processing, automation controls, and manufacturing execution environments. **Vision System Design & Development**

**Automation & Controls Integration**

* **Configure communication protocols such as Ethernet/IP, Profinet, OPC-UA, Modbus TCP/IP, and industrial networking standards.**

* **Traceability solutions**

**Commissioning & Support**

* **Optimize system performance to improve inspection reliability, cycle time, and manufacturing throughput.**
* **Provide production support and continuous improvement recommendations.**

**Documentation & Compliance**

* **Develop and maintain technical documentation, system architecture, commissioning reports, SOPs, and maintenance guidelines.**
* **Ensure compliance with customer quality standards, industrial safety practices, and engineering procedures.**
* **Support customer reviews, audits, and project documentation requirements.**

**Must-Have Skills**

**Machine Vision Platforms**

**Hands-on experience with one or more of the following:**

* **Cognex VisionPro**
* **Keyence Vision Systems**
* **Omron FH/FZ Series**

**Robotics Integration**

**Programming & Software**

**Manufacturing Experience**

* **Automotive Manufacturing**

* **Automated Production Lines**

**Preferred Skills**

* **Understanding of Digital Manufacturing and Industry 4.0 architecture.**
