title: SAS/Datamart Developer
description:
**Data Management & Analytics Developer**
**Business Data & Analytics**

We are seeking a
**DMA Developer**
to support and evolve enterprise data assets that underpin revenue, sales, analytics, and executive reporting. This role focuses on
**hands‑on development**
,
**data transformation**
, and
**production support**
across SAS (9.x & Viya 4) and Oracle platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong individual contributor who is comfortable working in
**rules‑driven, audit‑sensitive environments**
, partnering with senior developers, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and usability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Engineering & Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain SAS (9 and Viya) and Oracle SQL logic supporting data pipelines, transformations, and curated data assets.
* Build and maintain reporting tables aligned to defined KPIs and business rules.
* Develop and enhance Oracle views, packages, procedures, and validation logic used across analytics and downstream integrations.
* Support SAS‑based ETL/ELT workflows that integrate data from Orion, GIDB, EDW, operational systems, and external sources.

**Data Quality, Validation & Audit Support**

* Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and validation controls to ensure reporting accuracy.
* Support historical traceability and reproducibility of results for finance, sales, and audit use cases.
* Diagnose and remediate data issues raised by downstream consumers (Finance, Sales Ops).

**Integration & Change Management**

* Adapt SAS and Oracle logic to upstream data changes from platforms such as EDW, PDH, and third‑party sources.
* Implement defensive logic when upstream data is incomplete, inconsistent, or delayed.
* Partner with senior team members during release cycles to ensure integration stability.

**Production & Operational Support**

* Support scheduled releases, including pre‑release validation, production troubleshooting, and post‑deployment fixes.
* Investigate job failures, performance bottlenecks, and data inconsistencies.
* Contribute to operational improvements that reduce rework, technical debt, and manual intervention.

**Collaboration & Documentation**

* Work closely with data engineers, analysts, and business partners to clarify requirements and data definitions.
* Maintain technical documentation, metadata, and business logic descriptions.
* Work in an Agile environment using Jira.
* Use GitHub and VS Code to manage source control, code reviews, and collaborative development.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong experience with SAS 9 and/or SAS Viya development in enterprise data environments.
* Advanced Oracle SQL experience, including views, procedures, packages, and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of implementing business rules in data logic.
* Experience supporting production data systems with regular release cycles.
* Practical experience using VS Code and GitHub for source control and team development.

**Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have**

* Exposure to revenue, pipeline, sales credit, or financial reporting data.
* Familiarity with audit‑ or compliance‑driven data environments.
* Experience modernizing or refactoring legacy SAS or Oracle codebases.
* Knowledge of data lineage, historical tracking, or slowly changing dimensions.
* Exposure to AI‑assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot or similar).

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**

* You become productive quickly in an established SAS and Oracle codebase.
* You independently own well‑defined development and support work, reducing strain on senior engineers.
* You improve data reliability, performance, and confidence without redesigning the platform.
* You collaborate effectively, ask the right questions, and deliver accurate, reliable solutions in a complex environment.

**Team & Environment**

* Part of the Business Data & Analytics (DMA) organization supporting multiple enterprise stakeholders.
* Highly collaborative team of data engineers, analysts, and business partners.
* Strong emphasis on data accuracy, auditability, and operational reliability throughout the development life cycle.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**Senior DevOps Infrastructure Engineer**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a talented and highly motivated
**Senior DevOps Infrastructure Engineer**
to join our DevOps team. The ideal candidate will play a key role in designing, implementing, automating, and maintaining DevOps tools, processes, and infrastructure across cloud and on-premises environments. This role requires strong technical expertise, hands-on problem-solving ability, and the capability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment.
  
  
The successful candidate should be comfortable working across infrastructure administration, automation, cloud platforms, CI/CD enablement, virtualization, configuration management, and operating system support. A proactive mindset, strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to drive technical execution independently are essential for success in this role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, administer, maintain, and decommission infrastructure across both on-premises and cloud environments.
* Build and manage Infrastructure as Code solutions for cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS.
* Automate build, deployment, and release processes using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, Shell, Perl, and Batch.
* Support CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated testing, quality assurance, and deployment workflows.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to infrastructure, application deployment, networking, operating systems, and cloud environments.
* Administer and maintain Windows and Linux server environments, including operating system deployment and platform-level support.
* Manage configuration management tools such as Chef, Puppet, and Ansible, including setup, maintenance, and automation use cases.
* Work with virtualization technologies such as VMware ESXi, vCenter, and vRA cloud management platforms.
* Implement and maintain security best practices to protect sensitive data and support compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with geographically distributed development, QA, IT, and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable DevOps and infrastructure solutions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in DevOps, cloud computing, infrastructure automation, and software delivery.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in a DevOps, infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or similar technical role.
* Strong hands-on experience with infrastructure administration and maintenance across cloud and on-premises environments.
* In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux server administration.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Set up and maintain Network, firewall and DMZ, Vnet, subnets in Azure
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation-driven infrastructure deployment.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, Shell, Perl, or Batch.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts, protocols, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Experience with configuration management tools such as Chef, Puppet, or Ansible.
* Exposure to virtualization technologies, including VMware ESXi, vCenter, and cloud management platforms.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively while solving complex technical problems.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with globally distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with dynamic public, private, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Hands-on experience with Terraform, Chef, Puppet, Python, Perl, Shell, Batch, and PowerShell scripting.
* Experience working on Windows and Linux platforms, including operating system administration.
* Experience managing vendors for license procurement, setup, and configuration.
* Experience implementing FinOps, cost optimization, and cloud governance practices.
* Certification in Red Hat Enterprise Linux or SUSE Linux Enterprise Server is preferred.

**Professional Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**Senior DevOps Infrastructure Engineer**
with strong expertise in cloud and on-premises infrastructure, automation, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, operating system administration, virtualization, and configuration management. The candidate should have hands-on experience with Windows and Linux administration, scripting, cloud platforms such as Azure/AWS/GCP, VMware technologies, and tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Chef, Puppet, Ansible, and Terraform. This role requires a self-driven professional who can troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, automate build and deployment processes, collaborate with global teams, and contribute to secure, scalable, and efficient DevOps operations.
  
  
**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

* Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson, Revel, Denon, and Bowers & Wilkins
* Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development
* Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
As a Software Engineer in the Digital Commerce team, you will be responsible for developing and delivering high-quality e-commerce solutions that enhance the customer experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive initiatives from planning through execution, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives. The role requires strong problem-solving skills, effective communication, and the ability to manage priorities while working closely with stakeholders to improve and optimize digital commerce platforms.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Develop, support, and maintain web applications hosted on the Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) B2C platform, with a primary focus on front-end development and user interface enhancements.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to define requirements, establish project deliverables, and set timelines using Agile methodologies.
* Drive the development and support of e-commerce initiatives, ensuring high-quality and reliable solutions.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and deliver engaging digital content and applications that enhance the customer experience.
* Ensure project documentation is complete, and all deliverables comply with established software development standards and best practices.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* 3–5 years of web development experience, with a strong focus on e-commerce platform implementations.
* Strong hands-on expertise in JavaScript, Node.js, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Bootstrap, Underscore.js, Font Icons, and GitHub.
* Mandatory experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC/SFRA) and e-commerce applications, with a good understanding of product catalogs, cart, content assets, content slots, SFCC libraries, inventory, pricing, payments, checkout, and order management.
* Experience in integrating web applications with third-party libraries and services, along with a strong understanding of responsive web design and JSON/XML data formats.
* Hands-on experience with coding standards, error and exception handling, logging, security, performance optimization, and troubleshooting, including experience with high-volume, high-transaction websites.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies and performing unit testing, integration testing, and browser compatibility testing to ensure quality deliverables within project timelines.
* Ability to take ownership of application development and support, collaborate with product/project managers and stakeholders to refine requirements iteratively, adapt to new technologies, and deliver projects on time with high quality.
* We see AI as an important part of how work gets done. While tools may vary, a baseline familiarity with using AI to support efficiency, problem-solving, and quality is expected.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in supporting and enhancing e-commerce solutions using Agile methodologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

**Things To Know**

* This role is based in Pune, India, and follows HARMAN’s office or hybrid working policies and role requirements.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others).
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs.
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
* Tuition reimbursement support.
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available.
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development.

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
  
  
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!
  
  
**Important Notice: Recruitment Scams**
Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.
  
  
HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job-related performance.(www.harman.com)

title: Sr. Software Engineer | Defence
description:
**Sr. Software Engineer | Defence and R&D(only candidates who have experience in same industry is required)**
**Location:**
Noida (Sector 132)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience :**
5-8 years
  
  
**About The Company-**
Zoid is a high-tech R&D startup devoted to developing cutting-edge technologies in the Defence and Aerospace sector. We primarily deliver customized solutions to the Indian Armed Forces, leveraging our expertise in AI, Electronics, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, and Robotics.
  
  
Currently Funded By The IDEX Initiative Under The Ministry Of Defence, India, We Are Working On Projects Of Strategic National Importance, Including
  
  

* AI-based FOD detection software for Naval Air Stations
* Reusable Off-board Missile Decoys for Anti-Ship Missile Defense

**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to design and lead our software architecture, AI/Computer Vision systems integration, and embedded systems infrastructure. You will be a technical leader who codes, architects, and mentors—driving both strategic system design and hands-on execution. You will take ownership of end-to-end software systems, from hardware abstraction layers through AI pipelines, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability for defence and aerospace applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities -**
**Design & Architect Core Software Systems**

* Define system architecture for project requirements.
* Create modular, scalable design patterns that handle real-time sensor inputs and AI inference pipelines
* Design hardware abstraction layers for seamless integration with various sensors (cameras, LiDAR, thermal) and edge processors
* Establish data flow architecture, APIs, and communication protocols between components
* Document architectural decisions, design patterns, and system specifications

**Production Code Development in C++**

* Write high-performance, production-grade C++ code for critical system components
* Develop code for GPU-accelerated AI inference and image processing
* Implement multi-threaded, real-time systems with stringent latency requirements
* Conduct performance profiling and optimization (memory, CPU, GPU utilization)
* Maintain code quality through testing, code reviews, and documentation

**Hardware & Sensor Integration**

* Lead integration efforts with hardware teams: cameras, compute modules, networking equipment, sensors
* Define hardware requirements and validate hardware selections
* Implement device drivers, firmware interfaces, and hardware communication protocols
* Ensure systems remain reliable in long-term industrial/defence deployments.
* Interface with GNSS receivers, inertial measurement units (IMUs), industrial cameras, thermal/IR cameras, LIDAR, rangefinders, communication radios, gimbal systems, and other peripherals.
* Contribute to open-source drivers, configure kernel modules, and write integration layers.
* For specialized hardware (e.g., Basler/FLIR industrial cameras, Veronte autopilots, military-grade radios): work with manufacturer SDKs, understand vendor-specific APIs and protocols.
* Communicate over serial protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, RS-232, RS-422) .

**Linux Systems Software**

* Set up and optimize Linux kernel configurations for real-time performance
* Provision, configure, and harden Linux (Ubuntu) OS images for field-deployed systems: minimal attack surface, systemd service management, user/permission lockdown.
* Implement process management: watchdog timers, heartbeat monitoring, automatic service restart, graceful shutdown sequencing, zombie process management.
* Write robust Bash scripts for Ubuntu command-line automation
* Manage system-level drivers, device tree configurations, and boot processes
* Implement system monitoring, logging, and telemetry frameworks
* Handle cross-compilation, build systems (CMake, Yocto), and deployment pipelines

**Networking & Infrastructure Development**

* Design and implement network communication layers (Ethernet, CAN, MQTT, gRPC)
* Set up edge computing infrastructure and distributed system communication
* Implement secure communication protocols and data transmission standards
* Manage system interconnectivity
* Build TCP/UDP socket communication, RTSP video streaming pipelines, and mesh networking for multi-node systems.

**Technical Planning & Execution**

* Create technical roadmaps aligned with product goals (6-12 month outlook)
* Break down complex architectural work into executable sprints and milestones
* Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and scalability challenges early
* Drive solutions and proof-of-concepts for new technical requirements
* Coordinate with systems engineers on end-to-end testing and validation
* Support field testing and customer deployment efforts with technical expertise

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of software development experience in complex, real-time systems
* Expert-level proficiency in C++ ; deep understanding of memory management, concurrency,multi-threading, and performance optimization
* Strong hands-on experience optimizing AI inference on GPUs
* Proven background in AI/Computer Vision (model deployment, PyTorch/TensorFlow, OpenCV)
* Deep experience with Linux kernel and linux based OS, system programming, device drivers, and embedded systems
* Solid knowledge of networking protocols, hardware integration, and sensor interfaces
* Experience with technical documentation and architectural design patterns
* Proven experience designing architectures for real-time or mission-critical systems: module decomposition, IPC, state machines, data flow, deployment topology
* Experience building multi-threaded and multi-process systems on multi-core and/or multi-GPU hardware.
* Produce documentation to IEEE/ISO/IEC 12207 and IEEE 29148 (prior experience not mandatory; learn within the first few months)
* Demonstrated problem-solving and systems-level thinking
* Leadership experience (formal team lead)
* Strong communication skills; ability to explain complex technical concepts

**Desirable Qualifications**

* Experience with defence or aerospace software systems and constraints
* Knowledge of distributed systems, edge computing, and system scalability patterns
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices
* Ability to produce defence-grade engineering documentation to IEEE 12207 or demonstrated aptitude to learn.
* Implement pub/sub middleware (DDS) for real-time communication in distributed defence systems, including domain partitioning, QoS policy configuration, and topic architecture.
* Experience deploying ML inference pipelines on edge hardware (Jetson, NUC) or server hardware (multi-GPU, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, CUDA).
* DDS middleware implementation including QoS configuration and domain architecture.
* Hardware integration experience: sensor bring-up, serial protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, RS-422), industrial camera SDKs (Basler, FLIR, Allied Vision).
* Familiarity with defence software standards (DO-178C, MIL-STD-498, STANAG 4586). CODE- SOFTTECH

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design and evolution of our backend platform. You'll own the architecture of large-scale, distributed systems built on Java and microservices, set technical direction across teams, and raise the bar for resilience, scalability, and operational excellence. This role spans building new products from the ground up and scaling existing ones. It is hands-on technical leadership: you'll write code, drive design reviews, and mentor engineers while partnering with product and engineering leadership to shape the roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

* **Build products from 0 to 1**
  by turning ambiguous ideas into a clear architecture, shipping MVPs quickly, and evolving them into production-grade systems.
* **Architect and build**
  highly available, fault-tolerant microservices that scale to millions of requests and handle failure gracefully.
* **Set technical direction**
  for backend systems across multiple teams, authoring design docs and driving architectural decisions with clear trade-off analysis.
* **Champion resilience engineering**
  through patterns such as circuit breakers, bulkheads, retries with backoff, rate limiting, idempotency, and graceful degradation.
* **Drive scalability and performance**
  by identifying bottlenecks, optimizing JVM performance, and designing for horizontal scale, caching, and data partitioning.
* **Own operational excellence**
  , including observability (metrics, logging, tracing), SLOs/SLAs, incident response, and blameless postmortems.
* **Lead modernization efforts**
  , such as decomposing monoliths, adopting event-driven architectures, and reducing technical debt.
* **Mentor and grow engineers**
  through code reviews, design reviews, and technical coaching, building a strong engineering culture.
* **Influence cross-functionally**
  by partnering with product, SRE, security, and data teams to deliver customer outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

* 7+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on backend systems.
* Proven experience building at least one product or platform from 0 to 1, from concept through production launch.
* Expert-level proficiency in Java, including concurrency, memory management, and JVM tuning.
* Deep experience designing and operating microservices in production using frameworks such as Spring Boot or Micronaut.
* Proven track record of building resilient, scalable distributed systems serving high-traffic workloads.
* Strong knowledge of distributed systems fundamentals: consistency models, CAP trade-offs, partitioning, replication, and failure modes.
* Experience with RESTful and gRPC API design, plus asynchronous messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
* Hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, Cassandra).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

* Exposure to agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain4j, Spring AI, LangGraph) and building LLM-powered features such as tool calling, RAG, and multi-agent workflows.
* Experience using AI coding assistants and AI tools to speed up development.
* Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS or GCP) and cloud-native design.
* Proficiency with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Experience with resilience libraries and practices such as Resilience4j, service mesh, and chaos engineering.
* Strong background in observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, Datadog).
* Experience with event-driven architecture, CQRS, event sourcing, and saga patterns.
* Track record of leading technical initiatives spanning multiple teams.
* Excellent written communication, especially design docs and architectural proposals.

title: Platform Infrastructure DevSecOps Developer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer**
**The opportunity**
In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for an innovative AI-Native DevSecOps Developer to rapidly design, build and ship custom software products that automate, orchestrate and modernize EY's infrastructure platform engineering capabilities. This is not a traditional software engineering role — it is a product builder position for someone who uses AI as their primary development accelerator and who thrives on shipping working software quickly.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-native internal products — self-service infrastructure portals, workflow orchestration engines, policy-as-code enforcement systems and operational automation platforms — built on modern cloud-native stacks including Kubernetes, Temporal, Terraform and Angular. They will have sufficient infrastructure awareness to understand the operational context of what they are building, and will work closely with I&O engineering teams to translate complex infrastructure workflows into elegant, automated, AI-augmented software solutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer designs and delivers bespoke internal software products that eliminate manual infrastructure workflows, accelerate provisioning and give engineers and stakeholders real-time, self-service operational visibility. Drawing on AI coding tools as a core development accelerant, this professional dramatically compresses delivery timelines — prototyping, iterating and shipping production-grade software at a pace that traditional development workflows cannot match.
  
  
The role spans the full software development lifecycle — from requirements and architecture through build, test, security hardening, deployment and ongoing improvement — with a security-first mindset embedded at every stage. The developer will own the product delivery end-to-end, partnering with I&O platform engineers, architects and service management stakeholders to ensure what is built reflects the real operational needs of the infrastructure estate and is designed to scale across EY's global data center footprint.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade software rapidly using AI development tools as a primary delivery accelerant (exclusionary).
* Deep, active use of AI coding assistants throughout the development lifecycle, including:

+ GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI pair-programming tools
+ ChatGPT, Claude or similar LLMs for architecture design, code generation and review
+ AI-assisted test generation, security scanning and code refactoring
+ Prompt engineering for development workflow automation

* Strong full-stack development capability across front-end and back-end disciplines:

+ Angular (v14+) for self-service portal and operational UI development
+ Python or Go for back-end services, APIs and automation engines
+ REST and GraphQL API design and implementation

* Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, particularly Temporal.io.
* Strong Kubernetes engineering skills — deployment, Helm charts, operators, RBAC and namespace management.
* Infrastructure-as-Code authoring using Terraform and Ansible for provisioning automation.
* Strong DevSecOps pipeline development — CI/CD design, security gate integration and automated deployment:

+ GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines
+ SAST/DAST tooling integration (Snyk, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP or equivalent)
+ Container image scanning and policy enforcement (Trivy, Cosign, OPA/Gatekeeper)

* Policy-as-Code implementation using Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent.
* Experience building AI-native product features, including:

+ LLM integration via API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent)
+ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns for operational knowledge bases
+ AI-driven workflow decision making and self-healing automation
+ Copilot / chat interface integration into operational tooling

* Sufficient infrastructure platform knowledge to design software that reflects real-world operational constraints:

+ Virtualization and hyperconverged infrastructure concepts (Nutanix, Hyper-V, VMware)
+ Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
+ Networking concepts — VLANs, DNS, IP management, load balancing
+ Storage and compute provisioning workflows
+ ServiceNow ITSM integration patterns

* Strong software product ownership mindset — able to take a problem statement from whiteboard to production with minimal hand-holding.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to demo working software and articulate product decisions to both technical and executive audiences.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.

**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**

* Full-stack software product development and delivery — 5–7 years.
* AI-assisted software development as an active daily workflow — 2+ years.
* Angular front-end application development (v14+) — 3–5 years.
* Python or Go back-end service development — 5+ years.
* Kubernetes cluster management and application deployment — 3–5 years.
* Terraform and Ansible Infrastructure-as-Code authoring — 3–5 years.
* Temporal.io or equivalent workflow orchestration platform (Argo, Conductor or equivalent).
* CI/CD pipeline development with integrated security gates — 3–5 years.
* LLM API integration for production AI-native product features.
* Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent policy-as-code enforcement.
* REST API design, development and documentation.
* Container build, scanning and secure image management (Docker, Podman).
* Git-based source control and pull-request-driven development workflows (GitHub, Azure DevOps).
* SAST/DAST security tooling integration in CI pipelines.
* ITSM platform integration — ServiceNow API or equivalent.
* Agile sprint-based delivery with regular demo and release cadences.
* Infrastructure provisioning workflow automation (VM builds, network configuration, DNS/IP management).
* Helm chart authoring for Kubernetes application packaging and deployment.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) or equivalent cloud certification (desired).
* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) or CKA certification (better to have).
* HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification (desired).

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:

title: Scientific Computing / Research Engineering Expert — Earth Sciences
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking experienced Earth Sciences experts to develop realistic, terminal-based scientific and computational tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will design challenging scientific tasks involving climate science, atmospheric processes, geophysics, oceanography, geology, hydrology, remote sensing, and environmental modeling. You will build reproducible computational workflows that require AI agents to analyze scientific datasets, execute code, run simulations, troubleshoot technical issues, and generate objectively verifiable scientific outputs.

**What you'll do:**

* Design realistic, multi-step scientific tasks based on authentic Earth Sciences, climate, geospatial, environmental, and geophysical research workflows.
* Prepare and process scientific datasets involving climate, weather, atmospheric conditions, oceanography, geology, hydrology, satellite imagery, and environmental systems.
* Develop computational tasks involving geospatial analysis, time-series processing, numerical modeling, interpolation, forecasting, remote sensing, and environmental risk analysis.
* Build reproducible, terminal-based computational environments using scientific libraries, command-line tools, and appropriate dependencies.
* Develop expert reference solutions using Python, R, Bash, Julia, or domain-specific scientific software.
* Create automated tests and evaluation criteria to verify scientific correctness, numerical accuracy, spatial and temporal consistency, and reproducibility.
* Validate coordinate reference systems, measurement units, timestamps, missing-data handling, uncertainty, and scientific assumptions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues involving geospatial projections, large scientific datasets, software dependencies, computational performance, and numerical stability.
* Ensure tasks require meaningful multi-step scientific reasoning and cannot be solved through simple shortcuts or hard-coded outputs.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Earth Sciences, Climate Science, Atmospheric Science, Geophysics, Oceanography, Geology, Hydrology, Environmental Science, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in Python, R, Bash, Julia, or another relevant scientific programming language.
* Hands-on experience working in Linux and terminal-based computational environments.
* Practical expertise in at least one major area: scientific data processing, numerical modeling, geospatial analysis, climate modeling, remote sensing, or environmental data analysis.
* Strong understanding of spatial datasets, time-series analysis, scientific modeling, numerical accuracy, uncertainty, and data quality control.
* Experience working with real-world scientific datasets, including geospatial, climate, atmospheric, oceanographic, geological, or hydrological data.
* Ability to independently develop, execute, debug, and validate reproducible scientific computational workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify scientific inaccuracies, data inconsistencies, and computational errors.

* Familiarity with Docker, Conda, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience using high-performance computing (HPC) environments or processing large-scale scientific datasets.
* Experience with Earth-system models, environmental forecasting, remote sensing applications, or geophysical simulations.
* Research software engineering experience, including developing scientific tools, simulation pipelines, or reproducible research workflows.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, scientific benchmarks, or automated grading systems.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Role Overview

* Role: Solution & Integration Architect
* Team: Technology
* Reporting to: Global CTO
* Location: Mumbai or Delhi, India
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Experience: Typically 8–12+ years, including at least 3 years in solution architecture or a technical leadership role.

Role Purpose

The Solution & Integration Architect is responsible for designing scalable enterprise solutions and seamless integrations between a digital property decisioning platform and banks’ existing technology systems.

The role acts as a technical bridge between customers, Product, Engineering, IT Operations and leadership, ensuring that business requirements are translated into practical, secure, and buildable technical solutions. It involves hands-on API design, troubleshooting, customer engagement, and end-to-end integration delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Architecture

* Lead technical discovery and architecture workshops with banking customers.
* Design solution architectures, application components, data flows, security, and non-functional requirements.
* Maintain architecture documentation, decision records, risks, and dependencies.
* Promote reusable solutions and minimise customer-specific development.

2. API and Integration Design

* Design and document REST APIs, webhooks, callbacks, event-driven integrations, and secure file transfers.
* Develop API specifications using OpenAPI/Swagger, including payloads, validation, error handling, versioning, retries, and idempotency.
* Define authentication, authorisation, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Work with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure API Management, Service Bus, Functions, and App Services.
* Troubleshoot integration issues using logs, API traces, and monitoring tools.

3. Requirements Definition

* Work with Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and customers to gather requirements.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications, API contracts, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and technical constraints.
* Support backlog refinement, estimation, prioritisation discussions, and solution feasibility assessments.

4. Customer Integration Delivery

* Act as the primary technical contact for bank integration teams and third-party vendors.
* Coordinate connectivity, certificates, whitelisting, environments, and security approvals.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution, go-live, and post-launch support.
* Ensure integrations are properly documented and handed over to Support and IT Operations.

5. Security and Compliance

* Ensure designs meet banking security requirements and enterprise security standards.
* Address data protection, encryption, data residency, audit logging, and retention requirements.
* Support security assessments and compliance reviews involving RBI guidance, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, and CERT-In requirements.

6. Architecture Standards and Continuous Improvement

* Develop reusable architecture patterns, integration templates, and API standards.
* Improve onboarding efficiency across multiple banking customers.
* Capture implementation lessons and collaborate with global architecture, Product, and Engineering teams.

Essential Skills and Experience

* Enterprise solution architecture and integration design, preferably in banking or financial services.
* Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, JSON, and XML.

title: Electrical Engineering & Computer Science
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks.
* Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability.
* Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results.
* Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design.
* Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles.
* Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm.
* Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest.
* Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions.
* Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions.
* Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
  4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  
When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
  
  
Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.
  
  
**Our Mission**
is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
  
  
  
  
**Our Values**
underpin everything we do.
  

* **Customer Centric:**
  Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:**
  We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:**
  Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action & Ownership:**
  We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:**
  We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:**
  We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

**Global Benefits**

* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed
* Paid Volunteer Time\*
* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*

\* varies by country
  
  
**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

title: Data/Integration Engineer
description:
We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Data Integration Engineer to lead offshore data engineering delivery for a US-based investment management client.

You’ll own ingestion and transformation delivery on Fivetran, Snowflake and dbt, and coordinate MDM, reporting and platform work with the onshore architect and project manager.

**What you’ll do**

• Own offshore data engineering estimates, task allocation, dependencies, progress reporting and delivery commitments

• Build and maintain Fivetran ingestion and approved file/API pipelines; manage incremental loads, schema changes, failed loads and recovery

• Develop Snowflake Bronze, Silver and Gold datasets and modular dbt models with documented dependencies

• Implement source-to-target mappings, reconciliation, incremental processing, historical data handling and dimensional models

• Own pipeline data quality through dbt tests, completeness and freshness checks, and remediation tracking

• Review code and designs across the offshore team and enforce engineering standards

• Coordinate Snowflake and Profisee data flows with the MDM engineer, and trusted reporting datasets with the BI engineer

• Maintain technical metadata, documentation and lineage

• Coordinate integration testing, defect resolution, deployment readiness and production handover

**What you bring**

• 8+ years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading delivery teams

• Strong SQL, Snowflake data engineering, dbt development and Fivetran ingestion

• At least two production data platform implementations delivered, including source reconciliation and operational handover

• dbt models, tests, documentation, incremental strategies, Git workflows and performance tuning

• Working knowledge of MDM integration patterns, data governance controls and Power BI data requirements

• Strong written and verbal communication and ownership of assigned work

**Nice to have:**
 financial services or investment data (customer, account, advisor, sales), Profisee, Dynamics 365 integrations, Python, Azure DevOps, Snowflake or dbt certification, consulting or SI delivery experience.

* Overlap with US Central business hours is required.

title: Software Development Engineer -1
description:
**About Mechademy**

Mechademy is transforming the predictive analytics landscape for rotating machinery. Our flagship platform, Turbomechanica, seamlessly integrates applied physics with advanced machine learning to deliver prescriptive insights. Turbomechanica detects potential issues long before they become costly failures, enabling clients to maximize uptime, extend asset life, and reduce operational risks. By empowering clients with optimized performance and reliability of their multi-billion-dollar assets, we’re setting a new standard for operational excellence.

**What We’re Looking For**

People who would rather build than talk about building. You’ll fit right in if you:

* Like owning a problem end to end, from the first design note to production.
* Pick up new tools quickly, and have opinions about which ones we should use.
* Care about getting things right, because engineers make real decisions on what we build.
* Enjoy a small, energetic team that ships fast and celebrates its wins.

**Why Mechademy?**

Kickstart your career with a company that’s fun, innovative, and shaping the future of the oil and gas industry. Mechademy is where cutting-edge predictive analytics meets a culture of collaboration and creativity. We’re not your typical start-up company – we thrive on solving complex challenges with technology, fostering growth, and making an impact. Whether you're diving into groundbreaking projects, learning from industry leaders, or enjoying team outings, you’ll feel valued and inspired every step of the way.

•
**Work on groundbreaking technology**
that is shaping the future of rotating equipment diagnostics.

•
**Relish a challenging, dynamic role**
with opportunities for individual contributions that direct impact on the success of the company.

•
**Grow into a leadership position**
as Mechademy grows.

•
**Enjoy flexible work hours**
to work when you are most efficient.

•
**Generous compensation**
to help you achieve financial stability.

At Mechademy, your ideas matter, your growth is our priority, and your future starts now.

**About the Role**

An unplanned trip of a single critical machine can halt production at an entire facility. Turbomechanica exists to see that coming, and the team makes sure the right people see it, trust it and act on it in time. You do not need an industrial or mechanical background. Our domain engineers will teach you how turbines and compressors fail.

**Responsibilities**

* **Platform -**
  Design, build and own features on a secure, multi-tenant platform used by enterprise clients across the globe. Work on authentication, access control and auditability, web and mobile experiences, and APIs that let other systems work with platform data safely.
* **Monitoring -**
  Build the workflows that turn detected issues into alerts, escalations and tracked actions, and the tooling that helps engineers prioritise, investigate and resolve issues faster. Work with large volumes of time series sensor data.
* **Reliability -**
  Add alerting, health checks and dashboards so we catch problems before a client does.
* **Engineering Quality -**
  Write clean, tested code and own features from design through production. Write design notes, take part in design and code reviews, and document what you build.
* **Ways of Working -**
  Ship in two-week sprints using Git, GitHub, CI/CD and ClickUp. Use modern developer tooling, including AI coding assistants, while staying accountable for every line you merge.

**Requirements**

**Must Have**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related branch
* 1.5+ years building and shipping production software
* Strong Python (preferred), or Java, Go, TypeScript or similar; solid DSA and OOP fundamentals
* REST APIs with Django, FastAPI, Flask, Express or similar
* SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL
* JavaScript or TypeScript, React preferred
* Web authentication basics (sessions, tokens, OAuth) and secure coding
* Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD
* Clear communication and a real willingness to learn and take feedback
* LLM APIs (Claude and other leading models), Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG and agent orchestration frameworks

**Good to Have**

* Open source work or side projects you can discuss in depth
* Interest or experience in applied machine learning or LLMs
* Multi-tenant SaaS systems
* Time series data or large datasets
* Mobile app development
* SSO / OIDC providers, role-based access control
* Docker, AWS or Azure in production; logging, monitoring and alerting tools
* Mentoring peers, writing clear design docs

**What This Role Offers**

* **Work that matters -**
  What you build runs in production every day at some of the world’s largest energy companies.
* **Hard, real problems -**
  Security, multi-tenancy, large-scale sensor data and systems engineers depend on.
* **Ownership -**
  A squad buddy gets you productive in 30 days; you own a part of the platform within 6 months.
* **Mentorship -**
  Learn from senior engineers and domain experts with decades of equipment experience.
* **Growth -**
  A clear path from SDE-1 to SDE-2.
* **Flexibility -**
  Flexible work hours and a hybrid setup.

**Selection Process**

1. Introductory call - A short conversation with our talent team about your background, interests and expectations.
2. Technical interview 1 - Problem solving and live coding, plus a deep dive into a project you have shipped.
3. Technical interview 2 - System design and full stack fundamentals: APIs, data modelling, scaling and trade-offs.
4. Hiring manager - A conversation with the P&M Squad Owner about how you work, own problems and grow.
5. HR and culture - Team fit, compensation and joining logistics.

*No trick puzzles. When you apply, tell us about something you have shipped. That matters more to us than where you have worked.*

title: Senior Software Development Engineer

Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building. Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. You contribute as a senior member of the team by partnering with engineers and product management throughout the software development life cycle, from design and estimation through testing, deployment, and support. title: Staff Engineer
description:
The database market is massive (IDC estimates it to be $121B+ by 2026!) and MongoDB is at the head of its disruption. At MongoDB we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading modern data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.
  
  
MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to create tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Staff Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The ideal candidate for this role will have
  
  

* 8+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
* Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium
* Extensive experience with relational data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc)
* Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus
* Empower the engineering team with unparalleled thought leadership on emerging technologies and best practices

title: Software Engineer 2
description:
**The role**

An SDE 2 at CareFi owns problems, not tickets. You will take a business outcome, work out what needs to be built, design it, ship it, and stay accountable for how it behaves in production.

This is a backend-leaning role on a small team, which means your work will show up in front of hospital staff, ops teams and borrowers within weeks. You will have real say in architecture, and real responsibility when something breaks at 11pm on a discharge that has to clear tonight.

**What you will own**

- Design and deliver backend services end to end: scoping, data modelling, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and the fixes that follow

- Write a lightweight design doc for anything that spans more than one service or one engineer, and get it reviewed before you build

- Model and evolve financial and claims data correctly. Ledgers, disbursements, repayments and reconciliation have to be right the first time, and auditable afterwards

- Build and maintain integrations with hospitals, insurers, payment providers and logistics partners, including the messy ones with no sandbox and a PDF for documentation

- Raise technical risk, feasibility concerns and scope creep before work starts rather than in the retro

- Review code substantively. Explain the reasoning behind a change request, not just the change

- Mentor SDE 1s and interns through pairing, intentional PR reviews, and unblocking them early

- Own incidents in your domain: triage, mitigate, write the post-incident review, close the action items

- Identify tech debt in the areas you touch and propose a concrete fix alongside the flag

- Keep the documentation for your systems current after every release

**What we work with**

- Backend: NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL

- Cloud and infra: Azure (AKS), containerised services, GitLab CI/CD

- Adjacent: React Native and Flutter clients, OCR and document extraction pipelines, internal ops tooling

- Ways of working: sprint-based delivery, design docs, PR review culture, blameless post-incident reviews. You do not need prior NestJS experience. Strong Node and TypeScript fundamentals transfer in a week or two.

**What we are looking for**

- 5 to 7 years building and running backend systems in production, with at least 3 years in a typed language on a modern service framework (Node/TypeScript, Java, Go, Python)

- Strong relational database skills: schema design, indexing, query performance, transactions and isolation levels. You can explain why a migration is safe under load

- Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of at least one non-trivial system or service, including what it cost you to operate it

- Practical experience with API design, third party integrations, idempotency, retries and failure handling

- Comfort with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD. You can deploy, observe and debug your own service without waiting for someone else

- Testing as a default habit, not a compliance step

- Clear written communication. Design docs, PR descriptions and incident notes are part of the job

- Evidence of lifting other engineers: mentoring, reviews, standards, or documentation people actually use

title: AI/ML Enterprise Architect
description:
**AI/ML Enterprise Architect**

**Experience:**
8–12 Years

**Location:**
Delhi/Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced
**AI/ML Enterprise Architect**
to define and drive scalable enterprise architecture and technology strategy, with strong expertise in
**AI/ML, Generative AI, cloud architecture, enterprise integrations, APIs, and security**
.

The ideal candidate will have a strong track record of designing enterprise-grade AI solutions, integrating AI capabilities with existing business applications, and making strategic architectural decisions across cloud and hybrid environments. The candidate should also have hands-on exposure to
**A2A (Agent-to-Agent) communication and MCP (Model Context Protocol)**
and experience building or architecting AI-powered assistants, chatbots, and agentic solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define
  **enterprise AI/ML architecture, technology strategy, and reference architectures**
  aligned with business and technology objectives.
* Design scalable, secure, and highly available
  **GenAI, AI/ML, and agentic AI solutions**
  for enterprise use cases.
* Architect enterprise integrations across applications, APIs, data platforms, AI services, and third-party systems.
* Design and implement
  **A2A and MCP-based architectures**
  for AI agents and enterprise AI ecosystems.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate
  **AI models, agent frameworks, cloud services, APIs, vector databases, and integration technologies**
  .
* Leverage
  **Microsoft Azure AI services**
  and other cloud-native capabilities to build enterprise-grade AI solutions.
* Define architecture patterns for
  **chatbots, virtual assistants, AI agents, RAG-based applications, and enterprise AI platforms**
  .
* Establish architectural standards covering
  **security, scalability, performance, reliability, observability, governance, and compliance**
  .
* Collaborate with engineering, product, security, data, and business teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide technical direction to development and engineering teams.
* Assess emerging AI technologies and frameworks and recommend their adoption where they provide business value.
* Identify technical risks, architecture gaps, and integration challenges and define appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Create and maintain
  **solution architecture documents, technical specifications, architecture diagrams, and technology roadmaps**
  .
* Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise security and responsible AI principles.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **8–12 years of overall experience**
  in software architecture, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or related technology roles.
* Strong experience in
  **AI/ML and Generative AI architecture**
  and enterprise AI solution design.
* Strong understanding of
  **enterprise integration architecture, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems**
  .
* **Hands-on experience with A2A (Agent-to-Agent) and MCP (Model Context Protocol).**
* Strong knowledge of
  **Microsoft Azure AI services**
  , Azure cloud architecture, and cloud-native technologies.
* Experience with
  **AI/agent frameworks**
  , LLM-based applications, RAG, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
* Experience designing or architecting
  **chatbots, virtual assistants, conversational AI, or enterprise AI platforms**
  .
* Strong understanding of
  **API management, authentication/authorization, identity, security, and enterprise integration patterns**
  .
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably
  **Microsoft Azure**
  .
* Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle, model integration, deployment, monitoring, and governance.
* Strong
  **solution design and architectural decision-making**
  capabilities.
* Excellent understanding of scalability, high availability, performance, security, and resilience principles.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with
  **Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry**
  , Azure AI Search, Azure AI services, or equivalent AI platforms.
* Experience with
  **LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or similar agent frameworks**
  .
* Knowledge of
  **RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration**
  .
* Experience with
  **Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevSecOps**
  .
* Exposure to
  **AI governance, responsible AI, data privacy, and enterprise security frameworks**
  .
* Experience working with large-scale enterprise transformation or modernization initiatives.

title: GDS Cyber-AI Driven IAM-Manager
description:
