At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY GDS Cybersecurity is seeking an experienced IAM AI Manager to help clients modernize their Identity and Access Management landscape through AI-led transformation. This role focuses on identifying where AI can improve IAM operations, governance, access risk management, privileged access, and non-human identity controls across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work closely with clients and delivery teams to translate IAM challenges into practical, scalable, and reusable AI-enabled solutions. The role requires strong IAM domain understanding, consulting leadership, and the ability to shape solution approaches that improve identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, privileged access, compliance posture, and emerging areas such as agent, workload, and service identities.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of IAM experience, AI awareness, solution design capability, and stakeholder-facing communication skills. This profile is expected to guide discovery, define the IAM-AI vision, support PoCs and MVPs, and help clients adopt intelligent, risk-aware, and secure identity operations without losing focus on control, auditability, and business value.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical architecture & design**

* Define IAM-AI solution architecture across IGA, AM/SSO, PAM, directory services, NHI, and security operations use cases.
* Translate client IAM challenges into scalable AI-enabled workflows, PoCs, MVPs, and implementation roadmaps.
* Guide secure integration of identity data, AI models, automation scripts, APIs, analytics, and cloud services to improve IAM operations and risk visibility.
* Provide hands-on direction using Python, PowerShell, APIs, and automation patterns to validate and accelerate solution delivery.

**LLM, Reasoning & Knowledge Engineering**

* Design AI-led IAM use cases using LLMs, RAG, agents, copilots, orchestration frameworks, and responsible AI guardrails.
* Apply AI/ML techniques to support access risk analysis, anomaly detection, role mining, certification insights, and privileged access intelligence.
* Support secure NHI and agent identity governance covering discovery, inventory, authentication, authorization, and guardrails.

**IAM integration automation leadership**

* Lead client workshops, discovery, solution shaping, estimation, roadmap definition, and executive-level IAM-AI storytelling.
* Design AI-enabled governance capabilities across SailPoint, Saviynt, access reviews, lifecycle management, provisioning, SOD, and compliance reporting.
* Shape PAM automation and analytics across CyberArk, privileged access patterns, session monitoring, password rotation, secrets, and risk-based remediation.
* Develop client-ready insights and dashboards using identity data, analytics, automation, and visualization tools.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in IAM, cybersecurity consulting, AI architecture, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics.
* Strong understanding of IAM domains including IGA, AM/SSO, PAM, AD/Entra ID, NHI, lifecycle management, governance, provisioning, access reviews, and risk scoring.
* Working knowledge of AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, AI agents, copilots, orchestration, embeddings, and cloud AI services.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation scripts, data pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns.
* Good understanding of IAM protocols and controls including SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, authorization, and certificate/key management.
* Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and executive storytelling skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Big 4, GDS, global delivery, or consulting-led environments.
* Ability to create PoC/MVP plans, architecture views, roadmap slides, executive summaries, and client demos.
* Exposure to IAM modernization, NHI governance, privileged access transformation, AI adoption, and responsible AI controls.
* Relevant working knowledge or certifications across CISSP, CISM, Azure AI, Google ML, Saviynt, SailPoint, CyberArk, or cloud security are preferred.

**Certifications, Compliance & Assurance**

* Ensure IAM-AI solutions are secure, auditable, explainable, and aligned with client risk, compliance, and assurance expectations.
* Define governance guardrails for AI-driven identity operations, NHI controls, privileged access automation, access recommendations, data handling, and model-assisted decisions.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.

title: Mid & Senior Informatica MDM & IDQ Developer – MDM Hub & ActiveVOS
description:
Mid & Senior Informatica MDM & IDQ Developer – MDM Hub & ActiveVOS

Experience- 5–15 Years

Employment Type- Full-Time

Work Location- Remote

Notice Period- Immediate

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Informatica MDM & IDQ Developer with strong hands-on expertise in Informatica Multidomain MDM, MDM Hub Console, Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ), and ActiveVOS.

The ideal candidate should be a strong technical resource who can work directly within the MDM Hub Console, understand business requirements, configure and develop MDM solutions, build and customize match/merge and survivorship logic, and develop ActiveVOS workflows for data stewardship and approval processes.

This is a hands-on development and configuration role requiring deep knowledge of Informatica MDM architecture, MDM Hub configuration, data quality, integration, and workflow development.

Key Responsibilities

Informatica MDM Development & Configuration

* Work extensively with the Informatica MDM Hub Console for configuration, development, testing, and deployment.
* Configure and develop Base Objects, Landing Tables, Staging Tables, Mappings, Packages, Queries, Tokens, Match Rules, Merge Rules, and Trust/Survivorship Rules.
* Design and implement MDM solutions based on business and data governance requirements.
* Configure match and merge strategies, including deterministic and probabilistic matching.
* Configure trust, validation, survivorship, and consolidation rules.
* Develop and maintain Business Entity Services (BES) and associated MDM services.
* Configure and maintain Hub Jobs, batch processes, load jobs, tokenization, and cleanse processes.
* Troubleshoot data processing, matching, merging, and consolidation issues within the MDM Hub.
* Perform MDM configuration changes, enhancements, testing, and production deployments.

ActiveVOS Workflow Development

* Design, develop, configure, and maintain ActiveVOS workflows integrated with Informatica MDM.
* Develop workflows for data stewardship, approvals, exception handling, and business processes.
* Configure ActiveVOS tasks, business processes, rules, notifications, and assignments.
* Integrate ActiveVOS workflows with MDM Hub and Business Entity Services.
* Troubleshoot workflow failures, stuck tasks, integration issues, and process bottlenecks.
* Customize workflows based on changing business and data governance requirements.

Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ)

* Develop and maintain data quality mappings, transformations, cleansing, standardization, and validation rules.
* Work with profiling, scorecards, reference data, and reusable data quality components.
* Configure and maintain AddressDoctor and address cleansing/standardization processes.
* Identify data quality issues and implement appropriate remediation and cleansing strategies.
* Integrate IDQ capabilities with MDM processes to improve data accuracy and consistency.

Integration & API Development

* Develop and support integrations between Informatica MDM and upstream/downstream applications.
* Work with REST/SOAP APIs, Business Entity Services, web services, and application integrations.
* Configure and troubleshoot MDM data publishing and integration processes.
* Work with ETL/data integration processes for loading and synchronizing master data.
* Troubleshoot integration failures and performance issues across MDM and connected systems.

Production Support & Performance

* Monitor MDM processes, workflows, integrations, and scheduled jobs.
* Analyze and resolve production issues related to MDM Hub, IDQ, and ActiveVOS.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
* Optimize match rules, mappings, queries, batch processes, and workflows for better performance.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, database, application, and vendor teams when required.
* Support deployment, release management, upgrades, patches, and migration activities.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5–10 years of overall IT/data management experience, with significant hands-on experience in Informatica MDM.
* Strong hands-on development and configuration experience with Informatica Multidomain MDM / Informatica MDM Hub.
* Must have extensive experience working directly with the MDM Hub Console.
* Strong understanding of MDM configuration, development, match/merge, survivorship, trust, validation, and consolidation.
* Strong hands-on experience with ActiveVOS workflow development and administration.
* Experience developing and maintaining MDM Business Entity Services (BES).
* Strong experience with Informatica Data Quality (IDQ/CDQ).
* Good understanding of Informatica MDM architecture and data model.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or Snowflake.
* Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and web-service integrations.
* Good understanding of ETL/data integration concepts.
* Experience with Linux/Unix environments and shell scripting.
* Ability to troubleshoot application, database, integration, and MDM-related issues independently.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* A hands-on Informatica MDM developer/configurator, not purely an administrator.
* Comfortable navigating the MDM Hub Console and independently configuring and developing MDM components.
* Strong in ActiveVOS workflow development and MDM workflow integration.
* Able to understand complex master-data requirements and convert them into technical MDM solutions.
* Strong in troubleshooting, debugging, performance tuning, and production support.
* Capable of working independently with business, data governance, integration, and technical teams.

Core Technical Skills

Primary:

Informatica MDM Hub | MDM Hub Console | ActiveVOS | Informatica IDQ/CDQ | Match & Merge | Survivorship | Trust Rules | Business Entity Services | Data Stewardship Workflows

title: Software Engineer III
description:
**Job Description**
The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.
  
  
The Global Merchant and Network Services Technology (GMNST) organization at American Express is responsible for modernizing the payments network to enable next-generation payments products. The team creates flexible merchant platforms to acquire, bill, pay, service and foster innovation, while enabling a payments ecosystem to connect and authenticate parties seamlessly and securely
  
  
American Express is making strategic investments in new card network products and platforms to allow the company to meet its ambitious global growth agenda. Card Network platform is a distributed near real time low latency system that is always available and highly resilient, processing transactions from around the world 24x7, 365 days a year. American Express Global Card Network Platform authorizes and processes all of the company’s customer card transactions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As Software Engineer, you will be a responsible to build core features and functions of card transaction systems on distributed platform deployed in hybrid cloud.
  
  

* You will be a core member of an agile team driving the latest development practices, writing code and unit tests, working with API specs and automation.
* You will be using Java Technologies – Vertx, Spring MVC, Spring Data and Spring Boot and RESTful micro services.
* Lead a culture of innovation and experimentation, engage in fun and outcome-oriented culture, and always be ready to try new concepts without fear of failure.
* Collaborate with peer technology and development teams across different locations.
* Identifying opportunities for adopting new technologies
* Work along with stakeholders to understand and analyze the requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Computer Science, or equivalent degree or industry experience.
* 5+ years of software development experience in a professional environment.
* Strong OOPs concepts, concurrency, exception handling etc.
* Data structures and Algorithms, Strong OS fundamentals, Advanced Java concepts
* Strong development experience using languages Java/ Go. Keen understanding of how to build highly performant systems with such languages.
* Hands on experience in building distributed micro-service systems, experience with Service Mesh products/frameworks like such as Envoy, Linkerd, Istio, gRPC/ProtoBuf; Distributed System Management/tracing and monitoring such as Zipkin/Jaeger, ELK Stack, Prometheus
* Have experience in designing and building Cloud native applications. Experience in cloud platforms like Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift are a plus.
* Experience in using NoSQL databases and distributed messaging systems such as Redis, Kafka, Couchbase, Cassandra in the context of low latency and high transaction volume systems.
* Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment tools such as Jenkins, GitHub
* Experience working in DevOps teams and Scrums.
* Ability to learn and deep dive into new technology and business domains, question status quo and think outside of the box.
* Proficient oral and written communication skills.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: SDE-2, Partner Engineering
description:
**Who We Are**
80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?
  
  
Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.
  
  
We are a remote-first, global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
We are looking for a SDE to join our rapidly expanding Engineering team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Application Development – Design, develop, configure, and enhance business applications using the Zinier Low/No-Code Platform.
* Module Development – Build new modules, workflows, business rules, UI components, and application capabilities based on product requirements.
* Application Enhancement – Analyze existing modules and continuously improve functionality, usability, reliability, and performance.
* Integration Development – Build and maintain integrations with REST APIs, third-party applications, enterprise systems, and other services.
* End-to-End Development – Work across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, and platform components to deliver complete solutions.
* Testing & Quality Assurance – Develop unit, integration, and functional tests and ensure high-quality production releases.
* Performance & Security – Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and implement secure application development practices, including protection against XSS, CSRF/XSRF, and other common web vulnerabilities.
* AI-Native Development – Build and integrate AI/LLM-powered capabilities such as copilots, intelligent automation, recommendations, and AI-assisted workflows.
* Production Support – Diagnose and resolve application, integration, and production issues efficiently.
* Collaboration – Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Architects, QA, and other engineering teams to deliver robust solutions.
* Version Control & Deployment – Follow engineering best practices using Git, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and automated testing.
* Continuous Improvement – Identify opportunities to improve application architecture, development processes, platform capabilities, and engineering productivity.

**Required Skills**

* 6–10 years of software development experience building scalable web applications.
* Strong programming fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React.js or Angular.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, AJAX/fetch, JSON, REST APIs, and web application architecture.
* Experience with API integrations, authentication, authorization, and API security.
* Experience with unit testing frameworks such as Jest, Jasmine, or Mocha.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD practices.
* Understanding of web performance optimization and cross-browser compatibility.
* Ability to work effectively in a low-code/no-code application development environment.

**AI-Native Development — Must Have**

* Hands-on experience building or integrating applications powered by LLMs or AI services.
* Experience with AI/LLM platforms or APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, or similar.
* Experience designing and iterating on prompt flows and AI workflows.
* Understanding of structured outputs, function/tool calling, RAG, or agentic workflows.
* Ability to evaluate AI output quality and design mechanisms for monitoring, feedback, and continuous improvement.
* Understanding of AI application security, data privacy, hallucination mitigation, and access control.

**Backend Development — Good to Have**

* Experience with Java/JEE, Spring Boot, and RESTful services.
* Understanding of database design, schemas, and SQL/NoSQL databases.
* Exposure to microservices architecture.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

**What Would Make a Candidate Successful**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals rather than dependence on a particular framework.
* Ability to translate business requirements into working applications.
* Comfortable working across UI → business logic → APIs → integrations → data.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new platform capabilities and AI technologies.
* Ability to balance configuration, low-code development, and custom engineering appropriately.

* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. title: Software Engineer
description:
**About the role**

We're hiring a Software Engineer with 1–3 years of experience to build and maintain our Java / Spring Boot backend platform. You'll design APIs, build integrations and work on high-impact business workflows, and you'll also contribute to our React-based internal admin portal. Working React knowledge is a strong plus.

**Role:**
Software Engineer

**Experience:**
1–3 years

~80% backend (Java / Spring Boot), ~20% frontend (React)

**Backend**

* Design, build and maintain REST APIs in Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a multi-module Maven codebase.
* Implement core business logic with clean, well-tested code.
* Build and maintain integrations with third-party APIs (REST, OAuth, webhooks).
* Model data in PostgreSQL with JPA/Hibernate and ship schema changes through versioned migrations.

* Work with product, QA and support to turn requirements into shippable changes.

**Must have**

* 1–3 years of professional backend development in Java (Java 11+).
* Hands-on Spring Boot: REST controllers, dependency injection, Spring Data JPA, exception handling, configuration profiles.
* Solid SQL and relational modeling, preferably PostgreSQL: joins, indexes, transactions, query tuning basics.
* Working knowledge of Hibernate/JPA, including lazy loading and the N+1 problem.
* Experience writing unit tests with JUnit and Mockito.
* Comfort with Maven, Git and a PR-based workflow.
* Understanding of REST API design, HTTP status codes, auth basics (JWT/OAuth) and JSON.
* Core CS fundamentals: data structures, OOP, collections, multithreading basics.
* Clear written communication and ownership of tasks end to end.

**Good to have**

**Frontend**

* React 18 with TypeScript: functional components, hooks, props and state.
* Material UI (MUI), including Data Grid and date pickers.
* Calling REST APIs with Axios and handling loading and error states.
* React Router and a state library (Easy Peasy, Redux or similar).
* Testing with Jest and React Testing Library.

**Backend and platform**

* Kafka producers/consumers, Redis caching or distributed locks.
* Liquibase or Flyway schema migrations.
* Quartz or other job schedulers; actor-based concurrency (Akka).
* Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins CI/CD.
* Experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) in daily work.

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–3 years building production backend systems.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Monetization Platform
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Monetization Platform team owns the systems behind how Rippling sells, contracts, bills, collects, and recognizes revenue across products and countries.
  
  
This is the platform behind the Quote -> Contract -> Entitlement -> Subscription -> Usage -> Bill -> Revenue lifecycle. It supports a $1B+ sales base, manages entitlements, metering, and usage-based billing rules, and enables localized billing for new country launches. The team gives Rippling the foundation to launch new products, pricing models, and markets without rebuilding monetization logic each time.
  
  
Our vision: "Let any team monetize any product, anywhere, without writing code."
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the next generation platform. This is an Individual Contributor role for someone who can own broad, ambiguous, multi-team technical charters, influence technical direction without relying on formal authority, and stay close to the code.
  
  
You will work on systems where errors are expensive: contracts, entitlement state, subscription state, usage meters, invoices, payments, taxes, revenue data, audit trails, and customer-facing billing experiences. You will define architecture, make hard tradeoffs, mentor technical leaders, and build a platform that lets Rippling monetize new products faster and with more confidence.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* System Design: Design scalable, reliable systems that handles contracting, subscription management, invoicing, billing and revenue recognition
* Ownership & Impact: Own projects end-to-end, from design through production - with direct visibility into business outcomes
* Engineering Excellence: Set the bar for code quality, testing practices, and technical documentation within your team
* Mentorship: Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, best practices, and continuous learning within the team
* Collaboration: Partner with Business stakeholders, Product, and Platform teams to translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions

**What You Need To Have**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field.
* 6+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong proficiency in Java, Python, or similar programming languages.
* Proven experience in designing and developing scalable, distributed systems or SaaS platforms.
* Experience with reliability engineering, incident response, performance tuning, observability, and operational excellence.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
* Excellent ability to communicate complex technical ideas with clarity and precision in written and verbal modes.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

title: Software Engineer, Privileged Access Management (PAM) / Password Manager (PWM) - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

Position Overview
  

We are seeking a Senior / Lead Software Engineer to drive the architectural evolution, security posture, and engineering execution of our core platform. In this role, you will lead the design of scalable microservices, integrate enterprise
**Privileged Access Management (PAM)**
frameworks, drive automated delivery pipelines, and champion cutting-edge AI-assisted engineering practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
* **Architecture & Core Engineering:**
  Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available microservices using C#, .NET Core, Go, and TypeScript via gRPC and the ABP framework.
  
* **Privileged Access Management (PAM):**
  Design and deploy enterprise-grade Privileged Access Management (PAM)/IDAM solutions (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault), enforcing Zero Trust principles, Least Privilege access, and SCIM protocol integrations.
  
* **Delivery & Test Engineering:**
  Own end-to-end continuous delivery using Origin CI, Kargo, and WoK. Ensure platform resilience by implementing unit, functional, and Playwright E2E suites alongside Performance, Scalability, and Reliability (PSR) testing.
  
* **AI Adoption & Technical Leadership:**
  Champion the BMAD framework to establish governance and structure for AI-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot). Mentor engineers, conduct RFC reviews, and build shared team skill libraries.
  
* **Multi-Platform & Full-Stack Development:**
  Build cross-platform services and native desktop applications (macOS, Windows, Linux) supporting complex enterprise user workflows.
  
* **Observability & Operational Excellence:**
  Implement robust telemetry, logging, and tracing across microservices to monitor system health, reduce latency, and ensure strict SLA/SLO compliance.
  
* **Technical Debt & Governance:**
  Partner with Product, Design, and Infrastructure teams to manage technical debt, refactor legacy components, and establish standardized engineering best practices across Agile sprints.
  
* **Problem solving & Troubleshooting:**
  Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn-around to resolve the incident.
  
  

  
**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**
  

  
* **Experience:**
  8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with proven leadership as a Lead Architect or Senior Staff Engineer in a modern product environment.
  
* **Backend Stack:**
  Deep expertise in C#, .NET (ASP.NET Core / ABP Framework), Go, gRPC, and RESTful APIs.
  
* **Databases:**
  Advanced proficiency with relational (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL (DocumentDB) architectures.
  
* **Cloud & DevOps:**
  Strong hands-on experience with AWS, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and custom CI/CD automation pipelines.
  
* **Testing:**
  Proficiency with automated testing frameworks, specifically Playwright for E2E automation and dedicated load/stress testing tools.
  
* **Artificial Intelligence:**
  Direct experience establishing spec-driven AI development workflows in production teams.

  

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

  
  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  

 

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

 

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  

 

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**

  

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

  
  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

**Role:**
Software Engineer – Backend & Multi-Agent Systems (Founding Team)

**Function:**
Software Engineering / Backend & AI Systems

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Technology / AI Agent

**About Company**

The company is building an AI-powered personal agent designed specifically for the Indian market. Its core product transforms noisy group conversations into structured, actionable workflows.

It identifies what needs attention, tracks responsibilities, remembers context, and takes follow-up actions on a user's behalf. The company is seed-stage, backed by repeat entrepreneurs and senior technologists with backgrounds at Google, Meta, and a successful fintech/crypto venture.

The founding team of 10 is based in Bangalore. This is a true 0→1 opportunity — the first engineers will define the architecture, technology stack, and engineering culture from day one.

**Position Overview**

As one of the company's first engineers, you will own the backend systems and agent orchestration layer that keep hundreds of AI agents running reliably at scale. There is no spec waiting for you: you will decide what to build, build it, ship it, and own what happens after. The role demands someone who can hold the entire system in their head while multiple streams of work move simultaneously — catching what's quietly gone wrong and ensuring pieces still fit when they land.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Design and build the agent orchestration layer — how agents plan, act, remember context, and stay reliable when thousands of conversations run concurrently
* Build and operate the backend infrastructure behind the messenger — real-time messaging, sync, notifications, and everything that runs server-side
* Identify broken or missing parts of the system and fix or build them without waiting for a ticket or approval
* Hold the full system in context across multiple parallel workstreams — knowing what each agent is doing, catching silent failures, and ensuring components integrate cleanly
* Shape how the team builds — tooling, processes, and AI-assisted workflows that let a small team ship at the speed of a large one without quality slipping
* Own what you ship: monitor it in production, respond when it breaks, and improve it based on real user behaviour

**Must Have Criteria**

* 3–7 years of building and owning backend systems used by real people in production — with accountability through and after launch
* Hands-on experience building multi-agent or LLM-based systems that run reliably in production — not just a single-agent prototype
* Track record of taking ambiguous, undefined problems from first principles to shipped product without a spec
* Ability to make sound technical decisions under uncertainty — knowing when to move fast and when to slow down
* Strong debugging and systems-thinking skills — able to pick up an unfamiliar part of a codebase and get to the root of what's wrong

**Nice to Have**

* Has built and operated a backend at real scale — and lived with it in production under sustained load
* Has shipped a consumer product in messaging, mobile, or real-time domains
* Has worked across client, backend, and infrastructure without staying in a single lane
* Comfortable with LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, or agent memory and reliability at scale

**What We Offer**

* Founding-team equity and direct ownership of product, architecture, and company direction
* A direct line from your work to real users solving a genuinely hard problem
* Access to the latest AI tooling and the freedom to change how the team works when you find a better way
* Daily collaboration with founders who have built and scaled products at Google, Meta, and a successful fintech venture

description:
****Company Description****
Company Description
  
  
Continental develops pioneering technologies and services for sustainable and connected mobility of people and their goods. Founded in 1871, the technology company offers safe, efficient, intelligent, and affordable solutions for vehicles, machines, traffic and transportation. In 2023, Continental generated sales of €41.4 billion and currently employs around 200,000 people in 56 countries and markets.
  
  
Guided by the vision of being the customer's first choice for material-driven solutions, the ContiTech group sector focuses on development competence and material expertise for products and systems made of rubber, plastics, metal, and fabrics. These can also be equipped with electronic components in order to optimize them functionally for individual services. ContiTech's industrial growth areas are primarily in the areas of energy, agriculture, construction, and surfaces. In addition, ContiTech serves the automotive and transportation industries as well as rail transport.
  
  
The IT Digital and Data Services Competence Center of ContiTech caters to all the Business Areas in ContiTech and responsible among other on areas of Data & Analytics, Web and Mobile Software Development and AI
  
  
The team for Data services specializes in all platforms, business applications and products in the domain of data and analytics, covering the entire spectrum including AI, machine learning, data science, data analysis, reporting and dashboarding.
  
  
****Job Description****
Job Description
  
  
****Job Description****
This is a software engineering role focused on building production-grade data platform components.
  
  
You will design and operate services, APIs, and data pipelines in a CI/CD-driven environment.
  
  
This is NOT a notebook-driven or analytics-focused role.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable and fault-tolerant data ingestion pipelines from a wide variety of source systems, including SAP, Salesforce, SharePoint, APIs, and (legacy) manufacturing platforms.
* Build and enhance production-grade metadata-driven data handling components and inbound-/outbound-interfaces.
* Own production data interfaces end-to-end.
* Develop reusable, version-controlled platform components, APIs, or data interfaces, following software engineering best practices (CI/CD, automated testing, version control, monitoring).
* Contributes to a global data engineering team delivering to all major business domains.
* Establish and maintain holistic data quality management, monitoring and reporting.
* Collaborates across business IT, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and architecture teams to ensure secure and sustainable delivery.

**Main Tasks:**

* Design and implement fault-tolerant, observable data pipelines, including logging, alerting, and failure handling strategies.
* Build and maintain Python- or Scala-based extraction services (e.g., Debezium Server, custom APIs, rclone)
* Implement CDC, delta, and event-based patterns.
* Build and enhance push-based HTTP, Kerberos-authenticated custom data lake transfer delivery component.
* Integrate with systems such as Salesforce, SharePoint, and other API- or file-based endpoints.
* Establish, operate and troubleshoot extraction from SAP using tools like Theobald Extract Universal.
* Establish and maintain a web-accessible data catalog application as part of the data platform, focusing on backend services, metadata management, and integration with platform components.
* Integrate dataset discoverability, preview/exploration options, and lineage information using Unity Catalog as a backend metadata system.
* Design and implement structured access request workflows including request submission, approval chains, audit trail, and enablement triggers.
* Perform design reviews with Cybersecurity.
* Ensure documentation and compliance for all interfaces and data ingress points.
* Manage audit and traceability requirements.
* Collaborate closely with IT and business users to translate requirements into scalable technical patterns.
* Serve as technical escalation point for complex source integration.
* Define and implement a multi-layered data quality framework, including unit-level, integration-level, and cross-pipeline validation rules.
* Establish centralized and version-controlled storage of DQ rules, with integration into orchestration and CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement automatic DQ monitoring with severity levels (Critical, High, Medium, Low) and enable flagging, filtering, and quarantining logic at relevant stages of the pipeline.
* Collaborate with source system owners and business stakeholders to define meaningful and actionable DQ thresholds.

****Qualifications****
Qualifications
  
  
Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  
  

* 5–8 years in software development, with hands-on experience with inbound- and outbound data exchange interfaces, using a variety of technologies, such as APIs, CDC, managing endpoints.
* Hands-on experience with Scala / Java, Python, and advanced SQL, using Git for collaborative development and CI/CD methodologies.
* Experience building robust ingestion pipelines and ETL-jobs in a software engineering context.
* Track record with Azure or other hyperscaler resource management.
* Familiarity with data lake housing and data warehousing, Databricks and Azure knowledge is a plus.
* Comfortable working across geographies and time zones; collaborates effectively with global teams and enterprise stakeholders.
* Candidates with a strong backend/software engineering background (e.g. Java, Scala, distributed systems) who want to move into data platform engineering are highly encouraged to apply.

****NOT a Fit If Your Experience Is Primarily:****
▪ Notebook-based data processing (e.g. Jupyter, ad-hoc PySpark) without production deployment
  
  
▪ Dashboarding / analytics / BI tools
  
  
▪ SQL-only roles without software engineering experience

The MS SQL Developer will collaborate with application, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams to deliver reliable and maintainable database solutions. The role contributes to business objectives by improving database performance, availability, data quality, security, and operational continuity.
  
  
****Software Requirements****

* Database management systems: Strong knowledge of database concepts and experience with SQL Server or comparable platforms.
* Database design: Experience designing tables, relationships, indexes, constraints, schemas, and data access structures.
* Performance optimization: Experience analyzing execution plans, identifying bottlenecks, optimizing queries, and improving database performance.
* Database security: Knowledge of access controls, authentication, authorization, permissions, encryption, auditing, and secure data-handling practices.

* Programming languages: Familiarity with SQL and at least one additional language such as Python or Java.

* Exposure to cloud database platforms and managed database services.

Equivalent database platforms and tools may be considered where they provide comparable capabilities.
  
  
****Overall Responsibilities****

title: Senior Software Engineer - Semantic Data Lake
description:
**About The Team / Role**
Senior Software Engineer, Semantic Data Team
  
  
WEX is reimagining its enterprise data platform with a powerful goal: transforming raw data into semantically meaningful, reusable, and trusted business assets. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Semantic Data Team, you'll contribute to designing, building, and maintaining control plane for Semantic layer and AI Native data platforms supporting our core 360 data objects (Customer, Fleet, Health and Payments)
  
  
An embedded DataOps backbone and self-service control plane ensures governance, lineage, observability, and operational efficiency at scale. Together, these elements empower WEX to modernize responsibly—continuously delivering business value while evolving toward a future where intelligence and automation are built on a foundation of governed, high-quality data.
  
  
This team is at the heart of WEX's DaaS platform where the platform integrates DataOps automation, control plane services, and governance tooling to uphold quality and trust at scale, enabling trusted, production-grade semantic models through automated controls, audit validation, and operational alignment.
  
  
Wex is highly invested in building AI native data platform. The Agentic Control Plane is the runtime layer that determines how an AI agent interprets a user request, assembles the right context, applies the right rules and constraints, uses approved tools, and drives the next step.
  
  
We're looking for an AI-native engineer: someone who builds with modern AI coding tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, and similar) and Spec-Driven Development (SDD) as a core part of their daily workflow. You'll use these tools to accelerate development and apply solid engineering judgment to ship production-grade, trustworthy data assets.
  
  
How you'll make an impact
  
  

* Engineer the Operational Backbone: You will design and implement the core infrastructure of the Control Plane, serving as the central execution engine that orchestrates the entire data lifecycle—from ingestion and transformation to final distribution.
* Shift from Reactive to Proactive: You will transform platform reliability by building sophisticated observability frameworks and automated quality gates, ensuring that data trust is engineered into the system rather than inspected after the fact.
* Drive Self-Service Autonomy: You will eliminate operational bottlenecks by developing intuitive portals and "golden templates," empowering domain teams to autonomously build, manage, and consume trusted data products.
* Champion Platform Governance: You will automate critical compliance and security policies, including end-to-end data lineage, role-based access control (RBAC), and PII protection, making security an inherent feature of our data objects.
* Prepare for AI-Native Scale: You will build the foundational data architecture required for our AI future, contributing to the development of the context and RAG-based systems that will power the next generation of data-driven intelligence.
* Leverage AI coding assistants (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, and similar) to accelerate development—drafting transformation logic, generating tests, refactoring pipelines, exploring datasets, and producing semantic documentation—while critically reviewing AI output for correctness and alignment with business rules.
* Share patterns, prompts, and workflows that help the team get more leverage out of AI tooling, contributing to AI-native engineering practices across the Semantic Data Team.
* Work closely with domain experts, data scientists, and product stakeholders to translate business concepts into framework that supports development
* Implement logic for classifications, KPIs, scoring algorithms, and business rules, ensuring traceability and data lineage.
* Follow and contribute to standards for data modeling, documentation, and governance within the semantic layer—including responsible, auditable use of AI-generated code and artifacts.
* Collaborate across teams to integrate with ingestion, MDM, and data product layers.

Experience you'll bring
  
  

* 4–8 years of experience in data engineering or software engineering with a focus on data transformation, modeling, or analytics platforms.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose language such as Python or Scala.
* Demonstrated experience as an AI-native engineer—using tools like Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar as a regular part of your development workflow.
* AI-Native Architecture: You are passionate about the future of data intelligence and have hands-on experience with LLM-driven architectures. You are comfortable designing RAG systems, building agentic workflows (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI), and working with vector/graph databases to manage context and ontology.
* Familiarity with modern AI engineering practices such as prompt design, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), and AI-assisted code review.
* Advanced Data Orchestration & Pipeline Reliability: You possess deep expertise in building and managing complex orchestration systems (specifically Airflow) and are obsessed with reliability. You know how to engineer "quality-first" pipelines using frameworks like Great Expectations to ensure data trust at scale.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Platform Engineering: You are fluent in the modern DevOps stack—including Terraform, Kubernetes, and CI/CD automation—allowing you to build self-healing, scalable infrastructure that minimizes operational toil.
* Enterprise Governance & Metadata Management: You have a proven track record of implementing automated governance, specifically utilizing DataHub or similar platforms to manage end-to-end lineage, cataloging, and RBAC policies that make security inherent to the data object.
* Observability & Incident Management: You understand that "the platform is the product." You bring experience building comprehensive observability frameworks (e.g., Grafana, xMatters integration) that move teams from reactive firefighting to proactive, automated alerting.
* Self-Service Mindset: You advocate for "developer autonomy" over manual intervention. You have experience building intuitive portals and developer tools that enable domain teams to build, manage, and consume trusted data products independently.
* Solid understanding of data quality practices—including validation, enrichment, schema enforcement, and business rule encoding.
* Comfort operating in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, balancing business logic with platform scalability.
* A proven track record for traceability, reproducibility, and semantic clarity—you build data models others can trust and reuse.

title: .NET Developer
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
The .NET Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining reliable software solutions using modern Microsoft technologies. The role requires a strong hands-on developer with 2–5 years’ experience who can work confidently with modern .NET technologies including C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, Web API, RESTful services, and modern application development practices. The role also requires good SQL capability, preferably across SQL Server or Oracle, and practical exposure to modern UI frameworks such as React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. The developer will work closely with technical leads, business analysts, testers, architects, and delivery stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, well-tested, performant, and maintainable applications across enterprise platforms. Basic awareness of legacy .NET technologies is desirable to support existing applications and contribute to gradual modernisation where required.
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus 
  

* Contribute to the delivery of modern, secure, scalable, and maintainable applications using C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST APIs, Entity Framework or similar ORM/data-access patterns, and relational databases.
* Apply sound engineering practices including clean coding, SOLID principles, unit testing, code reviews, source control discipline, and effective technical documentation.
* Support continuous improvement by adopting relevant tools, automation, cloud services, secure development practices, and AI-assisted engineering responsibly where appropriate.

  
Operational Management 
  

* Analyse business and technical requirements, clarify assumptions, and contribute to solution design with guidance from technical leads and architects.
* Design, build, enhance, and maintain application components across back-end services, APIs, database objects, integrations, and front-end features using React or similar modern UI frameworks where applicable.
* Write clean, efficient, reusable, and testable code using modern C#, ASP.NET Core, RESTful API patterns, asynchronous programming, LINQ, dependency injection, and SQL Server or Oracle.
* Develop and consume RESTful APIs, implement validation, authentication/authorisation checks, structured logging, exception handling, and robust error handling to support integration with internal and external systems.
* Work with SQL Server or Oracle to write and optimise queries, understand joins, indexes, stored procedures, execution behaviour, and troubleshoot performance or data-related issues.
* Contribute to UI development using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, including API integration, component-level changes, validation, and basic usability improvements.
* Prepare and maintain unit tests, support test automation where applicable, and work with testers to resolve defects through triage, root-cause analysis, and technical fixes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support maintenance and enhancement of existing legacy .NET applications where required, while contributing to gradual modernisation using current .NET, API, cloud, and UI development practices.
* Use Git-based source control, branching, pull requests, code review feedback, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes in line with team standards.

  
Collaboration & Team Contribution 
  

* Work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, testers, architects, delivery managers, and support teams to deliver quality software outcomes.
* Communicate progress, risks, blockers, and technical considerations clearly and in a timely manner.
* Share knowledge with team members, contribute to documentation, and support a positive engineering culture focused on learning and continuous improvement.

  
Governance & Risk 
  

* Follow secure coding, data protection, accessibility, audit, and information security requirements relevant to enterprise financial technology applications.
* Support production stability by creating maintainable solutions, documenting changes, participating in defect analysis, and assisting with release and post-release support activities when required.

  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  

* Minimum Qualification: Bachelor of Engineering / MSc / BSc – IT / Computer Science / Any Graduate with relevant software development experience.
* 2–5 years of hands-on software development experience using modern C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, RESTful services, and object-oriented programming concepts.
* Strong understanding of full SDLC, Agile delivery practices, requirements analysis, estimation, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong SQL capability using SQL Server or Oracle, including writing complex queries, joins, stored procedures, indexes, performance-aware database access, query optimisation, and troubleshooting data-related issues.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs and integrating applications with internal or external systems.
* Strong understanding of SOLID principles, design patterns, clean code practices, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, exception handling, logging, security awareness, and performance considerations.
* Experience with unit testing, mocking frameworks, debugging, defect triage, and root-cause analysis.
* Hands-on experience with Git, pull requests, branching strategies, and collaborative code review practices.
* Working knowledge of Azure services, CI/CD pipelines, application monitoring, and cloud-based deployment practices is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot application issues across code, APIs, databases, logs, deployments, and environments, with a practical approach to root-cause analysis and long-term fixes.
* Expected to stay up to date with latest .NET ecosystem changes, Microsoft platform capabilities, secure development practices, and modern engineering tools including AI-assisted development where appropriate.
* Practical exposure to front-end development using React is preferred; experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, component-based UI development, API integration, and client-side validation will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of legacy .NET technologies such as .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, Web Forms, WCF, or older enterprise application patterns will be an advantage, as some existing platforms may require maintenance, enhancement, troubleshooting, or gradual modernisation alongside modern .NET development.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, willingness to learn, adaptability to changing priorities, and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

description:
