At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.
  
  
Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.
  
  
**Summary Of Position**
Teladoc Health is seeking a
**Senior/Mid Software Engineer – Mirth / Healthcare Interoperability**
to join our engineering organization and build, enhance, and support healthcare integrations that enable the secure and reliable exchange of clinical and operational data.
  
  
This is a
**hands-on engineering role**
focused on Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability. The engineer will design and implement complex integration workflows, troubleshoot production interfaces, collaborate with internal teams and external healthcare partners, and contribute to the evolution of our integration platform.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in
**Mirth Connect and HL7v2**
, combined with solid software engineering, integration, debugging, and production support skills. Experience with
**FHIR, EHR/EMR integrations, and healthcare interoperability standards**
is highly valued.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Healthcare Integration & Engineering**

* Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and maintain healthcare interfaces using Mirth Connect.
* Develop complex integration workflows for HL7v2 message parsing, transformation, validation, routing, and delivery.
* Develop reusable and maintainable JavaScript-based transformations and business logic within Mirth Connect.
* Integrate healthcare systems using TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, SFTP, and other integration protocols.
* Translate business and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and production-ready integration solutions.
* Collaborate with internal engineering teams, healthcare organizations, and external vendors to design and implement interfaces.
* Contribute to the design and evolution of healthcare interoperability solutions and integration architecture.
* Identify opportunities to improve integration performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

**Production Support & Reliability**

* Monitor and support production healthcare interfaces and integration workflows.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving message processing, transformation, routing, connectivity, certificates, and downstream systems.
* Troubleshoot network and protocol-level issues across MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP.
* Perform root-cause analysis for production incidents and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Improve interface reliability through effective logging, monitoring, alerting, error handling, and operational automation.
* Participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical production integrations.
* Ensure integration solutions meet appropriate security, reliability, and operational standards.

**Collaboration & Technical Leadership**

* Partner with product managers, architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors to deliver healthcare integration solutions.
* Communicate technical designs, issues, risks, and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Participate in technical design and architecture reviews.
* Conduct code and configuration reviews and promote standards for secure, scalable, and maintainable integration development.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including interface specifications, mapping documents, design documents, and operational runbooks.
* Mentor engineers and serve as a technical resource for Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability.
* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across the integration platform.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering and/or healthcare integration experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting Mirth Connect integrations.
* Strong, practical knowledge of HL7v2, including message structure, segments, fields, components, repetitions, acknowledgments, and common message types.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Mirth Connect channels, including connectors, filters, transformers, and JavaScript.
* Strong experience with TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot connectivity, message delivery, transformation, routing, and downstream system issues in production environments.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript for Mirth transformations and integration logic.
* Understanding of SSL/TLS, certificates, keystores/truststores, and secure endpoint configuration.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience with software development lifecycle practices, source control, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with FHIR, including FHIR resources, APIs, and integration patterns.
* Experience with EHR/EMR integrations and healthcare information exchange.
* Experience with CCDA/C-CDA.
* Familiarity with XDS.b and XCA.
* Experience working with healthcare interoperability standards and architectures.
* Experience developing or integrating with REST APIs and web services.
* Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
* Experience with other healthcare interface engines such as Rhapsody, Corepoint, Cloverleaf, or similar technologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Mirth Connect Certified Developer (MCCD) certification.
* Participation in Mirth Connect, healthcare interoperability, or open-source technical communities.

title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Send is part of Duck Creek Technologies, the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry.
  
  
Founded in 2017, Send was created with a clear ambition: to transform commercial insurance underwriting by combining deep industry expertise with modern technology. Today, Send’s award-winning underwriting workbench helps commercial insurers improve the way underwriting teams access information, make decisions, collaborate, and manage complex risks.
  
  
Following Send’s acquisition by Duck Creek Technologies, we are bringing together Send’s specialist commercial underwriting capabilities with Duck Creek’s scale, expertise, and modern SaaS platform. Together, we have an exciting opportunity to deliver even greater value to insurers and help shape the future of commercial insurance technology.
  
  
As part of Duck Creek Technologies, the Send team benefits from the scale, investment, expertise, and global reach of a market-leading insurance technology organization while continuing to build on the specialist underwriting expertise and entrepreneurial culture that have driven Send’s success.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
As our Senior Software Engineer in our Delivery and Support team, you will keep Send’s underwriting platform running well for our customers. You’ll predominantly own application and production support for live customer environments, working closely with the customer implementation projects at the point of handoff. This role sits alongside our core product engineering team rather than within it. You’ll work closely with Delivery, Product, Engineering and customer stakeholders to resolve issues quickly, configure and extend the platform for each customer’s needs, and feed what you learn back into the product. It suits a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving real problems that directly affect customers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide application and production support for live customer environments. You’ll investigate, diagnose and resolve incidents, defects and performance issues across global our customer base.
* Own issues from first report to resolution, including root-cause analysis, fixes, clear communication with customers and internal stakeholders, and steps to stop them happening again.
* Sometimes get involved with the delivery of customer implementation projects by configuring, integrating and extending the platform to meet customer requirements.
* Work with Delivery, Product and core Engineering to turn customer requirements into maintainable solutions and pass recurring issues and product gaps back to the product team.
* Build quality into delivery through unit and integration testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and maintaining reliable and performant services.
* Improve our engineering and delivery capabilities through CI/CD and deployment automation, while contributing to architectural decisions that enhance the platform’s scalability and performance.

**What You Bring**

* At least 5 years of professional Java engineering experience, with strong experience developing backend web applications.
* Proficiency with Spring Boot, REST APIs, JPA, and Hibernate, together with experience working with relational databases such as MySQL.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture and software engineering best practices, including unit and integration testing and maintaining high code quality.
* A proactive, pragmatic approach to problem-solving, with strong communication and collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a distributed team.
* Experience with AWS, Apache Camel, Docker, Kubernetes, or other relevant cloud and DevOps technologies is beneficial.
* Experience in the insurance industry or working with insurance-related software is beneficial.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Join a specialist team solving some of the most important challenges in commercial insurance underwriting.
* Contribute to an award-winning underwriting technology platform while being part of Duck Creek Technologies, one of the leading technology providers in the global P&C insurance industry.
* Benefit from the scale, investment, expertise, and global reach of Duck Creek while continuing to work within the specialist and entrepreneurial environment that has driven Send’s success.

**Additional Information**
Location: Mumbai or Bengaluru, India - Hybrid
  
  
Work Authorization: This position does not sponsor employment-based visas.
  
  
**Location & Ways Of Working**
Send, a Duck Creek Company, operates within Duck Creek’s flexible-first working model, giving employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work while creating intentional opportunities for meaningful in-person collaboration.
  
  
This role is aligned to Mumbai or Bengaluru, India, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to one of those locations. You will partner with your leader to participate in in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, customer engagement, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As Duck Creek’s Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Send, a Duck Creek Company, is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves.
  
  
**Our Values Guide Us**
We Prioritize Respect. We Listen. We Care. We Add Value. We Lead.
  
  
**Learn More**
**Duck Creek Technologies**
https://www.duckcreek.com/
  
  
**Life At Duck Creek**
https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/
  
  
**Benefits & Rewards**
https://www.duckcreek.com/wellbeing-and-rewards/
  
  
**AI Statement**
To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted.
  
  
**Privacy Notice**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with its Privacy Notice and applicable data protection laws.
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies does not accept, nor will we pay a fee for, any hires resulting from unsolicited headhunter or agency resumes.

**Job Title: Windows Endpoint Security Developer (C/C++ & Driver Development)
  
  
Location | Remote
  
  
Time Zone | US Time Zones (EST–PST)**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Windows Endpoint Security Developer with strong C, C++, and Windows driver development skills to help build an AI-focused endpoint protection platform. This is a full-time, hands-on engineering role. Your first focus will be building a Windows service that collects system, network, and process data to detect and respond to threats. The ideal candidate knows Windows internals well and enjoys building fast, reliable security software.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement Windows endpoint services, including kernel-mode and user-mode modules
* Develop Windows drivers (WDM, KMDF, UMDF) to monitor file system, process, memory, and network activity
* Build features that drive efficient data collection focused on AI behavioral monitoring
* Implement secure hooks and filters using Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* Collaborate with the team on threat research strategies and translate them into detection logic using endpoint telemetry
* Perform advanced debugging and troubleshooting across kernel and user mode using WinDbg, crash dump analysis, and Sysinternals tools
* Ensure compliance with Microsoft driver signing, PatchGuard, Secure Boot, and kernel security restrictions
* Optimize agent performance to minimize system impact while maintaining visibility and protection
* Participate in threat modeling, secure coding reviews, and internal security assessments

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience working on Windows endpoint security products such as AV, EDR, DLP, firewall, or intrusion prevention (non-negotiable)
* Deep expertise in C, C++, and Windows driver development
* Strong understanding of Windows OS fundamentals and internals
* Experience with kernel-mode communication mechanisms (IOCTL, ALPC, shared memory)
* Proficiency with WinDbg, crash dump analysis, and Sysinternals tools
* Knowledge of Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* Understanding of Microsoft driver signing, PatchGuard, and Secure Boot
* Experience with threat modeling and secure coding practices
* Strong written and spoken English with a clear, professional communication style
* Must have prior remote work experience, be fluent with remote collaboration tools and platforms (such as Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Asana, or similar), and have ideally worked with US or UK-based companies. Applications without this experience will not be considered.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with cross-platform endpoint security (macOS/Linux)
* Experience building telemetry or behavioral analytics pipelines for threat detection
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven security products or monitoring AI agent activity

**Tools & Technology**

* C and C++
* Windows Driver Frameworks (WDM, KMDF, UMDF)
* Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* WinDbg and Sysinternals tools
* Slack, Zoom, and other remote collaboration tools

If you do not record a video, we will not be able to consider you for ANY open roles.

title: SENIOR ELECTRONICS ENGINEER (FIRMWARE)
description:
**ABOUT US**

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing.

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to own the design, development, and verification of high-reliability firmware for our microcontroller-based satellite subsystems. In this role, you will work at the intersection of bare-metal software development and cutting-edge hardware, converting complex aerospace requirements into robust, high-performance C code.

As a key member of our engineering division, you will directly drive firmware architecture, schematic integration, and bench-level debugging. Your ownership will directly impact sub-system reliability, hardware-software integration speed, and the overall execution of our active low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite platforms.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Firmware Architecture & Design:**
  Architect, write, and debug bare-metal and low-level embedded C firmware for ARM 32-bit microcontroller systems powering satellite payloads and sub-systems.
* **Hardware-Software Integration:**
  Review hardware schematics, block diagrams, and datasheets to bring up board support packages (BSPs) and implement device drivers for analog and digital peripherals.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner closely with hardware design, thermal, and systems engineering teams to translate high-level mission requirements into optimal firmware features.
* **Hardware Bench Debugging:**
  Perform root-cause analysis, hardware bring-up, and physical debugging using DSOs (Digital Storage Oscilloscopes), logic analyzers, and multimeters.
* **Protocol & Bus Implementation:**
  Configure and optimize robust embedded communication interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, and USB.
* **Quality & Lifecycle Management:**
  Maintain version control, maintain code standards (e.g., MISRA C guidelines), and write technical documentation, design notes, and test cases to ensure space-grade software reliability.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Experience:**
  4–8 years of hands-on experience in embedded C firmware development for microcontroller-based systems.
* **Education:**
  BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Electronics Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
* **Core Programming:**
  Expert proficiency in Embedded C and bare-metal programming without reliance on abstraction layers.
* **Hardware Understanding:**
  Solid grasp of digital and analog electronics concepts, including DAC/ADC interfaces and schematic reading.
* **Lab Equipment:**
  Hands-on experience troubleshooting, testing, and debugging hardware using DSOs, multimeters, and logic analyzers.

**PREFERRED / DESIRABLE SKILLS**

* **Microcontroller Expertise:**
  Direct experience with ARM 32-bit microcontrollers, specifically Microchip SAM V71 architectures and the MPLAB IDE ecosystem.
* **Code Quality & Standards:**
  Working knowledge of MISRA C compliance and defensive programming techniques for high-reliability systems.
* **Protocols:**
  Practical exposure to industrial and aerospace protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, USB).

**WHY JOIN US?**

* **Pioneer Space Tech:**
  Work directly on active satellite platforms inside India's first mass-production space facility.
* **Vertically Integrated Impact:**
  See your code move rapidly from design and bench testing to integrated satellite hardware orbiting Earth.
* **Engineering Excellence:**
  Collaborate with world-class engineers across hardware, thermal, payload, and mission control domains.
* **Career Acceleration:**
  Scale your skills in a high-growth sector with continuous exposure to complex, space-grade embedded systems.
* **Competitive Package:**
  Attractive salary, comprehensive health benefits, and a culture that celebrates technical innovation and autonomy.

description:

At CosmoChute, we are building modular, reusable lunar robotics infrastructure for long-duration planetary operations. Our systems combine mobility, modular payload deployment, survivability through lunar nights, and repair ability to make sustained presence on the Moon economically viable. We’re a deeply technical, fast-moving team that believes in real ownership, real trust and in creating an environment where your best work matters.

**Your Role**

We're looking for an Avionics Engineer to join our core engineering team. You'll work across the avionics stack, on the design, integration, and testing of avionics systems for lunar robotic platforms and payload systems. This includes embedded electronics, power systems, communication interfaces, and system-level reliability engineering.
  
You will collaborate closely with mechanical, mobility, thermal, and software teams to develop robust hardware systems capable of operating under vacuum, radiation exposure, thermal cycling, vibration, and lunar dust conditions.
  
This role is suited for engineers who enjoy building real hardware, debugging systems hands-on, and solving multidisciplinary engineering problems under mission-critical constraints.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Design and develop embedded electronics and avionics architectures for lunar robotic systems
* Work on onboard power distribution, sensor integration, communication buses, and embedded control systems
* Develop schematics, PCB layouts, wiring architectures, and hardware documentation
* Support integration of motors, actuators, cameras, IMUs, navigation systems, and payload electronics
* Guidance in hardware bring-up, debugging, validation, and environmental testing.
* Work with embedded firmware and low-level communication protocols
* Support EMC/EMI considerations, grounding strategies, and power integrity analysis
* Collaborate with software teams on embedded interfaces and system integration
* Contribute to reliability engineering and fault-tolerant system design
* Assist in component selection, supplier coordination, and manufacturing reviews

**Must have**

* Experience of 5+ yrs in the same domain.
* Strong understanding of electronics design and embedded systems
* Experience with PCB design tools such as Altium, KiCad, Eagle, LtSim or similar
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, SPI, UART, RS485, or Ethernet
* Understanding of power systems, voltage regulation, and signal integrity
* Hands-on experience with hardware debugging and test equipment
* Ability to work independently in fast-moving engineering environments

**Good to have**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, or related field
* Experience with robotics, drones, automotive systems, aerospace hardware, or space systems
* Familiarity with micro-controllers, FPGAs, or embedded Linux platforms
* Knowledge of radiation-aware or high-reliability electronics design
* Experience with motor controllers, battery systems, or autonomous robotic systems
* Exposure to environmental testing, vibration testing, or thermal-vacuum testing

* Experience in working with either of ECSS, ISO, NASA, GEVS or similar standards for design, development and/or verification

* LLM API integration for production AI-native product features.

**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- SailPoint ISC Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis

As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 3-7 years of experience in designing and deploying ISC-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions.
* Configure and manage SailPoint ISC tenant, including deployment of Virtual Appliances for secure connectivity between cloud and on-premises environments
* Integrate of different auth sources and create identity profiles with transforms.
* Manage identity lifecycle through Joiner-Mover-Leaver processes.
* Develop workflows and custom forms for access requests and access review modules.
* Write and maintain Cloud Rules using Java/BeanShell for complex attribute transformations.
* Build and configure connectors for systems like Active Directory, Azure AD, Workday, Web Services, and JDBC.
* Work with SailPoint REST APIs for bulk operations, custom reporting, and external integrations (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
* Demonstrate strong understanding of JSON, XML, REST/SOAP, and SCIM protocols.
* Stay updated on latest ISC modules and functionalities such as AI and CIEM.
* Sailpoint engineer certification is preferred

**What We Offer You**

: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.
* Produces accurate, maintainable, and well-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.
* Comfortable working in a global environment with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark and manufacturing sites as required.

With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly capable
**Salesforce Lead**
to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation
**Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**
powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can
**lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions**
. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking.
  
  
As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms.

title: AI Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to design and guide the implementation of secure, scalable, and production-ready artificial intelligence solutions. This role will establish enterprise AI architecture, lead technical design decisions, and support the delivery of machine learning and generative AI capabilities across cloud and enterprise environments.

The ideal candidate combines strong architecture and software engineering experience with hands-on knowledge of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI governance, cloud platforms, and enterprise application integration.

Key Responsibilities

AI Solution Architecture and Delivery

* Design end-to-end architectures for machine learning and generative AI solutions.
* Lead the architecture and implementation of solutions involving large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent document processing, automation, and predictive analytics.
* Define reusable architectural patterns, reference architectures, and technical standards for enterprise AI.
* Guide engineering teams in developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining AI solutions that support clinical, operational, and administrative use cases.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend appropriate platforms, models, tools, and implementation approaches.

Enterprise AI Infrastructure

* Design and optimize enterprise AI infrastructure across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Define architectural requirements for scalability, availability, security, reliability, and performance.
* Establish deployment, monitoring, and operational standards for AI workloads.
* Support platform health, system performance, capacity planning, and infrastructure readiness.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, security, data, and application teams to ensure architectural alignment.

Enterprise Systems Integration

* Design integration patterns connecting AI capabilities with enterprise applications, data platforms, healthcare systems, and business workflows.
* Define secure interfaces, APIs, data pipelines, and orchestration patterns for AI-enabled solutions.
* Partner with business and technical teams to understand system dependencies and integration requirements.
* Support implementation teams in resolving complex integration and architectural challenges.

AI Governance, Security, and Responsible AI

* Establish AI quality, safety, security, privacy, and governance standards.
* Define evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, validation methods, and monitoring requirements for AI solutions.
* Ensure solutions comply with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and responsible AI principles.
* Identify and mitigate technical, operational, security, privacy, and model-related risks.
* Incorporate human oversight, traceability, and appropriate controls into AI solution designs.

Technical Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as a technical subject matter expert supporting AI strategy, adoption, and solution implementation.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for business and executive stakeholders.
* Lead architectural reviews and provide technical direction to engineering and delivery teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and provide implementation guidance.
* Present findings, recommendations, architectural decisions, and solution options to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Collaborate across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Required Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Equivalent combinations of education, relevant certifications, and professional experience may be considered.

Experience

* Minimum of
  **5 years of professional experience**
  in AI, machine learning, software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale AI or machine learning solutions.
* Experience developing solutions using Python and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with cloud-based AI services and infrastructure, including Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services, and Databricks.
* Experience with generative AI technologies, large language models, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and business workflows.
* Experience establishing technical standards, reusable architecture patterns, or reference architectures.
* Experience moving AI solutions from proof of concept into secure and supportable production environments.

Required Knowledge and Skills

* Advanced knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI technologies.
* Strong understanding of large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Knowledge of AI solution architecture, system integration, application architecture, and data architecture.
* Understanding of cloud architecture, containerization, distributed systems, APIs, and modern deployment practices.
* Familiarity with structured and unstructured data management and analytics platforms, such as Databricks or comparable technologies.
* Knowledge of AI governance, model evaluation, validation methodologies, privacy, security, risk management, and responsible AI.
* Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend solutions based on business, architectural, security, and operational requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across clinical, operational, technical, security, compliance, and executive teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, data, security, or AI certifications.
* Experience working in healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with healthcare data, clinical systems, or electronic health record environments.
* Experience implementing AI governance, model monitoring, or AI risk-management frameworks.
* Experience guiding multidisciplinary teams through AI solution design and production implementation

title: Senior Data Coding Specialist - India
description:

**SUMMARY: Utilize standard and/or sponsor custom dictionaries to code Adverse Events, Medical and Surgical Histories, Medications and any other sponsor requested medical terminology required for projects. Ensure coding guidelines and company SOP’s are adhered to and dictionary versions / updates are maintained as appropriate for the project. Back up to Manager Clinical Coding and Data Management as required.**
**Responsibilities**
Tasks may include but are not limited to:
  
  

* As a priority, provide coding support for projects including:

+ Coding activities for Study start up on existing and new EDC databases
+ Input into the Data Management Plan, performing User Acceptance Testing, including review of Database Specifications and CRFs
+ Performing manual coding of medical and medication terms, generation and review of coding consistency reports for accuracy and submission of coding reports to internal Medical Monitor / peer review and for sponsor review at periodic time points specified for the project.

* Coordinate dictionary implementation and version updates for projects as applicable.
* Communicate effectively with Sponsors on general and project specific coding issues, as needed.
* Ensure coding is performed and delivered consistently both internally and externally with the highest quality and timelines are met according to study requirements.
* Coordinate dictionary licence validation checks and Worldwide licence renewal process.
* Identify coding process and technology improvements, implement changes, monitor the outcome and recommend further action.
* Provide leadership/mentorship to support junior staff performing coding activities.
* Attend sponsor and team meeting as necessary.
* Maintain solid awareness of study coding budget and potential CIS/OOS issues related to coding for studies.
* Provide regular updates to management regarding coding deliverables, metrics, coding issues, etc. as necessary.
* Ensure clinical coding operations are conducted according to WCT SOP’s.
* Act as back up to Manager Clinical Coding and Data Management as required.
* Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

**Other Skills And Abilities**

* Must be computer literate and numerate with a willingness to adapt to various computer systems. It is essential that the job holder works with close attention to detail and to be questioning about the validity of the data being entered.
* Excellent time management and man management skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple coding tasks and to prioritize workload accordingly with attention to detail.
* Very good interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in a global work environment.

**Requirements**

* Educated to degree level (preferably Life Science), Nursing qualification, or relevant industry experience Trained/experienced in coding with industry standard dictionaries (e.g., MedDRA, WHO-DD)
* A minimum of 3 years of experience in clinical data coding or a related role within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device industries.

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.
  
  
We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.
  
  
To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Senior Developer(Windows)-Endpoint Sustaining** to be part of making that happen.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**About Airbound**
------------------

**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**

This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.

The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.

To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

**About Flight Systems**
------------------------

The hardware on the drone is only half of what keeps it up in the air. The rest is the software both on the craft and on our ground station. Our unique dual motor thrust vectored tailsitter with blended wing body design has to fly in almost all weather-including heavy winds and light rains autonomously. We’re targeting 1000s of flights per day across all locations, requiring us to rethink everything from firmware, controls, state estimation to even ground control and fleet management software. We’ve achieved an industry-leading payload-to-weight ratio of ~2kg drone for 1kg payload and we’re pushing this even further. Every gram matters when you’re revolutionizing logistics. This is where cutting-edge aerospace engineering meets software scalability meets real-world impact. If you get excited about solving problems that span multiple disciplines that don’t have textbook solutions, this is your playground.

**About the Role**
------------------

In this critical, hands-on engineering role, you will develop the embedded software that keeps our revolutionary aircraft flying safely and efficiently. You will build flight-critical systems, optimize real-time performance of our state estimation and control loops, and integrate cutting-edge sensors into our dual-motor thrust-vectored tailsitter platform.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Flight-Critical Firmware Development: Design and implement core embedded systems that control our unique blended wing body aircraft through complex autonomous flight operations
* Real-Time Control Systems: Develop high-frequency control loops and sensor fusion algorithms under strict timing constraints. Implement advanced flight control logic and state estimation systems that respond to changing flight conditions in milliseconds
* Hardware Integration & Optimization: Build low-level drivers for custom avionics hardware including IMUs, GPS modules, cameras, and motor controllers. Optimize code for memory and power efficiency
* Autonomous Navigation Systems: Support development of computer vision pipelines for precision landing, path planning algorithms, and obstacle avoidance systems for fully autonomous flight operations
* Communication & Telemetry: Develop robust communication protocols for ground station connectivity, fleet coordination, and real-time telemetry streaming. Ensure reliable data transmission in challenging RF environments with failsafe mechanisms

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Must-Have**
-------------

* 3-4 years or equivalent expertise in embedded/firmware engineering, with proven experience preferably in the drone/robotics industry or on similar complex real-time systems
* Core Programming Skills: Expert-level proficiency in embedded C and modern C++ 14/17+ for embedded systems, with strong knowledge of Python 3.8+ for computer vision, scripting and data analysis
* **Embedded Systems Expertise:**

  + Low-level MCU firmware with hardware interfaces, device drivers, and system programming for I2C/SPI/GPIO/UART/CAN based peripherals in bare-metal and RTOS setups
  + Proficiency with Embedded Linux systems in user-space and/or kernel-space modules, with exposure to multithreading and multiprocessing
  + Knowledge of computer vision libraries (OpenCV) and camera integration
* **Flight Control Systems:**

  + Hands-on experience with autopilot frameworks like ArduPilot/PX4 and ground control software (Mission Planner, QGroundControl, MAVProxy)
  + Strong understanding of control theory including PID controllers, and real-time feedback systems
  + Experience with SITL/HITL testing and flight simulation environments
* **Software Engineering Fundamentals:**

  + Strong test-driven development and profiling expertise for safety-critical systems
  + Mastery of Git workflows and collaborative development practices
  + Application of SOLID principles and embedded software best practices
  + Excellent documentation and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with state estimation techniques (Kalman filters, least squares) and advanced control algorithms like model predictive control, disturbance rejection control
* Experience with high-speed communication protocols: MIPI-CSI/DSI, USB cameras with v4l2 stack, Ethernet, SerDes
* Experience with ROS2/Zenoh for distributed robotics systems and inter-process communication

**Work location:** Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)  
#LI-AR1

-----------------

* **Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend** to ease your commute
* **Advanced salary credit** to support you when you need it

“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive - **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** from the ground up”

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

It drives Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD practices while leveraging skills in Angular, Java, Spring Boot, Python, Golang, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms. **Qualifications:**

**Education/Training:**

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for a curious, detail-oriented Programmer Analyst II to join our Agentic Solutions team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain intelligent automation workflows that transform complex operational process into AI agents. You'll define technical requirements for agentic systems, build scalable bot infrastructure, and drive continuous improvement across compliance and verification workflows through AI-powered solutions. Collaborating with stakeholders across operations and product, you'll identify automation opportunities, measure agent performance, and architect process improvements that reduce manual intervention and operational risk.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1. Agentic Systems Development & Technical Execution-
  
> Design, develop, and maintain intelligent automation workflows using Python, SQL, and cloud-native services (AWS Lambda, Step Functions, Bedrock, Agent core)  
> Build and optimize agentic bot infrastructure that processes complex operational processes across compliance and verification workflows  
Implement rule-based detection engines, anomaly identification, and automated decision-making pipelines  
> Develop automated monitoring systems, daily scorecards, and real-time alerting mechanisms integrated with RPA platforms  
> Ensure data integrity through automated validation checks, upstream issue flagging, and pipeline health monitoring  
> Build and maintain KPI dashboards with summarized visuals to track bot performance, success rates, and operational metrics globally  
2. Problem Solving & Intelligent Automation Designc-
  
> Decompose ambiguous operational challenges into structured automation opportunities with minimal guidance  
> Evaluate and distinguish between rule-based automation (deterministic) and AI-driven agentic approaches based on use-case complexity  
> Conduct root-cause analysis and diagnostic investigations to identify systemic gaps in bot infrastructure and upstream processes  
> Design intelligent escalation paths and exception-handling logic within agentic workflows  
> Navigate uncertainty in poorly defined problem spaces and propose scalable automation solutions  
3. Stakeholder Communication & Requirements Management  
Translate complex technical automation concepts into clear business narratives for leaders up to three levels above.  
> Proactively communicate project status, pipeline health, risks, and blockers to reset expectations with stakeholders  
Prepare and deliver business requirements reviews and automation impact assessments to senior management  
4. Project Delivery & Execution  
Scope, architect, and deliver end-to-end automation projects across multiple teams with minimal supervision  
Manage development timelines, sprint commitments, and proactively identify risks to deliverables  
Deliver production-ready, well-documented code and automation workflows that meet quality and reliability standards  
Incorporate engineering best practices including code reviews, unit testing, and CI/CD integration  
Balance tradeoffs between development speed, solution robustness, and operational risk  
  
6. Process Improvement & Strategic Contribution  
Identify transformational automation opportunities in areas heavily dependent on human resources with significant operational and financial risk  
  
7. Team Development & Technical Leadership  
Mentor and develop junior programmers on automation best practices, code quality, and agentic design patterns.  
> Participate in recruiting and technical interviewing for the team  
Share knowledge through documentation, SOPs, and optimization of analytical and engineering best practices  
Build trust through consistent delivery, proven business impact, and measurable automation outcomes  
  
About the team  
The RPE Agentic Solutions team builds and scales intelligent automation systems that safeguard Transaction Integrity across Identity Verification, Account Support, and Compliance workflows for Carrier and Driver processes. Operating at the intersection of risk management, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven operations, we design agentic solutions that reduce manual intervention, minimize operational risk, and ensure the integrity and reliability of critical verification processes at scale - partnering with product and technology teams to transform human-dependent workflows into scalable, automated systems.

* 2+ years of front-end web development experience

* Experience using SQL

title: Principal Software Engineer - AI Native UX
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you'll do:**
**UX Architecture & Strategy**
— Define and own the long-term architecture for AI-native user experiences across the platform, making critical build-vs-buy decisions (design systems, agent-to-UI interaction patterns, real-time/streaming UX for AI-generated content) to ensure the experience layer stays resilient and coherent as the platform scales.
  
  
**AI-Native Intelligent Experiences**
— Design and build user-facing surfaces where agentic backends - recommendations, autonomous triage, generated fixes/insights, multi-step agent reasoning - are exposed to end users through fast, trustworthy, low-friction interaction patterns. Own the hard UX problems unique to AI-native products: progressive disclosure of agent reasoning, graceful handling of uncertainty/latency, human-in-the-loop review flows, and making autonomous system behavior legible and controllable to end users rather than a black box.
  
  
**UXC & Workspace Platform**
— Deep ownership of the UXC (User Experience/Workspace, UI16) surface — component architecture, design system consistency, and performance — as the primary canvas AI-native features are built on top of.
  
  
**Agentic Pipeline Awareness**
— Partner closely with platform/ML teams building the agent orchestration and tool-calling infrastructure underneath (multi-agent dispatch, MCP-style tool integration, reasoning traceability) — translating what these backends can do into UX patterns that make them usable, safe, and trustworthy for real users.
  
  
**Business Alignment**
— Align UX and technical architecture with business goals, ensuring engineering velocity, experience quality, and adoption of AI-native features directly support customer acquisition, retention, and time-to-market.
  
  
**Hands-on Engineering**
— Write high-performance, clean, production-grade code primarily across the frontend/experience stack (Lit.js, React/TypeScript, design systems, component architecture), with working fluency in backend/platform code (Java, Python, Postgres, K8s) to collaborate effectively with platform teams.
  
  
**Cross-functional Execution**
— Drive business-critical UX and platform outcomes in close collaboration with ML, backend platform, and product teams.
  
  
**Engineering Culture**
— Mentor senior engineers, champion UX and engineering excellence, and foster a culture of rapid, impact-driven innovation in AI-native product development.
  
  
**Ownership & Initiative**
— Proactively identify UX and platform gaps in the AI-native experience, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and drive execution with a high degree of ownership.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into engineering and platform work—AI-powered tooling, automated operational workflows, agentic systems for fleet visibility and operations, or reasoning about AI’s impact on how infrastructure is built and run.
* 15+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated progression into senior technical leadership, and a track record concentrated in user experience and frontend platform engineering.
* Deep UXC / AI-native UX expertise - has shipped intelligent, AI-driven user experiences (not just consumed an LLM API), with strong intuition for how agent/model output should surface to real users.
* Hands-on experience with agentic/multi-agent systems from the consumer side — understands agent orchestration, tool-calling protocols (MCP or equivalent), and reasoning traceability well enough to design UX around them, even if platform-layer implementation sits with another team.
* Strong hands-on coding ability with deep design thinking in the frontend/experience stack (React/TypeScript, component/design systems), working proficiency in backend fundamentals (K8s, Java, Python, Postgres) to bridge into platform architecture conversations.
* Demonstrated ability to connect UX and engineering decisions to business outcomes - adoption, retention, time-to-market, not just technical metrics.
* Self-driven with strong ownership, able to identify UX and system gaps, propose solutions, align stakeholders, and execute at startup pace.
* Experience integrating or critically evaluating AI tools/agentic workflows in product and engineering decision-making, particularly from a user-experience and trust/legibility angle.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in distributed systems performance/scalability, even if not the primary focus of recent roles.
* Open-source contributions to major AI-native UX, design-system, or agent-framework projects.
* Prior startup experience working closely with Product and Growth teams in an early-stage environment.

Additional Information

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
**About the role**

You will build and maintain the site on WordPress and be accountable for its speed, uptime, security and SEO readiness. You will turn content and marketing needs into reliable features, manage hosting and releases, and keep the site compliant with Indian data-protection rules (DPDP Act, 2023).
 

**Key responsibilities**

**WordPress development**

 

* Build and maintain custom themes, child themes and Gutenberg blocks in PHP, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
* Develop custom plugins, custom post types, taxonomies and Advanced Custom Fields setups for articles, news, guides and landing pages.
* Integrate third-party tools: CRM and lead forms, analytics, newsletter, payment and API-based services.
* Write clean, documented, version-controlled code using Git.

**Website technical management**

 

* Own hosting, server, DNS, SSL, CDN and email-deliverability settings, and liaise with the hosting provider.
* Manage WordPress core, theme and plugin updates through a staging-to-production release process.
* Monitor uptime, errors and logs; run backups and a tested disaster-recovery plan.
* Maintain technical documentation, access control and an inventory of plugins and licences.

**Performance and technical SEO**

 

* Keep Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) in the "Good" range on mobile and desktop.
* Implement caching, image optimisation, lazy loading and database clean-up.
* Manage XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicals, redirects, schema markup, hreflang and site architecture with the SEO team.
* Fix crawl, indexing and coverage issues reported in Google Search Console.

**Security and compliance**

 

* Harden the site: firewall, malware scanning, 2FA, least-privilege roles and secure login.
* Patch vulnerabilities promptly and lead incident response.
* Implement cookie consent, privacy notices and data-handling controls in line with the DPDP Act, 2023.

**Analytics and tracking**

 

* Set up and maintain GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console and conversion tracking.
* Ensure forms, events and funnels are tracked accurately and report technical KPIs monthly.

**Collaboration and leadership**

 

* Translate requirements from content, SEO, design and marketing into scoped tasks and timelines.
* Review work from freelancers or agencies and enforce coding and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) standards.
* Train editors on the CMS and recommend improvements to the site roadmap.

**Required skills and qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of WordPress development, with a portfolio of custom themes and plugins.
* Strong PHP 8, MySQL, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3/SCSS and the WordPress REST API.
* Hands-on Gutenberg block development and ACF; working knowledge of React.
* Experience managing Linux hosting or managed WordPress hosting, cPanel or similar, DNS, SSL and CDNs such as Cloudflare.
* Proven record improving Core Web Vitals and fixing technical SEO issues.
* WordPress security best practices and incident handling.
* Git, staging workflows and deployment tools.
* GA4, Google Tag Manager and Google Search Console.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical teams.

**Preferred skills**

* Experience with news, media or content-heavy portals with large article archives.
* Headless WordPress, Next.js or WPGraphQL.
* AWS, Google Cloud or containerised hosting; CI/CD pipelines.
* Multilingual sites (WPML or Polylang) and international SEO.
* CRM integrations such as Salesforce or Zoho.
* Familiarity with the DPDP Act, 2023 and GDPR requirements for websites.
