title: Lead Software Engineer - C# .net
description:
**Lead Software Engineer – C# .net**
**Location: Hyderabad**
Are you a passionate developer with an agile mindset? And would you like to be part of a strategically important product area in one of the world’s leading software providers within the Fintech industry? Then you should join SimCorp as a C# & APL Software Engineer!
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values – caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
  
  
We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to join the Transactions product area and contribute to business-critical functionality used by our clients in their daily investment operations.
  
  
You will work as part of an experienced engineering team, contributing to backend development, component design, performance, reliability and maintainability. The work is technically interesting because it combines complex business logic, long-lived enterprise software and the need to keep improving how we build and deliver functionality.
  
  
Most of the current product logic is written in APL, while we are increasing our use of C#/.NET in new development, integrations, cloud enablement, and platform modernization. You do not need prior APL experience. We will provide training and support and we are looking for someone who is curious enough to learn what is needed while bringing strong engineering practices from C#/.NET.
  
  
You will work with experienced engineers across locations and have room to influence how we build, modernize and evolve the product.
  
  
**what You Will Be Responsible For**
As a Lead Software Engineer, you will help the team build reliable, maintainable and well-tested backend solutions. In practice, you will:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end design, implement, test and maintain backend functionality using APL and, where relevant, C#/.NET
* Drive technical discussions and decision-making aligned with long-term business goals
* Architect scalable, secure and high-performance solutions
* Contribute to code quality, performance and long-term maintainability
* Mentor and guide a team of engineers through code reviews, technical planning, and agile practices
* Ensure system reliability through unit testing, integration testing and CI/CD pipelines
* Work closely with product managers, engineers and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver client-relevant functionality
* Investigate technical issues, performance bottlenecks and bugs and help design sustainable solutions
* Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to technical discussions within the team

**What We Value**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field
* 7+ years of hands-on experience with C# and .NET technologies
* Expert knowledge of C#, .NET Core/Framework and backend development
* Good understanding of object-oriented design, clean code, APIs, and integration patterns
* Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and Git-based workflows
* Ability to work with complex business logic and collaborate with both technical and non-technical colleagues
* Interest in learning APL. Prior APL experience is not required
* Experience with Azure or cloud-based development is an advantage, but not a prerequisite

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Experience from fintech, financial services or another regulated industry
* Exposure to functional, array-oriented or vector-based programming languages
* Experience with Azure services or cloud-based development
* Experience mentoring other engineers or taking ownership of a component

**Benefits**
Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.
  
  
Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
  
  
**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
For any questions you are welcome to contact Viswanath Tangella (viswanath.tangella@simcorp.com), Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Processing
description:
**Aliases:**
Staff Engineer, Senior Staff Engineer, Lead Engineer, Senior Technical Lead, Senior Architect, Platform Architect, Data Architect, Solutions Architect (Engineering), Principal Engineer at a smaller company
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values.
  
  
**This opportunity**
Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early members, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
  
  
The Data Platform group in India owns parts of the pipeline that ingests, processes, stores, and serves healthcare data at a scale very few organizations operate at. Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve the same engineering rigor that has transformed other industries, and that is the work: correctness under volume, reliability under failure, and speed without cutting the corners that regulated health data does not allow anyone to cut.
  
  
**Who We Need**
We are seeking engineers who think in platforms. You will own a processing domain or a multi-team data capability, define its architecture, and make that architecture legible enough that the teams building inside it can move quickly without asking permission. The problems at this level are the recurring ones: the class of data-quality defect that keeps returning, the chronic cost line, the incident that has a different proximate cause every quarter and the same root cause every time. You will remain hands-on, because the credibility of the architecture depends on it.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own a platform, a processing domain, or a multi-team data capability, including both its architecture and its technical roadmap.
* Define the architecture for your domain and write it down clearly enough that teams can build inside it without constant consultation.
* Drive modernization, reliability, scalability, and cost programs that cross team boundaries.
* Solve the systemic problems that show up as recurring incidents, cost escalations, or repeating data-quality defects.
* Influence the technical direction of several teams through design review, written architecture, and working prototypes.
* Set engineering standards for the domain and make them hold without relying on a reporting line.
* Mentor SDE2 and SDE3 engineers and raise the design bar of the whole group, not only of your own projects.
* Stay hands-on through prototypes, critical-path code, and the hardest debugging in the domain.

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 to 12 years of professional software engineering experience.
* Ownership of a platform or domain rather than a single system, with architectural decisions that outlived your involvement.
* Deep distributed systems and data-processing expertise at production scale.
* Strong hands-on coding ability that is current, not historical.
* Demonstrated cross-team influence, meaning architecture that other teams adopted because it was right rather than because it was mandated.
* Cloud-native architecture on Azure or equivalent, with real depth on cost, reliability, and security.
* Track record of mentoring senior engineers and improving how a group designs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Healthcare data, clinical informatics, or any other heavily regulated data domains.
* Experience standing up or scaling an engineering site, or a new platform area from zero.
* Governance, lineage, privacy-preserving processing, or large-scale de-identification.
* Public technical writing, conference talks, or sustained open-source contribution.

title: AI/ML Compiler Developer (NPU Acceleration)
description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
**MTS SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER**
**THE ROLE:**
  
  
We are looking for a dynamic, energetic Lead / Staff Software Engineer to join our growing team in AI (Artificial Intelligence) group. In this role, the individual will be responsible for developing AI/ML specific C/C++ kernels and dataflow schedules for AMD Ryzen Processors built on XDNA Neural Processor Units (NPU) to map LLMs, Stable Diffusion networks on NPU. As a C++ Kernel Developer, you will play a crucial role in designing, optimizing, and implementing machine learning kernels specifically tailored for vector processors. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, speed, and accuracy of our machine learning models.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Kernel Development:
* Design and implement highly optimized C++ kernel library for NPU/GPU.
* Collaborate with the research and software teams to integrate these kernels into the existing software stack.
* Vector Processor Optimization:
* Work closely with hardware engineers to understand the architecture of VLIW vector core units such as MAC, GeMM, and non-linear functions.
* Develop vectorized code that leverages SIMD (Single Instruction, Multiple Data) and ILP (instruction level parallelism) for maximum performance.
* Performance Profiling and Tuning:
* Profile and analyze the performance of existing kernels.
* Identify bottlenecks and optimize critical sections for better throughput.
* Testing and Validation:
* Develop CPU models for the ML operators in C++/ Python to validate accuracy.
* Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure correctness and reliability.
* Validate kernel performance across different hardware platforms.
* Documentation and Collaboration:
* Document design specs for new kernels and the performance improvements.
* Follow coding guidelines, use tools like git to maintain code and create pull-requests, and documentation.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including machine learning researchers and software engineers.

  
  
**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**
  
  

* Excellent C/C++ and Python coding skills
* Good understanding of SIMD/Tensor/VLIW processor architecture to exploit parallelism.
* Experience with vectorized programming (SIMD) and parallel computing.
* Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) is a plus.
* Experience with silicon bring-up and pre-silicon validation on Emulation platforms is a plus.
* Knowledge of low-level hardware details (cache hierarchy, memory access patterns) is desirable.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for performance optimization.

**Academic Credentials**
BS/Masters/PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with around 10/8/5 year experience respectively.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About SkySpecs**

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so that less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is helping to make this possible by automating the operations and maintenance of wind farms using advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon.

SkySpecs launched the world’s first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of the US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding the health of turbine blades. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.

**What will you be getting into?**

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help shape the future of our Horizon platform and the way we build software. Horizon is the platform behind SkySpecs' wind and solar inspection and asset-management business, and the work is hands-on, building end-to-end.

As the cost of producing code falls, an engineer's impact comes more than ever from judgment, design, and outcomes, not volume. AI is central to how we work here, and we treat it as serious leverage: a force multiplier for engineers who already have strong instincts, not a substitute for them. We expect everyone to keep pushing what AI, automation, and agents make possible, and to bring the judgment that makes that leverage pay off.

We do not separate thinking from doing. You will be expected to independently take broad, highly ambiguous problem statements, formulate scalable technical solutions, and participate directly in delivery by writing and owning production code.
**We value a founder’s mindset; the people closest to the work are expected to challenge assumptions, optimize proposed approaches, and actively engineer high-impact business outcomes.**

This is a full-stack engineering role. While engineers may develop areas of deeper expertise, we expect everyone to be capable of working across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and developer tooling as needed to deliver outcomes. We value engineers who can understand the entire system, formulate end-to-end solutions, and contribute wherever the work requires.

Our platform is built using AWS, GitLab, Auth0, Grafana, Terraform, Kafka, Node.js, Nest.js, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL, React, Ant Design, Vitest, Playwright, and PostgreSQL.

**IN A GIVEN WEEK, YOU WILL:**

Formulate solutions, evaluate tradeoffs, and break work into executable milestones and implementation plans.

**[55%]**
Build and ship software:

* Authoring and infrastructure as code.
* Designing and implementing new services and APIs.
* Building reusable user experiences and workflows.
* Improving reliability, performance, security, and developer productivity.
* Reviewing code generated by peers and by agents
* Leveraging AI tools and autonomous agents to accelerate delivery.

Improve Horizon, our engineering systems, and the way we work. Examples include:

* Building internal tooling and automation.
* Improving documentation and architectural clarity.
* Reducing operational toil.
* Expanding AI and agent capabilities.
* Improving testing, observability, and deployment workflows.
* Exploring new ideas, experiments, and prototypes that could improve Horizon or the way we build software.

**Success is measured by outcomes delivered, not lines of code written.**

* 7+ years of experience designing, shipping, and operating production software systems.
* A proven track record of operating with absolute self-direction—capable of taking a loosely defined, high-level mandate and driving it to production with minimal to no supervision.

* Impact: Contribute to building the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

title: Manager I - Senior Software Engineer, SAP Quality Management
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision – transforming patients’ lives through science. In oncology, hematology, immunology and cardiovascular disease – and one of the most diverse and promising pipelines in the industry – each of our passionate colleagues contribute to innovations that drive meaningful change. We bring a human touch to every treatment we pioneer. Join us and make a difference.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients’ lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care.
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer, SAP Quality Management should have strong experience supporting and delivering SAP QM capabilities in an SAP S/4HANA environment, with working knowledge of manufacturing integration points across PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS. This role focuses on quality inspection processes, quality notifications, batch and material quality controls, master data, regulated validation expectations, and operational support in an FDA and GxP environment.
  
  
If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!
  
  
🚀 Shape the Future of Quality Technology | SAP S/4HANA Quality Management Specialist
  
  
Are you ready to make an impact where Quality meets Innovation?
  
  
We're looking for a talented SAP Quality Management Specialist to join our global team and help drive the next generation of intelligent, compliant, and cloud-enabled quality solutions. If you're passionate about SAP QM, digital quality transformation, AI-enabled innovation, and regulated manufacturing excellence, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
💡 Delivering Smart Quality Solutions
  
  

* Design, implement, and support SAP S/4HANA Quality Management solutions across inspection planning, inspection execution, results recording, usage decisions, quality notifications, batch release, and quality certificate processes.
* Own end-to-end delivery across requirements, design, configuration, testing, deployment, validation support, and operational excellence.
* Provide scalable and compliant SAP QM solutions aligned with business and regulatory expectations.

🔗 Connecting the Dots
  
  

* Partners with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Warehouse, Laboratory, and Enterprise Platform teams to deliver integrated quality processes.
* Support integrations with MES, LIMS, Batch Release Hub, BTP/BIAP, and other enterprise platforms.
* Ensure seamless execution of quality processes across manufacturing, inventory, warehouse, and laboratory systems.

☁️ Driving Cloud & AI Transformation
  
  

* Support digital quality transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA and cloud technologies.
* Apply AI, GenAI, automation, process mining, reporting, and analytics to improve operational efficiency, accelerate documentation, strengthen quality compliance, and reduce manual effort across SAP QM processes.
* Identify and support AI-enabled use cases including quality anomaly detection, proactive incident prevention, automated root cause analysis, intelligent incident resolution, quality trend analytics, and process mining insights.
* Use AI/GenAI responsibly in regulated environments to support GxP documentation, test script preparation, validation evidence reviews, audit-readiness checks, and knowledge management while aligning with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) Teams, data integrity, and validation expectations.
* Contribute to enterprise modernization initiatives involving SAP RISE, BTP/BIAP, and digital manufacturing capabilities.

🛡️ Keeping Us Compliant
  
  

* Support FDA, GxP, Information Technology Quality System (ITQS), and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) compliant solution delivery, documentation, and operations.
* Produce and maintain GxP documentation including SDLC deliverables, validation plans, requirements traceability, test scripts, testing evidence, deviations, approvals, and audit-ready records in alignment with Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) and Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) expectations.
* Ensure quality processes and system changes meet regulatory, validation, inspection readiness, and compliance requirements.

🤝 Collaborating & Innovating
  
  

* Build strong relationships with Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Validation, Enterprise Platform, IT Business Partners, and external partners.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote adoption of emerging technologies.
* Lead stakeholder communications and influence cross-functional decision making.
* Mentor team members and contribute to organizational capability development.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* ✅ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* ✅ 5–7+ years of SAP QM experience in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments.
* ✅ Strong experience in Inspection Management, Quality Notifications, Batch Management, Quality Master Data, and Quality Certificates.
* ✅ Experience supporting FDA-regulated and GxP-compliant environments, including Information Technology Quality System (ITQS) / Information Technology Quality Assurance (ITQA) documentation, validation evidence, traceability, change control, and audit readiness.
* ✅ Knowledge of SAP QM integration with PP/PI, MM, IM, WM/EWM, MES, and LIMS.
* ✅ Experience supporting SDLC, validation, testing, deployment, and operational support activities.
* ✅ Ability to apply AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, and process mining to improve SAP QM delivery, documentation quality, incident prevention, testing efficiency, and compliance outcomes.
* ✅ Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
* ✅ Passion for continuous learning, innovation, and adoption of emerging technologies.

Bonus Points If You Have...
  
  

* ⭐ Experience with SAP RISE, SAP BTP/BIAP, cloud transformation initiatives, or enterprise integration platforms.
* ⭐ Experience with Batch Release Hub and advanced quality release processes.
* ⭐ Hands-on exposure to AI/GenAI, Copilot-style productivity tools, automation, process mining, predictive analytics, anomaly detection, or intelligent operational support in SAP, Quality, Manufacturing, or regulated environments.
* ⭐ Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated manufacturing industry experience.
* ⭐ Experience supporting global SAP programs and enterprise-scale deployments.

What Makes You Stand Out
  
  
You combine deep SAP Quality Management expertise with a passion for innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. You thrive in complex environments, build trusted partnerships across business and technology teams, and proactively leverage modern technologies such as AI, GenAI, automation, process mining, analytics, and cloud platforms to improve quality processes, reduce manual effort, strengthen compliance, and support better patient outcomes. You bring a growth mindset, strong leadership capabilities, and a commitment to delivering compliant, scalable, and business-focused solutions in a regulated digital environment.

**Secondary Technology Stack:**

Angular or other modern web UI frameworks, Docker, Helm, CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, logging and monitoring tools, distributed application troubleshooting, and basic infrastructure or cloud operations knowledge.

* Familiarity with CI/CD practices and working knowledge of deployment pipelines in enterprise environments.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

**About the job**
-----------------

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started - and as a manager, you guide the way.  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of software engineers. You will be responsible for career growth, providing coaching, and managing performance to build an engineering organization.
* Partner with product management and technical leads to define and execute the technical strategy for Google feedback and user areas.

title: .NET Developer
description:
**Overview**

The .NET Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining reliable software solutions using modern Microsoft technologies. The role requires a strong hands-on developer with 2–5 years’ experience who can work confidently with modern .NET technologies including C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, Web API, RESTful services, and modern application development practices. The role also requires good SQL capability, preferably across SQL Server or Oracle, and practical exposure to modern UI frameworks such as React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. The developer will work closely with technical leads, business analysts, testers, architects, and delivery stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, well-tested, performant, and maintainable applications across enterprise platforms. Basic awareness of legacy .NET technologies is desirable to support existing applications and contribute to gradual modernisation where required.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Contribute to the delivery of modern, secure, scalable, and maintainable applications using C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST APIs, Entity Framework or similar ORM/data-access patterns, and relational databases.
* Apply sound engineering practices including clean coding, SOLID principles, unit testing, code reviews, source control discipline, and effective technical documentation.
* Support continuous improvement by adopting relevant tools, automation, cloud services, secure development practices, and AI-assisted engineering responsibly where appropriate.

Operational Management

* Analyse business and technical requirements, clarify assumptions, and contribute to solution design with guidance from technical leads and architects.
* Design, build, enhance, and maintain application components across back-end services, APIs, database objects, integrations, and front-end features using React or similar modern UI frameworks where applicable.
* Write clean, efficient, reusable, and testable code using modern C#, ASP.NET Core, RESTful API patterns, asynchronous programming, LINQ, dependency injection, and SQL Server or Oracle.
* Develop and consume RESTful APIs, implement validation, authentication/authorisation checks, structured logging, exception handling, and robust error handling to support integration with internal and external systems.
* Work with SQL Server or Oracle to write and optimise queries, understand joins, indexes, stored procedures, execution behaviour, and troubleshoot performance or data-related issues.
* Contribute to UI development using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, including API integration, component-level changes, validation, and basic usability improvements.
* Prepare and maintain unit tests, support test automation where applicable, and work with testers to resolve defects through triage, root-cause analysis, and technical fixes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support maintenance and enhancement of existing legacy .NET applications where required, while contributing to gradual modernisation using current .NET, API, cloud, and UI development practices.
* Use Git-based source control, branching, pull requests, code review feedback, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes in line with team standards.

Collaboration & Team Contribution

* Work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, testers, architects, delivery managers, and support teams to deliver quality software outcomes.
* Communicate progress, risks, blockers, and technical considerations clearly and in a timely manner.
* Share knowledge with team members, contribute to documentation, and support a positive engineering culture focused on learning and continuous improvement.

Governance & Risk

* Follow secure coding, data protection, accessibility, audit, and information security requirements relevant to enterprise financial technology applications.
* Support production stability by creating maintainable solutions, documenting changes, participating in defect analysis, and assisting with release and post-release support activities when required.

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

* Minimum Qualification: Bachelor of Engineering / MSc / BSc – IT / Computer Science / Any Graduate with relevant software development experience.
* 2–5 years of hands-on software development experience using modern C#, .NET 6/7/8 or later, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, RESTful services, and object-oriented programming concepts.
* Strong understanding of full SDLC, Agile delivery practices, requirements analysis, estimation, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong SQL capability using SQL Server or Oracle, including writing complex queries, joins, stored procedures, indexes, performance-aware database access, query optimisation, and troubleshooting data-related issues.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs and integrating applications with internal or external systems.
* Strong understanding of SOLID principles, design patterns, clean code practices, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, exception handling, logging, security awareness, and performance considerations.
* Experience with unit testing, mocking frameworks, debugging, defect triage, and root-cause analysis.

title: Sr Applications Developer
description:
**About the role and team**  
  
FinTech is part of the CFO's organization and is responsible for innovating and building Financial Products & Systems. Our DNA is customer obsession, high-quality products, teamwork, and transparency. We provide systems for compliance, data reliability, and audit, ensuring timely availability of business-critical data.
  
  
This role has two halves, split roughly evenly:
  

* **Automation delivery (~50%)** : lead a 15-20-member external vendor team that builds and supports our RPA (robotic process automation) bots.
* **System controls & SaaS security (~50%)** : keep our financial systems, including cloud ERPs such as Oracle Fusion, Coupa, etc secure, well-controlled, and SOX-compliant.

  
The two halves belong together. Automation is how we turn manual controls into automated, continuous ones. Strong controls are what make our bots safe to run on financial systems.
  
  
**What you'll do**  
  
**Lead Automation Delivery**

* Manage and mentor a 15-20 person vendor team across development and production support.
* Set development standards, review designs, and sign off on solutions before they go live.
* Own bot reliability: SLAs, escalations for critical failures, and root-cause fixes so problems don't repeat.
* Run the vendor relationship: scope, staffing, performance scorecards, and quarterly reviews.
* Choose the right tool for each job. Use an API or native integration where it will outlast a screen-based bot.
* Manage the MS Power Automate Platform, deployment pipelines, and licensing.

**SaaS ERP Security & Identity Management**

* Design and maintain user roles and access in FinTech applications and cloud ERPs (Oracle Fusion, Oracle EPM Cloud, Coupa), including role-based access (RBAC), so each person has only the access they need.
* Find and fix segregation-of-duties (SoD) conflicts, including conflicts that span two apps.
* Govern single sign-on, MFA, user provisioning and de-provisioning, access requests, access certifications, and privileged/emergency admin access (PAM).
* Track every system and bot account: who owns it, what it can access, and when its credentials rotate.
* Work with the IAM team on the integrations, APIs, workflows, rules, and reporting that FinTech applications need.
* Review vendor SOC reports and make sure we run the controls each vendor expects from us.
* Check each quarterly vendor release for security and control impact before it goes live, and make sure security is built into the development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Monitor tenant configuration and audit logs for risky changes, and lead efforts to strengthen the overall security of FinTech applications.

**Own SOX & System Controls**

* Manage IT general and application controls: user access reviews, change management, SoD, and SDLC.
* Act as the main point of contact for SOX audits of FinTech applications, including evidence, walkthroughs, and auditor questions.
* Track control deficiencies through to remediation, working with Financial Risk Management.
* Partner with the IAM team on access requests, certifications, and role-based access.

**Automate Controls**

* Identify manual controls that can be automated, starting with high-risk, repetitive ones, and deliver them through the RPA team.
* Explore AI for anomaly detection and continuous control monitoring.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience, including 3+ years leading teams of 15 or more. Experience leading external vendor teams is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with **Microsoft Power Automate** (Desktop and Cloud). Exposure to UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism is a plus.
* Proven experience with **SOX audits, IT controls, and identity & access management** .
* Hands-on security experience with a **cloud ERP** . Oracle Fusion is preferred; SAP, Workday, or NetSuite are also considered.
* Functional knowledge of **Oracle EBS R12 and/or Oracle Fusion Financials** .
* Working knowledge of SQL, APIs, and scripting (Python or PowerShell).
* Clear communication with finance, audit, and technical stakeholders. Able to hold a vendor accountable while keeping the relationship strong.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SailPoint, Okta, Coupa, Oracle EPM Cloud, Oracle Integration Cloud, or access-governance tools.
* Experience with an on-premise to cloud ERP migration.
* Exposure to AI-driven automation (Copilot Studio, AI Builder, document processing).
Certifications: CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, CCSP, PL-500, PL-600, or ITIL.  

  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

description:

**Job Title: Windows Endpoint Security Developer (C/C++ & Driver Development)**  
**Location | Remote**  
**Time Zone | US Time Zones (EST–PST)**

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a Windows Endpoint Security Developer with strong C, C++, and Windows driver development skills to help build an AI-focused endpoint protection platform. This is a full-time, hands-on engineering role. Your first focus will be building a Windows service that collects system, network, and process data to detect and respond to threats. * Perform advanced debugging and troubleshooting across kernel and user mode using WinDbg, crash dump analysis, and Sysinternals tools
* Ensure compliance with Microsoft driver signing, PatchGuard, Secure Boot, and kernel security restrictions
* Optimize agent performance to minimize system impact while maintaining visibility and protection
* Participate in threat modeling, secure coding reviews, and internal security assessments

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience working on Windows endpoint security products such as AV, EDR, DLP, firewall, or intrusion prevention (non-negotiable)
* Deep expertise in C, C++, and Windows driver development
* Strong understanding of Windows OS fundamentals and internals
* Experience with kernel-mode communication mechanisms (IOCTL, ALPC, shared memory)
* Proficiency with WinDbg, crash dump analysis, and Sysinternals tools
* Knowledge of Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* Understanding of Microsoft driver signing, PatchGuard, and Secure Boot
* Experience with threat modeling and secure coding practices
* Strong written and spoken English with a clear, professional communication style
* Must have prior remote work experience, be fluent with remote collaboration tools and platforms (such as Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Asana, or similar), and have ideally worked with US or UK-based companies. Applications without this experience will not be considered.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with cross-platform endpoint security (macOS/Linux)
* Experience building telemetry or behavioral analytics pipelines for threat detection
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven security products or monitoring AI agent activity

**Tools & Technology:**

* C and C++
* Windows Driver Frameworks (WDM, KMDF, UMDF)
* Windows Filtering Platform (WFP), minifilters, and ETW
* WinDbg and Sysinternals tools
* Slack, Zoom, and other remote collaboration tools

**About GF**
------------

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power-efficient and high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner for customers around the world. GF's talented global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

  

**Introduction**
----------------

GlobalFoundries is seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineer to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across the embedded software development lifecycle. This role combines deep expertise in embedded systems with practical experience applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI-powered automation to accelerate software development, validation, and product delivery.

The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader driving the integration of AI-enabled workflows across platform software, firmware, test, and validation teams. This position requires strong hands-on experience in embedded software development, AI/ML technologies, and engineering productivity tooling, enabling the transformation of how software is designed, implemented, tested, documented, and maintained.

  
  

**Your Job**
------------

* Define and drive the technical strategy for AI adoption across the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, coding, testing, validation, documentation, and release activities.
* Develop AI-powered solutions that generate embedded software components such as low-level drivers, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), BSP integrations, register-access layers, and validation utilities from specifications and hardware documentation.
* Design and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems utilizing source code, technical documentation, silicon specifications, issue-tracking systems, and historical validation data.
* Build and fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs) and LLM-based solutions for embedded software generation, test automation, defect triage, and engineering productivity enhancement.
* Develop automated pipelines that convert requirements and design specifications into executable embedded test cases, validation frameworks, and simulation scripts.
* Create AI-based solutions for post-silicon validation, including log analysis, anomaly detection, failure clustering, regression triage, and root-cause assistance.
* Integrate AI-enabled tooling into engineering workflows, source control systems, code review processes, IDEs, CI/CD environments, and validation frameworks.
* Establish model evaluation methodologies and quality metrics focused on correctness, code quality, coverage improvements, build success rates, productivity gains, and developer adoption.
* Define governance, traceability, security, IP protection, and compliance controls for AI-generated software artifacts in safety-critical development environments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and AI enablement across software, architecture, validation, and platform engineering teams.
  

  

**Other Responsibilities**
--------------------------

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
* Support engineering excellence through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements.
* Maintain compliance with company quality standards, development processes, and product security requirements.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **4 to** **8 years** of industry experience in embedded software development, firmware engineering, platform software, or related fields.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Hands-on experience developing embedded software for microcontrollers, microprocessors, automotive systems, or embedded Linux platforms.
* Strong understanding of RTOS concepts including scheduling, interrupts, synchronization mechanisms, memory management, and low-level driver development.
* Experience with protocols and interfaces such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, or related embedded communication technologies.
* Practical experience with AI/ML frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience developing and deploying RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval systems.
* Proven expertise in model fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience integrating AI solutions into software engineering workflows, developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated validation environments.
* Knowledge of model serving, optimization, quantization, and deployment in on-premises environments.
* Experience with embedded testing, silicon bring-up, HIL validation, system debugging, and hardware/software integration.
* Ability to work effectively across distributed global engineering teams.
* Ability to travel up to 10% as required.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.  
  
  
With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.  
  
  
Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer who can turn complex data into simple and meaningful business insights.

Location: Pune, India

You will work closely with business teams, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and other technology teams to understand business needs and build scalable reporting and analytics solutions.

The role requires strong hands-on experience in Power BI, SQL, Snowflake, and MicroStrategy, along with a good understanding of Databricks and modern data platforms.

We are also looking for someone who understands how Business Intelligence is evolving, especially how strong semantic models can support AI-assisted and natural-language analytics.

**Impact of the Role**

• Understand the business meaning behind the data, ask the right questions, and build reporting solutions that business teams can trust and easily use.

• Take ownership, solve complex reporting problems, work directly with business and engineering teams, and help improve the overall BI platform.

• Contribute to how business users will interact with enterprise data in the future as Business Intelligence continues to move toward semantic models, conversational analytics, and AI-assisted reporting.

**Technology Platforms You Will Work On**

• Power BI, DAX, Power Query, Power BI Copilot, and Microsoft Fabric

• MicroStrategy, Intelligent Cubes, REST APIs, SDK-based integrations, and System Manager

• SQL, Snowflake, Azure Databricks, and Delta Lake

• Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Blob Storage, and Azure DevOps

• Python, PySpark, and Apache Spark

• Apache Kafka and other streaming technologies

• AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and natural-language analytics

• CI/CD pipelines and Dev, QA, and Production environments

**Key Responsibilities**

• Design and develop scalable Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.

• Build and maintain business semantic models with clear measures, dimensions, relationships, KPIs, and business definitions.

• Develop and maintain MicroStrategy reports, dashboards, scorecards, and reporting solutions.

• Design and work with MicroStrategy schema objects such as attributes, facts, hierarchies, relationships, metrics, filters, prompts, consolidations, and custom groups.

• Work with MicroStrategy projects, Intelligent Cubes, caching, aggregate tables, and VLDB settings to improve reporting performance.

• Write and optimize complex SQL queries across large enterprise datasets.

• Work with Snowflake, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and other enterprise data platforms.

• Understand business requirements and convert them into clear data models, semantic models, reports, and analytical solutions.

• Build solutions using good data modeling practices, including fact and dimension models, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.

• Improve dashboard, SQL, semantic model, and reporting performance.

• Work with business teams to define and maintain consistent business metrics, KPIs, definitions, and calculation logic.

• Understand how AI agents and natural-language analytics can work on top of a governed business semantic layer.

• Add meaningful metadata, descriptions, synonyms, relationships, and business context so AI-based analytics can interpret business questions correctly.

• Work with Data Engineering and AI teams to ensure AI-assisted analytics uses trusted and governed enterprise data.

• Ensure data quality, security, access control, lineage, and consistency across reporting solutions.

• Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide long-term fixes.

• Support deployments and production releases across reporting platforms.

• Review solutions developed by other engineers and help maintain good engineering standards.

• Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge and best practices across the team.

• Take ownership of solutions from requirement understanding through design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

**Qualifications**

• 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a similar role.

• Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including semantic models, DAX, Power Query, and performance optimization.

• Strong hands-on experience with MicroStrategy reporting and dashboard development.

• Good understanding of MicroStrategy schema objects, metrics, filters, prompts, Intelligent Cubes, caching, and performance tuning.

• Strong SQL skills with experience working with large enterprise datasets.

• Good hands-on experience with Snowflake.

• Experience working with Azure Databricks / Delta Lake or similar modern data platforms.

• Strong understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including fact tables, dimensions, star schemas, and snowflake schemas.

• Good understanding of semantic layers, business measures, KPIs, metadata, and relationships.

• Experience with report and query performance optimization.

• Understanding of data quality, governance, security, lineage, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

• Ability to troubleshoot complex reporting and data issues independently.

• Ability to work directly with business users and translate business questions into technical solutions.

• Good communication and problem-solving skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.

Good to Have

• Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) for building simple ETL/ELT and reporting pipelines.

• Ability to use ADF to move data from source systems to Azure Blob Storage or other cloud storage.

• Understanding of ADF linked services, parameters, variables, and environment-specific configurations.

• Exposure to deploying ADF resources across Dev, QA, and Production using Azure DevOps and CI/CD.

• Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI Copilot.

• Basic understanding of how LLMs, RAG, and AI agents can work with enterprise data and business semantic models.

• Experience with Python, PySpark or Apache Spark.

• Exposure to Apache Kafka or other streaming technologies.

• Experience with MicroStrategy REST APIs or SDK-based integrations.

• Exposure to MicroStrategy administration or System Manager activities.

• Experience working with retail, e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, customer, or finance data would be an advantage.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

• Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.

• Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.

• Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.

• Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.

• Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

  

**Williams-Sonoma India Pvt. Ltd.**

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide.

title: Staff Enterprise App Admin - Ironclad CLM and Workflow Developer
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Senior Ironclad CLM Solution Architect and Workflow Developer  
  
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of customer experience software, bringing the power of AI and cloud innovation to customers worldwide.  
  
Living our values every day results in our team first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together.  
  
We are seeking a Senior Ironclad CLM Solution Architect and Workflow Developer to join our Business Technology team. This role leads the design, implementation, and administration of Ironclad as Five9's contract lifecycle management platform and serves as the technical lead for replacing DocuSign CLM with Ironclad. You will architect the target-state solution, build and maintain the Workflow Designer workflows, templates, and clause libraries used to generate, route, negotiate, and execute Five9's customer agreements, and guide the migration of existing templates, workflows, and executed agreements from DocuSign CLM.  
  
The ideal candidate is a senior business systems professional with seven or more years of experience, including at least three years of hands-on CLM implementation or administration and at least two years configuring Ironclad in production. The candidate holds the Ironclad Core Administration Certification and, ideally, has completed Ironclad's Implementation Bootcamp and Verification Exam (Verified Partner Consultant, Implementation), with prior experience leading a CLM migration or platform replacement strongly preferred.  
  
The position is a hybrid role combining in-office and work-from-home days, based in Chennai or Bengaluru, India, and requires regular overlap with United States business hours, including work until approximately 11:30 PM India Standard Time when needed.  
  
Key Responsibilities

* Lead the solution design and implementation of Ironclad CLM, defining the target-state architecture for contract intake, generation, review, negotiation, approval, signature, repository, and reporting, and serving as the subject matter expert for Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Finance.
* Own the replacement of DocuSign CLM with Ironclad, including migration strategy and roadmap, template and workflow inventory and rationalization, repository and metadata migration of executed agreements, parallel run, cutover, in-flight agreement handling, and decommissioning of legacy DocuSign CLM components.
* Design, build, and maintain Ironclad workflows in Workflow Designer, including launch forms, conditional logic, approval routing, notifications, escalations, signature routing, and exception handling.
* Create and maintain commercial document templates and clause libraries — including Master Services Agreements, service orders, order forms, amendments, and renewals — using legal language and clauses approved by the Legal team, with conditional content based on product, pricing, transaction type, and geography.
* Administer and configure the Ironclad platform, including users, groups, roles and permissions, SSO and provisioning, repository structure, metadata and record types, and environment and release management.
* Design and maintain the integrations between Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ, and Ironclad, including Workflow Sync and Record Sync, field mappings, and generation of service orders from CPQ quotes and quote lines, ensuring contract status and executed agreements are accurately returned to Salesforce.
* Define the electronic signature approach for the future state, including Ironclad Signature and any external eSignature provider retained during or after the transition, and manage the related configuration and signature coordination.
* Use the Ironclad API and webhooks to build custom integrations, automations, and data migration tooling with other Five9 systems as required.
* Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT to translate business and legal requirements into scalable solutions, and lead change management, documentation, user training, and adoption.
* Troubleshoot workflow, document generation, data mapping, integration, and signature issues, and drive them to resolution.
* Establish administration standards, governance, and best practices, and mentor team members and partner consultants on Ironclad configuration and design.
* Identify opportunities to simplify contract processes, reduce manual effort, and accelerate contract execution, and track outcomes through Ironclad reporting and analytics.

Key Requirements  
  
Required Qualifications:

* Seven or more years of business systems experience, including at least three years of hands-on CLM implementation or administration and at least two years of hands-on Ironclad configuration in production.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ironclad Core Administration Certification required. Completion of the Ironclad Implementation Bootcamp and Verification Exam (Verified Partner Consultant, Implementation) strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading a CLM implementation or migration, ideally replacing DocuSign CLM or a comparable platform, including template and workflow rationalization, repository and metadata migration, and cutover planning.
* Advanced hands-on experience designing and building Ironclad workflows in Workflow Designer, including launch forms, conditional logic, approval routing, notifications, escalations, and exception handling.
* Experience building and maintaining commercial document templates (e.g., Master Services Agreements, service orders, order forms, amendments, renewals) and clause libraries using legal language approved by the Legal team.
* Experience designing and supporting Salesforce and Salesforce CPQ integrations with a CLM platform, including generating documents from quotes and quote lines and syncing contract data and status back to Salesforce (Account, Opportunity, Quote, Quote Line, Product, Contract).
* Experience with the Ironclad API, webhooks, and integration patterns, plus working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTML, basic JavaScript, and SQL.
* Working knowledge of electronic signature platforms, including DocuSign eSignature and Ironclad Signature, covering templates, recipients, signing order, and authentication.
* Basic Salesforce administrator-level knowledge (objects, fields, relationships, and permission sets) and familiarity with the Salesforce CPQ data model and document generation process.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word template formatting, including tables, styles, sections, headers, and conditional content.
* Strong solution design, analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to lead initiatives independently, influence stakeholders across Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT, and work across a distributed, global team.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Salesforce Certified Administrator or Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification is a plus.
* Prior experience with DocuSign CLM and DocuSign eSignature administration, which helps with migration scoping, is a plus.
* Experience with project delivery methodologies, enterprise change management, and mentoring or leading consultants is a plus.

Why You'll Love This Role:

* You will lead the move to Ironclad and play a central role in shaping how Five9 generates, negotiates, and executes customer contracts at scale.
* You will partner closely with Legal, Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and Finance, gaining broad visibility into the commercial contracting process.
* You will work at the intersection of Salesforce, Salesforce CPQ, and Ironclad, solving practical, cross-system problems that directly impact deal velocity.
* If you enjoy simplifying complex processes, setting technical direction, and building reliable, well-documented systems, this role offers a strong opportunity to grow as a CLM architect.

Workplace location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside further than a 30 kilometer driving distance from either our Bangalore or Chennai offices. Candidates who reside within a 30 kilometer driving distance of one of our office locations would be required to work in-office 3 days a week.  
Workplace location: This role is hybrid and requires 3 days a week in office.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Digital Payments and Emerging Markets
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

What if every customer around the world could pay for their order in the way that feels most natural to them? The Digital and Emerging Payments team at Amazon is working to make that happen, building payment experiences that work across geographies, platforms, and customer expectations. From Android and Fire devices to resilient back-end systems that guarantee no order is ever lost, the technical challenges here are real and the customer impact is global.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help lead the technical direction of our payments platform. You will own the design and delivery of systems that process transactions at massive scale, mentor fellow engineers, and shape architectural decisions that determine how millions of customers complete their purchases. If you’re passionate about solving complex distributed systems challenges and want to make a direct impact on the customer experience, this could be the role for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the design and delivery of payment platform features end-to-end, ensuring systems are reliable and performant across multiple geographies and device platforms.
* Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating technology choices, defining engineering best practices, and guiding future system design while balancing short-term delivery with long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with product managers, partner engineering teams, and stakeholders across Amazon to define requirements, align on technical approaches, and deliver integrated solutions.
* Mentor engineers on your team through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance, raising the overall quality of the codebase.
* Use metrics and operational data to identify improvement opportunities, drive rapid iteration on features, and maintain high availability for payment systems.

  
A day in the life  
You review a design document for a new payment method integration, providing feedback that helps a teammate strengthen their approach. You dive deep into code, building a service component that must process thousands of transactions per second while staying resilient when downstream dependencies are unavailable. You join a cross-team sync with product managers to discuss upcoming requirements for an emerging market, then pair with a junior engineer on a tricky concurrency issue. Throughout the day, you balance hands-on engineering with the architectural thinking that keeps the platform reliable and ready for what comes next.  
  
About the team  
The Digital and Emerging Payments team is responsible for how Amazon customers pay across the globe. We build and run the systems that connect customers to the payment methods they trust, whether that is a credit card, a mobile wallet, or a region-specific option unique to their market. Our mission is to make every transaction feel simple and reliable.  
  
We are an inclusive group that values knowledge sharing and mentorship. Team members at every experience level contribute to technical decisions, and we invest in each person's growth by matching projects to development goals. If you want to shape the future of payments at Amazon's scale, we would love to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Sr. SAP ABAP Developer
description:
Dorman was founded on the belief that people should have greater freedom to fix motor vehicles. For over 100 years, we have been driving new solutions, releasing tens of thousands of aftermarket replacement products engineered to save time and money, and increase convenience and reliability. Founded and headquartered in the United States, we are a pioneering global organization offering an always-evolving catalog of automotive, heavy-duty and specialty vehicle products. Today, we have more than 3,800 employees across 29 different locations, with a family of brands that also includes SuperATV and Dayton Parts. Publicly traded under the stock ticker DORM, reaching a revenue of $2.13 billion in 2025.

Everyone who works at Dorman is called a Contributor. We need everyone, regardless of role and experience, to contribute to our success. That means everyone has a unique ability to make an impact on the business. We encourage all our Contributors to bring their authentic selves to work. The freedom to pursue new ideas, offer different perspectives, and grow in your career is fundamental to working at Dorman.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Sr SAP ABAP Developer will provide hands-on technical leadership, architecture, design, and solution delivery for SAP application development, workflow automation, integrations, enhancements, and production support. This offshore role requires deep ABAP expertise and proven experience leading delivery teams, defining scalable technical solutions, and integrating SAP with SAP and non-SAP platforms. The position will partner closely with business, functional, architecture, integration, Basis, Security, QA, and U.S.-based teams to deliver secure, maintainable, high-performing solutions across logistics and Order-to-Cash processes.

**Primary Duties**
------------------

* Lead the offshore SAP development team across solution design, project delivery, enhancements, interfaces, workflow, upgrades, releases, defect resolution, and production support.
* Own technical discovery, feasibility analysis, solution architecture, design decisions, effort estimates, delivery plans, technical specifications, and implementation approaches for complex SAP requirements.
* Design and develop scalable Object-Oriented ABAP solutions using classes, interfaces, inheritance, polymorphism, exception classes, design patterns, dependency separation, reusable frameworks, and ABAP Unit.
* Lead SAP Business Workflow design and development, including workflow templates, tasks, events, agents, containers, business objects/classes, deadlines, escalations, substitutions, work-item administration, email notifications, debugging, monitoring, and restart/recovery procedures.
* Architect and deliver SAP-to-SAP and SAP-to-non-SAP integrations using ALE/IDoc, RFC, BAPI, OData, REST, SOAP, web services, APIs, file-based interfaces, middleware, and event-driven patterns as applicable.
* Own inbound and outbound ALE/IDoc solutions, including message types, basic types, extensions, custom segments, partner profiles, ports, process codes, distribution models, change pointers, serialization, status management, monitoring, error handling, and reprocessing.
* Design and support dialog and Module Pool applications, including screen flow logic, PBO/PAI processing, table controls, tab strips, custom controls, validations, locking, authorizations, transaction design, and maintainable separation of presentation and business logic.
* Lead RF development for warehouse execution, including RF screens, logical transactions, menus, function codes, barcode/scanning flows, device considerations, validations, exception handling, performance, and operational troubleshooting.
* Partner with functional teams to design solutions across SAP Logistics Execution and Order-to-Cash, including sales orders, deliveries, picking, packing, warehouse operations, post goods issue, transportation, billing, outputs, and related integration touchpoints.
* Conduct architecture, design, and code reviews; enforce standards for performance, security, maintainability, error handling, naming, documentation, testability, and transport discipline.
* Use ABAP Test Cockpit, Code Inspector, ABAP Unit, SQL analysis, runtime analysis, traces, and security checks to improve code quality and prevent critical issues from progressing across the landscape.
* Promote SAP-standard, upgrade-stable solutions and clean-core principles through released APIs, approved enhancement technologies, side-by-side extensions, and disciplined management of custom code and technical debt.
* Lead root-cause analysis for complex cross-system incidents and determine whether corrective action belongs to custom code, configuration, master data, workflow, middleware, authorization, network, or infrastructure.
* Plan and assign work, manage priorities and dependencies, review deliverables, coach developers, build technical capability, and maintain delivery accountability across onsite and offshore teams.
* Coordinate testing, transports, release readiness, cutover, go-live, hypercare, incident response, and production stabilization; communicate status, risks, options, and recovery plans to technical and business stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement through reusable assets, automation, observability, performance optimization, technical-debt reduction, development standards, and knowledge-sharing practices.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA development and transformation programs, including modern ABAP syntax, ADT, CDS views, AMDP, RAP, OData, custom-code remediation, and simplification-item impact analysis.
* Experience applying clean-core principles, released APIs, approved extension methods, ATC governance, security checks, and upgrade-stable extensibility patterns.
* Experience with SAP BTP, Integration Suite or comparable middleware, event-driven integration, API management, side-by-side extensions, or SAP Build Process Automation.
* Experience with EWM, LE-TRA, SAP Transportation Management, output management, Fiori/UI5, Web Dynpro ABAP, or warehouse and transportation-system integrations.
* Automotive, automotive aftermarket, discrete manufacturing, distribution, or a similar high-volume logistics industry background is an advantage. Familiarity with EDI-driven customer and supplier processes, scheduling agreements, advance shipping notices, labeling, warehouse execution, and high-volume order fulfillment is beneficial.
* SAP certification in ABAP, S/4HANA, integration, workflow, BTP, or logistics is preferred but not required.

**Education / Experience**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, MIS, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 12-15 years of hands-on SAP ABAP development experience, with substantial experience as a Technical Lead, Development Lead, or Solution Lead in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven leadership experience managing or coordinating SAP development teams, mentoring developers, reviewing technical deliverables, managing estimates and priorities, and collaborating across global time zones.
* Expert-level Object-Oriented ABAP experience, including solution architecture, reusable frameworks, exception handling, testable design, performance optimization, and complex debugging.
* Strong SAP Business Workflow experience with end-to-end workflow design, development, enhancement, agent determination, event linkage, deadline and escalation handling, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Strong SAP and non-SAP integration experience using ALE/IDoc, RFC, BAPI, APIs, OData, REST, SOAP, web services, files, and enterprise middleware or integration platforms.
* Strong inbound and outbound ALE/IDoc development and support experience, including custom types/extensions, interface recovery, duplicate prevention, high-volume processing, monitoring, and production issue resolution.
* Strong hands-on experience with Module Pool programming and dialog applications, including screen design, PBO/PAI, table controls, custom controls, validations, authorizations, and transaction handling.
* Hands-on RF development experience supporting warehouse mobile transactions, scanning workflows, RF screens, logical transactions, menus, function codes, device behavior, and troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated design and solutioning experience, including requirements analysis, fit-gap assessment, technical architecture, integration design, non-functional requirements, estimates, risks, prototypes, design documentation, and stakeholder presentations.
* Experience with ABAP Dictionary, reports, ALV, enhancements, BAdIs, user exits, BTEs, BAPIs, RFCs, forms, application logs, background jobs, conversions, and performance tuning.
* Functional and technical understanding of SAP Logistics Execution, Shipping, Warehouse Management, Transportation, and end-to-end Order-to-Cash processes.
* Experience with software development lifecycle, Agile delivery, change control, transport management, incident and problem management, release governance, cutover, and production support.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain architecture, technical trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to both technical and business audiences.
* Preferably, candidates should be based in Hyderabad.

description:
